label: entertainment
title: Ibyamamare 10 bifite abandi bantu basa mu buryo butangaje-Amafoto
content:
Mu buzima busanzwe abantu cyane cyane ibyamamare baba bifuza kuba umwihariko kugeza no ku isura yabo. Gusa n’ubwo bimeze gutya abantu barasa cyane ndetse na nyirubwite hari igihe abyibonera bitagombeye ko abantu bamubwira ko asa na runaka. Ku ruhande rwa rubanda rwa giseseka ho hari n’abibagisha kugira ngo base n’ibyamamare runaka cyangwa se bahindure ishusho yabo. Uyu munsi tugendeye ku rutonde rwakozwe na Bright Side, tugiye kubagezaho urutonde rw’ibyamamare 10 bifite abantu basa nabyo neza kandi nta sano y’amaraso bafitanye yewe akenshi batanakomoka mu bihugu bimwe. Itegereze neza urebe ko wabasha gutahura isura y’icyamamare usanzwe uzi. 1.Álvaro Morte


Uyu ni umukinnyi wa filime wo muri Esipanye yitwa Álvaro Antonio García Morte.Yakinnye filime yakunzwe cyane "Lacasa de Papel" yitwa Sergio "El Professor" 2.Ed Sheeran


Amazina ye yose yitwa Eduard Christopher Sheeran. Ni umuhanzi w’Umwongereza wakunzwe mu ndirimbo nka "Shape Of You","Perfect" n’izindi. 3.Britney Spears


Ni Britney Jean Spears akaba ari umuhanzi, umwanditsi n’umukinnyi wa filime w’Umunyamerikakazi akaba azwi mu ndirimbo nka "Criminal" na "One More Time" 4.Rihanna


Ni Robyn Rihanna Fenty umuhanzi w’Umunyamerikakazi wamenyekanye mu ndirimbo nka "Diamond" na "Man Down". 5.Selena Gomez


Selena Marie Gomez ni umuhanzi, umwanditsi n’umukinnyi wa filime w’Umunyamerikakazi wamenyekanye mu ndirimbo nka "Same Old Love" na "Heart Wants what It Wants". 6.Shakira


Shakira Isabel Mebarak Ripoll ni umunya-Columbia akaba umuririmbyi,umwanditsi n’umukinnyi wa filime wamenyekanye cyane mu ndirimbo yakoreye igikombe cy’isi cy’umupira w’amaguru yitwa "Waka Waka". 7.Angelina Jolie


Angelina Jolie ni umukinnyi wa filime w’Umunyamerikakazi wamenyekanye muri filime nyinshi zirimo iyitwa "In the Land of Blood and Honey". 8.Kate Moss


Katherine Ann Moss ni Umwongerezakazi w’umunyamideri akaba n’umucuruzi. 9.Maisie Williams


Margaret Constance Williams ni Umwongerezakazi wamamaye cyane nko muri filime yitwa "Game of Thrones" yanyuraga cyane kuri Televiziyo. 10.Blake Lively


Blake Ellender Lively ni umukinnyi wa filime w’Umunyamerikakazi wamenyekanye muri filime zitandukanye nka "Gossip Girl" na "A Simple Favor".

title: Ingaruka za Coronavirus : Ubukene kubari batunzwe n’ibikorwa by’imyidagaduro
content:
Kimwe n’abandi bafungiwe ibikorwa byabatungaga bya buri munsi mu rwego rwo gukumira icyorezo cya covid-19, abakora ibikorwa by’imyidagaduro nk’abahanzi, ababyinnyi, abatunganya umuziki, abacuruza utubari ndetse n’utubyiniro na bo bakomeje guhura n’ingaruka z’izi ngamba kuko aho bakuraga imibereho hasa n’ahahagaze. Mu itangazo ry’ibyemezo by’Inama y’Abaminisitiri idasanzwe yateranye kuwa 1 Mata 2020 hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga, iyobowe na Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame ikaba yari igamije kwiga ku cyorezo cya Covid-19, hemejwe ko iminsi yo gukomeza ifungwa ry’ingendo n’ibikorwa bimwe na bimwe byari byarahagaritswe yongerewe kugeza kuwa 19 Mata 2020. Ni itangazo rije rikomeza iryo kuwa 21 Werurwe 2020 ryahagarikaga ingendo n’ibikorwa bihuriza abantu benshi hamwe nk’utubari, ibitaramo, resitora, inama n’ibindi. Abari batunzwe no gukora ibikorwa by’imyidagaduro babayeho bate? Hari ingeri z’abantu mu Rwanda bari babayeho ahanini kubera ibikorwa bifitanye isano n’imyidagaduro nk’abahanzi, abatunganya umuziki,abavanga umuziki mu tubari,abacuruza utubari,ababyinnyi,abaririmba karaoke,abamansuzi,indaya,abareberera abahanzi n’abandi. Abareberera bakanafasha abahanzi Inararibonye muri muzika nyarwanda Muyoboke Alex wafashije abahanzi n’amatsinda nka Dream Boyz,Charly na Nina, Tom Close, Davis D  n’abandi, aganira n’umunyamakuru wa Bwiza.com yavuze ko iki cyorezo cya Coronavirus cyakomye muzika nyarwanda mu nkokora kitibagiwe n’ubukungu bw’igihugu muri rusange. Yagize ati "Ubundi umuhanzi atungwa n’abafana be. Ubu ni ugufata indirimbo twakoze tukaba ari zo tureba kuri televiziyo. Hari ibitaramo bitandukanye twari twateguye byaburijwemo kandi byaduteye igihombo, ni ugutegereza tukazasubukura igihe bizaba bishoboka." 

Muyoboke Alexis umwe mubafite ijambo rinini mu myidagaduro y’u Rwanda Ibi biragaragaza neza ko hari ingaruka iri subikwa rizateza umuziki nyarwanda muri rusange ku batunganya umuziki no kubareberera abahanzi , umuhanzi ashobora no gucika intege zo gukora umuziki kubera ko atazabona aho yerekanira ibyo bihangano bye ,  hari n’abamwe byahagaze bafite imishinga y’indirimbo muri za studio. Uhujimfura Jean Claude ,uyobora inzu itunganya umuziki "Kikac Music" mu kiganiro yagiranye na Yambi Tv ku ngaruka Coronavirus izasigira muzika nyarwanda, yavuze ko mu bahanzi akorana na bo Danny Vumbi, Mico The Best na Isra Holly Rapper ku ikubitiro bahise basogongera kungaruka z’isubikwa ry’ibitaramo. Yagize ati "Mico The Best, nka ambassador wa tuberculosis yari afite ibitaramo bizenguruka igihugu byagombaga gutangira kuwa 10 bigasoza kuwa 28 Werurwe, akaza kubisoresha "collabo" n’umuhanzi ukomeye muri Nigeria. Ibi byose byahise bihagarara kandi imyiteguro yari yarangiye." Uhujimfura yanavuze kuri Danny Vumbi na we yarafite ibitaramo na "collabo" n’umuhanzi wo hanze ariko birangira na byo bidakunze kubera Coronavirus. Abari batunzwe no kuririmba "Karaoke"
 Umuririmbyikazi akaba n’umunyamakurukazi, Uwimana Janne, usanzwe aririmba "Karaoke" yabwiye Bwiza.com ko muzika nyarwanda na Karaoke byahungabanye bikomeye kubera icyorezo cya Covid-19. Yagize ati"Benshi muri twe twakoraga umuziki nk’akazi ariko ubu turi mu ngo iwacu, turi gukoresha amafaranga nta yandi twinjiza. Ubu kuba iminsi yo kuguma mu rugo yiyongereye ni ikigeragezo gikomeye kuko ibyo umuntu yateganyije bizashira atarabona andi mafaranga." Uwimana akomeza avuga ko nubwo atari mu kazi kamwinjiriza yanze kwicara ntacyo akora, ubu ari kwiga guitar akabifatanya no kwigisha umwana we piano ndetse akaba anafite umushinga wo gukorana indirimbo n’umwana we vuba aha. Uwimana kandi yavuze ko ari gutunganya urubuga ruzaba rwitwa www.gutehowcomment.com akazajya arukoresha aha amakuru abamukurikira kandi rukazaba rufite imbuga nkoranyambaga na channel ya YouTube.Uwimana Janne niwe wabonetse ariko ibibazo abisangiye n’abandi nkawe cyangwa bo bafite ibiruseho. Indaya na ba Slay Queens  Indaya zaryaga aruko zabonanye n’abagabo zirabaho zite muri ibi bihe bitagira ubuzima bwo kwishimisha? Ese ba Slay Queens batungwaga no gukoresha imbugankoranyambaga zabo neza aho bashyiragaho amafoto n’amashusho akurura imbaga bo barayafatira he batemerewe gusohoka? Ibi bibazo umuntu utari muri aba abyumva nk’ibyoroshye ariko birakomeye kuko uru rwego rw’aba bantu rubaho kuko rwagiye mu ruhame kandi ubu ni ikizira. 

Shady Boo ngo yaba akumbuwe  Abakora uburaya mu mujyi wa Rusizi basanzwe babyemera baravuga ko muri iki gihe cy’ingamba zo kwirinda COVID-19 babayeho mu buzima bubi cyane burimo inzara , ubwoba bwa buri gihe bwo kwirukanwa mu nzu bacumbikamo babuze icyo bishyura, abafite abana bakavuga ko batakibona icyo babagaburira. Mu kiganiro na Bwiza.com, bamwe muri bo basanzwe biyita ‘abatabazi’ kubera ko ngo batabara abagabo baba bananiranywe n’abagore babo cyane cyane ku byerekeranye n’imibonano mpuzabitsina bakaza bazigana zikabatabara, bamwe mu bagabo bakorera mu mujyi wa Rusizi bafite ingo ahandi igihe batari mu ngo zabo bakabagana n’ababakenera bavuye hirya no hino bagiye muri uyu mujyi, aba bose baravuga ko batakibabona kandi ari bo bari babatunze n’abana babo. ati: "Akazi kacu ni ugutanga serivisi, abo twazihaga bose basanze abagore babo, nijoro twajyaga gutega abaza mu mahoteli no mu tubari none byose birafunze, n’abagabo b’ino badusambanyaga usohotse umugore amukurikiza ijisho ku buryo twamanjiriwe rwose kandi ntidushobora kugira ahandi twerekeza. Twabaye indaya kubera ubupfubyi cyangwa imiryango mibi tutasubiramo, ntituzi niba ubuyobozi butwemera nk’abandi banyarwanda,nk’ubu turabaho dute koko?’’ Ubu biragoye ko Umugabo yakwemera kuryamana n’umukobwa atazi aho akomotse kandi biranagoye kuba bahura kuko bahuzwaga n’ibitaramo, utubyiniro, akabari, amahoteli n’ahandi hahurira abantu mu buryo bwo kurya ubuzima ariko ubu byose byarahagaritswe. Slay Queens nka Shady Boo, Super Sexy n’abandi ntabyo gukora amafoto bakibona n’ugize icyo ashyira ku rukuta rwe rwa Instagram aba agira abantu inama mu kwirinda icyorezo cyangwa se akaba ari kugaragaza irungu yatewe no kuba adasohoka. 

Abakora uburaya muri Rusizi ngo babayeho nabi Umunyamakuru wa Bwiza.com yavuganye na Nsengiyumva Francois ucuruza akabari akanakora ku cyocyezo mu kabari kazwi nka "Humeka Bar" gaherereye mu murenge wa Gitega ho mu karere ka Nyarugenge amubwira ko bikomeje uku nta kizere cy’ubuzima abona. Yagize ati"Twe boss wacu yari yagerageje aduha udufaranga Duke two kuba turya twakongera gukora akazayadukata, gusa bikomeje gutya yadushirana kandi ntiyabona andi yo kuduha. Hari benshi nzi banirukanwe kuko nta masezerano y’imikorere tuba dufite, ubu babayeho nabi cyane." Abafana nk’urwego rudashora ho byifashe gute? Umuziki ni ryo pfundo umuhanzi aba ahuriyeho n’abafana be kuko ibyishimo byabo babisoroma mu bihangano by’abahanzi. Iyo umuhanzi azimye abafana baramwibagirwa bakamuvaho bakajya ku bandi bari gukorana imbaraga muri icyo gihe. Ese abafana baraza kureka nde bafane nde ko atari urw’umwe? Abasoromaga ibyishimo mu muziki se bo babayeho bate muri iyi minsi yuje irungu? Biragaragara ko atari urw’abahanzi gusa ahubwo n’abafana ibi bihe byo kubura imyidagaduro biri kubatonda. Ni ibihe bibazo byaterwa no kwigunga? Ikigo gishinzwe kugenzura indwara (Centre for Disease Control and Prevention, CDC) gitangaza ko abantu bari hejuru y’Imyaka 12 byibuze abarenga 7% bagira ikibazo cyo kwigunga. Ibi byashimangiwe n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima (WHO) risobanura ko kwigunga ari indwara rusange ku isi kandi ikaba iteza ubumuga bunyuranye uyirwaye. Bivugwa ko ku isi yose abasaga miliyoni 350 barwaye iyi ndwara. Ikinyamakuru le Figaro cyatangaje ko ubushakashatsi bugaragaza ko muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika abantu basaga miliyoni 42 bari mu kigero cy’imyaka 45 bafite ikibazo cyo kwigunga bikabije, ibintu bavuga ko bingana no kuba wanywa isigara 15 z’itabi ku munsi. Ibi byashimangiwe n’abandi bo muri kaminuza ya Brighan Young, mu mwaka wa 2015 aho basanze kwigunga bifite ingaruka zikomeye cyane, binaza gushimangirwa kandi n’umwarimu Julianna Holtlunstad, aho avuga ko kugirana ubusabane n’abandi ari intwaro nziza umuntu yakabaye akoresha mu buzima bwe kugira ngo arusheho kubaho neza. Julianna yavuze ko kwigunga bikabije bigira ingaruka zisa neza nk’iz’umubyibuho ukabije, iz’umunywi w’ibiyobyabwenge, ndetse ngo bingana no kunywa isigara 15 ku munsi. Kwigunga bikabije kandi ngo byongera ibyago byo gupfa vuba kuko umuntu umeze utyo ahorana ibibazo bidashira birimo kurwara za infection zitandukanye, indwara zidasobanutse, umunaniro ukabije, kanseri zitandukanye ndetse na zimwe mu ndwara zibasira ubwonko. Dore ng’ibi ibiba bitegereje umuntu uri mu bwigunge ukumbura icyo akunda ntakibone. Nyuma y’uko umubare wabarwaye Coronavirus mu Rwanda ukomeje kuzamuka aho ugeze ku bantu 84, ingamba  zo gufunga ibikorwa bimwe na bimwe birimo n’ingendo zitari ngombwa byongererewe igihe aho hashyizweho ibindi byumweru bibiri by’agateganyo kugeza kuwa 19 Mata 2020. byaye bihagaritswe , uyu mwanzuro wakomye mu nkokora abafite aho bahurira Guverinoma y’u Rwanda ikomeje igikorwa cyo gufasha abashyizwe mu kaga n’ihagarikwa ry’imirimo imwe n’imwe bakaba bagorwa no kubona amafunguro, ku bufatanye n’inzego z’ibanze habarurwa imiryango ibabaye kurusha indi bakayigenera ibyo kurya bibafasha muri iki gihe kitoroshye nubwo bitaragera kuri bose.

title: Lil Wayne yasabye abagabo ibitangaje ku bijyanye no kubana n’abagore
content: Icyamamare mu njyana ya Rap muri Amerika no ku isi muri rusange,  Dwayne Micheal Carter Jr. uzwi nka Lil Wayne araburira abasore bakibyiruka bakunda abagore cyane (biruka inyuma y’abagore) kuko bibicira icyerekezo cy’ubuzima. Lil Wayne kimwe n’abandi bahanzi bagenzi be bahuriye kuri iyi njyana, bavugwaho amakuru yo gukunda itabi, ubusinzi ndetse no gukunda abagore. Gusa ubu butumwa yatanze dukesha Salone Daily agaragaza ko bishobora kuba ari ibyo avugwaho ari ibihuha. Uyu muhanzi yagize ati: “Nkiri umwana, nakurikiye inzozi zanjye, ntabwo nakurikiye abagore. Abagore ni umugisha kuri twe abagabo ariko ku bakiri bato bashaka kugera ku ntego nziza mu buzima, mugomba kubanza kugera ku nzozi zanyu. Ntabwo mukwiriye kwiruka inyuma y’abagore. Abagabo bafite intego ntabwo biruka ku bagore, ahubwo bakurikira inzozi zabo.” Lil Wayne ahamya ko umuntu ufite inzozi ashaka kugeraho, adashobora kubona umwanya wo kwiruka inyuma y’abagore. Lil Wayne yavutse tariki ya 27 Nzeri 1982.  Ni umuhanzi wageze kuri byinshi akesha injyana ya Rap birimo ibihembo bya Grammy Awards bitanu, BET Awards 11, Billboard Music Awards enye, MTV Video Awards ebyiri na NAACP Image Awards. Lil Wayne kandi ni umuyobozi w’inzu itunganya umuziki ya Young Money Entertainment, akaba ari na we wayishinze.

title: Diamond arahigira kurongora bitarenze 2020
content: Umuhanzi Diamond Platnumz wo mu gihugu cya Tanzania, avuga ko nta kintu  na kimwe abuze kugira ngo abe yarongora, none ubu akaba ahigira kubikora mu mwaka utaha wa 2020.  Diamond avuga ko afite umukunzi, Tanasha Donna ukomoka muri Kenya ngo wanamubyariye umwana mwiza, akagira inshuti n’ibindi byangombwa, bityo ko gukora ubukwe atabibona nk’ibyamunanira ariyo mpamvu ahigira kubusoza umwaka utaha. Nk’uko ikinyamakuru Star cyo muri Kenya kibitangaza, Diamond yagize ati "Mfite ibyangombwa byose binyemerera kurongora, mfite umugore mwiza wambyariye umwana mwiza, ndarya ndetse mfite n’inshuti nziza". Byari biteganijwe ko Ku itariki ya 14 Gashyantare uyu mwaka aribwo Diamond na Tanasha bagombaga gukora ubukwe ariko biza gusubikwa. Uyu mugore asobanura ko byatewe n’ibura ry’umubyeyi we. Tanasha ati "Byari biteganijwe ko ubukwe buba ku wa 14 Gashyantare, ariko nabwiye Diamond ko ntabukora mama adahari, Mama ntabwo byamushobokeraga kuba yava mu kazi". Tanasha yabyariye Diamond mu kwezi kwa 10, ni umwana bise Naseeb Jnr akaba uwa Kane w’uyu muhanzi nyuma y’abandi batatu yabyaranye n’abagore babiri, [Zari  babyaranye babiri & umunyamideli Mobeto amubyaza umwe]. Diamond yakundanye n’abakobwa benshi barimo na nyampinga wa Tanzania mu 2006, Wema Sepetu baje gutandukana bageze mu bihe byo gutegura ubukwe aribwo yahise abana na Zari Hassan. Zari yabanye na Diamond banabyarana abana babiri mbere y’uko batandukana ku itariki ya 14 Gashyantare 2018, ku munsi w’abakundanye, uyu mugore ashinja uyu muhanzi kumuca inyuma. Iki kinyamakuru gitangaza ko Diamond yari yaravuze ko ubukwe bwe na Zari buzaba ubw’agatangaza ndetse n’ubwa mbere muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba ariko bashwana batabukoze. Nyuma yo gutandukana na Zari nibwo Diamond yakundanye n’uyu munyamideli akaba n’umunyamuziki ukomoka mu gihugu cya Kenya, Tanasha Donna, biza kurangira anamuteye inda yavutse mu Ukwakira.

label: entertainment
title: Museveni yanze gukorana indirimbo na Chris Brown, ahitamo Kanye West na Lionel Litchie
content: Perezida wa Uganda, Yoweri Kaguta Museveni arashaka kugaruka mu muziki, agakorana indirimbo n’abahanzi bakomeye ku  ruhando mpuzamahanga. Don Balaam Baruhagara ureberera inyungu z’uyu muhanzi (Museveni) yabwiye ikinyamakuru Blizz Uganda ko yanze kuzakorana na Chris Brown bitewe uburyo bw’imirimbire ye butamunyura. " Ubu turi gukorana na Kanye West ndetse na Lionel Litchie. Twashakaga gukorana na Chris Brown ariko Muzehe yarabyanze kubera ko ngo adakunda umuziki we n’uburyo awuririmbamo." Balaam. Repubulika Iharanira Demukarasi ya Congo ni igihugu kimaze igihe kinini gifite umuziki ukunzwe ku mugabane. Balaam ngo ari kumvisha Museveni uburyo ari byiza gukorana indirimbo n’umuhanzi Kanda Bongo Man wo muri iki gihugu. Kugaruka mu muziki kwa Museveni ni ukugira ngo yongere yigarurire imitima y’abaturage ba Uganda, cyane abakunzi b’umuziki. Umuziki ni na yo ntwaro Depite Robert Kyagulanyi (Bobi Wine) utavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bwa Uganda yifashishije akurura imitima y’urubyiruko rwinshi muri iki gihugu, mu gihe amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu azaba mu 2021, aba bombi bakaba baremeje guhatana. Mu 2015 mbere y’amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu mu 2016, Museveni yasohoye indirimbo yise ’Ye Ngoma’. Iyo yakoze mu 2010 yayise ’Penkoni’. Izi ndirimbo zombi zumvikanamo amagambo nka ’you want another rap?’ Muri Uganda, umuziki na politiki birajyana kuko uruhande abahanzi nka Jose Chameleone na Bobi Wine babogamiyemo ruzana n’abandi bantu benshi. Ni ko byagenze no muri Kenya, aho umudepite Charles Njagua Kanyi uzwi nka Jaguar mu muziki yabonye uyu mwaka awukesha abayoboke be mu muziki.

title: Amafoto: Faustin wahoze akinira Rayon Sports na APR FC, yasabye aranakwa umukunzi we
content:
Kuwagatandatu tariki ya 9 Ugushyingo 2019, myugariro ukinira ikipe ya Buildcon FC muri Zambia, Usengimana Faustin  wanakiniye Rayon Sports na APR FC yasabye ndetse anakwa umuumukobwa bari bamaranye igihe bakundana , Bayingana Daniela. Ni umuhango wabereye i Rubavu, mu Busitani bwa kaminuza ya UTB. Biteganyijwe ko tariki ya 15 Ugushyingo 2019 aba bombi bazasezerana imbere y’amategeko mu murenge wa Kimironko mu karere ka Gasabo. Nkaho tariki ya 16 Ugushyingo saa 15:00’ bakazasezerana imbere y’Imana muri Parkland Remera. 
 Usengimana Faustin ni umwe mu bakinnyi bake b’abanyarwanda bakinnye igikombe cy’Isi cy’abatarengeje imyaka 17 cyabereye muri Mexique muri 2011.Hano  mu Rwanda kandi yakiniye ikipe Rayon Sports na APR FC kandi atwarana nazo ibikombe.

title: Perezida Museveni yashimagije abatsinze muri East Africa's Got Talent
content: Perezida Museveni yashimagije abana babiri baraye begukanye irushanwa rya East Africa’s Got Talent ryari rihuje abanyempano baturuka mu bihugu bitatu, u Rwanda,Kenya na Uganda. Abinyujije kuri twiter ye Museveni yagaragaje akanyamuneza yatewe no kuba Esther&Ezekiel bakomoka muri Uganda aribo begukanye ibihumbi 50 by’amadorali bahigitse abandi benshi bahatanaga.  Yagize ati"Abana banjye bakuru bambwiye ko mfite abuzukuru bafite impano, narabakurikiranye muri abaririmbyi beza" Esther&Ezekiel bo muri Uganda begukanye irushanwa rya ‘East Africa’s Got Talent’ bahigitse abarimo Itorero Intayoberana ryo mu Rwanda, Janelle Tamara wo muri Kenya, Yada Dance, DNA na Shaloom Accapella bo muri Uganda Esther&Ezekiel ni abanya-Uganda bombi baravukana. Esther yavuze ko iri rushanwa ryamufashije kwitinyuka. Avuga ko kwamamara atari ukwiremereza ahubwo ko bigusaba gusabana n’abandi. [caption id="attachment_145866" align="alignnone" width="300"]  Bashyikrijwe sheki y’ibihumbi 50 by’amadorali  [/caption]

title: Amag G yarahiye ko atari agakingirizo cyangwa umusifuzi w’inda Bruce Melody ngo yaba yarateye Agasaro
content:
Nyuma y’iminsi bivugwa ko Bruce Melody atorohewe kubwo kwihakana umukobwa yateye inda akamwihakana bigatuma ajyanwa mu nkiko ,Amag The Black watanzwe nk’umuhamya yabyamaganiye kure.
Agasaro Diane uvuga ko yatewe inda n’umuhanzi Bruce Melody yatanze abahamya bari bahari ubwo yaryamanaga n’umuhanzi Bruce barimo na Amag The Black ariko we abajijwe koko niba yahamya ibyo yabonye abyamaganira kure.

Ngo kuba yaratanzwe nk’umutangabuhamya ko umuhanzi Bruce Melody  yaba yararyamanye na “Agasaro Diane” yasobanuye ko atabihamya.
N’ubwo Amag ari inshuti magara ya Bruce Melody avuga ko atahamya ko yaryamanye n’uyu mukobwa ngo  kuko Atari ishuka cyangwa agakingirizo ndetse ntanabe umusifuzi w’inda.

Amag yagize ati:”njye se nabyemeza nte ko ntari amashuka cyangwa agakingirizo, ikindi kandi si ndi umusifuzi w’inda! njye mfite umuntu wanjye dukundana kereka niba bashaka kumunteranyaho”
Diane yemeza ko Bruce Melodie ari we wamuteye inda akanavuga ko mbere y’uko bijya mu itangazamakuru Melody yayemeraga ariko byamara kumenyekana akabihakana.
 Kanda hano ujye ubona amakuru yihuse kandi kugihe kuri Facebook no kuri twitter

title: Umuririmyi w’icyamamare Jean Claude Gianada yageze mu Rwanda
content: Umuhanzi w’umufaransa w’icyamamare mu muziki w’indirimbo zisingiza Imana benshi bazi nka Classique , Jean Claude Gianadda, yageze i Kigali aho aje mu gitaramo “Stand up for Children with Disabilities ” kizaba kuri uyu wa gatandatu tariki ya 5 Ukwakira 2019, ni igitaramo yatumiwemo na Kolari Christus Regnat yo mu Rwanda isengera muri Kiliziya Gatolika muri Paruwasi ya Regina Pacis. [caption id="attachment_145683" align="alignnone" width="7360"] Jean Claude Gianada ubwo yari ageze mu Rwanda [/caption] Jean Claude Gianada ubwo yageraga ku kibuga cy’indege cya Kigali yakiriwe n’abaririmbyi bo muri Chorale Christus Regnate barimo perezida n’umutoza wiyi Chorale. Mu kiganiro yahaye abanyamakuru yavuze ko yishimye ubwo yahabwaga ubutumire n’umuyobozi wa Chorale “ nabyakiriye neza ubwo nabonaga ubutumire bwo gutaramira mu Rwanda”. [caption id="attachment_145687" align="alignnone" width="7360"] Jean Claude Gianada yavuze ko yari asanzwe azi u Rwanda cyane kuri Kibeho [/caption] Muri iki gitaramo “Stand up for Children with Disabilities ” amafaranga azavamo azakurwamo ibizaba byakoreshejwe mu mitegurire yacyo, asigaye azaba ari inkunga yo gushyigikira ikigo Centre inshuti zacu-Gahanga - Kicukiro, cyita ku bana bafite ubumuga butandukanye. Igitaramo kizabera Camp Kigali, tariki 5/10/2019, kuva saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba. Aho kwinjira azaba ari amafaranga 10,000 frw mu myanya y’imbere ndetse na 5,000 frw ahasigaye. Naho tariki ya 6/10/2019, ni igitambo cya Misa, kizabera kuri Paruwasi Regina Pacis i Remera kuva saa Ine za mu gitondo.

content: 3.2. Urugomo (violence) : Gusesengura violence duhereye mu byahishuwe (rÃ©vÃ©lation) Ibyahishuwe ni amagambo azwi nk’ava ku Mana. Muri uwo murongo nta cyava ku Mana cyagombye kurangwamo urugomo cg ibisa narwo kuko bivuye ku Mana y’Ukuri, ikunda Ukuri kandi y’Urukundo. Mu nyandiko nyinshi zitandukanye ndetse mu bitabo byitwa bitagatifu harangwamo imvugo z’urugomo rweruye. Aha havuka ibibazo bibiri : 1/Ese koko ibyo twita ibitabo bitagatifu byahishuwe byavuye ku Mana ? 2/ Imana nziza y’Amahoro yashyigikira urugomo ? Mu kugerageza gusubiza ibi bibazo turareba imiterere y’ibyitwa ijambo ry’Imana. Nkuko nabivuze hejuru ijambo ry’Imana haba mu myumvire ya kisilamu cg iya gikristu, Ijambo ry’Imana kenshi riza rije gusobanura igikorwa abantu bakoze hagati yabo, noneho Imana ikazana urumuri kuri cyo cg se igisobanuro, icyerekezo. Dufashe urugero kw’ivanjiri ya Yezu. Yohani 6:1-16 Yezu atubura imigati. Ikigaragara ni uko icyitwa ijambo ry’Imana gihera ku bantu baje basanga Yezu ahantu ku Kiyaga cya TibÃ©riade. Si Imana itangiye ivuga,ahubwo ni igikorwa kibaye noneho Imana ihatangira ubutumwa. Ibi rero bivuze ko iyo dusanze urugomo mu byahishuwe, biba ari Imana ivuga urugomo ruri mu Bantu noneho ikaza kubabwira uko babyitwaramo. Ibyo kandi bishobora no gushingira k’uburyo iyo mbaga (Oumat cg nation) ibayeho, niba urogomo ari rwo rurangiza ibibazo hagati y’abantu, Imana yaruvugaho nk’ibibutsa uko basanzwe bacyemura ibibazo byabo, noneho nyuma ikazabagarura ku nzira yo kurwirinda. Bishobora no kuba kandi mu mvugo isa n’itinyisha nk’ubwira Umwana ati ni wongera ndaguca amatwi nyamara utayamuca. Aha biza gutera ikibazo kuko inyandiko dufite uyu munsi zamanutse mu buryo bw’imvugo nyamara twe tukaba tubitunze nk’ibyanditse. (diffÃ©rence entre l’oral et l’Ã©crit). Urugero rwa Coran 9:5 ; cg 9:29 , Bibiliya Marc 9:42. Ubisoma mu gitabo uyu munsi abifata nk’itegeko nyamara mu gihe cy’ihishurwa byari mu rurimi gusa nko guca intege (dissuasion) uyu munsi tukabifata nk’ihame kuko tutiha umwanya wo kubisesengura bya nyabyo twitwaje ihame ry’uko ibivuye ku Mana bidasuzumwa, bifatwa uko bije n’uko byumvikanye byumvikanishijwe n’abiyise abahagararizi b’ubwo butumwa. (mÃ©diateurs) Kuri iyi violence hiyongeraho violence ivugwa izaranga Umunsi w’Imperuka, aho Imana ivuga uko izagenza abayigometseho mu buzima bwabo bwo mw’isi. 3.2.1. Gusesengura violence duhereye mu buryo abantu bagennye imyemerere (conceptualisation thÃ©ologique) guerre juste : St Augustin, St Thomas D’Aquin, Jihad : Intambara ntagatifu mu bayisilamu. Uretse ko violence iboneka mu bitabo byitwa bitagatifu, tunayisanga mu nyigisho zakozwe n’abayobozi b’amadini zizwi nka theologiya cg sciences z’idini (ulum diin). Nta warondora ibice bikubiyemo izo nyigisho ngo azirangize. Tugiye kurebera hamwe ibihe bikomeye byaranze iyo myigishirize. Mu bukristu uwitwa Mutagatifu Augustini (354-430) yatangije ihame ryitwa Intambara ikwiye (la guerre juste) uwitwa St Thomas d’Aquin(1225-1274) mu k’umwunganira abyita intambara ntagatifu (guerre sainte). Ubusanzwe ihame ry’amadini rivuga ko amadini akomora ibyo avuga kw’Ijambo ry’Imana. Nyamara iyo witegereje imikorere yayo usanga ahubwo ibyo yita Ijambo ry’Imana rimara Umuhango wo kuyabera ishingiro (lÃ©gitimitÃ©) bamara kuyifata bakisubirira mu byabo twakwita gakondo (tradition). Uwitwa Frank Bourgeois avuga kw’inyigisho za Saint Augustin azivana kuri Platon, akanyura kuri Aristote agakomeza no kwa CicÃ©ron mu buryo bemezaga Intambara batezaga mu bo bitaga aba « Barbares ». Ikigaragara ni uko Saint Augustin n’abandi bitwa pÃ¨res latins de l’Eglise basimbutse Yezu bavuga ko bakurikira ndetse banakorera bajya gushaka kure mu mico (y’abagiliki ba mbere). Frank Bourgeois yibaza ikibazo n’undi wese yakwibaza agira ati : [···] : ni ryari ibitekerezo by’aba philosophes b’abapagani byinjiye bikanashyirwa mu myigishirize ya Gikristu kugeza ubwo byinjijwe mu mategeko ya Kiliziya (droit canon) ? Iki kibazo kijyanye n’Intambara Amadini(ndaza kubyerekana no mu buyisilamu kuko hose bisa) yita ntagatifu gihabanye n’Ijambo ry’Imana. Yesu mu nyingisho ze ntarwanya gusa Urugomo, ntaruteza ntanarushyigikira ahubwo ajya kure guhashya impamvu shingiro ziruteza. Mw’Ivanjiri ya Mat 5 : 43-44 agaragaza uburyo bwo kurenga kure impamvu z’ururgomo aho agaragaza ko nta mwanzi, ukwiye kubaho n’iyo we yaba abishaka, Paulo mu rwandiko ku Baroma 12 : 17-18 agaragaza imvugo isa n’iyo dusanga muri coran nzavugaho nyuma ko nta mpamvu yo kubaho kw’uwo twakwita Umwanzi. Bityo tugatsindira urugomo mw’ikubitiro (Ã l’origine) aho gushaka kurunesha twamaze kuruteza. St Augustin na bagenzi be uko nabavuze hejuru, bashyira imbere uburyo bwo kururwanya nyamara bagize uruhare m’ukuruteza igihe babona bagenzi babo mu yindi shusho y’abandi (les autres). Ibi bitandukanye n’inyigisho za Yezu kuko atugaragariza isoko yo kugira Roho y’Imana (nafsi) muri twe bityo, undi akatubera indorerwamo yacu muri we aho kuba undi duhindura Umwanzi ngo kuko tutumva ibintu kimwe. Ibi byagaragaye aho Kiliziya yarwanyije inatwika abitwa Abatannye (hÃ©rÃ©sie) ; mu ntambara zizwi kw’izina ry’abanyamisaraba (croisades), inquisitions, tutibagiwe uburyo yahembereye urwango ku Bayahudi bikabaviramo gÃ©nocide. Uwitwa Henri Tincq mu nyandiko ye yo ku wa 09/09/015 yise Violence et sacrÃ© yaribajije Ati : Bishoboka bite kw’idini yakorewe urugomo yamara gutsinda nayo ikarukorera abandi ? (religion persÃ©cutÃ©e devient persÃ©cutrice) Henri akomeza avuga ko Kiliziya ibwira abayoboke bayo ko uretse n’uko barwana intambara ntagagatifu, iyo ntambara inabaha ubutagatifu bo ubwabo, bityo uguye k’urugamba nka ruriya ahinduka igitambo (martyr) : (uko niko na Daesh yigisha) N’ubwo Abapadiri ba mbere (les pÃ¨res de l’Ã©glise) barimo Tertullien, OrigÃ¨ne, babanje kwanga ko abakristu barwana, OrigÃ¨ne yokejwe igitutu na Celse w’Umupagani wabaregaga ko babaho nk’indorerezi, yageze aho yemera ko bikwiye kw’abakirisitu barwana barengera Ingoma yabo (y’Abaromani) barwanya abo bitaga aba « barabares ». Uwitwa Ambroise wa Millan, akaba n’umuyoboke wa CicÃ©ron arerura avuka ko kurwanya aba barbare bihwanye n’ivanjiri ya Yezu maze abishishikariza abapadiri yayoboraga . Nibutse k’uyu Ambroise ari m’ubo St Augustin akomoraho inyigisho ze. Ashingiye kuri izo nyigisho, uwitwa Saint Bernard de Clervaux (1090-1153) ahimbiraho inyandiko yamamaye yiswe Eloge de la nouvelle milice yahamagariraga abeza mu bakristu kwica aba Sarasins (abasilamu). Ibi birakwereka ubukana, urukundo rwo kwica no gupfa mu cyizere cyo kubona ijuru ry’Imana. Iyi mivugire y’aba banyedini ba gikristu irasa neza neza n’iy’abasilamu bakora ibikorwa nka biriya mw’izina ry’idini mu cyiswe Jihad.

title: Umunyarwenya Bishop Gafaranga yiyemeje gukosora Bishop, Pastor biba Abakirisito bakoresheje ubutekamutwe-Video
content: Mu kiganiro yagiranye na Bwiza.com, umunyarwenya ukunzwe muri iyi minsi uzwi ku izina rya Bishop Gafaranga, yavuze ko adateze kureka gukosora abesikoro n’abanyamitwe biyemeje kwambura Abanyarwanda bitwaje Bibiliya, ubuhanuzi n’ibindi biri kugaragara mu nsengero zimwe na zimwe zo mu Rwanda.  Bishop Gafaranga yahamije ko ibyo akina abizi hirya no hino mu gihugu ndetse yabibonye inshuro nyinshi adashobora kumenya umubare, aho yabonye bamwe mu bayobora amatorero bakoresha imvugo zirimo iterabwoba no kugoreka amagambo bagamije gucucura abantu. Ati “ Ibyo mvuga ndabizi kandi nawe wasanga ubizi, hashizi igihe gito impano yanjye ntangiye kuyikoresha , nararebye nsanga nk’umuntu usenga nta handi nayikoresha mpitamo kwerekeza mu rusengero nta kindi ngamije ari ugukangura Abakirisitu n’abashumba b’amatorero kuko usanga bigeze habi, aho umuntu ashobora kukubwira ko ukura amaso ku bantu ( ba so wanyu, Nyoko wanyu, abavandimwe n’inshuti), nyamara we akayakwerekezaho ngo umugurire ibyo akeneye.” Muri iki kiganiro, Bishop Gafaranga yahamije ko atazigera atezuka na gato kuko azabikora kugeza apfuye agamije gufasha Abanyarwanda kugira ngo be gukomeza gushukwa no kwamburwa utwabo babeshywa ko bakorera Imana. [penci_related_posts dis_pview="no" dis_pdate="no" title="INKURU ZINDI MWASOMA" background="" border="" thumbright="no" number="4" style="grid" align="none" withids="" displayby="recent_posts" orderby="rand"] Ati“Tekereza nawe umu Bishop nanjye ntatinya no gutera ubwoba wa mukene utagira n’inkweto yo kwambara ngo agure itara rya V8 y’umushumba we arwana no kurya, nyamara n’uwo mushumba ntazi aho iyo ntama ye ituye.” Bishop Gafaranga kandi yakomoje ku cyizere abantu bagakwiye kuba bagirira mu nsengero ariko ubu bikaba bigoye kubera ibihakorerwa. Avuga ko bigoye ko ubu ushobora kwizera kurerera mu rusengero bitewe n’uko umwana wawe ushobora kumwohereza mu rusengero akagaruka atwite cyangwa akahahurira n’izindi ngorane . Ati “Umwana iyo umwohereje mu rusengero uramubwira uti ’mwana wanjye uzirekure’, ariko iyo agiye mu kabyiniro uramubwire uti ’wirinde mwana wanjye’, kugeza ubu biragoye kwizera mu rusengero kuko usanga naho umuntu agomba kugenda agira impungenge bitewe n’imyitwarire y’abitwa abakozi b’Imana.”  Ibindi kuri iki kiganiro mwabikurikira muri iyi video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ln-on4rvm1U Habiyaremye Zakarie uzwi ku izina rya Bishop Gafaranga, n’umurokore usengera mu itorero Salivation Church, ni umudiyakoni, ni umugabo wubatse ufite umugore n’abana babiri uvuga ko yiyemeje kurwanya ubwambuzi, iterabwoba, ubwesikore nibindi bibi bikorwa n’abayobozi b’amatorero atandukanye, byose bigakorerwa abasengera muri yo ahanini bigamije kubambura utwabo binyuze mu kwiyitirira Imana .

content: Ushobora gusoma inkuru zabanje Urugomo mu Madini — Igice cya kabiri Urugomo mu Madini (violence dans les religions)- Igice cya 1 Abahanga mu mibereho y’abantu (anthropologues-sociologues) bavuga kw’idini rigaragara iyo itsinda ry’abantu (groupe) ritandukanije icyitwa ; gitagatifu n’ibintu bisanzwe (sacrÃ© et profane). Maze icyo bise gitagatifu kigakorerwa imihango (culte). Uwitwa Emile Durkheim avuga kw’idini ari : Uburyo (systÃ¨me) buhuje abantu bemera ibintu byagizwe bitagatifu bukanarangwa n’ibikorwa byo kubigaragira, bukagena imyifatire iranga abayoboke b’Itorero bayobotse . Mu buryo bw’ururimi (Ã©tymologie) ijambo religion rituruka ku magambo abiri asa n’ayemejwe n’ubwo hatabura impaka zidakomeye. Religare : lier, attacher, lier fortement : Guhuza, kuzirika, gufatanya ndetse cyane : St Augustin avuga ko ari igikorwa cyo guhuza Imana n’Umuntu. (ibi bigana ku Mana) Relegere : rassembler, cueillir, : Gushyira hamwe, kwegeranya : byashyigikiwe na CicÃ©ron binashyigikirwa na J Benveniste. (Ibi ubona biganisha ku bantu). Zishingiye kuri iyo myumvire itandukanye itangwa n’abanyedini, sciences humaines zisesengura iby’idini muri izo ngeri nyinshi kugirango hatavaho hagira igice cy’idini kibagirana. Bityo byigwa mu buryo : Nyuma yo kugenzura izo ngeri zose, sciences humaines zishaka igisobanuro cyoroshye kandi cyumvikana aricyo : « Religion ni systeme ishingiye k’ukwemera, amarangamutima, amahame, imigenzo, n’ibikorwa bigaragaza Umubano w’Umuntu n’Ikintu atagatifuza cg se yita Imana ikanagena uko abaho ahamukikije ». Umwihariko wa sciences humaines ni uko zitiga idini uko ryanditse mu bitabo byitwa bitagatifu byemerwa n’amadini, ahubwo zo zishishikazwa no kwiga uko religion cg idini ryigaragaza (manifestation) mu bantu mu byitwa « faits religieux » Uku kubona ijambo religion bitya bituma science humaines (Ubumenyi nyamuntu) zidatandukanya amadini Gakondo(traditionnelles) n’amadini yahishuwe(rÃ©vÃ©lÃ©es) ahubwo areba icyo amaze mu mibereho ya Muntu akareba niba ntabyo ahuje cg se atandukaniyeho.  3.1.4. Ibintu rusange amadini ahuriyeho birebewe m’Ubumenyi nyabantu ( Points communs au regard des sciences sociales) Amadini avuga ko yemera Imana imwe, yabihishuriwe, yajyaga avuga kw’amadini yitwa Gakondo ari amapagani (mu rurimi rwabo) ko ndetse yemera Imana nyinshi z’impimbano. Mu mwaka wa 1923 Papa Pio XI yohereza Intumwa zize ibya sciences sociales mu bihugu bitandukanye mu duce twa kure,mu mashyamba. Bagiye muri Congo kureba Impunyu (pygmÃ©es), abandi bajya muri dÃ©sert ya Karahari (Afrique Australe) kureba abitwa Bushmen, muri Soudan na Ethiopia kureba abitwa les Nuers. Ibyo basanze byarabatangaje : kuko basanze Imana bemera ntaho itaniye n’iyo muri Bibiliya Urugero muri Congo basanze Abambote bafite Imana irema, yaremye uwitwa Tolle na Mushiki we Ngolobanzo maze bakomokwaho n’abandi. Igikomeye kurushaho ni uko mu buryo bw’imibereho (anthropologique) n’akamaro k’idini mu mibereho ya Muntu basanze aya madini yose ayitwa aya Gakondo n’ayahishuwe bahuriye ku bintu bine by’ingenzi.   Icyitonderwa  : Mu rwego rw’ukwemera aya madini afite aho atandukaniye uko theologiya zayo zabigennye, ariko mu rwego rw’akamaro k’idini mu bantu, ntaho ataniye.  3.1.5.Umwanzuro ku bijyanye n’ijambo idini cg religion  Biragaragara kw’ijambo idini uko rikoreshwa uyu munsi haba mu basilamu haba no mu bakirisitu ari inyubako y’abantu (construction des organisation socio-politique humaine) bishyize hamwe ngo bashyire mu bikorwa Ibyahishuwe. uko babyumva. Iyo nyubako yakozwe n’Inzego (instances) ebyiri zikomeye arizo :Leta (politiki) n’Abanyedini. Inyungu zashyizwe imbere  ni  iz’izo nzego kabone n’ubwo bitwaje ko baharanira guteza imbere ibyahishuwe n’Imana. Havuka ikibazo cy’uko ibyahishuwe biba bigamije guha abantu icyerekezo no kubasobanurira impamvu n’inshingano bafite kw’isi, (la quÃªte du sens) naho iby’izo nzego bikaba bigamije guteza imbere (la volontÃ© des puissances) ubushake bw’izo mbaraga zishyizeho. Biteze ikibazo gisa n’ihangana n’ubwo iteka bahora bitwaje ibyahishuwe kugirango bibaheshe ishingiro (lÃ©gitimitÃ©). Umwemera w’ibihe byose ahora avuga kw’ahagaze k’Ukwemera nyako (idini nyaryo) ahari kubera kutamenya inzira idini abarizwamo yanyuzemo kugeza kuri we.   Birakwiye ko abemera babasha gutandukanya ibintu bitatu bikomeye : Abemera babashije kuyoboka Ubutumwa bwahishuwe, butavangiwe na thÃ©ologiya zigishijwe n’abanyedini mu buryo bwo guhangana (systÃ¨me thÃ©ologique d’exclusion rÃ©ciproque) amakimbirane yaba macye kuko Umuzi shingiro w’ukwemera kwabo ari umwe (symbolique ni imwe). None se iri hangana ry’abanyedini ryaba ariryo ntandaro y’Urugomo rugaragara mu Madini twayobotse ? Rwaba se rutegekwa n’Imana ibinyujije mu byahishuwe (rÃ©vÃ©lation) ? Ibi nibyo tugiye kurebera hamwe maze bidufashe kwinjira mw’isesengura ry’Urugomo mu Madini. Mu kugerageza gusubiza iki kibazo mu buryo buvunaguye, ndanyura mu mateka y’ayo madini yombi (Ubukristu n’Ubusilamu) kubera kw’ariyo yagize Umwanya ukomeye mu ngeri zose z’ubuzima bw’abayoboke bayo. Aya madini yagiranye ndetse ntawatinya kuvuga ko kugeza n’ubu afitanye amakimbirane atera urugomo ashingiye ku bintu bibiri : Ikibazo cya thÃ©ologia, n’ikibazo cya idÃ©ologie  Tuzakomeza nindi nyandiko ubutaha…..

content: Ushobora gusoma inkuru yambere yabanje 3.Isesengura ryimbitse ry’amagambo (concepts) idini n’ urugomo 3.1.1. Idini â€¨Turagerageza gusobanura idini mumyumvire ya kisilamu n’iyagikristu 3.1.1. Igisobanuro cy’idini mumyumvire ya kisilamu. Mugitabo :Dictionnaire du CoranÃ©d Robert Lafont, Paris 2007 cyasobanuye ijambo idini muburyo burebure. Nkaba nifuje kubibagezaho ngenekereje kubihindura mukinyarwanda. Icyitonderwa : Hamenyerewe kw’ijambo ry’igifaransa Religion risobanurwa nk’Idini ryo mu rurimi rw ’Icyarabu. Nyamara iyo ubirebye ntibivuga kimwe kubera kw ’imico y’izo ndimi zombi itandukanye. Gusa ntan’uwavuga ko bihabanye cyane. Ijambo idini ryakoreshejwe inshuro 92 muri Coran, harimo inshuro 47 mu ma Sura yahishuriwe I Makka, n’inshuro 45 mu masura ya Madina. Muri izo nshuro naho hazamo ibisobanuro by’ubwoko butatu nk’uko byerekanwanaYazbeck Haddad. 1/ Mu minsi ya mbere tya Makka,din byasobanuraga: Urubanza, ibihembo, (yawm din2:4) Umunsi w’urubanza. 2/ Igisobanuro cya kabiri kiboneka muri aya tnka30 zo mu masuratya nyuma ya Makka. Bikavuga ibijyanye n’amategeko n’imigirire (coutumes et lois) bikajyana no kuyibombarikaho bizana umuco mwiza mu bantu. Iyo myitwarire Bravmann Michael abihuza n’imyitwarire myiza ya Muntu, inzira nziza igana ku Mana, ya dinu, dayn mbese nk’ideni Umuntu agirira Imana kubyiza yamugiriye ndetse bakabihuza na Tawhid. (Cor8:39, 12:76) 3/ Igisobanuro cya gatatu : iki gice kizamo ayatza nyuma za Makka n’iz’iMadina. Cyerekana idini y’amategeko y’Inyoko Muntu niho haza moidini ya Ibrahim, idini ya Ummat Muslimat. Aha ni ho Corani garagaza cyane kubaho kw’idini imwe ibereye abantu bakwiye kwibombarikaho kuko yahishuriwe Intumwa zose, hakaza kubaho kuyitatira (altÃ©rer) hanyuma Muhamad (sw) akazana urwibutso rubagarura kw’idini nyayo batannye ishingiye kuri almithaaq (alianceoriginele). Iki gice nicyo abanditsi bose bashyize imbere.(6:161, 61:9) 3.1.2.Igisobanuro cy’idini mumyumvire ya gikirisitu: Ijambo Idini ryagize urugendo rungana nk’urw’Ubukristu ubwa bwo.Muzi ko ihishurwa rya Bibiliya ndetsen’Ivanjili yaYezu byabereye muri Palestina (Yeruzalemu, Galileya, Nazareti etc) abigishwa be bahise bimukira m’Ubugereki, hanyuma muri Roma (Ubutaliyani). Ubutumwa bwajemo. Langage ihindutse, bihindura ubutumwa maze ibyari parabole (kuvugira mu migani) bihinduka concept langage iva muriparabole ihinduka discursif.(diskuru iteguye, ikurikiranye mu buhanga bwahimbwe na Aristote:rhÃ©torique aristotÃ©licienne ) Ikigaragara ni uko iryo hindagurika ry’ijambo idini ryaterwa n’iryohinduka rya baye hagati y’ihishurwa n’iyamamazwa (rÃ©vÃ©lation na expansion cg propagation) bigira ingaruka k’ubutumwa ubwabwo. Urugendo rwose rwagiraga ingaruka kw’ijambo idini ndetse no k’ubutumwa ubwa bwo. Inyigisho za Yezu zigeze mu Bugiriki, zasanze hari ijambo bita religiorisan ’iri hanganisha imitwe ibiri: Umutwe umwe unakomeye w’abashingira kw’idini rya filozofiya, n’Umutwe w’abashingira kuma dini twakwita gakondo. Byombi bikitwa kimwe. Inyigisho za Yezu nazo zijya mu zindi zifatwa nk’inyigisho z’amadini gakondo. Bayashakiye izina maze bayita religio bayabuza kwigaragaza mu ruhame ariko bayarekera mu ngo no mu miryango. Uko kubitandukanya ntikwavanyeho burundu imigenzo Ubutegetsi budashaka, maze barongera bashaka kubitandukanya nyabyo, babishakira izina rishya. Imigenzo (pratiques) â€¨itemewe yitwa superstitio (Ubupfumu) maze imihango yemewe isigarana religio. Icyitonderwa: â€¨Hagiye habaho icyo Umuntu yakwita amakimbirane (tensions) hagati y’imyumvire y’Abagiliki ishingiye kuri filosofiya n’imyumvire y’Abaromani ishingiye kumategeko (droit) mbere y’uko babihuza bikabyara ubukristu dufite uyumunsi. Umulatini wa mbere wakoze ibikomeye maze ahuza iyo myumvire yombi ndetse abasha no kwemeza icyo yise Uerare ligio UeriDei : Idini rimwer y’Imana imwe y’Ukuri ni uwitwa Tertulien (160-220). Uyu mulatinini we wabashije guhindura ibintu muburyo bita radical kuko kugeza kiriya gihe Ubukristu bwari buzwi nka ya madini y’Ubupfumu (superstitio) maze arabigaranzura ahubwo ibyabo aba aribyo ahindura Ubupfumu maze Ubukristu Buhinduka idini y’Ukuri yonyine.â€¨ Ntiyagarukiye aho gusa mu guhindura superstition idini ahubwo yabashije guhindura Ubukristu idini y’ukuri mu gihugu (espace politique et social) abasha no guhigika andi ma dini maze ayahindura amadini y’abapfumu (superstition). Uko guhigika idini y’abaromani akayisimbuza Ubukristu, ndetse bikaninjira mu nzego za politiki n’imibereho (politique etsociale) byatumye idini y’Ubukristu nayo igira ibyo itakaza n’ibyo yinjiza mw’idini yayo. Ishingiye kumyumvire ya kigiliki yemeje ko filosofi yaari yo dini yemewe nyayo kandi ikomoka ku Mana (rÃ©vÃ©lation) nk’uko bivugwa na Justin mu kiganiro yagiranye naTryphom 8,1. Bityo ibyari ibitekerezo bihinduka Ukwemera. N’ukogusimbura idini y’Abaromani byasabye ikiguzi gikomeye Ubukristu. Iryo hinduka ryabaye mu mpande zombi, bityo Ubukrisitu nabwo bwinjiza mu mahame yabwo iby’Uburoma kugirango bukunde bwemerwe n’ubutegetsi mu gihugu. Mukurangiza kuvuga kuriirihinduka byaba byiza nerekanye ibice by’ingenzi ijambo idini ndetse n’imyumvire ya byo ryanyuzemo nkuko bivugwa na MauriceSachot: 1.Igihe cy’ihishurwa (moment sÃ©mitique) ihishurwa ry’Ivanjili, kirangwa no kuyoboka kwa Muntu kugiti cye bigaragarira mu nyigisho za Bibiliya mu Makoraniro. 2.Igihe cyo mu Bugiliki ivanjili ihinduka philosofiya ndetse filosofiya nyayo (elaboration conceptuele du christianisme et la catÃ©chÃ¨se: gatigisimu) 3.Igihe cy’Abalatini Baromani: Idini ihinduka urwego rwa Politique n’ikorwa ry’amategeko y’idini agenga imyemerere n’imigenzo (Ã©laboration des textes lÃ©gislatifs concernant aussi bien la doctrine queles pratiques) Bityo rero iyo mihindagurikire yerekana idini ya gikrisitu mu nzego nk’eshatu z’ingenzi: Umuntu ushobora kwemera, akayoboka akaniyemeza (croyance, adhÃ©sion, â€¨engagement) â€¨Ubumenyi bushingiye kumyumvire ya science na philosophie â€¨imbaga ihamye ishingiye kuri politique n’imibereho myiza (sociÃ©tÃ© instituÃ©e â€¨politique mentet socialement) [caption id="attachment_111775" align="alignnone" width="800"] Omar Servil Ntagengwa [/caption]  Tuzakomeza nindi nyandiko ubutaha…..

Langage ihindutse, bihindura ubutumwa maze ibyari parabole (kuvugira mu migani) bihinduka concept langage iva muriparabole ihinduka discursif.(diskuru iteguye, ikurikiranye mu buhanga bwahimbwe na Aristote:rhÃ©torique aristotÃ©licienne ) Ikigaragara ni uko iryo hindagurika ry’ijambo idini ryaterwa n’iryohinduka rya baye hagati y’ihishurwa n’iyamamazwa (rÃ©vÃ©lation na expansion cg propagation) bigira ingaruka k’ubutumwa ubwabwo. Urugendo rwose rwagiraga ingaruka kw’ijambo idini ndetse no k’ubutumwa ubwa bwo. Inyigisho za Yezu zigeze mu Bugiriki, zasanze hari ijambo bita religiorisan ’iri hanganisha imitwe ibiri: Umutwe umwe unakomeye w’abashingira kw’idini rya filozofiya, n’Umutwe w’abashingira kuma dini twakwita gakondo. Byombi bikitwa kimwe. Inyigisho za Yezu nazo zijya mu zindi zifatwa nk’inyigisho z’amadini gakondo. Bayashakiye izina maze bayita religio bayabuza kwigaragaza mu ruhame ariko bayarekera mu ngo no mu miryango. Uko kubitandukanya ntikwavanyeho burundu imigenzo Ubutegetsi budashaka, maze barongera bashaka kubitandukanya nyabyo, babishakira izina rishya. Imigenzo (pratiques) â€¨itemewe yitwa superstitio (Ubupfumu) maze imihango yemewe isigarana religio. Icyitonderwa: â€¨Hagiye habaho icyo Umuntu yakwita amakimbirane (tensions) hagati y’imyumvire y’Abagiliki ishingiye kuri filosofiya n’imyumvire y’Abaromani ishingiye kumategeko (droit) mbere y’uko babihuza bikabyara ubukristu dufite uyumunsi. Bityo ibyari ibitekerezo bihinduka Ukwemera. N’ukogusimbura idini y’Abaromani byasabye ikiguzi gikomeye Ubukristu. Iryo hinduka ryabaye mu mpande zombi, bityo Ubukrisitu nabwo bwinjiza mu mahame yabwo iby’Uburoma kugirango bukunde bwemerwe n’ubutegetsi mu gihugu. title: Umuhanzi Murenzi Chris agiye gutaramira abafana be i Kigali
content: Ku wa 17 Werurwe 2019, ahagana sa cyenda za nimogoroba, Umuhanzi mu ndirimbo zihambaza ndetse zinaramya Imana, Chris Murenzi yateguye igitaramo cy’ imbaturabugabo kizabera ku Rusengero Evangelical Restoration Church ku Kimisagara.  Iki gitaramo cyiswe "Let Hope Rise live concert 2019", cyatumiwemo abahanzi batandukanye nka Nelson Mucyo , Arsene Tuyi , Deo Munyakazi, Justin Cubaka ndetse na Nziza Francis. Si abo gusa kuko, iki gitaramo kizitabirwa n’ amatsinda nka One familly one Vision izwi cyane mu njyana ya Hip Hop, itsinda Shining Stars Familly imaze kwamamara mu kubyina ndetse na Shekinah Dance na shekinah Worshipteam bizaba bihabaye. Mu kiganiro na Bwiza. com, Murenzi Chris(MC) yavuze ko hamwe no kwizera Imana imyiteguro y’ igitaramo ihagaze neza ndetse ko hari byinshi kandi byiza. Ati" Mushonje muhishiwe! ntimuzasibe !cyangwa ngo mucyererwe ni Saa cyenda ,imiryango izaba ifunguye , kugira habeho kwicaza abantu neza bityo barusheho kunogerwa n’ indirimo zinyuranye kandi zitanga icyizere cy’ ubuzima bwa none n’ ubw’ iteka ryose". Murenzi Chris yakomeje na none agira ati "Nk’ uko isanganyamatsiko ibivuga , Iki ni igihe cyawe cyo guhemburwa ukagira umutima nk’uwa Yesu kugeza gusa na we". Murenzi Chris ni umuhanzi w’ indirimbo zizimbaza Imana ariko mu mpano ye akora injyana zitandukanye nka Zouk, Rock n’ izindi nyinshi usibye kuririmba anasanzwe kandi ari umucuranzi wa guitare ndetse na piano.

title: Kaminuza ya CHUR yadabagije abazayigamo mu mwaka w'amashuri 2019
content: Kaminuza ya Christian University of Rwanda (CHUR) yashyizeho umwihariko ku biyandikisha kuyigamo uyu mwaka w’amashuri wa 2019/2020 mu mashami yayo yose.  Iyi kaminuza ifite ikicaro gikuru mu Mujyi wa Karongi, ikagira amashami mu Mujyi wa Kigali (Saint Paul), itangaza ko kwiyandikisha byatangiye ku bazangira kwiga muri Nzeri 2019. Umwihariko ku bazatangira amasomo muri uyu mwaka ni uko bazigishwa amasomo y’icyongereza umwaka umwe kandi bakazahabwa impambyabushobozi (Certificate) yo ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Ushinzwe kwandika abanyeshuri, Dieudonne Hakizimana yatangarije Bwiza.com ko uretse kuba batanga impamyabumenyi mu mashami akenewe cyane ku isoko ry’umurimo, basanze ari ngombwa ko bongeramo icyongereza, kugira ngo abize muri iyi kaminuza bace ukubiri n’imbogamizi y’ururimi. Ati “ Ubu ngubu abanyeshuri bose bazatangirana no kwiga icyongereza mu buryo buri professional. Tuzabaha impamyabushobozi y’icyongereza irimo ubufatanye na British Council.” Uyu muyobozi avuga ko amafaranga y’ishuri atigeze ahinduka ku biga mu bihe bitandukanye. Ati “ Ibisanzwe byo ni uko minerivali yacu ari nkeya. Ni ibihumbi 400,000Rwf ku mwaka waba wiga nijoro, ku manywa, cyangwa muri wikendi. Dutanga impamyabumenyi mu mashami yose twigisha mu gihe cy’imyaka itatu.” Kaminuza ya CHUR yatangiye gutanga amasomo mu 2016 mu Karere ka Karongi ifite abanyeshuri 100. Kuri ubu ifite abanyeshuri basaga 2,000 biga mu mashami anyuranye. Muri aya mashami harimo iry’Ubumenyi n’Ikoranabuhanga , Ubuhinzi n’iterambere ry’Icyaro, Ubucuruzi n’Ishoramari, Uburezi, Indimi n’Ubumenyamuntu. Ku bashaka kwiyandikisha muri iyi kaminuza cyangwa gusaba ibindi bisobanuro, bahamagara kuri izi nimero haba i Karongi no mu Mujyi wa Kigali.  Bashobora kandi kubandikira kuri email no kubasura ku rubuga rwabo.

title: Nyamasheke: Abanyeshuri b’abakobwa bo muri G.S FAK baryama mu buryo buteye inkenke
content: Abakobwa 280 biga mu rwunge rw’amashuri rwitiriwe Frank Adamson rwa Kibogora ( G.S FAK) mu karere ka Nyamasheke bavuga ko nyuma y’uko inyubako (Dortoir) bararagamo ihiye igakongoka, ubu barara mu buryo buteye inkeke.   Aba banyeshuri b’abakobwa bararana ari batatu kuri Matela, bose basasa hasi mu byumba bitari byarabugenewe. Ababyeyi baharerera n’ubuyobozi bw’ishuri mu nteko rusange yabaye ku wa 10 Gicurasi 2019, bakaba baremeranijwe ko isanwa vuba abana babo bakarara neza kugira ngo banabashe kwiga batekanye. Nk’uko umuyobozi mushya w’iri shuri, Ukizebaraza LÃ©on Emmanuel yabisobanuriye ababyeyi baharerera, ngo inyubako zirimo n’iyi zahiye inshuro 4 zose biba amayobera kuko yahiye ubwa mbere ku wa 20 Mutarama uyu mwaka, hashya icyumba cyararagamo abakobwa 19, nyuma y’iminsi 3 gusa ku wa 23 Mutarama irashya yose irakongoka, biba ngombwa ko abakobwa 280 bayiraragamo bose bashakirwa aho baryama. Bamwe bashyizwe mu cyumba cy’amasengesho, abandi mu nyubako yari igenewe kuvurirwamo abanyeshuri n’izindi nyubako zitari zaragenewe kuraramo abanyeshuri. Akomeza avuga ko ubwo aba bakobwa bararaga n’ubundi mu buryo budashobotse, ku wa 6 Gashyantare cya cyumba cy’amasengesho na cyo cyarahiye abakiraragamo barimurwa, ku wa 10 Werurwe ikindi cyumba cyarahiye ,aho hose nta kintu na kimwe bakuragamo, abana basigaye iheruheru, bagobokwa n’itorero MÃ©thodiste Libre mu Rwanda nyirishuri,akarere,Minisiteri ifite kurwanya Ibiza mu nshingano n’abandi bagiraneza ngo babashe gukomeza kwiga. Uyu muyobozi akomeza avuga ko izi nkongi z’umuriro zabaye amayobera ari ko n’iperereza rikorwa,haza gutabwa muri yombi abanyeshuri 4 barimo umukobwa wakekwaga uku gutwika hakurikijwe ibimenyetso bavuga ko byamufataga n’abandi bahungu 3 ngo babaga mu itsinda ryiyise amaniga bakekwaga ubufatanyacyaha,icyakora ngo kuva batabwa muri yombi ntihongeye gushya, na bo ngo baraburana bari hanze biga mu yandi mashuri bashakiwe,uretse uyu mukobwa ngo utarabona ahandi yiga. Nyuma yo kugezwaho uko imiryamire y’abana ihagaze ubu, bagasanga ari mibi kandi kugira ngo bige neza ari uko baba banaryamye neza,ababyeyi biyemeje gufasha mu isanwa ry’iyi nyubako ngo nibura umwaka utaha uzatangire biga neza. Mukamwiza ConsolÃ©e umwe mu baharerera yabwiye Bwiza.com ati’’ nyuma yo kutubwira uburemere bw’ikibazo kandi abana ari abacu,binavugwa ko bamwe muri bo ari bo bakekwaho kuyitwika, twiyemeje kugira uruhare mu kuyisana aho buri mubyeyi yiyemeje gutanga amafaranga 5.000 mu gihembwe gitaha kandi ntituzahagararira aho kuko uko barara twese nk’ababyeyi biduteye impungenge.’’ Pasiteri Mushimiyimana SimÃ©on, umubwiriza wa Conference ya Kibogora mu itorero MÃ©thodiste Libre mu Rwanda,yabwiye Bwiza.com ko habaruwe ibikoresho by’abana byahiriyemo bifite agaciro k’amafaranga hafi miliyoni 12, bakaba barashakiwe iby’ibanze by’agera kuri miliyoni 8 ngo babashe kwiga,gusana inyubako bikazatwara arenga miliyoni 38 agomba kuboneka vuba ngo imirimo itangire. Ati’’ twkoze ibishoboka byose ngo abana bakomeze bige nubwo barara mu buryo butameze neza,ariko ku bufatanye n’ababyeyi n’abandi bireba bose twiyemeje gukemura iki kibazo byihutirwa uko tuzashobozwa.’’ Ku bavuga ko ishuri rikwiye kuriha ibikoresho by’abana byose byangiritse,avuga ko ritabikora kuko atari ryo ryabitwitse,icyakora ko mu bufatanye abana bazagenda babona iby’ibanze bibafasha kwiga. Umuyobozi w’aka karere Kamari AimÃ© Fabien na we avuga ko bahangayikishijwe n’imiryamire y’aba bana, bakaba bakomeje gushakisha aya mafaranga ku bufatanye bw’abo bireba bose,akizeza ababyeyi ko bikurikiranwa kandi igisubizo kitazatinda kuboneka kuko iki ngo ari ikibazo bafatana uburemere bukomeye cyane. [caption id="attachment_133373" align="alignnone" width="1024"] Ababyeyi baganira n’abana babo ku myigire yabo nyuma y’izo ngorane zose[/caption] [caption id="attachment_133374" align="alignnone" width="1024"] Dorutwari yararagamo abakobwa 280 yarahiye irakongoka[/caption]

title: Bukavu: Abanyeshuri bo muri kaminuza eshatu bigaragambirije ibura ry’umuriro
content: Uyu munsi, tariki ya 16 Gicurasi, abanyeshuri bo muri kaminuza eshatu mu mugi wa Bukavu muri Repubulika Iharanira Demukarasi ya Congo, bigaragambije nyuma y’igihe kinini bamaze nta muriro w’amashanyarazi. label: education
title: Min. Mutimura yagaragarije Abadepite icyuho cya za Miliyari ku mafaranga agenerwa Minisiteri y’Uburezi
content: Minisitiri w’Uburezi, Dr Mutimura Eugene ubwo yaragaragarizaga Komisiyo y’Ingengo y’Imari n’Umutungo by’Igihugu mu Inteko Nshingamategeko, uko ingengo y’imari y’imyaka ibiri ishize yakoreshejwe n’ibikorwa biteganyijwe mu ngengo y’imari ya 2019/2020, yavuze ko hakirimo icyuho cya za Miliyari.  Minisitiri Mutimura avuga ko ingengo y’imari ya Minisiteri y’Uburezi yazamutse iva kuri Miliyari 15.5Frw muri 2018/2019 igera kuri Miliyari 24.9Frw muri 2019/2020, ko yarazamutse cyane kubera ibikorwa byo kubaka ibyumba by’amashuli. Avuga ko muri REB [Ikigo cy’Igihugu gishinzwe Uburezi] hateganyijwe miliyari 21.5Frw muri 2019/2020 ugereranyije na Miliyari 23.3Frw zari mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2018/2019. WDA [Ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe guteza imbere imyuga n’ubumenyingiro] ngo yahawe miliyari 8.7Frw muri 2019/2020 ugereranyije na miliyari 14.1Frw zari muri 2018/2019, ibi ngo byatewe akenshi n’uko ibikorwa byinshi bya WDA byagiye gukorwa na Rwanda Polytechnic. Rwanda Polytechnic [Ishuri Rikuru ry’u Rwanda ry’Imyuga n’Ubumenyingiro] ryagenewe miliyari 21.8Frw ugereranyije n’umwaka ushize aho yari ifite miliyari 15.2frw kubera ibikorwa byagiye byiyongera. Minisitiri Mutimura yakomeje avuga ko mu bikorwa by’ingenzi harimo kubaka ibyumba by’amashuli, ataga urugero rw’ishuri rya Kimironko ngo ryateganyirijwe miliyoni 150Frw ariko haracyari icyuho cya miliyoni 121Frw. Yagize ati “Twari twarateganyije kubaka ibyumba 3112 n’ubwiherere 4668, mu ngengo y’imari ubu twagenewe amafaranga yo kubaka ibyumba 1150 n’ubwiherero 1804, tukaba dufite icyuho cya miliyari 17.4rw kugira ngo dukemure ikibazo cy’ubucucike. Turacyafite kandi icyuho cya miliyari 3.3Frw ku mafaranga agenerwa amashuli (capitation grants) kugira ngo ashobore kubaho, kwiyubaka no kuvugurura ibikorwa, School Feeding Programme dufite n’icyuho cy’amadeni cya miliyari 1.3Frw”. Hon. Musolini, agira icyo avuga ku mafaranga yo kugaburira abanyeshuri ku mashuri, yagize ati “ Twumvaga twifuza ko amafaranga ya School Feeding yava kuri 56Frw akaba 100Frw ariko ikibabaje ni uko dusanze n’ayo make tukiri mu mwenda, bivuze ko nayo adatangwa, harateganywa iki ngo ayo yishyurwe?

title: Kicukiro: Bisi itwara abanyeshuri yafashwe n’inkongi y’umuriro irakongoka
content: Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki ya 4 Werurwe 2019, nibwo imodoka (Bus) itwara abanyeshuri yafashwe n’inkongi y’umuriro, irashya irakongoka. Ku bw’amahirwe nta muntu wahiriyemo.  Iyi modoka yari irimo umushoferi wayo wenyine, ubwo yabonaga itangiye kwaka, ngo yahise ayivamo. Igurumana nta muntu uyirimo, ubwo yari igeze hafi na Hotel Nobleza, mu Karere ka Kicukiro, Umujyi wa Kigali. Umuvugizi wa Polisi y’u Rwanda, Ishami rishinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda, Senior Superintendent of Police Jean Marie Vianney Ndushabandi, yatangarije KT ko iyo mpanuka yabaye ishobora kuba yatewe n’amasinga y’iyo modoka yo mu bwoko bwa TATA, yakoranyeho igahita itangira kwaka.

title: Gasabo: Umwarimukazi amaze imyaka itatu mu nzu idakinze
content: Mu murenge wa Rutunga, akarere ka Gasabo, abarimu bubakiwe inzu ebyiri zo gucumbikamo ariko nta n’imwe irangiye, ku buryo abarimu bake bazibamo uko ziri: zidakinze, nta mazi, nta mashanyarazi, nta bwiherero, nta pulafo, nta gikoni n’ibindi biburaho. Ni ku gicamunsi cyo kuwa gatandatu, tariki ya 9 Gashyantare 2019, abaturage babukereye bagana iya sitade Rutunga kwakira abadepite. Nyirakamana Ruth (izina ryahinduwe) nawe ni umunyarwanda akaba n’intore, ariko we yibereye mu rugo. Ni umwarimukazi muri uyu murenge, akaba n’umukorerabushake watoresheje abo badepite, ariko ntasamajwe no kujya kubareba: inzu ye irarangaye yasanga benengango bamucucuye. Ikindi arashyashyana mu bitabo atanguranwa n’uko iziba rirenga, kuko aho atuye nta mashanyarazi arimo, nyamara abaturanyi be baracana. Iyi nzu Nyirakamana abamo kuva muri Gashyantare 2016, yegeranye n’indi bisa neza. Ziri munsi y’umuhanda, mu metero 200 uvuye ku biro by’umurenge wa Rutunga na sitade yakiriye abadepite. Izi nzu zombi zubatswe na Leta, zitwara akayabo ka miliyoni zisaga 90 (ni ukuvuga miliyoni 45 buri imwe). Hafi buri murenge ufite nibura inzu imwe nk’iyi kuva muri 2013, ariko hamwe ntiziruzura nk’aha I Rutunga, ahandi zaruzuye zibura abazijyamo kuko bafite aho baba cyangwa zubatse kure, ahandi zibamo abatabigenewe nk’iya Nyamagabe yabagamo umuyobozi w’akarere wungirije. [caption id="attachment_126383" align="alignnone" width="1000"] Mu nzu imbere ni ibirangarira gusa [/caption]  Kiramujyanye, “Usibye ko mudakodesha murutwa n’ababa hanze” Aya ni amagambo abashyitsi ba Nyirakamana bamubwira iyo bamusuye, dore ko ari inkumi igeze kurangamirwa n’urungano. Abamugana basanga amaso ye atukuye, kubera imihangayiko no gukorera ku gatoroshi. Bamwe mu bahisi n’abagenzi banyura kuri iyi nzu ntibatinya kuyita Kiramujyanye, bavuga ko isaha iyo ariyo yose igisimba (impyisi) yatwara abayirirmo. Iyi nzu ni ubwugamo bw’amatungo, ni uburaro bw’inyamaswa; ndetse urebye n’abagizi ba nabi bashobora kuhaca ingando, ikaba yakorerwamo ibibi byose kuko idakinze. Nyirakamana avuga ko ubwiherero bakoresha ari abarimu babwiyubakishirije, ubuyobozi bw’ikigo bukanabasaba kwishyira hamwe bagashyira umuriro w’amashanyarazi muri izi nzu za Leta. Nta byo kwita ku kuba bakwimurirwa ahandi cyangwa kwirukanwa, babasaba gushora ayabo ngo babone aho baba. Ati, “diregiteri niwe muvugizi wacu, yatubwiye ko dukusanya amafaranga tugashyiramo umuriro, kandi mu by’ukuri kuwuhageza birahenze. Hari bamwe baba bagiye, ntiwawushyiramo wenda kuhava”. Akomeza agira ati, “Twahageze urugi rwaracitse, nyuma urundi umuyaga urarutwara, tuhaba gutyo. Ingorane, gukosorera mu rugo ntibishoboka, iyo bwije dukoresha agatoroshi. Ntiwacyura imikoro wahaye abana ngo ukosorere mu rugo. Twifuza ko bayubaka akamera nk’ay’ahandi. Abadusuye baraduseka cyane bati, [Usibye ko mudakodesha murutwa n’ababa hanze]”. Nyamara aba bashyitsi ntibaba babeshya, nubwo inkuru y’imbarirano ituba. Aya mazu arava, hejuru(mu ipinyu: aho amabati ahurira n’igikuta) ntihafunze, ku buryo igihe cyose baba bafite impungenge ko ibyabo byibwa. Ahateganijwe ubwiherero n’igikoni nta na sima irimo, amazi bakoresha bayakura ku murenge cyangwa imvura yagwa bakareka. Izi nzu kandi zugarijwe no gusenyuka bitewe n’igihuru n’ibyatsi byameze ku isima, ndetse n’amazi amanuka ku mabati akamena isima yo ku rubaraza.  Gasabo n’ahandi bimeze bite? Mu mirenge igize akarere ka Gasabo ndetse n’ahandi, nta na hamwe imyubakire n’imicungire y’izi nzu z’abarimu ivugwaho rumwe. Zimwe zicungwa n’ubuyobozi bw’umurenge, izindi abayobozi b’ibigo; kandi ari Minisiteri y’uburezi ari na REB ntibashaka gutanga amakuru ahagije kuri izi nzu. Hagati y’itariki 16 Werurwe na 18 Mata 2016, ushinzwe amakuru muri Mineduc yandikiwe azibazwaho, birangira atanze icyumweru na n’ubu. Ubutumwa bwagiraga buti: ku bireba  INZU YA MWARIMU,   -Gahunda yo kubaka inzu ya mwarimu yabaye mu wuhe mwaka?   -Hari hateganijwe amazu angahe mu gihugu?   -Ni abahe bafatanyabikorwa muri iyi gahunda, buri umwe afite uruhe ruhare?  -Ese iriya nzu ifite agaciro k’amafaranga angana iki?   -Ese zagombaga gutahwa zimeze zite(zirimo iki, zitarimo iki)?   -Ese ubu zaratashywe?  -Ni nde ushinzwe imicungire yazo umunsi ku munsi?   -Hari amakuru mufite ku buryo abantu bazibamo( izibamo abarimu, izibamo abandi batigisha, izitabamo abantu namba).   -Ni ubuhe butumwa mwatanga ku barimu, abayobozi b’ibigo n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa mu micungire ya ziriya nzu? [caption id="attachment_126392" align="alignnone" width="1000"] Ako ni agatuwaleti abarimu biyubabikiye hanze muri metero nka 20 [/caption] Hari imirenge yubatse inzu ebyiri zirarangira, hari n’iyananiwe kurangiza n’imwe. Hari aho zibamo abarimu (Gikomero), hari n’aho zibamo abatari abarimu (Nduba habamo abakozi ba Sacco). Hari kandi aho usanga zarubatswe kure y’amashuri cyangwa bigaragara ko zidakenewe. Mu murenge wa Ndera, imwe yubatswe Cyaruzinge (ku mudugudu w’abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka), nta shuri ryahabaga, ubu hamaze kugezwa imyaka itatu y’amashuri abanza. Inzu ibamo umwarimu umwe, undi ubuyobozi bwamukuyemo kuko yabanagamo n’abana be. Indi yubatswe ku mashuri ya Jurwe, ahaboneka icyiciro cy’amashuri abanza gusa. Kicukiro: mu murenge wa Nyarugunga hubatswe ebyiri ziruzura, magingo aya zombi zibamo abarimu Rwamagana: mu murenge wa Muyumbu hari imwe, ariko yagezemo abarimu itaruzura neza kubera yari ikenewe Gatsibo: mu murenge wa Gasange, iyi nzu yubakiwe ubwiherero n’igikoni, kandi abamo abarimu bayuzuye. Gicumbi: mu murenge wa Giti, mu 2016 yabagamo Dasso, mu murenge wa Byumba irakinze, mu murenge wa Kageyo ibamo uburiri wa Gitifu w’akagari; naho mu murenge wa Cyumba abarimu bayibamo. Gisagara: mu murenge wa Mukindo, 2016 niyo yakirirwagamo impunzi z’abarundi, ariko yari itaruzura neza. Muhanga: hafi ya zose zaruzuye ariko zibura abazijyamo, zimwe zarenzwe n’ibihuru; ariko akarere kavuga ko gateganya kuzishyiramo abandi bakozi badafite aho baba. Kayonza: mu murenge wa Kabarondo abazubatse bamaze imyaka itatu batarabona ubahemba Nyagatare: ku ishuri rya Cyagayaga bayitashye 2014, yuzuye ikoze neza isize n’amarangi Nyamagabe: hashize amezi make Visi Meya yemeye kuyizibukira akavamo akayirekera abarimu; N’ahandi n’ahandi. [caption id="attachment_126393" align="alignnone" width="1000"] Utubati(placards), inkuta zacukuwe ahazanyuzwa amasinga y’umuriro [/caption]  Ubwiru n’urujijo mu makosa Nubwo amakuru ku micungire y’aya mazu akomeza kugirwa ubwiru, bikomeza guteza urujijo kandi amakosa aragaragara. Nta kuntu inzu zisa, zifite imbata imwe, zatewe inkunga n’ikigo cyangwa urwego rumwe; zituzurira rimwe, ntizishyirwemo bimwe, ntizigengwe n’amabwiriza amwe. Izi nzu zatangiye kubakwa mu mwaka wa 2012-2013, buri nzu igizwe n’ibyumba umunani na salo ebyiri: bine bigenewe abakobwa na bine by’abahungu. Buri gihande kirimo ubwiherero bw’imbere mu nzu n’igikoni cyo mu nzu. Ibikoni n’ubwiherero byo hanze ni inyongera ishyirwaho n’imirenge cyangwa ibigo by’amashuri. Iyi nzu ifite agaciro ka miliyoni nibura 45 z’amanyarwanda. Gusa amakuru ahagije ku muterankunga n’uburyo zicungwa, minisiteri yarabibajijwe ntiyasubiza. Izi nzu kandi zakunze kugarukwaho na raporo y’umugenzuzi w’imari ya Leta, aho mu 2014 yavugaga ko zatinze kuzura, kuko zagombaga kuzura mu 2013. Ubwo izuzuye nyuma n’izitaruzura magingo aya zamaze gutinda. Mu mwaka wa 2015, umugenzuzi w’imari ya Leta yerekanye ko zimwe muri izi nzu zituzuye neza, izindi zubatswe mu manegeka, aho yagaragazaga ko zugarijwe n’amazi ashaka kuzisenya. Icyo atarareba ni uko zibyazwa umusaruro, naho izituzuye n’iziri gusenyuka nazo ziracyahari. [caption id="attachment_126391" align="alignnone" width="1000"] Aha ni ahagenewe ubwogero n’ubwiherero [/caption] [caption id="attachment_126385" align="alignnone" width="1000"] Inzu ibangamiwe n’amazi y’imvura kubera kutagira imireko [/caption] [caption id="attachment_126394" align="alignnone" width="1000"] Izi nzu zubatswe ari 2, ariko nta nimwe irangiye. Ibihuru bizigeze habi [/caption]

Aya mazu arava, hejuru(mu ipinyu: aho amabati ahurira n’igikuta) ntihafunze, ku buryo igihe cyose baba bafite impungenge ko ibyabo byibwa. Ahateganijwe ubwiherero n’igikoni nta na sima irimo, amazi bakoresha bayakura ku murenge cyangwa imvura yagwa bakareka. Izi nzu kandi zugarijwe no gusenyuka bitewe n’igihuru n’ibyatsi byameze ku isima, ndetse n’amazi amanuka ku mabati akamena isima yo ku rubaraza.  Gasabo n’ahandi bimeze bite? Mu mirenge igize akarere ka Gasabo ndetse n’ahandi, nta na hamwe imyubakire n’imicungire y’izi nzu z’abarimu ivugwaho rumwe. Zimwe zicungwa n’ubuyobozi bw’umurenge, izindi abayobozi b’ibigo; kandi ari Minisiteri y’uburezi ari na REB ntibashaka gutanga amakuru ahagije kuri izi nzu. Hagati y’itariki 16 Werurwe na 18 Mata 2016, ushinzwe amakuru muri Mineduc yandikiwe azibazwaho, birangira atanze icyumweru na n’ubu. Ubutumwa bwagiraga buti: ku bireba  INZU YA MWARIMU,   -Gahunda yo kubaka inzu ya mwarimu yabaye mu wuhe mwaka?   -Hari hateganijwe amazu angahe mu gihugu?   -Ni abahe bafatanyabikorwa muri iyi gahunda, buri umwe afite uruhe ruhare?  -Ese iriya nzu ifite agaciro k’amafaranga angana iki?   -Ese zagombaga gutahwa zimeze zite(zirimo iki, zitarimo iki)?   -Ese ubu zaratashywe?  -Ni nde ushinzwe imicungire yazo umunsi ku munsi?   -Hari amakuru mufite ku buryo abantu bazibamo( izibamo abarimu, izibamo abandi batigisha, izitabamo abantu namba).   -Ni ubuhe butumwa mwatanga ku barimu, abayobozi b’ibigo n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa mu micungire ya ziriya nzu? [caption id="attachment_126392" align="alignnone" width="1000"] Ako ni agatuwaleti abarimu biyubabikiye hanze muri metero nka 20 [/caption] Hari imirenge yubatse inzu ebyiri zirarangira, hari n’iyananiwe kurangiza n’imwe. Hari aho zibamo abarimu (Gikomero), hari n’aho zibamo abatari abarimu (Nduba habamo abakozi ba Sacco). Hari kandi aho usanga zarubatswe kure y’amashuri cyangwa bigaragara ko zidakenewe. Mu murenge wa Ndera, imwe yubatswe Cyaruzinge (ku mudugudu w’abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka), nta shuri ryahabaga, ubu hamaze kugezwa imyaka itatu y’amashuri abanza. Inzu ibamo umwarimu umwe, undi ubuyobozi bwamukuyemo kuko yabanagamo n’abana be. Indi yubatswe ku mashuri ya Jurwe, ahaboneka icyiciro cy’amashuri abanza gusa. Kicukiro: mu murenge wa Nyarugunga hubatswe ebyiri ziruzura, magingo aya zombi zibamo abarimu Rwamagana: mu murenge wa Muyumbu hari imwe, ariko yagezemo abarimu itaruzura neza kubera yari ikenewe Gatsibo: mu murenge wa Gasange, iyi nzu yubakiwe ubwiherero n’igikoni, kandi abamo abarimu bayuzuye. Gicumbi: mu murenge wa Giti, mu 2016 yabagamo Dasso, mu murenge wa Byumba irakinze, mu murenge wa Kageyo ibamo uburiri wa Gitifu w’akagari; naho mu murenge wa Cyumba abarimu bayibamo. Gisagara: mu murenge wa Mukindo, 2016 niyo yakirirwagamo impunzi z’abarundi, ariko yari itaruzura neza. Muhanga: hafi ya zose zaruzuye ariko zibura abazijyamo, zimwe zarenzwe n’ibihuru; ariko akarere kavuga ko gateganya kuzishyiramo abandi bakozi badafite aho baba. Kayonza: mu murenge wa Kabarondo abazubatse bamaze imyaka itatu batarabona ubahemba Nyagatare: ku ishuri rya Cyagayaga bayitashye 2014, yuzuye ikoze neza isize n’amarangi Nyamagabe: hashize amezi make Visi Meya yemeye kuyizibukira akavamo akayirekera abarimu; N’ahandi n’ahandi. [caption id="attachment_126393" align="alignnone" width="1000"] Utubati(placards), inkuta zacukuwe ahazanyuzwa amasinga y’umuriro [/caption]  Ubwiru n’urujijo mu makosa Nubwo amakuru ku micungire y’aya mazu akomeza kugirwa ubwiru, bikomeza guteza urujijo kandi amakosa aragaragara. Nta kuntu inzu zisa, zifite imbata imwe, zatewe inkunga n’ikigo cyangwa urwego rumwe; zituzurira rimwe, ntizishyirwemo bimwe, ntizigengwe n’amabwiriza amwe. Izi nzu zatangiye kubakwa mu mwaka wa 2012-2013, buri nzu igizwe n’ibyumba umunani na salo ebyiri: bine bigenewe abakobwa na bine by’abahungu. Buri gihande kirimo ubwiherero bw’imbere mu nzu n’igikoni cyo mu nzu. Ibikoni n’ubwiherero byo hanze ni inyongera ishyirwaho n’imirenge cyangwa ibigo by’amashuri. Iyi nzu ifite agaciro ka miliyoni nibura 45 z’amanyarwanda. Gusa amakuru ahagije ku muterankunga n’uburyo zicungwa, minisiteri yarabibajijwe ntiyasubiza. Izi nzu kandi zakunze kugarukwaho na raporo y’umugenzuzi w’imari ya Leta, aho mu 2014 yavugaga ko zatinze kuzura, kuko zagombaga kuzura mu 2013. Ubwo izuzuye nyuma n’izitaruzura magingo aya zamaze gutinda. Mu mwaka wa 2015, umugenzuzi w’imari ya Leta yerekanye ko zimwe muri izi nzu zituzuye neza, izindi zubatswe mu manegeka, aho yagaragazaga ko zugarijwe n’amazi ashaka kuzisenya. Icyo atarareba ni uko zibyazwa umusaruro, naho izituzuye n’iziri gusenyuka nazo ziracyahari. title: Nyamasheke: Bamwe mu bana bajya ku mashuri batagira ibikoresho by’ibanze
content: Ikibazo cya bamwe mu babyeyi bohereza abana ku mashuri batabahaye ibikoresho by’ibanze cyane cyane mu mashuri abanza, ni bimwe mu bikomeje gukoma mu nkokora ireme ry’uburezi ryifuzwa mu karere ka Nyamasheke.  Iki kibazo ni kimwe mu byagaragajwe n’itsinda rimaze iminsi rigenzura uko ireme ry’uburezi rihagaze muri aka karere riturutse muri Minisiteri y’uburezi n’ibigo biyishamikiyeho, hakorwa ubukangurambaga mu gushakisha uko iri reme ryazamuka. Kuva ku wa 28 Mutarama kuzageza ku wa 8 Gashyantare uyu mwaka,hagomba gusurwa ibigo by’amashuri abanza n’ayisumbuye 34 harebwa imyigishirize n’ibibazo byaba birimo. Mu bibazo bikomeje kugaragara mu mashuri abanza y’aka karere ngo hari uko bamwe mu banyeshuri usanga nta bikoresho by’ibanze bagira, aho usanga hari abajya ku mashuri batagira amakayi, amakaramu n’ibindi bikoresho umwana akenera mu ishuri, n’ababifite ugasanga ntaho kubitwara bafite,ari byo bituma n’ibyo bafite bitamara kabiri,hakaba n’ababa bafite ibidahagije, ugasanga mu by’ukuri bitwa ko biga ariko batiga mu buryo bwakagombye. Ikindi kigaragazwa n’abayobozi bamwe mu mashuri yasuwe, harimo kuba nta nteganyanyigisho zihagije abarezi bafite, ibura ry’ibitabo kuri amwe muri aya mashuri n’ibihari bikaba ngo bidasubiza ibyifuzo bafite, ubucucike muri amwe mu mashuri ku buryo abana biga batisanzuye neza, ibyumba by’amashuri bishaje cyane abana bigiramo batizeye umutekano wa byo, n’ibindi byose ngo bigikeneye gushakirwa umuti urambye. Ushinzwe ubuzima no kurwanya icyorezo cya SIDA muri Minisiteri y’Uburezi, Tuyishime Frodouard avuga ko muri iri genzura hibandwa ku miyoborere y’ishuri n’imiterere yaryo, isuku n’isukura, n’ibindi bitandukanye, ariko cyane cyane hakibandwa ku myigishirize. Yagize ati “Kugira ngo uburezi bugire ireme rihamye bisaba uruhare rwa buri wese uhereye ku mwana ubwe ugomba kwiga, ababyeyi bagomba kumushakira ibikoresho by’ibanze, ubuyobozi bugomba kugenzura ko yigishwa neza, mwarimu ugomba kumwigisha, n’undi wese ugomba kugira uruhare mu migendekere myiza ya bwo.’’ Yarakomeje ati “Icyo dusaba abarebwa n’uburezi bose muri Nyamasheke ni ukongera ingufu mu kuzamura ireme ry’uburezi ryifuzwa, kureba niba ibikenewe byose byuzuye ngo umwana yige neza hasurwa amashuri mu buryo buhoraho, abataye amashuri bakayagarurwamo kuko na bo twababonye, guhoza ijisho ku miyoborere y’amashuri,no kureba cyane cyane ko abana bafite ibikoresho bihagije kuko ari cyo twasanze giteye inkeke cyane aho tumaze kugera.’’ Umwe mu babyeyi baganiriye na Bwiza.com yavuze ko kudaha umwana ibikoresho bihagije biterwa n’ubukene buba buri mu rugo cyangwa kuba biba byasaranganijwe benshi mu bushobozi bwa ntabwo,ko biba bitabaturutseho. Umuyobozi w’ishuri ribanza rya Rangiro riri mu murenge wa Rangiro, Nikuze Doborah, avuga ko ubukene butagombye kuba urwitwazo rwo kudaha umwana ibikoresho by’ishuri bihagije, ko ari cyo umwana aba asabwa cyonyine mu gihe ibindi Leta iba yabikemuye, agashishikariza ababyeyi kumva inshinga no zabo zirimo guha abana ibikoresho bya ngombwa, akabasaba ubuyobozi kujya bubagezaho integanyanyigisho n’ibitabo bikenewe ku gihe, kugira ngo na bo bakore ibyo basabwa nta ngorane. Iri genzura ribaye mu gihe iriherutse ryibanze ku isuku, aho amwe mu mashuri yabanje guhagarikwa kwakira abanyeshuri mu gihembwe cya gatatu cy’umwaka ushize, gusa nyuma yo gukora ibyo yasabwaga akaba yarongeye gukomorerwa. [caption id="attachment_125502" align="alignnone" width="1024"] Nshimirimana Nadine ushinzwe amahugurwa y’abarimu mu cyongereza no mu gifaransa muri REB( i buryo) areba uburyo umwarimu ategura amasomo mbere yo kwigisha[/caption] [caption id="attachment_125503" align="alignnone" width="1024"] Umuyobozi w’ishuri ribanza rya Rwumba mu murenge wa Cyato, Uwizeyimana JosÃ©phine asobanurira iri tsinda ibibazo bahura nabyo mu kunoza ireme ry’uburezi[/caption]

title: Rusizi: Urubyiruko rurasabwa kubyaza umusaruro amahirwe yo kwiga rwahawe
content: Abasore n’inkumi bagera kuri 261 biga mu mashuri yisumbuye na kaminuza baturuka mu miryango itishoboye bakaba bafashwa n’umushinga RW 0152 ukorera mu itorero MÃ©thodiste Libre, paruwasi ya Kamembe, ku nkunga ya Compassion international, bavuga ko biteguye kubyaza amahirwe bahawe na Leta yo kwiga. Ubwo bahurizwaga hamwe n’abayobozi babo babifuriza Noheli nziza n’umwaka mushya muhire wa 2019 banabaha ibikoresho by’ishuri,bamwe muri bo bavuze ko bababazwa cyane na bagenzi babo babona cyangwa bumva hirya no hino bari baragize amahirwe yo kubona ababitaho bakiga, nyamara bakayivutsa bishora mu ngeso mbi zirimo ibiyobyabwenge, uburaya n’ibindi bidahesheje agaciro urubyiruko rw’u Rwanda, bavuga ko bo biyemeje kudatatira igihango. Niyonkuru Josiane urangije umwaka wa Kane w’amashuri yisumbuye avuga ko atigeze abona se umubyara kuko yamenye ubwenge yaritabye Imana, bakaba ari abana benshi mu rugo kandi ubushobozi bwa nyina butarashoboraga kumubonera ibyo akeneye birimo amafaranga y’ishuri, ariko ko ku bw’amahirwe aba bagiraneza baramufata bamushyira mu ishuri bimuhindurira ubuzima. Yagize ati ’’Niteguye kubyaza umusaruro aya mahirwe akomeye atagirwa na bose, nziga na kaminuza ngere kure hashoboka nziture igihugu cyanjye ineza cyangiriye, Sinzigera nemera unshukisha ibindi kuko ubuzima bwiza ari yo mpano ikomeye iruta ibindi”. Umuyobozi w’umushinga RW 0152, Nkinzingabo Rusimbi Martin avuga ko yishimira ko urubyiruko rwabo rukurikira neza amasomo mu ishuri kandi rukurikiranirwa hafi no mu myitwarire, kuruhuriza hamwe baruha ibikoresho by’ishuri bakanarwifuriza iminsi mikuru myiza isoza umwaka bibafasha kurwongerera impanuro z’ubuzima. Ati ’’Tubakurikiranira hafi cyane uwo tubonye ashaka gutana tukamugira inama kandi barazumva kuko twifuza ko bazigirira akamaro bakakagirira n’imiryango yabo usanga ikiri mu bukene cyane.’’ Avuga ko impungenge bagira ari abagabo bubatse usanga bashaka gushukashuka bamwe mu bana b’abakobwa ariko ko bababa hafi ku buryo n’uwigeze kubigeragezwa yashyikirijwe inzego zibishinzwe akabihanirwa,abahungu na bo bakabakurikiranira hafi cyane ngo hatagira ugendera mu kigare cy’abanywa ibiyobyabwenge akaba yayoba bikamubuza amahirwe yo kwiga. Umubwiriza wa Conference ya Kinyaga muri iri torero, RÃ©v.pasiteri Habiyambere CÃ©lÃ©stin asaba uru rubyiruko kwiyumva nk’urukenewe n’igihugu cyose ejo hazaza rukita ku byo rusabwa n’ababyeyi n’abarukuriye,rukirinda abashaka kuruyobya kuko bene abo icyo baba bagamije ari ukurushora mu rupfu rw’umubiri n’ubugingo. [caption id="attachment_122478" align="alignnone" width="1024"] Bavuga ko bababazwa na bagenzi babo b’urungano usanga bangiza ubuzima bwabo[/caption]

title: Rusizi: Ababyeyi barasabwa kongera imbaraga mu gukundisha abana ishuri
content: Ubuyobozi bw’akarere ka Rusizi busanga kuba hari abana bata ishuri, biterwa ahanini n’ababyeyi batabakurikirana ngo baribakundishe ahubwo bagahugira mu yindi mirimo, bugasaba buri mubyeyi wese kwibuka uruhare rwe mu burezi bw’abana.  Ibi byagarutsweho mu mpera z’icyumweru gishize ubwo mu kigo ’Saint Matthew’s college’ ry’itorero ry’Abangilikani, Diyoseze ya Cyangugu basozaga umwaka w’amashuri, bamwe mu bana n’ababyeyi bakaba barashimangiye ko umwana witaweho n’ababyeyi ku ishuri atabura gutsinda neza. Mugisha Arnauld avuga ko kwitabwaho cyane n’ababyeyi, bibafasha mu myigire yabo, ati " umwana witabwaho n’ababyeyi ku ishuri atandukanye kure n’utitabwaho nubwo iwabo baba bafite ibindi byose bamuha mu buzima. label: education
title: Kaminuza ya Mount Kenya I Rusizi na Kaminuza ya Kigali I Musanze zahagaritswe
content:
Inama nkuru y’amashuri makuru na za Kaminuza mu Rwanda, (Rwanda Higher Education Council) HEC, yahagaritse  Kaminuza ya Mount Kenya ishami rya Rusizi hamwe na kaminuza ya Kigali ishami rya Musanze bazira kuba baratangije amwe mu mashami na gahunda z’amasomo kuko bitangwa zitabifitiye uburenganzira. 
Zimwe muri kaminuza zagezweho n’ iki cyemezo harimo Kaminuza ya Mount Kenya ishami rya Rusizi na Kaminuza ya Kigali ishami rya Musanze.

Umuyobozi wa HEC, Dr. Innocent Mugisha,  yabwiye itangazamakuru ko ayo mashuri yafunzwe kuko hari ibyo babuzwa n’amategeko ariko bakanga bakabirengaho kandi bigira ingaruka no ku banyeshuri.
Yagize ati “Turashaka kuburira Abanyarwanda mu itangira ry’ amashuri 2015/2016.
Abantu bajye kwiyandikisha bari maso muri za porogaramu zemewe, kuko bimaze kugaragara ko hari za Kaminuza zimwe zagiye zemererwa gutangira amaporogaramu amwe, ariko bakiyongereramo ayandi, abanyeshuri bakajya kubimenya byageze hagati, bigateza ikibazo.”
Charles Kamuru ushinzwe itumanaho muri Kaminuza ya Kigali, yavuze ko hari ibyo HEC yabasabye, ariko bakaba batarabyuzuza mu ishuri ryigiramo icyiciro cya gatatu cya Kaminuza i Musanze, ariko ngo bari mu biganiro ku buryo kuwa Mbere bizaba byagiye mu buryo.

Yagize ati “Porogaramu (gahunda z’amasomo) zatangwagayo zaremewe na HEC, ariko hari ibyo basaba, ubu turi mu biganiro ngo turebe ko ibibura twabyuzuza. No kuwa Mbere dufitanye inama nabo kugira ngo noneho ibyo badusaba tubiganireho, tubyuzezo, noneho ibe Campus yemewe neza.”
Iri shami rya Kaminuza ya Kigali i Musanze ryigiramo abanyeshuri bagera kuri 50.
Dr. Mugisha uyobora Inama nkuru y’amashuri makuru na za Kaminuza avuga ko n’ubwo hari amwe mu mashuri yafungiwe porogaramu zigishwaga, hari n’ izindi zari zarafunzwe zakomorewe n’ubwo uyu muyobozi atifuje guhita azitangaza kuko ngo hari ikiganiro n’abanyamakuru bari gutegura.
 Kanda hano ujye ubona amakuru yihuse kandi kugihe kuri Facebook no kuri twitter  
Alphonse Munyankindi / Bwiza.com

label: politics
title: Maj. (Rtd) Habib Mudhatiru yemeye ibyaha byose ashinjwa ataruhanyije
content: Maj.(Rtd) Habib Mudhatiru, umwe mu bantu 25 bakurikiranweho kuba mu mitwe y’inyeshyamba (nka RNC na FDLR) irwanya ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda kuri ubu bari kuburanishwa n’urukiko rwa Gisirikare, kuri uyu wa Gatanu, itariki 18 Ukwakira, yemeye ibyaha ashinjwa avuga ko atabihakana kuko bigaragara. Aba bantu uko ari 25 bakurikiranweho ibyaha bigera kuri bine birimo; kurema no kuba mu mutwe witwara gisirikare utemewe, ubugambanyi, kugambirira kugirira nabi ubutegetsi buriho no kugirana imibanire n’igihugu cy’amahanga. Kuri uyu wa Gatanu Maj. (Rtd) Habib Mudhatiru yemeye ataruhanyije icyaha cyo kwinjira mu mutwe witwara gisirikare utemewe. Ati: “Ibyaha ndimo gushinjwa hafi ya byose ni ukuri kandi sinabihakana kuko biragaragara.” Yakomeje agira ati: “nibyo uwo mutwe wa gisirikare uriho kandi nari nkurimo.” Yongeyeho ko ari ukuri koko yabonanye n’abasirikare bakuru mu Burundi ariko nta wo muri Uganda bahuye. Ati: “Ndemera ibyaha byose bine nshinjwa kandi nifuzaga kuvuga ko nsabye imbabazi bimvuye ku mutima ku kwivanga muri buri kimwe.” Umwunganizi we mu mategeko, Paula Umulisa, yabwiye urukiko ko umukiriya we yaruhaye ubuhamya bw’amapaji 7 ku byaha byose ashinjwa, asaba ko igisigaye ari ukwihutisha ibintu bakaba bagombye gutangira kuburana ku ifungwa n’ifungurwa ry’agateganyo. Umucamanza akaba yamubwiye ko amategeko ari yo agena uko iburanisha rikorwa.

content: Nyuma y’amakuru yakomeje gutangazwa hirya no hino ko u Rwanda, u Burundi, Uganda na Tanzania bigiye guhurira muri Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo, gutera ingabo mu bitugu iki gihugu mu rugamba rwo guhashya imitwe y’inyeshyamba, ubuyobozi bw’u Rwanda rwayateye utwatsi.
