title: Kamonyi: Umunsi wa Siporo rusange no kuyitangiza mu mashuri byari ibicika(amafoto)
content: Kuri iki cyumweru tariki 02 Gashyantare 2020 mu mbuga y’Akarere ka Kamonyi hakorewe Siporo rusange, yitabirwa n’imbaga y’abaturage n’abanyeshuri baturutse mu mirenge ya Gacurabwenge, Runda, Rugalika Musambira n’ahandi. Wanabaye umunsi wo gutangiza iyi Siporo mu mashuri, haba amarushanwa, hatangwa n’ibihembo bitandukanye. Muri iki gikorwa cya Siporo rusange no kuyitangiza mu mashuri ku rwego rw’Igihugu, abitabiriye bapimwe ku bushake indwara zitandura (Tension arterielle, Body Mass Index…). Ibi byo gupima indwara zitandura byakozwe ku bufatanye n’ibitaro bya Remera-Rukoma. Iyi gahunda, yahuriranye n’isuzuma ku mikorere n’imikoreshareze ya Siporo rusange mu turere tugize Intara y’amajyepfo ryakozwe n’abakozi n’Intara. Abagize itsinda ryaturutse ku Ntara ryari riyobowe na Kabera Vedaste (Kaveda) ushinzwe imiyoborere n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage, aho bifatanije n’Abanyakamonyi muri iyi Siporo rusange. Mu butumwa bwahawe abitabiriye iyi Siporo, Kayitesi Alice umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Kamonyi yibukije ko Siporo ari ubuzima, asaba abaturage gukomeza kwitabira iyi myitozo no kubikangurira abandi hagamijwe kurinda ubuzima bwabo. Umuyobozi wa Polisi mu Karere ka Kamonyi, mu butumwa yatanze yagarutse ku bukangurambaga bwa gahunda ya “Gerayo Amahoro”, aho yakanguriye abantu kumenya gukoresha neza umuhanda, birinda impanuka n’ikindi cyose cyatuma ufashe urugendo atagera iyo agiye amahoro. Dr Jaribu Theogene, umuyobozi mukuru w’Ibitaro bya Remera-Rukoma yagarutse ku kamaro ko gukora Siporo, abwira abayitabiriye ibyiza byayo mu kurinda ubuzima bw’umuntu zimwe mu ndwara n’ibindi bishobora kuwibasira bitewe no kudakora siporo.  Uyu munsi kandi wa Siporo rusange, waranzwe no gutangiza Siporo mu mashuri ku rwego rw’Igihugu mu mwaka wa 2020, aho mu karere ka Kamonyi byitabiriwe na Padiri Gatete Innocent, umuyobozi wa Federation ya Siporo mu mashuri. Mu butumwa yagejeje ku bitabiriye iki gikorwa, yagarutse cyane ku gushishikariza abanyeshuri kwitabira Siporo by’umwihariko imikino bityo bakagaragaza impano bifitemo ari nako baziteza imbere. Mu gukora iyi Siporo rusanjye, igikundi kimwe cyaturutse mu isantere y’ubucuruzi ya Nkoto, ikindi gituruka ku Kamonyi bose bahurira mu mbuga y’Akarere ka Kamonyi bakomereza imyitozo hamwe mbere yo kujya mu bindi bikorwa twavuze hejuru. Hatanzwe ibihembo bitandukanye ku bantu bitwaye neza mu kwitabira Siporo no kuyishishikariza abandi, hanahembwa amakipe yakinnye.                 Munyaneza Theogene / intyoza.com

title: Rusizi: Itorero Inyamibwa ryishimiye impano ryagejejweho na Polisi y’Igihugu
content: Ni kuri uyu wa 10 Nyakanga 2019 ku biro by’Umurenge wa Bweyeye ubwo umuyobozi  wa Polisi mu ntara y’Iburengerazuba Commissioner of Police (CP) Rogers Rutikanga yashyikirije imyenda 60 itorero Inyamibwa rihakorera umurimo wo kubyina risusurutsa abashyitsi bagendereye uyu murenge. Itorero Inyamibwa ribyina imbyino za gakondo risusurutsa abashyitsi basuye uyu murenge wa Bweyeye rikaba rigizwe n’ababyinnyi bagera kuri mirongo itandatu (60), aba babyinnyi bakaba baturuka mu tugari dutandukanye tugize uyu murenge. Ubwo umuyobozi wa Polisi muri iyi ntara yabagezagaho iyi myenda yavuze ko ubuyobozi bwa Polisi bwifuje kubagenera imyenda yo kuzajya bakorana uyu murimo wabo wo kubyina. Yagize ati“ Mu rwego rw’imikoranire myiza, Ubuyobozi bwa Polisi y’u Rwanda bwishimiye igikorwa cyiza mukora cyo kwakira abashyitsi mu basusurutsa, bubibonye bwifuza kubashakira imyenda ituma mugaragara neza kandi mukarushaho gukora kinyamwuga.” Yakomeje ababwira ko basabwa gukomeza gukorera hamwe kandi bakagira uruhare mu gukumira no kurwanya ibyaha aho batuye. CP Rutikanga akomeza ashimira ibikorwa byiza iri torero rikora, agasaba n’indi mirenge kwigira kuri iri torero kuko ntibigiramo kubyina gusa bigiramo n’ibindi bibafasha guteza imbere ingo zabo, kwirinda no kurwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina, kugira uruhare mu gukumira no kurwanya ibyaha batangira amakuru ku gihe n’ibindi byinshi bitandukanye. Ati“ Byaba byiza buri murenge ufite iteroro risusurutsa abashyitsi bagana umurenge wabo, kuko rinafasha ubuyobozi mu kwigisha abaturage ribinyujije mu butumwa bw’indirimbo.” Umuhuzabikorwa w’umurenge wa Bweyeye Habimana Emmanuel yashimiye ubuyobozi bwa Polisi y’u Rwanda kuri iyi myambaro buhaye itorero ryabo avuga ko izabafasha mu kunoza ibikorwa byabo bakoraga kandi ko n’ubuyobozi buzaguma kubaba hafi kugira ngo igikorwa bakora kigume gutera imbere. Umuyobozi w’iri torero Nyirahategekimana Odette yavuze ko ari ibyagaciro gakomeye kubona ubuyobozi bwa Polisi y’u Rwanda bwarabatekereje bukabagenera iyi mpano y’imyenda yo gukoresha mu mwuga wabo wo kubyina. Yakomeje avuga ko iyi myenda bahawe izabafasha kurushaho kunoza igikorwa cyabo cyo kubyina batanga ubutumwa ku baturage ndetse n’abashyitsi babagana. intyoza.com

title: Kamonyi: Amakipe y’Akarere agiye guhagararira Igihugu mu mikino ya FEASSA yahawe Inama n’Impanuro
content: Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Kamonyi Kayitesi Alice ari kumwe n’abayobozi batandukanye kuri uyu wa 12 Kanama 2019 bakiriye amakipe atatu y’ibigo by’amashuri yisumbuye agiye guhagararira u Rwanda mu mikino ya FEASSA (Imikino ihuza ibigo by’amashuri yisumbuye byo mu karere ka Afurika y’Uburasirazuba) izabera mu gihugu cya Tanzaniya kuva kuwa 15-25 Kanama 2019. Mayor Kayitesi Alice, yibukije abakinnyi bose bagize amakipe y’Akarere agiye guhagararira Igihugu ko bakwiye kuzirikana ishema ry’Igihugu, bagaharanira gusigasira indangagaciro na Kirazira by’Umuco Nyarwanda ariko kandi batibagiwe intsinzi. Ati” Ibyo mwagombaga gukora rero mwarabikoze, ariko ubu mugeze ahakomeye kurusha ahandi. Mugiye mwambaye isura y’Igihugu ari nayo ikomeye cyane. Umunyarwanda agomba kwitwara ate mu gihugu cy’Amahanga!? Igikomeye cyane ni Discipline (ikinyabupfura) igomba kubaranga nk’Abanyarwanda, ni Ubumwe bugomba kubaranga. Nubwo mugiye muri amakipe atatu atandukanye muri Tanzaniya muzaba muriyo muri Abanyarwanda, mugomba kugira imyitwarire ibereye Umunyarwanda”. Yakomeje ati” Buri wese agende yumva ngo ni iyihe myitwarire itazasebya Igihugu, itazatesha agaciro indangagaciro zacu nk’Abanyarwanda. Turashaka ko mukomeza kuzamura Ibendera ry’Igihugu cyacu aho mugiye, ikindi kandi turashaka intsinzi ntabwo dushaka ko mugenda ngo mutsindwe kuko ubushobozi murabufite n’ibindi byose birahari”.  Uwimbabazi Immaculee, Kapiteni w’Ikipe y’Amaguru y’abakobwa( ba GS Remera-Rukoma) yijeje ubuyobozi imyitwarire myiza n’intsinzi anasaba bagenzi be kuba umwe bakumva ko batagiye gutembera dore ko iyi kipe ari nayo iheruka kuzana igikombe muri iyi mikino mu myaka ibiri ishize.  Ati ” Ntabwo tugiye gutembera.Tugiye gufashanya, dukorere hamwe kandi turangwe na Discipline nk’Abakobwa b’u Rwanda, tubaheshe agaciro nkamwe bayobozi mugiye gusigara aha ng’aha. Icyo nsaba bagenzi banjye ni ugusenyera umugozi umwe nk’Abakobwa b’u Rwanda tujyanye muri kiriya Gihugu nta gutatana tugakorera hamwe”.  Mwiseneza Denise, Kapiteni w’Ikipe y’umupira w’intoki( Basketball- Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Ste Bernadette) yashimiye ubuyobozi bwabahaye ibyo bari bakeneye mu kwitegura iyi mikino. Mu izina rya bagenzi be avuga ko intego bafite ari ukuza mu makipe azagera ku mukino wa nyuma kuko ubushize babaye aba kane.  Ntirenganya Fidele, Kapiteni w’Ikipe y’imikino ngororamubiri-abasiganwa n’amaguru-Abiruka, yavuze ko amahirwe yo gusohokera Igihugu batazayapfusha ubusa. Ati ” Intego yacu dukurikije imyitozo twahawe, inyigisho twahawe na Discipline badutoje twiteguye kuzazana imidari”. Emmanuel Habiyambere, Diregiteri Tekinike(ushinzwe imikino) mu karere ka Kamonyi aho agiye ari umutoza w’ikipe y’abasiganwa n’amaguru, yabwiye intyoza.com ko imyiteguro yagenze neza, ko mu gihe cy’Ikiruhuko gishize aba bagiye kwiruka bakoreye imyitozo mu karere ka Gicumbi ahari ikirere kiberanye n’ibyo bifuza, mu gihe andi makipe nayo yari kumwe n’abatoza aho bakoraga igitondo n’ikigoroba. Ahamya ko kwitwara neza bitazabagwirira kuko bagiye biteguye guhagararira Igihugu neza bagatahukana ishema. Padiri Majyambere Jean d’Amour, ushinzwe Federasiyo y’imikino mu mashuri mu karere ka Kamonyi yashimiye ubwitange bw’abakinnyi bagaragaje mu kugera aho bageze ariko kandi anabasaba ko barushaho kubyerekana bahagararira neza Igihugu. Ati ” Baduhesheje icyubahiro icyo twifuza ni uko bagerayo bagakomereza aho ng’aho”. Amakipe yose azahagararira u Rwanda biteganijwe ko kuri uyu wa Kabiri Tariki 13 Kanama 2019 ku i saa cyenda azahurira muri IPRC Kigali- Kicukiro bagahabwa inama n’impanuro na Minisitiri ufite iyi mikino mu nshingano ze, nyuma mu rukerera bagahaguruka berekeza mu gihugu cya Tanzaniya aho imikino izabera. Imikino ifungura irushanwa biteganijwe ko izatangira Tariki 15 Kanama 2019. Biteganijwe ko aba bakinnyi bazagaruka mu Rwanda tariki 26 Kanama 2019 imikino yaraye irangiye.           Munyaneza Theogene / intyoza.com

Yakomeje ati” Buri wese agende yumva ngo ni iyihe myitwarire itazasebya Igihugu, itazatesha agaciro indangagaciro zacu nk’Abanyarwanda. Turashaka ko mukomeza kuzamura Ibendera ry’Igihugu cyacu aho mugiye, ikindi kandi turashaka intsinzi ntabwo dushaka ko mugenda ngo mutsindwe kuko ubushobozi murabufite n’ibindi byose birahari”.  Uwimbabazi Immaculee, Kapiteni w’Ikipe y’Amaguru y’abakobwa( ba GS Remera-Rukoma) yijeje ubuyobozi imyitwarire myiza n’intsinzi anasaba bagenzi be kuba umwe bakumva ko batagiye gutembera dore ko iyi kipe ari nayo iheruka kuzana igikombe muri iyi mikino mu myaka ibiri ishize.  Ati ” Ntabwo tugiye gutembera.Tugiye gufashanya, dukorere hamwe kandi turangwe na Discipline nk’Abakobwa b’u Rwanda, tubaheshe agaciro nkamwe bayobozi mugiye gusigara aha ng’aha. Icyo nsaba bagenzi banjye ni ugusenyera umugozi umwe nk’Abakobwa b’u Rwanda tujyanye muri kiriya Gihugu nta gutatana tugakorera hamwe”.  Mwiseneza Denise, Kapiteni w’Ikipe y’umupira w’intoki( Basketball- Ishuri ryisumbuye rya Ste Bernadette) yashimiye ubuyobozi bwabahaye ibyo bari bakeneye mu kwitegura iyi mikino. Mu izina rya bagenzi be avuga ko intego bafite ari ukuza mu makipe azagera ku mukino wa nyuma kuko ubushize babaye aba kane.  Ntirenganya Fidele, Kapiteni w’Ikipe y’imikino ngororamubiri-abasiganwa n’amaguru-Abiruka, yavuze ko amahirwe yo gusohokera Igihugu batazayapfusha ubusa. Ati ” Intego yacu dukurikije imyitozo twahawe, inyigisho twahawe na Discipline badutoje twiteguye kuzazana imidari”. Emmanuel Habiyambere, Diregiteri Tekinike(ushinzwe imikino) mu karere ka Kamonyi aho agiye ari umutoza w’ikipe y’abasiganwa n’amaguru, yabwiye intyoza.com ko imyiteguro yagenze neza, ko mu gihe cy’Ikiruhuko gishize aba bagiye kwiruka bakoreye imyitozo mu karere ka Gicumbi ahari ikirere kiberanye n’ibyo bifuza, mu gihe andi makipe nayo yari kumwe n’abatoza aho bakoraga igitondo n’ikigoroba. Ahamya ko kwitwara neza bitazabagwirira kuko bagiye biteguye guhagararira Igihugu neza bagatahukana ishema. Padiri Majyambere Jean d’Amour, ushinzwe Federasiyo y’imikino mu mashuri mu karere ka Kamonyi yashimiye ubwitange bw’abakinnyi bagaragaje mu kugera aho bageze ariko kandi anabasaba ko barushaho kubyerekana bahagararira neza Igihugu. Ati ” Baduhesheje icyubahiro icyo twifuza ni uko bagerayo bagakomereza aho ng’aho”. Amakipe yose azahagararira u Rwanda biteganijwe ko kuri uyu wa Kabiri Tariki 13 Kanama 2019 ku i saa cyenda azahurira muri IPRC Kigali- Kicukiro bagahabwa inama n’impanuro na Minisitiri ufite iyi mikino mu nshingano ze, nyuma mu rukerera bagahaguruka berekeza mu gihugu cya Tanzaniya aho imikino izabera. Imikino ifungura irushanwa biteganijwe ko izatangira Tariki 15 Kanama 2019. Biteganijwe ko aba bakinnyi bazagaruka mu Rwanda tariki 26 Kanama 2019 imikino yaraye irangiye.           Munyaneza Theogene / intyoza.com

title: Rulindo/Burega: Barasaba RDB kuza gutwara inkende bita izayo
content: Abaturage b’Umurenge wa Burega bavuga ko imyaka ibaye myinshi badahinga ngo basarura kubera inkende ziva mu ishyamba zikona ibyo bahinze. Bavuga ko batakiye inzego zitandukanye babuze ubumva. Bavuga kandi ko izi nkende ari iza RDB, ko yaza ikazibakiza kuko badatuye muri Parike. Bamwe mu baturage baganiriye n’intyoza.com kuri uyu wa Kabiri Tariki 13 Kanama 2019 bavuga ko izi nkende akenshi zizamuka mubaturage mu masaha ya mugitondo n’ay’umugoroba zije gushaka ibyo zona. Bavuga ko nta muturage ugihinga imyaka ngo asarure kuko zibirira mu mirima ku buryo byaba Ibigori, Soya, Ibijumba, Ikawa, Amashaza, mbese ngo nta kintu zitarya. Umwe mu baturage uvuga ko yazengerejwe n’izi nkende utwo ahinze zisarurira, yabwiye intyoza.com ati” Ziraza ntacyo zisiga, ni nyinshi kuko harimo izimaze gukura, udutoya, byose zirarya. Mbese Turifuza ko banyirazo bariya bashinzwe ibidukikije baza bakazifata bakazijyana muri Parike nubundi kuko hano nti turi muri parike, bakazidukiza kuko hano ziratwononera”. Nikuze Didasiyana utuye mu Mudugudu wa Mataba, Akagari ka Karengeri avuga ko izi nkende zaje mu mwaka wa 2011 bakabanza kuyoberwa ibyo aribyo ku buryo mu bihe bya mbere zaboneraga bakagira ngo ni abajura biraye mu myaka yabo. Ati“ Naramanutse nsanga imirima y’amashaza yatonowe nsubira mu rugo ndimo kuvuza induru ngo abantu badutonoreye amashaza, abo murugo nabo bati abantu batwibye ku manywa bagatonoreramo ni bande? Muri 2012 nibwo twamenye ko ari inkende kuko twaziboneye zikajya zizamuka. Twahingaga intoryi, twarabiretse duhinga Karoti, n’amashu ejobundi narayahinze zirazamuka zikarya ibihaza by’amashu, n’urubingo ziraza zikarya.Turashaka ko baza bakazitwara ntabwo wamenya n’umubare wazo”. Uretse kuba izi nkende zona imyaka y’abaturage, ngo hari n’ubwo zihohotera abana nk’abajya ku ishuri. Si abana gusa kandi ngo n’abagore haba ubwo zibasuzugura bagakizwa n’amaguru. Habarurema Elias asaba ko RDB yaza igatwara amatungo yayo. Ati “ Twifuzaga ko rwose RDB yaza aya matungo ikayajyana cyangwa se ikareba ukuntu yayazitira. Ziduteye ikibazo rwose cyane kuko zirona kuva Karengeri, Taba na Cyinzuzi, mbese zarampombeje nk’igihembwe cy’ihinga gishize nahinze inyanya zarampombeje nk’ibihumbi 50, mpinga amatunda aya arandaranda ku biti ayo zayanciyeho kandi ni ikintu cyanyinjirizaga amafaranga”. Kamugwera Yozefa, utuye mu kagari ka Taba avuga ko bakanguriwe guhuza ubutaka ngo bahinge Ibigori ariko izi Nkende zihindura gahunda. Ati “ Hari igihe batubwiye duhuze ubutaka duhinge ibigori, ibigori nti tujya tubihahinga kuko zirabirya. Bati tuzahinga amajeri-Amashaza, nti duhinga ahubwo rimwe hari igihe zaduteranije n’abantu tugira ngo ni abagiye kutwiba”. Uyu mubyeyi avuga ko uretse kuba zibonera ngo banafite impungenge z’indwara zishobora kubatera. Ati “ Nk’ubu nk’izi ndwara bavuga ntabwo tuzi…, n’aho zituma ntituhazi nta n’urabona umupfu wayo avuge ngo iyi nkende yazize iki? Icyo twifuza ni uko zihavuye twagira umutekano kuko zidutera inzara”. Mbera Rodrigues, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Burega ahamanya n’aba baturage ko ikibazo cy’inkende kibakomereye, ko bakeneye ubuvugizi bwatuma umuturage ahinga yizeye gusarura atonewe n’Inkende. Gusa na none avuga ko ikibazo bakigejeje ku nzego zitandukanye bakaba bizeye igisubizo. Ati “ Ikibazo cy’Inkende turakizi kuko nanjye ubwanjye n’ubwo ntari mpari ( ni mushya mu Murenge) nari nkizi ko zonera abaturage. Umwaka ushize byarasakuje cyane amajwi yanyu ntabwo yagarukiye aha ngaha yageze n’ahandi harenze aha ubuyobozi bw’Akarere busaba RDB kuza kureba ikibazo cyabaye aha. Ari ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ari na RDB barabizi bari kudushakira umuti niba bazazimukana bakazijyana nk’ikigali badahinga si mbizi. Turakizi ko ari ikibazo gikomeye”. Intero y’abaturage ni uko ubuyobozi by’umwihariko RDB ifite izi nyamaswa mu nshingano zayo yabakiza guhora bonerwa nazo ariko kandi bagakira n’impungenge z’uko zishobora no gugira indwara zibanduza dore ko bavuga ko umubare wazo ari mwinshi cyane ku buryo iyo zizamukiye mu mirima y’abaturage ntacyo zisiga. Munyaneza Theogene / intyoza.com

label: economy
title: Ibuprofen isanzwe ikoreshwa mu kugabanya ububabare igiye kugeragezwa kuri Covid-19
content: Umuti wa Ibuprofen usanzwe ukoreshwa mu kugabanya ububabare, abahanga muri Siyansi bagiye kuwugerageza ngo barebe niba utakwifashishwa mu gufasha abari mu bitaro kubera icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Abagize itsinda ry’abahanga bo ku bitaro by’i Londres ( mu Bwongereza) bya Guy’s na St Thomas ndetse na King’s College London batekereza ko uyu muti wa Ibuprofen , usanzwe ufasha mu koroshya ububabare, ushobora kuvura abafite ibibazo byo guhumeka. Aba bahanga muri Siyanse, bizeye ko uyu muti udahenze ushobora gufasha abarwayi kuva ku byuma bibafasha guhumeka (ventilators). Muri iri geregeza ryiswe Liberate, kimwe cya kabiri cy’abarwayi bazahwabwa ibuprofen nk’inyongera y’ubundi buvuzi bahabwa. Iri gerageza rizakoresha ubundi bwoko budasanzwe bwa ibuprofen, aho gukoresha ibinini bisanzwe abantu bagura. Ubushakashatsi bwakorewe ku nyamaswa bugaragaza ko uyu muti ushobora kuvura ibimenyetso byo guhumeka nabi, kimwe mu biranga umuntu urembejwe na coronavirus. Prof Mitul Mehta wo mu itsinda rya King’s College London agira ati: “Tugomba gukora igerageza kugira ngo turebe niba ibivamo bihuye n’ibyo twiteze”. Mu bihe bya mbere by’iki cyorezo byavugwaga ko ibuprofen ishobora kuba ari mbi ku bantu mu gihe bayifata bafite ibimenyetso byoroheje by’iyi virus. Ibi byashimangiwe na Olivier Véran, Minisitiri w’ubuzima w’Ubufaransa, wavuze ko gufata imiti nka ibuprofen bishobora gutuma umuntu aremba. Yatanze inama yo gufata paracetamol ahubwo. Abahanga mu buvuzi, nyuma baje kwemeza ko kimwe na paracetamol, ibuprofen nayo igabanya umuriro kandi irwanya ibimenyetso by’ibicurane bityo nayo kuyifata nta cyo bitwaye. Ikigo cy’ubuzima cya Leta y’Ubwongereza, nkuko BBC dukesha iyi nkuru ikomeza ibitangaza, kigira inama abafite ibimenyetso byoroheje bya coronavirus gufata mbere na mbere paracetamol kuko ariyo ifite ingaruka zo ku ruhande nkeya kurusha ibuprofen. Munyaneza Theogene /intyoza.com

label: technology
title: Abajura biba bakoresheje ikoranabuhanga bararye bari menge
content: Mu gihe ikoranabuhanga bamwe barikoresha mu kwiteza imbere, hari abahisemo kurikoresha nk’umuyoboro wo kwiba utw’abandi batavunikiye. Uwimanimpaye Jean Damascene, umugabo w’imyaka 33 uvuka mu karere ka Rubavu umurenge wa Rubavu, afitwe n’inzego za Polisi y’u Rwanda akekwaho kwiba akoresheje ikoranabuhanga. Jean Damascene agira ati”Icyaha CID yamfatiye nuko nibisha ikoranabuhanga, nkaba icyaha nkurikiranyweho n’inzego z’umutekano nkemera”. Jean Damascene ukekwaho iki cyaha, bumwe muburyo akoresha ngo ni ukujya ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, agasoma amatangazo atanga akazi, akareba abagasabye n’ibibaranga ubundi agafata Telefone zabo akabahamagara yiyita umukozi w’ikigo basabyemo akazi akabaka amafaranga abizeza akazi. Uwimanimpaye, avuga ko bamwe mubo yaririye amafaranga bagiye bayanyuza kuri MTN mobile Money na TIGO cash, amafaranga aheruka kurya ngo agera kubihumbi 400 by’u Rwanda kubari basabye akazi muri Minisiteri y’Umutekano w’Igihugu (MININTER). Uwimana kandi ashyira cyane mu majwi kompanyi ya MTN ko bamwe mu bakozi bayo bagira uruhare muri ubu bujura ngo kuko aribo babagurisha simukadi bakoresha bahamagarisha kuburyo uhamagawe atabona nomero imuhamagaye. Uwimanimpaye, avuga ko ubu bujura yabwigishijwe n’umukozi wahoze ari uwa kampanyi wirukanywe ari nawe wajyaga muri MTN akavugana na bamwe mu bakozi bayo bakamuha Simukadi zikoreshwa zitagaragaza nomero. Jean Damascene, avuga ko Simukadi imwe ya MTN itagaragaza nomero yayiguze amafaranga ibihumbi 20,000 by’u Rwanda, asaba ko ababagurisha izi Simukadi zitagaragaza nomero barekera aho ngo kuko bari mubatuma ibyaha nkibi bikorwa. Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Celestin Twahirwa, umuvugizi w’igipolisi cy’u Rwanda, avuga ko uyu Jean damascene ari umwe mu bantu bakurikiranyeho icyaha kirimo uburiganya, kwambura umuntu ibye umushukishije amayeri adasanzwe kugira ngo ubashe kumuvanaho umutungo we cyangwa se igice cy’umutungo we. Umuvugizi w’Igipolisi cy’u Rwanda ACP Celestin Twahirwa, asaba abantu kudakomeza kwemera kwibwa muri ubu buryo, babashukisha ko batomboye, kubashukisha ko bagiye kubona umurimo, uzabyumva wese bamuhamagaye ngo azamenye ko ari ubusambo burimo gukorwa. ACP Twahirwa, asaba cyane urubyiruko ruri gusaba akazi ari rwinshi guca mu nzira zizwi zo gusaba akazi, urubyiruko ngo ni rwirinde ubu bujura bukoreshejwe kubashuka no gukoresha amayeri ngo babatware amafaranga yabo. Umuvugizi w’igipolisi cy’u Rwanda ACP Celestin Twahirwa, asaba kompanyi zikora akazi k’itumanaho gushyira mo ingufu mu kumenya ko ibikorwa nta ruhare babigizemo kandi ngo abantu biyandikisha ho imirongo ya telefone mu buryo buboroheye bakiba abantu ngo biraterwa n’uburyo barimo gukora. Jean Damascene ukekwaho ubu bujura, icyaha kimuhamye ngo ashobora guhanishwa igifungo kuva ku myaka 3 kugeza ku myaka5 akaba yanacibwa n’ihazabu kuva kuri Miliyoni 3 kugera kuri eshanu, iyo bigaragaye ko yabikoze ashaka gukoresha impapuro z’agaciro zihwanye n’amafaranga, banki n’ibindi ngo ihazabu ishobora kuzamuka kugera kuri Miliyoni icumi.   Munyaneza Theogene / intyoza.com

Jean Damascene ukekwaho iki cyaha, bumwe muburyo akoresha ngo ni ukujya ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, agasoma amatangazo atanga akazi, akareba abagasabye n’ibibaranga ubundi agafata Telefone zabo akabahamagara yiyita umukozi w’ikigo basabyemo akazi akabaka amafaranga abizeza akazi. Uwimanimpaye, avuga ko bamwe mubo yaririye amafaranga bagiye bayanyuza kuri MTN mobile Money na TIGO cash, amafaranga aheruka kurya ngo agera kubihumbi 400 by’u Rwanda kubari basabye akazi muri Minisiteri y’Umutekano w’Igihugu (MININTER). Uwimana kandi ashyira cyane mu majwi kompanyi ya MTN ko bamwe mu bakozi bayo bagira uruhare muri ubu bujura ngo kuko aribo babagurisha simukadi bakoresha bahamagarisha kuburyo uhamagawe atabona nomero imuhamagaye. Uwimanimpaye, avuga ko ubu bujura yabwigishijwe n’umukozi wahoze ari uwa kampanyi wirukanywe ari nawe wajyaga muri MTN akavugana na bamwe mu bakozi bayo bakamuha Simukadi zikoreshwa zitagaragaza nomero. Jean Damascene, avuga ko Simukadi imwe ya MTN itagaragaza nomero yayiguze amafaranga ibihumbi 20,000 by’u Rwanda, asaba ko ababagurisha izi Simukadi zitagaragaza nomero barekera aho ngo kuko bari mubatuma ibyaha nkibi bikorwa. Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Celestin Twahirwa, umuvugizi w’igipolisi cy’u Rwanda, avuga ko uyu Jean damascene ari umwe mu bantu bakurikiranyeho icyaha kirimo uburiganya, kwambura umuntu ibye umushukishije amayeri adasanzwe kugira ngo ubashe kumuvanaho umutungo we cyangwa se igice cy’umutungo we. Umuvugizi w’Igipolisi cy’u Rwanda ACP Celestin Twahirwa, asaba abantu kudakomeza kwemera kwibwa muri ubu buryo, babashukisha ko batomboye, kubashukisha ko bagiye kubona umurimo, uzabyumva wese bamuhamagaye ngo azamenye ko ari ubusambo burimo gukorwa. ACP Twahirwa, asaba cyane urubyiruko ruri gusaba akazi ari rwinshi guca mu nzira zizwi zo gusaba akazi, urubyiruko ngo ni rwirinde ubu bujura bukoreshejwe kubashuka no gukoresha amayeri ngo babatware amafaranga yabo. Umuvugizi w’igipolisi cy’u Rwanda ACP Celestin Twahirwa, asaba kompanyi zikora akazi k’itumanaho gushyira mo ingufu mu kumenya ko ibikorwa nta ruhare babigizemo kandi ngo abantu biyandikisha ho imirongo ya telefone mu buryo buboroheye bakiba abantu ngo biraterwa n’uburyo barimo gukora. Jean Damascene ukekwaho ubu bujura, icyaha kimuhamye ngo ashobora guhanishwa igifungo kuva ku myaka 3 kugeza ku myaka5 akaba yanacibwa n’ihazabu kuva kuri Miliyoni 3 kugera kuri eshanu, iyo bigaragaye ko yabikoze ashaka gukoresha impapuro z’agaciro zihwanye n’amafaranga, banki n’ibindi ngo ihazabu ishobora kuzamuka kugera kuri Miliyoni icumi.   Munyaneza Theogene / intyoza.com

title: Kamonyi: Amasaka agiye kongera guhabwa agaciro nk’igihingwa cyatoranijwe kubera uruganda rw’Ikigage
content: Uruganda rw’ikigage rwuzuye mu karere ka kamonyi ahazwi nka Bishenyi ho mu Murenge wa Runda, rugiye gutuma amasaka agarurwa ku butaka bwa Kamonyi nk’igihingwa cyatoranijwe. Kayitesi Alice, umuyobozi w’aka karere avuga ko uru ruganda rushobora gutuma basaba ko amasaka yongerwa ku rutonde rw’ibihingwa byatoranijwe mu karere. Amasaka, ni igihingwa kibarirwa mu bihingwa Ngandurarugo. Ni igihingwa kitaciwe ku butaka bw’akarere ka Kamonyi ariko kandi kitari ku rutonde rw’ibihingwa byatoranijwe kuhahingwa nk’uko haboneka; Soya, Ibigori, Urutoki, ibishyimbo, Imyumbati, Umuceri, imboga n’imbuto. Mu kiganiro n’itsinda rya bamwe mu banyamakuru bakorera mu Ntara y’amajyepfo ubwo bari mu rugendo ruzenguruka iyi Ntara muri gahunda yiswe “Menya Intara yawe”, yateguwe n’ubuyobozi bw’intara kuva kuwa 05-06 Werurwe 2020, Kayitesi yatangaje ko igihingwa cy’amasaka gishobora kuzongerwa mu byatoranijwe guhingwa ku butaka bw’Akarere bitewe n’uruganda rw’Ikigage. Ati“ Igihingwa cy’amasaka si uko kidahingwa mu karere kacu, ariko ntabwo cyari mu bihingwa byatoranijwe kuko kitagaragaraga cyane nk’igishobora kugirira akamaro abaturage, cyangwa se nk’aho bashobora kubona aho bayagurisha. Byari ukugira ngo gusa bayahinge, abashobora kwinika bakinika abandi bagasyamo igikoma”. Akomeza ati“ Kuba kitari mu bihingwa byatoranijwe, ubwo ubu twabonye uruganda kandi tukaba tunabizi ko ni igice cy’amayaga, amasaka arera n’ubu hari aho ugenda hirya no hino ukayabona, twizera ko ubwo bizaba bimaze kugaragara ko afite umurongo kandi n’uwayahinga yamugirira akamaro, hamwe n’inzego dufatanya MINAGRI, RAB, nacyo twabigaragaza kigahingwa kandi kikitabwaho”. Uruganda rugomba gutunganya Ikigage rwamaze kuzura ndetse n’ibikoresho birimo imashini byamaze kugezwamo. Biteganijwe ko ikigage cya mbere cy’igerageza (test) gishobora gusohoka mu ruganda mu ntangiriro z’ukwezi kwa Mata 2020. Ni uruganda ruhuriweho n’uturere tugize Intara y’Amajyepfo hamwe n’abashoramari. Akarere ka Kamonyi kashoyemo imigabane ingana na Miliyoni 125 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Munyaneza Theogene / intyoza.com

title: Nyaruguru: Dufite icyo nakwita “a very good Problem” mu buhinzi- Meya Habitegeko
content: Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Nyaruguru, Habitegeko Francois avuga ko abajyaga bavuga ngo aka karere ni ak’inzara n’ubukene bibeshyaga. Ahamya ko kaziraga imiyoborere mibi. Uyu munsi ngo nta nzara, nta n’ubukene bitewe n’imiyoborere myiza. Bafite ikibazo cyiza cyane mu buhinzi “a Very good Problem”, aho beza bakabura isoko. Ugenekereje mu kinyarwanda ” a very Good Problem”, ni nk’ikibazo gikomeye ariko cyiza”. Kuba abaturage b’Akarere ka Nyaruguru mu bihe byatambutse barafatwaga nk’abantu b’abakene, bo mu gace kazahajwe n’inzara ndetse bakagera aho basuhuka, ibi ngo bireberwa mu ndorerwamo y’imiyoborere mibi, kuko uyu munsi ngo gukemuka kw’ikibazo atari uko hari ubundi butaka bushya bahawe, ahubwo ni imiyoborere myiza. Meya Habitegeko ati” Ubu nta muturage ushobora guhunga ngo yishwe n’inzara, mu rugo hari ibyo kurya, ahubwo ubu ng’ubu ntabwo tukivuga ibyo kurya turavuga ku isoko. Amateka y’ubutebo, amateka y’inzara, amateka yo gusuhuka siyo tukirimo, turi mu mateka yo gukora nk’abandi tukihaza mubyo kurya tugasagurira amasoko. Aka ni akarere k’ubuhinzi, tudashyize imbaraga mu buhinzi ibindi byaba ari amagambo”. Agira kandi ati” Iyo tureba ubuhinzi ntabwo tuburebera mu muturage wasohotse mu rugo rwe n’isuka akagenda agakubita agataha. Tureba ubuhinzi mu buryo bwagutse, niba umuhinzi afite ubumenyi buhagije, uko ubutaka bw’aho ahinga butunganije, uko isoko rihagaze. Ubu dufite icyo nakwita “a very good Problem” mu buhinzi. Umuturage aho avuga ngo nk’ubu uyu musaruro ndawugira nte? Ni ikibazo cyiza, kuko ejo hashize yaribazaga ngo arararira iki, arabaho ate, ubu buyobozi bumumariye iki?, ariko uyu munsi sicyo kibazo. Ahubwo ikibazo noneho aribaza ngo ubu buyobozi bumaze iki kubona neza imyaka yanjye nkaba ntari kubona isoko”?. Meya Habitegeko, avuga ko iyo ugiye mu mateka y’Akarere ka Nyaruguru, unasanga hari amazina abaturage baho bari barahawe, “Abatebo”. Kuba barasuhukaga ndetse bakanicwa n’inzara, ibyo koko ngo byabayeho ariko iyo babireba uyu munsi babibonera mu kibazo cy’imiyoborere mibi yari mu Gihugu, aho kari akarere gasa n’akatereranwe. Ahamya ko abaturage b’aka Karere ari inyangamugayo kandi bakaba abakozi nk’abandi. Ngo hari na debate (ibiganiro) zajyaga zibaho zivuga ko abaturage bakomoka I Nyaruguru ari abanebwe, ngo niyo mpamvu bicwa n’inzara. Avuga ko ibi byari ikinyoma cyambaye ubusa, ko ahubwo iyo umuntu ashaka guharabika abantu no gutuma babaho nabi atabura ibintu abahimbira. Meya habitegeko, yemera ko abaturage b’I Nyaruguru koko bahingaga ntibasarure kubera guhinga mu bumenyi buke bwabo, aho batamenyaga ko ubutaka bwabo busharira bukwiye ishwagara Nyuma y’uko ngo abaturage basabye Perezida Kagame ishwagara akayibaha ndetse abahinzi bagahugurirwa gukora ubuhinzi bubateza imbere banasagurira amasoko, ibintu byahinduye isura, umusaruro mu buhinzi urazamuka mu buryo bugaragara, bahindura amateka basigara barwana no kubona amasoko bashoraho ibyo bejeje. Impuzandego y’umusaruru igaragaza ko kuva mu mwaka wa 2013 kuger 2020 umusaruro wagiye wiyongera bitewe n’imbaraga zashyizwe mu kubaka Politiki nziza y’ubuhinzi, hatangwa inyongeramusaruro n’amahugurwa mu bahinzi. Ibirayi byavuye kuri Toni 14 kuri Hegitali bigera kuri Toni 25 ndetse hakaba n’ahaboneka toni 29 kuri Hegiltali, Ibigori byavuye kuri toni 2 n’ibiro 820 kuri Hegitali bigera kuri Toni 3 n’ibiro 600 kuri Hegitali, ibishyimbo bishingirirwa bavuye kubiro 870 bagera kuri Toni 2 n’ibiro 100 kuri Hegitali naho Ingano bavuye kuri Toni 2 n’ibiro 640 bagera kuri Toni 3 n’ibiro 580 kuri Hegitali. Kwiyongera k’umusaruro ngo bigaragarira mu byo bahinga byose haba imusozi ndetse no mu bishanga. Habitegeko Francois, umuyobozi w’akarere ka Nyaruguru avuga ko ibi uwabyumva akagereranya n’ahandi ashobora kumva ko bakiri hasi. Avuga ko bari heza nubwo bifuza kugera kure heza hashoboka, ariko kandi ngo ntabwo mubyo bakora bigereranya n’ahandi, ahubwo bigereranya n’Ejo hashize h’akarere ka Nyaruguru, kandi ko inzira igana aheza bayikomeje. Munyaneza Theogene / intyoza.com

title: Kamonyi/Kayenzi: Bari ku rugamba rw’Umuhigo wo kutagira umugore n’umugabo babana badasezeranye
content: Imiryango 13 yabanaga itarasezeranye mu Mudugudu w’ikitegererezo wa Remera mu kagari ka Bugarama yasezeranye imbere y’amategeko kuri uyu wa 18 Nyakanga 2019. Uyu Mudugudu ufite imiryango yose hamwe 338 ariko ine niyo yitambitse mu kwesa uyu muhigo. Ubuyobozi bw’Umurenge buvuga ko kwesa uyu muhigo bizafasha mu miyoborere ndetse no mu ngo. Imiryango ine muri 17 yagombaga gusezerana mu Mudugudu w’icyitegererezo wa Remera utuwe n’imiryango 338 yatumye umuhigo w’Umudugudu utagerwaho. Bamwe mu bagize imiryango 13 yasezeranye mu buryo bwemewe n’amatageko babwiye intyoza.com ko gusezerana bibakuyeho igisuzuguriro, bibavanyeho guhora bakekana ariko kandi ngo bikaba bigiye no kubafasha gukorera hamwe birinda bimwe mu bibazo byaturukaga ku makimbirane ava mu kubana badasezeranye. Nyirangamije Marie Chantal, umwe mubasezeranye yabwiye intyoza.com ko yishimiye kuba agize agaciro. Ko mbere yiyumvaga nk’utagira umugabo. Ati“ Nari maranye imyaka itatu n’umugabo tubana ariko numva nta mahoro mfite kuko ntiyumvaga nk’umugore ufite umugabo. Ubu noneho ndatuje kandi kuba nsezeranye ndumva nta kumwishisha nibaza aho ndi ko atari uwanjye”.  Nyirangamije, avuga ko kubana n’umugabo we Mugesera basezeranye bimuremyemo icyizere no kurushaho gukora yumva ko aruhira urugo rwe, ko impamvu imutera gukora yunze ubumwe n’umugabo yabonetse. Avuga ko kandi ibibazo kenshi bituruka mu bashakanye bitewe no kutizerana kubwo kudasezerana nabyo birangiye agiye kunga ubumwe n’umugabo bagakora. Mugesera John, avuga ko mbere yo gusezerana yumvaga abayeho nk’indaya. Ati“ Njye n’umugore wanjye twari tumeze nk’indaya ariko uyu munsi turi Umugabo n’umugore. Ibi bituma nta kwishishanya hagati yacu, tugakorera hamwe twumva ko icyo duharanira ari ishema ryacu nk’umuryango”. Abasezeranye bahuza n’ubuyobozi kucyo isezerano rivuze n’ibibazo rikemura Mandera Innocent, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Kayenzi avuga ko igikorwa barimo kijyanye n’umuhigo bihaye wo kutagira imiryango ibana mu Murenge itarasezeranye, ariko kandi ngo biri no mu rwego rwo gutuma imiryango ibana mu mahoro itishishanya, yirinda ibibazo bituruka ku kubana nta sezerano.    Avuga ko iki gikorwa bagihereye mu Mudugudu w’Icyitegererezo wa Remera kikazakomeza mu tugari hose. Ahamya ko kugira imiryango ibana isezeranye bifasha mu miyoborere ariko kandi bikanazana icyizere mu bashakanye, bikarinda bimwe mu bibazo biterwa no kudasezerana. Ati“ Dusigaranye imiryango ine itabonetse kandi yari kuri gahuda muri uyu Mudugudu w’icyitegererezo. Kwesa uyu muhigo bizadufasha byinshi mu miyoborere kuko buriya amakimbirane kenshi avuka mu ngo akomoka ku kuba batarasezeranye, bafite ibyo bapfa kenshi bitewe no kutagirirana icyizere”. Akomeza ati” Ibibazo kenshi duhura nabyo usanga biba bishingiye ku kuba abantu badasezeranye, ugasanga gukemura ikibazo cyabo biratugora ariko iyo basezeranye urabizi ibyinshi ni ikoranabuhanga, kugirango ujye muri Mituweli, ibibazo by’ubutaka usanga biteza utubazo hirya no hino bishamikira ku kuba abantu badasezeranye. Mbese iyo basezeranye ibyo byose biroroha cyane”.  Gitifu Mandera Innocent, agira inama abantu bose ko kubana basezeranye ari ipfundo rikomeye ry’ubwizerane no guca ukubiri n’ibibazo bitandukanye bituruka ku kuba nta sezerano bafitanye. Avuga kandi ko muri gahunda z’ubuyobozi bw’Umurenge wa Kayenzi harimo kurangiza burundu ikibazo cy’imiryango ibana itarasezeranye bityo bakaba besheje umuhigo bavuga ko uzabafasha mu miyoborere ariko kandi n’imiryango ikabaho itekanye aho kumva ko hari uri kumwe n’uwo yita uwe atagira ikibyemeza. Umuntu umwe yaravuze ngo kubana n’Umugabo cyangwa Umugore utagira isezerano ni nko kugira ubutaka butakwanditseho. Icyemezo cy’uko ubutaka ari ubwawe ni icyangombwa kikwanditseho, icyemezo cy’uko umugore cyangwa Umugabo ari uwawe ni Isezerano mwagiranye imbere y’amategeko.  Munyaneza Theogene / intyoza.com
text:
Kamonyi/Kayenzi: Bari ku rugamba rw’Umuhigo wo kutagira umugore n’umugabo babana badasezeranye
Imiryango 13 yabanaga itarasezeranye mu Mudugudu w’ikitegererezo wa Remera mu kagari ka Bugarama yasezeranye imbere y’amategeko kuri uyu wa 18 Nyakanga 2019. Uyu Mudugudu ufite imiryango yose hamwe 338 ariko ine niyo yitambitse mu kwesa uyu muhigo. Ubuyobozi bw’Umurenge buvuga ko kwesa uyu muhigo bizafasha mu miyoborere ndetse no mu ngo. Imiryango ine muri 17 yagombaga gusezerana mu Mudugudu w’icyitegererezo wa Remera utuwe n’imiryango 338 yatumye umuhigo w’Umudugudu utagerwaho. Bamwe mu bagize imiryango 13 yasezeranye mu buryo bwemewe n’amatageko babwiye intyoza.com ko gusezerana bibakuyeho igisuzuguriro, bibavanyeho guhora bakekana ariko kandi ngo bikaba bigiye no kubafasha gukorera hamwe birinda bimwe mu bibazo byaturukaga ku makimbirane ava mu kubana badasezeranye. Nyirangamije Marie Chantal, umwe mubasezeranye yabwiye intyoza.com ko yishimiye kuba agize agaciro. Ko mbere yiyumvaga nk’utagira umugabo. Ati“ Nari maranye imyaka itatu n’umugabo tubana ariko numva nta mahoro mfite kuko ntiyumvaga nk’umugore ufite umugabo. Ubu noneho ndatuje kandi kuba nsezeranye ndumva nta kumwishisha nibaza aho ndi ko atari uwanjye”.  Nyirangamije, avuga ko kubana n’umugabo we Mugesera basezeranye bimuremyemo icyizere no kurushaho gukora yumva ko aruhira urugo rwe, ko impamvu imutera gukora yunze ubumwe n’umugabo yabonetse. Avuga ko kandi ibibazo kenshi bituruka mu bashakanye bitewe no kutizerana kubwo kudasezerana nabyo birangiye agiye kunga ubumwe n’umugabo bagakora. Mugesera John, avuga ko mbere yo gusezerana yumvaga abayeho nk’indaya. Ati“ Njye n’umugore wanjye twari tumeze nk’indaya ariko uyu munsi turi Umugabo n’umugore. Ibi bituma nta kwishishanya hagati yacu, tugakorera hamwe twumva ko icyo duharanira ari ishema ryacu nk’umuryango”. Abasezeranye bahuza n’ubuyobozi kucyo isezerano rivuze n’ibibazo rikemura Mandera Innocent, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Kayenzi avuga ko igikorwa barimo kijyanye n’umuhigo bihaye wo kutagira imiryango ibana mu Murenge itarasezeranye, ariko kandi ngo biri no mu rwego rwo gutuma imiryango ibana mu mahoro itishishanya, yirinda ibibazo bituruka ku kubana nta sezerano.    Avuga ko iki gikorwa bagihereye mu Mudugudu w’Icyitegererezo wa Remera kikazakomeza mu tugari hose. Ahamya ko kugira imiryango ibana isezeranye bifasha mu miyoborere ariko kandi bikanazana icyizere mu bashakanye, bikarinda bimwe mu bibazo biterwa no kudasezerana. Ati“ Dusigaranye imiryango ine itabonetse kandi yari kuri gahuda muri uyu Mudugudu w’icyitegererezo. Kwesa uyu muhigo bizadufasha byinshi mu miyoborere kuko buriya amakimbirane kenshi avuka mu ngo akomoka ku kuba batarasezeranye, bafite ibyo bapfa kenshi bitewe no kutagirirana icyizere”. Akomeza ati” Ibibazo kenshi duhura nabyo usanga biba bishingiye ku kuba abantu badasezeranye, ugasanga gukemura ikibazo cyabo biratugora ariko iyo basezeranye urabizi ibyinshi ni ikoranabuhanga, kugirango ujye muri Mituweli, ibibazo by’ubutaka usanga biteza utubazo hirya no hino bishamikira ku kuba abantu badasezeranye. Mbese iyo basezeranye ibyo byose biroroha cyane”.  Gitifu Mandera Innocent, agira inama abantu bose ko kubana basezeranye ari ipfundo rikomeye ry’ubwizerane no guca ukubiri n’ibibazo bitandukanye bituruka ku kuba nta sezerano bafitanye. label: economy
title: Perezida Kagame asanga ihindagurika ry’ikirere ryarabaye urwitwazo mu buhinzi bwa Afurika
content:
Perezida Paul Kagame avuga ko kuba ibisarurwa mu buhinzi bwa Afurika biri munsi y’ibyo ifitiye ubushobozi bidakwiye kwitirirwa ihindagurika ry’ikirere gusa kuko na mbere  abahinzi b’uyu mugabane bahoranye ubukene. 

Perezida Kagame ageza ijambo ku bitabiriye inama ku kwihaza mu biribwa Ubwo yakiraga abitabiriye ibiganiro ku kwihaza mu biribwa tariki 5 Kanama 2019, Perezida Kagame yavuze ko nta washidikanya ko imihindagurikire y’ikirere iri ku isonga ry’idindira mu kwihaza mu biribwa muri Afurika, avuga ko bizwi ariko hanazwi igishobora gukorwa. Perezida Kagame ariko agaragaza ko byose kubyitirira imihindagurikire y’ikirere ari urwitwazo, agira ati, "Turatanga umusaruro uri hasi y’uyo dufitiye ubushobozi, ntitwabyitirira ikirere gusa, abahinzi bo muri Afurika bari bakennye na mbere y’uko imihindagurikire y’ikirere iba ikibazo, ni ukuvuga ko hari ibindi bibazo dukwiye gushakira ibisubizo tutagize urwitwazo ibi cyangwa biriya, ntidukwiye gukomeza dutyo kuko nta kintu tutahindura". Avuga ko isoko rihuriweho rya Afurika (AfCFTA) rizagira uruhare mu gukemura byinshi mu bibazo kuko ubu ryamaze kwemezwa, ubucuruzi muri ryo bukazatangira muri Nyakanga 2020. Olusegun Obasanjo wahoze ari Perezida wa Nigeria wari i Kigali muri ibi biganiro, yavuze ko ubuhinzi butarimo ubumenyi ari nk’ikinyabiziga kitagira moteri, yongeraho ko Afurika ifite Politiki nziza nyinshi mu nyandiko, ahubwo ko ikibazo ari ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryazo, agira ati, "Kugira ubushake bwa politiki ni byiza, ariko igikenewe kurushaho ni ugushyira mu bikorwa". 

Olusegun Obasanjo wahoze ari Perezida wa Nigeria Gusa umuyobozi wungirije w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku biribwa n’ubuhinzi (FAO), Maria Helena Semedo, avuga ko abahinzi muri rusange ubumenyi babufite ikibura ari politiki zibafasha guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’igihe, kugira ikoranabuhanga rigezweho ndetse no koroherezwa mu ishoramari. Kugeza ubu nk’uko byanagarutsweho na Minisitiri w’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi Mukeshimana Gerardine, raporo y’Isi igaragaza imirire no kwihaza mu biribwa, ivuga ko abantu hafi miliyoni magana inani na makumyabiri n’imwe bashonje ku Isi, muri bo 31% bakaba muri Afurika, by’umwihariko iyo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara.

title: RSB yaburiye abakora ubucuruzi bw’amata batita ku buziranenge
content:
Abacuruzi bâamata bakura ku nganda ziyatunganya bamurikiwe igenzure ikigo gitsura ubuziranenge (RSB) cyabakoreye, bukaba bwagaragaje ko abenshi babikora mu buryo butanoze. RSB yavuze ko yakoreye ubu bugenzuzi mu makusanyirizo y’amata (milk zones) angana na 75% ariko abatagera kuri 30% bakaba ari bo bafite ubuziranenge mu mikorere yabo. Abenshi basanze bakoresha abakozi badafite ubumenyi  mu bijyanye nâamata ku buryo 85% byâabakozi bize amashuri abanza nâayisumbuye gusa. Ikindi beretswe kitagenda neza ni ukudasuzumisha indwara abakozi babo kandi bashobora kwanduza abakiriya babagana. Bongeye kwerekwa ko nta ngamba zihamye bafite zo kubungabunga ubuziranenge bwâamata bacuruza aho iri genzura ryasanze abangana na 90% batabwitaho. Murenzi Raymond uyobora RSB yavuze ko bagomba kubanza kubigisha, abatisubiyeho bakazahanwa, yagize ati âHari abo twasanze amata bayongeramo ifu, ifarini cyangwa se amazi yewe bamwe banayavanga nâamaze igiheâ. 

Murenzi Raymond, umuyobozi wa RSB Abafite aya magurishirizo bavuze ko ibyo basabwa ari byiza kandi bagiye gukora uko bashoboye bagatanga amata meza ndetse no mu buryo bwiza. Ariko banagarutse ku bibakoma mu nkokora bikababuza kuzuza ibisabwa. Bagarutse ku kuba bakirwanira isoko nâabandi bacuruza amata azanwa nâamagare, ndetse nâamazu ahenze kandi basabwa gukorera ahantu hanini kuko baba bafite ibyuma binini baterekamo amata. RSB yijeje aba bacuruzi ko igiye kuzabafasha ikabaha abakozi bo kuberekera uburyo bikorwa babyize ariko inabasaba kwigenzura mbere aho kurindira ibihano.

label: health
title: Huye: Bahangayikishijwe no kutabona udupfukamunwa duhagije
content: Bamwe mu baturage bâakarere ka Huye bavuga ko bifuza kugezwaho udupfukamunwa duhagije kugira ngo bahangane nâicyorezo cya COVID-19. Gusa bafite impungenge bifuza kumarwa nâinzego zibishinzwe. Amabwiriza mashya ya Minisiteri yâubuzima mu Rwanda asaba abanyarwanda bose kwambara udupfukamunwa, igihe bari mu ngo nâigihe basohotse, nkâimwe mu ngamba zikomeye zo kurwanya ikwirakwizwa ryâ icyorezo cya corona virusi. Abaturage bamwe bâI Huye bavuga ko batunguwe no kumva ko agapfukamunwa karinda corona virus ku buryo bushimishije mu gihe icyo cyorezo kikigera mu Rwanda katigeze gashyirwa mu ngamba zarinda abantu. Gusa ngo biteguye kukagura nikaba kajyanye nâamikoro yabo. Ngiruwonsanga Emmanuel, atuye I huye agira ati: ânituza nkabona tugura bijyanye nâubushobozi bwanjye nzatugura, nimba ntabishoboye nzatureka nâubundi ntaho njya, nirirwa mu rugo. Ubundi se tuzajya tudusanga mu mabutike?â Uwitwa Jonasi ati: âHari uvuga ati nkanjye sinjya nsohoka, ndajya kukagura hejuru yâiki? Ariko basobanukiwe ko ari ingamba nziza yo kugira ngo corona irangire basubire mu kazi ntakuntu batabikunda. Abantu biteguye kukambara kuko barambiwe kuguma mu rugoâ. Naho Uwamahoro Joselyne, nawe wo mu karere ka Huye avuga ko bumvise akamaro kâagapfukamunwa ariko ko bafite impungenge ko twaba duke. Ati: âimbogamizi ni uko wenda dushobora kuza duhenze abantu bakabura uburyo bwo kutugura cyangwa tukaba duke ku isoko. Hari abo twaganiriye bambwira ko bagiye kudushaka bakatubura, tugasaba leta ko yakora twinshi abantu bose bakabasha kutubona kuko ari uburyo bwiza bwo kwirinda, ukarinda umuryango wawe, abaturanyi ndetse nâigihuguâ. Undi muturage nawe wo muri Huye witwa Nyiraneza Melanie, avuga ko udupfukamunwa ajya abona abatwambaye ariko we atarakambara akaba yibaza niba abantu bagira umwuka muke nabo batwambara bigakunda kuko nawe afite icyo kibazo. Mu kiganiro yagiranye na RBA, umuyobozi wâikigo cyâigihugu cyâubuzima RBC Dr Sabin Nsanzimana Dr Sabin wa RBC yavuze ko  ingamba zo kurwanya COVID-19 zigenda zihinduka bitewe nâaho icyorezo kerekeza ari yo mpamvu nâagapfukamunwa basanze kakwambarwa na bose kugira ngo ubwirinzi bwizerwe. Dr Sabin kandi agaruka ku kijyanye no kwambara agapfukamunwa mu rugo, ati: âdutuye mu buryo butandukanye, umubyeyi nâabana niba bicaye mu nzu ntibivuze ngo batwambare, ariko hari ababa batuye mu gipangu kimwe ari imiryango irenze umwe, abo bakwiye kutwambara kugirango buri muryango urinde undi, kuko biba bisa nâaho bahurira hanzeâ. Ku kijyanye nâubushobozi bwo kugura udupfukamunwa, aha Dr Sabin yavuze ko hari abantu bafite ubushobozi bwo kuba bagura twinshi bagahaho nâabandi hakaba nâabandi uzasanga bakeneye ubufasha buruseho ku zindi nzego zibishinzwe.  Naho ku barwaye indwara zâubuhumekero Dr Sabin avuga ko bene uwo muntu akwiye gukurikiranwa na muganga atarinze kuguma mu  rugo ngo yambare agapfukamunwa kugirango katanamutera ibindi bibazo. Ku bijyanye nâaho udupfukamunwa tuzagurishirizwa, Dr Charles Karangwa uyobora ikigo cyâigihugu gishinzwe kugenzura ibiribwa nâimiti FDA  avuga ko abantu bazajya badusanga muri za farumasi, amaguriro ya kijyambere âsupermarketâ, nâibigo nderabuzima yemeza kandi ko hazakorwa uduhagije. Agapfukamunwa kagomba gukoreshwa abantu bita no ku yandi mabwiriza yo kwirinda nko gukaraba intoki kenshi gashoboka no kuguma mu rugo. Byaba ngombwa ko usohoka ugahana intera nâabo muhura byibura ya metero imwe.

Ku bijyanye nâaho udupfukamunwa tuzagurishirizwa, Dr Charles Karangwa uyobora ikigo cyâigihugu gishinzwe kugenzura ibiribwa nâimiti FDA  avuga ko abantu bazajya badusanga muri za farumasi, amaguriro ya kijyambere âsupermarketâ, nâibigo nderabuzima yemeza kandi ko hazakorwa uduhagije. Agapfukamunwa kagomba gukoreshwa abantu bita no ku yandi mabwiriza yo kwirinda nko gukaraba intoki kenshi gashoboka no kuguma mu rugo. Byaba ngombwa ko usohoka ugahana intera nâabo muhura byibura ya metero imwe.

title: Musanze: Ubwiyongere bw’abana b’inzererezi bwafatiwe ingamba nshya
content:
Ikibazo cy’abana b’inzererezi ni kimwe mu byagarutsweho mu kiganiro ubuyobozi bw’intara y’Amajyaruguru bwagiranye n’abanyamakuru tariki 31 Ukuboza 2019, bavuga ko muri aka karere ka Musanze abana b’inzererezi biyongera uko bwije n’uko bukeye, umuyobozi w’Intara asaba akarere kugira igikorwa kugirango bakurwe mu mihanda, umuyobozi w’Akarere akavuga ko hari ingamba nshya zafashwe. Umuyobozi w’intara y’amajyaruguru Gatabazi JMV yabwiye abayobozi b’aka karere ko nta kintu kindi bakwiriye gushyira imbere kiruta gukura bariya bana ku muhanda, kuko ari ikibazo gikabije cyane dore ko aka karere gakunda kugira ba mukerarugendo, iyo batambuka babona abana babirukaho babasaba ko nabyo ari igisebo. 

Guverineri Gatabazi JMV mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru Guverineri Gatabazi agira ati, âIkibazo cyâabana bâinzererezi birirwa basabiriza mu mujyi kimaze kurambirana, ndasaba abayobozi ko guhera uyu munsi tukivuga kirangire, hari nâaho usanga biruka inyuma ya ba mukerarugendo babaka amafaranga, abandi babaka amadenesi nyuma bakazabatesha umutwe baka inkunga, ba meya mubyumve mufatanye nâinzego dukorana iki kibazo kirangireâ. Umuyobozi w’akarere ka Musanze, Nuwumuremyi Jeannine nawe avuga ko iki kibazo bakizi kandi bagifatiye ingamba kuko bagiye kujya bafata abo bana bakabanza bagatumizaho ababyeyi babo bakagirana amasezerano. Agira ati âIki kibazo cyâabana birirwa basabiriza muri uyu mujyi kirahari, aho usanga aba bana ari bato cyane bari hagati yâimyaka umunani nâicumi, hari abo bajyana mu bigo ngororamuco ariko aba bo tugiye gufatanya nâinzego zâumutekano tubakusanyirize ku mirenge, dutumeho ababyeyi babo bandike impapuro zemeza ko bagiye kwita ku bana babo, ku buryo batazagaruka mu muhanda, kandi aho twabigerageje byatanze umusaruro, tugiye gukomeza kubishyiramo imbaragaâ. Iki kibazo cyâabana bato birirwa bazerera mu mujyi wa Musanze kimaze gufata indi ntera aho kuri ubu basigaye baryama ku mihanda, imbere yâamahoteri nâahandi hahurira abantu benshi, hagira ubabaza bakavuga ko bishwe nâinzara. Bimwe mu bibazo bagaragaza bituma bata iwabo bakaza kuzerera, birimo amakimbirane yo mu miryango, ubukene nâibindi.

label: politics
title: Uruhare rwâabaturage ni ingenzi mu igerwaho ryâintego zâibibakorerwa
content: Hari imishinga ishyirwa mu bikorwa ikagera ku ntego ariko hari nâindi icika intege yemwe ikazibagirana nyamara yaragenzeho ingengo yâimari nini. Akenshi ibi byaba binaterwa no kuba abaturage batarayiyumvisemo ngo bayigiremo uruhare hibandwa ku byo bakeneye kurusha ibindi. Umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa wâishami ryâu Rwanda ryâumuryango mpuzamahanga urwanya ruswa nâakarengane, Transparency International (TI Rwanda), Apollinaire Mupiganyi, avuga ko iyo imishinga itagizwemo uruhare nâabaturage ikunze kutagera ku ntego. Agira ati, âKudaha amakuru akwiye umugenerwabikorwa ariwe muturage, no kudaha amakuru akwiye abandi bafatanyabikorwa barimo abanyamakuru, imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta, ndetse yewe nâabakuru bâimidugudu, biri mu mpamvu zituma imwe mu mishinga itagera ku ntego.â Avuga ko hari aho hejuru ya 40% byâabakuru bâimidugudu bavuga ko imishinga igiye gukorerwa mu midugudu yabo baba batazi icyo igamije, kandi ko kugirango barengere ibyashyizwe mu bikorwa bisaba ko bo kimwe nâabandi baturage baba babigizemo uruhare. Ibi byagarutsweho ku wa Gatanu tariki ya mbere Ugushyingo ubwo hatangizwaga umushinga wo kurengera ibidukikije mu Karere ka Gicumbi, ni umushinga TI Rwanda izagiramo uruhare cyane cyane mu kongera uruhare rwâumuturage ndetse no gukorera mu mucyo. Gusa umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa wâakarere ka Gicumbi, Epimaque Habimana avuga ko nta buryo bwashyizweho bwo gukusanya ibitekerezo byâabaturage mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryâuyu mushinga wâamadolari yâAmerika 33 154 432, gusa akagaragaza ko ibizakorwa bizwi kuko bazibanda ku kurwanya isuri. Agira ati urebye imiterere yâakarere ka Gicumbi, ââNtabwo wakora ibikorwa byo kurwanya isuri ngo hagire ubyanga.â Hari imwe mu mishinga yagiye izana ingufu nyuma igacika intege, aha twavuga nkâumushinga wa Biogas yagabanyije umurego watangiranye.

label: politics
title: Kisaro: Bifuza ko abatarashaka bakoroherezwa kubona ibyiciro byâubudehe byabo
content:
Abaturage bo mu murenge wa Kisaro mu karere ka Rulindo, bavuga ko hari abasore nâinkumi bava mu ngo bakajya kwishakira indi mibereho bagatererana ababyeyi mu gutanga ubwisungane mu kwivuza. Mu bushobozi buke bwâababyeyi babona yabo nâabo basigaranye mu rugo, udahari wakabaye anabunganira akababera imbogamizi mu kwishyurira umuryango. Bakifuza ko mu byiciro bivuguruye urubyiruko rwakoroherezwa kubona ibyiciro byabo. Ndimube Jean de Dieu ni umwe mu batuye muri aka gace, avuga ko abana batarubaka ingo bakwiye gukomeza kubarwa ku byiciro byâababyeyi, ariko hagashyirwaho uburyo boroherezwa kubona ibyiciro byabo ku bwumvikane bwâumuryango, agira ati, âMbona byaterwa nâubwumvikane bwâabana nâababyeyi, hari ukuntu umuntu aba yagiye gupagasa nkâi Kigali wenda mu rugo nta bushobozi buhagije buhari ku buryo bagutangira mituweri. Habayeho uburyo bwo kumvikana mu muryango uwo mwana akitangira ariko yabiherewe uburenganzira nâabagize umuryango, numva ari bwo byaba byizaâ. Nkunzuwera Onesphore we asanga hakwiye gushyirwaho imyaka fatizo umwana avanwa ku cyiciro cyâababyeyi be, agira ati, âNi ngombwa ko urubyiruko rukurwa ku babyeyi, hari ubwo ababyeyi baba bageze mu za bukuru bafite nkâabana batanu, nka babiri bakuru iyo bagiye gushakisha ubuzima, baba imbogamizi ku babyeyi, batanga Mituweri ntiyakirwe ngo babanze batangire na babandi badahariâ. Uwitwa Gacinya Stanislas avuga ko akenshi hari nâabana baba bafite ubushobozi bwo kwitangirira mituweri ariko ababyeyi baba babasaba ayabo ngo bongere bishyurire umuryango bakabyanga kuko baziko bari ku byiciro byâababyeyi, bityo nta yandi mahitamo batabatangiye. Agasaba ko umwana wujuje nibura imyaka 21 yakabaye yitangira Mituweri. Umwe mu rubyiruko witwa Rwajekare Pascal, we agira ati, âNiba nkâumubyeyi wanjye bamushyize mu cyiciro cya mbere, sinshobora kuguza amafaranga ngo nikorere, icyo kiba kibaye imbogamizi ariko baramutse baduhaye icyiziro cyacu natwe byadufashaâ.
Nyirabarigira Philomene we agaruka ku kibazo cyâabakobwa babyarira iwabo, agira ati, âNkâubu iyo twabyariye iwacu ababyeyi banga gutangira Mituweri abana bacu, birakwiye ko twajya duhabwa icyiciro cyacu tukabona uko tuyitangira ndetse nâabana bacuâ. Gusa ibi ntibabyumva kimwe nâumubyeyi witwa Twagirayesu, avuga ko abagize umuryango baramutse batandukanyijwe bitaba bikitwa ubwisungane, agira ati, âUbwo mituweri yazaga, badusobanuriye ko ari ubwisungane, kuko uza nanjye nkaza, hari umuturage wivuza kuko hari mugenzi we watanze, jye numva twakumva kimwe ko ari ubwisungane ahubwo tugashishikariza abantu gukorera hamweâ. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wâumurenge wa Kisaro, Kabayiza Arcade, avuga ko ahubwo igikwiye ari ukunga imiryango aho kuyitatanya, agira ati, âAho ibyo bibazo biri ni mu miryango ifite amakimbirane, gufata icyemezo cyo gutatanya imiryango ntabwo byaba ari byo. Turabizi ko ibyo bibazo byose biriho, nkâumuyobozi unyegereye cyangwa ukegera umuyobozi wâAkagali cyangwa uwâumudugudu, ukavuga uti ayange ndayafite ariko runaka yanze kuyatanga, nkananirwa kuyamwaka kandi nkunga umuryango wanyu, ntabwo naba ndi mu nshingano zangeâ. Uyu muyobozi yasabye abaturage be kuzavugisha ukuri ubwo hazaba hakusanywa amakuru azifashishwa abaturage bashyirwa mu byiciro bivuguruye, abibutsa ko kutishimira ibyiciro kwagiye kugaragara byanaturutse ku bantu babeshye kubera kutamenya uburemere bwâamakuru batanze, gusa avuga ko ibigenderwaho ngo umuntu ashyirwe mu cyiciro runaka bikwiye kongerwa, kandi nâumubare wâibyiciro ukongerwa kugirango abari mu cyiciro cyimwe bajye baba bafite ubushobozi bujya kungana.

label: politics
title: Kenya: Perezida Kenyatta yiyemeje guhagarika imigenzo yo gusiramura abakobwa
content: Kenya ni igihugu kuri ubu cyari kikirangwa n’umuco gakondo wo gukeba bimwe mu bice byâimyanya ndangagitsina yâabagore izwi nkâisiramurwa ryâigitsina gore (Female genital mutilation, FGM), n’ubwo hashyizweho itegeko riwurwanya ntibyahagaze, kuri ubu perezida wa Kenya akaba yiyemeje guhagarika uyu mugenzo. Mu gihe manda ya  Uhuru Kenyatta yo kuyobora Kenya izarangira mu mwaka wa 2022, Kenyatta avuga ko yifuza guhagarika umugenzo wo gusiramura abakobwa mbere y’uko manda ye igera ku iherezo. Ibi yabitangaje abinyujije ku rubuga  rwa Twitter rw’ibiro by’umukuru w’igihugu, aho bashimangiye ijambo yavugiye muri Canada mu yitiriwe ’’Women Deliverâ, ku wa kabiri tariki 4 Kamena 2019, aho yavuze ko yizeye "guhagarika" umugenzo wo gukeba ibice bimwe by’imyanya myibarukiro y’abakobwa ikorwa muri Kenya. Kuva mu mwaka wa 2011 amategeko yo muri Kenya ntiyemera uwo mugenzo, ariko biracyakorwa. Perezida Uhuru ntiyasobanuye uburyo azahanganamo n’abagikora iyi migenzo kugira ngo icike burundu. Yiyemeje kandi gufasha kugira ngo ubusumbane hagati y’abagabo n’abagore bucike cyane cyane mu bijyanye n’ubutabera aho abagore basaga nk’abadahabwa agaciro kamwe n’abagabo. Kuri konti ye ya twita, naho yagize ati, "Twifuza ko igihugu kimenya ko abagore bashoboye nk’abagabo. Turashaka  kuborohereza tukabaha uburyo bwo gukora". Ayo magambo agaragara kuri Twitter, hari benshi bahise bagira icyo bayavugaho,  Jeremiah Kipainoi, asubiza Perezida Kenyata, yanditse ati, "Urugamba rwo kurwanya ikebwa ntirworoshye nk’uko ubivuga. label: politics
title: Amnesty International irashinja igisirikare cya Amerika kwica Abasiviri muri Somaliya
content: Amnesty International, ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga riharanira kurengera uburenganzira bwa muntu ryavuze ko hari ibimenyetso ko indege za gisirikare za Leta Zunze ubumwe za Amerika zishe zikanakomeretsa abantu batandukanye muri Somalia. Iri shyirahamwe rirashinja abategetsi ba minisiteri y’ingabo ya Leta Zunze  ubumwe za Amerika kudakora iperereza rihagije ku baturage ba Somaliya bahitanywe n’ibitero by’indege z’iki gihugu muri Somaliya. Nk’uko tubikesha Radiyo ijwi rya Amerika, ngo abayobozi bakuru b’ibiro bya’ gisirikare bya Leta Zunze ubumwe za Amerika muri Afurika bizwi nka AFRICOM, bamaze gutera utwatsi ibirego bikubiye muri raporo ya Amnesty International bemeza ko igisirikare cya Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bakoze iperereza. Batanga urugero ko igisirikare cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe Za Amerika zakoze iperereza ku madosiye 18 zâabaturage b’abasivire bishwe kuva mu mwaka wa 2017. Iyi raporo ishinja igisirikare cya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika kwica, yagiye ku mugaragaro ubwo  umuyobozi mu bashinzwe iperereza wa Somaliya, atashatse ko izina rye ritangazwa, atangarije ko igitero cy’indege yitwara izwi nka drone, ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yahitanye umuturage w’umusivire kuri uyu wa mbere. Ibi kandi byashimangiwe n’abantu bari muri aka gace igitero cyabereyemo, bemeza ko ibivugwa ari byo.

label: politics
title: FPR yijeje abatuye Musha gukataza mu iterambere
content:
Ubwo abakandida ba FPR Inkotanyi bakomerezaga ibikorwa byo kwiyamamaa mu murenge wa Musha akarere ka Rwamagana, bijeje abahatuye  kuzashyira imbaraga kuri gahunda y’imyaka 7 ya Guverinoma zigamije iterambere. Uwamariya Odette umwe mu bakandida ba FPR Inkotanyi yagize ati "Murabizi ko Perezida wa Repeburika yashyizeho gahunda y’imyaka irindwi ya Guverinoma yo guteza imbere abanyarwanda, kudutora rero nukugira ngo dufatanye twese mugushyira mu bikorwa iyo gahunda kandi murabizi ko Umuryango wa FPR Inkotanyi ari mudatenguha". Kayiranga Jerome umuturage utuye mu murenge wa Musha agira ati "Umuryango wa FPR Inkotanyi ntacyo utangejejeho, wamfashije kwiga ndangiza kaminuza mba umworozi worora inkoko, mva mu bukene ubu ndasobanutse ndumva rero kongera kubagirira icyizere bizampesha amahirwe yo kuva ku nkoko 1000 nkagera ku nkoko 3000 mu mwaka utaha kuko tuzaba tuyobowe neza".

 Biteganyijwe ko ku munsi wejo tariki ya 19 Kanama 2018 abakandida ba FPR Inkotanyi bazakomereza iyi gahunda yo kwiyamamaza mu murenge wa Rubona.

label: culture
title: Gicumbi: Hagiye kubakwa ingoro ndangamurage ya mbere mu Rwanda
content:
Kuva mu kwezi kwa Kanama uyu mwaka, biteganyijwe ko ku Mulindi mu karere ka Gicumbi hazatangira kubakwa ingoro ndangamurage yâurugamba rwo kubohora igihugu ya mbere mu Rwanda haba mu bunini, mu bwiza ndetse no kwinjiza amafaranga menshi. Amb. Masozera Robert uyobora ikigo cyâingoro zâumurage wâu Rwanda, avuga ko ku Mulindi wâIntwari hatangiye gutunganywa mu byiciro bitatu, icya mbere cyo kuvugurura amazu yari ahasanzwe kikaba cyararangiye. Icyiciro cya kabiri avuga ko ari ukubaka indi ngoro itari ihasanzwe ari yo izahurizwamo amateka yose, ikazaba ifite ibyumba bigaragaza amateka yaranze urugamba rwo kwibohora. Avuga ko abantu bazajya bayigeramo bakabona FPR na APR uko byavutse, uko urugamba rwatangiye, uko rwabaye amahina, uko rwagoranye, kugenda kugera rurangiye. Bikazaba bigaragara mu mafoto no mu buhamya. Avuga ko iyi ngoro izagaragaramo nâibikoresho byakoreshwaga icyo gihe, uko intwaro Inkotanyi zarwanishaga zari zimeze, aho baryamaga, itumanaho bakoreshaga, ingorane bahuye na zo nâibindi. Icyiciro cya Gatatu harimo gutunganya ibikorwaremezo birimo imihanda, Parking ndetse nâikibuga cyâumupira cya Mulindi. 

Umuhanda uva Maya ugera ku Mulindi wâintwari nawo uzakorwa Yemeza ko izaba ari iya mbere mu gihugu agatanga nâimpamvu Amb. Masozera agira ati âTwebwe mu kigo cyâingoro zâumurage wâIgihugu, turahamya ko iyi ngoro nirangira, ari yo igiye kuba ingoro ya mbere mu Rwanda nini kandi nziza kurusha izindi zose. Niyo ngoro izaba ihiga izindi mu bunini, mu bwiza, mu gusurwa nâabantu benshi no kwinjiza amafaranga menshi mu ngoro zindi zose dufite uko ari umunani, nta ngoro izaba imeze nkâiyingiyiâ. Impamvu ya mbere muri eshatu atanga zizeza ko iyi ngoro izaba ari iya mbere, ahera ku kuba ingoro yâurugamba rwo kubohora igihugu iri i Kigali mu Nteko Ishingamategeko, ariyo ikunzwe kugeza ubu, ikaba isurwa nâabagera ku bihumbi ijana na makumyabiri ku mwaka kandi imaze imaze umwaka umwe gusa. Impamvu ya kabiri avuga ko ariyo ngoro ya mbere igiye kuba muri Afurika ivuga amateka ya vuba nâabantu bayabayemo bakiriho, avuga ko izindi ziba zivuga ibintu bya kera abantu baterateranyije bakabihuriza hamwe. Agira ati âNkâiriya yâi Huye ivuga imibereho yâabanyarwanda mbere, tujya kuyikora ni ababirigi baje barayiduha, iriya ni impano yâababirigi. Ingoro yâabami tuvuga nayo ni nziza ariko twarateranyije turibaza tuti ariko abami babagaho bate! Abantu bagasoma, nta mwami twabajije, nta mutware wâingabo twabajije, nta buhamya burimo, ariko iyi dufite ubuhamya bwâabayoboye urugamba, bwâabarwanye, nâababibayemo bose. Iyi niyo izaba ibaye iya mbere muri Afurika  ifite umwimerere kurusha izindi zivuga amateka yâintambara.â 

Amb. Masozera, umuyobozi wâIkigo kâingoro zâumurage wâu Rwanda Impamvu ya gatatu atanga ni uko iyi ngoro ikomatanyije nâundi mushinga uhari wâubukerarugendo bushingiye ku mateka yâurugamba rwo kwibohora, ahantu hose habereye amateka akomeye, hakaba hari inyigo yo kugenda bahegeranya ku buryo hazakorerwa ubukerarugendo. Agira ati, âUriya muhora wose wo kuva Kagitumba ukagera ku Mulindi uciye za Nyagatare abantu bazajya bawusura mu munsi umwe, ku munsi wa kabiri habeho gusura undi muhora uva ku Mulindi ukagera Musanze ahahoze ari mu Ruhengeri. Hakaba nâundi uturuka ku Mulindi ukagera i Kigali mu nteko Nshingamategeko ahahoze hitwa CND.â Avuga ko mu nyigo biteganyijwe ko iyi ngoro igomba kurangira kubakwa muri Kamena 2020, ku buryo muri 2021 ishobora gutangira gusurwa. Abashoramari baratungirwa agatoki Guverineri wâIntara yâAmajyaruguru, Gatabazi Jean Marie Vianney, avuga ko ari amahirwe ku ishoramari ndetse akanakangurira abacuruzi kuhubaka amahoteri, amaresitora, amacumbi nâibindi. 

Guverineri Gatabazi JMV Agira ati, âBirakwiye ko hatangira kubakwa amahoteli, resitora, Bar nziza nâibindi bizafasha abazajya bahasura kubona serivisi bakeneye, abantu nibaza bavuye mu mahanga, cyangwa mu tundi turere twâu Rwanda, bazakenera kurya, kunywa ndetse nâaho barara. Abantu bakwiye kwitegura ku buryo ingoro izatangira kubakwa nabo batangira kubaka.â Avuga ko nâubu iyo ngoro itarubakwa, hari ubwo hasurwa nâabantu benshi, ariko bakaba batabona serivisi zâubucuruzi, akizeza ko uzahashora imari amafaranga azayabona.

label: culture
title: FESPAD yaba imwe mu nzira nziza zo guhuza abanyafurika
content:
Ibi byagarutsweho kuri uyu wa 29 Nyakanga 2018 ubwo hatangizwaga icyumweru cy’iserukiramuco ry’imbyino, FESPAD (Festival Pan-Africain de la Dance) nka kimwe mu bikorwa byo kwizihiza umuganura w’uyu mwaka. Iki gitaramo cy’imbyino zerekana umuco ny’Afurika cyabereye i Kigali kuri Stade Amahoro, kitabiriwe n’ibihugu bitanu aribyo Senegal, Burkina Faso, Congo Brazaville, DR Congo ndetse n’u Rwanda.


Hamuritse imico itandukanye Abaminisitiri b’umuco muri ibyo bihugu ndetse n’uwari uhagarariye Umuryango w’Afurika yunze ubumwe (AU) bafashe ijambo bagarutse ku mbaraga babona FESPAD ifite. Angela Martinez wari uhagarariye Umuryango w’Afurika yunze ubumwe muri iki gitaramo yavuze ko FESPAD ifite uruhare mu kunga Afurika ndetse anasaba Abamisitiri b’umuco gukomeza kuyishyigikira no kurushaho kuyimenyekanisha.


Angela Martinez wari uhagarariye AU muri iki gitaramo Yagize ati "FESPAD yadufasha kugera kuri Afurika twifuza muri 2063 kuko ikungahaye ku muco kandi niwo twahuza tukabona ubumwe bw’afurika." Yakomeje asaba Minisitiri w’umuco na siporo mu Rwanda, Uwacu Julienne kwamamaza iyi FESPAD ku buryo yajya yitabirwa n’ibihugu byinshi. 


Abitabiriye iki gitaramo bashimishijwe n’imico itandukanye yamuritswe mu mbyino Uyu mwaka FESPAD iri kwizihizwa ku nshuro ya 10, iba rimwe mu myaka ibiri ariko umuganura wo wizihizwa buri mwaka kuwa gatanu wa mbere w’ukwezi kwa munani kuva muri 2015. Minisitiri uwacu Julienne yashimiye ibihugu bitandukanye byitabiriye iyi FESPAD.

label: culture
title: Bwa mbere mu Rwanda hizihijwe umunsi w’ibikorwa byiza
content:
Umunsi w’ibikorwa byiza (Good Deeds Day) ni umunsi ngarukamwaka wizihizwa nâimiryango myinshi ku isi hose ndetse nâibigo byâubucuruzi. Ni umunsi ahanini uba ugizwe nâibikorwa ndetse nâinyigisho zishimangira ko buri wese ashobora gukora igikorwa cyiza, cyaba gito cyangwa kinini ariko kigamije guteza imbere imibereho yâabandi. Mu Rwanda, uyu munsi wizihijwe kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 11 Gicurasi 2018 mu kigo cyâUmuco nâImyidagaduro cya Musanze. Uyu munsi watangiye kwizihizwa muri 2007 utangijwe na Shari Arison abinyujije mu muryango witwa Ruach Tova muri Isirayeli (Israel), uza guhinduka Umunsi Mpuzamahanga guhera mu wa 2012. Mu Rwanda wizihijwe bwa mbere muri uyu mwaka wa 2018 nâIngeri Arts. Nkâuko Umuyobozi wa Gahunda wâIngeri Arts Muhire Emmanuel yabisobanuye, Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wâIbikorwa Byiza ni umunsi uha urubyiruko urubuga rwo kuganira no guhura bakungurana ibitekerezo ku mbaraga zo gushyira hamwe ari zo murunga wâiterambere ndetse rukanafata ingamba zo kurwanya inabi, ubwigunge, ubufura ndetse no guharanira umuco wo gukora neza. Ni urubuga urubyiruko rusangiriramo imbone, ubunararibonye nâibyifuzo rugamije gukangura imyumvire yagutse kandi iboneye binyuze mu biganiro (mpaka), ibikino, ibikorwa byâubwitange ndetse nâimyidagaduro. 

 Si urubyiruko gusa kandi nâabakuze bahabwa umwanya wo gutanga ibitekerezo no gufata ingamba zâibyakorwa ngo umuryango mugari wâabantu ugire ishinjo. Ikindi ni uko ari nâumunsi wo gukorera abandi ibyiza bitarangirira kâuwo munsi ahubwo bihabwa imbaraga hagashimangirwa ubutangamuganzanyo bwabyo. Igikorwa kiza ni iki? Ni ikintu gito cyangwa kinini muntu akora biturutse ku mutimanama we agamije gukemura ikibazo cyâundi cyangwa abandi mu buryo bufatika (matÃ©rielle) cyangwa budafatika (morale) kikaba cyatsura imibereho myiza yâumuryango mugari wose cyangwa umuntu umwe ku giti ke, cyangwa se kikaba gihimbaza imibanire myiza muri ibyo byiciro byâabantu. Kuki Ingeri Arts yizihiza uyu munsi? Ingeri Arts ni umuryango nyarwanda uharanira guteza imbere ubugeni nâubuhanzi, uburezi, umuco nâimibereho myiza yâabana nâurubyiruko bigamije iterambere rirambye ryâimibanire nâubukungu mu Rwanda. Ni umuryango ugizwe nâinzego zâibanze ari zo: Galaxy Theatre Troupe rushinzwe kubungabunga no guteza imbere Ubugeni bwâikinamico nâubundi buhanzi bukozwe mu zindi ndimi zitari Ikinyarwanda cyangwa umwimerere wâumuco nyarwanda. Amasaro yaka rushinzwe kubungabunga no guteza imbere Ururimi nâUmuco nyarwanda. Creative Arts Division rushinzwe kubungabunga no guteza imbere Ubugeni nâUbukorikori,âŠ Ibi rero bigenda byerekana impamvu yo kwizihiza umunsi nkâuyu nkâuko byagiye bigarukwaho mu biganiro.

 Ingeri Arts ikaba yarizihije  uyu munsi kubera impamvu nyinshi zirimo no mu kwiyibutsa indangagaciro yo kubana neza no kugirirana ineza himakazwa umuco wo gukora ibikorwa byiza aho abantu batuye kandi baniga kureba kure hashoboka. Uyu mwaka, Ingeri Arts yawizihirije ku nsanganyamatsiko igira iti: âUruhare rwâurubyiruko mu kwimakaza umuco wo gukora neza bizamura imibereho myiza yâaho batuyeâ. Ni ibiganiro byitabiriwe nâurubyiruko rusaga 40 ruturutse ahantu hatandukanye nko mu bigo byâamashuri, amatsinda yâurubyiruko nâabikorera. Ibibazo byigagwaho mu matsinda byose byahurizaga ku ntego yâuyu mwaka kandi bigamije kurebera hamwe uruhare urubyiruko rwagira mu guteza imbere umuco wo gukora ibyiza. Urubyiruko rwari rwitabiriye rumaze kwerekana ibyo rwagezeho mu matsinda, Umuyobozi Mukuru wâIngeri Arts Jean-Paul INGABIRE yaboneyeho gutanga impuguro, agaragaza ko gukora neza bitagombera ubushobozi buhanitse kandi ko buri wese uko ameze kose ashobora gukora igikorwa kiza. Yasobanuye ko burya ibikorwa binakomeye muntu aba akeneye ari byo abantu badakunze no guha agaciro. Aha yatanze urugero ruboneka mu ndangagaciro zâAbanyarwanda yo gusuhuzanya no kubwirana neza. Yavuze ko hari abantu benshi baba bakeneye byibura uwabasuhuza, akabavugisha bakumva ko hari ubitayeho; icyo iyo ugikoze uba ukoze igikorwa kiza. 

 Jean-Paul kandi yasobanuye ko umuco wo gukora neza wakwizera ko ushinze imizi ari uko urubyiruko nâabana babirerewemo bakabikurana. Ibyo byongera guha ababyeyi inshingano ikomeye yo kuba intangarugero ku bana babo no kubatoza ibikorwa byiza. Gukora neza kandi yavuze ko atari impuhwe umuntu aba agize, ahubwo ko muntu yaremewe gukora neza kandi ikaba nâinshingano ye mbatanwa. Habayeho umwanya wo kubaza ibibazo bijyanye nâumunsi ari na ko intego yâumunsi ihuzwa nâintego zihariye zâIngeri Arts. Mu gusoza ibiganiro, abitabiriye bahawe umwanya wo gutanga ibitekerezo byâicyajya gikorwa mu gihe hizihizwa Umunsi Mpuzamahanga wâIbikorwa Byiza.

label: politics
title: Gitifu wakubise umukecuru w’imyaka 95 amushinja amarozi yagawe na Minisitiri ahita afungwa
content:
Polisi y’u Rwanda ikorera mu karere ka Nyaruguru mu murenge wa Ngoma mu kagari ka Nyamirama yafashe uwitwa Kayigamba Valens w’ imyaka 35 akaba yari umuyobozi w’akagari ka Nyamirama mu murenge wa Ngoma mu karere ka Nyaruguru. Uyu yafatanyije na bagenzi be babiri n’abaturage bakirimo gushakishwa n’inzego z’umutekano, bakurikiranweho gukubita Nyirabititaweho Anastasie w’imyaka 95 n’abakobwa be aribo Ndaruzaniye Josephine w’imyaka 54 na Nyiraminani Triphine w’imyaka 38.
 Polisi y’u Rwanda ikorera mu karere ka Nyaruguru mu murenge wa Ngoma mu kagari ka Nyamirama yafashe uwitwa Kayigamba Valens w’ imyaka 35 akaba yari umuyobozi w’akagari ka Nyamirama mu murenge wa Ngoma mu karere ka Nyaruguru. Uyu yafatanyije na bagenzi be babiri n’abaturage bakirimo gushakishwa n’inzego z’umutekano, bakurikiranweho gukubita Nyirabititaweho Anastasie w’imyaka 95 n’abakobwa be aribo Ndaruzaniye Josephine w’imyaka 54 na Nyiraminani Triphine w’imyaka 38. Ibi bibaye nyuma gato y’uko umuyobozi w’akarere ka Nyaruguru, Habitegeko Francois, atangaje kuri Twitter ko uyu muyobozi ahagaritswe ku kazi by’agateganyo mu gihe ikibazo cye kikigwaho nk’uko amategeko abiteganya, kubera guhohotera abaturage kandi imiyoborere myiza ari umusingi ubuyobozi bukomeyeho. Meya Habitegeko yahise yunganirwa na Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’igihugu, Anastase Shyaka wagize ati "Nibyo. Umuturage ku isonga! Imiyoborere myiza ni umusingi dukomeyeho. Kirazira guhohotera Umuturage, cyane ku muyobozi umushinzwe! Ni igihango twese Minisiteri y’Ubutegetsi bw’igihugu dufitanye n’Igihugu. Utatiye igihango wese, agomba kubibazwa". Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu ntara y’Amajyepfo,Chief Inspector of Police (CIP) Sylvestre Twajamahoro avuga ko uriya mukecuru n’abakobwa be bakubiswe bashinjwa amarozi no kujya mu bapfumu nyamara nta bimenyetso bifatika mu byo babashinja. CIP Twajamahoro yagize ati "Uriya mukecuru n’abakobwa be  ngo babakekaho kuroga abantu, tariki ya 23 Mata mu gitondo bafatiwe  mu karere ka Gisagara mu murenge wa Nyanza mu kagari ka Nyaruteja abaturage bo muri uyu murenge bafatanyije na Sibomana ushinzwe umutekano mu mudugudu w’Urugomero muri aka kagari ka Nyaruteja. Babafashe bavuga ko baje kubaroga no kuraguza ku mupfumu uhaba." Gitifu witwa Kayigamba Valens ushinjwa gufatanya n’abandi baturage bagahohotera umukecuru n’abakobwa be CIP Twajamahoro akomeza avuga ko aba baturage ba Gisagara bamaze gufata uriya mukecuru n’abakobwa be barabakubise bahamagara umuyobozi w’akagari baturutsemo ka Nyamirama muri Nyaruguru ariwe Kayigamba Valens nawe abajyana abakubita abashinja amarozi. Ati "Uriya muyobozi Kayigamba amaze guhabwa bariya baturage nawe yarabakubise afatanyije n’abandi baturage ari nabwo amakuru yaje kugera kuri Polisi Kayigamba ahita afatwa. Ubu haracyashakishwa Sibomana wo  mu karere ka Gisagara ndetse n’undi muturage witwa Minani Evariste w’imyaka 41 nawe ukurikiranweho gukubita abo baturage." Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu ntara y’amajyepfo yakanguriye abaturage kwirinda kwihanira ndetse nibagira uwo bafatira mu makosa bakajya bahamagara inzego z’umutekano zikaba arizo zifata ukekwaho icyaha. Yagize ati  "Bariya bantu bakoze icyaha cyo guhohotera abaturage babakubita babashinja amarozi kandi nta bimenyetso bafite niyo babigira nta muntu wemerewe kwihanira." Kayigamba yashyikirijwe urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe ubugenzacyaha rukorera muri sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Kibeho. Umukecuru n’abakobwa be baragaragaza imibyimba y’inkoni ku mubiri wabo, ubu bakaba barimo gukurikiranirwa hafi n’abaganga.

Gitifu witwa Kayigamba Valens ushinjwa gufatanya n’abandi baturage bagahohotera umukecuru n’abakobwa be CIP Twajamahoro akomeza avuga ko aba baturage ba Gisagara bamaze gufata uriya mukecuru n’abakobwa be barabakubise bahamagara umuyobozi w’akagari baturutsemo ka Nyamirama muri Nyaruguru ariwe Kayigamba Valens nawe abajyana abakubita abashinja amarozi. Ati "Uriya muyobozi Kayigamba amaze guhabwa bariya baturage nawe yarabakubise afatanyije n’abandi baturage ari nabwo amakuru yaje kugera kuri Polisi Kayigamba ahita afatwa. Ubu haracyashakishwa Sibomana wo  mu karere ka Gisagara ndetse n’undi muturage witwa Minani Evariste w’imyaka 41 nawe ukurikiranweho gukubita abo baturage." Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu ntara y’amajyepfo yakanguriye abaturage kwirinda kwihanira ndetse nibagira uwo bafatira mu makosa bakajya bahamagara inzego z’umutekano zikaba arizo zifata ukekwaho icyaha. Yagize ati  "Bariya bantu bakoze icyaha cyo guhohotera abaturage babakubita babashinja amarozi kandi nta bimenyetso bafite niyo babigira nta muntu wemerewe kwihanira." Kayigamba yashyikirijwe urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe ubugenzacyaha rukorera muri sitasiyo ya Polisi ya Kibeho. Umukecuru n’abakobwa be baragaragaza imibyimba y’inkoni ku mubiri wabo, ubu bakaba barimo gukurikiranirwa hafi n’abaganga.

title: Menya ingano y’imishahara Abayobozi bakuru bigomwe ngo bafashe abazahajwe na Coronavirus
content:
Kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 5 Mata 2020 nibwo Ibiro bya Minisitiri w’Intebe byatangaje ko mu rwego rwo gukomeza kurwanya Koronavirusi, Leta y’u Rwanda yemeje ko abagize Guverinoma bose, abanyamabanga bahoraho, abayobozi b’ibigo bya Leta, ndetse n’abandi bayobozi mu nzego nkuru z’igihugu bazigomwa umushahara w’ukwezi kwa Mata 2020.
 Kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 5 Mata 2020 nibwo Ibiro bya Minisitiri w’Intebe byatangaje ko mu rwego rwo gukomeza kurwanya Koronavirusi, Leta y’u Rwanda yemeje ko abagize Guverinoma bose, abanyamabanga bahoraho, abayobozi b’ibigo bya Leta, ndetse n’abandi bayobozi mu nzego nkuru z’igihugu bazigomwa umushahara w’ukwezi kwa Mata 2020. Ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zitandukanye, abantu bagiye bagaragaza ko babyishimiye ndetse bamwe bakibaza ingano y’aya mafaranga abayobozi bakuru bigomwe, hakaba n’abibaza niba bo basanzwe biteguye kuburyo bitazabangamira imibereho yabo. Mu kubaha ishusho yabyo, turabagezaho ishusho y’imishahara basanzwe bahabwa kuburyo bifasha buri wese kubyumva. Iteka rya Perezida N°004/01 ryo ku wa 16/02/2017 rigena ingano y’imishahara n’ibindi bigenerwa Abanyapolitiki Bakuru b’Igihugu n’uburyo bitangwa, ryasohotse mu Igazeti ya Leta nimero idasanzwe yo kuwa 23/02/2017, rigaragaza ingano y’Imishahara aba Banyapolitiki Bakuru b’Igihugu bahabwa ndetse n’ibindi biherekeza iyo mishahara. Aba Banyapolitiki Bakuru b’Igihugu, barimo Perezida wa Repubulika, Perezida wa Sena, Perezida w’Umutwe w’Abadepite; Minisitiri w’Intebe; ba Visi Perezida ba Sena; ba Visi Perezida b’Umutwe w’Abadepite; Abaminisitiri; Abanyamabanga ba Leta; Abandi bagize Guverinoma bashobora gushyirwaho na Perezida wa Repubulika; Abaguverineri b’Intara; Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali, Abasenateri n’Abadepite. Umushahara mbumbe ugenerwa buri munyapolitiki mukuru uvugwa muri iri teka wiyongeraho icumi ku ijana (10%) byawo nyuma ya buri myaka itatu (3). Perezida wa Repubulika agenerwa ibi bikurikira: Perezida wa Sena, Perezida w’Umutwe w’Abadepite na Minisitiri w’Intebe: Perezida wa Sena, Perezida w’Umutwe w’Abadepite na Minisitiri w’Intebe bagenerwa buri wese umushahara mbumbe w’umurimo ungana n’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni enye n’ibihumbi magana atatu na mirongo ine na bitandatu n’ijana na mirongo itanu n’atandatu (4.346.156 Frw) buri kwezi. Buri wese agenerwa kandi ibi bikurikira: Amabwiriza ya Minisitiri ufite imiturire mu nshingano ze agena agaciro ntarengwa k’inzu ivugwa muri iyi ngingo mu gace kayo ka mbere n’agaciro ntarengwa k’ibyangombwa bigomba kuba biyirimo. Visi-Perezida ba Sena, ba Visi- Perezida b’Umutwe w’Abadepite, Abaminisitiri n’abandi bagize Guverinoma Ba Visi-Perezida ba Sena, ba Visi- Perezida b’Umutwe w’Abadepite, Abaminisitiri n’abandi bagize Guverinoma bashobora gushyirwaho na Perezida wa Repubulika bagenerwa buri wese umushahara mbumbe buri kwezi ungana n’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni ebyiri n’ibihumbi magana atanu mirongo itatu na bine na magana inani na mirongo itandatu na rimwe (2.534.861 Frw). Abanyamabanga ba Leta bagenerwa buri wese umushahara mbumbe buri kwezi ungana n’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni ebyiri n’ibihumbi magana ane na mirongo itatu na bine na magana atandatu na cumi n’atatu (2.434.613 Frw). Ba Visi-Perezida ba Sena, ba Visi-Perezida b’Umutwe w’Abadepite, Abaminisitiri, abandi bagize Guverinoma bashobora gushyirwaho na Perezida wa Repubulika n’Abanyamabanga ba Leta bagenerwa kandi buri wese ibindi bibafasha gutunganya imirimo bashinzwe, bikurikira: Amafaranga y’icumbi ya buri kwezi avugwa mu gace ka mbere k’igika cya 3 cy’iyi ngingo ntagenerwa umunyapolitiki mukuru w’Igihugu uvugwa muri iyi ngingo, iyo yahawe na Leta inkunga y’icumbi yatanzwe ingunga imwe, ingana na miliyoni cumi n’ebyiri n   amafaranga y’u Rwanda (12.000.000 Frw), mu gihe hakurikizwaga amategeko yabigenaga. Abaguverineri b’Intara n’Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali  Abaguverineri b’Intara n’Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali bagenerwa buri wese umushahara mbumbe w’umurimo buri kwezi ungana n’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni ebyiri n’ibihumbi magana ane na mirongo itatu na bine na magana atandatu na cumi n’atatu (2.434. 613 Frw). Buri wese agenerwa kandi ibindi bimufasha gutunganya imirimo ashinzwe, bikurikira: Amafaranga y’icumbi ya buri kwezi avugwa mu gace ka mbere k’igika cya 2 cy’iyi ngingo ntagenerwa Umuyobozi w’Umujyi wa Kigali, cyangwa uwahoze ari Guverineri w’Intara usubiye ku mwanya wa Guverineri w’Intara mu Ntara yigeze kuyobora; iyo yahawe na Leta inkunga y’icumbi yatanzwe ingunga imwe, ingana na miliyoni cumi n’ebyiri z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda (12.000.000 Frw), mu gihe hakurikizwaga amategeko yabigenaga. Abasenateri n’Abadepite: Abasenateri bagenerwa buri wese umushahara mbumbe w’umurimo ungana n’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni imwe n’ibihumbi magana inani na mirongo ine na birindwi na magana atandatu n’icyenda (1.847.609 Frw) buri kwezi. Abadepite bagenerwa buri wese umushahara mbumbe w’umurimo ungana n’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyoni imwe n’ibihumbi magana arindwi na mirongo irindwi na bine na magana atanu na mirongo ine (1.774.540 Frw) buri kwezi. Abaperezida ba Komisiyo muri Sena no mu Mutwe w’Abadepite, buri kwezi bongererwa buri wese ku mushahara mbumbe amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitanu (35.000 Frw) naho aba Visi-Perezida b’izo Komisiyo bakongererwa ibihumbi mirongo itatu (30.000 Frw) buri wese kandi buri kwezi. Abasenateri n’Abadepite bagenerwa kandi buri wese ibindi bibafasha gutunganya imirimo bashinzwe, bikurikira: Amafaranga y’icumbi ya buri kwezi avugwa mu gace ka mbere k’igika cya 4 cy’iyi ngingo ntagenerwa umunyapolitiki mukuru w’Igihugu uvugwa muri iyi ngingo, iyo yahawe na Leta inkunga y’icumbi yatanzwe ingunga imwe, ingana na miliyoni  cumi n’ebyiri z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda (12.000.000 Frw), mu gihe hakurikizwaga amategeko yabigenaga.  Amafaranga y’ubutumwa imbere mu gihugu. Mu kubagezaho ishusho y’imishahara y’abayobozi b’ibigo bitandukanye bya Leta nabyo bifite abayobozi bagomba kwigomwa, turashingira ku byasohotse mu Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe N° 92/03 ryo kuwa 01/03/2013 rihindura kandi ryuzuza Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe no 53/03 ryo kuwa 14/07/2012 rishyiraho imishahara n’ibindi bigenerwa Abakozi bo mu Butegetsi Bwite bwa Leta. Byumvikane neza ariko ko iri Teka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe ari iryo mu mwaka wa 2013, bisobanura ko mu mwaka ishize bitewe n’uburyo butandukanye abakozi ba Leta bagenda bongezwa, hashobora kuba hariyongereyeho amafaranga n’ubwo nanone impinduka zabaho zitaba zihambaye. ICYITONDERWA: Aba bayobozi bakuru b’ibigo bya Leta nabo bagenda bagenerwa ibintu bitandukanye bibafasha kuzuza inshingano zabo nk’amafaranga y’itumanaho, ay’urugendo n’ibindi
