label: politics
title: Nyirarukundo yavuze icyatumye ibyiciro by’ubudehe bishya bidasohoka muri Nyakanga nk’uko byari biteganyijwe
content:
Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’ Ubutegetsi bw’ Igihugu Nyirarukundo Ignatienne yavuze ko icyatumye ibyiciro bishya by’ubudehe bidasohoka muri Nyakanga 2019 nk’uko byari biteganyijwe ari uko bikiri kunozwa.
 Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’ Ubutegetsi bw’ Igihugu Nyirarukundo Ignatienne yavuze ko icyatumye ibyiciro bishya by’ubudehe bidasohoka muri Nyakanga 2019 nk’uko byari biteganyijwe ari uko bikiri kunozwa. Ibyo byiciro byagombaga gusohora mu kwezi kwa 7 umwaka ushize byahawe amazina mashya ariyo Ndinda, Ingemwe, Uruyange , Bandereho, na Rugerabicu. Aganira na UKWEZI kuri uyu wa 11 Werurwe 2020, Nyirarukundo yavuze ko icyatindije isohoka ry’ibyiciro by’ubudehe ari uko bikiri kunozwa. Yagize ati “Nta mbogamizi zindi uretse kunoza. Ni gahunda izamara igihe kirekire, mbese ni ugutinda ariko kurimo no gushaka kunoza ibintu”. Avuga ko kuba byaratinze bidakwiye gutera abaturage impungenge ko ahubwo bakomeza bagakoresha ibisanzweho, baharanira kuva muri kimwe bajya mu kindi. Ati “Iyo itegeko ritarahinduka iriba rihari riba rigifite agaciro”. avuga ko igihe ibi byiciro bishya bizatangarizwa kitaramenyekana. Byari byitezwe ko ibi byiciro bishya byavuye mu makuru yakusanyijwe mu baturage mu ntangiriro za 2019 bitangazwa mu ntangiriro za Nyakanga 2019 bikaba ari nabyo bigenderwaho mu mwaka w’ imihigo 2019/2020. Amakuru avuga ko ibyiciro by’ ubudehe byavuye kuri 7, biba 4 none bigiye kuba bitanu.  Mu nama yabaye kuri uyu wa 03 Kamena yahuje inzego zitandukanye zifite aho zihuriye n’ ibi byiciro by’ ubudehe ,hemejwe by’agateganyo ko ibyiciro by’ ubudehe bigomba kuba bitanu gusa bikazemezwa n’ Inama y’ Abaminisitiri. –Icyiciro cya mbere cyiswe Ndinda –Icyiciro cya kabiri cyiswe Ingemwe –Icya gatatu cyiswe Uruyange  Icya kane cyiswe Bandebereho –Icyiciro cya gatanu ni Rugerabicu . Ndinda,Ingemwe,Uruyange , Bandereho, na Rugerabicu niyo mazina mashya y’ibyiciro by’Ubudehe

title: Nyanza: Bakoze amahitamo azacungura burundu miliyoni 4 zagendaga buri mwaka kuri Situation Room
content:
Akarere ka Nyanza niko karere kuri ubu gafite icyumba cy’amakuru cy’ ikoranabuhanga. Umuyobozi wako Ntazinda Erasme avuga ko iri koranabuhanga rizafasha aka karere kudakomeza gutakaza miliyoni 4 mu gufotoza impapuro.
 Akarere ka Nyanza niko karere kuri ubu gafite icyumba cy’amakuru cy’ ikoranabuhanga. Umuyobozi wako Ntazinda Erasme avuga ko iri koranabuhanga rizafasha aka karere kudakomeza gutakaza miliyoni 4 mu gufotoza impapuro. Magingo aya icyumba cy’amakuru kizwi nka Situation Room kiri mu turere 30 twose tw’u Rwanda gusa uturere hafi ya twose dufite muri Situation room amakuru ari ku mpapuro. Iki cyumba gitwara miliyoni 4 buri mwaka agenda mu gufotoza amakuru aba ari kuri izi mpapuro zimanikwamo kugirango  ukeneye imibare igaragaza aho akarere kageze kesa imihigo ayibonemo. Bivuze ko Leta itakaza miliyoni 120 kuri iki cyumba gusa. Uko akarere ka Nyanza kahagaritse gutanga miliyoni 4 buri mwaka kandi amakuru akagaragazwa Umuyobozi w’ Akarere ka Nyanza Ntazinda Erasme avuga ko akarere karekuriye rimwe miliyoni 8 kagura ingaragazamashusho (screen) izakora imyaka yose. Ngo byatewe n’uko basanze bafite ikibazo cy’icyumba gito kitazakwirwamo impapuro ziriho ayo makuru, kandi ngo byanakozwe mu rwego rwo kurinda ibidukikije kuko buri rupapuro rushotse haba haguye igiti. Ati “Twakoreshaga miliyoni hafi enye zo kwempurima, ubwo twavuga ko twafashe imyaka ibiri tukayihuriza hamwe ariko ni ikintu kizabaho imyaka myinshi harimo rero inyungu ikomeye”. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’ Intara y’ Amajyepfo Jabo Paul yavuze ko akarere ka Nyanza kabaye bandebereho. Ngo gahunda ihari ni uko mu ntara y’amajyepfo yose mu turere twose uko ari 8 n’imirenge 101, icyumba cy’amakuru bamwe bita icyumba cy’imihigo kigomba kuba icy’ikikoranabuhanga (Smart Situation Room). Ati “Impamvu ikomeye ni uko impapuro ziragenda zikaba nyinshi zikaba zakenera n’ububiko, ahubwo zimwe zikaba zanakwangirika. Ikiza cya smart situation ariya ma format mwabonye yose azaba ari mu mashini.”. Jabo avuga ko iki cyumba cy’ikoranabuhanga kitezweho gukemura ikibazo avuga ko gisanzwe gihari cyo kutabona amakuru ajyanye n’imibare. 

Iyi screen yatwaye miliyoni 8 niyo ibitsemo amakuru yose ajyanye n’iterambere ry’akarere ka Nyanza

label: politics
title: Kagame na Museveni barahurira I Gatuna mu nama yiga ku mubano wa Uganda n’ u Rwanda
content:
Kuri uyu wa 21 Gashyantare 2020 biteganyijwe ko Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame na mugenzi wa Uganda bahurira I Gatuna mu nama yiga ku ngamba zo kunoza umubano hagati y’ u Rwanda na Uganda.
 Kuri uyu wa 21 Gashyantare 2020 biteganyijwe ko Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame na mugenzi wa Uganda bahurira I Gatuna mu nama yiga ku ngamba zo kunoza umubano hagati y’ u Rwanda na Uganda. Biteganyijwe ko iyi nama yitabirwa na Perezida wa Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Congo Felix Antoine Tskisekedi na Perezida wa Angola  João Lourenço. Perezida Lourenço yaraye ageze I Kigali ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 20 Gashyantare kugira ngo abone uko aza kwitabira iyi nama ihuza abakuru b’ibihugu bine. Iyi nama igiye kuba mu gihe Uganda iherutse gushyikiriza u Rwanda Abanyarwanda 13 yari ifunze mu buryo bunyuranyije n’amategeko. Uwo munsi nibabwo yarushyikirije abanyarwanda babiri bakekwaho kugaba igitero mu karere ka Musanze cyahitanye abarenga 10. Inama igiye kuba none ni iya kane, iheruka yabereye I Luanda muri Angola tariki 2 Gashyantare 2020, ari nayo yafatiwemo umwanzuro ko iya kane izabera I Gatuna. Mbere y’inama ya gatatu y’aba bakuru b’ibihugu uko ari bine Uganda yarekuye Abanyarwanda 9.

label: politics
title: Minisitiri Busingye yavuze ku bagabo basambanya abakobwa bitwaje ko bambara imyenda migufi
content:
Minisitiri w’ Ubutabera akaba n’intuma nkuru ya Leta Johnston Busingye avuga ko kuba umwana w’umukobwa yambaye mini(impenure) ari uburenganzira bwe, bityo ko ntawe ukwiye kubyitwaza ngo amusambanye.
 Minisitiri w’ Ubutabera akaba n’intuma nkuru ya Leta Johnston Busingye avuga ko kuba umwana w’umukobwa yambaye mini(impenure) ari uburenganzira bwe, bityo ko ntawe ukwiye kubyitwaza ngo amusambanye. Yabitangarije mu karere ka Nyanza mu nama yahuje abayobozi b’aka karere kuva ku rwego rw’umudugudu kugera ku rwego rw’akarere. Iyi nama yari ifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti “Sobanukirwa ibyaha ubyirinde, tutwanye ihohoterwa rikorerwa mu ngo n’irikorerwa abana” Minisitiri Busingye yavuze ko icyaha cy’ihohotera rishingiye ku gitsina atari impanuka cyangwa ikiza nk’imyuzure, n’inzige ahubwo ari ibikorwa umuntu ategura agafata isuka aho guhinga ikawa agahinga umugore we. Yavuze ko umuntu ukora icyaha cy’ihohotera ari ukwiye kugira ubwoba kuko ngo nibatagira ubwoba bazakomeza ati “Polisi ikwiye gutabara uwahohoteye umuntu abandi bashaka kumuniga. Dukwiye kwirukanka kubahohotera abantu akaba aribo bagira ubwoba nibatagira ubwoba bazakomeza.” 
 Minisitiri Busingye yavuze ko Abanyarwanda biyemeje ko bagiye kurwanya ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina ryarangira. Anavuga ko kunywa ibiyobyabwenge atari urwitwazo rwo gukora icyaha ati “Kuki uwanyoye ibiyobyabwenge atiyahura, kuki atajya kwijugunya muri Nyabarongo, ni uko hari amahitamo aba yasigaranye”. Yakomeje agira ati “Umugabo utekereza ngo umwana w’abandi yambaye mini, ngo urwo ni uruhushya rwo kumuterura, umuterura nkande wowe? Umwana washatse kwambara mini(impenure) uramushakaho iki?. Ntacyo bitwaye, ariko se wowe wa mugabo we wayambaye wowe umwanya wo kujya guterura abandi. Tugatangira gukumakuma abakobwa bacu ngo ntugende, ni kunywa ni nijoro ntuge hariya, abana bacu bakeneye gusohoka, ejo bazajya mu mijyi, bazasohoka mu Rwanda bage ahandi. Ubwo rero tubahindure abaturage batarabona n’imodoka, batarabona kaburimbo ngo twabatinyishije izi ngwe z’abahungu bahindutse ingwe ryari? Niba ari ingwe ingwe ziba mu kagera”. Busingye yavuze ko umuntu umwe wahohotewe akwiye gutuma abantu bose bahanguruka. Ngo atumwa ukuntu abantu 200 bahohotera bagenzi babo bananira abantu ibihumbi 400 batuye akarere ka Nyanza. 
 Umunyamabanga mukuru wungirije wa RIB, Isabelle Kalihangabo, yavuze ko Urwego rw’igihugu rwonyine rudashobora kurangiza rwonyine inshingano zo gukumira , gutahura no kugenza ibyaha rudafashijwe n’abaturage. Ati “Abantu twese duteraniye hano dushyize hamwe ihohoterwa rishingiye ku gitsina ryaranduka burundu”. Urwego rw’igihugu rw’ubugenzacyaha RIB ruvuga ko mu karere ka Nyanza rwakiriye umwaka ushize wa 2019 rwakiriye ibirego 177 by’ihohoterwa. Meya wa Nyanza Ntazinda Erasme we yavuze ko ibirego by’ihohoterwa byagaragaye muri 2019 ari 214. RIB ivuga ko ibyaha by’ihohoterwa ababikora cyane ari abagabo. Muri 2019 abagabo bakurikiranyweho ibyaha by’ihohoterwa ni 180 mu gihe abagore ari 24. Kalihangabo yavuze mu byaha by’ ihohoterwa ikiza ku isonga ari ugusambanya abana, ibirego 60, bigakurikirwa n’icyaha cyo Gukubita no gukomereka cyagize ibirego 34, mu gihe icyaha cyo Gukoresha undi imibonano mpuzabitsina ku gataho cyagize ibirego 18. Intara y’Amajyepfo iri kumwanya wa gatatu (3) mu byaha byose muri rusange, aho mu mwaka wa 2019, RIB yagenjeje ibyaha 10, 924 Akarere ka Nyanza by’umwihariko kari ku mwanya wa (26) mu byaha byose muri rusange, ku bw’imwihariko Nyanza hakaba haragaragaye ibyaha byo gusambanya abana 60, no guhohotera uwo bashakanye ibyaha 24. Ibi ni byaha byakurikiranywe dosiye zoherezwa mu Bushinjacyaha Mu ntara y’amajyepfo akarere kaza ku mwanya wa mbere mu kugira ibyaha byinshi ni  by’ ihohoterwa ni Nyaruguru gafite ibirenga 300. 

Abaturage bavuga ko igitera ihohoterwa cyane ari inzoga z’inkorano

label: politics
title: Kigali:Imiterere mishya y’ubuyobozi yicaje abari ba meya
content:
Ibiro bya Minisitiri w’Intebe byatangaje ko kuri uyu wa 07 Gashyantare 2020, hashyizwe mu myanya abayobozi, mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ku buryo bukurikira:
 Ibiro bya Minisitiri w’Intebe byatangaje ko kuri uyu wa 07 Gashyantare 2020, hashyizwe mu myanya abayobozi, mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ku buryo bukurikira: Ibiro by’Umujyi wa Kigali Madamu RUGAZA Julian: Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ibikorwa by’Umujyi (City Manager)  Bwana ASABA KATABARWA Emmanuel: Umuyobozi Mukuru ushinzwe Imyubakire n’Imitunganyirize y’Umujyi (City Engineer);  Bwana NIYONGABO Joseph: Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Imirimo Rusange (Director General of Corporate Services);  Madamazela MUHIRWA Marie Solange: Umuyobozi Mukuru Ushinzwe Igenamigambi ry’Imiturire n’Imitunganyirize y’Umujyi (Chief of Urban Planning);  Bwana RUBANGUTSANGABO Jean: Umuyobozi Mukuru Ushinzwe Iterambere ry’Ubukungu ry’Umujyi (Urban Economist). Mu Karere ka Gasabo:  Madamu UMWALI Pauline: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere (District Executive Administrator);  Bwana MUDAHERANWA Regis: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere Wungirije (Deputy District Executive Administrator). Mu Karere ka Kicukiro:  Madamu UMUTESI Solange: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere (District Executive Administrator);  Bwana RUKEBANUKA Adalbert: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere Wungirije (Deputy District Executive Administrator). Mu Karere ka Nyarugenge:  Bwana NGABONZIZA Emmy: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere (District Executive Administrator);  Madamu NSHUTIRAGUMA Esperance: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere Wungirije (Deputy District Executive Administrator). Izi mpinduka zishingiye ku itegeko Nº 22/2019 ryo ku wa 29/07/2019 rigenga Umujyi wa Kigali riherutse kuvugururwa, hagakorwa impinduka mu miterere n’inshingano z’inzego z’ubuyobozi, mu rwego rwo kunoza imicungire n’iterambere ry’Umujyi, cyane cyane ku bijyanye n’ibikorwa remezo. Ku wa 26 Nyakanga 2019, nibwo Umutwe w’Abadepite, watoye Itegeko rigenga Umujyi wa Kigali, risohoka mu Igazeti ya Leta n° idasanzwe yo ku wa 31/07/2019, hagamijwe kunoza imitunganyirize n’imikorere by’Umujyi wa Kigali. Iryo tegeko rivuga ko Uturere tw’Umujyi wa Kigali tudafite ubuzima gatozi mu micungire y’imari n’abakozi, ahubwo abakozi bakorera mu Turere, Imirenge n’Utugari bakaba ari ab’Umujyi wa Kigali, ari na wo ugenera izo nzego ingengo y’imari yo gukoresha. Itegeko rigenga umujyi wa Kigali kandi ryahinduye inyito n’inshingano z’abayobozi bungirije b’Umujyi wa Kigali n’Urwego nshingwabikorwa rw’Umujyi wa Kigali rukazajya ruyoborwa n’Umuyobozi w’Ibikorwa by’Umujyi (City Manager). Itegeko rigenga Umujyi wa Kigali rikuraho Inama Njyanama z’uturere rikanavuga ko Akarere kazajya kayoborwa n’Urwego nshingwabikorwa rugizwe n’Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere ndetse n’Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere Wungirije, bashyirwaho n’Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe. Stephen Rwamurangwa n’abandi babiri bari bamwungirije ku buyobozi bw’ Akarere ka Gasabo ubu ntibakikayobora. Ni mu gihe Dr. Jeanne Nyirahabimana wari umaze igihe ayobora Akarere ka Kicukiro we hagati mu mwaka ushize yagizwe Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Intara y’Iburasirazuba, Kicukiro isigara iyoborwa n’umuyobozi w’agateganyo. Ubuyobozi bwa Kayisime Nzaramba wayoboraga Akarere ka Nyarugenge n’abari bamwungirije na bwo burangiye kuri uyu wa gatanu, kimwe n’abandi bayoboraga uturere two mu Mujyi wa Kigali.

 Ibiro bya Minisitiri w’Intebe byatangaje ko kuri uyu wa 07 Gashyantare 2020, hashyizwe mu myanya abayobozi, mu Mujyi wa Kigali, ku buryo bukurikira: Ibiro by’Umujyi wa Kigali Madamu RUGAZA Julian: Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ibikorwa by’Umujyi (City Manager)  Bwana ASABA KATABARWA Emmanuel: Umuyobozi Mukuru ushinzwe Imyubakire n’Imitunganyirize y’Umujyi (City Engineer);  Bwana NIYONGABO Joseph: Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Imirimo Rusange (Director General of Corporate Services);  Madamazela MUHIRWA Marie Solange: Umuyobozi Mukuru Ushinzwe Igenamigambi ry’Imiturire n’Imitunganyirize y’Umujyi (Chief of Urban Planning);  Bwana RUBANGUTSANGABO Jean: Umuyobozi Mukuru Ushinzwe Iterambere ry’Ubukungu ry’Umujyi (Urban Economist). Mu Karere ka Gasabo:  Madamu UMWALI Pauline: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere (District Executive Administrator);  Bwana MUDAHERANWA Regis: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere Wungirije (Deputy District Executive Administrator). Mu Karere ka Kicukiro:  Madamu UMUTESI Solange: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere (District Executive Administrator);  Bwana RUKEBANUKA Adalbert: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere Wungirije (Deputy District Executive Administrator). Mu Karere ka Nyarugenge:  Bwana NGABONZIZA Emmy: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere (District Executive Administrator);  Madamu NSHUTIRAGUMA Esperance: Umuyobozi Nshingwabikorwa w’Akarere Wungirije (Deputy District Executive Administrator). Izi mpinduka zishingiye ku itegeko Nº 22/2019 ryo ku wa 29/07/2019 rigenga Umujyi wa Kigali riherutse kuvugururwa, hagakorwa impinduka mu miterere n’inshingano z’inzego z’ubuyobozi, mu rwego rwo kunoza imicungire n’iterambere ry’Umujyi, cyane cyane ku bijyanye n’ibikorwa remezo. Ku wa 26 Nyakanga 2019, nibwo Umutwe w’Abadepite, watoye Itegeko rigenga Umujyi wa Kigali, risohoka mu Igazeti ya Leta n° idasanzwe yo ku wa 31/07/2019, hagamijwe kunoza imitunganyirize n’imikorere by’Umujyi wa Kigali. Iryo tegeko rivuga ko Uturere tw’Umujyi wa Kigali tudafite ubuzima gatozi mu micungire y’imari n’abakozi, ahubwo abakozi bakorera mu Turere, Imirenge n’Utugari bakaba ari ab’Umujyi wa Kigali, ari na wo ugenera izo nzego ingengo y’imari yo gukoresha. Stephen Rwamurangwa n’abandi babiri bari bamwungirije ku buyobozi bw’ Akarere ka Gasabo ubu ntibakikayobora. Ni mu gihe Dr. Jeanne Nyirahabimana wari umaze igihe ayobora Akarere ka Kicukiro we hagati mu mwaka ushize yagizwe Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Intara y’Iburasirazuba, Kicukiro isigara iyoborwa n’umuyobozi w’agateganyo. Ubuyobozi bwa Kayisime Nzaramba wayoboraga Akarere ka Nyarugenge n’abari bamwungirije na bwo burangiye kuri uyu wa gatanu, kimwe n’abandi bayoboraga uturere two mu Mujyi wa Kigali.

title: Ubutumwa buherutse kuzanwa n’ intumwa ya Museveni buratanga icyizere?’ - Kagame yagize icyo abivugaho
content:
‘Perezida Kagame yavuze ko amahirwe yose aganira ku gushakira umuti umubano utifashe neza hagati y’ u Rwanda na Uganda atajya ayasubiza inyuma gusa ngo nubwo yagiranye ibiganiro byiza n’ intumwa ya Perezida wa Uganda Yoweri Museveni ngo ikiganiro kirimo kubwizanya ukuri cyonyine ntabwo gihagije.
 ‘Perezida Kagame yavuze ko amahirwe yose aganira ku gushakira umuti umubano utifashe neza hagati y’ u Rwanda na Uganda atajya ayasubiza inyuma gusa ngo nubwo yagiranye ibiganiro byiza n’ intumwa ya Perezida wa Uganda Yoweri Museveni ngo ikiganiro kirimo kubwizanya ukuri cyonyine ntabwo gihagije. Ku Cyumweru tariki 29 Ukuboza 2019 nibwo Perezida Kagame yakiriye ambasaderi Adonia Abaye nk’ intumwa yari imuzaniye ubutumwa bwa Perezida Museveni ku mubano w’ ibihugu byombi. Mu kiganiro Perezida Kagame yagiranye na Radiyo na Televiziyo Rwanda kuri uyu wa 31 Ukuboza 2019 yavuze ko intumwa yakiriye ari muri gahunda ikomeje yo gushakisha uko umubano w’ ibihugu byombi wakongera ukamera neza. Yagize ati “Ibintu byinshi bimaze gukorwa byo gushaka uko ibibazo bihari byakemuka, byaba ibishingiye ku kuri, byaba ibyo kwanduranya gusa, byaba ibyo kwiyemera, byaba ibyo kugira gute, ibyo byose biba bikubiyemo bivangavanze. Ariko nanone abantu bagomba gushaka uko byakemurwa niyo nzira twagiyemo, tujya Luanda muri Angola, inshuro nyinshi cyangwa Abanyangola bafatanyije na DRC baje kudusura, bagiye gusura Uganda. Ibiriho kugira ngo iryo pfundo rishobore gupfunduka bizakomeza”. Perezida Kagame avuga ko abantu aria bantu ngo niyo mpamvu ibintu hari igihe bitagenda neza nk’ uko bikwiye nyamara byumvikana. Ati “Ukuri ni uko yaba Uganda yaba u Rwanda sinshidikanya ko twese twifuza amahoro”. Yavuze ko Intumwa ya Perezida Museveni aribyo yaje kumureba ngo nabyo ni muri iyo nzira yo gushakisha hubakirwa kuri biriya bindi byagiye biba. Ati “Kuvuga rero ngo intumwa yahageze icyizere cyabonetse, ntabwo nibwira ko ari uko nabivuga, njye nabivuga ko iyo ari indi ntambwe ikomeza guterwa muri ubwo buryo bwo gushakisha icyatuma ikibazo icyo ari cyose cyaba gihari gishobora gukemuka”. Yakomeje avuga ati “Niyo mpamvu njyewe aho mboneye ko hari intumwa igiye kuza kugira icyo ivuga ntabwo nakwanga kuyakira…Twagize ikiganiro kibwizanya ukuri, ariko ikiganiro ubwacyo ntabwo gihagize hagomba kugira ibiva mu kiganiro”. Perezida Kagame yasabye Uganda guha u Rwanda amahoro ati “Baduhe amahoro, nubwo u Rwanda ruyakeneye nabo ndibwira ko bayakeneye. Ikintu cy’ ifatwa ry’ Abanyarwanda rya buri munsi aho bashakiye bakubitwa bamburwa ibyabo, ugashakisha n’ impamvu ikabura. Birimo urwango, birimo ibintu byinshi kandi si umwe, si babiri, si icumi, bagera muri magana.”. “Kugera ahantu igihugu gihiga abanyagihugu b’ ikindi gihugu ntabwo byasobanuka, sinzi impamvu yabisobanura neza. Abandi bakavuga ngo baba bagiyeyo baba bagiye gutata, gutata iki? Kirimo abana kirimo, abagore kirimo abantu batazi no kwandika no gusoma, abantu bari aho bashakisha uko biberaho”. Umukuru w’ igihugu yavuze ko hari abava mu Rwanda batarwifuriza ineza kuko hari ibyo yabajijwe cyangwa bafite uko batekereza, yagera mu kindi gihugu kikabafasha. 
U Rwanda rushinja Uganda gutera inkunga imitwe irurwanya narwo rugashinjwa n’ u Burundi gucumbikira abafite imigambi mibi ku Burundi, gusa Perezida Kagame yagize ati “Twe ntabwo twigeze dushyigikira abari bafitanye ibibazo n’ ibi bihugu bindi”.

label: politics
title: U Rwanda rugiye kubaka ibyumba ibihumbi 11 by’ amashuri
content:
Minisiteri y’ Uburezi yatangaje ko mu myaka 3 iri imbere Leta y’ u Rwanda izaba imaze kubaka ibyumba by’ amashuri ibihumbi 11 mu rwego rwo gukemura ikibazo cy’ ubucucike mu mashuri.
 Minisiteri y’ Uburezi yatangaje ko mu myaka 3 iri imbere Leta y’ u Rwanda izaba imaze kubaka ibyumba by’ amashuri ibihumbi 11 mu rwego rwo gukemura ikibazo cy’ ubucucike mu mashuri. Ni mu gihe abarimu n’ inzobere mu burezi badasiba kugaragaza ko ubucukike mu mashuri ari kimwe mu bisubiza hasi ireme ry’ uburezi mu Rwanda. Iby’ umushinga wo kubaka ibyumba ibihumbi 11, Umunyamabanga uhoraho muri Minisiteri y’ uburezi Mulindwa Samuel yabitangarije mu karere ka Nyaruguru mu muhango wo gutaha ku mugaragaro ibyumba bishya by’ amashuri byubatswe mu mwaka w’ ingengo y’ imari 2019/2020. Mulindwa yavuze ko iyi nkunga yo kubaka ibyumba ibihumbi 11 yatanzwe na banki y’ Isi, anemera ko mu mashuri yo mu Rwanda hagaragara ikibazo cy’ ubucukike bukabije, bityo ngo kubaka aya amashuri bigomba kwihutishwa. Yagize ati “Turifuza ko bishobotse na ya gahunda ya Banki y’ Isi itageza ku myaka ine, nibura imyaka itatu kuko icyuho kirahari n’ amafaranga nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repubulika yaratuvugiye turayabona, miliyoni 200 z’ amadorali. Tugiye kubaka ibyumba ibihumbi 11 ku rwego rw’ igihugu”. Yakomeje avuga ko muri ibyo byumba ibihumbi 11 harimo ibyumba birenga 200 bigenewe akarere ka Nyaruguru. Umuyobozi wungirije w’ Akarere ka Nyaruguru ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’ abaturage Colette Kayitesi avuga ko muri aka karere ubucukike mu ishuri buri ku bana 71 mu cyumba cy’ ishuri. Mulindwa avuga ko intego ya Leta y’ u Rwanda ari uko nibura icyumba cy’ ishuri kigomba kutarenza abana 50 kuko bituma abana biga neza bikanorohereza umwarimu. Muri uyu mwaka w’ ingengo y’ imari 2019/2020 Leta y’ u Rwanda yubatse ibyumba by’ amashuri 1 100.. U Rwanda rufite abanyeshuri miliyoni 2,5 biga mu mashuri abanza n’ abanyeshuri ibihumbi 500 biga mu mashuri yisumbuye. Impuzandengo y’ imyaka umunyarwanda yiga igeze ku myaka 6,6.

label: politics
title: Komisiyo y’ Abakozi ba Leta yatahuye ko hari abakora ibizami by’ akazi bakagabanyirizwa amanota abandi bakayongererwa
content:
KAYIJIRE Agnès, Visi Perezida w’Inama y’Abakomiseri muri Komisiyo y’ abakozi ba Leta n’ umurimo (PSC) yavuze ko bavumbuye ko hari inzego za Leta zagiye zitanga ikizami cy’ akazi zikagabanya amanota ya bamwe mu bakandida abandi bakandida bakayongererwa.
 KAYIJIRE Agnès, Visi Perezida w’Inama y’Abakomiseri muri Komisiyo y’ abakozi ba Leta n’ umurimo (PSC) yavuze ko bavumbuye ko hari inzego za Leta zagiye zitanga ikizami cy’ akazi zikagabanya amanota ya bamwe mu bakandida abandi bakandida bakayongererwa. Yabitangaje kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 30 Ukwakira 2019, ubwo iyi Komisiyo yagezaga ku Badepite n’Abasenateri raporo y’ibikorwa byayo Komisiyo y’Igihugu ishinzwe Abakozi ba Leta by’umwaka wa 2018-2019 na gahunda y’ibikorwa by’umwaka wa 2019-2020. KAYIJIRE Agnès yavuze ko iki kibazo cy’ abongerera amanota bamwe mu bakandida abandi bakayagabanyirizwa bakibonye muri uyu mwaka ushize w’ ingengo y’ imari ubwo basesenguraga imicungire y’ abakozi ba Leta. Depite Mukabunani Christine avuga ko iyo hari umukandida wongerewe amanota haba habayemo ruswa nyamara ngo ntabwo abariye iyo ruswa bahanwa ahubwo ngo barihanangirizwa. Yagize ati “Ikigaragara muri iyi raporo ni uko ruswa yihishe inyuma y’ abantu bongerera abandi amanota kandi iyo ngingo ikaba ikomeye cyane. Usanga naho komisiyo yasabye ko uwabikoze ahanwa ariko ugasanga baramwihanangirije mu magambo, nyamara ruswa ntabwo ari icyaha cyo guhanisha kwihanangiriza mu magambo” Yakomeje agira ari aha ngaha abantu bakaba babireba neza kuko gufata umuntu wari ufite amanota 20, ukamuha 80, byanze bikunze haba harimo ruswa kandi tuziko ari icyaha gihanwa n’ amategeko. 
 Depite Christine Mukabunani avuga ko kuba bamwe mu bakandida ku myanya y’ akazi bagabanyirizwa amanota abandi bakayongererwa hari ruswa ibyihishe inyuma Depite Mukabunani avuga ko kuba aho bigaragaye ko hari umukandida wongerewe amanota , uwo mwanya usubizwa ku isoko atari byo kuko haba hari uwagize amanota ya 2 kandi ngo uwo ntabwo aba yarongerewe amanota. Ngo iyo adahawe uwo mwanya biba ari akarengane kuko ubutaha ashobora kuba yacitse intege ntasubire gukora ikizamini. KAYIJIRE nawe yemera ko nka PSC iyo basesenguye basanga abongererwa amanota abandi bakayagabanyirizwa harimo ruswa n’ itonesha. Senateri Uwambaje Aimee Sandrine yibajije niba aya manota ahindurirwa mu kigo gishinzwe gutanga ibizamini by’ akazi cyangwa niba ahindurirwa ku rwego rwa Leta. Depite Rubagumya yibaza impamvu abakandida 39% aribo gusa bitabira gukora ibizami by’ akazi akongera akibaza impamvu 9% aribo gusa batsinda ibizamini. Kuri iki kibazo PSC ivuga ko kubera ko gusaba akazi byashyizwe mu buryo bw’ ikoranabuhanga bituma umuntu uri kure y’ ahazakorerwa ikizami asaba akazi, mu gihe cyo gukora ikizami hakaba ubwo kugera aho ikizami gikorewe bimunaniye. Naho ku kibazo cyo kuba abatsinda ikizami cy’ akazi mu bihumbi birenga 40 bikora buri mwaka ari 9% ngo biterwa n’ uko kugira ngo umuntu atsinde asabwa kugira amanota 70% mu gihe no mu mashuri abagira 70% atari benshi. PSC ivuga ko bataramenya mu by’ ukuri aho ayo manota ahindurirwa; Gusa ivuga ko bamwe mu bagize uruhare mu guhindura aya manota hari abirukanywe burundu, hari abahawe ibindi bihano ariko yemera ko niba bigaragaye ko  habayemo ruswa cyangwa itonesha hari ibindi bihano biteganywa n’ amategeko. Mu mwaka wa 2018/2019 yakiriwe ubujurire 602 muri ubwo  571 bwatanzweho imyanzuro. Uturere n’ amashuri makuru nibyo bifite ubujurire bwinshi. 52,2% ni ubujurire bushingiye ku kutanyurwa n’ amanota. Ubujurire mu micungire y’ abakozi ni 424 muri bwo 77% bwavuye mu turere. Ubujurire PSC yakira, muri 2018/2019 bwiyongereyeho 5% mu bijyanye n’ amakosa mu gushaka abakozi, buniyongeraho 6% mu makosa ajyanye no gucunga abakozi.

Depite Mukabunani Christine avuga ko iyo hari umukandida wongerewe amanota haba habayemo ruswa nyamara ngo ntabwo abariye iyo ruswa bahanwa ahubwo ngo barihanangirizwa. Yagize ati “Ikigaragara muri iyi raporo ni uko ruswa yihishe inyuma y’ abantu bongerera abandi amanota kandi iyo ngingo ikaba ikomeye cyane. Usanga naho komisiyo yasabye ko uwabikoze ahanwa ariko ugasanga baramwihanangirije mu magambo, nyamara ruswa ntabwo ari icyaha cyo guhanisha kwihanangiriza mu magambo” Yakomeje agira ari aha ngaha abantu bakaba babireba neza kuko gufata umuntu wari ufite amanota 20, ukamuha 80, byanze bikunze haba harimo ruswa kandi tuziko ari icyaha gihanwa n’ amategeko. 
 Depite Christine Mukabunani avuga ko kuba bamwe mu bakandida ku myanya y’ akazi bagabanyirizwa amanota abandi bakayongererwa hari ruswa ibyihishe inyuma Depite Mukabunani avuga ko kuba aho bigaragaye ko hari umukandida wongerewe amanota , uwo mwanya usubizwa ku isoko atari byo kuko haba hari uwagize amanota ya 2 kandi ngo uwo ntabwo aba yarongerewe amanota. Ngo iyo adahawe uwo mwanya biba ari akarengane kuko ubutaha ashobora kuba yacitse intege ntasubire gukora ikizamini. KAYIJIRE nawe yemera ko nka PSC iyo basesenguye basanga abongererwa amanota abandi bakayagabanyirizwa harimo ruswa n’ itonesha. Senateri Uwambaje Aimee Sandrine yibajije niba aya manota ahindurirwa mu kigo gishinzwe gutanga ibizamini by’ akazi cyangwa niba ahindurirwa ku rwego rwa Leta. Depite Rubagumya yibaza impamvu abakandida 39% aribo gusa bitabira gukora ibizami by’ akazi akongera akibaza impamvu 9% aribo gusa batsinda ibizamini. Kuri iki kibazo PSC ivuga ko kubera ko gusaba akazi byashyizwe mu buryo bw’ ikoranabuhanga bituma umuntu uri kure y’ ahazakorerwa ikizami asaba akazi, mu gihe cyo gukora ikizami hakaba ubwo kugera aho ikizami gikorewe bimunaniye. Naho ku kibazo cyo kuba abatsinda ikizami cy’ akazi mu bihumbi birenga 40 bikora buri mwaka ari 9% ngo biterwa n’ uko kugira ngo umuntu atsinde asabwa kugira amanota 70% mu gihe no mu mashuri abagira 70% atari benshi. PSC ivuga ko bataramenya mu by’ ukuri aho ayo manota ahindurirwa; Gusa ivuga ko bamwe mu bagize uruhare mu guhindura aya manota hari abirukanywe burundu, hari abahawe ibindi bihano ariko yemera ko niba bigaragaye ko  habayemo ruswa cyangwa itonesha hari ibindi bihano biteganywa n’ amategeko. Mu mwaka wa 2018/2019 yakiriwe ubujurire 602 muri ubwo  571 bwatanzweho imyanzuro. Uturere n’ amashuri makuru nibyo bifite ubujurire bwinshi. 52,2% ni ubujurire bushingiye ku kutanyurwa n’ amanota. Ubujurire mu micungire y’ abakozi ni 424 muri bwo 77% bwavuye mu turere. Ubujurire PSC yakira, muri 2018/2019 bwiyongereyeho 5% mu bijyanye n’ amakosa mu gushaka abakozi, buniyongeraho 6% mu makosa ajyanye no gucunga abakozi.

title: ‘Ntabwo u Rwanda rukize ku mitungo ariko rukize ku mutima’ Perezida Kagame
content:
Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame yagaragaje ko kuba u Rwanda rwaremeye kwakira impunzi 500 zizava muri Libya aho zaheze zashakaga kujya I Burayi atari uko rukize ku mitungo ahubwo ari uko rukize ku mutima w’ impuhwe n’ urukundo.
 Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame yagaragaje ko kuba u Rwanda rwaremeye kwakira impunzi 500 zizava muri Libya aho zaheze zashakaga kujya I Burayi atari uko rukize ku mitungo ahubwo ari uko rukize ku mutima w’ impuhwe n’ urukundo. Yabikomojeho ubwo yaganiraga n’ urubyiruko 10 000 ruteraniye I Kigali mu ishuriro ngarukamwaka ry’ urubyiruko rizwi nka ‘Youth Connekt Africa’. Perezida Kagame wafunguye ku mugaragaro iri huriro yeretse uru rubyiruko ko ikibanze ari ukubaho no kugira ikerekezo ubundi ugaharanira kugera ku kerekezo wihaye. Ati “Mwasomye inkuru ya Libya? Aho twakuye abantu bamwe bari bazengutse hariya, hari n’ abandi benshi barimo baza. Reka ngire icyo mbibabwiraho. U Rwanda ntabwo ari igihugu gikize mu ku mitungo ariko turi abatunzi dufite ubuzima mu buryo byinshi. Turi abatunzi kandi dufite ubuzima ku mutima n’ intego, mu kongera ibishoboka mu byo dufite”. Yakomeje avuga ko u Rwanda rufite izindi mpunzi nyinshi zirimo izavuye mu bihugu by’ abaturanyi, avuga ko u Rwanda ruziha ibishoboka uko rushoboye byenda kungana n’ ibyo ruha abaturage barwo birimo amashuri, amavurimo n’ ibindi. Perezida Kagame yabwiye urubyiruko abitabiriye Youth Connekt Africa 2019  ko u Rwanda rumaze kubona uburyo abimukira bava muri Afurika barimo gupfira mu nyanja ya Mediterane, no kuba hari abohereza indege zigatera ibisasu mu nkambi barimo rwabwiye abo bireba ko hari amahitamo atatu. Avuga ko u Rwanda rwahaye abo bireba amahitamo atatu atari meza 100% ariko aruta kubura ubuzima: Mubatuzanire abashaka gukomeza kujya I Burayi tubahe aho bategerereza batekanye. Aho kugira ngo batangirirwe hariya bicwa buri munsi bashobora kuza bagategerereza tugakorana n’ u Burayi bukaza bugahitamo abo bushaka kujyana, tuzabarekura bagende. Amahitamo ya kabiri ni uko abumva bashaka gusubiza mu bihugu byabo, u Rwanda rwemeye kubaha aho baba bari mu gihe mu gihe bari kuganira na Leta z’ ibihugu byabo kugira ngo bazasubire iwabo mu buryo buboneye. Akomeza agira ati “Amahitamo ya gatatu ari nayo ya nyuma yari, niba badashaka gusubira iwabo, bakaba batanabonye ubajyana I Burayi, bakaba bemera kumuguma hano tuzagumana nabo (abari mu cyumba bahise bakoma amashyi)






Mu ntangiro z’ ukwezi kwa 9 nibwo amakuru y’ uko u Rwanda rugiye kwakira impunzi 500 zizava muri Libya yamenyekanye. Kugeza ubu impunzi 66 zamaze kugera mu Rwanda izindi ziracyashakirwa uko zizanwa mu Rwanda. Leta y’ u Rwanda ivuga ko nta mafaranga yahawe ngo yemere kwakira izi mpunzi ngo impamvu yazakiriye ni uko ari ikibazo cy’ Afurika kigomba gusubizwa n’ Abanyafurika.

label: politics
title: Nyamagabe: Meya yasuye rya shuri animateri aherutse gufatanwa umunyeshuri mu cyumba nijoro ati ’ni musigeho’
content:
Umuyobozi w’ Akarere ka Nyamagabe Uwamahoro Bonaventure yasabye abarezi kwamagana abasambanya abanyeshuri agaragaza ko ari uguteguha ababyeyi baba babagiriye ikizere bakabaha umwana ngo bamurere.
 Umuyobozi w’ Akarere ka Nyamagabe Uwamahoro Bonaventure yasabye abarezi kwamagana abasambanya abanyeshuri agaragaza ko ari uguteguha ababyeyi baba babagiriye ikizere bakabaha umwana ngo bamurere. Ubu butumwa yabutanze ubwo yari yasuye abanyeshuri, abarezi n’abayobozi b’ibigo bya amashuri bya ES Kaduha na GS St Jean Bosco Kaduha kuwa 15/10/2019 agamije kuganira nabo no kubakangurira  kwirinda guhohotera abana bashinzwe kurera ahubwo bakabaha uburere bwiza. Ibi bije nyuma yaho animateur wo mu kigo cya GS St Jean Baptiste Kaduha afatanywe n’umwana w’umukobwa muri chambre mu  masaha ya saa sita z’ijoro ariko bakaba barafashwe batararyamana (ataramusambanya). Uwo murezi yafashwe n’inzego z’umutekano (police, RDF na DASSO) hamwe na RIB ubu akaba acumbikiwe na RIB kuri ya police ya Kaduha. Meya Uwamahoro yagize ati “Ibyabaye hano mu kigo cya GS St Jean Bosco Kaduha ni amahano, guca ayo amahano ni ukongera gutanga impanuro mu mashuri ubu bukangurambaga bugamije kwerekana ko nta muntu ukwiye kubishyigikira yaba umunyeshuri byabayeho cyangwa n’undi wese byabayeho ntabivuge turamusaba kugira ubutwari bwo kubivuga kugira ngo tubone uko tubyamagana”. Yakomeje avuga abarezi nk’ abantu barerera u Rwanda rw’ ejo hazaza bakwiye kwamagana ikintu cyo gusambanya abanyeshuri. 
 Meya Uwamahoro yijeje Abanyarwanda ko abakora iki cyaha bose bazamenyekana kandi bagahanwa. Avuga ko ubukangurambaga nk’ ubwo bakoze buzatuma ababikora bazajya bamenyekana kuko abanyeshuri bazahindura imyumvire bakajya batanga amakuru y’ abarezi bitwara nabi. Yabwiye abarimu ati “Barimu iyo umubyeyi aguhaye umwana we ngo umurere akamugusigira ku ishuri aba akugirye ikizere gikomeye aba yizeye ko hari akarusho wazana mu burere n’uburezi by’uwo mwana nimusigeho kwangiza abana b’abakobwa mubashuka nimureke tubyamagane”. Umuyobozi w’akarere yabwiye abo barimu n’abayobozi b’ikigo ko abanyeshuri bashinzwe kurera aribo bukungu bukomeye bw’igihugu bakaba ari nabo bayobozi b’ejo hazaza bityo bakaba bagomba kubarera neza bakabigisha indangagaciro nkuko babisabwa byaba ngombwa bakanongeraho akarusho. Yabibukije ko umurezi nyawe aba agomba kurangwa n’imyitwarire ikwiye mubo ayobora kandi yanaboneyeho kubaha impanuro za perezida wa repubulika ko ibintu bwo guhohotera abakobwa n’abagore atari ibintu bw’I Rwanda nta ndangagaciro zibirimo bityo buri wese aba agomba kubigendera kure. Inkuru bifitanye isano : Nyamagabe: Animateri yafatiwe mu cyuho yararanye n’ umunyeshuri w’ imyaka 17

title: Impunzi 66 zageze mu Rwanda ziganjemo abasore n’ inkumi
content:
Kuri uyu wa 26 Nzeri 2019 nibwo itsinda rya mbere ry’ impunzi zo muri Libya u Rwanda rwemeye kwakira zageze ku kibuga mpuzamahanga cya Kigali, abenshi ni abari mu myaka yo gukora.
 Kuri uyu wa 26 Nzeri 2019 nibwo itsinda rya mbere ry’ impunzi zo muri Libya u Rwanda rwemeye kwakira zageze ku kibuga mpuzamahanga cya Kigali, abenshi ni abari mu myaka yo gukora. Izi mpunzi zirimo abahunze ibihugu byabo bashaka kujya I Burayi. Abenshi bakomoka mu bihugu byo mu ihembe ry’ Afurika birimo Somalia, Eritrea na Ethiopia. Barimo abasore n’ inkumi, ababyeyi badafite abagabo n’ imiryango. Aba 66 ni itsinda rya mbere rigeze mu Rwanda muri 500 u Rwanda rwemeye kwakira. Ishami ry’ umuryango w’ abibumbye ryita ku mpunzi UNHCR ryatangaje ko izi mpunzi zigiye kubaho mu mutekano imyaka myinshi nyuma y’ igihe zibayeho mu buzima bugoye. 
 Leta y’ u Rwanda yateguye ko izi mpunzi zizakirirwa ahahoze ari inkambi y’ agateganyo ya Gashora mu Bugesera. Iyi nkambi yakiraga impunzi zaturukaga mu Burundi mbere y’ uko zerekeza I Mahama ubu yamaze gutunganywa hubakwa neza niho izi mpunzi ziva muri Libiya zizatuzwa. Muri uku kwezi Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yasinyanye amasezerano n’umuryango wa Afurika yunze Ubumwe n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku mpunzi, HCR, agamije kwakira impunzi z’abanyafurika 500 zaheze muri Libya aho zibayeho nabi. Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame, ubwo yagezaga ijambo ku bitabiriye Inteko Rusange y’Umuryango w’Abibumbye yavuze, ko kuba u Rwanda rwaremeye kwakira impunzi n’abimukira bo mu gihugu cya Libya ari ikimenyetso cyerekana ko Afurika yifitemo ibisubizo ku bibazo byayo ndetse ubufatanye n’Isi muri rusange bushobora gutanga ibisubizo ku bibazo by’ingutu byugarije Isi muri iki gihe. 
 Yagaragaje ko ubufatanye no kutikanyiza kwa bamwe, byatanga umuti urambye ku bibazo byugarije Isi birimo n’icy’abimukira cyabaye agatereranzamba, aho bamwe muri bo bakomeje kurohama mu mazi magari abandi bagacuruzwa.

label: politics
title: Prof KANYARUKIGA nawe yiyongereye ku rutonde rw’ abasenateri bashya
content:
Abarezi n’ abayobozi mu mashuri makuru na Kaminuza byigenga batoreye Prof Kanyarukiga Ephrem kuba umwe mu basenateri bashya bazinjira muri sena amategeko baturutse muri za Kaminuza n’ amashuri makuru.
 Abarezi n’ abayobozi mu mashuri makuru na Kaminuza byigenga batoreye Prof Kanyarukiga Ephrem kuba umwe mu basenateri bashya bazinjira muri sena amategeko baturutse muri za Kaminuza n’ amashuri makuru. Ni mu matora yabaye kuri uyu wa 18 Nzeri 2019, akurikira ayabaye ku munsi w’ ejo ubwo hatorwaga umusenateri umwe utorwa muri Kaminuza n’ amashuri makuri bya Leta. Prof. Ephrem Kanyarukiga asanzwe ari umwarimu wigisha indimi n’ubuvanganzo muri Kaminuza y’Abadiventisiti yo muri Afurika yo hagati (AUCA: Adventist University of Central Africa). Prof Kanyarukiga yagize amajwi 59,3%, Munyamasoko Cyeze Emmanuel yamuguye mu ntege agira 27.0% naho Nkundabatware Innocent agira 13,7%. Abakandida bahataniraga kujya muri sena batowe na Kaminuza n’ amashuri makuru byigenga bari batatu. Abagombaga gutora bari 664. Umusenateri watowe aturutse muri Kaminuza n’ amashuri makuru bya Leta ni Prof. Niyomugabo Cyprien wari usanzwe ari umuyobozi w’ ishuri ry’ uburezi muri Kaminuza y’ u Rwanda kolegi ya Rukara. Abatsinze amatora bombi icyo bahuriyeho ni uko bari abarimu bigisha Ikinyarwanda muri Kaminuza. 

Prof. Kanyarukiga Ephrem yatsinzwe abo bari bahanganye mu matora

label: politics
title: Rwanda - Uganda: Inama yiga ku ishyirwamubikorwa ry’ amasezerano ya Luanda yatangiye
content:
Intumwa z’u Rwanda n’iz’igihugu cya Uganda zitabiriye ibiganiro bya mbere ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano ya Luanda agamije kuzahura umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi.
 Intumwa z’u Rwanda n’iz’igihugu cya Uganda zitabiriye ibiganiro bya mbere ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’amasezerano ya Luanda agamije kuzahura umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi. Iyi nama iri kubera ku kicaro cya Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga n’ubutwererane y’u Rwanda. Ni ibiganiro biteganyijwe n’amasezerano y’ubwumvikane  yashyizweho umukono na ba Perezida Paul Kagame,  Ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda na Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, ku ruhande rwa Uganda muri Kanama 2019 muri Angola. Muri ibi biganiro u Rwanda ruhagarariwe n’Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Amb. Olivier Nduhungire naho Uganda ihagarariwe na Minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga Sam Kutesa. Abandi bayobozi bahagarariye u Rwanda muri ibi biganiro ni Minisitiri w’Ubutabera akaba n’Intumwa Nkuru ya Leta, Johnston Busingye na Minisitiri w’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu Prof. Shyaka Anastase. 



Ba Minisitiri bahagarariye Uganda muri ibi biganiro barimo Sam Kutesa 

Ba Minisitiri bahagarariye u Rwanda muri ibi biganiro Ku ruhande rw’ibihugu by’ibihuza kandi, ibi biganiro byitabiriwe na Minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga wa Angola Hon. Manuel Domingos Augusto ndetse na Minisitiri w’Intebe wungirije wa DRC, Gilbert Kankonde Malamba. Biteganyijwe nyuma yo gutangiza ibi biganiro ku mugaragaro, ababiteraniyemo baza kuganira mu muhezo mbere yuko abakuriye intumwa z’u Rwanda na Uganda bagirana ikiganiro n’abanyamakuru ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Mbere. Mu kwezi gushize kwa 8 nibwo u Rwanda na Uganda byasinyanye amasezerano yo kuzahura umubano hagati y’ ibihugu byombi.

title: Dr Ngirente ahagarariye u Rwanda mu muhango wo gusezera kuri Mugabe
content:
Abaperezida n’ abanyacyubahiro batandukanye batangiye kugera I Harare muri Zimbabwe mu muhango wo kunamira Robert Mugabe wahoze ari Perezida w’ iki gihugu uherutse gupfa.
 Abaperezida n’ abanyacyubahiro batandukanye batangiye kugera I Harare muri Zimbabwe mu muhango wo kunamira Robert Mugabe wahoze ari Perezida w’ iki gihugu uherutse gupfa. Mu baperezida barenga 10 bategerejwe muri uyu muhango wo gusezera kuri Robert Mugabe bamwe bafata nk’ intwari y’ Afurika, ntabwo harimo Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame. Robert Mugabe yapfuye tariki 6 Nzeri 2019, abaperezida batandukanye barimo Kenyatta wa Kenya, na Magufuli wa Tanzania banyujije ubutumwa ku rubuga rwa Twitter yagaragaza ko Afurika ibuze umuntu ukomeye. U Rwanda rurahagararirwa na Minisitiri w’ Intebe Mu butumwa , Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’ ububanyi n’ amahanga ushinzwe Afurika y’ Iburasirazuba yashyize kuri Twitter yavuze ko u Rwanda ruhagararirwa na Minisitiri w’ Intebe Edouard Ngirente mu muhango wo gusezera bwa nyuma kuri Mugabe. Yagize ati “Uyu munsi ndaba ndi I Harare mu kiriyo cya Robert Mugabe wahoze ari Perezida wa Zimbabwe watabarutse tariki 6 Nzeri 2019. Ndaherekeza nyakubahwa Minisitiri w’ Intebe Edouard Ngirente uhagararira guverinoma y’ u Rwanda muri uyu muhango”. 

Abo mu muryango wa Robert Mugabe Abakuru b’ ibihugu bategerejwe muri Zimbabwe mu muhango wo gusezera kuri Robert Mugabe harimo Nana Akufo Addo wa Ghana, Edgar Lungu wa Zambia, King Letsie wa Lesotho, Peter Mutharika wa Malawi, Idriss Deby wa Tchad, Masisi wa Botswana, Xi Jiping w’ u Bushinwa, Filipe Nyusi wa Mozambique, Minisitiri w’ Intebe w’ u Buhinde Narendra Modi, Felix Tshisekedi wa RDC n’ uwo yasimbuye Joseph Kabila, Denis Sassou Nguesso wa Congo Brazaville, Abandi barimo Magufuli wa Tanzania n’ abo yasimbuye Kikwete na Mkapa, Paul Biya wa Cameroun, Salva Kiir wa Sudan y’ Epfo, Alexandre Lukashenko, Uhuru Kenyatta wa Kenya, Alassane Ouattra wa Cote d’ Ivoire, Yoweri Museveni wa Uganda, Halimah Jacob wa Singapore, Raul Castro wahoze ari Perezida wa Cuba, George Weah wa Liberia na Ellen Johnson Serlef yasimbuye. Umurambo wa Robert Mugabe wageze muri Zimbabwe ku wa Gatatu ukuwe muri Singapore aho yapfiriye. Ku wa Kane umuryango we watangaje ko azashyingurwa ku ivuko ariko kuri uyu wa Gatanu umuvugizi w’ umuryango Leo Mugabe yisubuyeho avuga ko Robert Mugabe azashyingurwa mu irimbi ry’ intwari. Leo Mugabe yavuze ko abahagarariye umuryango wa Mugabe na guverinoma basuye aho Mugabe azashyingurwa bagasanga kuhategura bizatwara iminsi 30.

label: politics
title: Rubavu: Impanuka y’ ikamyo yahitanye umukozi wa RIB
content:
Umukozi w’ urwego rw’ igihugu rw’ ubugenzacyaha RIB wakoreraga mu karere ka Rubavu mu murenge wa Gisenyi yagonzwe n’ ikamyo mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 2 Ukwakira 2019 ahita yitaba Imana.
 Umukozi w’ urwego rw’ igihugu rw’ ubugenzacyaha RIB wakoreraga mu karere ka Rubavu mu murenge wa Gisenyi yagonzwe n’ ikamyo mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 2 Ukwakira 2019 ahita yitaba Imana. Iyi mpanuka yabereye mu Mudugudu wa Gikarani, Akagari ka Nengo mu Murenge wa Gisenyi. Vedaste Uwimana, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’ Umurenge wa Gisenyi wageze aho iyi mpanuka yabereye yabwiye UKWEZI ko impanuka ikimara kuba umurambo wa nyakwigendera Mugunga Yves wahise ujyanwa ku bitaro bya Gisenyi. Yagize ati “Iyo mpanuka yabereye mu murenge wa Gisenyi hafi y’ ibitaro. Nagezeyo aho yabereye. Uriya muntu umwe niwe yahitanye”. Ababonye iyi mpanuka bavuga ko ikamyo yabuze feri yamanukaga iri inyuma y’ uyu mukozi wa RIB ihita imuca hejuru. Umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda muri Polisi y’u Rwanda Commissioner of Police(CP) Rafiki Mujiji yatangaje ko iyi mpanuka yatewe n’ ikibazo cy’ umwuka kuko amakamyo akoresha feri zikoresha umwuka. Mbabazi Modeste, umuvugizi w’ urwego rw’ igihugu rw’ ubugenzacyaha RIB yemeje ko nyakwigendera yari umukozi wa RIB.

label: politics
title: Rwanda Day ya 2019 isigaje iminsi ibarirwa ku ntoki
content:
Rwanda Day yari iteganyijwe kubera mu Budage igasubikwa, nyuma ikimurirwa ku wa Gatandatu tariki 5 Ukwakira 2019 isigaje iminsi 6.
 Rwanda Day yari iteganyijwe kubera mu Budage igasubikwa, nyuma ikimurirwa ku wa Gatandatu tariki 5 Ukwakira 2019 isigaje iminsi 6. Iyi Rwanda Day yagombaga kuba yarabaye tariki 24 Kanama 2019, isubikwa tariki 14 Kanama hasigaye iminsi 10 ngo ibe. Icyo gihe isubikwa Minisiteri y’ ububanyi n’ amahanga yatangaje ko igihe yimuriwe kizatangazwa nyuma. Hashize iminsi mike isubitswe nibwo Ambasade y’ u Rwanda mu Budage yatangaje ko yimuriwe tariki 5 Ukwakira 2019. Rwanda Day yatangiye bwa mbere mu Bubiligi mu myaka 9 ishize. Rwanda Day ni umunsi uhuza Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bahurira hamwe bakaganira n’umukuru w’igihugu ku iterambere ry’u Rwanda, muri 2011 wabereye i Paris mu Bufaransa, muri 2012 i Boston muri USA, muri 2013 i Toronto naho muri 2014 ibera i Atlanta n’i Dallas muri 2015 ubera mu Buholandi. Muri 2016 Rwanda Day yabereye i San Francisco uri USA naho muri 2017 ibera i Brussels mu Bubiligi.

Rwanda Day ni umunsi uhuza Abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bahurira hamwe bakaganira n’umukuru w’igihugu ku iterambere ry’u Rwanda, muri 2011 wabereye i Paris mu Bufaransa, muri 2012 i Boston muri USA, muri 2013 i Toronto naho muri 2014 ibera i Atlanta n’i Dallas muri 2015 ubera mu Buholandi. Muri 2016 Rwanda Day yabereye i San Francisco uri USA naho muri 2017 ibera i Brussels mu Bubiligi.

title: Mureshyankwano ku rutonde rw’ Abasenateri batorewe kuzahagararira Intara n’ umujyi wa Kigali
content:
Abasenateri 12 batorwa mu Ntara n’ umujyi wa Kigali bazajya mu Inteko ishingamategeko umutwe wa Sena bamaze kumenyekana. Barimo Mureshyankwano Marie Rose wahoze ari Umuyobozi w’ Intara y’ Amagepfo ndetse wigeze no kuba Umuyobozi wa Komisiyo y’ Abadepite bashinzwe imibereho myiza y’ Abaturage
 Abasenateri 12 batorwa mu Ntara n’ umujyi wa Kigali bazajya mu Inteko ishingamategeko umutwe wa Sena bamaze kumenyekana. Barimo Mureshyankwano Marie Rose wahoze ari Umuyobozi w’ Intara y’ Amagepfo ndetse wigeze no kuba Umuyobozi wa Komisiyo y’ Abadepite bashinzwe imibereho myiza y’ Abaturage Mu ntara y’ Iburengerazuba hatowe  BIDERI John Bonds, NSENGIYUMVA Fulgence na MUPENZI Georges. Mu ntara y’ amagepfo hatowe UMUHIRE Adrie ari we urushije abandi akurikirwa na NKURUNZIZA Innocent na UWERA Pelagie. Mu ntara y’ Iburengerazuba hatowe MURESHYANKWANO Marie Rose wahoze ari guverineri w’ intara y’ amagepfo, HAVUGIMANA Emmanuel na DUSHIMINANA Lambert. Mu ntara y’ amajyaruguru hatowe Dr NYINAWAMWIZA Laetitia na Dr HABINEZA Faustin. Mu mujyi wa Kigali hatowe Ntidendereza William wagize amajwi 60% atsinda Mutimura Zeno wahoze ari umudepite mu nteko ishinga amategeko y’ u Rwanda. Mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru hatorwa abasenateri 2, Intara y’Amajyepfo, iy’Iburasirazuba n’iy’Iburengerazuba hagatorwa batatu batatu mu gihe mu Mujyi wa Kigali hatorwa umusenateri 1. Umubare w’abasenateri muri buri ntara, ukaba waragenywe hashingiwe ku mubare w’abaturage bayigize.

title: Minisitiri Shyaka ati ‘Nta gikuba cyacitse’, abaturage bati ‘Ntibyumvikana ukuntu ba meya begurira rimwe’
content:
Inkubiri yo kwegura kw’ abayobozi b’ uturere n’ ababungirije yakuruye ikiganiro kiganjemo impaka nyuma y’ uko Minisitiri w’ ubutegetsi bw’ igihugu Prof Shyaka Anastase avuze ko nta gikuba cyacitse.
 Inkubiri yo kwegura kw’ abayobozi b’ uturere n’ ababungirije yakuruye ikiganiro kiganjemo impaka nyuma y’ uko Minisitiri w’ ubutegetsi bw’ igihugu Prof Shyaka Anastase avuze ko nta gikuba cyacitse. Kuva mu gitondo cy’ ejo tariki 3 Nzeri 2019, abayobozi b’ uturere biganjemo ba Meya na Visi Meya bari kwegura umusubirizo abandi bakeguzwa. Mu butumwa Minisitiri Shyaka yashyize kuri Twitter yavuze ko nta gikuba cyacitse ati “ Nta gikuba cyacitse! Ibi ni ibisanzwe mu gihugu nk’ u Rwanda, cyimakaza imiyoborere myiza, ishingiye ku buyobozi n’ ubushobozi byegerejwe abaturage, irangwa na demokarasi kandi ishyira imbere inyungu z’ umuturage n’iterambere ry’igihugu.  DukomezeImihigo”. Yakomeje avuga ko 2019 ari umwaka wa nyuma ushyira Icyerekezo2020. Ndetse ko ari umwaka uganisha hafi muri 1/2 cy’ Icyerekezo cya gahunda ya guverinoma y’ imyaka 7 NST2024. Ati “Nta gihe cyo gutakaza! Buri Karere gafite inyota  y’ubuyobozi bwiza, bukora neza, butuma bagera ku mibereho myiza y’abaturage n’ iterambere bifuza” Yongeyeho ati “Uyu munsi mu Nzego z’Ibanze: Bamwe mu bayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze barasaba Njyanama kwegura cyangwa Njyanama ikabeguza nk’uko biteganwa n’amategeko. Ibi byatewe n’ imikorere yabo itari myiza no kutageza ku baturage ibyo babemereye”. Nubwo Minisitiri Shyaka avuga ko nta gikuba cyacitse hari abasanga igikuba cyacitse kuko abayobozi b’ uturere begurijwe rimwe bakibaza impamvu Njyanama z’ uturere zegurije rimwe abayobozi.  


 Ku rundi ruhande ariko hari bamwe mu baturage bashyigikiye ko abayobozi begura igihe badashoboye guhigura ibyo bahize batitaye uko kubeguzwa byakorwamo. 
Bamwe mu baturage basanga kweguza abayobozi bidakwiye gukorerwa umunsi umwe ko ahubwo igihe umuyobozi agaraariyeho ikosa akwiye guhita yeguzwa. 
 Bamwe mu baturage basanga kweguza abayobozi bidakwiye gukorerwa umunsi umwe ko ahubwo igihe umuyobozi agaraariyeho ikosa akwiye guhita yeguzwa.

label: politics
title: Perezida Museveni yakomoje ku bikubije mu masezerano u Rwanda rwasinyanye na Uganda
content:
Perezida wa Uganda Yoweli Kaguta Museveni yavuze muri make ibikubiye mu masezerano y’ ubufatanye u Rwanda rwasinyanye na Uganda kuri uyu wa 21 Kanama 2019 avuga ko Uganda yiyemeje kuzayashyira mu bikorwa.
 Perezida wa Uganda Yoweli Kaguta Museveni yavuze muri make ibikubiye mu masezerano y’ ubufatanye u Rwanda rwasinyanye na Uganda kuri uyu wa 21 Kanama 2019 avuga ko Uganda yiyemeje kuzayashyira mu bikorwa. Aya masezerano yashyiriweho umukono I Luanda muri Angola nyuma y’ inama yahuje abakuru b’ ibihugu bitanu byo mu karere u Rwanda ruherereyemo aribyo : U Rwanda, Uganda, Angola, RDC na Congo Brazzaville. Mu butumwa Perezida Museveni yashyize kuri Twitter nyuma yo gusinya aya masezerano yavuze ibyo aya masezerano azakemura. Yagize ati “Twemeranyije ku bigiye gushyirwa mu bikorwa mu rwego rwo guteza imbere umutekano, ubucuruzi, umubano ushingiye kuri politiki. Uganda yiyemeje gushyira mu bikorwa aya masezerano” Yakomeje agira ati “Ndashimira Perezida  Joao Lourenco wa Angola na Felix Tshisekedi wa DR Congo ku bwo gukurikiranira hafi itegurwa ry’ aya masezerano. Ndashimira na His Excellency Dennis Sassou Nguesso wakurikiranye isinywa ry’ aya masezerano nk’ umuyobozi wa International Conference on the Great Lakes Region.”. 
 Amasezerano yashyizweho umukono asaba impande zombi guhagarika ibikorwa bihungabanga urundi ruhande haba mu bukungu n’ umutekano. Aya masezerano kandi ahamagarira ibihugu byombi kubahiriza uburenganzira n’ ubwisanzure bw’ abaturage b’ ikindi gihugu batuye cyangwa batemberera muri icyo gihugu. Ibihugu byombi byitezweho kurekura urujya n’ uruza rw’ abantu n’ ibicuruzwa ku mipaka ihuza u Rwanda na Uganda.

label: politics
title: Perezida Kagame yagaragaje ikihishe inyuma yo kuba FT yatangaje ko u Rwanda rwatekinitse imibare y’ ubukungu
content:
Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame yagaragaje ko ibyo inkuru icukumbuye ya Financial Times ivuga ko ‘u Rwanda rwatekinitse imibare muri 2015 rukagaragaza ko ubukene bwagabanutse’  ibyo ivuga atari ukuri, agaragaza ikibyihishe inyuma ari icyengezamatwara ry’ Uburayi n’ Amerika.
 Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame yagaragaje ko ibyo inkuru icukumbuye ya Financial Times ivuga ko ‘u Rwanda rwatekinitse imibare muri 2015 rukagaragaza ko ubukene bwagabanutse’  ibyo ivuga atari ukuri, agaragaza ikibyihishe inyuma ari icyengezamatwara ry’ Uburayi n’ Amerika. Iyi nkuru icumbuye yatangajwe kuri uyu wa Kabili tariki 13 Kanama 2019. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’ urubyiruko kuri wa 14 Kanama yanyomoje ibivugwa muri iyo nkuru. Perezida Kagame yavuze ko iyi nkuru ya FT itangajwe mu gihe hashize icyumweru kimwe hatangazwa inkuru zivuga ko u Rwanda ruri gutera imbere. Ati "Hari izindi nkuru zishingiye kuri za gihamya zaba izo muri Banki y’ Isi, IMF, iza World Economic Forum zibara inkuru itandukanye n’ iya (FT)". Umukuru w’ igihugu yavuze ko iyi nkuru ikiyihishe inyuma ari propaganda y’ Abanyaburayi kandi ari urugamba yiteguye kurwana. Perezida Kagame yasabye abanyarwanda kumufasha kurwanya iyi propaganda kuko ari urugamba rw’ abo Abanyarwanda aribo n’ abo bashaka kubabo. Yagize ati “Bamwe muri aba bantu ntaburenganzira bafite bwo kudusuzugura. Niba dushaka kubaka u Rwanda twifuza ntabwo bagomba kuza ngo batubwire ngo iki ntikibabereye iki nicyo kibabereye”. Avuga ko abantu bagomba kugira ibitekerezo bitandukanye ariko ko nta we ukwiye gutegeka Abanyarwanda icyo bakwiye gukora. Yakomeje agira ati “Ntabwo dushaka kuba aho abandi bashaka ko tuba. Uburezi muhabwa bwakabayeyo bubaremamo uwo mutima. Mukwiye kwibaza impamvu ibihugu u Rwanda , Afurika biri ahantu byari biri mu myaka myinshi ibindi bihugu byari munsi bikaza bikabicaho bikabisiga”. Umuntu ugukandagira akaba ari wowe uvuga sorry bigaragara nk’ aho ari gusaba ko akomeza kugukandagira. Minisitiri w’ Urubyiruko Mbabazi Rose Mary yasabye urubyiruko gukunda igihugu bitari mu magambo gusa nk’ uko byagaragajwe n’ umusore witwa Nizigiyimana Emmanuel wo mu Karere ka Karongi wahanzwe umuhanda wenyine. Mu kiganiro ku ruhare rw’ ikoranabuhanga umuyobozi wa Irembo yavuze ko iyi gahunda yo gusabira ibyangombwa yorohereje abaturage kuko abaturage basiragiraga mu buyobozi basaba ibyangombwa ubu bimwe muri ibi byangombwa bikaba bishobora kuboneka mu masaha ane gusa umuntu atavuye aho ari.

label: politics
title: Akarere ka Gasabo katangiye gukorera muri etage nshya bamwe bayobera aho kahoze
content:
Kuri uyu wa Kabili tariki 13 Kanama 2019 , ibiro by’ akarere ka Gasabo byimukiye mu nzu y’ amagorofa atandatu iherereye ku Gishushu mu murenge wa Remera, bamwe bayobera ahahoze ibiro by’ akarere ka Gasabo basanga nta bakozi n’ abayobozi bahari.
 Kuri uyu wa Kabili tariki 13 Kanama 2019 , ibiro by’ akarere ka Gasabo byimukiye mu nzu y’ amagorofa atandatu iherereye ku Gishushu mu murenge wa Remera, bamwe bayobera ahahoze ibiro by’ akarere ka Gasabo basanga nta bakozi n’ abayobozi bahari. Akarere ka Gasabo kari kamaze imyaka myinshi gakorera mu nzu y’ igorofa iherereye hafi y’ ambasade y’ Abanyamerika mu murenge wa Kacyiru. Kuri uyu wa Kabili hari abakeneye serivise ku biro by’ akarere ka Gasabo bajya kuri iyo nzu iherereye hafi y’ ambasade y’ Abanyamerika basanga imiryango irakinze. Barimo umugabo wari wagiye ku biro by’ akarere ka Gasabo gusinyisha dosiye bamusaba ko yazasubirayo kuri uyu wa 13 Kanama ariko ntibibuka kumubwira ko bazaba bimukiye mu nzu nshya. Uyu mugabo yabwiye RBA ko kuba yageze kuri iyi nzu akarere ka Gasabo kakoreragamo agasanga harakinze ari igihombo kuri we kuko byatumye akoresha amafaranga atari yateganyije gukoresha akanatakaza n’ umwanya. Yagize ati “Nsanze ibiro bitarimo umuyobozi n’ umwe. Njye ntabwo bigeze babimenyesha, ibyo ari byose niba bari bafite na gahunda yo kwimuka bari kumbwira bati ku wa Kabili tuzaba twimuye ibiro”. Yakomeje agira ati “Ibi biratwangiriza umwanya kubera ko umuntu aba afite byinshi akora, n’ amatike ya hato na hato umuntu aba atateganyije ugasanga rero biraguhombya aho kugira ngo bikungure”. Kuri iyi nyubako yahoze ikorerwamo n’ akarere ka Gasabo abahageze kuri uyu wa Kabili bavuga ko nta tangazo rihari rigaragara ko ibiro by’ akarere byimukiye ku Gishushu. Inzu iri ku Gishushu akarere ka Gasabo katangiye gukoreramo ni nini ugereranyije n’ aho kari gasanzwe gakorera. Raymond Chrétien Mberabahizi, Umuyobozi wungirije w’ akarere ka Gasabo yavuze ko muri iyi nzu nshya batangiye gukoreramo bazatanga serivise nziza kurushaho kuko hari interinete yihuta cyane. Avuga ko iyi interinete izatuma gutanga serivise byihuta cyane bikongera no gukorera mu mucyo. Iyi nzu nshya y’ akarere ka Gasabo ifite ibyumba byinshi birimo icyumba cy’ inama gifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira abantu barenga 500, ikagira parikingi ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira imodoka 260. Izakorerwamo n’ abakozi b’ ikigo gishinzwe kwegereza iterambere abaturage LODA n’ abakozi n’ abayobozi b’ akarere ka Gasabo.

title: ‘Ntabwo nabaye umubyeyi mubi’ Perezida Kagame avuga uko yitaye ku bana b’ ingagi yise izina
content:
Perezida Kagame yasabye abaturage ba Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo, Uganda n’ u Rwanda baturiye pariki y’ Ibirunga uruhare rwabo mu kwita ku ngagi zo muri iyi pariki kugira ngo amafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo bwo gusura izi ngagi akomeze gufasha aba baturage mu iterambere.
 Perezida Kagame yasabye abaturage ba Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo, Uganda n’ u Rwanda baturiye pariki y’ Ibirunga uruhare rwabo mu kwita ku ngagi zo muri iyi pariki kugira ngo amafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo bwo gusura izi ngagi akomeze gufasha aba baturage mu iterambere. Yabivugiye mu muhango wo kwita izina abana 25 b’ ingagi wabereye mu karere ka Musanze mu majyaruguru y’ u Rwanda kuri uyu wa 6 Nzeri 2019. Muri uyu muhango ubaye ku nshuro ya 15, Perezida Kagame yavuze ko mu myaka 15 ishize we ubwe yise izina abana b’ ingagi b’ impanga kandi ko yakomeje kubitaho, ndetse umwe muri bo akaba ari umutware w’ umuryango. Yagize ati “Mu myaka 15 ishize nagize amahirwe ubwanjye yo kwita izina abana b’ ingabi b’ impanga. Nk’ uko mwabyumvise ntabwo nabaye umubyeyi mubi, nabiseho, nishyuye amafaranga y’ ishuri kandi ku gihe. Nakoze uko nshoboye kandi byarashobokaga ko dutumanaho kuko muri aka gace hari internete na WIFI. Umwe muri abo bana yabaye ingenzi mu muryango Sliverback , izina ry’ iyo Silverback ni Ibyishimo” Mu minsi ishize Leta y’ u Rwanda yahaye bamwe baturage b’ akarere ka Musanze, Nyabihu na Rubavu inka 720 mu rwego rwo kubashimira uruhare bagira mu kubungabunga pariki y’ ibirunga no kubafasha kwiteza imbere. Perezida Kagame yibukije abaturage baturiye za Pariki ko 10 by’ amafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo akoreshwa mu bikorwa bibateza imbere. Umukuru w’ igihugu yasabye abaturage ubufatanye mu kwita kuri za pariki avuga ko buzatuma u Rwanda rugira inshuti nyinshi. Perezida Kagame yashimiye abise ingagi amazina kuri uyu munsi anashimira abarinda Pariki y’ Ibirunga ndetse n’ Ikigo cy’ Igihugu cy’ Iterambere RDB kireberera za pariki zo mu Rwanda. Abise amazina abana b’ ingagi uyu munsi barimo umusore wo mu karere ka Karongi wahanze umuhanda wa km7, yise umwana w’ ingani ‘Nimugwire’. 

Meddy Meddy nawe ni umwe mu bantu 25 bise amazina abana b’ ingagi uwo yise akaba yamwise ‘Inkoramutima’. Uyu muhanzi w’ Umunyarwanda ariko ubarizwa muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika afite indirimbo yakunzwe cyane yitwa ‘Inkoramutima’. Umuhanzi w’ Umunyamerika NEYO nawe ni umwe mu bise izina abana b’ ingagi akaba uwe akaba yamwise ‘Biracyaza’ 


 Niringiyimana Emmanuel wahanze umuhanda wa km 7 nawe yise izina 





Umuhanzi wo muri Amerika NEYO yifatanyije n’ Abanyarwanda mu muhango wo kwita izina abana b’ ingagi

label: politics
title: Rubavu: Ba Visi Meya bombi banditse basaba kwegura
content:
Abayobozi bungirije b’ Akarere ka Rubavu kuri uyu wa Kabili baraye bandikiye Inama Njyanama y’ Akarere basaba kwegura kuri iyi myanya y’ ubuyobozi.
 Abayobozi bungirije b’ Akarere ka Rubavu kuri uyu wa Kabili baraye bandikiye Inama Njyanama y’ Akarere basaba kwegura kuri iyi myanya y’ ubuyobozi. Abeguye ni Murenzi Janvier wari Umuyobozi w’ Akarere ka Rubavu ushinzwe iterambere ry’ ubukungu na Uwampayizina Marie Grace wari Umuyobozi w’ Akarere ashinzwe Imibereho Myiza y’ Abaturage. Perezida w’ inama Njyanama y’ akarere ka Rubavu yatumije inama ya njyanama idasanzwe yo kwiga ku bwegure bw’ aba ba visi meya babiri. Iyo nama iraba saa tanu z’ amanywa kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 4 Nzeri 2019. Mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kabili tariki  3 Nzeri nibwo abayobozi ba mbere b’ akarere beguye kuva Prof Shyaka Anastase yaba Minisitiri w’ ubutegetsi bw’ igihugu. Kugeza ubu uturere dufite abayobozi bamaze kwegura ni Karongi Nyobozi yose, Ngororero ba Visi Meya bombi, Musanze Nyobozi yose, Burera Visi Meya umwe, Muhanga Meya Uwamariya Beatrice yanditse asaba kwegura, Gisagara  Hanganimana Jean Paul wari Visi Meya ushinzwe ubukungu yeguye.

label: politics
title: Rwanda Revenue Authority yasabye imbabazi umuturage waciwe amafaranga kuko atazi gusoma
content:
Ikigo cy’ Igihugu cy’ Imisoro n’ amahoro Rwanda Revenue Authority cyasabye imbabazi umuturage witwa Nsabimana Dominique waciwe amafaranga y’ uko atazi gusoma.
 Ikigo cy’ Igihugu cy’ Imisoro n’ amahoro Rwanda Revenue Authority cyasabye imbabazi umuturage witwa Nsabimana Dominique waciwe amafaranga y’ uko atazi gusoma. Kuri uyu wa 12 Kanama 2019 nibwo ku rubuga rwa Twitter hagaragara imyemezabwishyu yatanzwe na RRA ivuga ko uwitwa Nsabimana Dominique yishyuye amafaranga ibihumbi 2 yaciwe kuko atazi gusoma. Mu butumwa RRA yashyize ku rubuga rwa Twitter yavuze ko uyu muturage yamaze gusubizwa amafaranga ye kuko ayo mande ntaho ateganyijwe mu itegeko. “Turisegura kuri Bwana NSABIMANA Dominique waciwe amafaranga yiswe ayo kutamenya gusoma kuko ntaho ateganijwe mu itegeko. Ubu yamaze gusubizwa amafaranga ye, nyuma yuko RRA n’ akarere ka Rusizi basuzumye imiterere y’iki kibazo. Abakozi babikoze nabo barimo gukurikiranwa”. Kayumba Ephrema, Umuyobozi w’ akarere ka Rusizi yabwiye Radio Isangano ko iki kibazo cyabaye kuri uyu muturage wenyine kuko bitakorewe mu mukwabu . Ati “Ni uriya wenyine byabayeho, kuko ntabwo ari umukwabu wabaye ngo bajye gufata abantu batazi gusoma no kwandika, ahubwo bamufatanyije yari aje gusaba service, bamusabye gusoma urutonde rw’ibisabwa ntiyabasha kurusoma, bahita bamenya ko atazi gusoma no kwandika, bamubaza impamvu atagiye mu isomero ry’abakuze, kuko nta gisubizo yari afite bahita bamuca amande”. 

Nsabimana Dominique wo mu murenge wa Nyakarenzo yaciwe 2000 frw kuko atazi gusoma Ikigo cy’ Igihugu cy’ imisoro n’ amahoro ni cyo kigo gihigura ibyo cyahize ku kigero kirenze 100%.

label: politics
title: ‘Abagiye muri Nyungwe guhungabanya umutekano barakosowe’ Minisitiri Busingye
content:
Minisitiri w’ Ubutabera akaba n’ intumwa Nkuru ya Leta Johnston Busingye yabwiye yavuze ko ikibazo cy’ inyeshyamba zashatse guhungabanya umutekano w’ u Rwanda, u Rwanda rwakirangije yizeza Abanyarwanda ko ntawe ushobora guhungabanya umutekano w’ u Rwanda ngo abigereho aho yaturuka hose.
 Minisitiri w’ Ubutabera akaba n’ intumwa Nkuru ya Leta Johnston Busingye yabwiye yavuze ko ikibazo cy’ inyeshyamba zashatse guhungabanya umutekano w’ u Rwanda, u Rwanda rwakirangije yizeza Abanyarwanda ko ntawe ushobora guhungabanya umutekano w’ u Rwanda ngo abigereho aho yaturuka hose. Yabitangarije mu karere ka Nyaruguru kuri uyu wa 27 Nyakanga 2019, nyuma yo kwifatanya n’ abaturage b’ aka karere mu muganda rusange. Yagize ati “Ejobundi rero mwumvise ko hari abantu babuze icyo gukora, bakagerageza kujya muri Nyungwe guhungabanya umutekano w’ igihugu cyacu. Babuze icyo gukora nk’ uko waba uri aho gusa wabuze amafaranga y’ urwagwa ukavuga uti reka ntangire ndwane. Ntabwo ari uko nguko bigenda. Babigenje nabi barakosorwa nyine, ababishinzwe barabakosora, umutekano wanyu ntacyo wabaye ntacyo wahungabanyeho”. Majoro Callixte Sankara wigambaga ibitero byo muri Nyungwe byakorwaga n’ umutwe w’ inyeshyamba za FLN yatawe muri yombi. Kuva yatwabwa muri yombi nta gitero kirongera kugabwa mu Rwanda. Uyu mugabo ubusanzwe witwa Nsabimana Callixte tariki 23 Gicurasi 2019 yemeye ibyaha byose aregwa anabisabira imbabazi. Minisitiri Busingye yabwiye abaturage ba Nyaruguru ko bagomba kwigira mu makoperative bagakora imirimo ibateza imbere kuko umutekano ucunzwe neza. Ati “Uvuga ngo ashaka guhungabanya umutekano yaturuka mu kirere, yaturuka mu ishyamba, yaturuka mu mazi, yaturuka munsi y’ ubutaka azamuka, ntabwo bizakunda. Murye muryame, musinzire”. 

Minisitiri Busingye Johnston yifatanyije n’ abaturage ba Nyaruguru mu muganda wo gusiziriza no kubakira babiri badafite aho kuba Uyu muganda ubaye mu gihe muri Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo hakomeje kugaragara icyorezo cya Ebola. Minisitiri Businye na Meya wa Nyaruguru Habitegeko Francois babwiye Abanyarwanda ko bagomba kwirinda kujya ahari icyo cyorezo kugira ngo badakururira u Rwanda akaga. Meya Habitegeko ati “Ebola, ubutumwa twabaha uyu munsi, ni ukwirinda kujya ahavugwa icyo cyorezo. Ntawe ukwiye kujyayo nta mpamvu ifatika. Kugeza ubu tuyumva muri Kongo ariko birashoboka ko hari uwajyayo akaba yazana ako kaga”. Habitegeko yabwiye Abanyarwanda ko Leta y’ u Rwanda yashyizeho ingamba zo gukumira Ebola bityo ngo ntawe ukwiye kwifuza kuba nyirabayazana w’ ako kaga. Mukamugema wo mu murenge wa Ruramba aho uyu muganda rusange wabereye yabwiye UKWEZI ko ikibazo cy’ umutekano muke cyakemutse gusa ngo cyari kibahangayikishije. Yagize ati “Turashimira ubuyobozi bwacu ko ikibazo cy’ umutekano wo muri Nyungwe bagikemuye kuko icyo gihe twari duhangayitse ariko byarakemutse.” Mukamugema abajije kurwara ya Ebola yagize ati “Ebola ntayo nzi, kereka niba ari yarwara y’ ibiheri bita shishikara”. 
 Muri uyu muganda abaturage, abasenateri ndetse na Minisitiri Busingye basijije ikibanza cyo kubakiramo inzu Mukarukundo Feblonie wari umaze imyaka 7 acumbitse ku nshuti ye. 

Mukarukundo Febronie watangiye kubakirwa inzu avuga ko izamufasha kwiteza imbere Mukarukundo yabwiye itangazamakuru ko ashimishijwe no kuba agiye kubakirwa avuga ko namara kubakirwa akabona aho kuba adacumbitse bizamufasha kwiteza imbere. Uyu muganda wasijije ibibanza bibiri unasiga hatangiwe kuzamurwa amazu abiri y’ abaturage babiri barimo na Mukarukundo batari bafite aho kuba. Uretse izi nzu zatangiye kubakwa kandi hanubatswe uturima tw’ igikoni mu rwego rwo guhangana n’ ikibazo cy’ imirire mibi.

Majoro Callixte Sankara wigambaga ibitero byo muri Nyungwe byakorwaga n’ umutwe w’ inyeshyamba za FLN yatawe muri yombi. Kuva yatwabwa muri yombi nta gitero kirongera kugabwa mu Rwanda. Uyu mugabo ubusanzwe witwa Nsabimana Callixte tariki 23 Gicurasi 2019 yemeye ibyaha byose aregwa anabisabira imbabazi. Minisitiri Busingye yabwiye abaturage ba Nyaruguru ko bagomba kwigira mu makoperative bagakora imirimo ibateza imbere kuko umutekano ucunzwe neza. Ati “Uvuga ngo ashaka guhungabanya umutekano yaturuka mu kirere, yaturuka mu ishyamba, yaturuka mu mazi, yaturuka munsi y’ ubutaka azamuka, ntabwo bizakunda. Murye muryame, musinzire”. 

Minisitiri Busingye Johnston yifatanyije n’ abaturage ba Nyaruguru mu muganda wo gusiziriza no kubakira babiri badafite aho kuba Uyu muganda ubaye mu gihe muri Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo hakomeje kugaragara icyorezo cya Ebola. Minisitiri Businye na Meya wa Nyaruguru Habitegeko Francois babwiye Abanyarwanda ko bagomba kwirinda kujya ahari icyo cyorezo kugira ngo badakururira u Rwanda akaga. Meya Habitegeko ati “Ebola, ubutumwa twabaha uyu munsi, ni ukwirinda kujya ahavugwa icyo cyorezo. Ntawe ukwiye kujyayo nta mpamvu ifatika. Kugeza ubu tuyumva muri Kongo ariko birashoboka ko hari uwajyayo akaba yazana ako kaga”. Habitegeko yabwiye Abanyarwanda ko Leta y’ u Rwanda yashyizeho ingamba zo gukumira Ebola bityo ngo ntawe ukwiye kwifuza kuba nyirabayazana w’ ako kaga. Mukamugema wo mu murenge wa Ruramba aho uyu muganda rusange wabereye yabwiye UKWEZI ko ikibazo cy’ umutekano muke cyakemutse gusa ngo cyari kibahangayikishije. Yagize ati “Turashimira ubuyobozi bwacu ko ikibazo cy’ umutekano wo muri Nyungwe bagikemuye kuko icyo gihe twari duhangayitse ariko byarakemutse.” Mukamugema abajije kurwara ya Ebola yagize ati “Ebola ntayo nzi, kereka niba ari yarwara y’ ibiheri bita shishikara”. 
 Muri uyu muganda abaturage, abasenateri ndetse na Minisitiri Busingye basijije ikibanza cyo kubakiramo inzu Mukarukundo Feblonie wari umaze imyaka 7 acumbitse ku nshuti ye. 

Mukarukundo Febronie watangiye kubakirwa inzu avuga ko izamufasha kwiteza imbere Mukarukundo yabwiye itangazamakuru ko ashimishijwe no kuba agiye kubakirwa avuga ko namara kubakirwa akabona aho kuba adacumbitse bizamufasha kwiteza imbere. Uyu muganda wasijije ibibanza bibiri unasiga hatangiwe kuzamurwa amazu abiri y’ abaturage babiri barimo na Mukarukundo batari bafite aho kuba. Uretse izi nzu zatangiye kubakwa kandi hanubatswe uturima tw’ igikoni mu rwego rwo guhangana n’ ikibazo cy’ imirire mibi.

title: U Rwanda n’ Igisirikare cya Uganda bagize icyo bavuga ku Banyarwanda 40 bafatiwe Uganda
content:
Umuvugizi wa UPDF Richard Karemire
Urwego rw’ Ubutasi rwa Uganda kuri uyu wa 24 Nyakanga 2019 rwafashwe Abanyarwanda 40 rubakuye mu rusengero rwa ADEPR rw’ ahitwa Kibuye mu mujyi wa Kampala.
 Umuvugizi wa UPDF Richard Karemire Urwego rw’ Ubutasi rwa Uganda kuri uyu wa 24 Nyakanga 2019 rwafashwe Abanyarwanda 40 rubakuye mu rusengero rwa ADEPR rw’ ahitwa Kibuye mu mujyi wa Kampala. Umuvugizi w’ Igisirikare cya Uganda Brig Richard Karemire avuga ko abo bantu bafashwe ku munsi w’ ejo aho bari bameze neza muri kasho y’ inzego z’ umutekano, ntabwo yavuze icyo bakurikiranyweho. Yagize ati “Ntabwo nshobora gutanga amakuru arambuye ngo mvuge ubwenegihugu bw’ abakekwa ariko icyo mpamya ni uko bameze neza aho bari muri kasho y’ inzego z’ umutekano kandi iperereza rikomeje”. Brig Richard Karemire abajijwe icyo abo bantu bakurikiranyweho yavuze ko adashaka kubivugaho mu ryo bweruye. Umuvugizi wa Polisi ya Uganda Patrick Onyango yavuze ko nta makuru arambuye afite kuri iki kibazo. Ati “Iyo operasiyo ntabwo tuyizi. Twatanze umusanzu gusa. Niba ushaka amakuru arambuye baza afande Karemire”. Aba Banyarwanda bafashwe nyuma y’ ibyumweru bibiri Perezida Paul Kagame w’ u Rwanda na Kaguta Museveni wa Uganda bahuriye muri Angola mu nama. Abaperezida ba Angola na Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo bakemera gufasha ibi bihugu kongera kubana neza. U Rwanda rusanzwe rushinja Uganda ko ifungiye Abanyarwanda barenga 100 ahantu hatazwi. Muri Gicurasi, Abanyarwanda babiri Ishimwe Bosose na Peter Sanvura bafatiwe mu rusengero rwa Kamwezi mu karere ka Rukiga bakekwaho kuba ba maneko b’ u Rwanda. Ibi nabyo byabaye hashize iminsi ibiri abashinzwe umutekano ku ruhande rw’ u Rwanda barasiye hafi y’ umupaka abantu babiri, Umunyarwanda n’ Umunya-uganda. Kuva muri Gashyantare 2019, Leta y’ u Rwanda yaburiye Abanyarwanda ibabuza kujya muri Uganda kuko umutekano wabo utizewe igihe bariyo. Amb. Olivier Nduhungirehe, Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’ Ububanyi n’ amahanga y’ u Rwanda ushinzwe Afurika y’ Iburasirazuba yabwiye Dail monitor ko iki kibazo cy’ Abanyarwanda 40 bafashwe n’ abashinzwe umutekano wa Uganda , u Rwanda ruri kugikurikirana binyuze muri ambasade yarwo iri Uganda. Iki kinyamakuru kivuga ko mu masaha y’ igicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa 25 Nyakanga cyavugishije High commissioner w’ u Rwanda muri Uganda Frank Mugambage akakibwira ko ahuze. 

Frank Mugambage, High commissioner w’ u Rwanda muri Uganda

label: politics
title: Perezida Kagame n’ Igikomangoma cy’ Ubwongereza bagiranye ibiganiro
content:
Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame, yagiranye ibiganiro n’Igikomangoma cy’Ubwongereza Charles Philip Arthur George, ku myiteguro y’inama y’ibihugu bigize Commonwealth izabera mu Rwanda.
 Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame, yagiranye ibiganiro n’Igikomangoma cy’Ubwongereza Charles Philip Arthur George, ku myiteguro y’inama y’ibihugu bigize Commonwealth izabera mu Rwanda. Iyi nama ya 26 y’ abakuru ba za guverinoma n’ abakuru b’ ibihugu bbigize Commonwealth izabera mu Rwanda muri Kamena 2019. Ibi biganiriro byabereye mu nzu y’iki gikomangoma izwi nka Highgrove House kuri uyu wa 23 Nyakanga 2019. Muri Mata umwaka ushize, u Rwanda rwatorewe kuzakira iyi nama, ifatwa nk’ihenze kurusha izindi zose zihura abakuru b’ibihugu na za Guverinoma. U Rwanda rwatsindiye iyi tike, nyuma yo gutsinda ibihugu nk’Ikirwa cya Pacifique na Fiji, kiba igihugu cya Kabiri muri Afurika cyakiriye iyi nama nyuma ya Uganda yayakiriye mu 2007. Igikomangoma Charles yatangaje ko azitabira iyo nama kugira ngo yirebere ibyiza by’u Rwanda. Yagize ati “Nishimiye ko nzabona umwanya wo kwirebera n’amaso yanjye ubwiza bw’igihugu cyanyu.” Itsinda ry’intumwa zo mu Bwongereza zikora mu biro bishinzwe Umuryango uhuza ibihugu bikoresha Icyongereza (Commonwealth) muri Werurwe uyu mwaka ryashimye aho u Rwanda rugejeje imyiteguro yo kwakira inama ya 26 y’abakuru b’ibihugu na za Guverinoma z’ibihugu bikoresha Icyongereza. U Rwanda rumaze imyaka 10 rubaye umunyamuryango wa Commonwealth , kuko rwinjiye muri uyu muryango tariki 28 Ugushyingo 2009. Uyu muryango uhuza ibihugu bikoresha Icyongereza ugizwe n’ ibihugu 54 bituwe n’ abaturage miliyari 2,4.

label: politics
title: Kongo na Angola byiyemeje gufasha u Rwanda na Uganda gukemura ikibazo bifitanye
content:
Mu nama yahuje abakuru b’ibihugu by’u Rwanda, Uganda, Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo na Angola,  biyemeje gushyigikirana mu bikorwa bigamije gushakira umuti ikibazo cy’amahoro n’umutekano muri ibyo bihugu n’akarere k’ibiyaga bigari muri rusange.
 Mu nama yahuje abakuru b’ibihugu by’u Rwanda, Uganda, Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo na Angola,  biyemeje gushyigikirana mu bikorwa bigamije gushakira umuti ikibazo cy’amahoro n’umutekano muri ibyo bihugu n’akarere k’ibiyaga bigari muri rusange. Kuri uyu wa 12 Nyakanga 2019, nibwo I Luanda mu gihugu cy’ Angola habereye inama yibanze ku kibazo cy’ umutekano mu karere. Iyi nama yahuje aba bakuru b’ibihugu yatumijwe na Perezida wa Angola Jao Laurenco, yitabiriwe na Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame, uwa Uganda Yoweli Museveni, uwa Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo Felix Tshisekedi.
Itangazo ryakurikiye iyi nama rivuga ko ibiganiro by’ aba bakuru b’ ibihugu byibanze ku mahoro n’ umutekano n’ imibanire y’ ibi bihugu uko ari bine. Abakuru b’ ibi bihugu bagaragaje ko bashyigikiye Kongo mu rugamba rwo guhashya inyeshyamba ziba muri Kongo zigahungabanya umutekano wayo n’ uw’ ibihugu by’ abaturanyi. 
 Umwanzuro wa kane ugira uti “Abakuru b’ ibihugu bashimangiye akamaro k’ ibiganiro bihoraho birimo kuvugisha ukuri, bemeza ko byongererwa imbaraga ku rwego rw’ igihugu no ku rwego rw’ akarere hagamijwe gushimangira akamaro k’ amahoro mu bufatanye no mu bukungu”. Umwanzuro wa gatanu uvuga ko abakuru b’ ibi bihugu bashyigikiye kwamagana imitwe iteza umutekano mu karere. Ku kibazo cy’ umubano utifashe neza hagati y’ u Rwanda na Uganda abakuru b’ ibi bihugu bafashe umwanzuro wo gushyigikira ibiganiro hagati yabyo. Umwanzuro wa 10 ugira uti “Hashingiwe ku buryo umubano wifashe hagati y’ u Rwanda na Uganda, Inama ishyigikiye ubushake bw’ impande zombi mu gukomeza gushakira umuti ikibazo gihari. 11. Ni muri urwo rwego iyi nama ishyigikiye ubushake bwa Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo n’ ubwa Angola mu gufasha muri iyo nzira”. Perezida wa Uganda mu butumwa yashyize kuri Twitter nyuma y’ iyi nama yavuze ko Uganda ishyigikiye umugambi wo gushimangira amahoro n’ umutekano mu karere, ndetse ko ashyigikiye gahunda z’ ibihugu zo gushakira ineza ibihugu mu bukungu n’ imibereho myiza binyuze mu kwishyirahamwe. 
 Mu mpera za Gicurasi 2019 nibwo Perezida Laurenco, Tshisekedi na Kagame bemeranyije guhuza imbaraga mu gushakira umuti ikibazo cy’ inyeshyamba. Uyu munsi Perezida Museveni yatangaje ko nawe azatanga umusanzu we mu gushyigikira iyi gahunda yo kurwanya inyeshyamba zihungabanya umutekano w’ akarere. 

Iyi nama yatumijwe na Perezida Laurenco wa Angola

label: politics
title: ‘Nta Munyarwanda wakwifuza gusubira aho twahoze’- Perezida Kagame
content:
Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame avuga ko ibyo u Rwanda rumaze kugeraho nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, byaturutse ku bushake no kwishyira hamwe kw’Abanyarwanda.
 Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame avuga ko ibyo u Rwanda rumaze kugeraho nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, byaturutse ku bushake no kwishyira hamwe kw’Abanyarwanda. Yabitangaje kuri uyu wa 14 Kamena 2019, ubwo yatangizaga ku mugaragaro inama y’ ihuriro Eisenhower Fellowships ibereye muri Afurika ku nshuro ya mbere. Urubyiruko rwitabiriye iyi nama rwabajije Perezida Kagame ibanga u Rwanda rwakoresheje ngo rube ari igihugu gihagaze neza mu myaka 25 ruvuye muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Perezida Kagame ati "Abanyarwanda twabonye ibibi byinshi ku buryo uyu munsi nta munyarwanda wakwifuza gusubira aho twahoze. Ihame ry’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge, gukorera hamwe, no kugira intego imwe yo kuzamura igihugu cyacu nibyo twashyize imbere ngo tube tugeze aho tugeze". Umukuru w’igihugu abajijwe icyatuma umugabane w’Afurika utera imbere, yavuze ko byose bizaturuka kwishyirahamwe no gushora mu rubyiruko Ati "Gukora wenyine nk’igihugu ntacyo wageraho, ibyo ukora byose ubikora wenyine, ariko gukorera hamwe nk’umugabane wa Afurika, niyo nzira nziza yo gutera imbere ku ibihugu byacu. Icyo udafite ukaba uzi neza ko ushobora kukibona mu kindi gihugu”. “Mu rubyiruko niho rero tugomba gushyira imbaraga by’ umwihariko tuzamura ihame ry’ubumenyi bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga ndetse tunashimangira ko urwo rubyiruko rugira ubuzima bwiza." Iyi nama iri kubera ku nshuro ya mbere ku mugabe wa Afurika, ikaba iri kubera mu Rwanda, aho iteraniyemo abagera kuri 200 baturutse hirya no hino ku isi biganjemo urubyiruko rufite ibikorwa byindashikirwa byiganjemo ikoranabuhanga, guhanga imirimo itanga akazi, guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, ubuzima, ubuhinzi n’indi. Ni inama yitiriwe uwahoze ari Perezida wa Leta Zunze Ubumwe z ’Amerika Dwight D.Eisenhower . Muri iyi nama hakomojwe k’ ukuntu umugabane w’Afurika wakwigira ubwabo, Abanyafurika bakagira ukwishyira ukizana mu gutembera ( Free Movement  of People), no ku isoko rusange ku mugabane wa Afurika ( Africa Free Trade Union ). 
 Mu mwaka 1953 nibwo iyi gahunda yiswe Eisenhower Fellowship yatangijwe ni mu gihe mu mwaka wa 2016 aribwo hatoranyijwe ko u Rwanda rwakwinjira muri Eisenhower Fellowships. George de Lama, Perezida wa Eisenhower Fellowships yashimiye umukuru w’igihugu ku ruhare yagize mu kuzahura igihugu cyari cyarasenyutse nyuma ya Jenoside yakorwe Abatutsi muri Mata 1994. Ati "Ni iby’agaciro kuri twese gushimira Abanyarwanda barangajwe imbere na Perezida Paul Kagame kubera intambwe ishimishije u Rwanda rumaze kugeraho”. Yakomeje agira ati “Imibare myinshi dukura mu bitangazwa n’Imiryango Mpuzamahanga nka World Economic Forum itwereka ko u Rwanda rwateye imbere mu kuzamura ubukungu imbere mu gihugu (National GDP), guteza imbere umugore n’umukobwa haba mu kazi no mu burezi ndetse no kuzamura ikoranabuhanga muri servisi zose.” George akomeza avuga ko ahazaza heza h’umugabane w’ Afurika hari mu biganza by’urubyiruko, ni ngombwa ko ibihugu bya Afurika biha urubyiruko amahirwe angana mu burezi, n’ ikoranabuhanga. Rumwe mu rubyiruko ruturutse hirya no hino ku isi rushimira u Rwanda intambwe nziza rwanteye nyuma yaho mu mwaka 25 ishize igihugu cyarimo ubusa. ‘Nta Munyarwanda wakwifuza gusubira aho twahoze’- Perezida Kagame
Perezida w’ u Rwanda Paul Kagame avuga ko ibyo u Rwanda rumaze kugeraho nyuma ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, byaturutse ku bushake no kwishyira hamwe kw’Abanyarwanda.

Yabitangaje kuri uyu wa 14 Kamena 2019, ubwo yatangizaga ku mugaragaro inama y’ ihuriro Eisenhower Fellowships ibereye muri Afurika ku nshuro ya mbere. Urubyiruko rwitabiriye iyi nama rwabajije Perezida Kagame ibanga u Rwanda rwakoresheje ngo rube ari igihugu gihagaze neza mu myaka 25 ruvuye muri Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Perezida Kagame ati "Abanyarwanda twabonye ibibi byinshi ku buryo uyu munsi nta munyarwanda wakwifuza gusubira aho twahoze. Ihame ry’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge, gukorera hamwe, no kugira intego imwe yo kuzamura igihugu cyacu nibyo twashyize imbere ngo tube tugeze aho tugeze". Umukuru w’igihugu abajijwe icyatuma umugabane w’Afurika utera imbere, yavuze ko byose bizaturuka kwishyirahamwe no gushora mu rubyiruko Ati "Gukora wenyine nk’igihugu ntacyo wageraho, ibyo ukora byose ubikora wenyine, ariko gukorera hamwe nk’umugabane wa Afurika, niyo nzira nziza yo gutera imbere ku ibihugu byacu. Icyo udafite ukaba uzi neza ko ushobora kukibona mu kindi gihugu”. “Mu rubyiruko niho rero tugomba gushyira imbaraga by’ umwihariko tuzamura ihame ry’ubumenyi bushingiye ku ikoranabuhanga ndetse tunashimangira ko urwo rubyiruko rugira ubuzima bwiza." Iyi nama iri kubera ku nshuro ya mbere ku mugabe wa Afurika, ikaba iri kubera mu Rwanda, aho iteraniyemo abagera kuri 200 baturutse hirya no hino ku isi biganjemo urubyiruko rufite ibikorwa byindashikirwa byiganjemo ikoranabuhanga, guhanga imirimo itanga akazi, guhangana n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere, ubuzima, ubuhinzi n’indi.
