title: U Rwanda rwafunguye by’ agateganyo umupaka wa Gatuna uruhuza na Uganda
content:
Leta y’ u Rwanda ibinyujije mu kigo RRA yatangaje ko yafunguye by’agateganyo umupaka wa Gatuna na Uganda wari umaze amezi atatu ufunze ku modoka nini zitwara imizigo, bamwe mu Banyarwanda bafite icyizere ko ibicuruzwa byari byarabuze n’ ibyazamuriwe ibiciro bizongera guhenduka.
 Leta y’ u Rwanda ibinyujije mu kigo RRA yatangaje ko yafunguye by’agateganyo umupaka wa Gatuna na Uganda wari umaze amezi atatu ufunze ku modoka nini zitwara imizigo, bamwe mu Banyarwanda bafite icyizere ko ibicuruzwa byari byarabuze n’ ibyazamuriwe ibiciro bizongera guhenduka. Itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara n’ Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Imisoro n’Amahoro (RRA) rivuga ko imodoka nini zemerewe kongera gukoresha umupaka wa Gatuna mu gihe cy’ ibyumweru bibiri. Kuwa 28 Gashyantare nibwo hari hasohotse itangazo risaba imodoka nini gukoresha umuhanda wa Kagitumba mu gihe imirimo yo gutunganya uwa Gatuna yari ikomeje n’ubwo bitakiriwe neza n’abashoferi bavugaga ko kunyura Kagitumba (Mirama hills) ari ukuzenguruka. Leta ya Uganda isanzwe itabanye neza n’ u Rwanda yuririye ku kuba Leta y’ u Rwanda yari yabujije amakamyo, n’ izindi modoka nini kunyura ku mupaka wa Gatuna, ivuga ko u Rwanda rwafunze umupaka uruhuza na Uganda. Leta y’ u Rwanda ivuga ko impamvu yabaye ifunguye by’ agateganyo uyu mupaka ari impamvu z’ igerageza ngo harebwe ko imirimo yo kwagura uyu mupaka yakozwe neza. Itangazo rigira riti, “Ubuyobozi bw’Ikigo cy’Imisoro n’Amahoro buramenyesha abantu bose ko mu rwego korohereza iryo gerageza, amakamyo atwaye imizigo iremereye yemerewe by’agateganyo kwambukiranya umupaka wa Gatuna (OSBP) mu gihe cy’ibyumweru bibiri uhereye tariki ya 10 Kamena 2019 kugeza tariki ya 22 Kamena 2019.” Umuturage wo mu karere ka Huye yabwiye Ikinyamakuru Ukwezi ko kuba uyu mupaka wongeye gufungurwa nubwo ari iby’ agateganyo bitanga icyizere ko ibicuruzwa birimo kawunga y’ ingande na movit y’ umuhondo bigiye kongera kuboneka. Yagize ati “Kuba umupaka wongeye gufungurwa ni ibintu twishimiye cyane, kuko hari ibicuruzwa byari byarabuze , ibindi byarahenze abacuruzi bakatubwira ko biterwa n’ uko umupaka ufunze. Mperutse kujya kugura movit nini y’ umuhondo bansha 1500 kandi ubusanzwe nayiguraga 1000” Umubano w’u Rwanda na Uganda umaze igihe urimo agatotsi aho rushinja Uganda gufunga Abanyarwanda bya hato na hato, kubakorera iyicarubozo, kubambura utwabo no kubatoteza. Leta ya Uganda ivuga ko abo ifunga iba ibakekaho kuba ba maneko b’ u Rwanda. 





Imirimo yo kuvugurura uyu mupaka irakomeje nubwo wabaye ufunguwe by’ agateganyo

label: politics
title: Kwibohora25: Muhanga abaturage biguriye imodoka y’ umutekano ya miliyoni 21
content:
Abaturage bo mu murenge wa Nyamabuye akarere ka Muhanga buri wese uko yifite bakusanyije amafaranga bigurira imodoka yo kubafasha gucunga umutekano no kubungabunga isuku.
 Abaturage bo mu murenge wa Nyamabuye akarere ka Muhanga buri wese uko yifite bakusanyije amafaranga bigurira imodoka yo kubafasha gucunga umutekano no kubungabunga isuku. Iyi modoka bayimurikiwe kuri uyu wa 4 Nyakanga 2019, ubwo u Rwanda rwizihizaga ku nshuro ya 25 Umunsi mukuru wo kwibohora. Ku rwego rw’ akarere uyu munsi mukuru wizihiriwe muri sitade ya Muhanga. Iyi modoka abakarani bo mu mujyi wa Muhanga bayitanzeho ibihumbi 40. Bavuga ko iyi modoka izabafasha gucunga umutekano. Umwe muri bo yagize ati “Hari igihe abantu bashobora gushyamirana bakarwana ikaza kubafasha kugemura ibibazo byabo”. Rev. Pasiteri Nkundiye Theophile yavuze ko iyi modoka abaturage biguriye ari ikimenyetso cyo kwibohora nyako. Ati “Kwibohora nyako, ni ukwibohora ingoyi y’ ubukene, umwanda, ndetse n’ umutekano muke. Iyi modoka buriya izunganira cyane cyane mu irondo ry’ umwuga. Ibyo ntibyigeze bibaho bibaye ubu ng’ ubu”. Umuyobozi w’ Akarere ka Muhanga, UWAMARIYA Beatrice avuga ko iyi modoka izunganira izindi akarere gasanzwe gafite kuko wasangaga zifite inshingano nyinshi. Yagize ati: “Ndashimira abaturage uruhare rwabo kuko iriya modoka izajya ibagoboka mu bikorwa byihutirwa kandi bitunguranye.” Mu bindi bikorwa by’Iterambere Abaturage bavuga begerejwe harimo Urugomero rw’Amashanyarazi rwa Nyabarongo, indege  zo mu bwoko bwa Drones zitwara amaraso y’abarwayi ndetse n’imihanda ya Kaburimbo yubatswe mu Mujyi. 

Meya Uwamariya Beatrice ashimira abaturage batanze umusanzu bakigurira imodoka

title: U Rwanda na Uganda byarezwe kubera ibyemezo bijyanye n’ifungwa ry’umupaka wa Gatuna
content:
Imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta muri Uganda yatanze ikirego mu rukiko irega Leta y’u Rwanda ndetse na Leta ya Uganda isaba ko batanga indishyi zakababaro kubera  amabwiriza yo gufunga imipaka, iyi miryango yo ikaba ivuga ko byakenesheje abaturage.
 Imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta muri Uganda yatanze ikirego mu rukiko irega Leta y’u Rwanda ndetse na Leta ya Uganda isaba ko batanga indishyi zakababaro kubera  amabwiriza yo gufunga imipaka, iyi miryango yo ikaba ivuga ko byakenesheje abaturage. Kuva mu kwezi kwa Gashyantare, Leta y’u Rwanda yafunze umupaka wakoreshwaga cyane wa Gatuna, ndetse ubuyobozi bunagira inama abaturage b’u Rwanda yo kutajya muri Uganda kuko abajyayo bajya bagirirwa nabi bagatotezwa mu buryo butandukanye. Abayobozi batandukanye ku ruhande rw’u Rwanda bakunze kuvuga ko batafunze imipaka yose ahubwo bafunze uwo mupaka umwe wa Gatuna kugirango usanwe, naho ibyo kubuza abaturage kujya muri Uganda bikaba biterwa n’uko abenshi bajyayo bagafungwa bakanakorerwa ibikorwa bitandukanye by’iyicarubozo. BBC dukesha iyi nkuru ivuga ko imijyi n’ibice byegereye umupaka w’u Rwanda na Uganda byahungabanyijwe n’ibi byemezo, nk’uko iyo miryango itegamiye kuri Leta yaranze ikirego ibivuga. Deborah Kyarisiima, umuyobozi wungirije mu ishyirahamwe ry’abacuruzi b’abagore ku mupaka wa Gatuna igice cya Uganda, avuga ko hari abantu bari barafashe inguzanyo ngo bakore ubucuruzi bwambukiranya imipaka ariko ubu bahunze kuko bari kwishyuzwa kandi badafite icyo bishyura. Bavuga ko abaturiye ibi bice, by’umwihariko abagore bakora ubucuruzi hagati y’ibihugu byombi, "batewe n’ubukene" kuva u Rwanda rwafata ibyo byemezo. Ikirego cy’iyi miryango kuri leta zombi cyashyikirijwe urukiko rw’umuryango w’ibihugu bya Afurika y’iburasirazuba, kivuga ko gufunga imipaka binyuranyije n’amabwiriza ashyiraho uyu muryango. Abarega barasaba n’indishyi z’akababaro ku bagizweho ingaruka n’ibi byemezo bya politiki. Uganda yahungabanyijwe byihariye n’ibi byemezo kuko Banki y’iki gihugu ivuga ko ibyoherezwaga mu Rwanda byagabanutseho 80% mu kwezi kwa gatatu ugeraranyije n’ukwezi kwa kabiri. Abarezwe, nta wuragira icyo avuga kuri iki kirego. Buri ruhande, u Rwanda na Uganda, rushinja urundi kwivanga mu bibera imbere mu gihugu. U Rwanda rushinja Uganda gutera inkunga imitwe irwanya ubutegetsi buriho mu Rwanda no gutoteza abanyarwanda bajya muri Uganda babita intasi. Perezida Museveni nawe ubwe yemeye ko yabonanye n’abarwanya ubutegetsi bw’u Rwanda ariko avuga ko byabaye ku bw’impanuka.

label: politics
title: Abaperezida bose bayoboye u Rwanda, uko bagiye ku butegetsi n’uko byabagendekeye
content:
Kuva ingoma ya cyami yakurwaho mu Rwanda, iki gihugu cy’imisozi igihumbi kimaze kuyoborwa n’abaperezida batandatu, muri abo bose babiri bakaba barapfuye urupfu rusanzwe, babiri bahiritswe ku butegetsi baranicwa naho abandi babiri baracyariho. Muri iyi nkuru, Ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com cyabakusanyirije ibijyanye n’uko aba baperezida bakurikiranye, uko bagiye bafata ubutegetsi, igihe bagiye babumaraho n’uko batanu ba mbere muri aba batandatu bagiye babuvaho. 1. Mbonyumutwa Dominique 
 Mbonyumutwa Dominique, ni we Perezida wayoboye u Rwanda mu gihe cy’igeragezwa rya Repubulika ryabaye mbere y’uko rubona ubwigenge, nyuma kandi y’irangira ry’ingoma ya cyami mu Rwanda. Mbonyumutwa yayoboye u Rwanda mu gihe  cy’amezi icyenda gusa, kuva tariki 28 Mutarama kugeza tariki 26 Ukwakira 1961. Kuva ku butegetsi kwe, byatewe n’uko atabashije gutsinda amatora. Uyu Dominique Mbonyumutwa yari yaravutse mu 1921, nyuma yaje gutabaruka tariki 26 Nyakanga 1986 aguye mu Bubiligi, ashyingurwa mu cyahoze ari Gitarama ahari hubatse sitade yari yaramwitiriwe. 2. Kayibanda Grégoire Kayibanda Grégoire, niwe Perezida wa kabiri u Rwanda rwagize, akaba ari nawe wa mbere waruyoboye kuva rwabona ubwigenge ndetse ninawe wa mbere wabaye Perezida habayeho amatora. Kayibanda yagiye ku butegetsi tariki 26 Ukwakira 1961 atsinze amatora ayobora manda ye ya mbere kugeza mu 1965 ubwo yongeraga kwiyamamaza ari we mukandida rukumbi ndetse anongera kwiyamamaza ari wenyine mu 1969, aho hose atsinda amatora. Kayibanda yayoboye u Rwanda mu gihe cy’imyaka 12 kugeza tariki 4 Nyakanga 1973 ubwo yahirikwaga ku butegetsi na Juvénal Habyarimana wari inshuti ye magara akaba yari na Minisitiri w’ingabo icyo gihe. Kayibanda Grégoire yapfuye afite imyaka 52 kuko yari yaravutse tariki 01 Gicurasi 1924. 3. Habyarimana Juvénal Juvénal Habyarimana wari umusirikare ku ipeti rya Général Major akaba yari na Minisitiri w’ingabo z’u Rwanda, yagiye ku butegetsi tariki 5 Nyakanga 1973 nyuma yo guhirika ubutegetsi bwa Kayibanda. Ubutegetsi bwa Habyarimana ntibwavugirwagamo, ndetse amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu nayo yabaga mu buryo budasanzwe, ari we mukandida rukumbi. Nyuma yo gushinga ishyaka MRND ryari ryo shyaka rukumbi ryemewe mu gihugu, Juvénal Habyarimana yagiye akoresha icyari nk’ikinamico y’amatora, aho yiyamamazaga ntawe bahatana. Amatora ya mbere yiyamamajemo wenyine ni aya tariki 24 Ukuboza 1978 aho byatangajwe ko yatowe ku kigero cya 98.99%, ayakurikiyeho yabaye tariki 19 Ukuboza 1983 nabwo bitangazwa ko yatsinze ku kigereranyo cya 99.97%, naho andi yabaye tariki 19 Ukuboza 1988 byatangajwe ko yayatsinze ku kigereranyo cya 99.98%. Uyu yari yaravutse tariki 8 Werurwe 1937, akaba yarayoboye u Rwanda imyaka myinshi kurusha abandi bose bayoboye u Rwanda kugeza ubu, kuko yayoboye imyaka 21 ategekesha igutugu kugeza ubwo yiciwe mu ndege yahanuwe tariki 6 Mata 1994, ubutegetsi bwe buba butembagaye butyo. 4. Dr Sindikubwaho Théodore Dr Sindikubwabo Théodore, niwe Perezida u Rwanda rwagize mu mateka waruyoboye igihe gito kandi mu gihe kibi cya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi, byumvikana ko nta n’umusaruro muzima yabyaje intebe y’ubutegetsi bwe. Sindikubwaho wari warigeze kuba Minisitiri w’ubuzima mu gihe cy’ubutegetsi bwa Kayibanda, yari yaraminuje mu by’ubuvuzi. Habyarimana amaze gufata ubutegetsi yahise ajya mu kazi k’ibyo yize by’ubuganga, akora mu bitaro bya CHK kugeza mu 1988 ubwo yasubiraga muri Politiki nk’umudepite mu Nteko Ishinga Amategeko y’u Rwanda. Nyuma y’iminsi ibiri indege ya Habyarimana Juvénal irashwe, Sindikubwabo wari ukuriye Inteko Ishinga Amategeko icyo gihe, yabaye Perezida kuva tariki 9 Mata 1994, mu cyari cyiswe Leta y’Abatabazi. Mu gihe cya Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi, Sindikubwabo azwiho kuba yaragiye ashishikariza abahutu kwica abatutsi ndetse agashimira cyane ababaga bakora ubwicanyi cyane. Yahise ava ku butegetsi nyuma y’amezi atatu gusa, ingabo za FPR Inkotanyi zimaze kubohoza igihugu. Ingoma ye yarangiye tariki 19 Nyakanga 1994, ubwo yahungiraga mu cyahoze cyitwa Zaïre. Yaje gupfira muri iki gihugu gisigaye cyitwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, akaba yarapfuye mu mwaka w’1998. Yapfuye ari umukambwe w’imyaka 70 kuko yari yaravutse mu 1928. 5. Bizimungu Pasteur Pasteur Bizimungu, niwe wahise ayobora u Rwanda nyuma y’ihagarikwa rya Jenoside, akaba yaricaye mu ntebe y’ubuyobozi tariki 19 Nyakanga 1994 ubwo yari afatanyije na Major General Paul Kagame wari Visi Perezida akaba ari nawe wari umugaba mukuru w’ingabo. Pasteur Bizimungu yayoboye u Rwanda mu gihe gikabakaba imyaka 6, kugeza ubwo yatangazaga ko yeguye ku bushake tariki 23 Werurwe 2000. Hagati aho ariko akimara kwegura, Charles Ntakirutinka wabaye Minisitiri w’Ingufu, Imirimo ya Leta, no gutwara abantu n’Ibintu; ndetse akaba yaranigeze kuba Minsitiri w’imibereho Myiza y’Abaturage mu gihe cy’ubutegetsi bwa Pasteur Bizimungu ndetse bakavira rimwe mu myanya y’ubuyobozi, muri 2001 bafatanyije n’abandi bantu batandatu bashinga ishyaka bise PDR-Ubuyanja (Parti Démocratique du Renouveau/ Democratic Party for Renewal Ubuyanja) mu gihe uyu Pasteur Bizimungu yahoze mu ishyaka rya FPR Inkotanyi ubwo yari Perezida. Mu kwezi kwa Kane 2002, nibwo batawe muri yombi bazira ibyaha byo gukwirakwiza ibihuha mu baturage hagamijwe kubangisha ubuyobozi n’amategeko y’igihugu. Bashinjwaga kandi gukora inama rwihishwa ngo zari zigambiriye kubangamira umudendezo w’igihugu no guteza amacakubiri mu Banyarwanda. Bahise bagezwa imbere y’urukiko, maze Pasteur Bizimungu akatirwa imyaka 15 y’igifungo ariko aza guhabwa imbabazi na Perezida wa Repubulika Paul Kagame kuwa 6 Mata 2007; mu gihe Charles Ntakirutinka we yakatiwe gufungwa imyaka icumi, iki gihano cye akaba yaranakirangije tariki 01 Werurwe 2012. Uyu mugabo Pasteur Bizimungu w’imyaka 66 kugeza ubu, ninawe ukiri ku isi mu ba Perezida bose bigeze kuyobora u Rwanda mbere ya Perezida Paul Kagame uyobora kugeza ubu. N’ubwo akiriho ariko, kuba yarakatiwe byamwambuye uburenganzira bwo kongera kugaragara mu mirimo ya Politiki. 6. Paul Kagame Perezida Paul Kagame wavutse tariki 23 Ukwakira 1957, niwe Perezida w’u Rwanda kugeza ubu, akaba amaze imyaka 16 ayobora Abanyarwanda. Ninawe Perezida rukumbi umaze gutorwa kenshi n’abaturage ahatanye n’abandi bakandida, kuko abandi bamubanjirije wasangaga biyamamaza ari bo bonyine. Kuwa Gatandatu tariki 22 Mata 2000 ku isaha ya saa 11:45 za mu gitondo ku isaha y’i Kigali, kuri sitade nkuru y’u Rwanda; sitade Amahoro i Remera, Paul Kagame wari visi Perezida w’u Rwanda icyo gihe, nibwo hatangajwe ko yagiye mu ntebe y’ubuyobozi nka Perezida wa Repubulika by’agateganyo, nyuma yo kwegura kwa Pasteur Bizimungu. Aha yari agiye kuyobora inzivacyuho nyuma yo gutorwa n’Inteko Ishinga Amategeko. Tariki 25 Kanama 2003, Paul Kagame wari umaze imyaka itatu ari Perezida w’inzibacyuho, yatowe n’abaturage kuva ubwo yemererwa kuyobora manda ye ya mbere y’imyaka 7, yarangiye muri 2010. Tariki 9 Kanama 2010, Paul Kagame yatorewe manda ya kabiri igomba kuzarangira muri 2017, gusa nyuma y’ivugururwa ry’Itegeko Nshinga ku busabe bw’abaturage bamugaragarije ko bamukunda kandi bifuza ko yakomeza kubayobora indi myaka myinshi, ubu Paul Kagame ni umwe mu bakandida baziyamamaza mu matora yo mu mwaka utaha wa 2017, hakaba hari n’icyizere cyinshi cy’uko ari we uzatsinda agakomeza kuyobora u Rwanda mu gihe kizaza.

title: Ubuzima bw’ubuhunzi butera umujinya ariko bugatera n’ishyaka - Perezida Kagame
content: Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 26 Gicurasi 2016, Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda, Paul Kagame, yakiriye abanyeshuri basaga 30 bo muri Kaminuza ya Wharton, abaganiriza byinshi ku mateka y’u Rwanda n’ubuzima bw’ubuhunzi yabayemo. Jenoside yabaye mu Rwanda mu 1994 yatumye abantu benshi ku isi bamenya u Rwanda kubera amabi yarubayemo, ariko nyuma yayo amahanga noneho yagiye amenya iki gihugu cy’imisozi igihumbi kubera iterambere no kwiyubaka bidasanzwe rwabashije kugeraho. Ubwiwe amateka y’u Rwanda akabona n’aho ruri ubu ararutangarira, bikaba ari nako byagenze kuri aba banyeshuri bo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika bakiriwe na Perezida Kagame. Perezida Paul Kagame yabasobanuriye uburyo amateka mabi y’u Rwanda ari yo abanyarwanda bakuyemo isomo ryo kwiyubaka. Yagize ati: "Abantu bishyize hamwe baravuga bati dushobora gukora ibihambaye nidutegura neza ahazaza hacu iby’ahashize tukabyirengagiza. Twiyumvishaga ndetse ko tugomba gushyira imbaraga mu iterambere kurushaho bitewe n’aho twari tuvuye ndetse n’aho twifuzaga kugera. Mu myaka 22 ishize twabonye ibintu bibi abantu bafite ubushobozi bwo gukora, uyu munsi nabwo ubona ibyiza ba bantu bashobora gukora." Agaruka ku buzima bubi yabayemo ubwo yari impunzi mu gihugu cya Uganda, Perezida Kagame yavuze ko ubuzima bw’ubuhunzi butera umujinya ariko nanone bugatera ishyaka. Yagize ati: Kuba impunzi bikubakamo umujinya ariko nanone bikakubakamo ishyaka, ugashaka gusubira iwanyu ngo urwane ubaza impamvu bagufata gutyo". Perezida Kagame avuga ko byashoboka ko abanyarwanda bungukiye mu bihe bikomeye banyuzemo, ubu bakaba barabashije kubaka amateka mashya.

title: Kagame yikomye raporo za Loni zishinja u Rwanda gufasha abashaka guhirika Nkurunziza
content: Perezida wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda, Paul Kagame, yamaganye ibya raporo z’umuryango w’abibumbye zishinja u Rwanda gutera inkunga imitwe ishaka gutera u Burundi igahirika ubutegetsi bwa Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza, yikoma abakora izi raporo ndetse anagira inama abarundi ku cyo bakwiye gukora ku bibazo byabo. Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 12 Gicurasi 2016, nibwo ibiro ntaramakuru by’abongereza, byatangaje ko akanama gashinzwe umutekano ku isi mu muryango w’Abibumbye, kongeye gushinja u Rwanda gutanga imyitozo, guha inkunga mu by’ubukungu n’ubundi bufasha butandukanye ku mitwe ishaka guhirika ubutegetsi bwa Perezida Pierre Nkurunziza w’u Burundi. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 13 Gicurasi 2016, Perezida Paul Kagame yongeye kunenga iby’izi raporo z’umuryango w’Abibumbye (LONI), agaragaza ko abazikora bongera ibibazo mu biba bisanzwe bihari. Perezida Kagame ati: "Abandika raporo za Loni ku Rwanda, bakabaye bakora ibindi by’ingirakamaro aho kongera ibibazo bihari" Perezida Kagame kandi yagiriye inama Abarundi, ku bijyanye n’uko bakwiye gufata ibibazo byabo ndetse no gushaka umuti wabyo aho gutekereza ko hari ahandi biva. title: Rubavu: Gitifu w’Akagari yafatiwe mu cyuho amaze kwakira ruswa y’ibihumbi 10
content:
Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Akagari ka Gikombe mu murenge wa Rubavu mu karere ka Rubavu yafashwe yakira ruswa akekwaho ko yari yatse umuturage wubakaga urupangu nta bya ngombwa byo kubaka.
 Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Akagari ka Gikombe mu murenge wa Rubavu mu karere ka Rubavu yafashwe yakira ruswa akekwaho ko yari yatse umuturage wubakaga urupangu nta bya ngombwa byo kubaka. Kuri uyu wa 23 Mata nibwo uyu muyobozi yatawe muri yombi. Ibi byamenyekanye ubwo, umuturage witwa Mugwaneza Justine w’imyaka 28 yahamagara ubuyobozi avuga ko, yatswe amafaranga ibihumbi 25 yakirwa umuyobozi w’umudgudu wa Rebero Gasore Viateur kugira ngo akomeze yubake nta cyangombwa. Nyuma yaho ngo uyu muyobozi w’akagari yaje kongera kubwira Mugwaneza ko agomba gutanga andi mafaranga ibihumbi 15,yakwanga agakuraho ibyo yubatse byose. Amakuru agera k’Ukwezi avuga ko uyu muyobozi w’Akagari yakomeje kujya yandikira uyu mugore ubutumwa bugufi amusaba, kurangiza ibyo bavuganye yakwanga agasenyerwa. Uyu mugore yabonye uyu muyobozi amurembeje amuha amafaranga ibihumbi bitanu bemeranya ko ibihumbi 10 bisigaye azabimuha tariki 23 Mata. Ibihumbi 10 byari bisigaye yasabye uyu mugore kubimuhera umucurizi wa mobile money. Ubwe ahamagara,umu Agent amubwira ko hari umuntu,ugiye kumumuhera amafaranga ati “Uhite uyanyoherereza”. Uyu mugore yayahaye, umucuruzi wa mobile money ahita ayoherereza gitifu, bamubaza niba yayabonye undi arikiriza, Abakozi ba RIB bari hafi y’uyu mucuruzi wa mobile money bahise babaza nomero ayoherejeho basanga ni iya gitifu w’akagari ka Gakombe. Bamugezeho basanga afite kuri telefone amafaranga 95 516 ariko message yayo yari amaze kwakira ibihumbi 10 igaragara kuri Screen ya Telefone. Uyu mu Agent avugako asanzwe ,amwoherezaho,abantu batandukanye, bakamwoherereza amafaranga. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge wa Rubavu Tuyisenge Annociata yemereye Ikinyamakuru Ukwezi ko aya makuru ari impamo avuga ko kuri ubu uyu muyobozi w’akagari afungiye kuri RIB sitasiyo ya Gisenyi.

label: politics
title: Gisagara: Abaturage mu rujijo, amabuye ngo ari guterurwa n’imbaraga zidasanzwe akitura ku nzu y’umuturanyi wabo
content:
Iminsi ine irashize amabuye aterurwa n’imbaraga zidasanzwe akitura hejuru y’inzu ya Nsabimana Jean Pierre, umuturage wo mu murenge wa Musha Akarere ka Gisagara, abaturage byabayobeye ndetse ntibatinya kuvuga ko bibateye ubwoba.
 Iminsi ine irashize amabuye aterurwa n’imbaraga zidasanzwe akitura hejuru y’inzu ya Nsabimana Jean Pierre, umuturage wo mu murenge wa Musha Akarere ka Gisagara, abaturage byabayobeye ndetse ntibatinya kuvuga ko bibateye ubwoba. Nsabimana yabwiye UKWEZI ko iki kibazo cyatangiye ku wa Mbere w’iki cyumweru saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba. Bitangira ngo yitabaje abayobozi agira ngo ni abantu bari gutera amabuye hejuru y’inzu ye, bukeye ku wa Kabili ikibazo kirakomeza, bigeze ku wa Gatatu bwo aya mabuye ngo yatangiye guhaguruka ari ku manywa n’abayobozi bareba. Kugeza ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane aya mabuye yari agikomeje kwiterura akagwa iruhande rw’inzu y’uyu muturage. Ati “Inzu, amategura yaramenetse uruhande rumwe, n’ay’inyuma yaramenetse amwe, n’iyi y’amabati yaratobaguritse kubera amabuye aremereye yagiye ayitura hejuru”. Nsabimana avuga ko umuyobozi w’umurenge yageze iwe ategeka ko aya mabuye arundwa uruhande rumwe. Ati “Kiriya kirundo ubona kirunze hariya, ni Executif w’umurenge wategetse ngo bayarunde hariya andi ari hejuru y’inzu buriya ariya yose ubona ni ayo byateye”. 

Nsabimana Jean Pierre, nyiri urugo ruri guterwamo amabuye Akomeza agira ati “Ikidasanzwe twabonye kuri aya mabuye ni uko amabuye yaturutse ku butaka rikajya ryiterura rigafata ikirere, rikagwa aho rigomba kugwa byagennye ko rigomba kugwa bigaragara ko ari imyuka mibi”. Kugeza ubu nta muntu urakomeretswa n’aya mabuye, keretse umugabo umwe ryasatiriye akarihunga bigatuma agwira igare agakomereka ku kuguru. Iri buye ngo rihagurukana imbaraga ariko iyo rigeze imbere y’umuntu rigabanya umuvuduko rikagwa imbere ye. Ibi byemezwa n’Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Akagari ka Kimana Mukeshimana Veneranda uvuga ko nawe yabyiboneye n’amaso ye. Mukeshimana avuga ko yabajije nyiri urugo ngo amubwire abantu bose akeka ko bafitanye ikibazo, undi arabavuga, ubuyobozi bw’akagari bwohereza intumwa kuri buri muntu wese wari waketswe birangira basanze utera amabuye atari muri abo kuko amabuye yari akomeje guterwa kandi abo bose bari baketswe ntawe uri hafi y’uru rugo. Uyu muyobozi nawe asanga aya mabuye aterurwa n’imbaraga zidasanzwe. Yagize ati “Mu by’ukuri nk’ibuye nabonye njyewe ubwanjye ryazamutse hano mu gikari, ndeba n’amaso yanjye gusa naje gutungurwa n’uko ryikubita hasi ntawe rigwiriye”. Mukeshimana avuga ko nyuma yo kwibonera ibiri kuba yahamagaye Nsabimana baraganira, ngo Nsabimana yamubwiye ko nawe icyo abona ari uko nta muturanyi uri kumugirira nabi ati “Nabona ishobora kuba ari imyuka mibi”. 

Umuyobozi w’ Akagari ka Kimana nawe avuga ko yabyiboneye Ubwo abanyamakuru bari basuye Nsabimana ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane, Nsabimana yavuze ko iyo hari abantu bari kubihakana bavuga ko bidashoboka bihita biba. Mu minota nk’itatu yakurikiyeho hari ibuye ryahise ryikubita hasi imbere y’abaturage bari bashungereye, abaturage bati ‘Birongereye’. Iri buye ntabwo twabonye aho ryaturutse. Hashize akandi kanya gato ‘irindi buye ryongeye kugwa nabwo tuyoberwa aho riturutse”

label: politics
title: Rubavu: Umusore yashutse umwangavu ngo bage gutashya bageze mu ishyamba aramusambanya
content:
Umusore w’imyaka 25 wo mu murenge wa Kanzenze mu karere ka Rubavu arashakishwa n’inzego z’umutekano akekwaho gusambanya umukobwa w’imyaka 17 wiga mu mashuri y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka 9.
 Umusore w’imyaka 25 wo mu murenge wa Kanzenze mu karere ka Rubavu arashakishwa n’inzego z’umutekano akekwaho gusambanya umukobwa w’imyaka 17 wiga mu mashuri y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka 9. Kuri uyu wa 13 Mata 2020 nibwo uyu musore w’imyaka 25 tutaributangaze amazina ye kuko agifatwa nk’umwere bitewe n’uko atarahamywa n’icyaha yashutse uyu mukobwa ngo bage mu ishyamba. Bageze mu ishyamba aramusambanya ariko mu kumusambanya ngo hari ibintu yamusezeranyije atamuhaye itangazamakuru ritaramenya. Nyuma yo kuva mu ishyamba uyu musore yagiye iwabo n’umukobwa ajya iwabo. Abaturage bavuga ko mu by’ukuri intego umusore yari afite itari ukujya gutashya ahubwo yari agambiriye kugeza uyu mukobwa mu ishyamba ngo amusambanyirizeyo. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’ Umurenge wa Kanzenze Monique Nyiransengiyumva yatangarije UKWEZI ko uyu mukobwa yageze iwabo bamenya ko hari ibintu uyu musore yamwereye ntiyabimuha. Ati “Ukuntu twabimenye ni uko ibyo umusore yari yasezeranyije umukobwa atabimuhaye, noneho ababyeyi barabimenya bagerageza guhuza uyu mukobwa n’umusore, umuyobozi w’umudugudu arabimenya niwe wabitubwiye”. Uyu musore akimara kumenya ko byamenyekanye yahise atoroka kugeza ubwo twandikaga iyi nkuru yari atarafatwa. Umusore n’umukobwa baturanye mu kagari ka Nyamikongi gusa batuye mu midugudu itandukanye. Uyu mukobwa yajyanywe mu bitaro bya Gisenyi kugira ngo ahabwe imiti yatuma atandura indwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina no kugira ngo hakusanywe ibimenyetso bizifashishwa mu nkiko kuko gusambanya umwana utarageza ku myaka 18 ari icyaha gihanwa n’amategeko mu Rwanda. Nyiransengiyumva arasaba abakobwa kujya bumvira ababyeyi babo kandi bakirinda gushukishwa ibintu. Uyu mukobwa wasambanyijwe yari yagiye mu ishyamba mu buryo iwabo batazi.

title: Rubavu: Umukobwa w’imyaka 18 yasanzwe aziritse ku giti yambaye ubusa
content:
Mu murenge wa Mudende mu karere ka Rubavu abantu batamenyekana nijoro ku cyumweru tariki 3 Gicurasi 2020 baziritse umukobwa ku giti yambaye ubusa abonwa n’abagenzi ahita ajyanwa kwa muganga.
 Mu murenge wa Mudende mu karere ka Rubavu abantu batamenyekana nijoro ku cyumweru tariki 3 Gicurasi 2020 baziritse umukobwa ku giti yambaye ubusa abonwa n’abagenzi ahita ajyanwa kwa muganga. Byabaye ahagana saa mbiri z’ijoro ku cyumweru, mu Kagari ka Kanyundo, Umurenge wa Mudende mu Karere ka Rubavu, umukobwa uri mu kigero k’imyaka 18 yasanzwe aziritse ku giti yambaye ubusa buri buri, kandi atabashaga kuvuga. Ababonye uyu mukobwa bavuga ko atabashaga kuvuga, yahise ajyanwa ku kigo nderabuzima cya Mudende ahabwa transfert ajyanwa ku bitaro bya Gisenyi. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Ugirabino Elisaphane yemeje aya makuru avuga ko bitaramenyekana niba uyu mukobwa yafashwe ku ngufu. Ati “Saa mbili z’ijoro abantu baba bakigenda. Ababyeyi bari bamutumye. Turakeka ko ari urugomo rwakozwe n’abantu bafite ingeso mbi, cyane cyane turakeka abashumba n’ibirara”. Ugirabino yasabye abaturage kudakuka umutima avuga ko uwahohotewe ari kwitabwaho n’abaganga kandi ko uwabikoze nafatwa azahanwa.

label: politics
title: Imvura idasanzwe yahitanye abantu 8 mu Rwanda inagiza byinshi [AMAFOTO]
text:
Imvura idasanzwe yahitanye abantu 8 mu Rwanda inagiza byinshi [AMAFOTO]
Minisiteri y’Ubutabazi mu Rwanda yatangaje ko imvura idasanzwe yaguye mu Rwanda tariki 1 n’iya 2 Gicurasi yahitanye abantu 8, ikomeretsa 5 inangiza ibikorwaremezo byinshi mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu.
 Minisiteri y’Ubutabazi mu Rwanda yatangaje ko imvura idasanzwe yaguye mu Rwanda tariki 1 n’iya 2 Gicurasi yahitanye abantu 8, ikomeretsa 5 inangiza ibikorwaremezo byinshi mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu. Mu butumwa iyi Minisiteri yashyize kuri twitter yagize iti “ Tariki ya 1 n’iya 2 Gicurasi, hirya no hino mu gihugu haguye imvura nyinshi itera ibiza; hapfuye abantu 8, hakomereka 5, inzu zirenga 100 zirasenyuka, imyaka irengerwa n’imyuzure n’imihanda itandukanye igwirwa n’inkangu.” Ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iteganyagihe cyatangaje ko hagati ya  tariki 1–10 Gicurasi hateganijwe imvura nyinshi iri hagati ya 90-120 mm mu mujyi wa Kigali, intara y’Amajyaruguru n’uturere twa Rubavu, Nyabihu,Rutsiro, Ngororero, Muhanga na Ruhango. 




 Minisiteri ishinzwe Ibikorwa by’Ubutabazi (MINEMA), irakangurira abantu bose gukomeza kwitwararika no kwirinda ibyabateza ibiza muri ibi bihe by’imvura nyinshi itwara ubuzima bw’abantu, yangiza imitungo itandukanye n’ibikorwaremezo. Ibiza byiganje biterwa n’imvura nyinshi irimo inkuba,iteza inkangu,imyuzure,inkubi y’umuyaga ndetse n’urubura. MINEMA irasaba abaturarwanda gufata ingamba zo kwirinda ibiza harimo: 1.Abatuye ahantu h’amanegeka barasabwa kuhimuka byihuse. 2.Kuzirika neza no gukomeza ibisenge ku nkuta z’inzu hakoreshejwe ibikoresho byabugenewe. 3.Igihe imvura igwa yiganjemo imirabyo n’imihindagano y’inkuba, abantu bagomba kwihutira kujya kugama mu nzu iri hafi;
4.Kwihutira kuva mu mazi (mu nzuzi, abareka, abashoye inka, …) igihe imvura itangiye kugwa; 5.Kwirinda gukoresha ibyuma bikoresha amashanyarazi; 6.Kwirinda gukoresha telephone mu gihe cy’imvura irimo inkuba; 7.Guhoma neza inzu harindwa ko amazi yakwinjira mu nkuta;
8.Kwimuka mu nzu zidakomeye zigaragaza ibimenyetso by’uko zishobora gusenyuka; 9.Gusibura inzira z’amazi,gusukura ruhurura no kwirinda kujugunyamo imyanda; 10.Gushishoza mbere yo kwambuka umugezi n’ibiraro, kwitondera amazi menshi atemba ava ku misozi,ruhurura, imigende n’imyuzi 11.Abatwara ibinyabiziga basabwe kwirinda kunyura mu mihanda irimo amazi afite umuvuduko mwinshi,inkangu,ahandi babujijwe na Police n’izindi inzego. 
 
 Aya ni amwe mu mazu amaze gusenywa n’ibiza mu bice bitandukanye by’u Rwanda

label: politics
title: Perezida Kagame yakoze impinduka mu buyobozi bw’ingabo z’u Rwanda
content:
Perezida w’u Rwanda Paul Kagame akaba n’ Umugaba w’ikirenga w’ingabo z’u Rwanda yakoze impinduka mu buyobozi burimo ubw’ibitaro bya gisirikare n’ishuri rya gisirikare.
 Perezida w’u Rwanda Paul Kagame akaba n’ Umugaba w’ikirenga w’ingabo z’u Rwanda yakoze impinduka mu buyobozi burimo ubw’ibitaro bya gisirikare n’ishuri rya gisirikare. Gen. Maj. Innocent Kabandana wari umuyobozi wungirije w’Inkeragutabara yagizwe umuyobozi mukuru w’Ishuri rya Gisirikare rya Gako. Brig. Gen. Ephrem Rurangwa wagizwe umuyobozi w’Ibitaro bya Gisirikare bya Kanombe. Col. Dr Etienne Uwimana yagizwe umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe gucisha abantu mu cyumba mu bitaro bya gisirikare bya Kanombe. Col. Kanobayire Emmanuel yagizwe umuyobozi wungirije w’ikigo cya gisirikare cya Gabiro. Brig.Gen. Murenzi Evariste yagizwe umuyobozi wungirije wa task force division ushinzwe ubutegetsi, igenamigambi n’ibikoresho. Maj. Kalisa Jean Claude yagizwe umuyobozi ushinzwe ubutegetsi n’ ibikoresho muri diviziyo wa kane.

label: politics
title: Ruhango: Uwarokotse Jenoside amaze kwangirizwa imyaka inshuro 3 mu byumweru 2
content:
Nyiramporampoze Chantal warokotse Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu karere ka Ruhango mu murenge wa Ruhango amaze kwangirizwa imyaka inshuro muri ibi bihe byo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi.
 Nyiramporampoze Chantal warokotse Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu karere ka Ruhango mu murenge wa Ruhango amaze kwangirizwa imyaka inshuro muri ibi bihe byo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi. Mu ijoro ryo ku wa 6 rishyira tariki ya 7 Mata, ubwo u Rwanda n’Isi muri rusange biteguraga gutangira igikorwa cyo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi; nibwo abantu bataramenyekana biraye mu myaka ya Nyiramporampoze irimo insina n’imyumbati barayitema mu murima ufite metero 20 kuri 30. Uyu mubyeyi wo mu kagari ka Buhoro nyuma yaho nabwo yasanze imyumbati ye bayiranduye abimenyesha ubuyobozi ndetse n’iperereza kuri ubwo bugizi bwa nabi rihita ritangira. Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere ka Ruhango ku bufatanye n’inzego z’umutekano bakurikiranye icyo kibazo ndetse bamwe mu bakekwaho ibyo bikorwa by’ubugizi bwa nabi batabwa muri yombi. Mu gihe bari bagikurikiranwa, mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa Gatatu indi myumbati ya Nyiramporampoze nayo yarandaguwe n’abantu bataramenyekana. Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu mu Karere ka Ruhango, Rusiribana Jean Marie yabwiye RBA ko iperereza ryatangiye hashakishwa abakoze ubwo bugizi bwa nabi. Ati “Ubu turi aho byabereye turi kumwe n’izindi nzego kugira ngo turebe icyakorwa. Ikibabaje ni uko uyu muturage ari inshuro ya gatatu bimubayeho; ubwa mbere bamutemeye insina, ubwa kabiri bamurandurira imyumbati, (…) uyu munsi bongeye kumurandurira imyumbati.” “Birababaje cyane kuba bikorwa bigakorerwa uwarokotse Jenoside kandi bigakorwa inshuro irenze imwe. Nta gihe kinini cyari giciyemo, iperereza ryari rigikorwa hari abakekwa bari bafashwe hagikorwa iperereza ritararangira.” Hashingiwe ku bikorwa bibi bimaze iminsi bikorerwa Nyiramporampoze Chantal, birerekana ko umutekano we utifashe neza muri ibi bihe kuko ashobora no kugirirwa nabi n’abo bamurandurira imyaka bakamutemera n’urutoki. Umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu mu Karere ka Ruhango, Rusiribana Jean Marie, yavuze ko umutekano w’uwo mubyeyi wizewe. Ati “Umutekano w’Abanyarwanda ubundi urabungabunzwe muri rusange ndetse by’umwihariko mu Karere ka Ruhango kandi n’umutekano we uracunzwe ntacyo ashobora kuba, umutekano we rwose awizere ndetse n’abaturage bandi tunabahumurize n’abarokotse Jenoside baturanye na we tubabwire ko nta mpungenge bakwiye kugira z’umutekano wabo.” Uyu muyobozi avuga ko muri rusange igipimo cy’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge muri aka karere gisanzwe gihagaze neza, gusa ko ibibazo by’ingengabitekerezo byongera kugaragara iyo igihe cyo kwibuka kigeze.

label: politics
title: Mu gihe abaturage basabwa kuguma mu rugo, ingona yaririye umugabo ku mugezi wa Nyabarongo
content:
Mu masaha ya mugitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 25 Werurwe 2020, ingona yaririye umugabo ku mugezi wa Nyabarongo ku gice cyo mu karere ka Kamonyi, ubuyobozi bukaba busaba abaturage kurushaho kwitwararika.
 Mu masaha ya mugitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 25 Werurwe 2020, ingona yaririye umugabo ku mugezi wa Nyabarongo ku gice cyo mu karere ka Kamonyi, ubuyobozi bukaba busaba abaturage kurushaho kwitwararika. Umuyobozi w’akarere ka Kamonyi, Kayitesi Alice, yahamirije ikinyamakuru Ukwezi iby’aya makuru. Yadutangarije ko uwariwe n’ingona ari umugabo uri mu kigero cy’imyaka 35 y’amavuko, wari uri mu gishanga ku nkombe y’uruzi rwa Nyabarongo. Meya Kayitesi Alice avuga ko amakuru bahawe n’abaturage ari uko bishoboka ko uwo mugabo yari agiye kuroba, kuko ngo n’ubusanzwe iyo umugezi wa Nyabarongo wuzuye ukamena hari abaturage bajya kuroba amafi muri icyo gishanga. Uyu muyobozi ariko avuga ko ubwo burobyi butemewe ndetse ko n’ibikoresho baba bakoresha bitemewe, agasaba abaturage kurushaho kwitwararika cyane ko aho uwo muturage yaririwe n’ingona atari ubwa mbere kuko hari n’undi ingona yahiciye. Meya Kayitesi Alice avuga ko muri iki gihe abaturage basabwe kuguma mu rugo birinda icyorezo cya Coronavirus, bari bakwiye kubyubahiriza wenda bakava mu rugo bajya mu bikorwa bidatuma bahura n’abandi cyane nko kwita ku matungo yabo n’ubuhinzi bwo hafi y’ingo zabo. Avuga ko buri wese akwiye kumva ko ibyo asabwa ari ku nyungu z’ubuzima bwe n’ubw’abandi baturage muri rusange.

label: politics
title: Ruhango : Ikigo cy’ Imari DUTERIMBERE cyibwe miliyoni zisaga 10
content:
Ikigo cy’imari iciriritse gikorera mu murenge wa Ruhango akarere ka Ruhango cyatobowe n’ abajura bacyiba miliyoni 10.
 Ikigo cy’imari iciriritse gikorera mu murenge wa Ruhango akarere ka Ruhango cyatobowe n’ abajura bacyiba miliyoni 10. Byamenyekanye mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa 20 Mutarama 2020 bibonywe n’abakozi b’iyi microfinance bari baje ku kazi ariko birakekwa ko byabaye mu ijoro ryo ku wa 19 rishyira kuwa 20 Mutarama 2020. Umuvugizi wa Polisi y’ u Rwanda mu ntara y’amajyepfo CIP Twajamahoro Sylvestre yemereye UKWEZI ko aya makuru ari impamo. Yagize ati "Byamenyekanye mu gitondo atanzwe n’abakozi bari baje mu kazi. Abajura batoboye inzu ikorerwamo n’icyo kigo cy’imari bibamo miliyoni 10 n’andi mafaranga arengaho." Inzego z’umutekano zataye muri yombi abakozi babiri bakorera kampani icunga umutekano yitwa Excel ishinzwe kurinda icyo kigo mu gihe iperereza rikomeje. Umuyobozi w’ Akarere ka Ruhango Habarurema Valens yatangaje ko RIB imaze guta muri yombi abantu 4 barimo abashinzwe umutekano w’iki kigo n’abafundi bari basanzwe bubaka inzu iri hafi y’ iki kigo. Meya Habarurema avuga ko amafaranga yibwe ari miliyoni 11 n’ibihumbi 200 akamara impungenge ababikije muri iki kigo Duterimbere kuko ayo mafaranga afitiwe ubwishingizi kandi abakekwa bakaba batawe muri yombi. Iki kigo kitwa Duterimbere cyibwe gikorera mu Mudugudu wa Njyejuru I Akagali ka Nyamagana, Umurenge wa Ruhango akarere ka Ruhango.

Meya Habarurema avuga ko amafaranga yibwe ari miliyoni 11 n’ibihumbi 200 akamara impungenge ababikije muri iki kigo Duterimbere kuko ayo mafaranga afitiwe ubwishingizi kandi abakekwa bakaba batawe muri yombi. Iki kigo kitwa Duterimbere cyibwe gikorera mu Mudugudu wa Njyejuru I Akagali ka Nyamagana, Umurenge wa Ruhango akarere ka Ruhango.

title: Nyanza: Umuturage yafatiwe mu cyuho aha ruswa umukozi wa RIB
content:
Umugabo witwa Hakizimana Aloys yafatiwe mu cyuha agerageza guha ruswa y’ ibihumbi 40 umukozi w’ urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha RIB.
 Umugabo witwa Hakizimana Aloys yafatiwe mu cyuha agerageza guha ruswa y’ ibihumbi 40 umukozi w’ urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha RIB. Byabereye mu murenge wa Nyagisozi saa munani z’amanywa kuri uyu wa 8 Gashyantare 2020. Hakizimana utuye mu mudugudu wa Kigarama, Akagari ka Rugangazi yagerageje guha ruswa umukozi wa RIB witwa Ndahimana Frodouard, ahita afatirwa mu cyuho. Uyu HAKIZIMANA Aloys yari atanze aya mafaranga mu rwego rwo gufunguza uwitwa TUYISENGE Pascal ufunzwe akurikiranyweho icyaha cyo gukubita no gukomeretsa uwitwa NTABANGANYIMANA Gerard w’imyaka 28. Tuyisenge yatawe muri yombi mu ijoro ryo kuwa 06/02/2020. Umuvugizi wa Polisi y’u Rwanda mu ntara y’amajyepfo CIP Twajamahoro Sylvestre aganira na UKWEZI yemeje aya makuru avuga ko Hakizimana ukekwaho gutanga ruswa y’ibihumbi 40 afungiye kuri sitasiyo ya Nyagisozi mu gihe iperereza rikomeje. CIP Twajamahoro yaboneyeho gusaba abaturarwanda gukurikiza ibiteganywa n’amategeko birinda gutanga ruswa. Yagize ati “Turasaba abaturage kwirinda kwishora mu ngso mbi, cyane cyane birinda gutanga ruswa. Bage bareka niba hari uwafatiwe mu cyaha amategeko yubahirizwe”. Ingingo ya 641 mu gitabo cy’amategeko ahana ibyaha mu Rwanda ivuga ko ibihano kuri ruswa ari igifungo kirenze imyaka itanu (5) kugeza ku myaka irindwi (7) n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda yikubye inshuro kuva kuri ebyiri (2) kugeza ku icumi (10) z’agaciro k’indonke yatanze cyangwa yashatse gutanga.

title: ‘Ntegereje ko urukiko rumpamagara kuburana mu mizi’ Dr Francis ushakishwa n’ ubutabera bw’ u Rwanda
content:
Dr Francis Habumugisha wakatiwe n’ urukiko rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge gufungwa iminsi 30 y’ agateganyo, akaba aherutse gushyira ifoto ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yibereye I Paris yibasiye itangazamakuru avuga ko riri kumuharabika.
 Dr Francis Habumugisha wakatiwe n’ urukiko rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge gufungwa iminsi 30 y’ agateganyo, akaba aherutse gushyira ifoto ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yibereye I Paris yibasiye itangazamakuru avuga ko riri kumuharabika. Mu biganiro yagiranye n’ abamukurikira ku rubuga rwa Twitter ku munsi w’ ejo Dr Francis(umuyobozi wa Good Rich TV yagaragaje ko  yasabye imbabazi uwo yakoreye icyaha akazihabwa, nyamara uwo avuga ko yamuhaye imbabazi niwe wajyanye ikirengo mu butabera. Yagize ati “Dear imbabazi nazihawe ikirego kitaratangwa ndetse ari nabwo narihaga ibyo nangije gusa nyuma ntungurwa n’ ikirego. Naho Ubutabera ndabwubaha cyane naniteguye kwitaba mu rukiko nkaburana ntegereje ko urukiko rumpamagara kuburana mu mizi”. 
 Mu iburanisha ku ifungwa n’ ifungurwa ry’ agateganyo urukiko rw’ ibanze rwa Nyarugenge rwarekuye by’ agateganyo Dr Francis kugira ngo akurikiranywe adafunze kuko yari yatanze ingwate. Ubushinjacyaha ntibwanyuzwe n’ umwanzuro w’ urukiko rw’ ibanze bujuririra urukiko rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge rwo rutegeka ko Dr Francis uregwa kuba mu kwezi kwa 7 yarakubise umukobwa witwa Kamali Diane akanamumera telefone hakaba hari n’ amashusho yafashwe na CCTV abigaragaza afungwa iminsi 30 y’ agateganyo mbere y’ uko urubanza rutangira kuburanishwa mu mizi. Umwanzuro w’ urukiko rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge ntabwo washyizwe mu bikorwa kuko magingo aya Dr Francis yibereye mu Bufaransa nk’ uko aherutse kubigaragariza ku rubuga rwa Twitter ashyiraho ifoto ye ari I Paris. 
 Ku rubuga rwa Twitter batangiye kwibaza uburyo umuntu ushakishwa n’ubutabera yasohotse igihugu akanigaragaza nk’aho nta cyabaye. Minisitiri w’ ubutabera akaba n’ intumwa nkuru ya Leta Johnston Busingye avuga ko Dr Francis Habumugisha ava mu Rwanda yanyuze inzira za panya. Minisitiri Busingye yavuze ko uwo mugabo yanyuze mu nzira zitemewe kuko ari ku rutonde rw’abatemerewe gusohoka mu gihugu. Yagize ati “Urukiko rwategetse ko Habumugisha afungwa by’agateganyo. Ari ku rutonde rw’abinjira n’abasohoka batemerewe gusohoka. Yasohotse igihugu anyuze mu nzira za Panya. Yarahunze, igihe n’igihe azagezwa imbere y’ubutabera.” Dr Francis arashinja itangazamakuru kumuharabika Uyu munyemari ufite n’ impamyabumenyi y’ ikirenga (Doctorat)  yandikiye Minisitiri Busingye kuri twitter agaragaza ko ari umwere ko ahubwo itangazamakuru riri kumuharabika ati “Dear Hon.Minister @BusingyeJohns ,iyo umuntu ataraburana ngo ahamwe n’icyaha aba akiri umwere ariko nimureba kuri twitter na medias zimaze amezi 2 hari agatsiko k’abantu  bishinze kunshinja ibyaha,kuntuka,kumparabika bakoresha Medias kandi ikigenderewe ari ukunkura ku isoko”. 
 Mu mbwiraruhame z’ abayobozi bakuru b’ u Rwanda hakunze kugarukamo ubutumwa buvuga ko ibyaha nshinjacyaha bidasabirwa imbabazi ngo abantu biyunge. Ubu butumwa ahanini butangirwa ku cyaha cyo gusambanya abana.

label: politics
title: Kigali: Umunyeshuri wigaga muri Kaminuza yapfuye urw’ amayobera
content:
Umusore wigaga muri Kaminuza ya Christian University of Rwanda (CHUR) mu mujyi wa Kigali acumbitse mu murenge wa Gitega mu karere ka Nyarugenge yitabye Imana azize urupfu rw’ amayobera.
 Umusore wigaga muri Kaminuza ya Christian University of Rwanda (CHUR) mu mujyi wa Kigali acumbitse mu murenge wa Gitega mu karere ka Nyarugenge yitabye Imana azize urupfu rw’ amayobera. Mukamurara Mariya wari ucumbikiye uyu musore avuga ko yari amaze ibyumweru bitatu amucumbikiye ati “Yari muzima ntituzi uko byagenze”. Abaturage bari bazi uyu musore bakeka ko yaba yishwe n’ umunaniro. babwiye Flash FM bati “Uyu mutipe twari tumuzi nk’ inshuti yacu, ngo yaje nimugoroba avuye gukora ikizami cy’ akazi mu gitondo bahita batubwira ngo yapfuye. Ndi kumva bavuga ngo ni stress kuko yigaga muri universite kandi akiga bimugoye, urikumva umuntu wigaga arara n’ ingangi yenda byaba ari na stress”. Umuvugizi wa RIB, Marie Michelle Umuhoza yatangaje ko aya makuru bayamenye saa yine z’ amanywa kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 25 Ugushyingo 2019, avuga ko batangije iperereza ku cyaba cyateye urupfu rw’ uyu musore. Yagize ati “Amakuru y’ urupfu rwa Niyirema Donat, RIB yayamenye mu ma saa yine, RIB yahise ifungura dosiye kugira ngo hamenyekane icyateye urupfu rwa Niyirema”. Imyirondoro ya Niyirema igaragaza ko yavukiye mu karere ka Nyamagabe. Umurambo we wajyanywe mu bitaro bya Kacyiru ngo ukorerwe isuzuma.

label: politics
title: Huye: Batewe ubwoba n’ icyobo kimaze gupfiramo ihene 5 no kuvunikiramo umukecuru
content:
Abaturage bo mu karere ka Huye murenge wa Mukura mu kagari ka Bukomeye umudugudu wa Bweramana bavuga ko batewe ubwoba n’ icyobo Abashinwa bakuyemo laterite bagasiga batahasubiranyije.
 Abaturage bo mu karere ka Huye murenge wa Mukura mu kagari ka Bukomeye umudugudu wa Bweramana bavuga ko batewe ubwoba n’ icyobo Abashinwa bakuyemo laterite bagasiga batahasubiranyije. Iki cyobo cyacukuwe kuva mu myaka 10 ishize nk’ uko abahatuye babivuga. Kugeza ubu hari uruhade rufite uruhavu rurerure ruhora rutenguka ari narwo abaturage bavuga ko hahanutsemo umukecuru akavunika akajyanwa kwa muganga akamarayo amezi 6 nk’ uko byemezwa na Nyirambonimana Vestine uhaturiye akaba anahafite isambu. Aganira na UKWEZI yagize ati “Kiriya cyobo ku mutekano wacu urahungabana. Iyo umuntu agiye kwicira inshuro avuga y’ uko asanga abana baguyemo. N’ abantu bakuru bagwamo nkanswe abana. Umuntu waguyemo ntabwo yari yasinze ahubwo yari agiye gusura umukobwa we hano hirya aranyerera ahita yikubitamo yanabaye mu bitaro igihe”. Nyirambonimana avuga ko iki cyobo cyanaguyemo ihene ye ihaka ikaramburura. Ati “Icyo dusaba ubuyobozi ni uko iki cyobo bagisiba cyangwa bakatwimura. Reba nk’ ubu haguyemo ihene yanjye ihaka ihita irambura abana batatu none byananteye ubukene nta rindi tungo ngira”. Hakizimana Emmanuel avuga ko iki kinogo ari Abashinwa bagicukuye batwara laterite zo gukoresha umuhanda. Uyu mugabo utuye muri metero zitageze kuri 30 uvuye kuri iki kinogo avuga ko haguyemo ihene ze ebyiri zirapfa. Agira ati “Uko imvura iguye hahita hariduka, uko iguye hariduka n’ ubu harakatse. Hamaze kugwamo abantu batatu n’ amatungo harimo ayagiye ahapfira, haguyemo ihene ebyiri zanjye zirapfa”. Ngabo Fidele, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’ umurenge wa Mukura avuga ko bafatanyije n’ urubyiruko bafite gahunda yo gusiba iki kinogo no kuhatunganya hakaba ikibuga cyiza cy’ umupira. Agira ati “Ubundi mu bijyanye no gucukura kariyeri hari amabwiriza avuga uburyo abahacukuye bagomba gusiga bahasubiranyije, twebwe ku rwego rw’ umurenge mu gihe akarere hari ukuntu gashobora gukurikirana abahakoreye bagakurikiza amabwiriza, hari icyo twiyemeye nk’ abaturage b’ umurenge wacu”. Yakomeje agira ati “Turebye nk’ imiterere yaho ni ahantu hashobora kuba ikibuga cyiza cy’ imikino. Twavuze ko tugiye gukorana n’ urubyiruko, tukagira uburyo tuhakora mu buryo bw’ umuganda dusa n’ abahashyira ibintu bimeze nk’ amatarasi ku buryo hatakongera guteza ikibazo”. Abaturiye iki kinogo bavuga ko kimaze imyaka irenga 10 gicukuwe kandi ko Abashinwa bahacukuye mbere n’ umugabo witwa Muhire wahacukuye nyuma ashaka laterite yo gukoresha muri sitade ya Huye nta ngurane yaho bigeze babaha. 



Iki kinogo kiri munsi y’ ishuri rya G.S.Mubumbano 

Aho Abashinwa bacukuye iki cyobo bakuramo laterite n’ imbere y’ ibiro by’ akagari ka Bukomeye 

Gitifu Ngabo Fidele asaba abaturage kwirinda gusohora amatungo mu rugo kuko binyuranyije n’ amabwira agenga aborozi

title: RIB yataye muri yombi 6 bakekwaho gukora ubucuruzi bw’ uruhererekane
content:
Urwego rw’ Igihugu rw’ Ubugenzacyaha RIB kuri uyu wa 26 Ugushyingo 2019 rwatangaje ko rwataye muri yombi abantu batandatu bakekwaho gukora ubucuruzi butemewe.
 Urwego rw’ Igihugu rw’ Ubugenzacyaha RIB kuri uyu wa 26 Ugushyingo 2019 rwatangaje ko rwataye muri yombi abantu batandatu bakekwaho gukora ubucuruzi butemewe. Abatawe muri yombi nk’ uko RIB yabitangaje ni Munezero Daniel, Nahimana Valens, Umutoniwase Claudine na Uwishimwe Gemima, bakorera muri Amway Group Ltd hamwe na Bizumuremyi Rafiki na Shema Darius, bombi bakorera muri Master Global Partners Ltd. RIB ivuga ko bose bakurikiranyweho gukora ubucuruzi butemewe n’amategeko (ubucuruzi bw’uruhererekane).Ubu bucuruzi ngo burangira abatanze amafaranga yabo bayamburwa. RIB irakangurira abaturarwanda kwirinda ababareshya bababeshya ko bagiye kubakiza vuba bakabashora mu bucuruzi butemewe ahubwo bagamije kubambura umutungo wabo, inashimira kandi abatanze amakuru kugira ngo abakekwaho ibyaha bafatwe. Ibi bije nyuma y’ uko muri Gicurasi 2019, RIB yataye muri yombi umuyobozi wa Supermarketings Global Ltd ikora ubucuruzi bw’amafaranga burimo uburiganya (Cripto-Currency scam).

title: Nyarugenge: Ababonye umurambo wa wa mukobwa bavuga ko basanze yakuwemo akenda k’ imbere [VIDEO]
content:
Abaturage bo mu murenge wa Nyarugenge mu karere ka Nyarugenge ahatoraguwe umurambo w’ umukobwa uri mu kigero cy’ imyaka nka 17 cyangwa 20 kuri uyu wa 20 Ugushyingo 2019 bavuga ko abishe uyu mukobwa babanje kumusambanya, bakabishingira ku kuba ngo biboneye umurambo we, akajipo n’ ikariso biri irunde rwawo.
 Abaturage bo mu murenge wa Nyarugenge mu karere ka Nyarugenge ahatoraguwe umurambo w’ umukobwa uri mu kigero cy’ imyaka nka 17 cyangwa 20 kuri uyu wa 20 Ugushyingo 2019 bavuga ko abishe uyu mukobwa babanje kumusambanya, bakabishingira ku kuba ngo biboneye umurambo we, akajipo n’ ikariso biri irunde rwawo. Hari amakuru avuga ko uyu mukobwa wishwe yaba yari asanzwe akorera uburaya ahitwa Mukarekare. Umurambo we wabonetse hafi y’ igishanga cy’ I Gikondo hagati y’ akarere ka Nyarugenge n’ aka Kicukiro. Umukecuru wabonye umurambo mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatatu niwe wahise awutwikirizaho igitenge, hanyuma abaturage bahamara inzego z’ umutekano zijyana umurambo kuwupima ngo hamenyekane iby’ uru rupfu. Abaturage bavuga ko n’ ubusanzwe batizeye umutekano wa kano gace, bagasaba inzego z’ ubuyobozi ko umuhanda uhari washyirwaho amatara n’ irondo rihoraho. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’ Umurenge wa Nyarugenge, Nyamutera Innocent yavuze ko bagiye gukaza umutekano muri aka gace uyu murambo watoraguwemo gusa anasaba abaturage kujya bagenda mu masaha meza kuko ngo uko bigaragara uyu mukobwa yishwe mu masaha akuze y’ ijoro. Gitifu Nyamutera yavuze ko hari na gahunda yo gukora neza uyu muhanda ugashyirwamo kaburimbo n’ amatara.

label: politics
title: Nyabihu: Umupolisi yakubise umugabo inshyi arangije aramurasa abaturage bashaka kwigaragambya
content:
Umugabo witwa HABARUREMA Jean Claude bakundaga kwita Gasore bikekwa ko yari atwaye magendu y’inkweto yarashwe n’ umupolisi amasasu ane ahita apfa.
 Umugabo witwa HABARUREMA Jean Claude bakundaga kwita Gasore bikekwa ko yari atwaye magendu y’inkweto yarashwe n’ umupolisi amasasu ane ahita apfa. Byabereye mu kagari ka Kijote umurenge wa Bigogwe mu karere ka Nyabihu saa sita z’amanywa yo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 27 Nzeri 2019. Ababonye ibi biba babwiye TV1 ko uwo mugabo wari usanzwe acuruza inkweto yari ari mu modoka ituruka Rubavu igana Musanze afite agafuka karimo imiguru 10 y’inkweto, yabona polisi ibahagaritse agafata agafuka ke akiruka ari nabwo umupolisi yahise amwirukaho akamurasa amasasu ane ari nabyo byamuviriyemo urupfu. Abo baturage bagaragazaga umujinya mwinshi bavuga ko ubwo umupolisi yamwirukankanaga yamurashe amasasu abiri amuhusha, nyuma akaza kumurasa andi abiri yamaze kumugeraho ndetse ngo akaba yabanje no kumukubita inshyi ebyiri. Ni ibintu abaturage bavugaga ko byabarakaje cyane, ari nayo mpamvu bashatse gukora igisa n’imyigaragambyo bagahagarara mu muhanda banga ko umurambo w’uwishwe utwarwa, nubwo bitamaze akanya. Umuvugisi wa polisi y’u Rwanda CP John Bosco Kabera yavuze ko ayo makuru ariyo koko ko abapolisi bari bacunze umutekano wo mu muhanda bahagaritse imodoka hakavamo umuntu ufite igikapu akiruka umupolisi yamurasa isasu rigafata mu cyico. Ku bivugwa n’abaturage ko uwo muturage amasasu abiri ya nyuma yayarashwe yamanitse amaboko ku buryo yashobora gufatwa atishwe, umuvugizi wa polisi avuga ko harimo gukorwa iperereza ngo harebwe niba koko uwo mupolisi wari mu kazi yaba yakoresheje imbaraga z’umurengera akaba yabibabazwa. Abaturage bo bifuza ko mu gihe byazagaragara ko uwo mupolisi yakoze ibidakwiye yazaza kuburanishirizwa mu ruhame, kuko ngo aribyo byabereka koko ko ntawe uri hejuru y’amategeko nta n’uwemerewe guhutaza umuturage. Uyu Habarurema Jean Claude bakundaga kwita Gasore wapfuye arashwe n’umupolisi, nubwo yarasiwe mu murenge wa Bigogwe mu karere ka Nyabihu, yari asanzwe atuye mu murenge wa Nyakiliba mu karere ka Rubavu. Yasize umugore n’abana batatu.

title: Rwamagana: Umusore yarasiwe ku rugo rw’ umuturage ari gucukura inzu
content:
Umusore uri mu kigero cy’ imyaka 20-30 warashwe n’ inzego z’ umutekano akekwaho kwiba. Ubuyobozi burasaba abaturage gutanga amakuru igihe cyose babonye umuntu batazi.
 Umusore uri mu kigero cy’ imyaka 20-30 warashwe n’ inzego z’ umutekano akekwaho kwiba. Ubuyobozi burasaba abaturage gutanga amakuru igihe cyose babonye umuntu batazi. Saa munani z’ ijoro kuri uyu wa 24 Nzeri 2019 nibwo abantu babiri bacukuye inzu y’ umuturage wo mu mudugudu wa Puraje, Akagari ka Nyarusange umurenge wa Muhazi. Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’ umurenge wa Muhazi yabwiye UKWEZI ko aya makuru ari impamo ndetse ko umurambo w’ uwarashwe wajyanywe mu bitaro bya Rwamagana. Yagize ati “Byabaye saa munani z’ ijoro. Hari abajura babiri baje bacukura urugo rw’ umuturage wo mu kagari ka Nyarusange, noneho abantu barabyumva kuko ari mu mugi haba hari abanyerondo n’ abapolisi baba bari ku burinzi mu ijoro. N’ uko aratabaza baramutabara baje basakirana n’ uwo mujura n’ umuhoro n’ amatindo , araraswa arapfa” Gitifu wa Muhazi avuga ko uwarashwe atari umuturage w’ umurenge wa Muhazi ndetse ngo nta n’ ubwo basanzwe bamuzi muri ako gace. Abacukuraga inzu bari babiri ariko harashwe umwe undi ahita atoroka. Ubuyobozi busaba abaturage igihe cyose babonye abantu batazi bazenguruka bakwiye gutanga amakuru kuko ngo akenshi baba bari kureba aho baza kwiba nijoro. Ikindi ubuyobozi busaba ba nyiri amazu ni uko bakwiye kujya bacana amatara yo hanze kuko abafasha mu kwicungira umutekano.

title: Rubavu: Umuyobozi w’ ishuri yatawe muri yombi ashinjwa gusoma umwana w’ imyaka 10
content:
Umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’amashuri abanza cya Complexe Scolaire de la Fraternite mu Karere ka Rubavu,Murigande Fulgence w’imyaka 37 arashinjwa gufata umwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka 10 akamusomera mu biro.
 Umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’amashuri abanza cya Complexe Scolaire de la Fraternite mu Karere ka Rubavu,Murigande Fulgence w’imyaka 37 arashinjwa gufata umwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka 10 akamusomera mu biro. Ibi ngo byabaye kuri uyu wa 19 Nzeri 2019 mu masaha ya mugitondo ubwo uyu munyeshuri yinjiraga mu biro bya diregiteri agiye gufata ibikoresho. Umuyobozi w’ Akarere ka Rubavu Habyalimana Gilbert yatangarije UKWEZI ko aya makuru ari impamo ndetse ko iki kibazo RIB yatangiye kugikurikirana. Yagize ati “Ayo makuru twayamenye n’ ubundi biracyari muri RIB , ni RIB irimo ibikurikirana, andi makuru twazayamenya ubusesenguzi bumaze kuba”. Amakuru agera k’ UKWEZI aravuga ko uyu muyobozi w’ ishuri yemera ibyo ashinjwa, ndetse ko yamaze gushyikirizwa sitasiyo ya Gisenyi y’Urwego rw’Igihugu rw’Ubugenzacyaha (RIB).

label: politics
title: Camille Nkurunziza wigeze kuba umusirikare w’ u Rwanda yashyinguwe muri Afurika y’ Epfo
content:
Umunyarwanda Camille Nkurunziza utaravuravugagarumwe n’ ubutegetsi bw’ u Rwanda yashyinguwe mu mujyi wa Cape Town muri Afurika y’ Epfo nyuma y’ uko arashwe n’ abapolisi b’ iki gihugu mu mpera za Gicurasi 2019.
 Umunyarwanda Camille Nkurunziza utaravuravugagarumwe n’ ubutegetsi bw’ u Rwanda yashyinguwe mu mujyi wa Cape Town muri Afurika y’ Epfo nyuma y’ uko arashwe n’ abapolisi b’ iki gihugu mu mpera za Gicurasi 2019. Nyakwikwigendera Nkurunziza warashwe tariki 30 Gicurasi yashyinguwe ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 7 Kamena 2019. Hari amakuru avuga ko Nkurunziza wari umusirikare w’ u Rwanda kuva mu 1994-2000 , akaza kwaka ubuhungiro muri Afurika y’ Epfo yarasanywe n’ umunyafurika y’ Epfo w’ imyaka 34 witwa Tabo Majeke. Camille Nkurunziza wari umaze imyaka umunani ahungiye muri Afurika y’ Epfo, Leta y’ u Rwanda ivuga ko yarashwe agerageza kurwanya abapolisi ba Afurika y’ Epfo bashakaga kumuta muri yombi. Umugore we Aneth Kabasindi yabwiye BBC ko ku wa Kabiri hari umuntu warasiwe ku gipangu cyabo aje mu kiriyo. Uwo mu ni Umurundi wakoragana na Nkurunziza umwuga wa Taxi akaba n’ inshuti ye. Kabasindi avuga ko Polisi y’ Afurika y’ Epfo yamusabye imbabazi kuko umupolisi w’ iki gihugu cyabahaye ubuhungiro cyarashe umugabo we. Camille Nkurunziza yahoze mu mutwe urwanya u Rwanda wa Kayumba Nyamwasa RNC, aza kuwuvamo ajya muri FLN ya Callixte Sankara nk’ uko byatangajwe n’ Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’ Ububanyi n’ amahanga y’ u Rwanda, Amb. Olivier Nduhungirehe. Camille Nkurunziza yagaragaye mu bukangurambaga bw’ abatavugarumwe na Leta y’ u Rwanda basabaga ko itegeko nshinga ritavugururwa ngo Perezida Kagame akomeze ayobore u Rwanda. Inkuru bifitanye isano:  Amb. Nduhungirehe yanyomoje abavuga ko ‘Camille Nkurunziza’ wiciwe muri Afurika y’ Epfo yahoze arinda Perezida Umugore wa Camille Nkurunziza wiciwe i Cape Town yavuze iby’undi warashwe aje mu kiriyo

Camille Nkurunziza wigeze kuba umusirikare w’ u Rwanda yashyinguwe muri Afurika y’ Epfo
Umunyarwanda Camille Nkurunziza utaravuravugagarumwe n’ ubutegetsi bw’ u Rwanda yashyinguwe mu mujyi wa Cape Town muri Afurika y’ Epfo nyuma y’ uko arashwe n’ abapolisi b’ iki gihugu mu mpera za Gicurasi 2019.
 Umunyarwanda Camille Nkurunziza utaravuravugagarumwe n’ ubutegetsi bw’ u Rwanda yashyinguwe mu mujyi wa Cape Town muri Afurika y’ Epfo nyuma y’ uko arashwe n’ abapolisi b’ iki gihugu mu mpera za Gicurasi 2019. Nyakwikwigendera Nkurunziza warashwe tariki 30 Gicurasi yashyinguwe ku mugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 7 Kamena 2019. Hari amakuru avuga ko Nkurunziza wari umusirikare w’ u Rwanda kuva mu 1994-2000 , akaza kwaka ubuhungiro muri Afurika y’ Epfo yarasanywe n’ umunyafurika y’ Epfo w’ imyaka 34 witwa Tabo Majeke. Camille Nkurunziza wari umaze imyaka umunani ahungiye muri Afurika y’ Epfo, Leta y’ u Rwanda ivuga ko yarashwe agerageza kurwanya abapolisi ba Afurika y’ Epfo bashakaga kumuta muri yombi. Umugore we Aneth Kabasindi yabwiye BBC ko ku wa Kabiri hari umuntu warasiwe ku gipangu cyabo aje mu kiriyo. Uwo mu ni Umurundi wakoragana na Nkurunziza umwuga wa Taxi akaba n’ inshuti ye. Kabasindi avuga ko Polisi y’ Afurika y’ Epfo yamusabye imbabazi kuko umupolisi w’ iki gihugu cyabahaye ubuhungiro cyarashe umugabo we. Camille Nkurunziza yahoze mu mutwe urwanya u Rwanda wa Kayumba Nyamwasa RNC, aza kuwuvamo ajya muri FLN ya Callixte Sankara nk’ uko byatangajwe n’ Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’ Ububanyi n’ amahanga y’ u Rwanda, Amb. Olivier Nduhungirehe. Camille Nkurunziza yagaragaye mu bukangurambaga bw’ abatavugarumwe na Leta y’ u Rwanda basabaga ko itegeko nshinga ritavugururwa ngo Perezida Kagame akomeze ayobore u Rwanda. label: politics
title: Mudasobwa z’ abanyeshuri zibwa mu Rwanda zigurishwa muri Kongo
content:
Polisi y’ u Rwanda ikorera mu ntara y’ amajyepfo yatangaje ko mudasobwa zagenewe abanyeshuri muri gahunda ya Onelaptop per child na Smart Classroom zibwa mu Rwanda ziguriswa muri Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo.
 Polisi y’ u Rwanda ikorera mu ntara y’ amajyepfo yatangaje ko mudasobwa zagenewe abanyeshuri muri gahunda ya Onelaptop per child na Smart Classroom zibwa mu Rwanda ziguriswa muri Repubulika ya Demukarasi ya Kongo. ACP Kajeguhakwa Jean Claude, Umuyobozi wa Polisi muri iyi ntara yatangaje ko hamaze kwibwa mudasobwa 636 mu turere twose tw’ intara y’ amajyepfo. Harimo 66 zibwe mu karere ka Kamonyi, 186 zibwe mu karere ka Muhanga, 115 zibwe mu karere Ruhango, 35 zibwe mu karere ka Nyanza, 72 zibwe mu karere ka Huye, 49 zibwe mu karere ka Gisagara, 25 zibwe mu karere ka Nyamagabe na 88 zibwe mu karere ka Nyaruguru. Abamaze gutabwa muri yombi bakekwaho kwiba izi mudasobwa ni 80 naho izimaze kugaruzwa ni 141. 
 ACP Kajeguhakwa mu kiganiro yahaye abayobozi b’ Akarere ka Gisagara n’ abafatanyabikorwa b’ akarere bari mu mwiherero yavuze ko igitiza umurindi ubu bujura ari ukutagira ururinzi buhamye. Ati “Ugasanga ikigo kiriho izi mudasobwa kirindwa n’ umuzamu ufite ikiringiti. Bene uyu muzamu biba byoroshye kumusindisha agasinzira ubundi abiba bakiba”. ACP Kajeguhakwa avuga ko Minisiteri y’ Uburezi na Polisi y’ u Rwanda bahagurukiye ikibazo cy’ ubujura bw’ izi mudasobwa. Izi mudasobwa zihabwa abanyeshuri biga mu mashuri abanza n’ ayisumbuye mu rwego rwo kubafasha kwiga neza no kumenya gukoresha neza ikoranabuhanga. ACP Kajeguhakwa ati “Twatahuye ko mudasobwa zibwa zigurishwa muri Kongo zigakorwamo ibyuma. Hari izafashwe ziragarurwa”. Mu rwego rwo gufasha abanyeshuri mu bijyanye n’ ikoranabuhanga buri kigo cy’ ishuri kigomba kugira Smart Classroom. Polisi y’ u Rwanda mu ntara y’ amagepfo ivuga ko indi mpamvu ituma mudasobwa zibwa ariko ziba zitabitse neza. Icyumba kibikwamo mudasobwa kigomba kuba gifite akabati zibikwamo kandi gafungwa neza n’ icyumba zibikwamo bikaba uko. ACP Kajeguhakwa agaragaza ko byinshi mu bigo by’ amashuri byo mu ntara y’ amajyepfo bitabika mudasobwa mu buryo bukwiriye. 
 Gahunda ya Smart Classroom ni gahunda yatangiye muri 2016, ifite intego ko buri kigo cy’ ishuri kigira icyumba cya mudasobwa. Iyi gahunda yaje yunganira gahunda ya mudasobwa imwe ku mwana One laptop per child.

title: U Rwanda rwanyomoje amakuru avuga ko abasirikare barwo barasiye abantu babiri ku butaka bwa Uganda
content:
Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma y’ u Rwanda akaba na Minisitiri w’ Ububanyi n’ amahanga Dr Richard Sezibera yatangaje ko amakuru y’ uko ingabo z’ u Rwanda zarasiye ku butaka bwa Uganda abantu babiri ari igihuha.
 Umuvugizi wa Guverinoma y’ u Rwanda akaba na Minisitiri w’ Ububanyi n’ amahanga Dr Richard Sezibera yatangaje ko amakuru y’ uko ingabo z’ u Rwanda zarasiye ku butaka bwa Uganda abantu babiri ari igihuha. Polisi ya Uganda mu gitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 25 yatangaje ko hari abantu babiri Umunya-uganda n’ Umunyarwanda baraye barasiwe ku mupaka w’ u Rwanda na Uganda mu karere ka Rukiga. Umuvugizi wa polisi ya Uganda Fred Enanga yavuze ko Umunyarwanda warashwe ari uwitwa Peter Nyengye wakora ubucuruzi. Enanga avuga ko uyu mucuruzi yashakaga kwambuka umupaka yinjira mu Rwanda apakiye ibicuruzwa kuri moto, yabona inzego z’ umutekano ku mupaka agahita akatisha moto ngo asubire iyo aturutse. Akomeza avuga ko abasirikare babiri b’ u Rwanda bakurikiye uyu mucuruzi bakagera kuri metero nka 80 bambutse umupaka , uwo mucuruzi akanga gutabwa muri yombi bagahita bamurasa mu mutwe akahita apfa. Polisi ya Uganda ivuga ko abo basirikare b’ u Rwanda banarashe umupolisi wa Uganda wagerageje gutabara. Uwo mupolisi wa Uganda warashwe ngo yitwa Alex Nyesiga. Imirambo y’ abarashwe yahise ijyanwa ku Kigo Nderabuzima cya Kamwezi IV. Ubutumwa Dr Sezibera yanditse kuri twitter asubiza ikinyamakuru Theeastafrican yagize ati “Amakuru y’ibihuha: Ibyo ntabwo byigeze biba. Igisubizo gisobanuye neza murakimenya vuba”. Yakomeje avuga ko nta musirikare w’u Rwanda wigeze yambuka umupaka ajya muri Uganda. 
 Ikibazo cy’ Abanyarwanda bahungabanyizwa ku mupaka w’ u Rwanda na Uganda si ubwa mbere cyumvikanye kuko hari undi mugabo witwa Innocent Ndahimana wo mu karere ka Gicumbi wavuze ko yarasiwe ku mupaka agerageza kwinjiza ibishyimbo mu muri Uganda abikuye mu Rwanda. Icyo gihe yari mu bitaro bya Kabale avurwa igikomere. Muri Werurwe, Umugore w’Umunyarwandakazi witwa Elisabeth Mukarugwiza w’imyaka 38, yaguye hasi ndetse apfira ku ruhande rwa Uganda hafi y’umupaka wa Cyanika, nyuma yo kubura ubufasha bwashoboraga kuramira ubuzima bwe.

label: politics
title: Ngoma: Inzu y’ubucuruzi yafashwe n’inkongi y’umuriro
content:
Mu masaha y’umugoroba wo kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 12 Gicurasi 2016, inzu y’ubucuruzi iherereye mu karere ka Ngoma ahahoze ari muri Kibungo, yafashwe n’inkongi y’umuriro irashya irakongoka, ibyari biyirimo birahatikirira. Amakuru abari ahahiriye iyi nzu bagejeje ku kinyamakuru Ukwezi.com, avuga ko inzu yahiye ari iy’umugabo witwa Martin, ikaba yakorerwagamo ubucuruzi muri aka karere ka Ngoma mu mujyi rwagati. Birakekwa ko iyi nkongi yaba yaturutse ku muriro w’amashanyarazi. 
 
 
 
 Inkongi z’umuriro hirya no hino mu Rwanda zari zimaze igihe zitagaragara, nyuma y’uko mu mwaka ushize wa 2015 zibasiye inyubako nyinshi hirya no hino mu gihugu ariko cyane cyane mu mujyi wa Kigali.

label: politics
title: Umugore w’umuzunguzayi yiciwe muri gare ya Nyabugogo
content: Mu masaha ya saa sita z’amanywa yo kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 7 Gicurasi 2016, nibwo muri gare ya Nyabugogo iherereye mu mujyi wa Kigali hiciwe umugore wakoraga akazi ko gucuruza ibintu abibungana, muri bamwe bamenyerewe ku izina rya’abazunguzayi. Umwe mu bari aho ibi byabereye, yabwiye Ukwezi.com ko umwe mu bashinzwe umutekano  muri gare (abanyerondo) yakubise umugore wacuruzaga ibintu bitandukanye abibungana, akikubita hasi agahita ashiramo umwuka. Ibi bikimara kuba, hahamagawe imodoka y’ubutabazi ariko abandi bazunguzayi banga ko itwara uwo murambo, basaba ko umuyobozi w’umujyi wa Kigali ndetse na Komiseri wa Polisi babanza bakahagera. Abazunguzayi bavugaga ko hari n’undi witwa Nyinya wishwe ntibamenye irengero rye, bityo banga ko imbangukiragutabara (ambulance) itwara umurambo, dore ko bayiteye amabuye ibirahure bakabimena, imvururu zigahosha Polisi imaze kuhagera. Mu kiganiro na Ukwezi.com, Umuvugizi wa Polisi y’u Rwanda mu mujyi wa Kigali, Sup Emmanuel Hitayezu, yaduhamirije iby’aya makuru, avuga ko ari igikorwa cy’urugomo cyahabaye ariko ahakana iby’uko uwo mugabo wishe umuzunguzayi yari umwe mu bashinzwe umutekano, kuko ngo ushinzwe umutekano agaragazwa n’umwenda w’akazi. Sup Hitayezu Emmanuel, yadutangarije ko uwishwe yitwaga Uwamahoro Theodosie naho uwamwishe akaba yitwa Joseph ndetse akaba yamaze gutabwa muri yombi kugirango iperereza rikomeze hamenyekane byinshi ku ntandaro y’uru rugomo.

content:

 Imibare ya Minisiteri y’ubuzima kugeza ubu igaragaza ko mu bantu 127 bamaze kubonwamo coronavirus mu gihugu muribo 42 bahanye na 33% bamaze gukira. label: health
title: Gicumbi: Abantu batandatu barimo umuyobozi w’ ishami rya I&M bank banduye covid-19
content:
Ibitaro bya Byumba byatangaje ko mu karere ka Gicumbi hamaze kuboneka abantu batandatu barwaye coronavirus barimo umuyobozi wa I&M ishami rya Byumba n’umushoferi utwara imodoka y’iyi banki.
 Ibitaro bya Byumba byatangaje ko mu karere ka Gicumbi hamaze kuboneka abantu batandatu barwaye coronavirus barimo umuyobozi wa I&M ishami rya Byumba n’umushoferi utwara imodoka y’iyi banki. Umuyobozi w’ Ibitaro bya Byumba Corneille Ntihabose yatangarije kuri Radio Ishingiro ko bamwe mu banduye iyi virus bamaze kujyanwa ku bitaro bya Kanyinya ahavurirwa abanduye iyi virusi mu Rwanda, mu gihe ikipe y’ibi bitaro bya Byumba ikomeje gushaka abahuye n’aba barwayi batandatu. Dr Ntihabose arashishikariza abahuye n’aba bantu banduye ko bahamagara nimero yabigenewe bakimenyekanisha kugira ngo bavurwe. Ati “Ikintu kiza kubaho mu karere ka Gicumbi ni uko umuntu wese wahuye n’aba bantu banduye araza gushyirwa mu kato. Icyorezo nk’iki giteye ubwoba kica abantu buri munsi hari ibyo ikiganga kivaho. Ibyo kuvuga ibanga rya muganga ubu ni ubuzima bw’abaturage miliyoni 12 ziri mu ntoki zacu ntabwo ari ubuzima bw’umuntu witwa Corneille, umuyobozi w’ibitaro bya Byumba, nimba yanduye yanduye kandi bigomba kumenyekana” Yakomeje agira ati “Ntihagire umuntu uza kutubwira ngo twatangiye kwica amabwiriza ya kiganga. Ubu tumaze kugira abantu batandatu, umuntu umwe twagize byabaye amahire twamuvanye ku mupaka wa Gatuna, yari yaragize ingendo zo mu karere, turamufata tumushyira mu kato k’iminsi 14, tumaze kumupima aza kubonekamo buno bwandu, abantu bahuye nawe ni bake cyane abo twafashe ni abamutekeraga” Dr Ntihabose yakomeje avuga ko abantu barwaye ari umuryango w’umuyobozi wa I&M bank ishami rya Byumba, asaba abahuye n’uyu muryango ko bakwigaragaza bagakurikiranirwa hafi. label: health
title: Abakozi ba RSSB bakora kwa muganga bafite ubwoba bwo kwandura Coronavirus, bavuga ko batereranywe
content:
Mu gihe hirya no hino abantu bose bakangurirwa kwirinda ikwirakwizwa ry’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, abakozi b’ikigo cy’Ubwiteganyirize mu Rwanda (RSSB) bakira abarwayi ku bitaro n’amavuririro atandukanye mu mujyi wa Kigali, bavuga ko bahagaritse umutima kuko uburyo bakoramo akazi kabo babona bishobora gushyira mu kaga ubuzima bwabo, ngo ibyago bya kwandura ni byinshi kandi ntagikorwa n’ikigo bakorera ngo nabo barindwe nk’abandi.
 Mu gihe hirya no hino abantu bose bakangurirwa kwirinda ikwirakwizwa ry’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, abakozi b’ikigo cy’Ubwiteganyirize mu Rwanda (RSSB) bakira abarwayi ku bitaro n’amavuririro atandukanye mu mujyi wa Kigali, bavuga ko bahagaritse umutima kuko uburyo bakoramo akazi kabo babona bishobora gushyira mu kaga ubuzima bwabo, ngo ibyago bya kwandura ni byinshi kandi ntagikorwa n’ikigo bakorera ngo nabo barindwe nk’abandi. Mu byo aba bakozi bataka harimo kutemererwa gusimburana (gukora ama shifts) no gukora igihe gito nk’uko birimo kugenda ku bandi bakozi, kudahabwa ibikoresho bihagije bibafasha kwirinda kandi bakora kwa muganga ahari urujya n’uruza rw’abantu bashobora kubamo abanduye ndetse no kuba ahenshi bakorana barenze umwe kuburyo uwanduye yahita yanduza mugenzi we. Abakozi nk’aba bakora mu ntara bo batangarije ikinyamakuru Ukwezi ko nta gikoresho na kimwe kibarinda kwandura bigeze bahabwa. Hashingiwe ku Itangazo rya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima ku ngamba zo gukomeza kurwanya ikwirakwizwa rya koronavirusi, Minisiteri y’Abakozi ba Leta n’Umurimo (MIFOTRA) iherutse kwibutsa Abakoresha kugena abakozi bakomeza gukorera aho basanzwe bakorera, abasigaye bakajya gukorera mu rugo, hitawe ku miterere y’imirimo bashinzwe. Ibi niko byagenze hirya no hino mu bigo bya Leta n’abikorera, ndetse no muri RSSB niko byagenze ku bandi bakozi uretse abakora ku bitaro n’amavuriro. Bamwe mu bakozi twaganiriye bavuga ko basabye abayobozi babo ko bajya bakora basimburana ariko ngo baheze mu gihirahiro. Umwe yagize ati: "Ahenshi usanga dukora turi babiri, kandi tugakora umunsi wose bivuga ko uwo mukorana yanduye nawe yahita akwanduza. Nko kuwa Gatandatu cyangwa ku munsi w’ikiruhuko ubusanzwe umukozi umwe akora kugera saa saba hanyuma undi akamusimbura saa saba akageza saa kumi n’imwe. Twasabye ko byanagenda uko muri iyi minsi ariko twaheze mu gihirahiro" Undi twaganiriye we yavuze ko muri iyi minsi n’ikibazo cy’imodoka zitwara abantu mu buryo bwa rusange kibakomereye, kuburyo bemerewe gukora basimburana byabafasha kugera ku kazi bitabagoye bikanatuma bakora neza akazi bashinzwe. Uyu yanavuze ku kibazo cy’ibikoresho hamwe na hamwe bidahagije nk’aho usanga agapfukamunwa gakoreshwa umunsi wose kandi hari amasaha macye umuntu yari akwiye kukambara ubundi akagasimbura. Kuva mu masaha ya mugitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kane kugeza mu masaha y’umugoroba ubwo twasohoraga iyi nkuru, twagerageje kuvugana n’uruhande rwa RSSB ariko kubona amakuru ajyanye n’icyo bavuga kuri ibi bibazo byatubereye ingorabahizi. Uwera Marie Claire, umukozi w’umusigire ushinzwe itumanaho muri RSSB, yahereye mu gitondo avuga ko mu minota micye agiye kuduhuza n’umuyobozi ugira icyo asobanura kuri icyo kibazo, kugeza ubwo yanze kongera kwitaba umunyamakuru kuri telefone ye igendanwa. Inshuro zose twahamagaye Regis Rugemanshuro, Umuyobozi mukuru wa RSSB, nabwo ntibyadukundiye kuko atigeze yitaba telefone ye igendanwa.

title: Mu Rwanda abarwaye COVID-19 bageze kuri 70, ku Isi barenze ibihumbi 720
content:
Minisiteri y’ ubuzima kuri uyu wa 29 Werurwe 2020 yatangaje ko habonetse abarwayi bashya 10 bituma abanduye bose bari mu Rwanda baba 70.
 Minisiteri y’ ubuzima kuri uyu wa 29 Werurwe 2020 yatangaje ko habonetse abarwayi bashya 10 bituma abanduye bose bari mu Rwanda baba 70. Itangazo rya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima riravuga ko muri abo bantu icumi harimo: • Abantu batandatu baje baturutse i Dubai bahita bashyirwa mu kato,
• Abantu babiri baje baturutse muri Afurika y’Epfo bahita bashyirwa mu kato,
• Umuntu umwe waje aturutse muri Nigeria ahita ashyirwa mu kato,
• Umuntu umwe wagize ingendo zitandukanye mu bihugu bya Afurika y’Iburasirazuba, ahita ashyirwa mu kato. 
 Ku Isi abamaze kwandura iyi virus barenga ibihumbi 722, abayikize ni hafi ibihumbi 152, abo imaze guhitana ni hafi ibihumbi 34. Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika nicyo gihugu cya gifite abarwayi ba covid-19 benshi kuko bamaze kuba ibihumbi 142, gikurikiwe n’ Ubutaliyani bumaze kugira abarwayi ibihumbi 97, Ubushinwa ku mwanya wa 3 bufite abarwayi 81,470.

title: Dr Utumatwishima wavuzweho kuburabuza abagore ashaka ko basambana yakingiwe ikibaba n’ABAKOMEYE?
content:
Bamwe mu bakozi b’ibitaro bya Ruhengeri n’abahoze babikoramo bakavamo kubera umwuka mubi wari urimo, bavuga ko Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah wahoze abiyobora yakingiwe ikibaba n’abakomeye barimo n’abakozi ba Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, kuburyo ngo n’ibihano yasabiwe n’Urwego rw’Umuvunyi bategereje ko bishyirwa mu bikorwa bagaheba. Bavuga ko nk’uko yakunze kubishongoraho ko ahagarikiwe n’abakomeye, babona koko ko azajya avuna umuheha akongezwa undi kuko ubu atengamaye mu bitaro bya Rwamagana asigaye ayobora.
 Bamwe mu bakozi b’ibitaro bya Ruhengeri n’abahoze babikoramo bakavamo kubera umwuka mubi wari urimo, bavuga ko Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah wahoze abiyobora yakingiwe ikibaba n’abakomeye barimo n’abakozi ba Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, kuburyo ngo n’ibihano yasabiwe n’Urwego rw’Umuvunyi bategereje ko bishyirwa mu bikorwa bagaheba. Bavuga ko nk’uko yakunze kubishongoraho ko ahagarikiwe n’abakomeye, babona koko ko azajya avuna umuheha akongezwa undi kuko ubu atengamaye mu bitaro bya Rwamagana asigaye ayobora. Nk’uko bigaragara mu rwandiko rwandikiwe Minisiteri y’Ubuzima tariki 24 Nyakanga 2019 igaragarizwa raporo ngo igire icyo ikora itange mu maguru mashya ibihano ku bagaragaweho amakosa, harimo ko Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rwakurikiranye amakuru ku bikorwa by’imyitwarire mibi yavugwaga kuri Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah wari Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Ibitaro bya Ruhengeri. Ibyo bikorwa ni ibyo kuburabuza abakozi b’abagore bakora mu Bitaro Bikuru bya Ruhengeri abashakaho imibonano mpuzabitsina, gukoresha imvugo idakwiye mu nama y’Abakozi no gukoresha nabi imodoka ya Leta binyuranyije n’amabwiriza ya Minisiteri y’Ibikorwa Remezo yo muri Nyakanga 2014 agenga imodoka za Leta n’iz’imishinga ya Leta. Ikindi ni aho yarekaga Bwana SERUHUNGO BIZIMANA Jean Paul; Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Imari n’Ubutegetsi (DAF) agakoresha imodoka ya Leta mu nyungu ze bwite. Nyuma y’Iperereza ryakozwe n’Urwego rw’Umuvunyi guhera mu kwezi kwa Kanama 2018 kugeza mu kwezi kwa Werurwe 2019 mu Bitaro Bikuru bya Ruhengeri ku myitwarire y’aba bayobozi, rwasanze Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah ahamwa n’amakosa yavuzwe haruguru. Rwasanze kandi Bwana SERUHUNGO BIZIMANA Jean Paul ahamwa n’amakosa yo gukoresha imodoka y’Ibitaro mu nyungu ze bwite ataha iwe mu karere ka Rubavu ndetse n’umushoferi umutwara nawe baturanye i Rubavu agahabwa amafaranga y’ubutumwa bw’akazi ntako yagiyemo ahubwo nawe yigiriye iwe. Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rukomeza rugira ruti: "Nyuma yo kubona ko ayo makosa ahama Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah na Bwana SERUHUNGO BIZIMANA Jean Paul, turabasaba kubafatira ibihano byo mu rwego rw’akazi, kandi mukabimenyesha Urwego rw’Umuvunyi mu gihe kitarenze iminsi mirongo itatu (30) guhera umunsi muzabonera iyi baruwa, mukurikije uburyo buteganwa n’Iteka rya Perezida No 65/01 ryo kuwa 04/03/2014 rigena uburyo bwo gutanga ibihano ku bakozi ba Leta bakoze amakosa mu kazi". Muri iyi baruwa, Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rukomeza rugira ruti: "Turabasaba kandi gukora igenzura ryimbitse ku mafaranga yose yahawe umushoferi witwa Karera Gad igihe cyose yatwaraga Bwana SERUHUNGO BIZIMANA Jean Paul atashye iwe i Rubavu kandi atagiye mu kazi. Abayobozi dusabira ibihano kuri iri kosa bazafatanye gusubiza mu isanduku ya Leta ayo mafaranga yatanzwe muri ubwo buryo butubahirije amategeko" Ubusanzwe ibyaha Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah yari yatanzweho amakuru bigakorwaho iperereza n’Urwego rw’Umuvunyi, harimo icyo kuburabuza abakozi b’abagore abashakaho imibonano mpuzabitsina, aho bamwe muri aba bahaye uru rwego ubuhamya bw’uko yagiye abasaba ko baryamana bakabyanga hanyuma akabatoteza mu kazi. Harimo kandi icy’uko hari umugore n’umugabo bakoraga muri ibi bitaro bya Ruhengeri, Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah akaza kwigarurira umugore bigatuma urwo rugo rusenyuka ndetse umugabo ubwe yitangiye ubuhamya ko yakomeje kuburabuzwa n’umuyobozi wamusambanyirizaga umugore akanamutera ubwoba ko azamufungisha, yabura uko agira agahitamo gusezera akazi. Mu bindi harimo gushakira ibyaha abo azi ko bamenye ko aburabuza abakozi b’abagore abashakaho imibonano mpuzabitsina, hakabamo gutuka abakozi mu nama abaziza ko bavuga amakuru y’ibyo akora, kwirukanisha umukozi ushinzwe abakozi kuko yamenye amakosa y’uko uwo muyobozi ashaka gukoresha imibonano mpuzabitsina ku ngufu bamwe mu bagore bakora muri ibyo bitaro n’ibindi. Gusa bimwe muri ibi, Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rwabiburiye ibimenyetso ariko ubuhamya bw’ababikorewe babimushinja rwanzura ko budakwiye kwirengagizwa ndetse ko akwiye kureka uko gukururana n’abagore. Gusa muri aba bamushinja kubaburabuza abashakaho imibonano mpuzabitsina, harimo uwo yemeye ko yaburabuje ndetse anamusabira imbabazi mu ruhame mu nama n’abandi bakozi n’ubwo ateruye ko intandaro ari ugushaka kuryamana nawe. Mu bindi yakozweho iperereza harimo no kwishongora akangisha ko ari umuyobozi mu muryango FPR Inkotanyi, aha Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rukaba rwaranabashije kumva amajwi aho yagiraga ati: "Igihe ukibanye n’Intare neza ukaba wubaha amahame, ko n’iyo bakubeshyera, iyo ukoze ikosa rimwe ugasaba imbabazi barakubabarira.". Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rwumvise amajwi (ayo majwi natwe twabashije kuyabona no kuyumva) yafashwe Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah yishongora ariko ruvuga ko rutakwemeza ibiyakubiyemo rutazi ibyari bikubiye mu byaganiriwe aho byose. Benshi mu baganiriye n’ikinyamakuru Ukwezi barimo abagikora mu bitaro bya Ruhengeri n’abahavuye bavuga ko bahunze Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah, baduhamirije ko yagiye akingirwa ikibaba na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima yayoborwaga na Dr Diane Gashumba, kuburyo n’ibihano yasabiwe n’Urwego rw’Umuvunyi yabisabiwe yarimuriwe mu bitaro bya Rwamagana ariko akaba atarigeze ahabwa igihano na kimwe. Gusa abenshi banze ko tubafata amashusho cyangwa ngo tugaragaze imyirondoro yabo kuko bavuga ko yazabakurikirana akabahemukira nk’uko yagiye abikorera abatari bacye. Willy Joseph Nshimiyimana wahoze ari umukozi ushinzwe abakozi mu bitaro bya Ruhengeri, we yemeye ko tumufata amashusho aho asobanura ibyagiye biba byose n’amakosa yakozwe na Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah ariko akaba atarayahaniwe nk’uko byasabwe n’Urwego rw’Umuvunyi. Ibyo bikorwa ni ibyo kuburabuza abakozi b’abagore bakora mu Bitaro Bikuru bya Ruhengeri abashakaho imibonano mpuzabitsina, gukoresha imvugo idakwiye mu nama y’Abakozi no gukoresha nabi imodoka ya Leta binyuranyije n’amabwiriza ya Minisiteri y’Ibikorwa Remezo yo muri Nyakanga 2014 agenga imodoka za Leta n’iz’imishinga ya Leta. Ikindi ni aho yarekaga Bwana SERUHUNGO BIZIMANA Jean Paul; Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Imari n’Ubutegetsi (DAF) agakoresha imodoka ya Leta mu nyungu ze bwite. Nyuma y’Iperereza ryakozwe n’Urwego rw’Umuvunyi guhera mu kwezi kwa Kanama 2018 kugeza mu kwezi kwa Werurwe 2019 mu Bitaro Bikuru bya Ruhengeri ku myitwarire y’aba bayobozi, rwasanze Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah ahamwa n’amakosa yavuzwe haruguru. Rwasanze kandi Bwana SERUHUNGO BIZIMANA Jean Paul ahamwa n’amakosa yo gukoresha imodoka y’Ibitaro mu nyungu ze bwite ataha iwe mu karere ka Rubavu ndetse n’umushoferi umutwara nawe baturanye i Rubavu agahabwa amafaranga y’ubutumwa bw’akazi ntako yagiyemo ahubwo nawe yigiriye iwe. Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rukomeza rugira ruti: "Nyuma yo kubona ko ayo makosa ahama Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah na Bwana SERUHUNGO BIZIMANA Jean Paul, turabasaba kubafatira ibihano byo mu rwego rw’akazi, kandi mukabimenyesha Urwego rw’Umuvunyi mu gihe kitarenze iminsi mirongo itatu (30) guhera umunsi muzabonera iyi baruwa, mukurikije uburyo buteganwa n’Iteka rya Perezida No 65/01 ryo kuwa 04/03/2014 rigena uburyo bwo gutanga ibihano ku bakozi ba Leta bakoze amakosa mu kazi". Muri iyi baruwa, Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rukomeza rugira ruti: "Turabasaba kandi gukora igenzura ryimbitse ku mafaranga yose yahawe umushoferi witwa Karera Gad igihe cyose yatwaraga Bwana SERUHUNGO BIZIMANA Jean Paul atashye iwe i Rubavu kandi atagiye mu kazi. Abayobozi dusabira ibihano kuri iri kosa bazafatanye gusubiza mu isanduku ya Leta ayo mafaranga yatanzwe muri ubwo buryo butubahirije amategeko" Ubusanzwe ibyaha Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah yari yatanzweho amakuru bigakorwaho iperereza n’Urwego rw’Umuvunyi, harimo icyo kuburabuza abakozi b’abagore abashakaho imibonano mpuzabitsina, aho bamwe muri aba bahaye uru rwego ubuhamya bw’uko yagiye abasaba ko baryamana bakabyanga hanyuma akabatoteza mu kazi. Harimo kandi icy’uko hari umugore n’umugabo bakoraga muri ibi bitaro bya Ruhengeri, Dr UTUMATWISHIMA Jean Nepo Abdalah akaza kwigarurira umugore bigatuma urwo rugo rusenyuka ndetse umugabo ubwe yitangiye ubuhamya ko yakomeje kuburabuzwa n’umuyobozi wamusambanyirizaga umugore akanamutera ubwoba ko azamufungisha, yabura uko agira agahitamo gusezera akazi. Mu bindi harimo gushakira ibyaha abo azi ko bamenye ko aburabuza abakozi b’abagore abashakaho imibonano mpuzabitsina, hakabamo gutuka abakozi mu nama abaziza ko bavuga amakuru y’ibyo akora, kwirukanisha umukozi ushinzwe abakozi kuko yamenye amakosa y’uko uwo muyobozi ashaka gukoresha imibonano mpuzabitsina ku ngufu bamwe mu bagore bakora muri ibyo bitaro n’ibindi. Gusa bimwe muri ibi, Urwego rw’Umuvunyi rwabiburiye ibimenyetso ariko ubuhamya bw’ababikorewe babimushinja rwanzura ko budakwiye kwirengagizwa ndetse ko akwiye kureka uko gukururana n’abagore.
