label: entertainment
title: Korali Galeedi yateguye igitaramo cy’imbaturamugabo yatumiyemo Dominic Ashimwe
content:
Korali Galeedi ibarizwa mu itorero rya ADEPR Kicukiro ku Mudugudu wa Nyakabanda yateguye igitaramo cyo guhimbaza Imana cyahawe intego iba mu gitabo cy’Abacamanza 6:14, igira iti : “Genda uko izo mbaraga zawe zingana… ".
 Korali Galeedi ibarizwa mu itorero rya ADEPR Kicukiro ku Mudugudu wa Nyakabanda yateguye igitaramo cyo guhimbaza Imana cyahawe intego iba mu gitabo cy’Abacamanza 6:14, igira iti : “Genda uko izo mbaraga zawe zingana… ". Korale Galeedi yatangiye umurimo w’Imana mu mwaka wa 1997 yitwa Korali Nyakabanda, nyuma yitwa Ebenezer. Nyuma y’imyaka isaga itatu iza guhindura izina yitwa Korali Galeedi, bisobanura igishyinga gihamya (Itangiriro 31 :46-48) ari na ko yitwa kuzeza uyu munsi. Iyi korali yakunze kugira umwihariko wo kuvuga ubutumwa hanze ya Kigali, mu bice by’ibyaro, hirya no hino mu Rwanda, ndetse iza kubihererwa igihembo na Isange Corporation. Iki gitaramo cyateguwe na Korali Galeedi kizaba ku Cyumweru tariki ya 22 Ukuboza 2019, saa munani zuzuye. Kizabera aho iyi korali ibarizwa, ku rusengero rwa ADEPR mu Nyakabanda, munsi y’ahahoze hoteri yitwaga Alpha Palace, i Remera, ku muhanda KK263 St. Iki gitaramo byemezwa ko ari kimwe mu byiza iyi korali iri gutegura, cyatumiwemo umuririmbyi Dominic Ashimwe, na we wemeza ko yiteguye kugeza ku bantu ubutumwa bwiza Imana imushyizemo muri iyi minsi, binyuze mu ndirimbo nziza zo guhimbaza Imana. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru, Erick Shaba, umuyobozi wa Korali Galeedi, yatumiye abantu bose kuzaza kumva ubutumwa bwiza mu ndirimbo, kuko korali yiteguye mu buryo bushoboka, kandi ngo bafite icyizere ko imitima y’abantu izahembuka. Yakomeje avuga ko iki gitaramo kizanagaragaramo Korali Sion, na yo ibarizwa kuri uyu mudugudu, izafasha Korali Galeedi kwakira no gufatanya n’abazitabira igitaramo guhimbaza Imana. Hatumiwe kandi n’itsinda ryo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana ryo muri ADEPR Nyarugenge, ndetse n’umuvugabutumwa Singirankabo Boniface. Kwinjira muri iki gitaramo ni ubuntu.

Korali Galeedi ibarizwa mu itorero rya ADEPR Kicukiro ku Mudugudu wa Nyakabanda yateguye igitaramo cyo guhimbaza Imana cyahawe intego iba mu gitabo cy’Abacamanza 6:14, igira iti : “Genda uko izo mbaraga zawe zingana… ".
 Korali Galeedi ibarizwa mu itorero rya ADEPR Kicukiro ku Mudugudu wa Nyakabanda yateguye igitaramo cyo guhimbaza Imana cyahawe intego iba mu gitabo cy’Abacamanza 6:14, igira iti : “Genda uko izo mbaraga zawe zingana… ". Korale Galeedi yatangiye umurimo w’Imana mu mwaka wa 1997 yitwa Korali Nyakabanda, nyuma yitwa Ebenezer. Nyuma y’imyaka isaga itatu iza guhindura izina yitwa Korali Galeedi, bisobanura igishyinga gihamya (Itangiriro 31 :46-48) ari na ko yitwa kuzeza uyu munsi. Iyi korali yakunze kugira umwihariko wo kuvuga ubutumwa hanze ya Kigali, mu bice by’ibyaro, hirya no hino mu Rwanda, ndetse iza kubihererwa igihembo na Isange Corporation. Iki gitaramo cyateguwe na Korali Galeedi kizaba ku Cyumweru tariki ya 22 Ukuboza 2019, saa munani zuzuye. Kizabera aho iyi korali ibarizwa, ku rusengero rwa ADEPR mu Nyakabanda, munsi y’ahahoze hoteri yitwaga Alpha Palace, i Remera, ku muhanda KK263 St. Iki gitaramo byemezwa ko ari kimwe mu byiza iyi korali iri gutegura, cyatumiwemo umuririmbyi Dominic Ashimwe, na we wemeza ko yiteguye kugeza ku bantu ubutumwa bwiza Imana imushyizemo muri iyi minsi, binyuze mu ndirimbo nziza zo guhimbaza Imana. Mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru, Erick Shaba, umuyobozi wa Korali Galeedi, yatumiye abantu bose kuzaza kumva ubutumwa bwiza mu ndirimbo, kuko korali yiteguye mu buryo bushoboka, kandi ngo bafite icyizere ko imitima y’abantu izahembuka. Yakomeje avuga ko iki gitaramo kizanagaragaramo Korali Sion, na yo ibarizwa kuri uyu mudugudu, izafasha Korali Galeedi kwakira no gufatanya n’abazitabira igitaramo guhimbaza Imana. Hatumiwe kandi n’itsinda ryo kuramya no guhimbaza Imana ryo muri ADEPR Nyarugenge, ndetse n’umuvugabutumwa Singirankabo Boniface. Kwinjira muri iki gitaramo ni ubuntu.

content:

 Joseph Akinfenwa Donus ukomoka muri Nigeria umaze kwamamara nka azataramira abanyakigali muri Kigali Jazz Junction izaba mu mpera z’iyi weekend . Joe Boy azafatanya n’abandi bahanzi babanyarwanda nka Davis D  ukwunzwe mu ndirimbo Dede ndetse na Niyo Bosco ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona ukunzwe mu ndirimbo “ubigenza ute “ndetse ufite n’ubuhanga mu gucuranga gitari . label: entertainment
title: Melodie,P Fly na Riderman mu bazaririmba hamurikwa ihuriro ryitezweho kuzamura umuziki w’ u Rwanda
content:
Ihuriro ry’abanyamakuru b’Imyidagaduro mu Rwanda (RSJF ) ryateguye igitaramo cyo kumurika iri huriro ku mugaragaro kizitabirwa na bamwe mu bahanzi bakunzwe mu Rwanda .
 Ihuriro ry’abanyamakuru b’Imyidagaduro mu Rwanda (RSJF ) ryateguye igitaramo cyo kumurika iri huriro ku mugaragaro kizitabirwa na bamwe mu bahanzi bakunzwe mu Rwanda . Iki gitaramo cyo kumurika ku mugaragaro Ihuriro ry’Abanyamakuru b’Imyidagaduro mu Rwanda [Rwanda Showbiz Journalist Forum] kizabera muri  Kigali Conference and Exhibition Village tariki 06 Ukuboza 2019 mu ihema rya  igitaramo. Iki gitaramo cyateguwe ku bufatanye n’Urugaga rwa Muzika mu Rwanda, cyatumiwemo abahanzi batandukanye bakunzwe mu Rwanda barimo Tom Close uzakiyobora, Riderman, Fireman, PFLA, Yverry, Ruti Joel, Peace Jolis, Andy Bumuntu, Alyn Sano na Uncle Austin. Murenzi Emmanuel [Emmalito],  umwe mubayobozi biri huriro yavuze ko ari ibyo kwishimira kuba abanyamakuru b’imyidagaduro barabashije kwishyira hamwe  kandi harimo inyungu nyishi  ku banyamakuru. Ati ‘Tugiye kubona impinduka ku banyamakuru bakora imyidagaduro kuko tuzagira ibintu byinshi bitandukanye yaba ari amahugurwa, kwiyungura ubumenyi kugira ngo natwe umusanzu dutanga mu myidagaduro urusheho kuba unoze.” Yakomeje avuga ko iki gitaramo cyo kumurika ihuriro giteguye neza kuburyo bwose  . Yagize ati “Ni ukuri turashaka kwizeza abanyarwanda turashaka kwizeza  buri muntu wese uzaza mu gitaramo y’uko ari igitaramo giteguye neza giteguwe  ni n’abanyamakuru bakora imyidagaduro kandi nabo bashaka gushyira imbaraga mu kuzamura umuziki nyarwanda ”. 
 Emmalito avuga ko kwishyirahamwe kw’abanyamakuru b’imyidagaduro bituma barushaho kunga ubumwe . Iki gitaramo cyateguranwe umwihariko kandi  n’umwanya mwiza wo kwagura ubufatanye hagati y’abakora ubuhanzi ndetse n’abanyamakuru b’imyidagaduro, nka zimwe mu nzego zikwiye gufatanya umunsi ku munsi. Umuraperi P-Fla uzaririmba muri iki gitaramo avuga  ko amaze iminsi ashyira hanze indirimbo zitandukanye ndetse ko no mu minsi iri imbere ashyira hanze indi indirimbo yakoranye na Jay Polly. Yavuze ko yiteguye kwiyereka abafana be mu isura nshya. Ati “Ikintu nabwira abafana b’umuziki P-Fla arahari cyane kandi azaza akaze cyane .” Yongeyeho ko ari ishema kuba azafatanya n’abanyamakuru kumurika ihuriro ryabo kuko  aribo bagira uruhare mu kuzamura abahanzi . Yagize ati "Ni ishema gukorana n’abanyamakuru kumurika ihuriro ryanyu iyo mwishyize hamwe n’imbaraga kuri twe kuko tuzakorana n’abantu bunze ubumwe" 
 P-Fla yiteguye gususurutsa abantu bazitabira iki gitaramo  Iki gitaramo kizayorwa na MC Anita Pendo na Mc Tino bakanyujijeho mu kuyobora ibitaramo mu Rwanda cyane cyane muri Guma Guma . Kwinjira muri iki gitaramo ni amafaranga ibihumbi bitatu ku banyeshuri, ibihimbi bitanu mu myanya isanzwe ku bantu bakuru n’ibihumbi 10 mu myanya y’icyubahiro. Amatike yatangiye gucuruzwa ku rubuga rwa interineti rwa www.ticket.rw.

title: Jules Sentore yavuze impamvu atatumiye Muyango,Nyiranyamibwa  na Teta Daina mu gitaramo cye
content:
Jules Sentore  umuririmbyi w’ijyana gakondo  ari mu myiteguro y’igitaramo yise ‘Inganzo yaratabaye’ kigamije kubwira no kwereka Abanyarwanda uruhare rw’inganzo mu kubohora igihugu.
 Jules Sentore  umuririmbyi w’ijyana gakondo  ari mu myiteguro y’igitaramo yise ‘Inganzo yaratabaye’ kigamije kubwira no kwereka Abanyarwanda uruhare rw’inganzo mu kubohora igihugu. Kuri uyu wa kabiri tariki 2 Nyakanga 2019 Sentore yagiranye ikiganiro n’itangazamakuru asobanura aho imyiteguro y’iki gitaramo igeze ndetse atangaza nabo bazafatanya muri iki gitaramo , yataumiye nyirarume Masamba Intore, Ingangare babyara be basanzwe baba  mu Bubiligi, Ibihame Cultural Troupe ndetse n’abagize Gakondo Group yubatse izina rikomeye mu gutaramira abanywanye n’umuco nyarwanda muri rusange . Muri iki kiganiro n’itangazamakuru Sentore yari kumwe  Ntazinda Marcel Umuyobozi wa Gakondo Group, wabwiye itangazamakuru ko batirengagije gutumira bamwe mu bahanzi bakuru bahimbye indirimbo zifashishijwe ku rugamba rwo kubohora igihugu. Yagize ati "Ntabwo twirengagije gutumira abahanzi bakuru bafite indirimbo zifashishijwe ku rugamba oya ahubwo twashatse guha umwanya abakiri bato ngo bagaragaze koko igihe baba basigiwe inkoni yo gukomera ku muco gakondo no gukomeza guhanga ibihangano byubaka abanyarwanda  babibasha’’. Yakomeje avuga ko baganirije abo bahanzi bakuru barimo Muyango na Nyiranyamibwa bakasaba kwitabira igitaramo gusa bamwe muri bo ntibabonetse nka Nyiranyamibwa ubu uri mu Bubiligi . 
 Ingangare babyara ba Sentore basanzwe baba  mu Bubiligi bazafatanya nawe muri iki gitaramo . Jules yavuze ko yiteguye kuko amaze amezi 7 ari mu myiteguro yagize ati” nakoze imyiteguro ihagije ‘ijana ku ijana’ kandi  na bagenzi bange  biteguye kugaragaza ‘ubuhanga n’ubutore’ mu gitaramo nahaye umwihariko w’injyana Gakondo nakoze  ngacika intege ariko nkongera nkabyuka”. Yakomeje avuga ko atigeze ajenjeka mu bijyanye n’umukino, imbyino, ibihangano n’ibindi azerekana muri iki gitaramo avuga ko atari ibyo kubwira abantu mu mugambo ahubwo  bazabibona no mu bikorwa. Sentore yavuze ko Teta Diana yagombaga kwitabira iki gitaramo ariko kiza guhurirana n’izindi gahunda yarafite bituma ataboneka . 
 Sentore yavuze ko yari kwishimira kuba hamwe na Teta Diana ariko ntibyakunze . Kwinjira muri iki gitaramo mu myanya isanzwe ni ibihumbi icumi (10 000 Frw), muri VIP ku muntu umwe ni ibihumbi mirongo itatu (30 000 Frw), ku meza y’abantu umunani ni ibihumbi Magana abiri ( 200 000 Frw). Igitaramo ‘Inganzo Yaratabaye’ kizabera muri Kigali Conference and Exhibition Village ahazwi nka Camp Kigali, kuya 05 Nyakanga 2019.

title: Ibyabaye kuri Michael Jacson umunota ku wundi  umunsi  apfa

 Itariki nk’ iy’ uyu munsi ya 25 Kamena mu mwaka wa 2009 nibwo icyamamare Michael Jackson yararembye bikomeye yihutanwa ku bitaro. Menya uruhererekane rw’ ibyamubayeho uwo munsi birimo no kuba imbuga nkoranyambaga zaragize ikibazo kubera gusurwa cyane. Ikinyamakuru TMZ cyariho kizamura kwizerwa kwacyo mu kwandika amakuru yihuse y’imyidagaduro cyanditse ko uyu muhanzi ari muri Coma. Michael Jackson, ni izina rikomeye mu mateka ya muzika ku isi, abantu benshi ntibahise bizera ukuri kw’aya makuru. Ian Youngs yibutsa ko hari hashize igihe bivugwa ko uyu mwami w’injyana ya Pop arwaye kanseri y’uruhu, nubwo nyuma uruhande rwe rwabihakanye. Muri iryo joro abanyamakuru benshi ku isi bahise batangira gukurikirana cyane iby’ubuzima bwa Jackson. Ibiro bya BBC i Los Angeles byahamagaye abavugizi, inshuti n’abakorana na Jackson ariko nta n’umwe wagize icyo yemeza, bamwe bakuragaho telephone zabo. Nyuma gato, TMZ yahise yandika ko Michael Jackson yapfuye. Ian Youngs avuga ko yatunguwe akiyumvira umwanya. Jackson nubwo yari yarashinjwe ibirego birimo gusambanya abana bato nta washidikanyaga ko ariwe muhanzi wa Pop wari imbere y’abandi bose mu myaka 30 ishize. Iby’ubuzima bwe byari bimaze iminsi bizwi ko atameze neza, ariko iby’iri joro nta makuru afatika isi yabashije kubona. Hari hashize ibyumweru bicye avuye mu bitaramo i Londres, ndetse kuri iyi tariki ya 25 mu masaha y’igicuku yari yakoze imyiteguro i Lod Angeles ya konseri zindi nk’uko ikinyamakuru 83Minutes kibivuga. Gupfa kwe bisa n’ibyatunguranye, gusa muganga we nyuma yemeje ko Michael Jackson yari amaze imyaka myinshi adashobora gusinzira kereka ahawe imiti imusinziriza. Dr Conrad Murray, umuganga we bwite wahembwaga $150,000 ku kwezi, yari amutegereje mu rugo atashye. Mu cyumba cye habaga harimo amacupa y’ibinini, uducupa tw’imiti banywa cyangwa bitera, inshinge n’ibindi. Dr Murray yabwiye polisi ko yari amaze iminsi aha Jackson umuti witwa propofol - umuti uterwa abagiye kubagwa ku bitaro mu majoro 60 kugeza tariki 22 z’ukwa gatandatu 2009 kugira ngo abashe gusinzira. Mu masaha ya mu gitondo kare tariki 25 z’ukwa gatandatu, Dr Murray yahaye Jackson indi miti kugira ngo asinzire, ariko iyi miti avuga ko itakoze kuko Jackson yari afite igishyika cya konseri zindi yateguraga. Byageze saa yine z’igitondo Jackson atarasinzira. Dr Murray yabwiye polisi ko Jackson yamwinginze ngo amuhe ’amata’ kugira ngo asinzire aha ngo yasobanuraga propofol ijya gusa n’amata. Uyu muganga yaremeye amutera uyu muti mu mutsi ahagana saa yine n’iminota minrongo ine. Dr Murray avuga ko yari afite ibikoresho byose bituma abasha gukurikirana umutima, umwuka mu maraso n’ibindi kuri Jackson, ndetse ko yamugumye iruhande nyuma gato akajya kwiyuhagira.Agarutse ngo yasanze Jackson adahumeka. Gusa iby’amasaha yavuze bishidikanywaho hagendewe ku majwi ye yafashwe kuri telephone aho yavugaga ko ibyo byabayeho mbere gato ya saa sita z’amanywa. Uyu muganga avuga ko yakurikijeho kugerageza gusubiza umwuka uyu muhanzi. Avuga ko atashoboraga guhamagara 911 (ubutabazi) kuko nawe yariho akora ubutabazi, gusa ko yahamagaye umwe mu bashinzwe umutekano wa Jackson. Ubutabazi babuhamagaye 12:21 ku isaha y’aho. Dr Murray avugwaho ko yabanje gusaba uyu ushinzwe umutekano kuvana mu cyumba ibikoresho by’imiti byose. Abana ba Jackson Prince na Paris bari mu rugo ibi byose biba, ariko bahiye ubwoba. Ubwo abatabazi bageraga mu rugo bavuga ko batabashije kumenya Jackson. Yagaragaraga nk’umuntu wazonzwe, unanutse cyane. Arebye uko yari ameze, umutabazi Richard Senneff yavuze ko yabonaga ari nk’umurwayi w’indembe igeze mu minsi ya nyuma. Bahise bamujyana ku bitaro biri hafi (UCLA medical center) aho bakomereje ibikorwa byo kumugarurira umwuka. Hashize isaha imwe n’iminota 13 bemeje ko byarangiye. Abafana be n’abanyamakuru bari bamaze kugera ku bitaro. Saa munani n’iminota 44 z’amanywa TMZ niyo yatangaje inkuru bwa mbere ko Jackson yapfuye, hari saa sita na 44 z’ijoro mu Rwanda n’i Burundi. 
 Abenshi kw’isi bari bagikeneye kumenya niba koko Michael Jackson byarangiye, abantu basuye Internet mu buryo budasanzwe. Google yageze aho itabasha gutanga amakuru (results) ku bayibajije Michael Jackson kuko uburyo (software) ikoresha bwibeshye ko kuyibaza kenshi iri jambo ari igitero bwagabweho. Twitter, Los Angeles Times, TMZ, Wikipedia na Messenger zose zagize ibibazo bya tekiniki kubera abazisuye benshi uwo mugoroba. Kugeza saa tanu n’igice z’ijoro z’ijoro (ku isaha ngengamasaha), umunyamakuru wa BBC Richard Bacon, yabwiye abakurikira BBC ko afite amakuru ahagije yemeza urupfu rw’iki cyamamare. Hashize imyaka ibiri, Dr Conrad Murray yahamijwe icyaha cy’ubwicanyi butagambiriwe afungwa igihe kituzuye neza imyaka ibiri muri ine yakatiwe. Iby’urupfu rwa Jackson n’iby’ibyaha yashinjwaga byavuzweho byinshi mu myaka 10 ishize, muzika ye nayo izaguma mu mitima ya benshi.

title: Sunny wahembye umufana 500.000, yavuze uko atazi uwo babyaranye, uko yambara ubusa n’ibindi
content:
Ingabire Sunny, umuhanzikazi akaba n’umunyamidelikazi ukunze kwibera mu gihugu cya Thailand ndetse no mu bindi bihugu bitandukanye, yavuzwe cyane mu minsi ishize ubwo yatangazaga ko amaze amezi abiri hanze bigatuma yaribagiwe Ikinyarwanda. Yakomeje kuvugisha benshi ku mbuga nkoranyambaga kubera bimwe mu byo akora no mu byo avuga. Ubu yahembye umufana we amafaranga y’u Rwanda 500.000, agira icyo abivugaho anatangaza byinshi ku buzima bwe birimo uburyo yabyaye ari isugi akaba atazi uwo babyaranye.
 Ingabire Sunny, umuhanzikazi akaba n’umunyamidelikazi ukunze kwibera mu gihugu cya Thailand ndetse no mu bindi bihugu bitandukanye, yavuzwe cyane mu minsi ishize ubwo yatangazaga ko amaze amezi abiri hanze bigatuma yaribagiwe Ikinyarwanda. Yakomeje kuvugisha benshi ku mbuga nkoranyambaga kubera bimwe mu byo akora no mu byo avuga. Ubu yahembye umufana we amafaranga y’u Rwanda 500.000, agira icyo abivugaho anatangaza byinshi ku buzima bwe birimo uburyo yabyaye ari isugi akaba atazi uwo babyaranye. Mu kiganiro kirekire cy’amashusho twagiranye na Sunny kuri iki Cyumweru, yadutangarije uburyo agiye guhigura umuhigo wo guhemba 500.000 uwarushije abandi kubyina neza indirimbo "Kungora" yakoranye na Bruce Melodie. Ibi yaraye anabisohoje muri Sun City i Nyamirambo, aho itsinda rya KDP ari ryo ryahawe igihembo, nyuma go guhatanira imbere y’abagize akanama nkemurampaka batatu. 
 Sunny yabwiye ikinyamakuru Ukwezi ko iyi ndirimbo imaze kumutwara arenga miliyoni 30 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. agikomeje kuyishoraho andi mu kuyiteza imbere. Yanagarutse ku yindi mishinga ye irimo indirimbo nshya yise Property, iyi akaba yaranashyize hanze ikirango cyayo akoresheje ifoto yambaye ikariso n’isutiye gusa, ibintu avuga ko atari ukwambara ubusa ndetse ngo binabaye ngombwa asanga kwambara ubusa ntacyo bitwaye. Sunny yatuganirije byinshi ku buzima bwe no ku mishinga ye. Yagarutse ku kuntu abwira abantu ko umwana afite atazi uwo bamubyaranye bakabihakana, nyamara ngo ari ko kuri kwe. Avuga ko yasamye akiri isugi kandi ngo nta mugabo bari barigeze banegerana, ariko agakeka ko yatwariye inda mu bwogero (Piscine) kuko yakundaga kujyamo kenshi kandi abaganga bakaba baramubwiye ko umugabo asizemo intanga byatuma asama. REBA VIDEO UKO SUNNY ABISOBANURA HANO: Sunny kandi muri iki kiganiro yagarutse ku by’uko yitukuje, asobanura akayabo byamutwaye ndetse ashimangira ko atabyicuza, kandi ngo afite umushinga wo kugeza ku Banyarwandakazi amavuta meza yabafasha kwitukuza bakagira uruhu rusa neza. Ashimangira ko uko byagenda kose ntacyatuma Abanyafurikakazi batitukuza kubera impamvu zitandukanye. Yavuze kandi ku myambaro ye n’akayabo imutwara, avuga ku mugabo we uba muri Kenya no ku bindi byinshi bitandukanye. REBA VIDEO IBITANGAJE SUNNY YADUTANGARIJE HANO:

label: entertainment
title: Commando wamamaye muri filime yakubitiwe muri Afurika y’ Epfo
content:
Arnold Alois Schwarzenegger wamamaye muri filime nka Terminator, Predator, Commando bigatuma abenshi bamufata nk’ umuntu w’ igihangange mu mirwano  yaragaye muri Video yakwiragijwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yerekanye aterwa umugeri mu gihe yari mu mikino yamwitiriwe iri kubera muri Afriya y’Epfo.
 Arnold Alois Schwarzenegger wamamaye muri filime nka Terminator, Predator, Commando bigatuma abenshi bamufata nk’ umuntu w’ igihangange mu mirwano  yaragaye muri Video yakwiragijwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yerekanye aterwa umugeri mu gihe yari mu mikino yamwitiriwe iri kubera muri Afriya y’Epfo. Schwarzenegger wanabaye Guverineri w’Intara ya California muri Leta zunze Ubumwe za Amerika yakubiswe umugeri w’inyuma ubwo yaganiraga n’abakunzi be mu gihe harimo kuba irushanwa ryo gusimbuka umugozi mu mikino yamwitiriwe,yitwa ‘Arnold Classic Africa’. Uwa wumuteye yerekanwe nawe afashwe amaze kuwumukubita. Naho Schwarzenegger we yashimiye abakunzi be ku myitwarire bagaragaje, ariko ko nta kibazo byamuteye. Iyo video yakwiragijwe cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga mu mpera z’ icyumweru gishize yerekana umugabo yasimbukiye kuri Schwarzenegger akamutera umugeri mu gihe yarimo yifotoza n’abakunzi be anifotozanya nabo muri iyo mikino yarimo ibera mu mujyi wa Johannesburg. Schwarzenegger yandikiye abakunzi be barenga miliyoni enye bamukurikirana kuri Twitter ati “Nabanje gutekereza ko narimo nsunikwa n’abafana kuko ibyo bibaho inshuro nyinshi. Nagiye kumenya ko nakubiswe, mbonye iyo video nka mwe mwese.” Polisi y’ Afuria y’ Epfo yatangaje ko uwateye umugeri uyu munyamerika wo muri Australia yahise atabwa muri yombi. Commando yasabye abakunzi be ko bashishikazwa n’abarimo kurushanwa iby’uko yakubiswe umugeri bakabyirengagiza. Yanditse ati “Dufite imkino 90 hano muri Afrika y’Epfo yitiriwe ArnoldSports, ihuza abarushanwa ibihumbi 24 b’imyaka itandukanye n’impano zitandukanye. Reka tubahe icyo cyubahiro.” Iryo rushanwa Arnold Classic Africa rihora riba mu kwezi kwa Gatanu buri mwaka, rikaba rigizwe n’imikino itandukanye, harimo imikino ngorangingo ndetse n’iyo kurwana.

title: Miss Mwiseneza Josiane yasobanuye ikibazo yagiranye na Meya wa Rwamagana n’ impamvu yahisemo kwicecekera
content:
Nyampinga w’ u Rwanda wakunze muri 2019 , Mwiseneza Josiane yavuze ko atemeranya n’ Umuyobozi w’ akarere ka Rwamagana wavuze ko impamvu ibikorwa yagombaga gukorera muri aka karere byaburijwemo ari uko atabamenyesheje mbere, ngo Josiane yirinze kugira icyo abivugaho mu rwego rwo kwirinda kubahuka umuyobozi.
 Nyampinga w’ u Rwanda wakunze muri 2019 , Mwiseneza Josiane yavuze ko atemeranya n’ Umuyobozi w’ akarere ka Rwamagana wavuze ko impamvu ibikorwa yagombaga gukorera muri aka karere byaburijwemo ari uko atabamenyesheje mbere, ngo Josiane yirinze kugira icyo abivugaho mu rwego rwo kwirinda kubahuka umuyobozi. Yabitangaje mu kiganiro yagiranye n’ abanyamakuru kuri uyu wa Gatanu tariki 19 Mata 2019, aho yanerekanye umujyanama we mu bijyanye no gushira mu bikorwa umushinga we wo kurwanya igwingira mu bana. Tariki 20 Gashyantare 2019 nibwo Miss Josiane yagombaga gukorera mu karere ka Rwamagana ubukangurambaga bwo kurwanya igwira mu bana. Uwo munsi Miss Josiane yabwiye UKWEZI ko ubu bukangurambaga bwahagaritswe ariko yirinda kugira byinshi asobanura kuri iki kibazo. Umuyobozi w’ akarere ka Rwamagana , Mbonyumuvunyi Radjab, uwo munsi yatubwiye ko impamvu ibikorwa bya Miss Josiane byaburijwemo ari uko atabimenyesheje akarere mu nyandiko. 

Miss Mwiseneza Josiane na Manager we Sunday James Ejo tariki 19 Mata nibwo Miss Josiane yavuze ko ibyo meya Mbonyumuvunyi yavuze atari ko byagenze. Yagize ati “Twarabyumvikanye twandika ibaruwa, nan’ ubu ushatse kuyireba nakwereka iyasigaye. Baduha umurenge baduha n’ itariki. Nyuma y’ ibyo rero nibwo yanze ngo twebwe mu karere kacu ntabwo harimo igwingira, nta kibazo gihari, ati ahubwo mwebwe mugende murebe aho rikabije, nimuharangiza natwe muzatugarukaho ariko uyu munsi wanone ntabwo turi mubafite icyo kibazo” Icyo gihe, Meya Mbonyumuvunyi yatubwiye ko atahagaritse ubukangurambaga bwa Miss Josiane ati “Ayo makuru nanjye nayumvise gutyo sinzi aho yaturutse, na Josiane namwandikiye mubaza niba ari we wayatanze ntabwo yansubije… Josiane ni umunyarwanda icyo yashaka kubwira Abanyarwanda yakivuga, ikibazo ni uko atigeze abitumenyesha kandi ntabwo waza mu karere ngo uze ukore igitaramo utarigeze ubibwira abayobozi” Miss Josiane yavuze ko impamvu yirinze kugira icyo arenza ku byo Meya yabwiye itangazamakuru ko ubukangurambaga bwahagaritswe kuko atamenyesheje akarere, ari uko yabonaga abafana be batangiye kubahuka Meya Radjab kandi bidakwiye. Yagize ati “Ntabwo njye yigeze abwira ikibazo cyo kutamumenyesha hakiri kare. Yarabivuze mu itangazamakuru ariko njye ntabwo yigeze atabimbwira kandi twandika umurenge batubwiye njye ntabwo narinywuzi. Ntabwo yigeze ampamagara n’ ubu nan’ ubu nabivuga” Yongeye ati “Habayeho indi mbogamizi nabonaga ishobora no ku nkoraho kuko Abanyarwanda babifashe nabi batangira no kumwubahuka, batangira no kumutuka. Bitewe n’ uburyo nabonaga abafana banjye bamutuka kandi bidakwiye, nararebye nsanga icyo aribuvuge mbyihoreye nkicecekera ntacyo byantwara” 

Miss Josiane yagiranye ikiganiro n’ itangazamakuru asobanura ibijyanye no gushyira mu bikorwa umushinga we Sunday James, manager wa Miss Josiane yavuze ibikorwa byose bigira inzira binyura, bityo ko batavuga ko Meya yabeshye cyangwa ko yavuze ibyo atazi kuko azi akarere ayoboye kurenza abandi bantu. Ati “Akarere gakoramo abantu benshi, Josiane ashobora kumenyesha umunyambana, umunyamabanga ntamenyeshe, Meya , Meya bikamugwaho atabizi. Nibwira ko yaba meya, yaba Josiane buri wese afite mu nshingano kurengera abo bana” Miss Josiane yavuze ko ibyabaye mu karere ka Rwamagana babikuyemo isomo kuko ngo magingo aya bavuganye na Minisiteri y’ Ubuzima, Ikigo cy’ igihugu mbonezamikurire y’ abana kugira abe aribo babereka aho bahera ubukangurambaga bwabo kuko arizo nzego za Leta zishinzwe by’ umwihariko kurwanya igwingira. Ibyo Meya wa Rwamagana yabwiye itangazamakuru ku bijyanye n’ ihagarikwa ry’ igikorwa cya Miss Josiane Mwiseneza

content:
Indirimbo iba nziza bitewe n’ ubutumwa buyirimo, uburyo ikurura amarangamutima y’ uyumva, uburyohe bw’ ijwi ryayo, n’ uburebure ifite.
 Indirimbo iba nziza bitewe n’ ubutumwa buyirimo, uburyo ikurura amarangamutima y’ uyumva, uburyohe bw’ ijwi ryayo, n’ uburebure ifite. Urubuga To10songs.com rukora intoned z’ uko indirimbo zirushanya ubwiza ruvuga ko kuva muri Nyakanga 2004 kugeza m’ Ukuboza 2013, indirimbo nziza zareberwaga kuzadawunilodinzwe cyane. Kuva muri Mutarama 2014 kugera muri Kanama 2018, indirimbo zikunzwe zareberwaga kuzadawunilodinzwe cyane hakanarebwa uburyo zatowe. Kuva muri Nzeli 2018 kugeza ubu uru rubuga ruri gutondeka indirimbo nziza rushingiwe kuko zatowe no ku butumwa buhindura. label: entertainment
title: Junior Multisystem waciwe ukuboko yari aherutse kubwira Oda Paccy igisa n’ ubuhanuzi
content:
Umuraperikazi Uzamberumwana Pacifique [Oda Paccy] yavuze ko Producer  Junior Multisystem bakoranaga muri studio yo ye Empire studio yari aherutse kumubwira ngo "Paccy ngwino dukore bigishoboka ufatirana ibintu bigishoboka ".
 Umuraperikazi Uzamberumwana Pacifique [Oda Paccy] yavuze ko Producer  Junior Multisystem bakoranaga muri studio yo ye Empire studio yari aherutse kumubwira ngo "Paccy ngwino dukore bigishoboka ufatirana ibintu bigishoboka ". Magingo aya amakuru aturuka ku barwaza ba Producer Junior Multisystem aremeza ko abaganga bamaze kumuca ukuboko. Uku kuboko kwangirikiye bikomeye mu mpanuka y’ imodoka yamugonze tariki 30 Werurwe 2019 ubwo yatemberaga I Remera mu mujyi wa Kigali n’ amaguru. Oda Paccy yabanye igihe kinini na Junior Multisystem. Afite indirimbo nyinshi yakorewe nawe zatumye aba uwo ari we uyu munsi. Indirimbo nka: ‘Gangster Love’, ‘Music’, ‘Banseka’, ‘Nzakuzire’, ‘Ndi uwawe’, ‘Miss President’, ‘Umusirimu’, ‘Love ya weekend’, ‘Igikuba’, ‘Igitego’, Order’, ‘Ibyatsi’. Mu butumwa Oda Paccy yashyize kuri instagram yavuze ko byinshi yavuga kuri Junior ndetse ko mu minsi ishize yamusanze amusaba gufatirana igihe bagakora indirimbo. Ati “ Mfite byinshi byo kukuvugaho ariko icyo ntakwibagirwa kurenza ibindi mu minsi ishize waraje urakora nta gahunda nari mfite yo gukora ‘recording’ ariko warambwiye ngo ‘Paccy ngwino dukore bigishoboka ufatirana ibintu bigishoboka ” . Uyu muraperikazi yakomeje avuga ko iyi ndirimbo yakozwe ikarangira neza ariko ko ‘ntawari uzi uko imbere bimeze’. Ati “Ikiruta byose ni URIHO” 
 Si Oda Paccy gusa wagaragaje ko icibwa ry’ ukuboko kwa Producer Junior Multisystem ryamubabaje kuko n’ abandi bahanzi barimo Ama g The Black, Queen Cha, Safi Madiba, Princess Pricilla bagaragaje akababaro batewe Princess Priscillah Umuratwa Princess Priscillah yanditse avuga ko bwa mbere yahuye na Junior Multisystem muri 2011. Yibuka ko bahura yumvaga ko atamufasha ariko ngo  yaramusekeye ndetse amufasha byihariye mu nzira y’umuziki yatangiye. Avuga ko adashobora kwibagirwa imirimo myiza yamukoreye. Ama G The Black Sinzi icyo navuga gusa Imana ikomeze kukuba hafi ninjira muri studio bwambere nuyu mugabo wanyakiriye haribyo umuntu abona akabura icyo yarenzaho gusa Imana ikomeze igufashe @juniormultisystem 
 Safi Madiba Kimwe kimwe,Umwanzuro,rekamfukame,babylove,Adam na Eva,umfatiye runini,bagupfusha ubusa,simubure,ibitenge nizindi nyinshi n’ayamaboko mureba yazikoze Bantu musenga ndabasabye mudufashe gusenga IMANA ikore ibitangaza ukuboko ntibaguce amasengesho arakenewe yanyu 
 Uncle Austin yanditse avuga ko ukuboko kw’ibumuso kwa Junior kwaciwe kwamukoreye indirimbo ‘Bagupfusha ubusa’, ‘Nzamira igisasu kubwabwe’. ‘Dududu’, ‘It’s Love’ [Yakoranye na Marina Deborah], ‘Fata Fata’ yatumye atangira guhangwa amaso na benshi n’izindi nyinshi. Yamubwiye ko amukunda kandi azahora ari kumwe nawe amuzirikana mu masengesho ye. Yagize ati ‘Ubuzima ni bubi rimwe na rimwe burangwa n’ubugome. Junior uri mu ba-‘producers’ nkunda cyane yakoze indirimbo yanjye iheruka none yaciwe ukuboko.  Ukuboko kwe kwaduhaye byinshi byiza. Birababaje cyane ndibaza ubu uko amerewe.” 
 Umuraperi Jay Polly Umuraperi Tuyishime Joshua wiyise Jay Polly yavuze ko inkuru y’uko Junior yaciwe ukuboko yamutashyeho kandi ‘biteye ubwoba’. Yasabye Imana gukomeza kubana na Junior muri ibi bihe bitoroshye kuri we. Yavuze ko mu ndirimbo yamukoreye harimo na ‘Ndacyariho ndamuheka’ yakunzwe bikomeye. 
 Producer Lick Lick Producer Mbabazi Lick Lick yabanye igihe kinini na Junior Multisystem muri studio yitwa Unlimited Records, nta byinshi yanditse gusaba yabwiye ‘Junior ko ari kumwe nawe kandi amusengera’ Queen Cha Mugemana Yvonne [Queen Cha] ubarizwa yavuze ko Junior ari we warambitse ibiganza ku ndirimbo ‘Icyaha ndacyemera’, ‘Kizimyamoto’, ‘Baby Love’ [Yakoranye na Safi], ‘Ishusho y’urukundo’, ‘Ntawe nkura’ n’izindi nyinshi zatumye uyu muhanzikazi ahagarara neza mu bandi bakora umuziki. 
 Queen Cha yavuze ko mu masengesho ye azirikana Junior Multisystem asaba Imana kumukomeza muri ibi bihe bitoroshye ari kunyuramo. Junior yakoze muri studio zitandukanye nka Unlimited Records, Touch Records, Round Music, kuri ubu akaba yari amaze igihe gito atangiye gukorera muri studio ya Oda Paccy yitwa Empire Records.

 Producer Lick Lick Producer Mbabazi Lick Lick yabanye igihe kinini na Junior Multisystem muri studio yitwa Unlimited Records, nta byinshi yanditse gusaba yabwiye ‘Junior ko ari kumwe nawe kandi amusengera’ Queen Cha Mugemana Yvonne [Queen Cha] ubarizwa yavuze ko Junior ari we warambitse ibiganza ku ndirimbo ‘Icyaha ndacyemera’, ‘Kizimyamoto’, ‘Baby Love’ [Yakoranye na Safi], ‘Ishusho y’urukundo’, ‘Ntawe nkura’ n’izindi nyinshi zatumye uyu muhanzikazi ahagarara neza mu bandi bakora umuziki. 
 Queen Cha yavuze ko mu masengesho ye azirikana Junior Multisystem asaba Imana kumukomeza muri ibi bihe bitoroshye ari kunyuramo. Junior yakoze muri studio zitandukanye nka Unlimited Records, Touch Records, Round Music, kuri ubu akaba yari amaze igihe gito atangiye gukorera muri studio ya Oda Paccy yitwa Empire Records.

title: Shaddyboo yogeje imodoka yambaye impenure [AMAFOTO]
content:
Umunyamideli Mbabazi Shadia, abenshi bazi nka Shaddyboo, uyu munsi tariki 9 Werurwe 2019 yafatanyije n’ ibindi byamamare nyarwanda boza imodoka mu rwego rwo gushakira D’ amour ubufasha.
 Umunyamideli Mbabazi Shadia, abenshi bazi nka Shaddyboo, uyu munsi tariki 9 Werurwe 2019 yafatanyije n’ ibindi byamamare nyarwanda boza imodoka mu rwego rwo gushakira D’ amour ubufasha. D’Amour Selemani, ni umukinnyi wa filime wagaragaye mu zirimo ‘Nkuba,’ ‘Urugamba’, ‘Nta heza h’Isi’, ‘Ruganzu’ ‘Ndi Umukiristo’ n’izindi, akamamara nka Papa Shaffy. Amaze igihe ababaye kubera uburwayi bw’impyiko bumurembeje. Shaddyboo yogeje imodoka zirenga 5, arazikuba n’ ikiroso mu mapine, yoza ibirahure byazo n’ icyogesho, anazitera amazi. Itangazamakuru ryitabiriye ku bwinshi iki gikorwa cyateguwe na Shaddyboo. Uyu mugore wamamaye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga yatunguranye ubwo yageraga mu kinamba yambaye ikanzu ngufi nk’ ugiye mu birori dore ko azwi cyane nk’ umunyabirori. Shaddyboo yabwiye abanyamakuru ko iki gikorwa yakoze kigamije ibintu bibiri by’ ingenzi aribyo gukusanya inkunga no kumenyekanisha uburwayi bwa D’amour. Ati “ Namufasha ku bwanjye ariko nari nkeneye ubufasha bwa bagenzi banjye. D’Amour ntabwo nari nsanzwe muzi, muzi nk’umukinnyi wa filime” D’Amour Selemani uri gutabarizwa yafashwe muri Nyakanga 2018, impyiko ze zose zarangiritse burundu, baramubaze bamushyiramo icyuma kimufasha kuyungurura amaraso hakoreshejwe uburyo bwo hanze y’umubiri, ibizwi nka Dialyse. Abakinnyi ba filime bafatanyije na MTN bashyizeho uburyo bwo gukusanya inkunga yo gufasha D’Amour haherewe ku mafaranga 100 kuzamura. Ukoresheje telefone ngendanwa ukanda *182*8*1*200400# ubundi ugakurikiza amabwiriza.

title: Sergeant Robert uherutse  gukora indirimbo y’arenga miliyoni ‘umuziki nturatangira kumwinjiriza’
content:
Umuhanzi Nyarwanda ubifatanya n’ igisirikare Kabera Robert abenshi bamenye ku izina rya Sergeant Robert ngo mu myaka irenga 20 amaze mu muziki awushoramo ariko ntaratangira gusasura.
 Umuhanzi Nyarwanda ubifatanya n’ igisirikare Kabera Robert abenshi bamenye ku izina rya Sergeant Robert ngo mu myaka irenga 20 amaze mu muziki awushoramo ariko ntaratangira gusasura. Uyu muhanzi aherutse gushyira ahagaragara indirimbo y’ amajwi n’ amashusho yitwa ‘Happy Solidier’ bivuze ‘umusirikare wishimye’. Sergeant Robert yabwiye UKWEZI ko yakoze iyi ndirimbo ashaka gusubiza abantu bahora bamubaza uko ahuza inshingano z’ igisirikare n’ inshingano z’ ubuhanzi. Ati “Ni ukuvuga ngo ku ntambara mba nkaze, mu bihe by’ amahoro nkishima, ngafatanya n’ abaturage kubaka igihugu” Iyi ndirimbo iri mu njyana ibyinitse ndetse inagaragaramo indege ya gisivile. Amashusho y’ iyi ndirimbo yafatiwe ahantu hatandukanye harimo no ku kibuga cy’ indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali i Kanombe. Ngo kuyikora byatwaye miliyoni n’ ibihumbi 200. Yagize ati “Happy Solidier urabona harimo gukodesha kujya mu kibuga cy’ indege, gufata amashusho atandukanye nka hariya ha tennis, kwishyura producer, urumva ko bitoroshye uretse ko nagiye ngira aho bagiye bampa umusanda naho ubundi byageze muri miliyoni n’ ibihumbi 200” Sergeant Robert, kuri ubu ufite ipeti rya Sergeat Major yamenyekanye mu ndirimbo nka ‘Impanda’, ‘Serious’, na ‘military love’ yatubwiye ko amaze imyaka 24 mu muziki, gusa ngo umuziki awukora nko kwishimisha ntabwo uratangira kumwinjiriza amafaranga ariko biri hafi. Ati “Mu 1996 nibwo natangiye muzika. Njyewe sindagera igihe cyo gufata amafaranga y’ ubuhanzi, nkora umuziki nka entertainment, ntabwo mbikora nk’ umwuga. Byakwitwa ko ari igihombo ariko ntabwo ari igihombo urebye” Uyu muhanzi avuga ko imyaka agize asatira kuva mu gisirikare akajya mu kiruhuko cy’ izabukuru nko mu myaka itatu iri imbere. Ngo namara kuva mu gisirikare nibwo azatangira gukora umuziki nk’ umwuga age ashyira ahagaragara indirimbo nyinshi abyaze umusaruro umuziki. Indirimbo z’ uyu muhanzi  zirakundwa cyane zigacurangwa no mu tubari, avuga ko hagize umutumira nko mu kabyiniro ngo age kuririmba indirimbo zirimo inshya imbyinitse yitwa ‘Happy Solidier’ yajyayo.

title: Inkuru ya Bamporiki na Odda Paccy yagarutse mu itangazamakuru kubera ifoto bifotoranyije
content:
Ifoto Umuyobozi w’ Itorero ry’ Igihugu yifotoranyije n’ umuhanzikazi Odda Paccy yatumye hagarukwa ku kuba uyu muhanzikazi yarambuwe ubutore mu mezi ane ashize.
 Ifoto Umuyobozi w’ Itorero ry’ Igihugu yifotoranyije n’ umuhanzikazi Odda Paccy yatumye hagarukwa ku kuba uyu muhanzikazi yarambuwe ubutore mu mezi ane ashize. Uzamberumwana Odda Paccy ni umuhanzikazi umaze kubaka izina mu kwifotoza amafoto akavugwaho cyane. Muribuka ifoto ye yakinze ikoma ku mabanga y’ ubugore, n’ ifoto ye yabanjirije indirimbo ibyatsi none n’ iyo yifotanyije na Edouard Bampariki mu bukwe bw’ Umunyamakuru Mike Karangwa itumye inkuru yo kwamburwa ubutore igaruka mu itangazamakuru. Tariki 24 Ukwakira nibwo Edouard Bamporiki yambuye Odda Paccy ubutore nyuma y’ ifoto y’ amabuno y’ umukobwa yanditseho ijambo ibyatsi yakurikiwe n’ indirimbo Ibyatsi nayo itaravuzweho rumwe. Mu itangazo ryambura ubutore Odda Paccy, Edouard Bamporiki yagize ati “ Nshingiye ku bubasha mpabwa n’Umutoza w’Ikirenga wandagije Itorero; ndamenyesha Abanyarwanda ko uwari waratojwe agahabwa izina ry” ‘Indatabigwi icyiciro cya kabiri’ Uzamberumwana Odda Paccy; yambuwe izina ry’ Ubutore, kubera ko imyitwarire ye inyuranye n’umuco w’ubutore yari yaratojwe ndetse ihabanye n’imihigo yagiranye nabo bahuje izina ry’ubutore. Uhereye uyu munsi tariki ya 24 Ukwakira 2018, Uzamberumwana Odda Paccy si “Indatabigwi”. Kuva icyo gihe kugeza uyu munsi ntawongeye kugaruka ku kuba Odda Paccy yarambuwe ubutore kugeza Odda Paccy yifotaranije na Edouard Bamporiki ifoto igaragaza ko nta kibazo bafitanye. Kuri iyo foto Edouard Bamporiki afite ibyatsi mu ntoki(inkuyo) ari nabyo byatumye bamwe bongera ku bihuza na ya ndirimbo IBYATSI yatumye Odda Paccy yamburwa ubutore, basaba ko yabusubiza. 





Odda Paccy yatangaje ko nubwo yahuriye mu bukwe n’ Umuyobozi w’ Itorero ry’ igihugu wasabiye Umunyamakuru Mike Karangwa wari wambariwe na Odda Paccy, bataganiriye ku byo kuba yaramwambuye ubutore cyokora Odda Paccy kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 18 Gashyantare 2019 yatangaje ko we nta Edouard Bamporiki nta kibazo bafitanye.

Ba nyampinga batatu ba 2019 barimo uwahize abandi kwifotoza, uwahize abandi kubana neza na bagenzi be n’ uwahize abandi gukunda umuco bahawe amakamba mu nkera y’ imihigo no guhigura yabaye kuri uyu wa 24 Mutarama 2019 mu muhango witabiriwe na Edouard Bamporiki Umuyobozi w’ Intorero ry’ Igihugu.
 Ba nyampinga batatu ba 2019 barimo uwahize abandi kwifotoza, uwahize abandi kubana neza na bagenzi be n’ uwahize abandi gukunda umuco bahawe amakamba mu nkera y’ imihigo no guhigura yabaye kuri uyu wa 24 Mutarama 2019 mu muhango witabiriwe na Edouard Bamporiki Umuyobozi w’ Intorero ry’ Igihugu. 


 
 Tuyishimire Cyiza Vanessa wasezerewe mu irushanwa tariki 23 Mutarama 2019 niwe wabaye nyampinga wahize abandi kubana neza Miss Congeniality yambikwa ikamba na Miss popularity 2018 Ndahiro Liliane. 


 Ricca Michaella Kabahenda yabaye Nyampinga w’ Umuco Miss Heritage yambikwa ikamba na Lydia Dushimimana wabaye nyampinga w’ umuco 2018. 





Uwase Muyango Claudine yabaye Nyampinga waberewe n’ amafoto Miss Photogenic yambikwa ikamba n’ uwabaye Miss Photogenic 2018.  Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 29 Ukuboza 2018, nibwo amajonjora y’abakobwa bifuza guhatanira ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2019 yakomereje mu mujyi wa Kigali hatoranywa abazahagaririra Umujyi wa Kigali muri aya marushanwa. title: Abakobwa bahatanira ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2019 bigishijwe gucinya umudiho wa Kinyarwanda (Amafoto)
content:
Abakobwa 20 bahatanira ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2019 bari mu mwiherero ( Boot Camp) i Nyamata mu Busegera, nyuma yo gusuzumwa uko ubuzima bwabo buhagaze bapimwa indwara zitandukanye, bigishijwe no kubyina Kinyarwanda.
 Abakobwa 20 bahatanira ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2019 bari mu mwiherero ( Boot Camp) i Nyamata mu Busegera, nyuma yo gusuzumwa uko ubuzima bwabo buhagaze bapimwa indwara zitandukanye, bigishijwe no kubyina Kinyarwanda. Uyu mwiherero urimo kubera muri Golden Tulip Lapalisse i Nyamata, aba bakobwa bawugiyemo ku Cyumweru tariki 13 Mutarama 2019 ukaba uzamara ibyumweru 2. Umunsi wambere babanje gusuzumwa uko ubuzima bwabo buhagaze , ndetse banagiranye ikiganiro n’Umuyobozi w’Itorero ry’Igihugu Bamporiki Edouard ndetse n’icyo bagiranye n’Umuyobozi w’Ishami ry’Umuco muri RALC, Dr Nzabonimpa Jacques, kuri uyu wa Kabiri. 
 Mwiseneza Josiane mubigishijwe gushyayaya no gucinya umudiho wa Kinyarwanda Ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 15 Mutarama abakobwa bose bitoje kubyina bya Kinyarwanda, kuko ku munsi nyir’izina wo gutanga ikamba biri mu byo bazgaragaza. Nyampinga w’u Rwanda 2019 azamenyekana mu birori bikomeye bizabera mu Intare Conference Arena i Rusororo ku wa 26 Mutarama 2019. 
 Wabonaga bafite akanyamuneza ku maso igihe bigishwaga kubyina

title: Byari agahebuzo abakobwa 20 barimo Mwiseneza Josiane bakomeza muri Miss Rwanda - Amafoto
content:
Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 5 Mutarama 2019, nibwo hakomeje amarushanwa ya Miss Rwanda 2019 aho abakobwa 37 batoranyijwe guhagararira Intara zitandukanye n’umujyi wa Kigali, baje babukereye  ngo bigaragaze imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka hanyuma batoranywemo abakobwa 20 bazakomeza mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho muri aya marushanwa.
 Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 5 Mutarama 2019, nibwo hakomeje amarushanwa ya Miss Rwanda 2019 aho abakobwa 37 batoranyijwe guhagararira Intara zitandukanye n’umujyi wa Kigali, baje babukereye  ngo bigaragaze imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka hanyuma batoranywemo abakobwa 20 bazakomeza mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho muri aya marushanwa. Abakobwa batandukanye baje i Gikondo mu mujyi wa Kigali ahasanzwe habera Expo, baherekejwe n’abafana benshi babashyigikiye kuburyo byasusurukije ibirori byo guhatanira kujya mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho. Buri mukobwa wageraga imbere y’abagize akanama nkemurampaka, abamushyigikiye biyamiraga bidasanzwe bagaragaza ko bamushyigikiye. Aba nibo bakobwa 37 baje guhatana ngo batoranywemo abakobwa 20 abandi 17 basezererwe Abakobwa aha bari bageze i Gikondo ahabereye amarushanwa yo gutoranywamo abakomeza n’abasigara .Kuri iyi nshuro, abagize akanama nkemurampaka bahindutse, Miss Mutesi Jolly wambaye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2016, Rusaro Carine wabaye igisonga cya Miss Rwanda 2009 akaba na Miss University of Rwanda 2007 ndetse n’Umunyamakuru Evelyne Umurerwa wa Radio na Televiziyo Rwanda. Abayoboye ibirori nabo bahindutse kuko uretse Luckyman Nzeyimana wa RBA, hiyongereyeho na Ally Soudy usanzwe aba muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 5 Mutarama 2019, nibwo hakomeje amarushanwa ya Miss Rwanda 2019 aho abakobwa 37 batoranyijwe guhagararira Intara zitandukanye n’umujyi wa Kigali, baje babukereye  ngo bigaragaze imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka hanyuma batoranywemo abakobwa 20 bazakomeza mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho muri aya marushanwa.
 Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu tariki 5 Mutarama 2019, nibwo hakomeje amarushanwa ya Miss Rwanda 2019 aho abakobwa 37 batoranyijwe guhagararira Intara zitandukanye n’umujyi wa Kigali, baje babukereye  ngo bigaragaze imbere y’akanama nkemurampaka hanyuma batoranywemo abakobwa 20 bazakomeza mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho muri aya marushanwa. Abakobwa batandukanye baje i Gikondo mu mujyi wa Kigali ahasanzwe habera Expo, baherekejwe n’abafana benshi babashyigikiye kuburyo byasusurukije ibirori byo guhatanira kujya mu cyiciro gikurikiyeho. Buri mukobwa wageraga imbere y’abagize akanama nkemurampaka, abamushyigikiye biyamiraga bidasanzwe bagaragaza ko bamushyigikiye. Aba nibo bakobwa 37 baje guhatana ngo batoranywemo abakobwa 20 abandi 17 basezererwe Abakobwa aha bari bageze i Gikondo ahabereye amarushanwa yo gutoranywamo abakomeza n’abasigara .Kuri iyi nshuro, abagize akanama nkemurampaka bahindutse, Miss Mutesi Jolly wambaye ikamba rya Miss Rwanda 2016, Rusaro Carine wabaye igisonga cya Miss Rwanda 2009 akaba na Miss University of Rwanda 2007 ndetse n’Umunyamakuru Evelyne Umurerwa wa Radio na Televiziyo Rwanda. label: entertainment
title: Rutamu na Rugimbana Théogène bamaze kuva kuri Radio bakoreraga, bagiye guhuza imbaraga
content:
Abanyamakuru Rugimbana Théogène na Rutamu Elie Joe bakunzwe na benshi mu Rwanda kubera ubuhanga n’impano bafite mu kogeza imikino y’umupira w’amaguru, hari amakuru yizewe agera ku kinyamakuru Ukwezi.com ashimangira ko bagiye kuva ku maradiyo bakoreraga bakajya guhuriza imbaraga ahandi.
 Abanyamakuru Rugimbana Théogène na Rutamu Elie Joe bakunzwe na benshi mu Rwanda kubera ubuhanga n’impano bafite mu kogeza imikino y’umupira w’amaguru, hari amakuru yizewe agera ku kinyamakuru Ukwezi.com ashimangira ko bagiye kuva ku maradiyo bakoreraga bakajya guhuriza imbaraga ahandi. Rutamu Elie Joe na Rugimbana Théogène, bombi bamamariye kuri Radio Flash FM, ariko baza kuhava bajya gukorera izindi Radio. Rutamu yabanje kujya ku Isango Star nyuma aza kujya kuri Radio Rwanda ari naho yari ari kugeza ubu, mu gihe Rugimbana we yakoreraga Radio 10, ariko bombi n’ubwo bataratangira gukorera ibitangazamakuru byabo bishya, bamaze gusezera ndetse mu minsi micye bakaba bitegura kubishyira ahagaragara. Kakoza Nkuriza Charles uzwi nka KNC, niwe wamaze kugirana amasezerano mashya n’aba banyamakuru b’imikino, bakaba bagomba gutangira akazi kabo kuri Radio 1 na TV1 mu minsi micye, ariko ahanini bakaba bifuzwa ngo bazogeze imikino y’igikombe cy’u Burayi kizabera mu Bufaransa guhera muri Kamena uyu mwaka. Biteganyijwe ko iyi mikino y’amakipe y’ibihangange i Burayi, izatangira tariki 10 Kamena 2016, ikazarangira tariki 10 Nyakanga 2016, KNC akaba yarifuje ko aba banyamakuru bazamufasha kogeza iyi mikino bityo nawe akarushaho kwiyongerera abakunzi no kuzamura ikigero cy’amatangazo yo kwamamaza yajyaga abona. Nyuma y’imikino y’iki gikombe, aba banyamakuru bazakomeza kongera imbaraga mu biganiro bya siporo kuri Radio 1 na TV1.

title: Umuhanzi Micah, ni umusore wibazwaho kuko ateye neza nk’abakobwa - Amafoto
content:
Umuhanzi w’imyaka 22 y’amavuko witwa Micah akomeje gutangaza abantu kubera imiterere ye, n’ubwo ari umusore akaba afite ibibuno n’imiterere bimeze nk’iby’abakobwa ndetse agaragara nk’abagore kuburyo arusha ibibuno abagore benshi.
 Umuhanzi w’imyaka 22 y’amavuko witwa Micah akomeje gutangaza abantu kubera imiterere ye, n’ubwo ari umusore akaba afite ibibuno n’imiterere bimeze nk’iby’abakobwa ndetse agaragara nk’abagore kuburyo arusha ibibuno abagore benshi. Uyu muhanzi ukizamuka mu njyana ya R&B, akomeje kuba icyamamare kubera imiterere ye ndetse abantu benshi bakomeje guhamya ko ari ibyo yaba yaritereshejeho ariko ubushakashatsi bukomeje gukorwa n’abahanga batandukanye bwerekana ko ari imiterere y’umwimerere y’umubiri we. Gusa n’ubwo ari umusore ufite ibibuno binini cyane biruta n’iby’abakobwa n’abagore benshi, no mu maso, ku isura no mu myitwarire agaragara nk’umukobwa ari nabyo bishingirwaho na benshi bagahamya ko yaba akundana n’abasore bagenzi be kuko n’ubwo imyanya myibarukiro ye ari iy’abagabo, imisemburo n’ibyiyumviro afite bigaragara ko we yiyumva nk’umukobwa. Mu mafoto akunda gushyira ku rubuga rwa Instagram, Micah aba yireba cyane mu ndorerwamo ndetse anifotoza mu myambaro agaragara nk’umukobwa n’ubwo ari umusore, akaba kandi avuga ko uko ateye ntacyo bimutwaye kuko yamaze kwakira uko Imana yamuremye, kuburyo abifata nk’umugisha yihariye abandi basore badafite kuko binamufasha mu kuba icyamamare mu buryo bumworoheye.

title: FERWAFA yabujije abakinnyi n’abatoza kongera gusuhuzanya mbere na nyuma y’umukino
content:
Ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda, FERWAFA ryamaze gushyiraho ingamba n’amabwiriza areba amakipe yose y’abanyamuryango baryo arebana no kwrinda Coronavirus aho abakinnyi abatoza ndetse n’abafana bategetswe kuzajya babanza gukaraba mbere yo kwinjira mu bibuga kandi gusuhuzanya n’intoki bikaba bitemewe haba ku batoza n’abakinnyi ubwabo nk’uko byari bisanzwe bikorwa mbere yo gutangira umukino.
 Ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda, FERWAFA ryamaze gushyiraho ingamba n’amabwiriza areba amakipe yose y’abanyamuryango baryo arebana no kwrinda Coronavirus aho abakinnyi abatoza ndetse n’abafana bategetswe kuzajya babanza gukaraba mbere yo kwinjira mu bibuga kandi gusuhuzanya n’intoki bikaba bitemewe haba ku batoza n’abakinnyi ubwabo nk’uko byari bisanzwe bikorwa mbere yo gutangira umukino. Nk’uko bigaragara mu ibaruwa yandikiwe abanyamuryango bose b’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda(amakipe), bayamenyesheje ko bagomba kubahiriza izo ngamba, zikaba zafashwe hagendewe ku mabwiriza ya Misisitiri w’intebe. Iyi baruwa iragira iti“ tugendeye ku ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya Koronavirusi(COVID-19) hirya no hino ku Isi n’ingamba leta y’u Rwanda yashyizeho mu rwego rwo kwirinda no gukumira icyo cyorezo mu Rwanda. tugendeye ku butumwa bwa Minisitiri w’intebe bwo kuwa 06 Werurwe bujyanye n’icyorezo cya Koronavirusi(COVID-19); Tubandikiye tugira ngo tubamenyeshe ko mu rwego rwo kwirinda no gukumira icyo cyorezo musabwa gukora ibi bikurikira mu mikino mwakiriye yose ku marushanwa ategurwa na FERWAFA: 1. Guteganya uburyo buhagije bwo gukaraba no gusukura intoki hakoreshejwe amazi asukuye n’isabune cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gusukura intoki(hand sanitizer) aho binjirira ku bibuga byabereyeho imikino. 2. Kwirinda kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza cyangwa se bahoberana(abafana, abakinnyi, abatoza). Ferwafa ikaba yatangaje ko ibi bikoresho byose bigomba kuba byageze aho imikino ibera biterenze.” FERWAFA ifashe izi ngamba mu gihe n’Umujyi wa Kigali wamaze guhagarika ibikorwa byose by’imyidagaduro burimo n’ibitaramo byari biteganyijwe guhera muri Werurwe 2020. Mu ijoro ryakeye nibwo mu Butaliyani, Komite Olempike yatangaje ko yahagaritse ibikorwa byose by’imikino mu gihugu harimo shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere mu mupira w’amaguru kugeza tariki ya 03 Mata 2020 ubwo iki kibazo kizaba kimaze guhabwa umurongo.

Iyi baruwa iragira iti“ tugendeye ku ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo cya Koronavirusi(COVID-19) hirya no hino ku Isi n’ingamba leta y’u Rwanda yashyizeho mu rwego rwo kwirinda no gukumira icyo cyorezo mu Rwanda. tugendeye ku butumwa bwa Minisitiri w’intebe bwo kuwa 06 Werurwe bujyanye n’icyorezo cya Koronavirusi(COVID-19); Tubandikiye tugira ngo tubamenyeshe ko mu rwego rwo kwirinda no gukumira icyo cyorezo musabwa gukora ibi bikurikira mu mikino mwakiriye yose ku marushanwa ategurwa na FERWAFA: 1. Guteganya uburyo buhagije bwo gukaraba no gusukura intoki hakoreshejwe amazi asukuye n’isabune cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gusukura intoki(hand sanitizer) aho binjirira ku bibuga byabereyeho imikino. 2. Kwirinda kuramukanya abantu bahana ibiganza cyangwa se bahoberana(abafana, abakinnyi, abatoza). Ferwafa ikaba yatangaje ko ibi bikoresho byose bigomba kuba byageze aho imikino ibera biterenze.” FERWAFA ifashe izi ngamba mu gihe n’Umujyi wa Kigali wamaze guhagarika ibikorwa byose by’imyidagaduro burimo n’ibitaramo byari biteganyijwe guhera muri Werurwe 2020. Mu ijoro ryakeye nibwo mu Butaliyani, Komite Olempike yatangaje ko yahagaritse ibikorwa byose by’imikino mu gihugu harimo shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere mu mupira w’amaguru kugeza tariki ya 03 Mata 2020 ubwo iki kibazo kizaba kimaze guhabwa umurongo.

title: Champions League: Umukino wa PSG na Dortmund uzaba mu muhezo kubera Coronavirus
content:
Kuri uyu wa Mbere Polisi yo mu gihugu cy’Ubufaransa yatangaje ko umukino wa 1/8 cy’irushanwa rya champions League uzahuza Paris Saint Germain na Borussia Dortmund ejo uzaba mu muhezo mu rwego rwo kwirinda kwanduzanya icyorezo cya Coronavirus.
 Kuri uyu wa Mbere Polisi yo mu gihugu cy’Ubufaransa yatangaje ko umukino wa 1/8 cy’irushanwa rya champions League uzahuza Paris Saint Germain na Borussia Dortmund ejo uzaba mu muhezo mu rwego rwo kwirinda kwanduzanya icyorezo cya Coronavirus. Ikipe ya Paris Saint Germain yo mu Bufaransa niyo izakira Borussia Dortmund yo mu Budage mu mukino wo kwishyura, ikaba yari yarayitsinzwe na Dortmund ibitego 2-1 mu Budage mu mukino ubanza. Mu minsi ishize ubuyobozi bw’ikipe ya Paris Saint Germain bwari bwatangaje ko bwakoze ibishoboka byose kugirango uyu mukino uzagende neza ariko kuri uyu wa mbere polisi yafashe icyemezo cyo guheza abafana kugirango hirindwe icyorezo cya Coronavirus gikomeje gukwirakwira muri iki gihugu. Ni nyuma y’uko umukino iyi kipe yagombaga gukina na Strasbourg mu mpera z’iki cyumweru gishize muri shampiyona usubitwe ku mpamvu z’iki cyorezo, Imibare itangwa n’ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku buzima, OMS igaragaza ko kugeza ubu mu gihugu cy’Ubufaransa icyorezo cya Coronavirus kimaze kwandurwa n’abasaga ibihumbi 11, iki gihugu kikaba gikurikira ibindi bihugu bifite ubwandu bwinshi nk’Ubushinwa ari nabwo bwa mbere, Ubutaliyani na Iran. Undi mukono bivugwa ko ushobora kuzabera mu muhezo ni uzahuza ikipe ya Barcelona yo mu gihugu cya Espagne na Napoli yo mu Butaliyani, nawo ukaba ushobora kuzabera kuri stade Nou Camp ya Barcelona nta mufana n’umwe urimo kubera iki cyorezo

title: AS Muhanga yahawe igisubizo kirambye ku bibazo by’ubukene bwavugwagamo
content:
Nyuma y’ibibazo bikomeje kuvugwa mu ikipe ya AS Muhanga byashoboraga gutuma isezera mu mikino y’icyiciro cya mbere muri uyu mwaka w’imikino wa 2019-2020 itarangiye, ubuyobozi bw’akarere ka Muhanga bwatanze igisubizo kigiye gutuma ibibazo byose by’iyi kipe bikemuka burundu.
 Nyuma y’ibibazo bikomeje kuvugwa mu ikipe ya AS Muhanga byashoboraga gutuma isezera mu mikino y’icyiciro cya mbere muri uyu mwaka w’imikino wa 2019-2020 itarangiye, ubuyobozi bw’akarere ka Muhanga bwatanze igisubizo kigiye gutuma ibibazo byose by’iyi kipe bikemuka burundu. Mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi nibwo ubuyobozi bw’iyi kipe yo mu karere ka Muhanga bwandikiye umuyobozi w’akarere bumumenyesha imibereho y’ikipe n’abakinnyi bayo itameze neza bunagaragazamo uruhuri rw’ibibazo iyi kipe ifite ari nabyo biri gutuma ititwara neza mu mikino yo kwishyura ya shampiyona nk’uko yari yabikoze mu mikino ibanza. Ubuyobozi bw’iyi kipe bwagaragaje ko bwugarijwe n’ubukene aho bwagaragaje ko nibura kugirango ibibazo ifite bikemuke hakenewe asaga miliyoni 96 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Muri izi miliyoni zisaga 96 ikipe yatangaje ko hagomba kwishyurwa ibirarane by’amezi 2 ifitiye abakinnyi bingana na 9,850,000frw, amafaranga yo gusinyisha abakinnyi (Recruitement) angana na 6,000,000frw batabahaye ndetse n’amafaranga yo kongerera abakinnyi amasezerano kuri ubu bayasoje mu kwezi k’Ukuboza 2019 angana na 6,500,000frw. Iyi kipe kandi nk’uko yakomeje ibigaragaza ikeneye kwishyura umwenda ibereyemo perezida wayo wayigurije 22,723,000frw, kwishyura umwenda ifitiye umukozi utekera abakinnyi hamwe na Pharmacy ibaha imiti agera kuri 1,360,000frw hanyuma ukongeraho na 25,200,000frw kugirango ikipe ibashe gusoza umwaka wa shampiyona neza, yose hamwe wayateranya akangana na 96,833,000frw. Mu gutanga igisubizo kuri ibi bibazo by’iyi kipe, umuyobozi w’akarere ka Muhanga, Madame Kayitare Jacqueline yavuze ko akarere n’ubuyobozi bw’intara bicaye kakayishakira igisubizo kirambye binyuriye kuyegurira ibirombe by’amabuye y’agaciro ikajya ibicukura igakora ubucuruzi bubyara inyungu aho gukomeza kujya ihabwa amafaranga ikoresha agahita ashira. Yagize ati “Icyagaragaye ni uko AS Muhanga yahabwaga amafaranga kashi ariko noneho hatekerejwe uburyo yahabwa ubushobozi bubyara amafaranga. Twarebye rero ibintu bitandukanye dushobora kubonamo ubushobozi AS Muhanga yakoresha dusanga mu mutungo kamere dufite haba mu karere kacu ndetse n’ahandi hatandukanye tuzajya tubakomangira ari uburyo bwo kubashakira ubushobozi bushingiye ku gucukura kariyeri (amabuye y’agaciro)… kugirango bashobore kubona amafaranga abyara andi aho kugira ngo tujye tubaha amafaranga ashire ahubwo tubahe inkunga twabageneye ariko tubahe n’igishoro baheraho nabo bakagira icyo bageraho.” Kayitare Jacqueline yakomeje avuga ko nk’akarere bemereye iyi kipe kubakorera ubuvugizi mu mabanki kugirango ashobore kubaha amafaranga yo gukoresha muri iyi minsi ya shampiyona isigaye hanyuma akarere kakazabashakira ingengo y’imari umwaka utaha iza ikishyura ayo mafaranga bakeneye ku buryo bwihuse. Umuyobozi w’akarere ka Muhanga kandi yavuze ko bari gukorera ubuvugizi ikipe ya AS Muhanga mu bigo bitandukanye ndetse ngo ubu akarere hari ibiganiro kari kugirana n’abantu batandukanye mu kuyishakira abaterankunga.

label: sport
title: APR FC itsinze Rayon Sports 2-0 [uko umukino wagenze n’ akari ku mutima w’ umutoza]
content:
Ikipe ya APR FC itsinze ikipe ya Rayon Sports mu mukino wa 90 mu myaka 25 ishize iha abafana bayo ibyishimo bikomeye bya Noheli n’ ubunani.
 Ikipe ya APR FC itsinze ikipe ya Rayon Sports mu mukino wa 90 mu myaka 25 ishize iha abafana bayo ibyishimo bikomeye bya Noheli n’ ubunani. Ni umukino wari utegerejwe n’ Abanyarwanda batari bake dore ko wari umaze icyumweru cyose uvugwa cyane mu itangazamakuru. Igitego cya mbere ya Byiringiro Lague cyabonetse ku munota wa 20 ku shoti riremereye yateye mu izamu ahawe pase nziza na Fitina Omborenga wavanye umupira muri santere. Ku munota wa 34, APR yabonye kufura nziza Ombolenga ayitera mu izamu rya Kimenyi wa Rayon Sports akozaho intoki umupira ujya muri koruneri. Sarpong Michael kizigenza muri Rayon Sports yagerageje gushaka uko yakwishyura igitego batsinzwe na APR ariko biranga abura imipira igice cya mbere kirangira Rayon Sports yibuze mu mukino. Umuvugizi wa APR FC, Kazungu Clever yagaragaje ko igitego batsinze cyaturutse ku buswa bw’ umuzamu wa Rayon Sports Kimenyi Yves umwe mu bo APR yirukanye. Ati “Nta gitangaza twebwe turahura n’ abakinnyi twasezereye, ni kamparampaka y’ uko badashoboye.  Igitego twabonye abari hanze babonaga aho umukinnyi agiye gutera kuko iyo umukinnyi ari umunyendyo cyangwa ari umunyemoso uba ubona aho agiye gutera”. Kazungu yakomeje avuga iminota 45 ya mbere yarangiye aribwo abakinnyi basa n’ abatangiye kuko batigeze baruha. Kamwe mu dushya twagaragaye muri uyu mukino, ni uko Manzi Thierry na Mangwende batagaragaye ku rutonde rw’ abazabanzamo, ariko bakaba binjiye mu kibuga bakanabanzamo, ndetse Thierry akabona igitego. Umuvugizi wa Rayon Sports, Nkurunziza Jean Paul yavuze ko 15 ya mbere Rayon Sports yatangiye ikina neza iza gukora ikosa ku munota wa 15 APR FC  irayikosora bituma yibura mu mukino aho yemeye ko mu minota 45 y’ igice cya mbere APR yarushije. Ku munota wa 50 w’ umukino Byiringiro Lague watsinze igitego cya mbere cya APR FC yateze Rutanga ahita ahabwa ikarita ya kabiri y’ umuhondo ikurikirwa n’ umutuku ava mu kibuga APR FC isigarana abakinnyi. Ikarita ya mbere yayihawe amaze gutsinda igitego ubwo yakuragamo umupira yerekana umupira wanditseho ko ari ‘umukirisitu’. Mu minota mike yakurikiyeho Djabel Manishimwe wa APR yahawe ikarita y’ umuhondo kubera gutinza umukino. Ahita asimburwa na Butera Andrew yasimbuye naho Claude Niyomugabo nawe asimburwa na Mushimiyimana Muhammed. Ku munota 61 Iranzi Jean Claude wa Rayon Sports yasimbujwe, ku munota wa 64 Radu ku ikosa yakoreye Mangwende yahawe ikarita y’ umuhondo, ku munota wa 69 Rayon Sports yahushije igitego cyari cyabazwe cy’ ishoti riremereye rya Michael Sarpong. Mugunga Yves yateye ishoti mu rushundura rw’ izamu rya Kimenyi Yves abafana ba APR FC bajya kwishima batamenye ko yari yaraye oruje. Manzi Thierry, kapiteni ku munota wa 89 washimangiye itsinzi ya APR FC kuri kufura yateye igonga ipoto yinjira neza mu izamu rya Kimenyi Yves. Umukino urangiye Kazungu uvugira APR FC ati “Ntabwo twatsindwa n’ abakinnyi twasezereye. Umutoza wa APR yashimiye abantu bose bagize uruhare muri iyi nsinzi barimo abakinnyi, abafana, itangazamakuru n’ abayobozi . Abajijwe ibanga ryatumye bihagararaho imbere ya Rayon Sports nyuma yo guhabwa ikarita itukura igice cya kabiri kigitangira ati “Ikarita itukura si ikibazo”. APR FC irangije imikino ibanza itaratsindwa umutoza ati “Ni agahigo kataherukaga kandi twarabiharaniye”.

Kamwe mu dushya twagaragaye muri uyu mukino, ni uko Manzi Thierry na Mangwende batagaragaye ku rutonde rw’ abazabanzamo, ariko bakaba binjiye mu kibuga bakanabanzamo, ndetse Thierry akabona igitego. Umuvugizi wa Rayon Sports, Nkurunziza Jean Paul yavuze ko 15 ya mbere Rayon Sports yatangiye ikina neza iza gukora ikosa ku munota wa 15 APR FC  irayikosora bituma yibura mu mukino aho yemeye ko mu minota 45 y’ igice cya mbere APR yarushije. Ku munota wa 50 w’ umukino Byiringiro Lague watsinze igitego cya mbere cya APR FC yateze Rutanga ahita ahabwa ikarita ya kabiri y’ umuhondo ikurikirwa n’ umutuku ava mu kibuga APR FC isigarana abakinnyi. Ikarita ya mbere yayihawe amaze gutsinda igitego ubwo yakuragamo umupira yerekana umupira wanditseho ko ari ‘umukirisitu’. Mu minota mike yakurikiyeho Djabel Manishimwe wa APR yahawe ikarita y’ umuhondo kubera gutinza umukino. Ahita asimburwa na Butera Andrew yasimbuye naho Claude Niyomugabo nawe asimburwa na Mushimiyimana Muhammed. Ku munota 61 Iranzi Jean Claude wa Rayon Sports yasimbujwe, ku munota wa 64 Radu ku ikosa yakoreye Mangwende yahawe ikarita y’ umuhondo, ku munota wa 69 Rayon Sports yahushije igitego cyari cyabazwe cy’ ishoti riremereye rya Michael Sarpong. Mugunga Yves yateye ishoti mu rushundura rw’ izamu rya Kimenyi Yves abafana ba APR FC bajya kwishima batamenye ko yari yaraye oruje. Manzi Thierry, kapiteni ku munota wa 89 washimangiye itsinzi ya APR FC kuri kufura yateye igonga ipoto yinjira neza mu izamu rya Kimenyi Yves. Umukino urangiye Kazungu uvugira APR FC ati “Ntabwo twatsindwa n’ abakinnyi twasezereye. Umutoza wa APR yashimiye abantu bose bagize uruhare muri iyi nsinzi barimo abakinnyi, abafana, itangazamakuru n’ abayobozi . Abajijwe ibanga ryatumye bihagararaho imbere ya Rayon Sports nyuma yo guhabwa ikarita itukura igice cya kabiri kigitangira ati “Ikarita itukura si ikibazo”. APR FC irangije imikino ibanza itaratsindwa umutoza ati “Ni agahigo kataherukaga kandi twarabiharaniye”.

title: KNC Perezida wa Gasogi avuga ko aje kuryoshya umupira mu kiciro cya mbere
content:
Kakooza Nkuliza Charles uzwi nka  ‘KNC’akaba umuyobozi wa Radio na Tv1 ndetse n’umuyobozi wa Gasogi united yazamutse ivuye mu kiciro cya 2 ikajya mu cya 1 avuga ko umusifuzi yarakozeho ikipe ye .
 Kakooza Nkuliza Charles uzwi nka  ‘KNC’akaba umuyobozi wa Radio na Tv1 ndetse n’umuyobozi wa Gasogi united yazamutse ivuye mu kiciro cya 2 ikajya mu cya 1 avuga ko umusifuzi yarakozeho ikipe ye . Kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 24 Nyakanga 2019  Gasogi united yari yakiriye Sorwathe FC mu mukino wo kwishyura wabereye kuri stade ya Kigali I Nyamirambo umukino warangiye ari igiteko 1 kuri 1 . Gasogi umukino ubanza yari yatsindiye Sorwathe I wayo ikinihira igiteko 1 ku busa ,ubumbiye hamwe imikino yombi Gasogi ifite ibitego 2 kuri 1 cya Sorwathe . Nyuma y’umukino byari ibyishimo kuri KNC nka Perezida wa Gasojyi United yari izamutse yinjiye mu kiciro cya mbere nyuma y’imyaka 3 ishinzwe. KNC yanenze bikomeye umusifuzi na Ferwafa agaragaza ko uburyo bwo kuzamura amakipe yo mu kiciro cya kabiri burimo ikibazo kigomba gukosorwa.  Yagize ati "Ntabwo intsinzi yari yoroshye ikipe yari ishyigikiwe n’umusifuzi wo hagati aho abakinnyi bakorerwaga amakosa akaba ari twe ahana ,twakinaga n’umusifuzi ntitwakinaga na Sorwathe ikipe twayirushaga umusifuzi akagerageza kuyigarura mu mukino ,umwana uri bupfe nubwo wamuha kigozi arapfa". 
 Byari ibyishimo bidasanzwe kuri KNC n’abakinnyi be nyuma yo kujya mu kiciro cya mbere  KNC yakomeje agira ati "Ngirango namwe mwabibonye ko umusifuzi yarafite motivation  wakibaza yayikuye hehe? Ferwafa ikwiye gushyiraho itegeko ko ikipe yamutse mu kiciro cya kabiri idagakwiye kwivanga mu mikino yo gushaka ikipe zizamuka mu kiciro cya mbere ,ikipe yamanutse ntiyigere itekereza kongera gukina imikino ituma isubira mu kiciro cyambere niba hari iyizamutse ariko yananirwa kujya mukiciro cya mbere zazindi bakinnye mu kiciro cya kabiri akaba arizo zikina umukino wo gushaka  ikipe isimbura iyananiwe kuzamuka ijya mu kiciro cya mbere aho kugira ngo zibe izamanutse zivuye mu kiciro cya mbere”. 
 KNC avuga ko bakinnye n’umusifuzi batakinnye na Sorwathe  KNC kandi avuga ko  ikipe ye itaje gutega amaboko no gutanga amanota ,vuba cyane  aragura abakinnyi b’ abanyamahanga bazakora ikinyuranyo mu kiciro cy ambere kuko aje guhangana na Rayon Sports ,APR FC ,Kiyovu na Mukura kuri we ngo arifuza ko ambiyanse igaruka ku kibuga abantu bakongera bakishima . 
 Abafana bari benshi kuri uyu mukino  
 
 Byari ibyishimo kubakinnyi ba Gasogi bari bazamutse mu kiciro cya mbere nyuma y’imyaka 3

title: Jacques Tuyisenge yaguzwe ibihumbi 350$ n’ ikipe yo muri Angola
content:
Ikipe ikomeye yo muri Angola ‘Petro Atletico’ kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 17 Nyakanga 2019 yatangaje ko yaguze Jacques Tuyisenge, Umunyarwanda wakiniraga ikipe ya Gor Mahia FC yo muri Kenya. Abaye Umukinnyi wa mbere w’ Umunyarwanda uguzwe menshi.
 Ikipe ikomeye yo muri Angola ‘Petro Atletico’ kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 17 Nyakanga 2019 yatangaje ko yaguze Jacques Tuyisenge, Umunyarwanda wakiniraga ikipe ya Gor Mahia FC yo muri Kenya. Abaye Umukinnyi wa mbere w’ Umunyarwanda uguzwe menshi. Rutahizamu Jacques Tuyisenge w’ imyaka 27 azwi n’ Abanyarwanda  kubera ko yatsindiye ikipe y’ igihugu Amavubi ibitego byinshi. Gor Mahia bivugwa ko yahawe miliyoni 15 z’ amashikingi ya Kenya kugira ngo igurishe amasezerano y’ imyaka ine yari yasinyiwe na Jacques Tuyisenge. Tuyisenge usanze icyamamare K’Ogalo mu ikipe ya Petro Atletico yakiniye Police FC yo mu Rwanda Tuyisenge Jacques yerekeje muri Petro Atlético imutanzeho ibihumbi 350 USD akazajya ahembwa ibihumbi 7 USD ari hejuru ya miliyoni 6.5 FRW. Uyu mukinnyi wari umaze kubaka izina muri Kenya kubera ibitego yagiye atsindira Gor Mahia, abaye umukinnyi w’Umunyarwanda wa mbere uguzwe amafaranga menshi nyuma ya Muhadjiri Hakizimana waguzwe ibihumbi 300 USD na Emirates SC yo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Abarabu. Jacques Tuyisenge yakiniye AS Kigali , mbere yo kwerekeza muri Police FC na Gor Mahia. Atangira gukinira Police FC afite imyaka 16, mu mwaka wa mbere atangiye gukinira police yatsinze ibitego 11 byinshi mu bitego atsinda abitsindisha umutwe. Muri 2016 nibwo Police FC yemeye kurekura Jacques Tuyisenge ajya muri Gor Mahia imutanzeho ibihumbi 40 by’amadolari ya Amerika arenga hafi kuri miliyoni 32 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.

title: Rayon Sports inyagiye Gicumbi 7-1 ibyinshi byatsinzwe na Jules Ulimwengu
content:
Ikipe ya Rayon Sports yongereye amahirwe yo kugera mu mikino ya ½ cy’ Igikombe cy’ Amahoro nyuma yo kunyagira Gicumbi FC ibitego 7-1.
 Ikipe ya Rayon Sports yongereye amahirwe yo kugera mu mikino ya ½ cy’ Igikombe cy’ Amahoro nyuma yo kunyagira Gicumbi FC ibitego 7-1. Umukino wa Rayon Sports na Gicumbi wabere kuri Sitade ya Kigali. Undi mukino wabaye kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 20 Kamena 2019 ni uwahuje Intare na Kiyovu Sports warangiye Kiyovu Sports itsinze Intare FC ibitego 3-0. Rayon Sports yaburaga abakinnyi bakomeye barimo Micheal Sarpong,Donkor Prosper,Manzi Thierry na Niyonzima Olivier uzwi nka Sefu baherutse gusezererwa,yanyagiye Gicumbi FC ibitego 7-1, birimo 5 yinjije mu gice cya kabiri gusa. Mu bitego 5 Rayon Sports yinjije mu gice cya kabiri harimo 4 bya Rutahizamu Jules Ulimwengu. Umukino wo kwishyura wa Rayon na Gicumbi uzabera i Gicumbi aho ku Cyumweru aho Gicumbi ifite akazi katoroshye ko gukuramo ikinyuranyo cy’ ibitego 6 yatsinzwe uyu munsi kugira ngo ibe yabona amahirwe yo gukomeza muri 1/2. Mu mikino yabaye ku munsi w’ ejo, AS Kigali yatsinze Gasogi United ibitego 2-1 mu mukino ubanza wa 1/4 waberaga kuri Stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo. Undi mukino wabaye ejo, Etincelles FC yatsinzwe na Police FC ibitego 2-0.

title: Gasimba ukunda APR FC yirukanye umugore we burundu amuziza ko afana Rayon Sports - VIDEO
content:
Umutoza Gasimba utoza abana bakiri bato abifashijwemo na Jimmy Gatete nk’uko abyivugira, ashimangira ko yafashe icyemezo cyo kwirukana burundu umugore bashakanye bakanabyarana umwana w’umukobwa, kandi ngo bari basanzwe babana neza ariko bapfuye ko uyu mugore ukomoka i Nyanza yanze kureka gufana ikipe ya Rayon Sports, mu gihe umugabo we akunda mukeba APR FC
 Umutoza Gasimba utoza abana bakiri bato abifashijwemo na Jimmy Gatete nk’uko abyivugira, ashimangira ko yafashe icyemezo cyo kwirukana burundu umugore bashakanye bakanabyarana umwana w’umukobwa, kandi ngo bari basanzwe babana neza ariko bapfuye ko uyu mugore ukomoka i Nyanza yanze kureka gufana ikipe ya Rayon Sports, mu gihe umugabo we akunda mukeba APR FC Mu kiganiro twagiranye na Gasimba, yadutangarije ko akunda ikipe ya APR FC ndetse ko yanayikiniye mu ikipe y’ingimbi, ndetse ngo yanakinnye muri Rayon Sports aho yaje kugirira imvune yasabaga ko yajya kuvuzwa hanze ariko habura ubushobozi. Avuga ko umugore we ukomoka i Nyanza we yari umukunzi wa Rayon Sports cyane, ibi bikaba ari nabyo byabateranyije. Gasimba ashimangira ko ubusanzwe yajyaga akunda kujya impaka n’umugore we ku bijyanye n’imikino yahuzaga APR FC na Rayon Sports, bakanajya intego bakemeranwa ko utsindwa aza kurara hanze. Uyu mugabo avuga ko ubwe yaraye hanze nko ku mukino APR FC yatsinzwemo na AS Muhanga bikanayigabanyiriza amahirwe yo gutwara igikombe cya shampiyona iheruka. Gasimba avuga ko kuba Rayon Sports yaratwaye igikombe cya shampiyona byamubabaje bigatuma anabipfa n’umugore we akamwirukana, gusa akavuga ko mu gihe yaramuka amusabye imbabazi akamurahirira ko atazongera gufana Rayon Sports bwo ngo basubirana. Gasimba yanadutangarije uburyo amakipe nka Rayon Sports na AS Kigali zimurimo amafaranga y’indezo kubera abana yagiye atoza bakajya muri ayo makipe ntacyo ahawe nk’uwabazamuye, ndetse ngo ashaka kurega ayo makipe. Avuga ko APR FC yo yamwishyuye amafaranga yasabwaga y’indezo, akaba yaranayabyaje umusaruro aguramo inzu mu mujyi wa Kigali. IREBERE VIDEO Y’IKIGANIRO CYOSE HANO:

title: Rayon Sports yabonye Umuyobozi Mushya  usimbura Muvunyi
content:
Sadate Munyakazi niwe watorewe kuba Perezida mushya wa Rayon Sports asimbuye Paul Muvunyi wari umaze imyaka ibiri kuri uyu mwanya.
 Sadate Munyakazi niwe watorewe kuba Perezida mushya wa Rayon Sports asimbuye Paul Muvunyi wari umaze imyaka ibiri kuri uyu mwanya. Munyakazi yungirijwe na ba Visi Perezida babiri aribo Thadée Twagirayezu ( Visi perezida wa Mbere)na Prosper Muhirwa wabaye Visi Perezida wa Kabiri. Iyi Komite nshya ya Rayon Sports yatorewe mu karere ka Bugesera kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 14 Nyakanga 2019 mu nama y’ Inteko Rusange. Munyakazi Sadate asanzwe akuriye MK SKy Vision yazanye umushinga wo gufasha Rayon Sports kubaka Stade wiswe ’Gikundiro Stadium’. Twagirayezu Thadee asanzwe ashinzwe discipline muri Rayon Sports. Muhire Jean Paul wahoze ari umubitsi wa Rayon Sports yagizwe umunyamabanga. King Bernard yagizwe CEO wa Rayon Sports. Cyiza Richard yabaye umubitsi asimbuye Muhire Jean Paul. title: Ibyo Neymar yabwiye abo yasanze hanze amaze guhatwa ibibazo ku kirego cyo gufata ku ngufu
content:
Icyamamare mu mupira w’ amaguru gikomoka mu gihugu cya Brazil Neymar kuri uyu wa Gatanu yagejejwe muri sitasiyo ya Polisi yo mu mujyi wa Rio de Janeiro ahatwa ibibazo ku kirego cy’ umukobwa umushinja kumufata ku ngufu, asohotse avuga ko Isi iri kumwe nawe.
 Icyamamare mu mupira w’ amaguru gikomoka mu gihugu cya Brazil Neymar kuri uyu wa Gatanu yagejejwe muri sitasiyo ya Polisi yo mu mujyi wa Rio de Janeiro ahatwa ibibazo ku kirego cy’ umukobwa umushinja kumufata ku ngufu, asohotse avuga ko Isi iri kumwe nawe. Neymar ahakana gufata kungufu umunyamideli w’ umunyeshuri Najila Trindade, ubwo bari muri hoteli yo mu Bufaransa tariki 15 Gicurasi 2019. Trindade ku wa Gatanu w’ icyumweru cyashize nibwo uyu mukobwa yatanze ikirego abwira televiziyo yo muri Brazil ko ashaka ubutabera. Neymar yahagarikiwe ikarita ya Mastercard yamufashaga kubikuza amafaranga n’ abo yamamarizaga barabihagarika. Iyi karita ngo azongera kuyikoresha ari uko iki kirego cyarangiye. Neymar ari mukinnyi bahembwa atubutse ku Isi. 
 Uruganda rwa Nike, Neymar yamamarizaga rwatangaje ko rutewe igishika n’ ikirego cyo kuba Neymar ashinjwa gufata ku ngufu. Neymar yagiye guhatwa ibibazo asunikwa mu kagare kubera imvune afite ku kabumbampori yavanye mu mukino wa gishuti wahuje Brazil na Qatar. Umunyamategeko wa Neymar, Maira Fernandes, yabwiye Reuters ko "Neymar yavuze ku byo aregwa… Dufite icyizere gihagije ko ibimenyetso dufite bizagaragaza ko ari umwere”. Asohotse muri Sitasiyo ya Polisi Neymar yashimiye abantu bakomeje kumushyigikira. Ati “Ndabashimira ko mukomeje kumba hafi, ubutumwa bwose Isi yanyoherereje, Inshuti zanjye, abafana banjye, Isi iri kumwe nanjye. Ndashaka kubashimira ku byiza munyifuriza no kubabwira no nuzuye urukundo”. Uyu mukobwa avuga ko we na Neymar bahuriye kuri instagram, umukobwa akabwira uyu mukinnyi wa PSG ko amwifuza bikaba nko korosora uwabyukaga. Neymar ngo yahise atega indege ava muri Brazil ajya mu Bufaransa ajyanywe no kwinezezanya bishingiye ku gitsina n’ uyu mukobwa. Trindade avuga ko icyo baje gushanira ari uko Neymar yanze kwikingira, umukobwa yamukanira agakoresha imbaraga akamufata ku ngufu. Ibi byose Neymar arabihakana akavuga ko icyo uyu mukobwa ashaka ari amafaranga. Neymar ashobora no gukurikiranwa kucyaha cyo gushyira ku mbuga nkoranyambaga amafoto y’ uyu mukobwa Trindade agahanirwa kwinjira mu buzima bwe bwite.

title: UEFA : Liverpool itwaye igikombe itsinze umukino waranzwe n’ udushya turimo umugore wambaye ubusa [AMAFOTO]
content:
Ikipe ya Liverpool yegukanye igikombe cya 6 cya UEFA Champions League nyuma yo gutsinda Tottenham Hotspurs F.C ibitego 2-0 birimo icyabonetse ku munota wa 1 w’ umukino.
 Ikipe ya Liverpool yegukanye igikombe cya 6 cya UEFA Champions League nyuma yo gutsinda Tottenham Hotspurs F.C ibitego 2-0 birimo icyabonetse ku munota wa 1 w’ umukino. Ni umukino wabaye kuri uyu wa 1 Kamena 2019, ukaba ari umukino waranzwe n’ ishyaka ryinshi ku ikipe ya Tottenham Hotspurs nubwo utayihiriye. Iyi kipe niyo yahererekanyije umupira cyane ariko kureba mu izamu byayibereye ingorabahizi kuko umutoza wa Liverpool yari maso cyane. Ku munota wa 1’48’’ w’ umukino nibwo ikipe ya Liverpool yabonye igitego cya mbere cyatshinzwe na Mohamed Sarah kuri penaliti yakozwe na Moussa Sissoko.  Iki gitego nicyo gitego cya kabiri kihuse mu mateka ya UEFA champions League nyuma y’ icyatsinzwe na Paulo Martins mu masegonda 50 y’ umukino. Uretse agashya ko kuba uyu mukino wabonetsemo igitego ku munota wa mbere w’ umukino akandi gashya kabonetse ni uko mu minota 30 y’ umukino hari umugore wambaye ubusa hasi yanyuze mu kibuga hagati, ku murongo ugabanya ikibuga mo kabiri, umukino uri kuba. 



Uyu mugore yanyuze mu kibuga hagati yambaye bikini ubwo umukino wari urimbanyije Amashusho y’ uyu mugore wanyuze mu kibuga cya sitade cya sitade y’ I Madrid yakiriye umukino wa nyuma y’ igikombe cy’ amakipe yabaye ayambere iwayo ntabwo yamaze amasegonda arenze atanu ku matereviziyo yerekanaga uyu mupira. Ishyirahamwe ry’ umupira w’ amaguru ku Isi FIFA ryahaye aya mateleviziyo amabwiriza y’ uko ishyano ribereye kuri sitade mu mupira w’ amaguru atemerewe kuricishaho. Liverpool yakiniye umukino wo kurinda izamu cyane no kunyuzamo ikiba umugono abakinnyi b’ ikipe ya Totten ham. Ku munota wa 38, umukinnyi wa Liverpool Andrew Robertson yahushije igitego cyari cyabazwe ku ishoti rikomeye cyane yashose umuzamu wa Totten ham akoraho umupira unyura hejuru y’ umutambiko w’ izamu. Uyu mukino wa nyuma Totten Ham yagezeho nyuma yo gutsinda ikipe ya Ajax, wabereye muri sitade ya gatatu mu mujyi wa Madrid yakira abantu 67 800. Amakipe yombi yagiye kuruhuka ari igitego kimwe cya Liverpool ku busa bwa Totten ham. Ku munota wa 73 Totten Ham yashyizemo Eric Didier asimbuye Moussa Sissoko wakoze penaliti mu buryo bwamutunguye agatuma igipe ye itangira umukino itsindwa. Ku munota wa 87 w’ umukino kuri pase yari aherewe mu rubuga rw’ amahina Divock Origi yatsinze igitego cya kabiri cya Liverpool umukino urangira , iyi kipe ihita yegukana igikombe cya 6 cya UEFA champions League. Liverpool yatwaye igikombe cya mbere cya UEFA champions League mu 1977, icya kabiri yagitwaye mu 1978, icya gatatu yagitwaye mu 1981, wagitwaye ku nshuro ya kane mu 1984, yaherukaga ku gitwara muri 2005 itsinze kuri Penaliti ikipe ya AC Milan.

title: Umuzamu wa APR FC yagaragaye muri video yambaye ubusa
content:
Kimenyi Yves, Umunyezamu w’ ikipe y’ igihugu Amavubi akaba n’ umunyezamu w’ Ikipe ya APR yagaragaye muri video y’ amasagonda 48 yambaye ubusa.
 Kimenyi Yves, Umunyezamu w’ ikipe y’ igihugu Amavubi akaba n’ umunyezamu w’ Ikipe ya APR yagaragaye muri video y’ amasagonda 48 yambaye ubusa. Aya mashusho yakwirakwiye ku mbuga nkoranya mbaga kuri uyu wa Mbere tariki 15 Mata 2019, mu gihe habura iminsi 5 ngo APR FC ihurire na Mukeba wayo Rayon Sports mu mukino w’ irushanwa ry’ igikombe cya shampiyona. Bigaragara ko iyi video yafatiwe mu bwongero n’ umuntu bikekwa ko ari inshuti ya Kimenyi Yves baganira. Gusa kurundi ruhande bamwe mu bakoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga bakekwa ko iyi video Kimenyi ashobora kuba yarayoherereje inshuti ikamuvamo ikayashyira ku mbuga nkoranya mbaga. Kimenyi Yves ntacyo aravuga ku birebana n’ iyi video. Ayo mashusho y’ amasagonda 48 yakwirakwiye ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zirimo WhatsApp na Instagram. Kimenyi Yves umaze imyaka itatu ari mu banyezamu APR FC igenderaho, yitwaye neza mu mpera za shampiyona ya 2016/17 ndetse agaragaza ubushobozi bwe mu mikino y’igikombe cy’Amahoro mu 2017 kugeza ku mukino wa nyuma ari mu izamu ubwo ikipe ye yacyegukanaga itsinze Espoir FC igitego 1-0. 
 Yatangiye kwifashishwa mu ikipe y’igihugu Amavubi mu mpera za 2017, ahamagarwa mu mikino itandukanye irimo CECAFA y’ibihugu, CHAN 2018 ndetse n’imikino y’ikipe nkuru mu gushaka itike ya CAN 2019, aho yabanje mu izamu mu mikino ine muri itandatu Amavubi yakinnye.

title: Esperance de Tunis yasabwe gusubiza igikombe cya CAF Champions League,Umukino uzasubirwamo
content:
Umukino wa nyuma wa CAF Champions League wari wahuje Esperance na Wydad Casablanca yo muri Maroc warangiye amakipe yombi atumvikanye  Wydada yikura mu kibuga .
 Umukino wa nyuma wa CAF Champions League wari wahuje Esperance na Wydad Casablanca yo muri Maroc warangiye amakipe yombi atumvikanye  Wydada yikura mu kibuga . Ubusanzwe amakipe akina imikino 2 umukino ubanza wahuje amakipe yombi wabereye muri Maroc banganyije 1-1. Mu mukino wo kwishyura, Esperance yari yabanje gutsinda igitego mu gice cya mbere, kiza kwishyurwa na Wydad Casablanca,ariko umusifuzi aracyanga, biteza ikibazo bituma Wydad Casablanca yivana mu kibuga. 
  Abakinnyi ba Wydad Casablanca bikuye mu kibuga nyuma yuko basanze VAR idakora .
 Abakinnyi ba Wydad Casablanca bashakaga ko hakoreshwa uburyo bwa VAR (the video assistant referee) kugira ngo bashire amatsiko niba batibwe. Ikibazo cyakomeye kurushaho nyuma yo gusanga VAR idakora. Nyuma y’isaha irenga, igikombe cyaje gushyikirizwa Esperance ariko CAF yasabye ko umukino uzasubirwamo , ugakinirwa ku kibuga kiri ‘neutre’ (kitari icya Esperance ntikibe nicya Wydad) BBC ivuga ko uyu mukino uzasubirwamo nyuma y’igikombe cya Afurika kizasozwa tariki 19 Nyakanga 2019. CAF ngo yasabye abakinnyi ba Esperance kuzasubiza igikombe ndetse n’imidali bari bahawe. Ibi Caf yabyemeje mu nama yabereye mu Bufaransa 
 CAF yasabye ko abakinnyi ba Esperance de Tunis basubiza imidari n’igikombe bari bahawe umukino ukazasubirwamo .

  Abakinnyi ba Wydad Casablanca bikuye mu kibuga nyuma yuko basanze VAR idakora .
 Abakinnyi ba Wydad Casablanca bashakaga ko hakoreshwa uburyo bwa VAR (the video assistant referee) kugira ngo bashire amatsiko niba batibwe. Ikibazo cyakomeye kurushaho nyuma yo gusanga VAR idakora. Nyuma y’isaha irenga, igikombe cyaje gushyikirizwa Esperance ariko CAF yasabye ko umukino uzasubirwamo , ugakinirwa ku kibuga kiri ‘neutre’ (kitari icya Esperance ntikibe nicya Wydad) BBC ivuga ko uyu mukino uzasubirwamo nyuma y’igikombe cya Afurika kizasozwa tariki 19 Nyakanga 2019. CAF ngo yasabye abakinnyi ba Esperance kuzasubiza igikombe ndetse n’imidali bari bahawe. Ibi Caf yabyemeje mu nama yabereye mu Bufaransa 
 CAF yasabye ko abakinnyi ba Esperance de Tunis basubiza imidari n’igikombe bari bahawe umukino ukazasubirwamo .
