Barahanurira umugore bati wari inguma ugiye kubyara, ingumba zose se ntizizajyayo? Imana yagirira umugore imbabazi akabyara, bati ntureba? Baravura indwara, barakora ibitangaza babeshya, Yesu ntiyaje gukiza imibiri yaje gukiza ibitekerezo... Njye ntawe nemera ko ahanura, nemera Bibiliya. Nanjye nta buhanuzi bwanjye, mvuga Bibiliya. Ntabwo ngira, ntabwo nigeze, ariko igihe nari ntarabimenya, narahanuraga bigacika. Nabivuyemo, ariko nari igitangaza. Ukaza ngo ngwino ngusabire, ngwino nguhe imigisha kandi ntayo mfite, nkayiguha nawe ukampa urufaranga, nanjye narababeshye, nararikoze. Ariko n’ubu ndicuza, ubu sindi Mpyisi wawundi." title: Theo Bosebabireba yakubitiwe bikomeye muri Uganda n’abagizi ba nabi arakomereka ajyanwa mu bitaro
content:
Umuhanzi Theogene Uwiringiyimana [Bosebabireba]  yakubitiwe bikomeye muri Uganda aho yari amaze iminsi arakomereka cyane ndetse anajyanwa mu bitaro. Bivugwa ko yahondaguwe n’agatsiko k’abantu bataramenyekana.
 Umuhanzi Theogene Uwiringiyimana [Bosebabireba]  yakubitiwe bikomeye muri Uganda aho yari amaze iminsi arakomereka cyane ndetse anajyanwa mu bitaro. Bivugwa ko yahondaguwe n’agatsiko k’abantu bataramenyekana. Umuhanzi Theo Bosebabireba amaze iminsi i Kampala muri Uganda aho yagiyeyo mu ntangiriro z’uku kwezi muri gahunda zitamenyekanye. Bivugwa ko Theo Bosebabireba yakubiswe mu ijoro ryo Cyumweru tariki 28 Mutarama 2018  n’abagizi ba nabi bamukubise bakamusiga ari intere bakekako yashizzemo umwuka. Uyu muhanzi yakubitiwe mu mujyi wa Kampala ubwo yari avuye mu gitaramo yari yatumiwemo mu gace ka Masanafu kuri iki cyumweru. Umugore wa Theo Bsebabireba, Mushimiyimana Marie Chantal, yemereye  Inyarwanda ko amakuru y’uko umugabo we yakubiswe ariyo koko, avuga ko  yayamenye ayabwiwe n’umwe mu bapasiteri bo mu Rwanda. Iyi nkuru ibabaje ije nyuma y’andi makuru aherutse kuvugwa cyane kuri uyu muhanzi ajyanye n’ihagarikwa rye mu itorero rya ADEPR aho ryamushijjaga imyitwarire idahwitse irimo ubusambanyi, ubusinzi n’ubuzererezi nk’uko abayobozi b’iri torero babihamirije itangazamakuru. Nyuma gato y’ihagarikwa muri iri torero,  nibwo uyu muhanzi Theo Bosebabireba yagiye mu gihugu cya Uganda. 
Theo Bosebabireba amerewe nabi aho ari kuvurirwa mu bitaro biri mu mujyi wa Kampala

title: Mugisha w’imyaka 10 yatangaje abantu nyuma yo gukizwa ubumuga na Bishop Rugagi - Amafoto
content:
Mugisha Julien ni umwana w’umuhungu w’imyaka 10 gusa y’amavugo, akaba agaragaza impano idasanzwe yo kubwiriza ijambo ry’Imana imbaga y’abantu benshi, ibintu yagaragaje nyuma y’igihe gito akorewe ibitangaza, dore ko yasengewe mu minsi ishize na Bishop Rugagi agahita akira burundu ubumuga yari afite.
 Mugisha Julien ni umwana w’umuhungu w’imyaka 10 gusa y’amavugo, akaba agaragaza impano idasanzwe yo kubwiriza ijambo ry’Imana imbaga y’abantu benshi, ibintu yagaragaje nyuma y’igihe gito akorewe ibitangaza, dore ko yasengewe mu minsi ishize na Bishop Rugagi agahita akira burundu ubumuga yari afite. Mu mezi macye ashize, uyu mwana yaje mu Iterero ry’Abacunguwe riyobowe na Bishop Rugagi Innocent, aho yaje aherekejwe na nyina umubyara ari kumucunga mu kagare kuko yari yarahinamiranye nyuma y’uko bari bamaze kumutangaho amafaranga y’u Rwanda arenga miliyoni 10 mu bitaro byitiriwe umwami Faisal ariko bikanga nk’uko urubuga rw’abacunguwe rwabitangaje. Uyu mwana muri Nyakanga uyu mwaka yari afite ubumuga bwari bwarananiranye, aha yari azanywe mu kagare Bishop Rugagi yaramusengeye, asaba Imana ko yamukiza akigenza Aha Mugisha Julien yari amaze kuva mu kagare atangiye kwigenza Tariki 19 Nyakanga 2017 ubwo mu Itorero Abacunguwe habaga amateraniro Bishop Rugagi agasengera abantu batandukanye bari bafite uburwayi bwananiranye, mu basengewe harimo n’uyu Mugisha Julien wahise akira atangira kwigenza, ajugunya akagare agenda yemye ndetse atangira no kwiruka. Ibi icyo gihe byatangaje ababyeyi be cyane cyane nyina kuko we byabaye ahibereye amaso ku maso. Nyina wa Mugisha Julien, ibyishimo byaramurenze amaze kubona umwana we arimo kwigenza Akagare Julien yajemo, ntiyigeze agacyura yagasize ku rusengero rw’itorero Abacunguwe ataha yigenza Tariki 24 Ugushyingo 2017, Mugisha Julien n’ababyeyi be baje kubatizwa nyuma yo kubona ko Imana yabakoreye ibitangaza bakemera gukizwa, kuva ubwo baba abayoboke b’Itorero Abacunguwe rya Bishop Innocent Rugagi. Nyuma yo gukira ubumuga yari afite agahita anakizwa, uyu mwana ubu yatangiye kujya abwiriza ubutumwa ndetse afite gahunda yo kuzabikomeza. Aha Mugisha Julien n’ababyeyi be bari babatijwe mu kwezi gushize Mu cyumweru gishize, Mugisha Julien yatunguye abantu ubwo yabwirizaga imbaga y’abantu benshi, akanagaragaza impano idasanzwe kuko mu kubwiriza kwe yavuze amagambo benshi bagaragaje ko yabakoze ku mutima cyane. Mu kubwiriza kwe, Mugisha ati: ”Hari abantu babaho nabi bakagira ngo nibwo buzima bazahoramo, nyamara n’iyo utabaho neza mu isi, hari ijuru aho umuntu azahoraho mu munezero udashira. Wowe nawe uriho neza uyu munsi, fasha mugenzi wawe umwiteho umufashe ku mugisha Imana yaguhaye kugirango muzabane na we mu ijuru mu munezero udashira. Wowe ufite ibibazo jya ubibwira Imana yonyine abe ariyo ubitura, kuko ishobora byose,….” Mugisha Julien imbere y’imbaga y’abantu benshi arimo kubwiriza Aba ababyeyi ba Mugisha Julien nabo bari bakurikiye ibyo umwana wabo yigisha Mu banejejwe n’uburyo Mugisha Julien yabwirije, harimo na Bishop Rugagi Innocent washimangiye ko uyu mwana Imana yamukijije kubera impamvu ikomeye. Uyu mwana amaze kubwiriza, Bishop Rugagi yarahagurutse avuga ko Imana yakijije uyu mwana ikamukura mu kagare kuko yabonaga satani afite umugambi wo gupfukirana impano imurimo idasanzwe. Bishop Rugagi ati: ”Imana yagukijije kuko yari igufiteho umugambi, ntabwo wari kubwiriza wicaye mu kagare. Imana igukomereze iyi mpano yawe, uzabe umubwiriza w’amahanga ndetse nawe uzakize abandi yaba imitima ndetse n’imibiri.... Julien ku cyumweru nibwo yambwiye ati Bishop nanjye mfite ijambo ry’Imana nshaka kuzabwiriza, nibwo namubwiye nti genda uritegure neza ku Cyumweru nzaguha umwanya uribwirize.”

title: Muhanga: Pasiteri warongoye inkumi arusha imyaka myinshi yavugishije benshi - Amafoto
content:
Kuwa Gatandatu tariki 2 Nzeri 2017, nibwo mu karere ka Muhanga habereye ubukwe bwahuruje imbaga ndetse bukomeza kugarukwaho cyane n’ababutashye, ababonye abageni mu mihango itandukanye y’ubukwe ndetse n’ababonye amafoto y’abageni acicikana ku mbuga nkoranyambaga bagakomeza kubitindaho.
 Kuwa Gatandatu tariki 2 Nzeri 2017, nibwo mu karere ka Muhanga habereye ubukwe bwahuruje imbaga ndetse bukomeza kugarukwaho cyane n’ababutashye, ababonye abageni mu mihango itandukanye y’ubukwe ndetse n’ababonye amafoto y’abageni acicikana ku mbuga nkoranyambaga bagakomeza kubitindaho. Ubu bukwe bwavugishije benshi amangambure, ni ubwa Pasiteri Buruga Aloys Gonzaga n’umukunzi we Umutoniwase Solange, bivugwa ko amurusha imyaka irenga 35 ariko ibi bikaba bitarababujije kwikundanira ndetse bakanashinga urugo nyuma yo gukora ubukwe bw’urukererezabagenzi. 
 Ubu ni ubutumire mu bukwe bwa Pasiteri Aloys n’umukunzi we Umutoniwase Solange Saa tatu za mugitondo cyo kuwa Gatandatu tariki 2 Nzeri 2017, nibwo Pasiteri Buruga Aloys Gonzaga n’abari bamugaragiye, bagiye i Ruli mu karere ka Muhanga mu mihango yo gusaba no gukwa Umutoniwase Solange. Mu masaha y’amanywa, ubukwe bwakomereje mu mihango yo gusezerana imbere y’Imana yabereye mu rusengero rwa Revival Mission Church rwa Muhanga, maze nyuma y’iyo mihango abatumiwe bakirirwa mu cyumba cya Lumina nacyo kiri aha mu mujyi wa Muhanga. 
 
 
 Ubu bukwe bwatashywe n’inshuti hamwe n’imiryango y’abageni bombi, ariko hari n’abahageraga bameze nk’abashungera bigaragara ko bari batangajwe n’ikinyuranyo cy’imyaka y’abageni, dore ko n’ubwo abageni ubwabo batabyihamirije, bivugwa ko umugabo arusha umugore imyaka iri hejuru ya 35. 
 
 Kuva ubukwe bwaba, amafoto y’aba bageni yagiye akwirakwizwa cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga nka Whatsapp na Facebook, abantu bagaragaza ko batangajwe n’ubu bukwe, abandi bakagaragaza ko ari ikimenyetso cy’urukundo nyarwo rudashingira ku kinyuranyo cy’imyaka, cyane ko abageni bombi bujuje imyaka y’ubukure. 
 Iyi mihango y’ubukwe bwabo yose yabanjirijwe n’uwo gusezerana mu murenge wa Nyamabuye Mu kiganiro n’Ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com, Pasiteri Buruga Aloys Gonzaga yavuze ko nta kintu yifuza gutangariza itangazamakuru ku bijyanye n’ubukwe bwe, iby’umugeni baherutse kurushingana n’iby’urukundo rwabo muri rusange.

title: Bombori bombori mu Itorero Inkuru Nziza, Umuvugizi waryo wagaragaye yikinisha ntiyorohewe
content:
Nyuma yo kujya hanze kw’amashusho y’Umuvugizi w’Itorero Inkuru Nziza mu Rwanda, Pasiteri Ngaboyisonga Theoneste arimo kwikinisha bikaza guteza impaka aho bamwe mu bafatanyije nawe kuyobora itorero bamusabye ubusobanuro kuri aya mashusho abandi bakamusaba ko yakwegura ku mirimo  kubw’imyitwarire ye, kuri ubu nonehobbamwe mu bakirisitu nabo bakomeje gusaba uyu muyobozi gutanga ubusobanuro kuri aya mashusho bamushinja kuzana umwuka mubi n’ubushyamirane bigamije gusenya itorero ryabo.
 Nyuma yo kujya hanze kw’amashusho y’Umuvugizi w’Itorero Inkuru Nziza mu Rwanda, Pasiteri Ngaboyisonga Theoneste arimo kwikinisha bikaza guteza impaka aho bamwe mu bafatanyije nawe kuyobora itorero bamusabye ubusobanuro kuri aya mashusho abandi bakamusaba ko yakwegura ku mirimo  kubw’imyitwarire ye, kuri ubu nonehobbamwe mu bakirisitu nabo bakomeje gusaba uyu muyobozi gutanga ubusobanuro kuri aya mashusho bamushinja kuzana umwuka mubi n’ubushyamirane bigamije gusenya itorero ryabo. Mu kwezi kwa Mutarama uyu mwaka wa 2017, nibwo hagaragaye video yagaragazaga, Pasiteri Ngaboyisonga Theoneste ari nawe muvugizi w’Itorero ry’Inkuru Nziza mu Rwanda aho yarimo yikinisha. Ibi bikaba byarahagurikije bamwe mu bashumba bafatanyije n’uyu mu pasiteri mu murimo wo kuyobora iri torero biza kugeza n’ubwo benshi mu ba kirisitu bumvikanya banenga cyane uyu muyobozi wabo dore ko bakunze kuvuga ko atari umuco wagakwiye kuranga umushumba uyoboye itorero ryose ku rwego rw’igihugu. 
Intandaro y’iyi video yateje impagaragara kuva muri Mutarama kugeza ubu Aho aya mashusho yaturutse ntabwo havugwaho rumwe cyane ko ari umuvugizi w’itorero Inkuru Nziza (Nyirubwite), Pasiteri Ngaboyisonga Theoneste adahakana cyangwa ngo yemere iby’ayo ahubwo kuri we ngo iyo abajijwe n’abapasiteri bagenzi be abasubiza ko Video yashyikirijwe Polisi ishami rishinzwe ubugenzacyaha kugirango harebwe uwaba yihishe inyuma y’iyi video. 
Umuvugizi w’Itorero Inkuru Nziza mu Rwanda, Pasiteri Ngaboyisonga Theoneste Pasiteri Bazatsinda Fred uyobora Itorero Inkuru Nziza muri Paruwasi ya Gihogwe iri mu murenge wa Jali, akarere ka Gasabo mu mujyi wa Kigali yabwiye ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com ko bakimara kubona aya mashusho banditse ibaruwa isaba ubusobanuro bwayo ndetse mu kwezi kwa kabiri bamwe mu ba Pasiteri bo mu Mujyi wa Kigali bikomwa n’Umunyamabanga mukuru w’iri torero abashinja kwigomeka no gushinga udutsiko tugamije gusenya iri torero Yagize ati "Mu kwezi kwa Kabiri (Gashyantare, 2017) nibwo abapasitori bo mu mujyi wa Kigali twateranye twandika ibaruwa dusaba ko umuvugizi wungirije yadushakira ubusobanuro bw’iyi video ariko umunyamabanga yahise atwita agatsiko nyuma atwandikira ibaruwa atubwira ko twebwe abashumba twakoze ibyo tudashinzwe ndetse anatubwira ko twahangaye umuyobozi. Ariko natwe twahise twandikira komite nyobozi y’itorero dusaba ko yahagarika igitaraganya uyu muvugizi mu gihe cyose atari yabanza kwisobanura ngo arinde ubu butumwa butari bwiza ku itorero n’abakirisitu baryo" Uyu mu pasiteri avuga ko nabo batazi aho iyo video yavuye cyane ko bigaragara ko ari pasiteri wayifashe arimo kwikinisha ndetse igashyirwa kuri uru rubuga ari nabyo bashaka ubusobanuro bwabyo kuko bihesha isura mbi itorero Gusa ku rundi ruhande hari amakuru agera ku kinyamakuru Ukwezi.com yemezwa na bamwe mu bari hafi ya nyirubwite, avuga ko iyi video yashyizwe ahagaragara n’umukobwa uyu mu pasiteri yari yayoherereje nyuma bakaza kugirana ikibazo umukobwa akabwira uyu pasiteri ko agiye gushyira hanze amwe mu mabanga yabo arimo n’iyi video. Aya makuru akomeza avuga ko byaje kuba ngombwa ko uyu Pasiteri Ngaboyisonga asabwa n’umukobwa  kuzamuha amafaranga agera kuri miliyoni ebyiri y’u Rwanda (2 000 000Frw) gusa byaje kurangira Pasiteri yanze kuyamuha umukobwa ahitamo kuyashyira aharagara. Abandi bapasiteri bamusabye kwegura no kwisobanura kuby’iyi video bose bari mu mazi abira Uyu Pasiteri Fred waganiriye n’ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com kandi yavuze ko muri Werurwe abashumba bayobora intara ya Kibungo nabo bafashe icyemezo cyo kwandika basaba ubusobanuro kuri iyi video Ati  "Abapasiteri bayobora intara ya Kibungo nabo banditse basaba ubusobanuro mu kwezi kwa Gatatu nyuma hakurikiraho n’abo mu ntara y’Umutara na Cyangugu. Ibi ariko byatumye bamwe bajya mu bibazo bikomeye kuko murabyibuka ko mu kwezi kwa Kane aribwo habaye imirwano ikomeye mu Itorero ryacu i Kibungo bikaviramo bamwe gufungwa, ariko si ibyo gusa kuko n’i Cyangugu  aba pasiteri babiri begujwe ku mirimo yabo bazira gusaba ubu busobanuro kuri iyi video" Iyi nkundura yo gusaba ubusobanuro kandi ntabwo yagarukiye ku kwirukanwa kwa bamwe dore ko hari n’abandi bapasiteri bagiye bahindurirwa ama paruwasi bayoboraga bakajyanwa aho badashaka ahanini biturutse ku kuba bari mu basaba ko hatangwa ubusobanuro kuri iyi video. 
Pasiteri Bazatsinda Fred, uyobora Itorero Inkuru Nziza, Paruwasi ya Gihogwe iri mu murenge wa Jali Umwuka si mwiza mu bakirisitu bitewe n’iyi video Kugeza ubu umuzungu wari umaze imyaka isaga 20 atera inkunga iri torero yamaze kwisubirira iwabo ndetse bikaba bivugwa ko impamvu nyamukuru ari uko aba bashumba batameranye neza ndetse n’abakirisitu nabo bakaba baratangiye gucikamo ibice, icy’abashyigikiye ko Umuvugizi yegura cyangwa agatanga ubusobanuro kuri iyi video n’ikindi gice cy’abashaka gukingira ikibaba uyu muvugizi. Bamwe mu bakirisitu twaganiriye batifuje ko dutangaza imyirondoro yabo bavuze ko umwuka mubi uri muri iri torero ryabo nta yindi ntandaro itari iy’iyi video bavuga ko hatabonetse ikihishe inyuma y’aya mashusho byakomeza guteza impagarara cyane ko hari abandi bapasiteri badahwema kotsa igitutu umuvugizi kandi abagaragaye bose bahita batangira guhura n’ibibazo bikurizamo gukurwa ku mirimo y’ubupasiteri. Gusa ku rundi ruhande hari amabaruwa avuga ko umuvugizi ashinja abapasiteri bamwe gucunga nabi umutungo w’abaterankunga b’iri torero ariko hakaza n’andi mabaruwa agaragaza gutesha agaciro ibi byanditswe n’uruhande rumwe nk’uko bigaragar muri aya mabaruwa Ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com gifitiye kopi, ndetse nk’uko bigaragara mu bo ubu butumwa bwagenewe harimo n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’imiyoborere (RGB) ari nacyo gifite mu nshingano amatorero n’amadini mu Rwanda. Mu gitondo cyo kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 29 Ukwakira 2017, ubwo umunyamakuru wa Ukwezi.com yageraga ku Itorero Inkuru Nziza muri Paruwasi ya Gihogwe ari naho uyu muvugizi yari yasengeye, ntitwabashije kubona uburyo tumuvugisha cyane ko yahise ajya mu modoka amateraniro akirangira.  Ubwo twatunganyaga iyi nkuru twagerageje kuvugisha uyu muvugizi w’Itorero Inkuru Nziza mu Rwanda, Pasiteri Theoneste ku murongo wa telefone ye igendanwa ntiyabasha kutwitaba, tuzakomeza kumuhamagara nagira icyo atangaza tuzabibagezaho.
Pasiteri Bazatsinda Fred, uyobora Itorero Inkuru Nziza, Paruwasi ya Gihogwe kuva mu mwaka w’1997, nawe ari mu bashobora kwimurwa cyangwa agakurwa ku mirimo y’ubu pasiteri azira gusaba ubusobanuro kuri iyi video yateje impagarara

label: religion
title: Bishop Rugagi agiye kugura indi modoka irenze Ranger Rover, indege nayo yabajije ibiciro
content:
Nyuma y’uko imodoka ya Bishop Rugagi yo mu bwoko bwa Range Rover mu minsi ishize yavugishije benshi ndetse abantu batandukanye ntibavuge rumwe ku magambo uyu muvugabutumwa yakoresheje ashima Imana ko yamuhaye imodoka nziza, ubu noneho Bishop Rugagi Innocent yavuze ko agiye kugura indi modoka y’igitangaza irenze kure Range Rover, ndetse yaciye amarenge ko azahita akurikizaho no kugura indege kuko yamaze no kubaza ibiciro byayo.
 Nyuma y’uko imodoka ya Bishop Rugagi yo mu bwoko bwa Range Rover mu minsi ishize yavugishije benshi ndetse abantu batandukanye ntibavuge rumwe ku magambo uyu muvugabutumwa yakoresheje ashima Imana ko yamuhaye imodoka nziza, ubu noneho Bishop Rugagi Innocent yavuze ko agiye kugura indi modoka y’igitangaza irenze kure Range Rover, ndetse yaciye amarenge ko azahita akurikizaho no kugura indege kuko yamaze no kubaza ibiciro byayo. Kuwa Gatatu tariki 1 Werurwe 2017, Bishop Rugagi Innocent, yashimye Imana ko yamuhaye imodoka y’akataraboneka ya Range Rover Sport iri mu modoka zihenze cyane, ibirenze kuri ibyo ikaba yaramuhaye n’imodoka ifite ibirango (plaque) bifite umubare ugaragaza ikimenyetso cya Yesu gihangana n’ikimenyetso cya Satani kizwi nka 666. Iyo modoka ya Bishop Ruragi Innocent yo ifite ibirango bya RAD 777 B, uyu mubare 777 akaba yarahamije ko ari ikimenyetso cya Yesu. Bisho Rugagi ati: "Niba Shitani afite ibimenyetso 666 Yesu na we afite ibimenyetso 777. Kandi uko imisozi igose i Yerusalemu niko Uwiteka agose abantu be." Nyuma yo kuva i Burayi aho yari yagiye mu biterane bitandukanye mu bihugu byiganjemo ibituyemo abanyarwanda benshi, Bishop Rugagi noneho kuri iki Cyumweru ubwo yari mu materaniro, yahishuye ko agiye kugura indi modoka ihenze cyane kandi ko n’indege yamaze kubaza ibiciro byayo. Bishop Rugagi yagize ati: "Ntabwo umukozi w’Imana ari we ukwiriye kubaho nabi, Oya habe na gato, ahubwo ni we ukwiriye kubaho neza mbere y’abandi bose! Muvuga Ranger Rover? Ubu ngiye kuzazana indi modoka iyirenzeho, ndetse n’indege namaze kubaza ibiciro byayo. Mutegereze gato gusa.” 
 Iyi ni imodoka yo mu bwoko bwa Range Rover Bishop Rugagi yari asanzwe afite gusa ngo ntabwo ihagije ashaka kugura indi akazagura n’indege


Iyi nayo ni indi modoka Bishop Rugagi yahawe nk’impano y’imodoka nziza n’umupasiteri witwa Bishop David uyobora Itorero ryitwa MICA rikorera mu mujyi wa Bruxelles.

 Nyuma y’uko imodoka ya Bishop Rugagi yo mu bwoko bwa Range Rover mu minsi ishize yavugishije benshi ndetse abantu batandukanye ntibavuge rumwe ku magambo uyu muvugabutumwa yakoresheje ashima Imana ko yamuhaye imodoka nziza, ubu noneho Bishop Rugagi Innocent yavuze ko agiye kugura indi modoka y’igitangaza irenze kure Range Rover, ndetse yaciye amarenge ko azahita akurikizaho no kugura indege kuko yamaze no kubaza ibiciro byayo. Kuwa Gatatu tariki 1 Werurwe 2017, Bishop Rugagi Innocent, yashimye Imana ko yamuhaye imodoka y’akataraboneka ya Range Rover Sport iri mu modoka zihenze cyane, ibirenze kuri ibyo ikaba yaramuhaye n’imodoka ifite ibirango (plaque) bifite umubare ugaragaza ikimenyetso cya Yesu gihangana n’ikimenyetso cya Satani kizwi nka 666. Iyo modoka ya Bishop Ruragi Innocent yo ifite ibirango bya RAD 777 B, uyu mubare 777 akaba yarahamije ko ari ikimenyetso cya Yesu. Bisho Rugagi ati: "Niba Shitani afite ibimenyetso 666 Yesu na we afite ibimenyetso 777. Kandi uko imisozi igose i Yerusalemu niko Uwiteka agose abantu be." Nyuma yo kuva i Burayi aho yari yagiye mu biterane bitandukanye mu bihugu byiganjemo ibituyemo abanyarwanda benshi, Bishop Rugagi noneho kuri iki Cyumweru ubwo yari mu materaniro, yahishuye ko agiye kugura indi modoka ihenze cyane kandi ko n’indege yamaze kubaza ibiciro byayo. Bishop Rugagi yagize ati: "Ntabwo umukozi w’Imana ari we ukwiriye kubaho nabi, Oya habe na gato, ahubwo ni we ukwiriye kubaho neza mbere y’abandi bose! Muvuga Ranger Rover? Ubu ngiye kuzazana indi modoka iyirenzeho, ndetse n’indege namaze kubaza ibiciro byayo. Mutegereze gato gusa.” 
 Iyi ni imodoka yo mu bwoko bwa Range Rover Bishop Rugagi yari asanzwe afite gusa ngo ntabwo ihagije ashaka kugura indi akazagura n’indege


Iyi nayo ni indi modoka Bishop Rugagi yahawe nk’impano y’imodoka nziza n’umupasiteri witwa Bishop David uyobora Itorero ryitwa MICA rikorera mu mujyi wa Bruxelles.

title: Bishop Rugagi yasengeye umugore wasambanyijwe n’umupfumu amwizeza urubyaro
content:
Bishop Rugagi Innocent uyobora itorero Abacunguwe (Redeemed Gospel Church), aherutse gusengera umugore wari warasambanyijwe n’umupfumu amubeshya ko ari kumukura imyaku n’imikoshi mu myanya ye y’ibanga yatumaga atabona urubyaro. Akimara kumusengera Bishop Rugagi yahise amubwira ko ababariwe anamwizeza ko azabona urubyaro vuba cyane.
 Bishop Rugagi Innocent uyobora itorero Abacunguwe (Redeemed Gospel Church), aherutse gusengera umugore wari warasambanyijwe n’umupfumu amubeshya ko ari kumukura imyaku n’imikoshi mu myanya ye y’ibanga yatumaga atabona urubyaro. Akimara kumusengera Bishop Rugagi yahise amubwira ko ababariwe anamwizeza ko azabona urubyaro vuba cyane. Ibi byabaye mu materaniro yabaye mu cyumweru gishije ubwo Bishop Rugagi yari ageze mu mwanya w’ubuhanuzi ngo yageze mu ruhande uyu mugore yari yicayemo maze arahagarara ahita atangira guhanura ko yeretswe umugore uherutse kujya mu bapfumu gusaba urubyaro ndetse umupfumu akanamusambanya amubeshya ko aribwo azabona urubyaro. Yagize ati " Aha hari umugore wabuze urubyaro kandi yagiye mu bapfumu kenshi bamwizeza kubyara kugeza aho umupfumu yamubwiye ko imyaku iri mu myanya ye y’ibanga kandi ko igomba kumarwa n’uko basambanye akayimukiza. Imana nkorera imbwiye ko kubohoka kwawe ari uyu munsi. Haguruka aho uri Imana igukize uwo muvumo.” Nk’uko ikinyamakuru Abacunguwe.org cy’iro torero dukesha iyi nkuru kibitangaza, Bishop Rugagi akimara kuvuga aya magambo, uyu mugore yabanje kugira ubwoba akomeza kwiyicarira maze Bishop akomeje kugaragaza ibimenyetso bimuranga kugeza n’aho yavuze imyaka ye y’amavuko ndetse n’aho umupfumu atuye, umugore yaje gufata umwanzuro maze arahaguruka aratura arabivuga anasaba Imana imbabazi maze yizezwa ko ababariwe kandi ko agiye kubona urubyaro vuba cyane. Uretse uyu mugore wahanuriye maze akanasengerwa akabohoka ngo hari n’undi mukobwa wari wararozwe kuzahera ku ishyiga ariko nawe Bishop yahanuriye maze amwizeza ko agiye gusubira ibwana akabona abasore bamurambagiza.Bishop yamwijeje ko nawe ibyo yari yararozwe yabyirukanye maze amubira ko azabona umugabo. Uyu mukobwa nawe ubwo Bishop yamuvugaga, yabanje kugira isoni zo guhaguruka, bigera aho Bishop avuze izina rye, aho atuye ndetse n’aho akomoka, nawe aza gufata umwanzuro wo guhaguruka. Uyu mukobwa akimara guhaguruka yagize ati " Ba marume barirahiye ngo nta mwishywa wabo uzapfa ushatse, ngo twese tuzahera kw’ishyiga.” Bishop yamubwiye ko Imana imubwiye ko agiye gusubirana itoto ndetse atazagwa ku ishyiga ahubwo azubaka urugo rwe. 

Bishop Rugagi ubwo yavugaga ibimenyetso by’umugore wasambanjijwe n’umupfumu 
Abari mu iteraniro batangajwe n’ibitangaza Bishop akomeje gukora maze bose bazamura amaboko baha Imana icyubahiro 
Uyu mugore akimara guhanurirwa yashimye Imana maze yizezwa ko azabona urubyaro vuba 

Bishop Rugagi yanahanuriye kandi umukobwa wari warazingiwe ku ishyiga amubwira ko azasubira ibwana akanabona umugabo vuba

label: religion
title: Umurundi yatangajwe n’ibyo Bishop Rugagi yakoze, bimukura muri Amerika aza kwirebera
content:
Masumbuko Abedenego, umusaza w’Umurundi umaze imyaka 9 yibera muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yafashe umwanzuro wo gushakisha uburyo yaza mu Rwanda ku nshuro ye ya mbere, nyuma yo kurebera kuri mudasobwa akabona ibintu Bishop Rugagi akora, agashaka kuza kubireba ahibereye.
 Masumbuko Abedenego, umusaza w’Umurundi umaze imyaka 9 yibera muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yafashe umwanzuro wo gushakisha uburyo yaza mu Rwanda ku nshuro ye ya mbere, nyuma yo kurebera kuri mudasobwa akabona ibintu Bishop Rugagi akora, agashaka kuza kubireba ahibereye. Uyu musaza Masumbuko wivugira ko atazi gusoma, ahamya ko Imana yamuyoboye mu rugendo rwe kuva muri Amerika kugeza ageze ku cyicaro cy’Abacunguwe mu mujyi rwagati, nta kibazo agize kandi atari asanzwe ahazi. Umusaza Masumbuko ukomoka mu Burundi ariko uba muri Amerika Uyu musaza yatangarije umunyamakuru uburyo yamenye Bishop Rugagi Innocent agira ati:”Ubundi mbona Bishop ubwa mbere, hari ahantu nari natembereye ngezeyo nsanga bari kureba kuri computer uyu Bishop nanjye ndareba, ariko byarantangaje cyane kuko nabonaga akora ibitangaza bidasanzwe, asengera abantu bose mu izina rya Yesu kandi bagakira... Ubwo mu mutima wanjye nahise ngambirira ko ngomba gushaka uburyo naza nanjye nkazifatanya n’abandi muri aya masengesho, ndetse nkabona na Bishop Rugagi amaso ku maso, kuko numvaga mu bihe byanjye nsigaje, nzaba mbonanye n’umuntu w’agaciro cyane.” Uyu musaza avuka ko nyuma yo gushaka ibyangombwa n’amafaranga y’urugendo, yaciwe intege n’abantu bamubwiraga ko kugera kwa Bishop Rugagi bizabagora kuko atazi gusoma, ariko we akababwira ko Imana izabikora.Ubwo yageragayo mu cyumweru gishize, yongeye gushimangira ko ibyo yaboneye kwa Bishop Rugagi bihambaye cyane. Yagize ati: "Uyu mukozi w’Imana yarantangaje cyane, ahubwo none nibwo nabonye byinshi kurusha ibyo nari narabonye kuri computer. Nabonye azura abantu bameze nk’abapfuye, bazaga batakaje ubwenge bwose akabasengera bagakira, nabonye aho abantu bata imbago bakagenda n’amaguru yabo, nabonye abo yirukanamo amadayimoni akabavamo bakaba bazima, ikindi asengera amazi abantu bakayanywa bagakira indwara zabo. Nanjye naje ntameze neza ariko maze kunywa amazi yasengeye, nahise numva ngize impinduka mu mubiri wanjye.”  Imbere y’abantu yatanze ubuhamya bw’ibyo yabonye kuri Rugagi Umusaza Masumbuko yavuze ko nta cyifuzo kinini cyane yazanye ngo Bishop amusengere, gusa ngo yumvaga kubonana n’umuntu w’Imana udasanzwe nka Bishop Rugagi, ari ikintu yumva azaba yaragezeho cy’umumaro mu buzima bwe. Ikindi yongeyeho, yavuze ko yaje yizeye ko nabonana nawe gusa imbonankubone n’ibitagenda neza byose, bizahita bizagenda neza. Uyu musaza kandi n’ubwo yaje kubona umudiyakoni wo mu itorero rya Bishop Rugagi umujyana akamucumbikira, yatangarije umunyamakuru ko iyo atabona umucumbikiran yari kuzajya yirirwa mu rusengero akanaruraramo kuzageza igihe azasubirira muri Amerika. Bishop Rugagi nawe yagaragaje ko yishimiye ibyatangajwe n’uyu musaza

label: religion
title: Rusine washyingiye Knowless na Gaby arashinja Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti ivangura n’uburiganya
content:
Mu nkuru nyinshi zakurikiye ubukwe bw’umuhanzi Umutare Gaby n’umukunzi we Nzere Joyce, Ubuyobozi bw’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti mu Rwanda bwamaganiye kure Pasiteri Rusine Josue washyingiye uyu muryango mushya, rivuga ko ritajya rishyingirira abantu mu busitani. Pasiteri Rusine ariko yatangaje ko iri torero rivangura abantu rikabariganya ndetse yaritunze urutoki ko ubuyobozi bwaryo bufite imikorere idahwitse. Yongeyeho ko bitangaje kuba yaramaganiwe kure kandi umukobwa wa Pasiteri Byiringiro Hesron; Umuyobozi w’Itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda yarashyingiriwe mu busitani bw’akabari.
 Mu nkuru nyinshi zakurikiye ubukwe bw’umuhanzi Umutare Gaby n’umukunzi we Nzere Joyce, Ubuyobozi bw’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti mu Rwanda bwamaganiye kure Pasiteri Rusine Josue washyingiye uyu muryango mushya, rivuga ko ritajya rishyingirira abantu mu busitani. Pasiteri Rusine ariko yatangaje ko iri torero rivangura abantu rikabariganya ndetse yaritunze urutoki ko ubuyobozi bwaryo bufite imikorere idahwitse. Yongeyeho ko bitangaje kuba yaramaganiwe kure kandi umukobwa wa Pasiteri Byiringiro Hesron; Umuyobozi w’Itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda yarashyingiriwe mu busitani bw’akabari. Ni mu kiganiro yahaye ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com, aho yavuze ko kwamaganirwa kure kwe ntacyo bimubwiye kuko atari we washyingiye Umutare Gaby na Joyce, avuga ko bashyingiwe n’Imana yari muri bo umunsi bemeranywa kubana. Avuga ku mpamvu zatumye asezera mu itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda kandi yarahoze ari umwe mu bayobozi baryo, yagaragaje ko yasezeye ahanini bitewe n’ivangura rigaragara mu buyobozi bw’iri torero, aho yagize ati : ”Kimwe mu bintu by’ingenzi cyatumye nsezera mu itorero ry’abadivantisiti, ni uko iri torero mu buyobozi bwaryo harangwamo cyane ivangura”. Pasiteri Rusine Josue kandi yagaragaje ko n’ubwo itorero ry’Abadivantisiti rigaragaza ko yakosheje agashyingira abageni basezeraniye mu busitani bwa hoteli, n’umuyobozi wabo yakoze nk’ibyo. Yagize ati: “Ubukwe bw’umukobwa wa Pasitoro Byiringiro; Umuyobozi w’Itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda bwashyingiriwe hehe? Ntabwo bwashyingiriwe mu rusengero, ahubwo bwashyingiriwe muri Jardin y’akabari ka Bambino i Kabuga., hari ubundi bukwe bw’abadivantisiti natashye bwabereye i Nyarutarama mu busitani bw’urusengero rw’abaporo”. Uyu mushumba uvuga ko yigenga, ashimangira ko nta na rimwe ashobora kubaza abagiye gushyingirwa ngo baratwite, ngo kuki arijye muje kureba, gusa avuga ko icyo abaza umusore n’inkumi baje bamugana ari icyemezo cyerekana ko bashyingiwe binyuze mu mategeko ya Leta. Kuba ubuyobozi bw’Itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda bwaramaganiye kure uyu mushumba, avuga ko nta kibazo bimuteye kuko we atakibarizwa mu mubare w’abapasitori b’iri torero ndetse ahamya ko adashobora na rimwe kwiyitirira iri torero. Ati :”Ku bwanjye icyo mvuga ku byamvuzweho, ni uko ntigeze na rimwe, sinzigera niyitirira itorero ry’abadivantisiti ngo ndi umupasitoro waryo kuko iyo nkenera kugumya kuba mu murongo barimo nari kugumamo, ni njye wabasezereye. Bafite uburenganzira bwo kwandika ibyo bashaka”. Abajijwe niba amaherezo atazashinga idini, Pasiteri Rusine Josue mu mvugo ye n’ubwo yahakanye yaciye amarenga y’uko amaherezo ariho bigana. Yagize ati: ”Ntabwo nzi uko ejo bizaba bimeze, ariko nzi uko uyu munsi bimeze, igitekerezo mfite ni uko, ntabwo Yesu yigeze ararikira abantu gushinga amadini, ahubwo Yesu n’inzira ye idusaba kubwira abantu inkuru nziza ya Kirisitu”. Pasiteri Rusine Josue avuga ko iteka ababazwa n’uburyo abasore n’inkumi bafite umugambi mwiza wo kubana kenshi usanga amadini abacamo ibice aho usanga niba badahuje amadini ubukwe bwabo bupfa, abanyamadini bari kubabwira ko batizera kimwe. Kuri we ngo amadini amaze kuba urusika. Yagize ati: ”Rimwe na rimwe idini rikavuga riti ntimwizera kimwe! Ibi bishatse kuvuga ko aho kwizera Kirisito abantu bari kumusimbuza idini, amahirwe ni uko mu Rwanda dufite Leta iba hafi irinda umutekano naho ubundi abantu bamarana kubera amadini atandukanye barimo”. Twibutse ko Pr. Rusine Josue yakunze kugarukwaho cyane mu Itangazamakuru nyuma yo gushyingira umuhanzikazi Butera Knwoless na Clement, yongeye gushyingira Umuhanzi Umutare Gaby n’umufasha we Nzere Joyce ari nabwo Ubuyobozi bw’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti b’umunsi wa Karindwi bwabyamaganiye kure buvuga ko yabashyingiye ku giti cye bidakwiye kwitirirwa Itorero. 
 Icyakoze ku rundi ruhande, Onesphore Yadusoneye uyobora icyiciro cy’Itumanaho mu Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti b’Umunsi wa karindwi mu Rwanda, ku bijyanye no kuba Pasiteri Byiringiro nawe umukobwa we yarashyingiriwe mu busitani bw’akabari, avuga ko atari byo kuko nta mukobwa w’uyu muyobozi mukuru w’Itorero washyingiriwe mu Rwanda.

Pasiteri Rusine ariko yatangaje ko iri torero rivangura abantu rikabariganya ndetse yaritunze urutoki ko ubuyobozi bwaryo bufite imikorere idahwitse. Yongeyeho ko bitangaje kuba yaramaganiwe kure kandi umukobwa wa Pasiteri Byiringiro Hesron; Umuyobozi w’Itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda yarashyingiriwe mu busitani bw’akabari.
 Mu nkuru nyinshi zakurikiye ubukwe bw’umuhanzi Umutare Gaby n’umukunzi we Nzere Joyce, Ubuyobozi bw’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti mu Rwanda bwamaganiye kure Pasiteri Rusine Josue washyingiye uyu muryango mushya, rivuga ko ritajya rishyingirira abantu mu busitani. Pasiteri Rusine ariko yatangaje ko iri torero rivangura abantu rikabariganya ndetse yaritunze urutoki ko ubuyobozi bwaryo bufite imikorere idahwitse. Yongeyeho ko bitangaje kuba yaramaganiwe kure kandi umukobwa wa Pasiteri Byiringiro Hesron; Umuyobozi w’Itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda yarashyingiriwe mu busitani bw’akabari. Ni mu kiganiro yahaye ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com, aho yavuze ko kwamaganirwa kure kwe ntacyo bimubwiye kuko atari we washyingiye Umutare Gaby na Joyce, avuga ko bashyingiwe n’Imana yari muri bo umunsi bemeranywa kubana. Avuga ku mpamvu zatumye asezera mu itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda kandi yarahoze ari umwe mu bayobozi baryo, yagaragaje ko yasezeye ahanini bitewe n’ivangura rigaragara mu buyobozi bw’iri torero, aho yagize ati : ”Kimwe mu bintu by’ingenzi cyatumye nsezera mu itorero ry’abadivantisiti, ni uko iri torero mu buyobozi bwaryo harangwamo cyane ivangura”. Pasiteri Rusine Josue kandi yagaragaje ko n’ubwo itorero ry’Abadivantisiti rigaragaza ko yakosheje agashyingira abageni basezeraniye mu busitani bwa hoteli, n’umuyobozi wabo yakoze nk’ibyo. Yagize ati: “Ubukwe bw’umukobwa wa Pasitoro Byiringiro; Umuyobozi w’Itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda bwashyingiriwe hehe? Ntabwo bwashyingiriwe mu rusengero, ahubwo bwashyingiriwe muri Jardin y’akabari ka Bambino i Kabuga., hari ubundi bukwe bw’abadivantisiti natashye bwabereye i Nyarutarama mu busitani bw’urusengero rw’abaporo”. Uyu mushumba uvuga ko yigenga, ashimangira ko nta na rimwe ashobora kubaza abagiye gushyingirwa ngo baratwite, ngo kuki arijye muje kureba, gusa avuga ko icyo abaza umusore n’inkumi baje bamugana ari icyemezo cyerekana ko bashyingiwe binyuze mu mategeko ya Leta. Kuba ubuyobozi bw’Itorero ry’abadivantisiti mu Rwanda bwaramaganiye kure uyu mushumba, avuga ko nta kibazo bimuteye kuko we atakibarizwa mu mubare w’abapasitori b’iri torero ndetse ahamya ko adashobora na rimwe kwiyitirira iri torero. Ati :”Ku bwanjye icyo mvuga ku byamvuzweho, ni uko ntigeze na rimwe, sinzigera niyitirira itorero ry’abadivantisiti ngo ndi umupasitoro waryo kuko iyo nkenera kugumya kuba mu murongo barimo nari kugumamo, ni njye wabasezereye. Bafite uburenganzira bwo kwandika ibyo bashaka”. Abajijwe niba amaherezo atazashinga idini, Pasiteri Rusine Josue mu mvugo ye n’ubwo yahakanye yaciye amarenga y’uko amaherezo ariho bigana. Yagize ati: ”Ntabwo nzi uko ejo bizaba bimeze, ariko nzi uko uyu munsi bimeze, igitekerezo mfite ni uko, ntabwo Yesu yigeze ararikira abantu gushinga amadini, ahubwo Yesu n’inzira ye idusaba kubwira abantu inkuru nziza ya Kirisitu”. Pasiteri Rusine Josue avuga ko iteka ababazwa n’uburyo abasore n’inkumi bafite umugambi mwiza wo kubana kenshi usanga amadini abacamo ibice aho usanga niba badahuje amadini ubukwe bwabo bupfa, abanyamadini bari kubabwira ko batizera kimwe. Kuri we ngo amadini amaze kuba urusika. Yagize ati: ”Rimwe na rimwe idini rikavuga riti ntimwizera kimwe! Ibi bishatse kuvuga ko aho kwizera Kirisito abantu bari kumusimbuza idini, amahirwe ni uko mu Rwanda dufite Leta iba hafi irinda umutekano naho ubundi abantu bamarana kubera amadini atandukanye barimo”. Twibutse ko Pr. Rusine Josue yakunze kugarukwaho cyane mu Itangazamakuru nyuma yo gushyingira umuhanzikazi Butera Knwoless na Clement, yongeye gushyingira Umuhanzi Umutare Gaby n’umufasha we Nzere Joyce ari nabwo Ubuyobozi bw’Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti b’umunsi wa Karindwi bwabyamaganiye kure buvuga ko yabashyingiye ku giti cye bidakwiye kwitirirwa Itorero. 
 Icyakoze ku rundi ruhande, Onesphore Yadusoneye uyobora icyiciro cy’Itumanaho mu Itorero ry’Abadivantisiti b’Umunsi wa karindwi mu Rwanda, ku bijyanye no kuba Pasiteri Byiringiro nawe umukobwa we yarashyingiriwe mu busitani bw’akabari, avuga ko atari byo kuko nta mukobwa w’uyu muyobozi mukuru w’Itorero washyingiriwe mu Rwanda.

label: religion
title: Impaka ku muririmbyi wo muri ADEPR wazize kwambara ipantalo, imikufi no kuboha imisatsi
content:
Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 15 Kamena 2017, ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zitandukanye zikoreshwa mu Rwanda, hakomeje gucicikana ibaruwa yanditswe n’ubuyobozi bwa Korali yo muri ADEPR buhagarika umwe mu baririmbyi azira kwambara ipantalo, kwambara imikufi no kuboha imisatsi, ibintu byateje impaka ndetse ntibinavugweho rumwe.
 Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 15 Kamena 2017, ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zitandukanye zikoreshwa mu Rwanda, hakomeje gucicikana ibaruwa yanditswe n’ubuyobozi bwa Korali yo muri ADEPR buhagarika umwe mu baririmbyi azira kwambara ipantalo, kwambara imikufi no kuboha imisatsi, ibintu byateje impaka ndetse ntibinavugweho rumwe. Iyi baruwa yanditswe tariki 13 Kamena 2017, yari yanditswe na Ruzibiza Athanase, Umuyobozi wa Korali yitwa Holy Nation yo mu Gatenga. Yari yayandikiye ubuyobozi bwa ADEPR, umudugudu wa Gatenga, abamenyesha ko umuririmbyi witwa Uwintwari Jeanne D’Arc yahagaritswe kubera imyitwarire ye. Iyo baruwa igira iti: "Ubuyobozi bwa Chorale Holy Nation bumaze kugenzura imyitwarire ya Uwintwari Jeanne D’Arc irimo kwambara amapantalo, amaherena, imikufi no kuboha imisatsi, bwafashe icyemezo cyo kumuhagarika muri Chorale ubu ntakiri umuririmbyi wa Chorale Holy Nation." Bamwe mu babonye iyi baruwa, bagiye bagaragaza ko umuyobozi wa Chorale yarenganyije umuririmbyi kuko basanga nta kibi yakoze, ndetse ibi byagiye biteza impaka cyane ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, aho abenshi bagaragazaga ko ibyakozwe birimo kurengera no gukabya. Nyamara Rev Pasteur Karangwa Alphonse, umushumba wa Paruwasi ya Gatenga mu itorero rya ADEPR, yabwiye ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com ko ibyakozwe ari ibisanzwe kuko imyizerere n’imico yo muri ADEPR, itemerera koko umukirisitu cyangwa umuririmbyi kuba yakwambara ipantalo, kwambara imikufi, kudefiriza imisatsi no gukora ibindi byose bijyanye no kwishyiraho ibirungo by’ubwiza. Avuga ko umuririmbyi ibyo bigaragayeho agawa akanagirwa inama, yakwisubiraho agasubizwa muri Korali ariko yananirana akirukanwamo ndetse akaba yakwirukanwa no mu itorero. Rev. Pastor Karangwa Alphonse; umushumba wa Paruwasi ya Gatenga

label: religion
title: Uwari Burugumesitiri wishe nyina wa Padiri Ubald ashobora gutangira kumufasha kwigisha
content:
Padiri Ubald Rugirangonga amaze kwamamara mu Rwanda no hanze kubera impano idasanzwe afite yo gusengera abarwayi bagakira ubumuga butandukanye n’indwara zikomeye ziba zarananiye abaganga b’inzobere. Uretse ibyo ariko, anazwiho kugira uruhare mu kwigisha abanyarwanda ubumwe n’ubwiyunge, ibintu akora yihereyeho kuko yabashije kubabarira abamwiciye umuryango muri Jenoside, uwishe nyina akaba aherutse no gufungurwa agasanga Padiri Ubald yararihiriye amashuri abana be, inyiturayo uyu muvugabutumwa amwifuzaho ikaba ari iy’uko yaza bagafatanya kwigisha umuryango nyarwanda.
 Padiri Ubald Rugirangonga amaze kwamamara mu Rwanda no hanze kubera impano idasanzwe afite yo gusengera abarwayi bagakira ubumuga butandukanye n’indwara zikomeye ziba zarananiye abaganga b’inzobere. Uretse ibyo ariko, anazwiho kugira uruhare mu kwigisha abanyarwanda ubumwe n’ubwiyunge, ibintu akora yihereyeho kuko yabashije kubabarira abamwiciye umuryango muri Jenoside, uwishe nyina akaba aherutse no gufungurwa agasanga Padiri Ubald yararihiriye amashuri abana be, inyiturayo uyu muvugabutumwa amwifuzaho ikaba ari iy’uko yaza bagafatanya kwigisha umuryango nyarwanda. Jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu Rwanda mu mwaka w’1994, yabaye Padiri Ubald ari umupadiri muri Paruwasi ya Nyamasheke, n’ubwo nyuma yaje kwimurirwa muri Paruwasi ya Mushaka, ndetse nyuma anahabera Padiri mukuru kuva mu 1999. Se yishwe mbere ya Jenoside yo mu 1994 azizwa ubwoko bwe, ndetse icyo gihe nibwo Padiri Ubald nawe yaje guhungira mu mahanga nyuma yo gutotezwa azira ubwoko, ariko akaza kugaruka mu Rwanda nyuma yo kumva ijwi ry’Imana rimusaba kuza kwigisha urukundo abanyarwanda. Mu 1994 nyirizina, Jenoside yavukije Padiri Ubald nyina n’abandi benshi bo mu muryango we, nyamara abamwiciye yaje kubababarira, ndetse arihira amashuri abana babiri; umuhungu n’umukobwa b’abamwiciye umuryango muri Jenoside. Mu kiganiro kirambuye Padiri Ubald yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com, yadutangarije ko gahunda y’ivugabutumwa rigamije kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubwiyunge nyabwo amaze igihe akora, hari abatayiyumvamo kuko bakiboshywe n’amateka. Yavuze ko hari abahutu bakiyumvamo Parmehutu, hakaba n’abatutsi bahahamutse kuburyo bahorana ubwoba budashira. Padiri Ubald ati: "Erega iki kibazo cyacu cy’aya mateka, harimo abantu bagitinya kuko iyo uvuze ngo Parmehutu yavangiye ivanjiri, abantu bose bahita bahahamuka., kandi nibyo, yavangiye ivanjiri kuri njyewe. Sinzi ubwoko bwawe sinkuzi ariko ukuri imbere yanjye kuba ari ukuri. Ube umuhutu, ube umututsi, ukuri ni ukuri. Uko njye mbibona, hari abahutu bibona muri Parmehutu benshi cyane kandi birababaje, hakaba n’abatutsi Parmehutu yahahamuye. Abatutsi bahahamuwe na Parmehutu nabo rero, batinya kugira icyo bavuga ku kibazo cy’amoko ngo tugitere hejuru kive mu nzira…" Padiri Ubald akomeza agira ati: "Abatutsi bahahamutse batinya Parmehutu, abahutu bamwe benshi bakayibonamo, ako ni akavuyo nshaka ko kava mu nzira hakaba abantu b’abakirisitu, kuko usanga abatutsi bamwe yahahamuye mu mutima, kandi koko birumvikana, niba yarakwiciye abantu, yarakubujije kwiga… hari ubwoba bupfuritse ugatinya kubivuga, kwinjira mu mateka bikakunanira, n’ubivuze agahahamuka. Abahutu benshi, baba abapadiri baba abaki, usanga bari kuyibonamo. Ugasanga rero biravangavanze neza neza, kandi hagomba kuboneka abantu bari free (babohotse) imbere y’Imana." Padiri Ubald yagaragaje ko hari abantu bagitsimbaraye ku by’amoko, hakaba abananiwe gusaba imbabazi babikuye ku mutima ndetse hakaba n’abananiwe kubabarira, nyamara we ibintu nk’ibyo ngo yumva yarabirenze akabasha kubabarira, kuburyo mu bo yababariye harimo uwamwiciye abo mu muryango we barimo n’uwishe nyina, nyuma yo kumubabarira akaba yaranarihiye amashuri abana be. Aha Padiri Ubald yagize ati: "Njye numva rero nk’umuntu w’umu Charismatique ibyo bintu narabirenze, nta muntu nshobora kwanga, umuntu wese mubonamo ishusho y’Imana, ni uko nabohotse... Njye aho nageze, buri wese ni ishusho y’Imana imbere yanjye, n’uwishe mama naramubabariye, ndihirira amashuri abana be, nawe aherutse no gufungurwa, yari Burugumesitiri, kuko yaburanye yemera icyaha baramufunguye, ubu ngiye kuzamukoresha dukorane. Niba waransabye imbabazi ubikuye ku mutima, nawe uraza umfashe twigishe... Umugore we yapfuye akiri muri gereza, abana be ndabarihira, afite umukobwa we wiga Medecine ni njyewe umurihira, mu minsi micye araba yabaye Dogiteri." Padiri Ubald avuga ko n’ubwo atarabonana n’uwamwiciye umuryango we, ngo ateganya kumushaka bakaganira akamusaba ko amufasha kwigisha. Yagize ati: "Afunguwe yaranterefonnye, ariko anterefona ngiye kujya i Yeruzaremu, navuyeyo ejobundi ubu sindatuza, nimara gutuza nicaye nibwo nzamuhamagara tukaganira, nkamubaza niba afunguwe, icyo agiye kumarira sosiyete. Ni uko njyewe numva ngombwa gukoresha abantu. Urafunguwe, wansabye imbabazi, ko naziguhaye, urabona impuhwe nakugiriye, none ugiye kumfasha iki muri sosiyete? Ni uko njyewe nkorana n’abantu. Aze atange ubuhamya bw’uko abona ibintu, atange ubuhamya bw’uko namufashirije abana, noneho atange ubuhamya bw’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge, nawe yigishe. Kuko urumva yari burugumesitiri, ni umunyepolitiki azi icyo yakwigisha." Padiri Ubald akomeza agira ati: "Yari Burugumesitiri wa Komine Karengera y’iwacu aho mvuka ariko njyewe sinari namuzi. Mubona bwa mbere avuga ko ansabye imbabazi sinari muzi, nibajije uwo ari we, ariko noneho kuko nigishaga gutanga imbabazi no gusaba imbabazi, narabibashije… Kubivuga birakomeye cyane, akibimbwira byarandenze ndarira numva ni nk’ikintu cy’inkota kinyuzemo ariko nongeye kugarura imbaraga z’impuhwe ndamubwira nti ndakubabariye, si ugupfa kuvuga ngo ndakubabariye rero hari benshi babivuga bitajyanye n’impuhwe. Iyo ubabariye ukagira impuhwe, ubwoba burashira. Kuki bakigira ubwoba? Umuntu wababariye akumva yarabohotse, ntaba agitinya umuhutu, aba yaragiye hejuru mu bindi bicu, amubonamo umwana w’Imana. Abo bose rero baba bagitinya iyamamazabutumwa, baba bagifite ubwoba burya baba batarababarira. Nashake abe musenyeri, barahari. Abo bakiri mu bya parmehutu, nibo batuma abantu badasaba imbabazi, kandi baba bahari mu nzego za Kiliziya. Iyo akiboshye nawe akibonamo amoko…" Padiri Ubald w’imyaka 62 y’amavuko, amaze imyaka 33 yose ari umupadiri. Yagiye asobanura ko iyo asenga yerekwa uburwayi abantu batandukanye baba bafite, bamwe bagahita batangira ubuhamya aho ko bakize, abandi bakamushaka nyuma bakamwibwirira ko bakijijwe n’isengesho rye. Indwara z’ibyorezo nka Kanseri, SIDA, Diyabete n’izindi zidakira cyangwa zikira bigoranye, hari benshi bagiye batanga ubuhamya ko bazikiriye mu masengesho ya Padiri Ubald.

Abahutu benshi, baba abapadiri baba abaki, usanga bari kuyibonamo. Ugasanga rero biravangavanze neza neza, kandi hagomba kuboneka abantu bari free (babohotse) imbere y’Imana." Padiri Ubald yagaragaje ko hari abantu bagitsimbaraye ku by’amoko, hakaba abananiwe gusaba imbabazi babikuye ku mutima ndetse hakaba n’abananiwe kubabarira, nyamara we ibintu nk’ibyo ngo yumva yarabirenze akabasha kubabarira, kuburyo mu bo yababariye harimo uwamwiciye abo mu muryango we barimo n’uwishe nyina, nyuma yo kumubabarira akaba yaranarihiye amashuri abana be. Aha Padiri Ubald yagize ati: "Njye numva rero nk’umuntu w’umu Charismatique ibyo bintu narabirenze, nta muntu nshobora kwanga, umuntu wese mubonamo ishusho y’Imana, ni uko nabohotse... Njye aho nageze, buri wese ni ishusho y’Imana imbere yanjye, n’uwishe mama naramubabariye, ndihirira amashuri abana be, nawe aherutse no gufungurwa, yari Burugumesitiri, kuko yaburanye yemera icyaha baramufunguye, ubu ngiye kuzamukoresha dukorane. Niba waransabye imbabazi ubikuye ku mutima, nawe uraza umfashe twigishe... Umugore we yapfuye akiri muri gereza, abana be ndabarihira, afite umukobwa we wiga Medecine ni njyewe umurihira, mu minsi micye araba yabaye Dogiteri." Padiri Ubald avuga ko n’ubwo atarabonana n’uwamwiciye umuryango we, ngo ateganya kumushaka bakaganira akamusaba ko amufasha kwigisha. Yagize ati: "Afunguwe yaranterefonnye, ariko anterefona ngiye kujya i Yeruzaremu, navuyeyo ejobundi ubu sindatuza, nimara gutuza nicaye nibwo nzamuhamagara tukaganira, nkamubaza niba afunguwe, icyo agiye kumarira sosiyete. Ni uko njyewe numva ngombwa gukoresha abantu. Urafunguwe, wansabye imbabazi, ko naziguhaye, urabona impuhwe nakugiriye, none ugiye kumfasha iki muri sosiyete? Ni uko njyewe nkorana n’abantu. Aze atange ubuhamya bw’uko abona ibintu, atange ubuhamya bw’uko namufashirije abana, noneho atange ubuhamya bw’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge, nawe yigishe. Kuko urumva yari burugumesitiri, ni umunyepolitiki azi icyo yakwigisha." Padiri Ubald akomeza agira ati: "Yari Burugumesitiri wa Komine Karengera y’iwacu aho mvuka ariko njyewe sinari namuzi. Mubona bwa mbere avuga ko ansabye imbabazi sinari muzi, nibajije uwo ari we, ariko noneho kuko nigishaga gutanga imbabazi no gusaba imbabazi, narabibashije… Kubivuga birakomeye cyane, akibimbwira byarandenze ndarira numva ni nk’ikintu cy’inkota kinyuzemo ariko nongeye kugarura imbaraga z’impuhwe ndamubwira nti ndakubabariye, si ugupfa kuvuga ngo ndakubabariye rero hari benshi babivuga bitajyanye n’impuhwe. Iyo ubabariye ukagira impuhwe, ubwoba burashira. Kuki bakigira ubwoba? Umuntu wababariye akumva yarabohotse, ntaba agitinya umuhutu, aba yaragiye hejuru mu bindi bicu, amubonamo umwana w’Imana. Abo bose rero baba bagitinya iyamamazabutumwa, baba bagifite ubwoba burya baba batarababarira. Nashake abe musenyeri, barahari. Abo bakiri mu bya parmehutu, nibo batuma abantu badasaba imbabazi, kandi baba bahari mu nzego za Kiliziya. Iyo akiboshye nawe akibonamo amoko…" Padiri Ubald w’imyaka 62 y’amavuko, amaze imyaka 33 yose ari umupadiri. Yagiye asobanura ko iyo asenga yerekwa uburwayi abantu batandukanye baba bafite, bamwe bagahita batangira ubuhamya aho ko bakize, abandi bakamushaka nyuma bakamwibwirira ko bakijijwe n’isengesho rye. Indwara z’ibyorezo nka Kanseri, SIDA, Diyabete n’izindi zidakira cyangwa zikira bigoranye, hari benshi bagiye batanga ubuhamya ko bazikiriye mu masengesho ya Padiri Ubald.

title: Abayobozi ba ADEPR bafunzwe batewe utwatsi, urukiko rutesha agaciro ubusabe bwabo
content:
Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 25 Gicurasi 2017, hasomwe urubanza ubushinjacyaha bw’u Rwanda buregamo abayobozi bakuru b’itorero rya ADEPR, aho bakurikiranyweho icyaha cyo kunyereza akayabo k’amafaranga y’u Rwanda akabakaba miliyari eshatu. Mu iburanisha ryabaye mu ntangiro z’icyumweru, bari basabye urukiko ko barekurwa by’agateganyo bakaburana badafunze ariko batewe utwatsi.
 Kuri uyu wa Kane tariki 25 Gicurasi 2017, hasomwe urubanza ubushinjacyaha bw’u Rwanda buregamo abayobozi bakuru b’itorero rya ADEPR, aho bakurikiranyweho icyaha cyo kunyereza akayabo k’amafaranga y’u Rwanda akabakaba miliyari eshatu. Mu iburanisha ryabaye mu ntangiro z’icyumweru, bari basabye urukiko ko barekurwa by’agateganyo bakaburana badafunze ariko batewe utwatsi. Imyanzuro y’urukiko yatangajwe kuri uyu wa Kane, igaragaza ko aba bayobozi batandatu ba ADEPR hari impamvu zikomeje zituma bakekwaho ibyaha bakurikiranyweho, kandi kurekurwa bikaba bishobora gusibanganya ibimenyetso, bityo bakatirwa gufungwa iminsi 30 y’agateganyo bakaburana bari muri gereza. Aba bayobozi bakuru ba ADEPR baherutse gutabwa muri yombi bakaba bakurikiranyweho kunyereza akayabo k’amafaranga, barimo Bishop Tom Rwagasana wari umuvugizi wungirije na Pasiteri Salton Niyitanga wakoraga mu biro bye nk’umunyamabanga, hakabamo Mutuyemariya Christine usanzwe ari umwe mu bagize Komite Nyobozi y’Itorero ADEPR aho yari ashinzwe ubukungu n’imari, hakabamo kandi Pasiteri Eng. Theophile Sindayigaya wari ushinzwe inyubako muri ADEPR, Gasana Valens ushinzwe icungamutungo muri ADEPR hamwe na Pasiteri Sebagabo Leonard wari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa ADEPR. Kuwa Mbere tariki 22 Gicurasi 2017, ubushinjacyaha bwa Gasabo bwasobanuye ko muri 2015 ubuyozi bw’itorero rya ADEPR bwatse muri Banki ya BRD inguzanyo bakemeranywa na banki ko bazarangiza kuyishyura muri 2025 kuko yagombaga kwishyurwa mu myaka 10, ariko aba bayobozi bagahita bashyira igitutu ku bayoboke bagakusanya akayabo k’amafaranga y’u Rwanda miliyari eshatu na miliyoni magana atanu na mirongocyenda n’ebyiri n’ibihumbi magana ane na mirongo itandatu na bitanu na magana atatu na makumyabiri n’ane (3.592.465.324 Frw), ariko aya yakusanyijwe akaba atarahise yishyurwa banki ahubwo ngo abayobozi bagiye bayanyereza mu byiciro bitandukanye bakoresheje amayeri. Nk’uko byasobanuwe n’Ubushinjacyaha, ngo hari abantu basinyirwaga amasheki y’amafaranga menshi n’abayobozi ba ADEPR bigaragara ko ari ayo bishyuwe na ADEPR cyane cyane ku bikoresho byubakishijwe Hotel Dove iri ku Gisozi, nyamara nyuma ngo abasinyiwe sheki bamaraga kubikuza ayo mafaranga bakayasubiza abayobozi bakayakoresha mu nyungu zabo bwite, mu gihe abayoboke bari barasabwe amafaranga bizezwa ko ari ayo guhita bishyura banki bari barafashemo umwenda. Muri rusange, Ubushinjacyaha bugaragaza ko amafaranga yaturutse mu misanzu y’abayoboke b’iri torero yanyerejwe n’abayobozi bakuru b’iri torero hagati y’umwaka wa 2015 n’uwa 2017, yose hamwe agera kuri 2.530.395.614 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda. Bishop Tom Rwagasana wari umuvugizi wungirije wa ADEPR, ahawe umwanya ngo yiregure yavuze ko nta mafaranga yigeze anyerezwa kandi ngo bagiye bakora amasuzuma atandukanye agaragaza ko nta yakoreshejwe nabi cyangwa ngo anyerezwe. Gusa yavuze ko ibijyanye n’amasheki yagiye ashyiraho umukono hagambiriye kunyereza amafaranga byo adakwiye kubibazwa kuko iby’imikoresherezwe y’amafaranga bitari mu nshingano ze. We na bagenzi be basabaga ko barekurwa bakaburana badafunzwe ariko batewe utwatsi. Bishop Tom Rwagasana wari umuvugizi wungirije wa ADEPR Mutuyemariya Christine yari ashinzwe ubukungu n’imari Pasiteri Salton Niyitanga wakoraga mu biro bya Tom nk’umunyamabanga we Gasana Valens wari ushinzwe icungamutungo muri ADEPR Pasiteri Sebagabo Leonard wari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa ADEPR.

label: religion
title: Bishop Rugagi yahaye umumotari amafaranga ngo yicare akurikirane amasengesho ye - Amafoto
content:
Bishop Rugagi Innocent, kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 14 Kamena 2017, yemeye guha umumotari amafaranga y’u Rwanda 30.000 kugirango akunde yicare atuze akurikirane amasengesho n’amateraniro ye mu itorero Abacunguwe rikorera hafi yo kwa Rubangura mu mujyi wa Kigali.
 Bishop Rugagi Innocent, kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 14 Kamena 2017, yemeye guha umumotari amafaranga y’u Rwanda 30.000 kugirango akunde yicare atuze akurikirane amasengesho n’amateraniro ye mu itorero Abacunguwe rikorera hafi yo kwa Rubangura mu mujyi wa Kigali. Ubwo Bishop Rugagi yari arimo kubwiriza mu rusengero ayobora ruzwi ku izina ry’Abacunguwe, kuri uyu wa Gatatu tariki 14 Kamena 2017, hari umumotari wageze ku rusengero akajya ahagarara hafi y’umuryango akumva ibyo Bishop Rugagi abwiriza hanyuma mu kandi kanya akongera agacunga hanze areba aho yaparitse moto ye ngo anarebe ko hari umugenzi wifuza ko yamutwara. Ubwo Bishop Rugagi yamubonaga, yahise amusanga ku muryango amubaza amakuru, batangira kuganira maze ahita amubaza amafaranga akorera ku munsi iyo yahiriwe, undi amusubiza ko iyo byagenze neza ashobora gukorera amafaranga y’u Rwanda 20.000 ku munsi cyangwa akarengaho gato akaba nka 23.000, ariko ko iyo abagenzi babuze atabura amafaranga 10.000 ku munsi. Nyuma yo kumva ibyo, Bishop Rugagi yahise amusaba ko yakwinjira mu rusengero agakurikirana amateraniro n’amasengesho ye atuje, hanyuma akaza kumuha amafaranga y’u Rwanda arenga ayo asanzwe akorera kuko yamwemerere 30.000. Bishop Rugagi ati: "Ngaho tambuka ujye kwicara wumve ijambo ry’Imana utuje nidusoza amateraniro ndaguha ibihumbi mirongo itatu (30.000) hanyuma uhite witahira."

title: Inteko rusange ya ADEPR yatangiye inzira yo gutora abayobozi bashya basimbura abafunzwe
content:
Mu masaha ya saa tatu za mugitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 30 Gicurasi 2017, nibwo Inteko rusange y’Itorero ADEPR yateraniye muri Dove Hotel y’iri torero iherereye ku Gisozi, ku murongo nyamukuru w’ibyigwa hakaba harimo gutora abayobozi b’iri torero basimbura abandi bamaze igihe bafunzwe bakurikiranyweho kunyereza amamiliyari y’abayoboke b’iri torero.
 Mu masaha ya saa tatu za mugitondo cyo kuri uyu wa Kabiri tariki 30 Gicurasi 2017, nibwo Inteko rusange y’Itorero ADEPR yateraniye muri Dove Hotel y’iri torero iherereye ku Gisozi, ku murongo nyamukuru w’ibyigwa hakaba harimo gutora abayobozi b’iri torero basimbura abandi bamaze igihe bafunzwe bakurikiranyweho kunyereza amamiliyari y’abayoboke b’iri torero. Amakuru y’uko abayobozi bashya ba ADEPR bagomba gutorwa kuri uyu wa Kabiri, ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com cyayahamirijwe n’umwe mu bagize Inteko rusange ya ADEPR, wadushimangiriye ko nyuma yo gutabwa muri yombi kw’abayobozi bari basanzwe bayoboye iri torero, hagomba gushakwa abandi bashya bakomeza izo nshingano. Pasiteri Ruzibiza Viateur ushinzwe itangazamakuru muri ADEPR, yemereye ikinyamakuru Ukwezi.com ko iyo nama y’Inteko rusange koko biteganyijwe ko ibera ku Gisozi kuri uyu wa Kabiri, ariko avuga ko ibiyivugirwamo atabizi kuko atari mu bayigize. Avuga ko ibishobora kuvugirwamo biza kumenyakana nyuma yayo. Abayobizi bakuru b’itorero rya ADEPR bagera kuri barindwi, nibo kugeza ubu bari mu maboko y’ubutabera nyuma yo gufungwa bakurikiranyweho kunyereza akayabo k’amafaranga y’u Rwanda arenga miliyari eshatu yari yatanzwe n’abakirisitu b’iri torero nk’imisanzu yo kwishyura inguzanyo iri torero ryafashe muri BRD. Abo bayobozi ni Bishop Jean Sibomana wari Umuvugizi Mukuru wa ADEPR, Bishop Tom Rwagasana wari umuvugizi wungirije na Pasiteri Salton Niyitanga wakoraga mu biro bye nk’umunyamabanga, hakabamo Mutuyemariya Christine usanzwe ari umwe mu bagize Komite Nyobozi y’Itorero ADEPR aho yari ashinzwe ubukungu n’imari, hakabamo kandi Pasiteri Eng. Theophile Sindayigaya wari ushinzwe inyubako muri ADEPR, Gasana Valens ushinzwe icungamutungo muri ADEPR hamwe na Pasiteri Sebagabo Leonard wari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa ADEPR. Bishop Jean Sibomana wari umuvugizi mukuru wa ADEPR Bishop Tom Rwagasana wari umuvugizi wungirije wa ADEPR Mutuyemariya Christine yari ashinzwe ubukungu n’imari Pasiteri Salton Niyitanga wakoraga mu biro bya Tom nk’umunyamabanga we Gasana Valens wari ushinzwe icungamutungo muri ADEPR Pasiteri Sebagabo Leonard wari Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa ADEPR.

title: Guhanganira icyubahiro, ubugambanyi, gucikamo ibice n’ubusambanyi byangije ADEPR
content: Itorero rya Pentekote ryo mu Rwanda rizwi nka ADEPR, riri mu matorero yo mu Rwanda yagiye arangwamo amatiku menshi mu myaka ishize, rikaba ryaragiye rivugwamo amacakubiri, guhanganira ubuyobozi, kugambanirana n’ibindi bibi byatumye kugeza ubu ritagifite isura ryahoranye. Gushaka ibyubahiro, kwivanga muri Politiki no gutakaza gakondo yaryo nabyo byavuzwe cyane kuri iri torero. Abantu bazi itorero rya ADEPR mu myaka nk’itandatu ishize, babona neza ko iri torero ryahindutse mu buryo butangaje ndetse isura, icyubahiro n’icyizere ryagirirwaga, byarahindutse mu buryo bugaragarira buri wese. Izina “Abarokore” rihabwa menshi mu matorero yo mu Rwanda, ryigeze kwiharirwa na ADEPR ndetse rikubahwa cyane, ariko hari ibyaranze iri torero ryatumye rigaragaramo amacakubiri, gushinjanya ubugambanyi, guhangana n’ibindi bitari byitezwe ku byitwa abakozi b’Imana, kuburyo hari n’abagisengera muri ADEPR bihamiriza ko itorero ryabo ryamaze kwangirika. Ariko se byaturutse he? Byazanywe n’iki? Bipfira he? Amaherezo ni ayahe? Ibi byose, nibyo tugiye kugarukaho muri iyi nkuru mu buryo busesenguye. Bijya gutangira byahereye ku kurwanira ubuyobozi bw’iri torero Mu mwaka wa 2012 ubwo itorero rya ADEPR ryayoborwaga na Pasiteri Usabwimana Samuel, hatangiye kujya havugwamo ibibazo by’amakimbirane ashingiye ku myemerere ndetse n’ubuyobozi, kuburyo bamwe mu bashumba bo muri ADEPR bagiye bafatirwa ibyemezo byo guhagarikwa ku nshingano zabo, ku bw’amakosa aremereye babaga bakoze. Icyagaragaye ni uko hari abifuzaga guhirika uyu mushumba ku buyobozi bwa ADEPR. Jean Sibomana uyobora ADEPR na Samuel Usabwimana yasimbuye Mu mwaka wa 2013, uyu Usabwimana Samuel yaje gusimburwa na Sibomana Jean akuwe ku buyobozi na Komite yahoze ayobora, ndetse uyu Sibomana Jean ku gihe cy’ubuyobozi bwe, nibwo uwo yari asimbuye yaje kubuzwa gusengera mu nsengero za ADEPR ahitamo kujya asengera mu rugo iwe, nk’uko nyir’ubwite Pasiteri Usabwimana Samuel yagiye abitangaza. Uyu mushumba ubu ufite imyaka isaga 70, yari akunzwe cyane n’abayoboke ba ADEPR ndetse biri no mu byabereye imbogamizi ikomeye abamusimbuye bananiwe kunyura aba bayoboke kuko babuze uwo bakundaga ku maherere. Ibi byatumye batangira kutabona neza itorero ryabo, ndetse bamwe batangira gucura umugambi wo kuzarivamo bakajya ahandi cyangwa bagashinga iryabo kandi koko byabayeho benshi bajya mu yandi matorero abandi bashinga ayabo, mu gihe kugeza ubu Usabwimana Samuel asigaye akorera ivugabutumwa ku mugabane w’u Burayi. Itorero ryacitsemo ibice, ADEPR ishyirwa mu majwi ko yaba itoteza abashaka kuyitwara abayoboke Amakimbirane n’amatiku yagiye yumvikana muri ADEPR ashingiye cyane ku bijyanye n’ubuyobozi, byatumye bamwe mu bayoboke bahitamo kwigira mu yandi matorero, ariko hari n’abahise bashinga ayabo. Itorero rizwi cyane ni iryitwa EPEMR, iri ryo byanageze kure kuko ryagiye ryimwa ibyangombwa, ariko rikemeza ko ADEPR aribo bababuza kwemerwa nk’itorero rikorera mu Rwanda. EPEMR na ADEPR byagiye bivugwa cyane mu bitangazamakuru guhera muri Mata 2014, ubwo iyi EPEMR yari igiye gutangira ku mugaragaro ariko aho ishatse gusengera hose igakomwa mu nkokora, bakavuga ko ADEPR aribo babatambamira. Ibi byarakomeje bigera n’aho kwihishira ko bahangana byananiranye. Ibya ADEPR na EPEMR byafashe indi ntera, bashwanira bikomeye mu kiriyo cy’umupasiteri Ku Cyumweru tariki 15 Kamena 2014, mu rugo rwa nyakwigendera Ngaboyimanzi Celestin wari umu pasiteri muri ADEPR habereye umuhango wo gukura ikiriyo cy’uyu mu pasiteri watabarutse tariki 10 Kamena 2014, gusa muri urwo rugo ruherereye mu murenge wa Bigogwe wo mu karere ka Nyabihu, haje kuba intambara ikomeye cyane y’abanyamadini nyamara igikorwa cyari giteganyijwe uwo munsi ntaho cyari gihuriye n’iby’amadini. Abenshi mu bari bahari hari higanjemo abayoboke ba ADEPR cyane ko uwo nyakwigendera nawe yari umu pasiteri muri iryo torero, ibi bikaba bishobora no kuba ari byo byabaye intandaro yo kuvanga iby’amadini no kuyagira umuryango wari waragize ibyago, dore ko amakuru dufitiye gihamya avuga ko abayoboke ba ADEPR bahise bitambika abari baje muri uwo muhango babarizwa mu itorero rya EPEMR, babahamiriza ko badatuma bitabira ikiriyo nk’abandi. Uyu niwe Gasarasi wahoze ari umuyobozi muri ADEPR akavamo ajya gushinga EPEMR Mu kiganiro Pasiteri Elie Sinzabakwira wo mu itorero rya EPEMR, yagiranye n’abanyamakuru icyo gihe, yatangaje ko yatunguwe cyane kuko we kimwe na bagenzi be bari kumwe ubwo bajyaga muri uwo muhango batari bagiye nk’itorero ahubwo bari bagiye nk’abavandimwe, cyane ko uyu Elie wari uri kumwe nabo yari asanzwe ari umuturanyi akaba n’inshuti ya Pasiteri Ngaboyimanzi wari wakuriwe ikiriyo, bityo muri uwo muhango bakaba bari banitwaje ibinyobwa mu rwego rwo kuyagira umuryango wagize ibyago nk’uko bisanzwe mu muco nyarwanda. Icyo gihe kandi umwe mu bayobozi ba ADEPR witwa Habinshuti Jean Bosco usanzwe atuye mu murenge wa Bigogwe ari naho byabereye, yahamije ko nabo nk’abayoboke ba ADEPR bumiwe kuko bababwiraga ngo ni amabwiriza yaturutse hejuru. Yagize ati: “Twagiye ku kiriyo kimwe n’abandi, ubwo rero haza kuza umu pasiteri w’i Kigali witwa Gasarasi wahoze muri ADEPR ariko akaba yaravuyemo agashinga irindi torero ryitwa EPEMR, ubwo rero yarahageze akumirwa n’abayobozi bari bahari ba ADEPR barashyamirana aragenda. Icyabiteye rero rwose natwe twabibajije abayobozi badukuriye batubwira ko ari muri ADEPR hejuru babahamagaye cyane ko banabivugaga twumva, ni uko abayobozi bari bahari ndetse n’uwo Gasarasi barabaza bati habaye iki ko twese duhuriye ku itabaro, bamubwira ko ari mu buyobozi hejuru bahamagaye ngo nagende umuteguro ni uwa ADEPR ntabwo ari umuteguro we, gusa nta mahane yateje we yahise asezera aragenda”. Mu rwego rwo kumenya icyo ubuyobozi bukuru bwa ADEPR bwaba bwarabwiye abayobozi b’amatorero yabwo yari muri ako karere ku bijyanye no gukumira EPEMR, umunyamakuru yagerageje kuvugana n’umuvugizi mukuru wa ADEPR Rev Pasiteri Sibomana Jean ariko nyuma yo kubazwa icyo kibazo atangaza ko ntacyo yavuga kuko arwaye, bigaragara ko byari ukubihunga. Mu magambo macye yagize ati: “Njye ndarwaye ntacyo nabatangariza”. Ku rundi ruhande ariko, Pasiteri Viateur Ruzibiza; ushinzwe itangazamakuru muri ADEPR, we yatangaje ko atumva ukuntu umuntu wavuye muri ADEPR yari kujya mu muhango wo gukura ikiriyo cy’umupasiteri wa ADEPR kandi ari mu rugo rwa ADEPR, ashimangira ko nta mwanya cyangwa ijambo yagombaga guhabwa uwo munsi kandi atari yateganyijwe ahubwo ko yagombaga gutegereza akazapanga indi gahunda ye ku giti cye ADEPR itagiyeyo. Gusa amakuru twabashije kumenya ni uko n’ubwo nyakwigendera yari pasiteri muri ADEPR, hari bamwe mu bana be batari abayoboke ba ADEPR bityo urugo rwose rukaba rutagizwe n’abayoboke ba ADEPR. Ikindi uretse EPEMR, abagize uyu muryango bahamije ko mu kiriyo hari abandi bantu bari mu yandi matorero atandukanye nyamara bo ntibigeze bakumirwa. Hari abandikiye Perezida Kagame batabariza ADEPR bahita babihanirwa Tariki 17/09/2013 nibwo ibaruwa yagejejwe mu biro by’ umukuru w’ igihugu yanditswe na bamwe mu bayobozi ba ADEPR, iyi ikaba yaratabarizaga iri torero rya ADEPR. Iyi baruwa yaranditswe isinywaho n’abapasiteri bagera ku icumi, ariko abanditse iyo baruwa bose uko ari 10 bagiye bahagarikwa umwe umwe n’ubuyobozi bw’itorero rya ADEPR bahabwa igihano cy’agateganyo kigera ku mezi atatu. Muri abo bahagaritswe  icyo gihe harimo Pasiteri Rukundo Octave, Mberabahizi Emmanuel na Ev. Mutangana Emmanuel bahagaritswe amezi atatu yarangira batarasaba imbabazi bagafatirwa ibindi bihano, ibyo byose intandaro ikaba yari ibaruwa bandikiye Umukuru w’Igihugu Paul Kagame bavuga ku bintu bitangenda neza mu buyobozi bw’iri torero. Abayobozi ba ADEPR bashinjwe ubugambanyi na Depite Bamporiki Mu gitaramo cya Korali Jehovah Jirey cyabereye muri Hoteli Serena ya Kigali ku mugoroba wo ku Cyumweru tariki 28 Ukuboza 2014, Depite Bamporiki Edouard wari mu banyacyubahiro bitabiriye icyo gitaramo, ubwo yahagurukaga yavuze byinshi kuri we anahamya ko Imana yari yaramubwiye iby’abantu bazamugambanira barimo Kizito Mihigo na bamwe mu bayobozi ba ADEPR. Yavuze ko hari abantu basenze maze umwe muri bo akaza kumuhanurira ko abantu barimo n’umuririmbyi Kizito Mihigo barimo gucura umugambi wo kumugambanira. Aha yagize ati: “Abantu barasenze, umukobwa umwe yuzura umwuka arahanura arambwira ati mbonye abantu bakoze uruziga bakugambanira ngo bakwice, kandi mu bantu barimo kukugambanira harimo na Kizito Mihigo… Nyamara ntibazi ko Imana yambwiye ko nzaba Depite ubwo nari mfite imyaka 17, yambwiye byinshi kuva mfite imyaka 11 hari n’ibyo yansezeranyije bitaraba, burya nujya kugambanira umuntu jya ubanza umenye amasezerano ye n’Imana. Kandi mbabwire niba hari umuntu nakunze kuruta n’uko nkunda umugore wanjye, uwo ni Kizito Mihigo, ndetse n’ubu mbangamiwe n’ubuzima Kizito Mihigo abayemo.” Depite Edouard Bamporiki wagambaniwe n’abayobozi ba ADEPR Bamporiki Edouard yakomeje asobanura ko hari abandi bantu b’abayobozi bo mu itorero asengeramo rya ADEPR bigeze kumugambanira bakavuga ko yagiye ahahoze hitwa i Cyangugu akita abakozi b’Imana “imbwa”, nyamara ngo icyo gihe yari yagiye kubwiriza ubutumwa bwiza, kandi abo bayobozi ba ADEPR bakaba batarigeze bamusaba imbabazi. Mu biyomoye kuri ADEPR, hari abagiye bigisha abantu ko bakwiye gusambana Mu itorero rya ADEPR mu mudugudu witwa Gashyekero wo muri Paruwasi ya Gikondo, muri Nyakanga 2014 habonetse itsinda ryo kuramya no guhimbaza (Worship Team) ryasohotse mu Itorero bitewe n’inyigisho z’ubuyobe ryari rimaze iminsi ririmo kugenda ryigisha muri ADEPR, abo bakaba baragendaga bakangurira abantu kwisambanira no gukora ibindi bishakiye. Ibi byemejwe na Pasiteri Ruzibiza Viateur ushinzwe itangazamakuru muri ADEPR, watangaje ko aya makuru yabagezeho ku itariki ya 5 Nyakanga 2014 avuga ko hari itsinda ry’abantu bigisha ibintu bigaragaza ubuyobe kandi bitemerwa muri ADEPR, gusa icyo gihe ngo bari bataramenya niba ari idini rishya rivutse cyangwa niba ari abantu ku giti cyabo. Ibintu bitatu baje bigisha, icya mbere ngo ni uko Yesu yarangije byose ku musaraba, akaba yarapfiriye abantu ku bw’ibyaha bakoze cyera n’ibyo bazakora mu gihe kizaza, bityo ngo buri wese akore ibyo ashaka, ushaka kwisambanira asambane nta kibazo, ushaka kunywa inzoga abikore ndetse n’ibindi byose by’irari ry’umubiri ngo nta kibazo biteye kuko Yesu byose yabirangirije ku musaraba. Ikindi cya kabiri bigishaga ngo ni uko muri Bibiliya handitse ko uwizera Imana atazigera apfa, ku bwabo ibyo bikaba bisobanuye ko abantu bapfa biba byatewe n’uko bari abanyabyaha batizeraga Imana, ibi nabyo Pasiteri Ruzibiza akaba yarashimangiye ko ari ikinyoma bo nka ADEPR batabyemera. Icya gatatu bigishaga ni uko nta mukirisitu ukwiye gutanga amaturo na kimwe mu icumi kuko Imana idakennye, ngo ahubwo wenda batanga ayo mafaranga mu gufasha abakene, impfubyi n’abapfakazi ndetse n’abandi batishoboye. Ibi nabyo muri ADEPR bakaba bahamya ko atari ukuri kuko gutanga amaturo ari itegeko ry’Imana kandi bizanira uyatanze umugisha. Umupasiteri wo muri ADEPR yafashwe asambana ahita ashaka kwiyahura ntiyapfa Mu mpera z’ukwezi kwa Gicurasi uyu mwaka, Safari Théogène wari umupasiteri mu itorero rya ADEPR mu karere ka Rulindo ko mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru, yafashwe asambana n’umugore utari uwe ahita agira ikimwaro ariyahura ariko ku bw’amahirwe ntiyapfa. Ibi byagarutsweho cyane ndetse binasiga icyasha Itorero rya ADEPR muri rusange, ubuyobozi bw’itorero nabwo bukaba butarazuyaje kuko bwahise bumwirukana ndetse nyuma y’iminsi micye agahita ashakirwa umusimbura. Abashumba bo muri ADEPR bizamuye mu ntera itari yarigeze ibaho, bivugisha menshi abayoboke  Mu myaka 75 ADEPR yari imaze ibayeho, nta mushumba wari warigeze azamurwa ngo agere ku kigero cyo kwitwa Musenyeri (Bishop), nyamara mu minsi ishize, Umuvugizi mukuru wa ADEPR, Jean Sibomana n’umuvugizi wungirije Tom Rwagasana, bombi byatangajwe ko babaye ba Musenyeri (Bishop). Kuko ibi byari bimenyerewe mu yandi matorero, abayoboke ba ADEPR kugeza n’ubu ntibabivugaho rumwe, dore ko hari abasanga ibi ari uburyo bwo gukomeza guhanganira ibyubahiro n’abandi bashumba bo mu yandi matorero. Ubu Tom Rwagasana na Jean Sibomana babaye ba Musenyeri (Bishop) Uretse n’ibi ariko, ubuyobozi bwa ADEPR bwagaragaje ko abayoboke bagomba kwitega n’izindi mpinduka mu itorero ryabo, binavugwa ko mu minsi itarambiranye aba bagizwe Bishop bazazamurwa ku rwego rw’ikirenga rwa Apotre (Intumwa z’Imana), ibintu byari bisanzwe mu yandi matorero arimo n’ayoborwa n’abiyomoye kuri ADEPR.

Mu rwego rwo kumenya icyo ubuyobozi bukuru bwa ADEPR bwaba bwarabwiye abayobozi b’amatorero yabwo yari muri ako karere ku bijyanye no gukumira EPEMR, umunyamakuru yagerageje kuvugana n’umuvugizi mukuru wa ADEPR Rev Pasiteri Sibomana Jean ariko nyuma yo kubazwa icyo kibazo atangaza ko ntacyo yavuga kuko arwaye, bigaragara ko byari ukubihunga. Mu magambo macye yagize ati: “Njye ndarwaye ntacyo nabatangariza”. Ku rundi ruhande ariko, Pasiteri Viateur Ruzibiza; ushinzwe itangazamakuru muri ADEPR, we yatangaje ko atumva ukuntu umuntu wavuye muri ADEPR yari kujya mu muhango wo gukura ikiriyo cy’umupasiteri wa ADEPR kandi ari mu rugo rwa ADEPR, ashimangira ko nta mwanya cyangwa ijambo yagombaga guhabwa uwo munsi kandi atari yateganyijwe ahubwo ko yagombaga gutegereza akazapanga indi gahunda ye ku giti cye ADEPR itagiyeyo. Gusa amakuru twabashije kumenya ni uko n’ubwo nyakwigendera yari pasiteri muri ADEPR, hari bamwe mu bana be batari abayoboke ba ADEPR bityo urugo rwose rukaba rutagizwe n’abayoboke ba ADEPR. Ikindi uretse EPEMR, abagize uyu muryango bahamije ko mu kiriyo hari abandi bantu bari mu yandi matorero atandukanye nyamara bo ntibigeze bakumirwa. Hari abandikiye Perezida Kagame batabariza ADEPR bahita babihanirwa Tariki 17/09/2013 nibwo ibaruwa yagejejwe mu biro by’ umukuru w’ igihugu yanditswe na bamwe mu bayobozi ba ADEPR, iyi ikaba yaratabarizaga iri torero rya ADEPR. Iyi baruwa yaranditswe isinywaho n’abapasiteri bagera ku icumi, ariko abanditse iyo baruwa bose uko ari 10 bagiye bahagarikwa umwe umwe n’ubuyobozi bw’itorero rya ADEPR bahabwa igihano cy’agateganyo kigera ku mezi atatu. Muri abo bahagaritswe  icyo gihe harimo Pasiteri Rukundo Octave, Mberabahizi Emmanuel na Ev. Mutangana Emmanuel bahagaritswe amezi atatu yarangira batarasaba imbabazi bagafatirwa ibindi bihano, ibyo byose intandaro ikaba yari ibaruwa bandikiye Umukuru w’Igihugu Paul Kagame bavuga ku bintu bitangenda neza mu buyobozi bw’iri torero. Abayobozi ba ADEPR bashinjwe ubugambanyi na Depite Bamporiki Mu gitaramo cya Korali Jehovah Jirey cyabereye muri Hoteli Serena ya Kigali ku mugoroba wo ku Cyumweru tariki 28 Ukuboza 2014, Depite Bamporiki Edouard wari mu banyacyubahiro bitabiriye icyo gitaramo, ubwo yahagurukaga yavuze byinshi kuri we anahamya ko Imana yari yaramubwiye iby’abantu bazamugambanira barimo Kizito Mihigo na bamwe mu bayobozi ba ADEPR. Yavuze ko hari abantu basenze maze umwe muri bo akaza kumuhanurira ko abantu barimo n’umuririmbyi Kizito Mihigo barimo gucura umugambi wo kumugambanira. Aha yagize ati: “Abantu barasenze, umukobwa umwe yuzura umwuka arahanura arambwira ati mbonye abantu bakoze uruziga bakugambanira ngo bakwice, kandi mu bantu barimo kukugambanira harimo na Kizito Mihigo… Nyamara ntibazi ko Imana yambwiye ko nzaba Depite ubwo nari mfite imyaka 17, yambwiye byinshi kuva mfite imyaka 11 hari n’ibyo yansezeranyije bitaraba, burya nujya kugambanira umuntu jya ubanza umenye amasezerano ye n’Imana. Kandi mbabwire niba hari umuntu nakunze kuruta n’uko nkunda umugore wanjye, uwo ni Kizito Mihigo, ndetse n’ubu mbangamiwe n’ubuzima Kizito Mihigo abayemo.” Depite Edouard Bamporiki wagambaniwe n’abayobozi ba ADEPR Bamporiki Edouard yakomeje asobanura ko hari abandi bantu b’abayobozi bo mu itorero asengeramo rya ADEPR bigeze kumugambanira bakavuga ko yagiye ahahoze hitwa i Cyangugu akita abakozi b’Imana “imbwa”, nyamara ngo icyo gihe yari yagiye kubwiriza ubutumwa bwiza, kandi abo bayobozi ba ADEPR bakaba batarigeze bamusaba imbabazi. Mu biyomoye kuri ADEPR, hari abagiye bigisha abantu ko bakwiye gusambana Mu itorero rya ADEPR mu mudugudu witwa Gashyekero wo muri Paruwasi ya Gikondo, muri Nyakanga 2014 habonetse itsinda ryo kuramya no guhimbaza (Worship Team) ryasohotse mu Itorero bitewe n’inyigisho z’ubuyobe ryari rimaze iminsi ririmo kugenda ryigisha muri ADEPR, abo bakaba baragendaga bakangurira abantu kwisambanira no gukora ibindi bishakiye. Ibi byemejwe na Pasiteri Ruzibiza Viateur ushinzwe itangazamakuru muri ADEPR, watangaje ko aya makuru yabagezeho ku itariki ya 5 Nyakanga 2014 avuga ko hari itsinda ry’abantu bigisha ibintu bigaragaza ubuyobe kandi bitemerwa muri ADEPR, gusa icyo gihe ngo bari bataramenya niba ari idini rishya rivutse cyangwa niba ari abantu ku giti cyabo. Ibintu bitatu baje bigisha, icya mbere ngo ni uko Yesu yarangije byose ku musaraba, akaba yarapfiriye abantu ku bw’ibyaha bakoze cyera n’ibyo bazakora mu gihe kizaza, bityo ngo buri wese akore ibyo ashaka, ushaka kwisambanira asambane nta kibazo, ushaka kunywa inzoga abikore ndetse n’ibindi byose by’irari ry’umubiri ngo nta kibazo biteye kuko Yesu byose yabirangirije ku musaraba. Ikindi cya kabiri bigishaga ngo ni uko muri Bibiliya handitse ko uwizera Imana atazigera apfa, ku bwabo ibyo bikaba bisobanuye ko abantu bapfa biba byatewe n’uko bari abanyabyaha batizeraga Imana, ibi nabyo Pasiteri Ruzibiza akaba yarashimangiye ko ari ikinyoma bo nka ADEPR batabyemera. Icya gatatu bigishaga ni uko nta mukirisitu ukwiye gutanga amaturo na kimwe mu icumi kuko Imana idakennye, ngo ahubwo wenda batanga ayo mafaranga mu gufasha abakene, impfubyi n’abapfakazi ndetse n’abandi batishoboye. Ibi nabyo muri ADEPR bakaba bahamya ko atari ukuri kuko gutanga amaturo ari itegeko ry’Imana kandi bizanira uyatanze umugisha. Umupasiteri wo muri ADEPR yafashwe asambana ahita ashaka kwiyahura ntiyapfa Mu mpera z’ukwezi kwa Gicurasi uyu mwaka, Safari Théogène wari umupasiteri mu itorero rya ADEPR mu karere ka Rulindo ko mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru, yafashwe asambana n’umugore utari uwe ahita agira ikimwaro ariyahura ariko ku bw’amahirwe ntiyapfa. Ibi byagarutsweho cyane ndetse binasiga icyasha Itorero rya ADEPR muri rusange, ubuyobozi bw’itorero nabwo bukaba butarazuyaje kuko bwahise bumwirukana ndetse nyuma y’iminsi micye agahita ashakirwa umusimbura. Abashumba bo muri ADEPR bizamuye mu ntera itari yarigeze ibaho, bivugisha menshi abayoboke  Mu myaka 75 ADEPR yari imaze ibayeho, nta mushumba wari warigeze azamurwa ngo agere ku kigero cyo kwitwa Musenyeri (Bishop), nyamara mu minsi ishize, Umuvugizi mukuru wa ADEPR, Jean Sibomana n’umuvugizi wungirije Tom Rwagasana, bombi byatangajwe ko babaye ba Musenyeri (Bishop). Kuko ibi byari bimenyerewe mu yandi matorero, abayoboke ba ADEPR kugeza n’ubu ntibabivugaho rumwe, dore ko hari abasanga ibi ari uburyo bwo gukomeza guhanganira ibyubahiro n’abandi bashumba bo mu yandi matorero. Ubu Tom Rwagasana na Jean Sibomana babaye ba Musenyeri (Bishop) Uretse n’ibi ariko, ubuyobozi bwa ADEPR bwagaragaje ko abayoboke bagomba kwitega n’izindi mpinduka mu itorero ryabo, binavugwa ko mu minsi itarambiranye aba bagizwe Bishop bazazamurwa ku rwego rw’ikirenga rwa Apotre (Intumwa z’Imana), ibintu byari bisanzwe mu yandi matorero arimo n’ayoborwa n’abiyomoye kuri ADEPR.
