title: CAF CC: Pyramids yanyagiye Zanaco i Lusaka, Horoya inganya na Enyimba muri Nigeria
content: Ni inshuro ya mbere ku banyamisiri b’ikipe ya Pyramids FC bari gukina amarushanwa y’amakipe yatwaye ibikombe iwayo k’umugabane w’Africa, ariko aba banyamisiri barakomeye cyane ugereranyije n’amakipe basanzwemo. Pyramids FC ni ikipe yaguzwe n’abaherwe bo muri Emirates ikaba iyobowe n’umugabo witwa Salem Al Shamsi, uva mu muryango ukize cyane w’Aba Shamsi. K’urundi ruhande ikipe y’umukire Antonio Souare wo muri Guinea yitwaye neza muri Nigeria ihanganyiriza n’ikipe ya Enyimba igitego 1-1 mu mukino ubanza wa ¼. Zanaco (Zambia) 0-3 Pyramids FC (Egypt) Ikipe ya Zanaco yagowe bikomeye n’ikipe ya Pyramids mu rugo kuri National Heroes Stadium iri mu murwa mukuru wa Zambia Lusaka. Myugariro Ali Gabr yafunguye amazamu ku munota wa 18 gusa w’umukino, mbere y’uko Mohamed Farouk atsinda igitego cya 2 nyuma y’iminota 6 bafunguye amazamu. Kapiteni w’iyi kipe witwa Abdullah Elsaid yatsinze igitego cya 3 kuri penaliti ku munota wa 68, Pyramids itera intambwe igaragara ibinjiza muri ½ ku nshuro yabo ya mbere, n’ubwo hakiri umukino wo kwishyura i Cairo kuri Stade yitiriwe u wa 30 Kamena kuri iki cyumweru. Enyimba FC (Nigeria) 1-1 Horoya AC (Guinea) Boniface Haba yavuye ku ntebe y’abasimbura atsindira Horoya igitego cy’ingenzi cyatumye amakipe asoza umukino anganya igitego 1-1 muri leta ya Aba kuri iki cyumweru mu gihugu cya Nigeria. Augustine Oladapo yari yafunguye amazamu ku ruhande rw’ikipe ya Enyimba FC itari ifite abafana benshi cyane nk’ibisinzwe, ntabwo yabashije kwihagararaho kuko baje kuyishyura habura iminota 20 ngo umukino urangire. Umunya Burkina Faso Aristide Bance yari yabonye uburyo nka 2 bwo kuba yatsinda igitego mu gice cya mbere ariko ntabwo byigeze bimuhira kugeza ubwo bamusimbuzaga uyu mukinnyi Boniface Haba, waje kubonera iyi kipe y’i Conakry igitego cyo kwishyura. Umukino wo kwishyura uri kuri iki cyumweru i Conakry. El Nasr (Libya) 0-5 Hassania Agadir (Morocco) Ikipe yo muri Libya ya El Nasr yakirira imikino yayo muri Misiri yahuye n’uruva gusenya kuri iki cyumweru, inyagirwa ibitego 5-0 ku n’ikipe yo muri Maroc mu mujyi wa Agadir yitwa Hassania. El Barkaoui yatsinze ibitego 3 wenyine muri uyu mukino wabereye kuri Petro Sport Stadium mu murwa mukuru wa Misiri Cairo. Uyu musore akaba yakwije ibitego 7 muri iri rushanwa uyu mwaka. Cisse nawe ntabwo yabuze muri iyi festival y’ibitego kuko yaje kongeramo ibitego 2 mu minota ya nyuma y’umukino, bakaba basubiye mu gihugu cy’umwamu Mohamed wa 6 bizeye kubona itike ya ½ muri iri rushanwa. Al Masry (Egypt) 2-2 RS Berkane (Morocco) Ikipe ya RS Berkane yitwaye neza mu Misiri kuri Suez Stadium ihakura ibitego 2 byo hanze inganyije na Al Masry ibitego 2-2 mu mukino ubanza wa ¼ mu irushanwa ry’amakipe yatwaye ibikombe iwayo. Rutahizamu w’imyaka 34 y’amavuko Mouhssine Iajour yatsinze ibitego 2 k’uruhande rw’ikipe ye RS Berkane, ariko Muftah Hamad aza kwishyuramo igitego igice cya 2 gitangiye, mbere y’uko umuzamu wa Berkane Zouhair Laaroubi yitsinda igitego cya 2. title: Robertinho yasembuye abafana ba Rayon Sports kubera ubutumwa yashyize kuri Instagram
content: Umutoza Roberto Oliveira Goncalves do Carmo uzwi nka Robertinho yasembuye abafana ba Rayon Sports ubwo yashyiraga ku rubuga rwa Instagram ubutumwa bushimira Rayon Sports bituma benshi bakeka ko uyu mugabo yagarutse mu ikipe. Robertinho watandukanye na Rayon Sports muri Kanama umwaka ushize,yagiye ku rubuga rwe rwa Instagram afata amafoto menshi ari gutoza iyi kipe y’ubururu n’umweru arangije arashimira. Yagize ati “Mwarakoze Rayon Sports,abakinnyi bose,abafana bose n’u Rwanda.” Benshi mu bafana ba Rayon Sports bahise bamwandikira bamushimira ibyo yabakoreye abahesha igikombe cya shampiyona akabageza muri ¼ cya CAF Confederations Cup bwa mbere mu mateka. Robertinho yasabwe n’abafana kugaruka aho benshi basubiyemo ubutumwa bugira buti “Garuka mutoza,turagukunda.Abandi banditse bagira bati “Turagutegereje.” Robertinho utarabona akandi kazi nyuma yo kuva muri Rayon Sports,biravugwa ko ashobora kuyigarukamo cyane ko nta mutoza mukuru ifite kugeza ubu. Mu nama ubuyobozi bwa Rayon Sports buherutse gukora ku cyumweru,bwemeje ko bugomba kubona umutoza mushya bitarenze kuwa kuwa Gatanu taliki ya 28 Gashyantare uyu mwaka. Robertinho yatandukanye na Rayon Sports nyuma yo kwimwa amasezerano mashya azira kunanirwa gutsinda Al Hilal mu mukino ubanza w’ijonjora rya mbere rya CAF champions League umwaka ushize, bakanganya 1-1 I Kigali.

label: sport
title: FERWAFA yahannye Rayon Sports yihaninikiriye nyuma yo kwikura mu irushanwa ry’intwari
content:
Ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amaguru mu Rwanda, FERWAFA, ryatangaje ko ryafatiye ibihano ikipe ya Rayon Sports byo kutazakina umukino n’umwe wa gicuti muri uyu mwaka wa 2020, mu gihe banakuwe mu irushanwa ry’intwari rya 2021 n’ubwo barangiza mu makipe ane ya mbere uyu mwaka. Nkuko amakuru dukura muri iri shyirahamwe abitangaza, Ferwafa ikaba yafashe uyu mwanzuro mu nama yaraye ihuje komite nyobozi y’iri shyirahamwe aho ku murongo w’ibyigwa harimo kureba icyo bakora nyuma y’ibyakozwe n’iyi kipe batazira GIKUNDIRO. Mu ibaruwa Ferwafa yandikiye Rayon Sports iri shyirahamwe rishingiye ku ngingo ya 12 itegeka amakipe yose kwitabira amarushanwa yateguwe na Ferwafa ikaba yahanishije Rayon Sports kutitabira igikombe cy’Ubutwari cya 2021, kwishyura amafaranga y’u Rwanda ibihumbi 300 ndetse no kudakina umukino wa gicuti haba imbere mu gihugu ndetse no hanze yacyo mu gihe cy’amezi 12.




FERWAFA ikaba ifashe ibi bihano nyuma yaho Rayon Sports yikuye mu irushanwa ry’intwari ku mpamvu z’uko yashakaga gukinisha abakinnyi badafite Licence mu gihe amategeko y’irushanwa yabibuzaga. Ibi bikaba byarakuruye impaka ndende aho ubuyobozi bw’iyi kipe bwatangaje ko ari uburenganzira bwayo kuba bakwikura mu marushanwa badashaka ndetse bidatinze bahita basohora ibizasabwa kugira ngo bazajye bemera gukina mu yandi marushanwa batumiwemo harimo no kuba ibihembo bigomba kuba biri ku rwego rushimishije ndetse no kuba bafite umuntu ubahagarariye mu bashyiraho amategeko y’irushanwa. Bamwe mu bagarutse kuri iki gikorwa barimo Umunyamabanga wa Leta muri Minisiteri y’Ububanyi n’Amahanga, Amb. Nduhungirehe Olivier, abinyujije ku rubuga rwa Twitter yavuze ko uburyo Rayon Sports yanze kwitabira iri rushanwa atari byo kwihanganira. Ati”…kwikura mu irushanwa kwa Rayon Sports kandi rigamije guha agaciro intwari zacu sibyo kwihanganira ndetse FERWAFA ntiyakabyemeye.” Umuyobozi wungirije wa APR FC Maj Gen Mubarak Muganga na we yari yavuze ko bidakwiye ko Rayon Sports yikura mu irushanwa ry’intwari ko abantu bagakwiye kureba inyungu za kure atari iza hafi cyane ko iri rushanwa ryari rifite kinini rivuze ku gihugu cy’u Rwanda. Ikipe ya APR FC ni yo yegukanye irushanwa ry’intwari n’amanota arindwi, ije imbere ya Police FC yarushije inota rimwe, Kiyovu Sports ikaza ku mwanya wa gatatu mu gihe Mukura VS yaherutse izindi.

label: sport
title: Impamvu itangaje Liverpool yananiwe gusinyisha Cristiano Ronaldo mbere ya Manchester United yamenyekanye
content:
Ikipe ya Liverpool niyo yagize amahirwe yo gusinyisha Cristiano Ronaldo mbere ya Manchester United muri 2003 aho yagombaga kumugura miliyoni 4 gusa ngo yagowe n’umushahara wa miliyoni imwe y’amapawundi ku mwaka yasabaga kuko ngo yari gutuma abandi bakinnyi bivumbura. Uwari umutoza wa Liverpool n’umwungiriza we aribo Gerard Houllier na Phil Thompson bakurikiranye igihe kinini Ronaldo muri Sporting CP ariko ngo baje kubona ko kumuzana muri Liverpool byari kwica urwambariro kuko ngo miliyoni 1 y’amapawundi yari kuzajya ahembwa ku mwaka yari menshi cyane. Thompson yagize ati “ Nabwiwe ko amafaranga yo kumugura ari miliyoni 4 z’amapawundi ariko nabwiwe ko yari kuzishyurwa mu myaka 4 buri mwaka miliyoni 1.Nabajije umushahara yagombaga guhembwa bambwira ko ari miliyoni 1 ku mwaka nta misoro irimo.Yari menshi ku mwana w’imyaka 18 ariko barambwiye ko twaganira.” Umutoza Houllier yavuze ko kugura Ronaldo byari guteza umwuka mubi mu ikipe kuko ngo yari kuzajya ahembwa amafaranga menshi bagenzi be ntibabyishimire.
Nyuma y’icyumweru kimwe Manchester United yaguze Cristiano Ronaldo muri Sporting kuri miliyoni 12.2 z’amapawundi. Uyu Thompson yagize ati “Nyuma y’icyumweru kimwe nabonye kuri Sky Sports ngo United yaguze Ronaldo miliyoni 12.Sinizeraga amaso yanjye.Naribajije nti “ni gute amafaranga avuye kuri miliyoni 4 akajya kuri miliyoni 12.Yari umukinnyi mwiza nta muntu wari kwibaza ku mafaranga yaguzwe.” Ronaldo yageze muri United akora amateka akomeye aho yayitsindiye ibitego 118 mu mikino 292.Yatwaye PL 3,FA Cup na Champions League.

title: APR FC y’abakinnyi 10 yananiwe gutsinda Etincelles FC bifasha Rayon Sports kuyisatira
content: Igitego cya Etincelles FC ku munota wa nyuma cyatumye abafana n’abakinnyi ba APR FC bagaruka I Kigali batishimye kuko iyi kipe y’I Rubavu yabahagamye kandi yari yabonye ikarita itukura ku munota wa 23 w’umukino.Rayon Sports yo yanyagiye Espoir FC ibitego 3-0 ibona amahirwe yo kungabanya ikinyuranyo kuri uyu mukeba. Yari imikino y’ umunsi wa 18 wa shampiyona aho ibi bigugu byakiniwe umunsi gusa APR FC itaratsindwa umukino n’umwe muri shampiyona ntiyabasha kubonera amanota 3 kuri stade Umuganda. APR FC yari imaze iminsi 2 I Rubavu,yaje kubona igitego ku munota wa 20 gitsinzwe na Nshuti Innocent bituma imara umwanya munini iyoboye umukino. Nyuma y’iminota 3 igitego cya APR FC cyinjiye,Myugariro wa Etincelles, Akayezu Jean Bosco ukina inyuma iburyo, yakoreye ikosa Nshuti Innocent,umusifuzi amuha ikarita itukura. Iyi karita itukura yateye uburakari abakunzi ba Etincelles bashinje umusifuzi kubiba kuko ngo abakinnyi bombi bahuriye ku mupira agahitamo guhana Akayezu. Nkuko benshi bari babyiteze, ba rutahizamu ba Etincelles FC batyaye barimo Mutebi Rachid na Kambale Salita Gentil bahaye akazi APR FC muri uyu mukino ariko ntibabasha kubyaza umusaruro uburyo babonye. Aba barutahizamu bahererekanyije umupira neza birangira ugeze kuri Niyibizi Ramadhan wishyuriye Etincelles igitego ku munota wa 90. Ku rundi ruhande,Rayon Sports ibura abakinnyi benshi muri iyi minsi,yatsindiye I Nyamirambo Espoir FC ibitego 3-0. Kuri uyu wa Gatandatu,umutoza Alain Kirasa yakoze impinduka ahoMirafa na Saidi bari basanzwe babanza mu kibuga babanje hanze mu gihe umwana w’imyaka 17 Axel yagiriwe icyizere cyo kubanza mu kibuga mu mwanya wa Radu.Habimana Hussein na we yagarutse mu kibuga nyuma y’igihe kirekire yicazwa ku ntebe. title: Amavubi ari gushakisha umutoza usimbura Mashami Vincent
content: Umutoza Mashami Vincent watsinzwe ikizamini kimwe muri 3 yari yahawe kugira ngo ahabwe akazi gahoraho ko gutoza Amavubi yamaze gusezererwa aho kuri ubu Minisiteri ya Siporo iri gushakisha umusimbura we. Muri Kanama 2019, nibwo Mashami Vincent yari yahawe inshingano zo gutoza ikipe y’igihugu nk’umutoza w’agateganyo mu gihe cy’amezi atatu gusa yahawe ibizamini 3 birimo kugeza amavubi muri CHAN 2020,gusezerera Seychelles mu gushaka itike yo kwerekeza mu majonjora yo gushaka itike y’igikombe cy’isi 2022 muri Qatar. Icya 3 cyamunaniwe kwari ugushaka amanota 4 mu mikino 2 ibanza yo mu itsinda F ryo gushaka itike y’igikombe cya Afurika kizabera muri Cameroon muri 2021 aho yatsinzwe iyo mikino na Mozambike ndetse na Cameroon. Umwe mu bakora muri MINISPOR yabwiye ikinyamakuru FunClub dukesha iyi nkuru ko umutoza Mashami yamaze kubwirwa ko atazakomezanya n’Amavubi, ndetse ko hatangiye gushakishwa umusimbura. Ati: “Ni byo rwose byararangiye Mashami ntabwo akiri umutoza w’Amavubu. Kuri ubu hari gushakishwa umutoza wo kumusimbura ndetse Ferwafa yarangije kubitangarizwa. Hari n’igitekerezo ko bazana umutoza udahoraho akajya atoza Amavubi ari uko hari imikino”. Mu minsi ishize nibwo byavuzwe ko umutoza mushya w’Amavubi agomba kumenyekana vuba kugira ngo ategure ikipe izakina CHAN 2020 igomba kubera muri Cameroon muri Mata uyu mwaka.

title: Bosebabireba arifuza igihembo kuko indirimbo ze zigera kure
content: Theo Bosebabireba ushinjwa kuba ajya kuririmba mu yandi matorero atari iryo asengeramo atatse uruhushya, avuga ko akwiye guhemberwa ko indirimbo ze zigera aho abandi bavugabutumwa batagera.  Mu minsi yashize by’umwihariko mu ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka Theo Bosebabireba wamenyekanye mu ndirimbo zihimbaza Imana hano mu Rwanda, yakunze gushinjwa n’itorero rya ADPR Shel asengeramo ibyaha birimo ubusambanyi, kujya kuririmbira ahandi hatari aho asengera atatse icyangombwa kimwemerera kuharirimbira. Nyuma y’igihe kinini Theo atari mu Rwanda ngo agire cyo abivugaho kugeza ubu yamaze kugira icyo atangaza avuga ko atemeranywa n’abamushinja ibyavuzwe haruguru. Kubyo kuririmbira ahandi ngo Bosebabireba ntabwo abifata nk’ikosa, naho ibyo gusambana ngo azabanza avugane n’itorero rye abone gutangaza uruhande rwe, ati ” Imana yaravuze ngo mugende muvuge ubutumwa bwiza kugeza mu mahanga ya kure. Bityo nanjye ndumva ko ngomba kuririmba mu matorero yose, kandi kuvuga ngo indirimbo zanjye zumvikana mu bubari no mu bapagani, ahubwo njyewe numva bo bagomba kumpemba ko ndirimba indirimbo zikumvikana, kandi zikagera ahandi hantu abavugabutumwa batagera.“ Ubusanzwe ngo iyo umukirisito wo muri ADPR agiye kuririmba cyangwa kuvuga ubutumwa mu bundi buryo, kandi mu rindi torero, agenda ahawe icyangombwa yerekana aho agiye kwamamaza ubutumwa, ariko kuri Theo we ngo ntacyo yakunze kujyana bitewe nuko ngo yabonaga iyo acyatse aho ajya n’ubundi batakimwaka. Source: RBA

title: Israel yerekeje i Burayi yirinda kuvuga ikimujyanye
content:
Ku munsi w’ejo tariki 27 Gashyantare nibwo umuhanzi Israel Mbonyicyambu uzwi mu ndirimbo zihimbaza Imana yerekeje mu gihugu cy’u Bufaransa, ariko yirinda gutangaza icyo agiye gukora yo.  Uyu muhanzi wakunze kumenyekana mu ndirimbo zikora ku mitima ya benshi kubera amagambo n’ubutumwa buyuzuyemo, ajya kugenda yirinze gutangaza ibyo agiye gukora muri iki gihugu, gusa yemera ko bidafite aho bihuriye n’ivugabutumwa, ariko ko ngo azamarayo ibyumweru bitatu byose. 
 Israel Mbonyi yerekeje i Burayi nyuma yo gutaha ku mugaragaro inzu bivugwa ifite agaciro ka miliyoni eshanu, yubakiye umuryango w’uwitwa Mucyo Eustache utishoboye uba mu mudugudu wa Buhoro, mu kagali ka Kibenga, Umurenge wa Ndera, mu Karere ka Gasabo.

title: Isabukuru ya Humble Jizzo ishobora kuba urufunguzo rwo gusezerana n’umukunzi we

title: Umwarimu wahahamuwe n’umwana w’imyaka 14 nyuma yuko bagiranye imibonano mpuzabitsina
content:
Ikinyamakuru faistdivers gitangaza inkuru y’agasore gato k’imyaka 14 ko muri Texas muri leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika kihandagaje kagahahamura umwarimu wako wakigishaga imibare. Uyu mwarimu ngo yarasanzwe afitanye umubano wihariye n’aka gasore ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ndetse biza no kugera ubwo baje kuza gukorana imibonano mpuzabitsina inshuro iki kinyamamkuru kivuga ko zirenga eshatu. Kuva ubwo aka gasore kaje kujya kaka amafaranga uyu mwarimukazi kakamubwira ko natayagaha kazamurega bityo bakamufunga. Mwarimukazi nawe mu rwego rwo kwirengera yarakayahaga akayagahata kugeza ubwo yaje kugera mu madoklari y’amerika akabakaba ibihumbi 28.
Ubwo uyavunje mu manyarwanda asaga miliyoni 22 n’ibihumbi magana cyenda y’amanyarwanda. Nawe reba muri iki gihe umwana wawe w’imyaka 14 atunze mu nzu mubanamo uri umubyeyi we miliyoni zirenga 22 utazi aho yazikuye? Umubyeyi w’aka gasore yahamagaye polisi .Mu kuyihamagara bakagahata ibibazo aka gasore byaje kurangira kabahishuriye ukuri kose kuri inyuma y’aya mafaranga yarabitse. Kugeza ubu  mwarimukazi yamaze gufatwa n’ubushinjacyaha ategerejwe kubazwa neza iby’amabanga ye n’umunyeshuri we yishyuriraga umushahara wo kutamena amabanga ye

title: Beyonce aritegura kubyara impanga
content: Mu gihe mu minsi yashize umuryango wa Jay Z na Beyonce wagiye uvugwaho kenshi ko baba bafitanye ibibazo hagati yabo ndetse bishobora no kubatanya, kuri uyu wa wa kane batangaje ko bishimiye kuba bagiye kwakira abana babiri b’impanga ndetse ngo n’imyiteguro igeze kure. Abinyujije ku rubuga rwe rwa Instagram, Beyonce umwe mu bahanzikazi bakomeye ndetse banakundwa cyane yeruriye isi ko atwite inda izavukamo impanga ashimangira ko ari amahirwe akomeye ngo kuko umuryango wabo ugiye kwaguka ukaba mugari. Ibingibi Beyonce yabivuze mu magambo agira ati”Twishimiye gutangaza urukundo rwacu ndetse n’ibyishimo byacu, twagiriwe Ubuntu inshuro zikubye ebyiri kandi twishimiye ko umuryango wacu ugiye kurera abana babiri.” Yasoje ashimira abakunzi be ndetse n’abumuryango wabo.

title: Imwe mu mibavu abagabo bakwiye kwitera
content: Bumwe mu bwoko bw’imibavu abagabo bakwiye kwitera bitewe n’amahitamo yabo, niyo mpamvu uyu munsi twahisemo kubaganiriza ku mibavu ikwiye gukoreshwa. Tobacco Vanille: uyu mubavu uba mwiza ku bantu banywa itabi kuko ubasha kuganza wa mwuka w’itabi usigara kurinywa bityo bikaba bitatuma ubangamira aho murikumwe batarinywa. Singombwa ko uwitera buriko umaze kunywa itabi kuko inshuro imwe mu masaha 12 uba uhagije gukumira uwo mwuka itabi ugusigaraho. Spice Citrus, Truefitt&Hillclubman, Hermès Rocabar, Bleu De Chanel ndetse nizindi zitandukanye zo zakwifashishwa n’abantu bose ariko nabwo ugahitamo umubavu wumva ukunogeye. Burya sibyiza kwitera umubavu ngo uregere, aho ndavuga ba bantu bawitera usanga urahumura cyane kuko burya nabyo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bari hafi yawe cyangwa se abo mukorana cyane cyane kuri ba bantu barwara irwara z’imyanya y’ubuhumekero. Nibyiza ko wakitera umubavu uriganiye kuburyo utabangamira abandi. Imibavu yose ihuje amazina usanga ihumura kimwe ariko se wakibaza ngo niki wakora kugirango wowe uhumure bitandukanye n’abandi aribyo uzasanga umuntu avuga ngo “ndumva hano hahumura nka kanaka”, ntarindi banga rikomeye aba akoresha uretse kuvanga imibavu irenze umwe bigatuma wumva agira ukwe kwihariye ahumura. Aha nabaha nkurugero rwo kwitera deodorant hanyuma ukaza no kwitera perfume nyuma.

Burya sibyiza kwitera umubavu ngo uregere, aho ndavuga ba bantu bawitera usanga urahumura cyane kuko burya nabyo bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bari hafi yawe cyangwa se abo mukorana cyane cyane kuri ba bantu barwara irwara z’imyanya y’ubuhumekero. Nibyiza ko wakitera umubavu uriganiye kuburyo utabangamira abandi. Imibavu yose ihuje amazina usanga ihumura kimwe ariko se wakibaza ngo niki wakora kugirango wowe uhumure bitandukanye n’abandi aribyo uzasanga umuntu avuga ngo “ndumva hano hahumura nka kanaka”, ntarindi banga rikomeye aba akoresha uretse kuvanga imibavu irenze umwe bigatuma wumva agira ukwe kwihariye ahumura. Aha nabaha nkurugero rwo kwitera deodorant hanyuma ukaza no kwitera perfume nyuma.

label: entertainment
title: Mutesi Jolly mu ntambwe ijya imbere muri Nyampinga w’isi
content:
Mutesi Jolly uhagarariye u Rwanda mu irushanwa rya Miss World ribera muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika, yatowe mu bakobwa 24 b’ubwiza bufite intego ’Beauty With a Purpose’, bazavamo umwe ubona itike imugeza mu ijonjora ribanziriza irya nyuma. ‘Beauty with the Purpose’ nicyo kiciro gikomeye muri bimwe mu bigize iri rushanwa ryo gutoranya nyampinga uhiga abandi ku isi bikanahuzwa n’imyitwarire ye mu irushanwa akaba yashobora kubona amanota amutambutsa. 
Kuri Nyampinga Mutesi Jolly, amanota menshi yari ku bikorwa amaze gukora mu gihe cy’amezi 10 amaze ari nyampinga; birimo kuba yaratanze mituelle de santé ku bantu 1000, kuba afite abana akamishiriza amata buri kwezi bakuze nabi ‘Kugwingira’ n’ibindi.
Nubwo yashoboye kuza muri 24, Kagame Ishimwe Dieudonne umuyobozi wa Rwanda Inspiration Back Up ifite nyampinga mu nshingano zayo, ya bwiye itangazamakuru ko aho bigeze ariho hakomeye.Ati “ Ubu nibwo irushanwa risa nkaho ritangiye. Kuko iki kiciro nicyo abantu benshi baba bategereje kubona ko bakijyamo ubundi bagahatanira ikamba nyabyo!!Gusa Jolly azi intego yamujyanye”.
Umukobwa uzegukana iki kiciro agomba guhabwa amadolari 10.000$,akabakaba muri 8.230.000 y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda,bitewe n’imyitwarire no gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo irushanwa risaba, muri aba 24 bagomba kuzongera gutoranywamo 10 abandi 14 bagasezererwa nyuma yaho ariho haboneka batanu bazatoranywamo uzegukana iri kamba.
Tubibutse ko ibirori byo gutoranya Nyampinga w’isi biteganyijwe kubera muri Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika muri Washington D.C taliki 18 ukuboza 2016.

label: entertainment
title: Ese nigute twakambara imikufi yo kumaboko?
content:
Bracelets niya mikufi abantu bambara ku maboko. Iyi mikufi iri mu moko atandukanye.
Hari iba ikozwe mu masaro, ikozwe mu mabuye y’agaciro arimo zahabu, ifeza n’umuringa ndetse hari nizikorwa mu ndodo ni myenda ifite lastic.
Imikufi yo kumaboko nibimwe mu bifasha abantu kurimba ndetse nokugaragara neza ariko nanone bikajyana nuko wambara iyo mikufi ku maboko yawe. Hari abakunda kwambara imikufi myinshi ku kuboko kumwe ndetse abandi bagahita kwambara kamwe ariko hari nabayambara ku maboko yombi.Nibyiza rero ko wamenya uko wambara iyo mikufi bitewe n’uburyo wowe uyambara, uyambaro. Kubakunda kwambara imikufi myinsi ku kuboko kumwe biba byiza iyo umenye uko ugomba gukurikiranya iyo mikufi mu buryo bujyanye kuburyo bisa neza ndetse nukubona akobona ko bifite isuku. Kubakunda kwambara umukufi umwe ku kuboko ni byiza ko umenya ubwoko bw’imikufi iberanye nuko umubiri wawe usa ndetse nukuboko ukwiriye kwambaraho uwo mukufi wawe. Sibyiza kandi kwambara uwo mukufi ngo wogereho n’isaha. Biba byiza isaha uyambaye ku kundi kuboko. Akenshi hari abibaza ukuboko gukwiriye kwambarwaho imikufi, gusa icyo nababbwira nuko nta kuboko utakwamabaraho imikufi kuko burya biterwa n’ukuboko ukunda gukoresha cyane. Iyo ukunda gukoresha ukuboko kw’iburyo uwambara cg uyambara ku kuboko kwibumoso waba ukunda gukoresha ukuboko kw’ibumoso ukayambara kukuboko kw’iryo kuko burya birinda umukufi wawe kwagirika vuba cg kuba wagira ikibazo kindi ugutera. Ese koko imikufi inanutse(mito mu mubyibuho) yaba ikwiriye kwambarwa n’abakobwa gusa? Oya n’abagabo bayambara ariko burya bigenda nuko umugabo akunda kwambara niyo mpamvu uzasanga kenshi abagabo bambara imikufi minini kuko burya imikufi yo kumaboko igenda nuko umuntu yambara. Gusa icyo tutakwiragiza nuko hari imikufi ikwiriye kwambarwa mu birori bitandukanye ndetse niyo kwambara bisanzwe. Imikufi ifite amabara yirabura sibyiza kuyajyana mu birori by’ibubashye nka amakwe, gusangira kwa nimugoroba ndukunze kwita dinner.
Ahasigaye n’ahantu ho guhitamo ibibabereye kuko burya uwambaye neza agaragara neza.

label: politics
title: Abarimu bakoze ibizamini by’akazi bagiye kubisubiramo
content: Minisiteri y’Uburezi iramenyesha abayobozi b’uturere twose gusubirishamo ibizamini byakozwe n’abarimu tariki ya 10 Ukuboza 2019. Mu itangazo ryasinywe ejo tariki 28 Gashyantare na Minisitiri mushya Dr Uwamariya Valentine, rivuga ko impamvu ari uko ibyo bizamini bitakozwe kimwe mu turere dutandukanye: hari abarimu bakoze ikizamini kimwe abandi bagakora bibiri. Muri iri tangazo, Minisitiri avuga ko abarimu batsinze ikizamini kimwe ku manota 70% bazakora ikindi batakoze cyangwa batatsinze, naho abazatsinda bibiri bazahita bashyirwa mu myanya abandi bajye ku rutonde rw’abategereje. Itangazo rya Mineduc risaba abayobozi b’uturere gusubirishamo ibizamini by’abarimu Mu kiganiro Isesenguramakuru cya Radio Rwanda kuri uyu wa gatandatu tariki 29 Gashyantare, Minisitiri w’Uburezi yavuze ko ibi bizamnini bizakomeza gutegurwa na REB, buri karere kagategura umunsi bizabera; ku buryo mu ntangiriro za Werurwe biba biri gukorwa.

label: politics
title: Nzahaha: Igifungo cya burundu ku mugabo wasambanyije abana batanu
content:
Imiryango itanu y’abana basambanyijwe n’umugabo wo mu murenge wa
Nzahaha mu karere ka Rusizi yari imaze amezi 10 itegereje ubutabera yabuhawe.
Urukiko rwamuhamije icyaha, rumuhanisha gufungwa burundu. Ababyeyi b’aba bana
bari bategerezanyije igishyika isomwa ry’urubanza rumaze imyaka ruburaniwe mu
rukiko rw’akarere ka Rusizi. Ababyeyi, bamwe mu baturanyi, abayobozi, abarezi n’abana bigana
n’abasambanyijwe; bose bari bahanze amaso ikiva mu ijambo ry’umucamanza uyu
munsi ku wa gatatu tariki 19 Gashyantare I saa cyenda. Uyu mugabo Sibomana Joseph bakunda kwita Kaduma, ari mu kigero
cy’imyaka 50 arubatse, afite abana 11 bakomoka ku bagore batatu, ariko babiri
bamaze gupfa. Iby’aya mahano byaje kumenyekana muri Gicurasi 2019, mu mpera
z’uko kwezi nibwo yashyikirijwe Polisi ikorera ku murenge wa Gashonga. Aha naho yahamaze igihe kigera ku kwezi, ubwo kandi niko abo
babyeyi n’abana babo bahahoraga batanga ibimenyetso. Nta gukora, nta kwiga;
amatike abavana Nzahaha, hari n’aho  umugabo yazaga aherekeje umugore
n’umwana nk’uko twabyiboneye ubwo twageraga ku murenge wa Gashonga. Uyu mugabo Kaduma yaje kuvanwa kuri Polisi ajya gufungwa, nabwo
niko ababyeyi bahoraga bibutsa ubushinjacyaha babaza aho ibyabo bigeze. Rimwe
ngo raporo ya muganga ntiraboneka, ubundi ngo umwanya ni muke, ngaho gusubikwa,
ngaho bagahabwa ubutumwa batinze. Kuwa kabiri tariki ya 21 Mutarama, ku  gucamunsi nibwo urubanza rwabaye mu rukiko
rw’ibanze rwa Rusizi, maze babwirwa ko ruzasomwa uyu munsin tariki 19
Gashyantare 2020. Urukiko ntirwitaye ku ‘matakirangoyi’ y’uregwa Mu iburanisha, umushinjacyaha yari yagaragaje ibyaha Kaduma ashinjwa, ashingiye ku makuru abana ubwabo bivugiye ndetse n’ibyavuye kwa muganga I Mibirizi, amusabira igifungo cya burundu. Urukiko narwo rwabihaye agaciro, ruvuga ko ababyeyi n’abana bane
batahuriza hamwe imvugo ngo bamushinje.  Ku
birebana n’ibimenyetso bya muganga, bigaragara ko babiri muri abo bana Kaduma
yasambanyije yanabakomerekeje mu myanya y’ibanga. Amatakirangoyi y’uko bamwanga nayo, urukiko ruvuga ko Kaduma
atigeze azana umutangabuhamya ubyemeza. Abana batanu bose yabasambanyirije mu mudugudu wa Ryarusaro, mu
kagari ka Butambamo, ho mu murenge wa Nzahaha. Mu kubashuka ngo yababwiraga ko
bagiye “gukora umuti”, akabaha ibiceri, ibisheke, ndetse akanabereka
televiziyo.
Nyuma yo kumva ibisobanuro by’impande zombi, urukiko rwamenyesheje ababuranyi
ko urubanza ruzasomwa ari kuwa gatatu tariki ya 19 Gashyantare, ni mu cyumweru
gitaha. Mu bushakashati ku ihohoterwa rikorerwa abana b’abakobwa bwakozwe
n’ihiriro ry’amadini rikora ku by’ubuzima (Rwanda Interfaith Council for
Health) bugararagaza ko abarenga 50% mu bahohotera abana b’abakobwa batagezwa
imbere y’ubutabera. Karegeya Omar

n’abasambanyijwe; bose bari bahanze amaso ikiva mu ijambo ry’umucamanza uyu

cy’imyaka 50 arubatse, afite abana 11 bakomoka ku bagore batatu, ariko babiri
bamaze gupfa. Iby’aya mahano byaje kumenyekana muri Gicurasi 2019, mu mpera
z’uko kwezi nibwo yashyikirijwe Polisi ikorera ku murenge wa Gashonga. Aha naho yahamaze igihe kigera ku kwezi, ubwo kandi niko abo
babyeyi n’abana babo bahahoraga batanga ibimenyetso. Nta gukora, nta kwiga;
amatike abavana Nzahaha, hari n’aho  umugabo yazaga aherekeje umugore
n’umwana nk’uko twabyiboneye ubwo twageraga ku murenge wa Gashonga. Uyu mugabo Kaduma yaje kuvanwa kuri Polisi ajya gufungwa, nabwo
niko ababyeyi bahoraga bibutsa ubushinjacyaha babaza aho ibyabo bigeze. Rimwe
ngo raporo ya muganga ntiraboneka, ubundi ngo umwanya ni muke, ngaho gusubikwa,
ngaho bagahabwa ubutumwa batinze. Kuwa kabiri tariki ya 21 Mutarama, ku  gucamunsi nibwo urubanza rwabaye mu rukiko
rw’ibanze rwa Rusizi, maze babwirwa ko ruzasomwa uyu munsin tariki 19
Gashyantare 2020. Urukiko ntirwitaye ku ‘matakirangoyi’ y’uregwa Mu iburanisha, umushinjacyaha yari yagaragaje ibyaha Kaduma ashinjwa, ashingiye ku makuru abana ubwabo bivugiye ndetse n’ibyavuye kwa muganga I Mibirizi, amusabira igifungo cya burundu. Urukiko narwo rwabihaye agaciro, ruvuga ko ababyeyi n’abana bane
batahuriza hamwe imvugo ngo bamushinje.  Ku
birebana n’ibimenyetso bya muganga, bigaragara ko babiri muri abo bana Kaduma
yasambanyije yanabakomerekeje mu myanya y’ibanga. Amatakirangoyi y’uko bamwanga nayo, urukiko ruvuga ko Kaduma
atigeze azana umutangabuhamya ubyemeza. Abana batanu bose yabasambanyirije mu mudugudu wa Ryarusaro, mu
kagari ka Butambamo, ho mu murenge wa Nzahaha. Mu kubashuka ngo yababwiraga ko
bagiye “gukora umuti”, akabaha ibiceri, ibisheke, ndetse akanabereka
televiziyo.
Nyuma yo kumva ibisobanuro by’impande zombi, urukiko rwamenyesheje ababuranyi
ko urubanza ruzasomwa ari kuwa gatatu tariki ya 19 Gashyantare, ni mu cyumweru
gitaha. Mu bushakashati ku ihohoterwa rikorerwa abana b’abakobwa bwakozwe
n’ihiriro ry’amadini rikora ku by’ubuzima (Rwanda Interfaith Council for
Health) bugararagaza ko abarenga 50% mu bahohotera abana b’abakobwa batagezwa
imbere y’ubutabera. Karegeya Omar

title: Umuhanzikazi Tonzi ashishikajwe no gufasha abana babana n’ubumuga
content: Ubwo yari mugikorwa cyo gufasha abana babana n’ubumuga bo mukigo ‘Izere Mubyeyi’, umuhanzikazi Tonzi yatangaje ko umugambi we ari guharanira guha agaciro abana babana n’ubumuga kugirango umuryango nyarwanda ubakire neza. Tonzi nk’umuhanzikazi ururimba indirimbo zihimbaza Imana, yashyizeho ihuriro ryitwa ‘Birashoboka Dufatanije’ aho ari kumwe n’abandi bahanzi batandukanye, abanyamakuru ndetse n’abandi bantu banana n’ubumuga. Kuri uyu wa gatanu ubwo basuraga ikigo ‘Izere Mubyeyi’ cyo mu Busanza mu Karere ka Kicukiro, ahari abana baharererwa babana n’ubumuga iri tsinda rya Tonzi ryashimiye ubwitange abashinze iki kigo bagaragaza mukwita ku bana baharererwa. Umuhanzikazi Tonzi ati:”Umurimo aba babyeyi bakoze wo gushinga iri shuri uratangaje, umutima bagaragaje wo kwita kubana nk’aba bafite ikibazo cy’imiterere y’umubiri Imana izabibahembere.” Imvo n’imvano y’uyu muryango “Birashoboka Dufatanije” washinzwe na Tonzi na bagenzi be, ni umugambi wavuye ku buzima bwite Tonzi yanyuzemo aho yabyaye umwana agahita apfa azize indwara yavukanye y’umutima. Tonzi ati:”Gushinga iri huriro byaturutse ku gikomere njyewe ubwanjye nagize, mu 2012 napfushije umwana wanjye maze ngira iyerekwa ngira umutwaro cyane w’ababyeyi benshi bafite ikibazo nk’icyanjye babaho, mpita numva ngomba gushakisha uburyo mbakomeza. Mbaha ubutumwa bwo kubamenyeshaka ko Imana itabibagiwe kandi ko ubuzima bw’abana babo ibufitiye umugambi ukomeye, naho igitekerezo cyo gushing umuryango ‘Birashoboka Dufatanije’ cyaturutse”. Mu ijambo rye Mukashyaka Agnes umubyeyi uhagarariye ‘Izere Mubyeyi’ yashimiye ‘Birashoboka Dufatanije’ ubushake bagize bwo kuza kubasura ndetse aboneraho mo kubamenyesha ko ‘Izere Mubyeyi’ izahora izirikana igikorwa Tonzi na bagenzi be bakoze. Ati: ”Ubuzima bw’umwana ubana n’ubumuga nibwo bukwiye kwitabwaho cyane kuko hari benshi bagira ipfunwe n’uko umwana wabo abana n’ubumuga kandi nta ruhare na ruto yagize muguhitamo ubumuga, guha agaciro abana nk’aba n’uguha umuryango nyarwanda agaciro.” Mu rwego rw’ubukangurambaga Tonzi na bagenzi be bakoze indirimbo ‘c’est possible’, yerekana ko umuntu ubana n’ubumuga nawe ashoboye kwiteza imbere, agateza imbere umuryango n’igihugu cyose muri rusange. Ishuri ‘Izere Mubyeyi’ ryashinzwe muri 2004 rifasha abana barenga 150 ariko bitewe n’ubushobozi bw’ababyeyi babo, abana bake gusa nibo babona uburyo bwo kugera ku ishuri buri munsi, abasigaye baza rimwe na rimwe baje kugororwa ingingo. Umwihariko w’abarezi n’ababyeyi bafasha aba bana muri ‘Izere Mubyeyi’, nuko nta mushahara bakorera, imirimo yo gufasha aba bana n’imirimo y’ubukorerabushake.

title: DORE ABAGORE BAFITE IBYAGO BYINSHI BYO KURWARA IBIBYIMBA CYANGWA KANSERI ZO MU NZIRA Z’IMYOROROKERE
content:
DORE ABAGORE BAFITE IBYAGO BYINSHI BYO KURWARA IBIBYIMBA CYANGWA KANSERI ZO MU NZIRA Z’IMYOROROKERE. Kuruyu munsi Ibyo twerekezaho ni urwungano rw’imyororokere ariko ku Gitsina gore,aho turibanda ku ndwara z’ IBIBYIMBA bikunze kwibasira izo nzira,mbere ya byose ka tugire icyo tunibutsa Izo nzira zose zigomba kuba nzima kugirango uru rwungano ruzakore akazi karwo neza nkuko bigomba,Kandi igihe cyose hagize imbogamizi ziboneka muri izo nzira zose, bishobora kuba imbogamizi yo kugubwa nabi ku gitsina gore.
1. Ashobora kugira gahunda mbi mu mihango
2. Ashobora guhora akuramo inda
3. Kwiyadukizamo kw’ibibyimba
4. Guhora aguwe nabi aribwa mu nda . Kuko dushaka gutinda ku bibyimba rero, icyo kuzirikana ni uko ibibyimba bishobora gufata aho ariho hose muri izo nzira,ikibyimba gishobora kuba kanseri cyangwa kikaba atariyo.,akenshi kanseri iba irangwa nuburyane ndetse no kuva cyaneee ikaba yanakwirakwira mu bindi bice by’umubiri.,ariko ikibyimba kitari kanseri, kiba kiri hamwe, gikura gahoro ariko ntacyo si cyiza;Muzumva ngo kanseri y’imirerantanga, iyanyababyeyi, iyinkondo y’umura, n’izindi ibyo byose kandi ni nako biteye ubwoba abantu. Ibibyimba bitari kanseri bizwi cyane bikunze kwibasira nyababyeyi (uterus), muzindi ndimi byitwa fibroids, myomes Ibyo bishobora kubuza umudamu kubyara, guhora akuramo inda, n’izindi ngorane zitandukanye na kaanseri izwi cyane ni iyi nkondo y’umura; UBUSHAKASHATSI BUGARAGAZA KO NIBURA BURI MINOTA IBIRI HAPFA UUMUDAMU AZIZE KANSERI Y’UMURA (CERVICAL CANCER). Mu Rwanda kanseri y’amabere niyo yiganje hagakurikiraho iy’umuraMu Rwanda kanseri y’amabere niyo yiganje hagakurikiraho iy’umura Itavamo umwana akaba yavuka afite forme mbi cyangwa ubundi bumuga;tubibutseko uretse ababyara babazwe, abadamu benshi babagwa impamvu aba ari ibyo bibyimba. Tutanibagiwe ko bamwe bashobora gutakarizamo amahirwe yo kubona akana kuko iyo ari byinshi nyababyeyi ishobora guterurwamo.   DORE ABAFITE IBYAGO BYO KURWARA IBIBYIMBA CYANGWA KANSERI ZO MURI IZI NZIRA TURI KWIBANDAHO 1. Abakora imibonano bakiri bato. Munsi y’imyaka 20
2. Abahura n’abagabo benshi batandukanye (multiple partners)
3. Kurwara virusi yitwa human papiloma (human papilloma virus)
4. Kunywa itabi
5. Umubyibuho ukabije
6. Abarwayi ba diyabete
7. Kubyara kenshi (multiparity)
8. Kunywa inzoga
9. Abarwaye umuvuduko w’amaraso (hypertension)
10. NIbindi… NI RYARI UKWIRIYE GUKEKA CYANGWA KWISUZUMISHA Igihe cyose ufite ibi bimemyetso ntugatuze ahubwo uzashakishe impamvu:
1.guhora uva amaraso mu gitsina
2. Kuva amaraso nyuma yo gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina
3. Kuribwa mu kiziba cy’inda cyane
4. Kumva uremereye mu kiziba cy’inda kandi hagahoramo imisonga
5. Gutakaza ibiro cyane
6. Guhorana impagarara mu mihango. Ikabura cyangwa ikaba myinshi,
7. Kokerwa mu gitsina ukumva wahora ushimamo,
8. Gukunda kuvamo inda
9. Kubyimba amaguru
10. Kugira amazi ku mpyiko (hydronephrosis),
11. Impyiko zikora nabi N’ibindi byinshi… Tuzabigarukaho mu nkuru zacu zitaha.

title: Coronavirus: Umuntu wa mbere uyifite muri Tanzania yahageze avuye mu Bubiligi
content: Ummy Mwalimu minisitiri w’ubuzima muri Tanzania amaze gutangaza ko muri iki gihugu habonetse umuntu wa mbere ufite coronavirus. Yabwiye abanyamakuru ko uyu ari umuturage wa Tanzania, akaba ari umugore w’imyaka 46 wageze muri iki gihugu avuye mu Bubiligi n’indege ya Rwandair. Indege ya Rwandair isanzwe ikora ingendo muri Tanzania no mu Bubiligi. Tanzania ibaye igihugu cya gatatu muri aka karere kigezemo iyi virus nyuma ya Kenya n’u Rwanda. Minisitiri Mwalimu yatangaje ko uyu murwayi ari kuvurwa kandi ameze neza kugeza ubu. Madamu Ummy Mwalimu yavuze ko leta ya Tanzania yafashe ingamba zo kwitegura guhangana n’iyi ndwara mbere y’uko ihagera, Covid-19 muri Afurika yo munsi y’ubutayu bwa Sahara kugeza ubu:

label: politics
title: Barasaba guverinoma kugenza gahoro ibyo guca amakara muri Kigali
content: Abatuye ibice bitandukanye by’umujyi wa Kigali barasaba guverinoma y’u Rwanda gutwara gake ibyo guca burundu amakara mu mujyi wa Kigali kuko basanga hari benshi ubuzima bwahita bugora kuko abatuye Kigali batanganya ubushobozi. Ni nyuma y’uko Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije itangaje ko igiye guca burundu muri Kigali amakara, abatuye Kigali bagakoresha gaze mu rwego rwo kurengera ibidukikije. Abaturage bo muri Kigali baganiriye nitangazamakuru barimo umugore uhagarariye abandi muri umwe mu mirenge yo mu mujyi wa Kigali yavuze ko abagore ayoboye barimo kumusaba kubakorera ubuvugizi kugira ngo guverinoma ye guhagarika amakara kuko ariyo ajyanye n’ubushobozi bwabo. Yagize ati “Kudakoresha amakara ni ikibazo, twajyaga ducungana n’amakara, ubuse? wenda nihereyeho n’abaturage mpagarariye, abagore bari kumbwira ngo nibafunga amakara murabona tubazabaho gute namwe nk’itangazamakuru mutuvuganire rwose kuko muri ijwi rigera kure”. Umwe mu bagabo bakorera mu mujyi wa Kigali akazi ko gusana ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga yagize ati “Ariya makuru yo guhagarika amakara yangezeho kuko yanyuze mu binyamakuru dukurikirana. Ntabwo kudakoresha amakara twese bizatugiraho ingaruka ku rwego rumwe, amakara yari ahendutse hafi kuri buri muturage wese wo mu mujyi wa Kigali, wajyanaga ibiceri byawe, 200,250 cyangwa 500 bitewe n’uko wifite ukabasha kuyagura ukarya kumanywa na nijoro ariko gaze uhereye no ku icupa ryayo ryonyine birahenze bisaba amafaranga umuntu ashobora gupagasa ukwezi kose”. Akomeza agira ati “Niba umuntu yabashaga kurya atekesheje amakara ya 200, kugura icupa rya gaze ry’ibihumbi 35 bizamusaba kwigomwa iminsi itari munsi ya 40 ukibaza uti ese muri iyo minsi azaba abayeho ate?”. Uyu mutenisiye ati “Tuvuye muri corona, kandi corona yatwigishije kwizigamira, ubwo Leta yareka tukabanza tukizigamira ikanareba ko isomo ryinjiye ikabona guhagarika amakara kuko gukoresha gaze bisaba guterurira amafaranga menshi rimwe. Izo ngamba baramutse bahise bazishyira mu bikorwa aka kanya biragoye”. Umucuruzi ufite butike mu murenge wa Gitega, Akarere ka Nyarugenge twaganiriye yavuze ko guhagarika amakara mu mujyi wa Kigali byashoboka ariko ngo byasaba ko Leta iha abaturage igihe gihagije cyo kwitegura. Uyu mugabo ucuruza ibintu bitandukanye birimo n’amakara agira ati “Hariho sisiteme y’ibyiciro nawe urayizi, uwo mu kiciro cya kane n’uwo mu kiciro cya mbere ntabwo babayeho kimwe. Izo gaze nibyo kuzikoresha ni iterambere ariko ntabwo twese bitworoheye kimwe”. Akomeza agira ati “Hari banyakabyizi, niba nabonaga igihumbi ku munsi ngombwa kwiporogarama nkagikuramo amakara, ntabwo bizankundira ngo ngure gaze y’ibihumbi 35 ni ibintu bihenze kuri njyewe wo mu kiciro cya mbere”. Aba baturage icyo bahurizaho ni uko Leta itahutiraho ngo ihite ihagarika amakara burundu, ahubwo icyo basaba ni uko iterambere rya gaze ryaza gahorogahoro ubonye ubushobozi akayigura, kuko ngo abatayikoresha si uko bayobewe ibyiza byayo ahubwo ikibazo kiri mu kutabona ubushobozi bwo kuyigura. Ku wa Kane w’Iki cyumweru tariki 28 Gicurasi 2020, nibwo Minisitiri w’Ibidukikije Dr Mujawamariya Jeanne d’Arc yatangaje ko amakara agiye gukumirwa burundu mu mujyi wa Kigali. Dr Mujawamariya yavuze ko ikibazo abantu bafite abenshi ari uko batunga gaze ariko ntibayitekeho ibishyimbo ngo idashira, ariko ngo ibishyimbo umuntu ashobora kubiraza mu mazi azabitekamo bwacya akabiteka ngo icyo ngihe umuntu abiteka iminota 55 aho kuba amasaha ane. Minisitiri Mujawamariya avuga ko umushinga w’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ingufu, REG, wiswe ‘Pay As You Cook’ kiri gufatanya na REMA kureba uko wagera ku banyarwanda bose. Ni uburyo umuturage ahabwa gaz iriho mubazi akajya yishyura iyo ashoboye, yashira ikazima ikongera kwaka yongeye kwishyura. Leta y’u Rwanda ivuga ko impamvu amakara yo gucana agiye gukumirwa muri Kigali bigamije kugabanya ibyuka bihumanya ikirere.
text:
Barasaba guverinoma kugenza gahoro ibyo guca amakara muri Kigali
Abatuye ibice bitandukanye by’umujyi wa Kigali barasaba guverinoma y’u Rwanda gutwara gake ibyo guca burundu amakara mu mujyi wa Kigali kuko basanga hari benshi ubuzima bwahita bugora kuko abatuye Kigali batanganya ubushobozi. Ni nyuma y’uko Minisiteri y’Ibidukikije itangaje ko igiye guca burundu muri Kigali amakara, abatuye Kigali bagakoresha gaze mu rwego rwo kurengera ibidukikije. Abaturage bo muri Kigali baganiriye nitangazamakuru barimo umugore uhagarariye abandi muri umwe mu mirenge yo mu mujyi wa Kigali yavuze ko abagore ayoboye barimo kumusaba kubakorera ubuvugizi kugira ngo guverinoma ye guhagarika amakara kuko ariyo ajyanye n’ubushobozi bwabo. Yagize ati “Kudakoresha amakara ni ikibazo, twajyaga ducungana n’amakara, ubuse? wenda nihereyeho n’abaturage mpagarariye, abagore bari kumbwira ngo nibafunga amakara murabona tubazabaho gute namwe nk’itangazamakuru mutuvuganire rwose kuko muri ijwi rigera kure”. Umwe mu bagabo bakorera mu mujyi wa Kigali akazi ko gusana ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga yagize ati “Ariya makuru yo guhagarika amakara yangezeho kuko yanyuze mu binyamakuru dukurikirana. Ntabwo kudakoresha amakara twese bizatugiraho ingaruka ku rwego rumwe, amakara yari ahendutse hafi kuri buri muturage wese wo mu mujyi wa Kigali, wajyanaga ibiceri byawe, 200,250 cyangwa 500 bitewe n’uko wifite ukabasha kuyagura ukarya kumanywa na nijoro ariko gaze uhereye no ku icupa ryayo ryonyine birahenze bisaba amafaranga umuntu ashobora gupagasa ukwezi kose”. Akomeza agira ati “Niba umuntu yabashaga kurya atekesheje amakara ya 200, kugura icupa rya gaze ry’ibihumbi 35 bizamusaba kwigomwa iminsi itari munsi ya 40 ukibaza uti ese muri iyo minsi azaba abayeho ate?”. Uyu mutenisiye ati “Tuvuye muri corona, kandi corona yatwigishije kwizigamira, ubwo Leta yareka tukabanza tukizigamira ikanareba ko isomo ryinjiye ikabona guhagarika amakara kuko gukoresha gaze bisaba guterurira amafaranga menshi rimwe. Izo ngamba baramutse bahise bazishyira mu bikorwa aka kanya biragoye”. Umucuruzi ufite butike mu murenge wa Gitega, Akarere ka Nyarugenge twaganiriye yavuze ko guhagarika amakara mu mujyi wa Kigali byashoboka ariko ngo byasaba ko Leta iha abaturage igihe gihagije cyo kwitegura. label: politics
title: Laboratwari yo muri RDC yakoze umuti wa Coronavirus yise ‘Covigonum’
content: Laboratwari yitwa ‘A Dieu la Gloire’ yo mu mujyi wa Beni mu Burasirazuba bwa Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo (RDC), yatangaje ko yakoze umuti uvura Coronavirus yise ‘Covigonum’. Uwo muti w’amazi (sirop) wamaze kwemezwa na Kaminuza y’Abagatulika ya Graben iherereye mu mujyi wa Butembo mu Ntara ya Kivu yAmajyaruguru. Dr Germain Kitoko, ukuriye ubushakashatsi muri Laboratwari yawukoze, ku wa 15 Gicurasi yasabye Guverinoma ko bawugerageza kugira ngo bahashye Coronavirus. Ubwo yawumurikiraga Guverineri wa Kivu y’Amajyaruguru, Dr Kitoko, yavuze ko bawukoze mu bimera kandi bawitondeye bakaba biteguye guhura na Minisitiri w’Ubuzima bakareba uko watangira kugeragezwa. Ati “Twakoresheje ibimera bine bivura, kugira ngo dukore uyu muti kandi twawuteguye neza. Twahuye na Minisitiri w’ubuzima ku rwego rw’Intara na Guverineri. Intego yacu ni uguhura na Minisitiri w’Ubuzima ku rwego rw’igihugu kugira ngo harebwe uko wasuzumwa ku rwego rwa Laboratwari.” Dr. Kitoko yavuze ko ikibazo gihari ari uko Abanyafurika batiyizera ariko ko bashobora gukora ibyafasha ikiremwamuntu. Ati “Ikibazo gihari gusa ni uko twe Abanyafurika, tutiyizera. Mu buhanga bwacu nk’abanyafurika cyangwa abanye-Congo, dushobora kuzana umuti wafasha ikiremwamuntu.” Radiyo Okapi yatangaje ko ‘Covigonum’ utaba ariwo muti wa mbere iyo Laboratwari ikoze ko hari indi ivura indwara zitandukanye yakoze iri ku isoko aho muri Kivu y’Amajyaruguru. Kugeza ubu Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (OMS) rishimangira ko nta muti nta n’urukiko bya Coronavirus biraboneka. Icyakora ibyo ntibibuza ibihugu bya Afurika bimwe na bimwe kwitabaza umuti wakozwe na Madagascar. Muri Repubulika iharanira Demokarasi ya Congo hamaze kwandura abantu 1,370, abagera kuri 61 Coronavirus yarabahitanye naho 229 barayikize.

label: politics
title: 10 Gicurasi 1994: Leta y’abicanyi yigambye ubufasha bw’u Bufaransa
content:
U Bufaransa bwari bwiteguye gukomeza gushyigikira ingabo z’u Rwanda (FAR), bwirengagije ubwicanyi Abatutsi bakorerwaga na Leta ya Theodore Sindikubwabo, Guverinoma ye n’ingabo za Leta.
 U Bufaransa bwashyigikiye u Rwanda mu rwego rwa politiki mpuzamahanga Raporo yavugaga ibijyanye n’ubufasha bw’u Bufaransa bwahaga u Rwanda mu rwego rwa politiki mpuzamahanga; kuba hari abasirikare b’Abafaransa ku butaka bw’u Rwanda, nk’umutwe w’abatoza ba gisirikare baje « gukubita ingabo mu bitugu » abasirikare ba Leta y’u Rwanda ; uburyo hakoreshwa ingabo z’amahanga, zaba iza Leta cyangwa abacanshuro, byabaga bica amarenga yuko hanakoreshwa abasirikare b’abacanshuro baza kurwana intambara ariko bakabihemberwa amafaranga, ibyo bikaba byaravugwaga ariko ntabwo tubitindaho kubera amakuru adahagije tubifiteho. Huchon yagiraga inama u Rwanda gukora ibishobotse byose  kugirango rwerekane ishusho nziza mu maso y’amahanga kandi bakegeka kuri FPR ubwicanyi bwose bwakorerwaga mu Rwanda : « (…) General Huchon yanyumvishije ko abasirikare b’Abafaransa bafite inzitizi nyinshi zo kudufasha kubera ibivugwa n’ibinyamakuru bisa nkaho bibogamiye kuri FPR yashoboye kubyigarurira; ko niba nta gikozwe kugirango duhindure ishusho igihugu gifite mu mahanga, abayobozi ba politiki n’aba gisirikare b’u Rwanda nibo bazaryozwa ubwicanyi bwo mu Rwanda. Yabigarutseho kenshi ». RTLM yamamazaga ubufasha bw’Abafaransa igakomeza gushishikariza kwica Abatutsi Iyo nama General Huchon yahaye Ephrem Rwabalinda, uyu yarayizirikanye cyane kuko mu gusoza raporo ye y’ubutumwa yanditse ibikurikira : “Kwerekana isura nziza y’Igihugu mu mahanga ni igikorwa kigomba kuzirikanwa cyane. Ibikoresho by’itumanaho nzanye bizadufasha kugira imishyikirano n’ibihugu by’amahanga”. Yakomeje avuga ko u Bufaransa bwatangiye gushyira mu bikorwa ubufasha bwagombaga guha Leta y’inzibacyuho n’ingabo zayo : “Urwego rushamikiye kuri Perezida Mitterrand rushinzwe ubufatanye mu bya gisirikare rurimo rurategura ibikorwa byo kudutabara .” Rwabalinda amaze kugaruka mu Rwanda (yavuye mu Bufaransa tariki ya 13 Gicurasi), habaye impinduka mu binyamakuru byari bishamikiye ku bahezanguni bari bashyigikiye Jenoside, haboneka ubushake bwo kugabanya ishusho mbi yaterwaga na Jenoside. Ariko, muri uko kwezi kwa Gicurasi 1994, ntabwo higeze haba impinduka ku byakorwaga na Guverinoma y’abicanyi yari ishyigikiye Jenoside. Abatutsi bakomeje kwicwa. RTLM yakomeje gushishikariza kwica Abatutsi, ndetse bishyirwamo ingufu nyinshi mu byumweru byakurikiyeho : abicanyi bitwaje intwaro bari kuri za bariyeri bashishikarijwe gukomeza « akazi », imvugo yuko Abatutsi biyahura irakwirakwizwa, ko ndetse aribo ba nyirabayazana b’ubwicanyi bwose. Raporo ya Rwabalinda yerekana ko yandikiwe tariki ya 16 Gicurasi 1994 i Gitarama, mu gihe Guverinoma y’inzibacyuho yari yarahimukiye. Tariki ya 18 Gicurasi 1994, Habimana Kantano, umunyamakuru wa RTLM, yatangaje ko u Bufaransa bwongeye gufasha u Rwanda, ari nako atanga inama yo guhisha ibimenyetso by’ubwicanyi : « Hari inkuru nziza ku Banyarwanda. Amakuru atangiye kuba meza koko. U Bufaransa bwongeye kuduha ubufasha bukomeye kandi bunizeza kuzabwongera. Ariko kugira ngo ubwo bufasha bukomeze kutugeraho, burasaba ko nta ntumbi z’abantu zigomba kongera kuboneka ku mihanda, kandi ko nta muntu ugomba kongera kwica undi, hari abamurebera bisekera aho kumujyana mu butegetsi ». Biragaragara ko inkuru yerekanye n’ubufasha bw’Abafaransa mu bya gisirikare  yaba yaratanzwe na Rwabalinda, cyane ko hasabwe ku mugaragaro guhisha ubwicanyi bwerekanaga ko harimo hakorwa Jenoside, nkuko General Huchon yari yabigiriye inama Rwabalinda. Twakwibutsa ko muri iyi minsi umuryango JAMBO ASBL ukorera mu Bubirigi, ugizwe ahanini n’urubyiruko rukomoka ku babyeyi bakoze Jenoside, aho rukora ibikorwa byo guhakana Jenoside no gukwirakwiza ingengabitekerzo ya Jenoside, uwo muryango uyobowe uyu munsi na Robert Mugabowindekwe, umuhungu wa Lt Col Éphrem Rwabalinda. Leta y’abicanyi yakomeje kwakira ubufasha bwa gisirikare bw’U Bufaransa, ibishyigikiwemo n’abasirikare b’icyo gihugu, kandi byemejwe n’abayobozi b’Abafaransa, barangajwe imbere na Perezida Mitterrand. Dr Bizimana Jean Damascène, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’Igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside, CNLG Ubwanditsi

label: politics
title: Perezida Kagame yahishuye icyasubitse inama ya EAC yagombaga gufatira hamwe ingamba zo guhashya Coronavirus
content:
Perezida Kagame yavuze impamvu yatumye abakuru b’ibihugu by’Umuryango wa Afurika y’Iburasirazuba (EAC), batagiranye inama yiga ku ngamba zihuriweho zo kurwanya icyorezo cya Coronavirus mu karere, ashimangira ko ubufatanye mu gukemura iki kibazo rusange ari yo nzira nziza.

 
Perezida Kagame yavuze ko EAC ikeneye gushyira hamwe mu guhangana na Coronavirus
  Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru cyabaye kuri uyu wa Mbere, Perezida Kagame, yavuze ko kuva icyorezo cya Coronavirus cyagera mu karere ku rwego rwa EAC, hari inama zagiye zikorwa zirimo iy’abaminisitiri b’ubuzima n’abashinzwe ibikorwa by’umuryango kandi bemeranyije ingamba rusange zo kurwanya icyorezo. Iyi nama yafatiwemo ingamba zo kwirinda ikwirakwira rya Coronavirus no gushyiraho ingamba zo guhangana n’ingaruka yateza mu Karere. Ibihugu binyamuryango byasabwe korohereza amakamyo n’imodoka zitwaye ibicuruzwa, ndetse bigashyiraho uburyo bwo gusuzuma ababitwaye ku mipaka yabyo. Perezida Kagame yavuze ko izi ngamba zidahagije kuko hagikenewe izindi nama n’imbaraga zihuriweho ku kurwanya icyorezo mu karere, ari nayo mpamvu abakuru b’ibihugu bagerageje kugirana inama ngo batange umurongo ngenderwaho ariko ntibikunde. Ati “Ntiyabayeho kuko umubare w’ibihugu bitatu, bitewe n’inzira zikoreshwa muri EAC, aho ibihugu binyamuryango byose bigomba kuboneka muri iyo nama igiye kuba. Ibyo ntabwo byabaye kuko abahagarariye ibihugu bitatu batabashije kwihuza n’abandi twese dusigaye, muri iyo nama”. Perezida Kagame yakomeje avuga ko ubwo bushake bwo kongera gukora inama y’abakuru ba EAC, bwakomeje no ku nshuro ya kabiri kugira ngo inama ibe ku yindi tariki inyuze buri wese ariko nanone bikagaragara ko nta n’umwe witeguye kuyitabira. title: Uko Papa Yohani XXIII yahuje Kiliziya Gatulika n’andi madini benshi bakabanza kubirwanya
content:
Papa Yohani wa 23 amazina ye bwite ni Angelo Giuseppe Roncalli (1881-1963) yabaye umupapa wa 261 muri Kiliziya Gatulika, abuhabwa ku itariki 28 Ukwakira 1958. Nyuma y’amezi 3 atorewe kuyobora Kiliziya Gatulika, ku itariki 25 Mutarama 1959 muri bazilika ya mutagatifu Pawulo i Roma, yatunguye abantu benshi asaba ko haba inama ya 21 Vatikani ya 2 yagombaga gutangira ku itariki 11 Ukwakira 1962 ikarangira 1965. Muri ubwo busabe bwe ntiyahise amenyesha impamvu zayo. Ni inama ikomeye itumirwamo abepisikopi ba Kiliziya gatulika ku isi yose. Yatumiwemo abantu 2 500 baturutse mu bihugu 135, byabaye ubwa mbere inama nk’iyo itumirwamo abaporotestani, abanglikani n’aba Orthodox. 
Uko Papa Yohani XXIII yahuje Kiliziya Gatulika n’andi madini benshi bakabanza kubirwanya   Iyo nama ya Vatikani ya 2 yagize impinduka zikomeye mu mibanire hagati ya Kiliziya gatulika  n’andi matorero n’amadini ku isi kuko Papa Yohani wa 23 yaboneyeho n’umwanya wo gusaba imbabazi ku byo Kiliziya yaba yarakoze byayiviriyemo gucikamo ibice. Indi nama nk’iyo yaherukaga mu 1869. Icyo gitekerezo cye cyo gutumira inama ya Vatikani ya 2 cyamukururiye kunengwa na bamwe mu bakaridinali bavugaga ko ku myaka afite atakagombye gutegura inama ikomeye nk’iyo isaba imbaraga n’ubushishozi bwinshi, ariko ntibashoboye guhindura icyifuzo cye. Umunsi umwe ari kujya impaka na bo, Papa Yohani wa 23 yarahagurutse, akingura idirishya arababwira ati: “Ndifuza umwuka mushya muri Kiliziya”. Abakirisito bari bamaze hafi imyaka 2000 ntawe utekereza ku cyatuma bakwiyunga bakongera kuba umwe. Ategura iyo nama, Papa Yohani wa 23 yavuze kandi ko atifuza kugira uwo acira urubanza. Bwari ubwa mbere na none inama nk’iyo iterana mu binyenjana 20 ntihagire umuntu ucirwa urubanza. Ku itariki 05 Kamena 1960 yashyizeho I Vatikani ibiro bishinzwe ubumwe bw’abakristo, biyoborwa na Kardinali Augustin Bea. Inama ya Vatikani ya 2 yakozwe mu byiciro bine:

title: Piran Rwanda Ltd  yatanze inkunga y’ibiribwa byo gufasha abagizweho ingaruka na Coronavirus
content:
Imiryango 220 yo mu Mirenge ya Musha ,Mwulire na Munyiginya yo  mu Karere ka Rwamagana intara y’iburasirazuba yahawe inkunga y’ibiribwa binyuranye n’ibikoresho by’isuku  byo gufasha abakomeje kugirwaho ingaruka n’ingamba zafashwe mu guhangana n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus, inkunga ifite agaciro  k’amafaranga asaga miliyoni 5 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ( 5.000.000 Frw)  ku bufatanye  na Campany ya Piran Rwanda Ltd ikora ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro mu gace ka Musha .
  Umukecuru Kamaraba ahabwa inkunga n’ubuyobozi bw’Umurenge wa Mwurire n’abafatanyabikorwa  Bamwe mu baturage bo mu mirenge ya Musha mwurire na Munyiginya bagenewe inkunga na  Company Piran Rwanda Ltd ikora ubucukuzi bw’amabuye y’agaciro  bavuga ko bari babayeho nabi none bakaba bashimira ubuyobozi bwabagobotse . Kamaraba utuye mu Mudugudu wa Kadasumbwa  afite imyaka 72 y’amavuko avuga ko imibereho ye n’umwuzukuru we yari imeze nabi kubera kutabona ifunguro. Agira ati“  Inzara yari imereye nabi  kuko ubundi najyaga ngira ikibazo nkajya kureba abantu dusengana none nabo nta kazi bafite  rwose twari  turi mu buzima bubi ,mbese ndabashimiye  ”
 Banganabaseka  ni umuturage wahawe inkunga atuye mu Kagali ka Ntunga  afite umugore n’abana batatu yaje mu Karere ka Rwamagana aturutse I Musanze  aje gukora akazi k ‘ubufundi  kuri ubu kakaba karahagaze avuga ko we n’umuryango we bigeze no kuburara akaba ashima ababageneye inkunga . Agira  ati “  Ndishimye cyane   kuko inzara yari itumereye nabi kubera ko nta kazi twari dufite  ngo tubone icyo kurya kandi nta na mafaranga twari dufite ngo tujye guhaha  kuva aho bibereye nari mburaye gatatu ”
  inkunga y’ibiribwa binyuranye n’ibikoresho by’isuku  byo gufasha abakomeje kugirwaho ingaruka n’ingamba zafashwe mu guhangana n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus Sematuro  Lionnel  ni umuyobozi wa Company ya  Piran Rwanda Ltd avuga ko bazakomeza gutanga umusanzu wabo mu gufasha abaturage badafite amikoro yo kuba babona ibyo kurya muri ibi bihe turimo bikomeye byatewe n’icyorezo cya Coronavirus.  agira ati “Turabizi neza ko hari benshi batuye muri bino bice batunzwe n’akazi ka buri munsi niba rero kahagaze ntabwo yabona ibimutunga niyo mpamvu tuzajya tureba uko dushoboye aho twakura kugira ngo dutange umusanzu  turebe imiryango imerewe nabi tuyisangize ibyo twashoboye kubona   ”

Sematuro  Lionnel  ni umuyobozi wa Company ya  Piran Rwanda Ltd ashyikiriza ubuyobozi inkunga Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Mwulire Rwagasana  Jean  Claude  asaba abaturage batagifite imirimo muri iyi minsi kugana iy’ubuhinzi kugira ngo nabo bashobore kwifasha  ati “  Imirimo imwe n’imwe yarahagaze  ariko hari  imirimo ihari ubuhinzi ntibwahagaze   kandi ni igihe cyiza cyo guhinga,  umusaruro ukomoka k’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi  twawongera ukazaziba cya cyuho  igihe tutakoraga indi mirimo   ”
Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Mwulire Rwagasana  Jean  Claude  ashyikirizwa inkunga Company ya Piran Rwanda Ltd yatangiye gukorera mu Rwanda mu mwaka wa 2014  aho mu Karere ka Rwamagana ikorera mu Mirenge ya Musha na Mwulire .  Jean Elysee Byiringiro / indatwa.org

title: Abantu 4 bakize COVID-19 mu Rwanda bamaze gusezererwa
content:
Abantu bane bari abarwayi   b’icyorezo cya Koronavirusi COVID19 bamaze gusezererwa uyu munsi ku Cyumweru tariki 05 Mata, nyuma y’aho ibizamini byabo byerekanye ko nta Koronavirusi ikirangwa mu mubiri wabo.
 Abakize bavurirwaga mu kigo gifasha abanduye icyorezo cya koronavirusi giherereye i Kanyinya mu Karere ka Nyarugenge. Abarwayi ba COVID-19 mu Rwanda bari bamaze kugera ku 102. Bivuze ko imibare yamaze guhinduka kubera abarwayi 4 basezerewe kuri iki Cyumweru bityo hakaba hasigaye abarwayi 98. Umwe mu bakize asezera ku baganga bamwitayeho, yiteguye gusubira mu muryango Kuva mu Rwanda hagaragara icyorezo cya COVID19, Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yafashe ingamba zirimo kwirinda ikwirakwizwa rya Koronavirusi. Abanyarwanda basabwe kuguma mu rugo, kugira isuku by’umwihariko gukaraba intoki inshuro nyinshi hakoreshejwe isabune n’amazi meza, kwirinda ingendo zitari ngombwa ndetse no gusiga metero imwe hagati y’abantu babiri hakiyongeraho no kudasuhuzanya. Nkuko bitangazwa n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (WHO/OMS),  kugeza ubu Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika ni zo ziri ku isonga mu kugira umubare munini w’abagaragaweho COVID-19, zigakurikirwa na Espagne, u Butaliyani, u Budage, u Bufaransa Indatwa.org

Abanyarwanda basabwe kuguma mu rugo, kugira isuku by’umwihariko gukaraba intoki inshuro nyinshi hakoreshejwe isabune n’amazi meza, kwirinda ingendo zitari ngombwa ndetse no gusiga metero imwe hagati y’abantu babiri hakiyongeraho no kudasuhuzanya. Nkuko bitangazwa n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku Buzima (WHO/OMS),  kugeza ubu Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika ni zo ziri ku isonga mu kugira umubare munini w’abagaragaweho COVID-19, zigakurikirwa na Espagne, u Butaliyani, u Budage, u Bufaransa Indatwa.org

label: politics
title: Drogba na Eto’o baramagana ibyo kugeragereza urukingo rwa Covid 19 muri Afurika
content:
Abakinnyi bubatse amateka mu mupira w’amaguru bakomoka muri Afurika; Didier Drogba na Samuel Eto’o Fils bamaganye bivuye inyuma ibyo kugeragereza urukingo rwa Coronavirus ku banyafurika.
 Izi mpaka zavutse ubwo Jean Paul Mira, umuganga ushinzwe abarwayi barembye cyane mu bitaro byitwa, “Cochin”  biri ku murwa mukuru, Paris na Dogiteri Camillle Locht ushinzwe ubushakashatsi mu byerekeye ubuzima bw’abantu mu kigo, “Inserm Health Research Group” bombi batangaje kuri televiziyo y’u Bufaransa ko kugerageza inkingo z’icyorezo cya coronavirus mu bihuhu byo muri Afurika kitaba ari igitekerezo kibi. Ikigo, “Inserm Medical Research Group”  kivuga ko abavuga gutyo bumvise nabi ibyatangajwe na muganga, Jean-Paul Mira n’umushakashatsi Camille Locht. Muganga Jean-Paul Mira yavuze ko kugeragereza uru rukinfo muri Afurika kitaba ari ikintu kibi kuko ngo nta bikoresho byo kwikingira bihari, kandi nta n’imiti ihari. Yatangaje ko ibyo byaba nkuko biriho bikorwa mu bindi bice ku bijyanye n’ubushakashatsi buri gukorwa kuri Sida. Yavuze ko bagira ubushakashatsi ku bakora umwuga w’uburaya ku bijyanye na Sida kubera bari mu bantu bashobora kwandura kurusha abandi iyo ndwara kubera ko batikingira. Abantu batari bake bahise bandika ku mbuga nkorangambaga bagaragaza akababaro kabo. Bakomoza ko ari ugusuzugura ab’uruhu rwirabura, bahasaba ko byamaganwa. Abo barimo Didier Drogba na Samuel Eto’o bahoze ari abakinyi bakomeye mu mupira w’amaguru, bakaba bombi baturuka muri Afurika. Didier Drogba yavuze ko Abanyafurika badakwiye kuba ibikoresho byo kugeragerezaho izo nkingo. Avuga ko ibyatangajwe na Jean-Paul Mira na Camille Locht biteye isoni. Nyamara ikigo cy’ubushakashatsi mu bijyanye n’ubuzima, “Inserm Medical Research Group” kimenyesha ko igerarezwa ry’inkingo zishobora gukingira coronavirus zigiye kubera mu bihugu by’i Burayi no muri Australia. Ico kigo kivuga ko iryo geragezwa ryabera muri Afurika, ngo ryanabera icyarimwe no mu Burayi ndetse no muri Amerika. Icyo kigo kimenyesha ko Afurika itakwibagirana cyangwa ngo ikumirwe mu bushakashatsi kubera ko Covid 19 yakwirakwiriye ku Isi hose. Mu Rwanda byavuzwe ko rwakiriye ubusabe bw’ikigo LEAF Pharmaceuticals cyo muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika kinafite ibiro mu Rwanda, gishaka gutangira ubushakashatsi ku muti wongera umwuka mu mubiri w’uwanduye Coronavirus. Ni umuti ushobora gufasha mu kongera umwuka mu bice by’umubiri (tissus), aho kwiringira imashini gusa zabigenewe (intensive care unit (ICU) ventilators). Umuyobozi wa LEAF Pharmaceuticals, Dr Clet Niyikiza yabwiye Televiziyo Rwanda kuri ko magingo aya ikigo cye kiri muri 17 biri gushaka umuti n’urukingo bya Coronavirus muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. U Rwanda ruvuga ko iki kigo cyamaze gusaba uburenganzira bwo gukorera ubu bushakashatsi mu Rwanda, harebwa uburyo uwo muti ukora. Kugeza ubu ngo impande zombi ziracyaganira. Indatwa.org

label: politics
title: Waba uzi abantu bafite ibyago byo kwandura coronavirus kurusha abandi ndetse n’icyo basabwa gukora?
content:
Virusi ya Corona ishobora kwanduza umuntu uwo ari we wese, ariko abantu bafite indwara zimwe na zimwe ndetse n’abasaza bafite ibyago byinshi byo kwandura iyi ndwara.
Waba uzi abantu bafite ibyago byo kwandura coronavirus kurusha abandi ndetse n’icyo basabwa gukora?  Niba urwaye igihe kinini ushobora kubangamirwa naya makuru. Ariko ninde ufite ibyago byo kwandura? Benshi mu bafite ibyago byo kwandura ni abantu bafite imyaka 70, abafite ubumuga bw’ubwonko ndetse nabantu bari munsi yimyaka 70 niba bafite ibimenyetso bikurikira. Indwara y’ibihaha nka asima, kubabara mu gatuza, kudahumeka neza no kugira umuriro mwinshi. Indwara z’umutima n’imitsi, Indwara y’impyiko Indwara y’umwijima Guhangayika mu mutwe Diyabete Indwara zifata ubudahangarwa bw’umubiri nka VIH na kanseri Abanywa ibiyobyabwenge Abagore batwite Ese urwaye asima yakora iki? Ikigo cy’ubuzima cy’Ubwongereza cyagiriye inama abantu barwaye asima gukoresha impemu zisanzwe, nkuko bisanzwe. Umuntu agomba kumenya neza ko impemu ziwe zimukikije buri munsi kabone niyo yaba adafite ibimenyetso bya asima. Niba usanze waranduye virusi ya corona, hamagara abashinzwe ubuzima. Ese ndamutse nkuze cyane nakora iki? Inama yatanzwe na muganga kubaturage, hatitawe ku myaka – ni ukuba kure yabandi kugirango wirinde kwandura. Ibi bivuze ko umuntu atagomba kujya ahantu hateraniye abantu kugirango yifatanye nabo. Ibi ni ingenzi cyane cyane kubarengeje imyaka 70 kimwe nabafite iyi ndwara kuko bafite ibyago byo kwandura. Nakora iki niba mfite uburwayi bukomeye? Umuntu wese ufite ibyago byo kwandura indwara nkubukonje busanzwe butera umuriro agomba gufata ingamba zo kwirinda ubwandu. Abantu bagaragaza ibimenyetso by’ubwandu – nkabafite inkorora cyangwa ibicurane, bagomba kuguma murugo. Niba ibimenyetso byashize kandi umuntu akaba atameze neza, bagomba kubonana na muganga. Nakora iki ndwaye diyabete? Abantu barwaye diyabete yo mu bwoko bwa 1 na 2 bafite ibyago byinshi byo kwandura virusi ya corona. Niba urwaye diyabete ukaba uhura nibimenyetso nko gukorora n’umuriro mwinshi kimwe no kunanirwa guhumeka ugomba guhora usuzuma uko umeze. Niba ufite kimwe muri ibyo bimenyetso ugomba kuguma murugo iminsi irindwi, ugakomeza gufata imiti. Niba utabonye ibimenyetso bya virusi ya corona ukaba ushaka kubonana na muganga ugomba guhamagara cyangwa ukamuhamagara kumurongo aho kujya imbona nkubone. Ese abagore batwite bakwiye guhangayika? Nta kimenyetso cyerekana ko abagore batwite n’abana babo bafite ibyago byo kwandura virusi ya corona ariko leta yabasabye gufata ingamba z’ubuzima bwabo. Kimwe nabandi bantu bagomba gufata ingamba zo kwirinda kwandura. Abashinzwe ubuzima bavuga ko bashyizwe ku rutonde rw’abantu bafite ibyago byo kwandura virusi.

label: politics
title: Impinduka mu bikorwa byo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi: Ikiganiro na Dr Bizimana
content:
Harabura iminsi mike ngo Abanyarwanda binjire mu bihe byo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, mu gihe isi n’u Rwanda muri rusange bikomeje guhangana n’icyorezo cya coronavirus. 
Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG), Dr Bizimana Jean Damascène Ni mu gihe kandi Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yafashe ingamba zikomeye zo kwirinda icyo cyorezo zirimo gusaba abaturage kuguma mu ngo zabo birinda ikwirakwizwa rya coronavirus, guhagarika ibikorwa bihuza abantu benshi, gufunga imipaka n’ibindi. IGIHE yagiranye ikiganiro cyihariye n’Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG), Dr Bizimana Jean Damascène, asobanura birambuye uko kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ku nshuroya 26 bizakorwa muri ibi bihe bidasanzwe. IGIHE: Muri iki gihe isi yugarijwe na coronavirus, kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bizakorwa bite? Dr Bizimana: Icya mbere nababwira nuko igikorwa cyo Kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ari ihame ubuyobozi bw’igihugu cyacu bukomeyeho, niyo mpamvu Kwibuka 26 bizakorwa ariko abanyarwanda bazibuka hubahirizwa amabwiriza yatanzwe na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yo kwirinda no kurwanya icyorezo kitwugarije. Abaturage bazibukira mu ngo zabo babifashijwemo n’ibiganiro bizahita mu itangazamakuru: Radiyo, Televiziyo n’imbuga nkoranyambaga kandi hazakorwa ibishoboka kugira ngo ibikorwa byo Kwibuka bigere no mu mahanga hakoreshejwe uburyo bw’iyakure. Hari ibikorwa byahagaritswe kubera ibihe bidasanzwe turimo. Nta biganiro bizatangwa mu midugudu no mu bigo bya Leta n’abikorera nkuko byari bisanzwe. Urugendo rwo Kwibuka ruba tariki 7 Mata buri mwaka ntiruzaba kimwe n’umugoroba wo kwibuka wakorwaga tariki ya 7 Mata n’ahandi hose wakorwaga ku yandi matariki. Kwibukira ahantu hatandukanye hirya no hino mu gihugu nkuko byari bisanzwe bikorwa mu gihe gisanzwe cyo kwibuka birahagaritswe kugeza igihe cyose amabwiriza yatanzwe na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yo kwirinda no gukumira icyorezo cya coronavirus atarahinduka. Igihe habaye ikibazo cy’ihungabana abantu bari mu ngo, hazakoreshwa kwiyambaza umujyanama w’Ubuzima cyangwa guhamagara umurongo wa telefoni utishyurwa kuri numero 114. IGIHE: Tariki 7 Mata hazaba ibihe bikorwa? Dr Bizimana: Hateganyijwe ko tariki ya 7 Mata, saa yine za mu gitondo, ku Rwego rw’Igihugu, ku Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gisozi hazabera igikorwa cyo kunamira abazize Jenoside kizarangwa no gushyira indabyo ku mva, kwenyegeza urumuri rutazima, gufata umunota wo Kwibuka bikurikirwe n’Ijambo nyamukuru rizanyuzwa kuri za Radiyo, Televiziyo no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Mu gihe ku Rwibutso rwa Gisozi hazaba hubahirizwa umunota wo Kwibuka, abaturage nabo bazawubahiriza mu ngo zabo batekereza abacu bishwe muri Jenoside bazizwa gusa ko ari Abatutsi. Iki gikorwa dukangurira abanyarwanda kuzakurikira no kwifatanya n’aho kiriho kibera, tuzirikana abacu bishwe muri Jenoside nubwo tuzaba tudashobora kujya aho biciwe cyangwa ku nzibutso baruhukiyemo.

IGIHE: Mu turere dutandukanye hari ibikorwa byo gutangiza icyunamo bizahabera ? Dr Bizimana: Saa yine za mu gitondo mu Turere tw’u Rwanda mu gihe ku rwibutso rwa Gisozi hazaba hariho habera umuhango wo gutangiza icyunamo, buri Karere kazagena itsinda ry’abantu batarenze icumi, ariko uyu mubare ukaba ushobora kuzagabanywa kubera ibihe turimo, iri tsinda rikazajya ku rwibutso rw’Akarere cyangwa Urwibutso rwo ku Rwego rw’Igihugu ruri muri ako Karere mu Turere tuzifite, bakore umuhango mugufi wo kunamira abazize Jenoside no gushyira indabyo ku mva. Abazajya ku Rwibutso bazaba ari abahagarariye ibyiciro harimo Meya w’Akarere, Umuyobozi wa Njyanama, Perezida wa IBUKA, Perezida wa AVEGA, Umuyobozi wa Polisi, Umuyobozi w’Ingabo, Uhagarariye urubyiruko n’Uhagarariye amadini n’amatorero kugira ngo avuge isengesho nkuko bisanzwe biba mu gikorwa cyose cyo Kwibuka. Abanyamakuru bari mu Turere bazoroherezwa gukurikira ibi bikorwa kugira ngo bashobore kubigeza ku Banyarwanda hakoreshejwe uburyo bwose. n’Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG), Dr Bizimana Jean Damascène yavuze ko kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi habazamo impinduka
IGIHE: Ku gicamunsi cya tariki 7 Mata hazakorwa iki ko hari hamenyerewe urugendo rwo Kwibuka? Dr Bizimana: Hari ibikorwa biteganyijwe ariko ku buryo budasanzwe bukoreshwa kubera ibi bihe turimo byo guhangana n’icyorezo cy’indwara kandi tukaba tugomba kugitsinda. Guhera saa cyenda z’amanywa, hazaba ikiganiro ku mateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi kinyuzwe kuri za Radiyo na Televiziyo no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Ikiganiro kizarangwa no gusangira ijambo no kungurana ibitekerezo n’abantu batuye mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu no mu mahanga. Ubu buryo buzakoreshwa mu cyumweru cyose cy’icyunamo buri munsi saa cyenda kugeza saa kumi n’igice z’amanywa. Ibiganiro bizatangwa bizibanda ku mateka ya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi no ku ngamba zikoreshwa n’izikenewe mu gukomeza kuyabungabunga, uruhare rw’urubyiruko mu guhangana n’ingaruka za Jenoside no kurwanya ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside, guha umwanya abacitse ku icumu tubakomeza no guhangana n’ikibazo cy’ihungabana, kugaruka ku ruhare rw’amahanga muri Jenoside no ku rugendo amahanga yakoze mu kwemera uruhare rwayo muri Jenoside no gufatanya n’u Rwanda mu rugendo rwo kwiyubaka, gutekereza ku ruhare rw’itangazamakuru mu bukangurambaga bwa Jenoside n’uruhare rwaryo mu kubaka igihugu, ndetse hanaganirwe ku ruhare rw’amashyaka ya politiki muri Jenoside n’uruhare rwayo nyuma ya Jenoside mu kubaka igihugu cyashegeshwe n’amateka ya Jenoside. Mu minsi y’icyumweru cy’icyunamo kandi, hazakomeza kuri Radiyo na Televiziyo ibikorwa bitandukanye bifasha Kwibuka Jenoside, birimo ubuhamya bw’abayirokotse, filime zerekeye amateka ya Jenoside n’ukwiyubaka k’u Rwanda, imivugo ijyanye no Kwibuka Jenoside, n’amateka yose ya Jenoside bikazanyuzwa mu itangazamakuru ku buryo bworohereza abaturage n’abanyarwanda baba mu mahanga n’inshuti z’u Rwanda kwibuka. IGIHE: Muvuze ko tariki ya 7 Mata 2020 nta mugoroba w’ikiriyo, haba hari ikizawusimbura ? Dr Bizimana : Tariki ya 7 Mata nimugoroba, guhera saa kumi n’ebyiri, hazatangwa ubutumwa bwo guhumuriza no kwiyubaka buzayoborwa na Perezida wa Ibuka ku Rwego rw’Igihugu afatanyije na bamwe mu bayobozi b’Imiryango y’abacitse ku icumu bari mu Rwanda no mu mahanga. Twatekereje guha umwanya wihariye abacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi aho bari hose ku isi dukoresheje ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo bahumurizanye, bakomezanye, baganire ndetse n’abandi banyarwanda n’inshuti z’u Rwanda bashobore kubaba hafi no kubatera imbaraga muri ibi bihe bazaba badashobora guhura ngo bafatanye kwibuka. Jenoside yatugizeho ingaruka mu buryo bwose, ariko ntawakwirengagiza ko uwacitse ku icumu muri 1994 wamaze biriya bihe byose yihishahisha, abicanyi bamuhiga amanywa n’ijoro, uwo muntu afite umwihariko we adahuje n’abandi. No mu ruhande rw’abahagaritse Jenoside, abasilikare ba RPA-Inkotanyi bahanganye n’abicanyi bahagarika Jenoside, uko babatsinze bagasanga aho bafashe hari imirambo y’abatutsi bamaze kwicwa, harimo n’inkomere zikomeye, bagashakashaka mu mirambo abagihumeka, bagira amahirwe yo kubabona bakabavura mu buryo bwose bashoboye kandi bugoranye kubera amikoro atari ahari n’ibihe bibi by’icyo gihe ; abo basilikare bacu bafite umwihariko ukomeye w’amateka udasangana abandi banyarwanda. Usanga bibabaje kubona hari abibagirwa ababarokoye mu bihe bibi cyane by’icuraburindi, bakajya mu murongo w’abarwanya Leta bakesha icyo ubu bari cyo. Numva ko Kwibuka26 bikwiye kuzaba umwanya wo kugaruka ku mateka yo kurokoka Jenoside n’igihango abanyarwanda bafitanye n’abarokoye u Rwanda, bigatuma twarongeye kubaho tukiyubaka, tukaba tugeze heza hashimishije.

IGIHE: Gusoza icyumweru cy’icyunamo ku itariki 13 Mata byo biteganyijwe gute? Dr Bizimana: Uyu mwaka igikorwa cyo gusoza icyunamo gikorerwa ku rwibutso rwa Rebero nacyo kizaba kigufi kubera ibihe turimo. Tariki 13 Mata saa yine za mu gitondo, ku rwibutso rwa Rebero hazajyayo itsinda rito riyobowe na Perezida wa Sena rizakora igikorwa cyo kunamira no gushyira indabyo ku mva zishyinguyemo abanyapolitiki bashyinguye ku i Rebero bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bazizwa kutemera umugambi wa Jenoside, indabyo zinashyirwe ku mva zishyinguyemo imibiri irenga ibihumbi cumi na bine y’Abatutsi bishwe muri Jenoside ishyinguye ku Rwibutso rwa Rebero. IGIHE: Mu Turere ho nta kintu kizahakorerwa? Dr Bizimana: Tariki ya 13 Mata nyuma ya saa sita, guhera saa cyenda hazaba ikiganiro kizanyuzwa kuri za radiyo, Televiziyo no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga kizaganira ku ruhare rw’amashyaka ya politiki muri Jenoside no ku kamaro ka politiki nziza mu kubaka igihugu no guhangana n’ingengabitekerezo ya Jenoside. IGIHE: Kwibuka mu gihe cy’iminsi 100 byo biteganyijwe gute? Dr Bizimana: Tuzakomeza kugendera mu murongo wo Kwibuka twiyubaka kandi twubahiriza amabwiriza yo kwirinda iki cyorezo duhanganye nacyo. Niyo mpamvu ibikorwa byo kwibuka bisanzwe bibera ahantu hatandukanye mu gihugu n’ahiciwe abatutsi muri Jenoside bitazahabera. Icyo gihe hazakurikizwa icyo amabwiriza mashya azaba ateganya. Bigenze bityo, byatuma nko mu kwezi kwa Gicurasi na Kamena, dushobora kureba uko muri buri Karere hatoranywa ahantu hamwe hafite amateka akomeye hakabera igikorwa cyo kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, hakibukwa Abatutsi bose biciwe muri ako Karere. Kuva muri Nyakanga 1994 abajenosideri batsindwa, Leta ikora ibishoboka ikaba hafi y’abacitse ku icumu rya Jenoside mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi. Muri iyi minsi tuzibuka mu buryo budasanzwe abacu bishwe muri Jenoside, ndatekereza by’umwihariko abagifite intege nke mbakomeza mu izina rya Komisiyo y’Igihugu yo Kurwanya Jenoside, mbasubiriramo ko bakwiye gukomezwa no kuba bafite ubuyobozi bw’igihugu cyabarokoye kandi giharanira iteka kububaka no kubaka ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda ngo Jenoside ntizongere kubaho mu Rwanda. Mu gihe cyo Kwibuka abacu bishwe hakaba hashize imyaka 26, tuzibuke aya mahirwe yo kuba abarokotse bararokotse koko kubera Inkotanyi, bakaba bariho babikesha FPR yubatse Leta nziza ikomeje guharanira ko icyo abishwe bazize kitazongera kubaho ukundi ari imbaraga zigomba guha abacitse ku icumu icyizere cyo kudahungabana. Mu gihe tuzaba twibukira iwacu mu ngo, abazumva bacitse intege bazatekereze ko muri 1994 abacu bicwaga kandi bakicishwa na Leta, ariko ubu abarokotse n’abagarutse mu Rwanda bari barambuwe na Leta y’abajenosederi, bariho kubera ubuyobozi bwiza bwa FPR-Inkotanyi burangajwe imbere na Nyakubahwa Perezida wa Repuburika Paul Kagame; ubuyobozi bwabarokoye bukaba bububatse. Impinduka mu bikorwa byo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi: Ikiganiro na Dr Bizimana
Harabura iminsi mike ngo Abanyarwanda binjire mu bihe byo kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi, mu gihe isi n’u Rwanda muri rusange bikomeje guhangana n’icyorezo cya coronavirus. 
Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG), Dr Bizimana Jean Damascène Ni mu gihe kandi Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yafashe ingamba zikomeye zo kwirinda icyo cyorezo zirimo gusaba abaturage kuguma mu ngo zabo birinda ikwirakwizwa rya coronavirus, guhagarika ibikorwa bihuza abantu benshi, gufunga imipaka n’ibindi. IGIHE yagiranye ikiganiro cyihariye n’Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG), Dr Bizimana Jean Damascène, asobanura birambuye uko kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ku nshuroya 26 bizakorwa muri ibi bihe bidasanzwe. IGIHE: Muri iki gihe isi yugarijwe na coronavirus, kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi bizakorwa bite? Dr Bizimana: Icya mbere nababwira nuko igikorwa cyo Kwibuka Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi ari ihame ubuyobozi bw’igihugu cyacu bukomeyeho, niyo mpamvu Kwibuka 26 bizakorwa ariko abanyarwanda bazibuka hubahirizwa amabwiriza yatanzwe na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yo kwirinda no kurwanya icyorezo kitwugarije. Abaturage bazibukira mu ngo zabo babifashijwemo n’ibiganiro bizahita mu itangazamakuru: Radiyo, Televiziyo n’imbuga nkoranyambaga kandi hazakorwa ibishoboka kugira ngo ibikorwa byo Kwibuka bigere no mu mahanga hakoreshejwe uburyo bw’iyakure. Hari ibikorwa byahagaritswe kubera ibihe bidasanzwe turimo. Nta biganiro bizatangwa mu midugudu no mu bigo bya Leta n’abikorera nkuko byari bisanzwe. Urugendo rwo Kwibuka ruba tariki 7 Mata buri mwaka ntiruzaba kimwe n’umugoroba wo kwibuka wakorwaga tariki ya 7 Mata n’ahandi hose wakorwaga ku yandi matariki. Kwibukira ahantu hatandukanye hirya no hino mu gihugu nkuko byari bisanzwe bikorwa mu gihe gisanzwe cyo kwibuka birahagaritswe kugeza igihe cyose amabwiriza yatanzwe na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yo kwirinda no gukumira icyorezo cya coronavirus atarahinduka. Igihe habaye ikibazo cy’ihungabana abantu bari mu ngo, hazakoreshwa kwiyambaza umujyanama w’Ubuzima cyangwa guhamagara umurongo wa telefoni utishyurwa kuri numero 114. IGIHE: Tariki 7 Mata hazaba ibihe bikorwa? Dr Bizimana: Hateganyijwe ko tariki ya 7 Mata, saa yine za mu gitondo, ku Rwego rw’Igihugu, ku Rwibutso rwa Jenoside rwa Gisozi hazabera igikorwa cyo kunamira abazize Jenoside kizarangwa no gushyira indabyo ku mva, kwenyegeza urumuri rutazima, gufata umunota wo Kwibuka bikurikirwe n’Ijambo nyamukuru rizanyuzwa kuri za Radiyo, Televiziyo no ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Mu gihe ku Rwibutso rwa Gisozi hazaba hubahirizwa umunota wo Kwibuka, abaturage nabo bazawubahiriza mu ngo zabo batekereza abacu bishwe muri Jenoside bazizwa gusa ko ari Abatutsi. Iki gikorwa dukangurira abanyarwanda kuzakurikira no kwifatanya n’aho kiriho kibera, tuzirikana abacu bishwe muri Jenoside nubwo tuzaba tudashobora kujya aho biciwe cyangwa ku nzibutso baruhukiyemo.

IGIHE: Mu turere dutandukanye hari ibikorwa byo gutangiza icyunamo bizahabera ? Dr Bizimana: Saa yine za mu gitondo mu Turere tw’u Rwanda mu gihe ku rwibutso rwa Gisozi hazaba hariho habera umuhango wo gutangiza icyunamo, buri Karere kazagena itsinda ry’abantu batarenze icumi, ariko uyu mubare ukaba ushobora kuzagabanywa kubera ibihe turimo, iri tsinda rikazajya ku rwibutso rw’Akarere cyangwa Urwibutso rwo ku Rwego rw’Igihugu ruri muri ako Karere mu Turere tuzifite, bakore umuhango mugufi wo kunamira abazize Jenoside no gushyira indabyo ku mva. Abazajya ku Rwibutso bazaba ari abahagarariye ibyiciro harimo Meya w’Akarere, Umuyobozi wa Njyanama, Perezida wa IBUKA, Perezida wa AVEGA, Umuyobozi wa Polisi, Umuyobozi w’Ingabo, Uhagarariye urubyiruko n’Uhagarariye amadini n’amatorero kugira ngo avuge isengesho nkuko bisanzwe biba mu gikorwa cyose cyo Kwibuka. Abanyamakuru bari mu Turere bazoroherezwa gukurikira ibi bikorwa kugira ngo bashobore kubigeza ku Banyarwanda hakoreshejwe uburyo bwose. n’Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa wa Komisiyo y’igihugu yo kurwanya Jenoside (CNLG), Dr Bizimana Jean Damascène yavuze ko kwibuka ku nshuro ya 26 Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi habazamo impinduka

Ikiganiro kizarangwa no gusangira ijambo no kungurana ibitekerezo n’abantu batuye mu bice bitandukanye by’igihugu no mu mahanga. Ubu buryo buzakoreshwa mu cyumweru cyose cy’icyunamo buri munsi saa cyenda kugeza saa kumi n’igice z’amanywa.
