title: “Nta gikuba cyacitse,icyo dushaka nuko abantu birinda”-Prof Shyaka
content:
Kuva mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa gatandatu tariki ya 21 Werurwe 2020,Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yakajije ingamba z’ubwirinzi ku cyorezo cya COVID19 kigenda gifata indi ntera mu bihugu bitandukanye n’u Rwanda rurimo. 

Prof Shyaka Anastase,Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu  Mu itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara n’Ibiro bya Minisitiri w’Intebe hagaragaramo ingamba icumi zigomba kubahirizwa uko byagenda kose zirimo guhagarika imirimo imwe n’imwe,ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi bimwe na bimwe ndetse abantu bategetswe kuguma mu ngo zabo uko bishoboka kose mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko abantu bakomeza gucaracara no kunyuranamo bishobora no kubaviramo gukwirakwiza indwara. Kuva izi ngamba zatangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa abantu batangiye kugira ubwoba cyane cyane bikanga ibura ry’ibiribwa . Mu duce dutandukanye tw’igihugu urasanga abantu bahaha mu buryo budasanzwe bamwe bakajya gukora za sitoki bavuga ko ibiribwa bigiye kubura. Hari kandi n’abavuga ko umubare munini w’abantu cyane cyane abatuye mu Mijyi  bagiye kwicwa n’inzara kubera ko mu buzima busanzwe baryaga bavuye gupagasa none abantu bakaba basabwe kuguma mu ngo zabo. Mu kiganiro cyatambutse ku ma radiyo atandukanye mu gihugu hose kuri iki cyumweru,Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu Prof Shyaka Anastase yahumurije abaturage ko nta kintu kidasanzwe cyane cyabayeho ahubwo ko amabwiriza yatanzwe agamije gufasha abantu gukaza ingamba zo kwirinda no kudakwirakwiza virusi yo mu bwoko bwa Corona. Prof Shyaka yagize ati” amabwiriza arasobanutse cyane kandi nta gikomeye kirimo kuko byose biganisha ku ibisubizo byo kwirinda icyorezo kitwugarije.” Prof Shyaka yahumurije abaturage ko ibikorwa byose birebana no gufasha abaturage gukomeza kubaho neza nk’ahacururizwa ibiribwa,bikomeza ndetse n’ingendo za ngombwa zishobora gukorwa. Minisitiri Shyaka ati”ujya muri butiki guhaha agende ahahe,ujya mu isoko yihute ahahe atahe ariko yibuka kubahiriza amabwiriza yatanzwe nko kwirinda kugendera mu kivunge,abantu bagahana intera bagamije kwirinda icyorezo cya COVID19.” Shyaka yabwiye abanyarwanda ko ibikorwa by’ubuhinzi,ubworozi ndetse no kugemura umusaruro ku masoko bikorwa nta nkomyi gusa akomeza kwitsitsa ku cyo kwirinda kuramukanya,kwegerana no kwikubanaho n’indi migenzo ishobora gutuma abantu banduzanya. Ku birebana n’abavuga ko bashobora kubura ibiribwa kubera ko nta buryo bwo kujya gupagasa bafite ,Minisitiri Shyaka yongeye kwibutsa abanyarwanda umuco wo kuremerana aho bishoboka,ariko avuga ko Leta igiye kwiga ku buryo yagoboka abashobora guhura n’icyo kibazo.Ati” bene abo baba mu masoko ku buryo kubamenya byoroshye bityo tukareba uko inzego zafatanya mu kubagoboka ariko batishoye mu bikorwa byatuma bandura cyangwa bakwirakwiza coronavirus.”
kubahirizwa.Gusa imyumvire itandukanye,ubwoba ,ndetse no gusa n’abakutse imitima nibyo usanga abantu bakwirakwiza ku mbuga nkoranyambaga. Kuva mu ijoro ryo kuri uyu wa gatandatu tariki ya 21 Werurwe 2020,Guverinoma y’u Rwanda yakajije ingamba z’ubwirinzi ku cyorezo cya COVID19 kigenda gifata indi ntera mu bihugu bitandukanye n’u Rwanda rurimo. 

Prof Shyaka Anastase,Minisitiri w’Ubutegetsi bw’Igihugu  Mu itangazo ryashyizwe ahagaragara n’Ibiro bya Minisitiri w’Intebe hagaragaramo ingamba icumi zigomba kubahirizwa uko byagenda kose zirimo guhagarika imirimo imwe n’imwe,ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi bimwe na bimwe ndetse abantu bategetswe kuguma mu ngo zabo uko bishoboka kose mu rwego rwo kwirinda ko abantu bakomeza gucaracara no kunyuranamo bishobora no kubaviramo gukwirakwiza indwara. label: politics
title: Muje kwirinda icyorezo ntimuje mu butembere-Guverineri Gatabazi
content:
Mu gikorwa cyo gufasha abanyeshuri baba mu bigo by’amashuri gutaha iwabo mu ngo kubera icyorezo cya COVID19,icyemezo cyafashwe na Guverinoma y’u Rwanda,Guverineri w’Intara y’Amajyaruguru Gatabazi Jean Marie Vianney yabwiye aba banyeshuri ko atari umwanya wo gutembera bajemo cyangwa kwirirwa bazerera .

 Igikorwa cyo gucyura abanyeshuri iwabo cyakurikiranwe n’abayobozi .Guverineri Gatabazi aganira n’abanyeshuri mbere yuko burira imodoka  Kuri stade Ubworoherane yo mu Karere ka Musanze niho abanyeshuri bo mu bigo bimwe na bimwe byo mu Ntara y’Amajyaruguru bahuriraga  baturutse mu bigo byabo mbere yuko baherezwa mu Turere dutandukanye n’Umujyi wa Kigali. Mbere yuko burira imodoka, Umukuru w’Intara y’Amajyaruguru Gatabazi Jean Marie Vianney, ari kumwe n’abandi bayobozi mu nzego zitandukanye, yabanzaga kuganira n’abo bana . Mu kiganiro kigufi yabahaye,yabibukije ko  nubwo batashye  bagomba kuzirikana ko byakozwe  kugira ngo batanduzanya icyorezo cya COVID 19 kugeza ubu cyugarije isi yose  kandi ko bari begereje igihe cy’ibizamini .Ati “mwari mu maze iminsi musubiramo amasomo mwitegura ibizamini , ubu rero mugende mukomeze musubiremo amasomo yanyu, mubikore neza muzirikana ko  nyuma y’ ibi amasomo azakomeza kandi ko muzaza mukora ibizamini.” Guverineri kandi yasabye aba banyeshuri ko muri iyi minsi basubiye mu rugo  bakwiye kuzirikana impamvu nyamukuru itumye bajya mu rugo .Ati “ Guverinoma yafashe icyemezo gikomeye cyo gufunga amashuri kugira ngo mubashe kurinda amagara yanyu, ntabwo ari umwanya mubonye wo kwirirwa mu bigare, mugomba kwirinda ahantu hahurira abantu benshi.” Ikindi kandi Umukuru w’Intara y’Amajyaruguru yabwiye aba banyeshuri ko ari bamwe mu bavuga rikumvikana igihugu gifite bityo ko bakwiye kuba ba ambasaderi bo gukwirakwiza umuco mwiza w’ isuku.Ati “bimwe mu by’ ingenzi Inzego z’ ubuzima zikangurira abaturarwanda  ni ukugira isuku bakaraba intoki neza kandi igihe cyose  ndetse no kwirinda kuramukanya bahana ibiganza  no guhoberana.Ndabasaba ngo mu mbere ba ambasaderi b’ isuku iwanyu mu ngo .” Kuri uyu wa mbere ingendo ntizari zoroshye  muri za gare hirya no hino mu gihugu bitewe nuko imodoka zari zahariwe abanyeshuri.Gusa abagenzi  bamwe nubwo bitari biboroheye babwiye VALUENEWS ko byari ngombwa ko abana bataha kuko icyorezo cya COVID19 kitoroshye. Basabye bagenzi babo ko bareka gukora ingendo zitari ngombwa muri iki gihe imodoka zigifite akazi ko gucyura abanyeshuri.Mu bigo byose abana  ntibabashije gutaha , iki gikorwa kikaba kirakomeza kuri uyu wa kabiri tariki ya 17 Werurwe 2020.

label: politics
title: Abagabo bigira ntibindeba mu kwita ku bana bato- Ubushakashatsi
content:
Ubushakashatsi bw’Umuryango mpuzamahanga urengera abana bwatunze agatoki abagabo gutererana abagore mu kwita k’uburere bw’abana bato. Bamwe mu bagabo babwiye umunyamakuru wacu ko biterwa n’uko baba bagiye gushaka ibitunga umuryango.
 Ubushakashatsi bwa ‘Save the Children’ ishami ry’u Rwanda  bwamuritswe kuri uyu wa 4 Werurwe 2020, bwakorewe mu turere twa Gasabo, Ruhango na Kirehe bugaragaza ko  mu miryango myinshi abagabo badafata  umwanya  wo gusabana n’abana bato  ngo babakinishe cyangwa babasomere inkuru nk’uburyo bufasha umwana gukura mu bwenge ahubwo bigaharirwa ababyeyi b’ababagore. Bamwe mu bagabo bavuga ko impamvu batagira umwanya wo kwita ku burere bw’abana bato babiterwa n’uko baba bagiye mu mirimo Umwe ati “ Abagabo akenshi tuba twagiye gushaka imibereho tugasiga abadamu bari kumwe n’abana.”
 Undi nawe ati “ Umwana w’imyaka ibiri aba akiri ku ibere urumva umufashe ukamuha papa we ntabwo bishoboka ko papa we yamuha ibere, yakora ibindi byose bishoboka akamuha ibiryo ariko ntabwo yamuha ibere.” Hari umubeyi w’umugore wabwiye Flash ko kuba abagabo batita ku bana bakiri bato bituma umwana akura atinya se. Ati “ Ingaruka ziza nyuma umwana iyo amaze gukura aho usanga akura atinya papa we kubera atigeze akunda kumubona kenshi.” Imibare igaragaza ko ababyeyi b’ababagore bakinisha abana ku kigero cya 61% mu gihe abagabo ari 20% . N’ubwo abagabo bavuga ko bahugira mu gushaka ibitunga umuryango ntibabone umwanya wo kwita ku bana, hari abasanga ahanini bishingiye kumyumvire y’abagabo yo kuva cyera yo  kumva ko kitwa ku bana ari iby’ababyeyi b’ababagore. Gusa ngo iyi myumvire ikwiye guhinduka. Monique Abimpaye ashinze ubushakashatsi muri ‘Save the Children’ ishami ry’u Rwanda. Ati “Icyo navuga mu bushakashatsi twabonye ni ikintu kijyanye n’imyumvire ijyanye n’umuco wacu yo kumva ko umugabo we ari uwo kwita ku rugo ariko kumenya uko umwana ameze uko yiriwe ugasanga biraharirwa umubyeyi w’umugore kandi umwana aba akeneye urukundo rwa se na nyina.” Inzego za Leta zishinzwe uburere bw’abana bato  zivuga ko iyo mubyeyi w’umugabo n’uwumugore bafatanyije kwita ku mwana muto bituma akura neza Nk’uko bisobanurwana na Freya Zaninka De Clercq, Umuyobozi w’ishami ry’imbonezamikurire y’abana bato muri gahunda y’igihugu mbonezamikurire . Ati “Usanga abyeyi b’ababagabo bibwira ko abagore bahagije mu kwita ku bana bato bakumva ko wenda akamaro k’umugabo ari gushaka imibereho, mbese ugasanga ari ukutamenya aho gushyira ingufu tukigisha abagabo kwita ku burere bw’abana kuko umwana ubonye urukundo rwa se na nyina bituma akura neza yigiririra ikizere.” Hashize igihe mu Rwanda hatangijwe Gahunda y’imbonezamikurire y’abana bato ishinzwe kugabanya imirire mibi n’idindira ry’imikurire n’igwingira ry’abana bato, ifasha ababyeyi n’abaturage muri rusange gutanga uburere buboneye, ifasha kwita ku bana bafite ubumuga n’abakeneye kwitabwaho ndetse no gutegura abana kwiga amashuri abanza. Daniel Hakizimana / Flash Tv

title: Burundi: Amasaha y’utubari yagabanijwe mu gukaza umutekano
content:
Umutegetsi w’umujyi wa Bujumbura yasohoye amabwiriza akaza umutekano ndetse amasaha yo kujya mu tubari aragabanwa.
 Ikinyamakuru The East African cyanditse ko umuyobozi wa Bujumbura Freddy MBONIMPA yagiranye inama n’abandi bategetsi bakemeza ko utubari tuzajya dufungura saa kumi n’imwe za nimugoroba tugafunga saa tatu mu minsi isanzwe, naho mu mpera z’icyumweru no kumunsi w’ikiruhuko tugafungura saa saba tugafunga saa tatu. Ibi ngo bikozwe mu rwego rwo gukaza umutekano muri iki gihe bitegura amatora ya 2020.

label: politics
title: Abakozi ba Leta no mu bigo byigenga bagiye gutangira gukurwaho 0.5% by’umushahara azunganira mituweri
content:
Minisiteri y’Abakozi ba leta n’Umurimo (MIFOTRA) yasabye abakoresha mu nzego za leta n’iz’abikorera kujya bakata 0.5% ku mushahara wa buri kwezi ku bakozi babo, bakawushyikiriza ikigo cy’Ubwiteganyirize mu Rwanda (RSSB) akajya kunganira ubwisungane mu kwivuza, mutuelle de santé.
Abakozi ba Leta no mu bigo byigenga bagiye gutangira gukurwaho 0.5% by’umushahara azunganira mituweri 
 Ni icyemezo iyo Minisiteri yatangaje igendeye ku Iteka rya Minisitiri w’Intebe no 034/01 ryo ku wa 13/02/2020 ryerekeye inkunga z’ubwisungane mu kwivuza riteganya ahantu hatandukanye hagiye kujya hava amafaranga yo kunganira ubwisungane mu kwivuza. Itangazo MIFOTRA yashyize ahagaragara rivuga ko “Minisiteri y’abakozi ba leta n’umurimo imenyesha abakoresha bose mu nzego za leta n’iz’abikorera mu Rwanda ko 0.5% avuga muri iryo teka mu ngingo yaryo ya kabiri igika cya 10 akatwa n’umukoresha ku mushahara utahanwa n’umukozi.” Rikomeza rivuga ko umukoresha akusanya buri kwezi uwo musanzu akawushyikiriza RSSB kuri konti yayo iri muri Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda yitwa RSSB CBHI SCHEME. Iryo tangazo ryashyizweho mukono na Minisitiri Rwanyindo Kayirangwa Fanfan, ryibutsa ko imenyekanisha ry’uwo musanzu rikorwa bitarenze tariki 15 z’ukwezi gukurikira uko abakozi bahembwamo.

Ahandi hateganyijwe kuva ubwunganizi Iri teka rivuga ko ku mafaranga azajya aturuka muri Leta, arimo miliyari 6 Frw azajya aturuka mu ngengo y’imari y’umwaka, yishyurwa na Minisiteri ifite imari mu nshingano zayo. Iri teka risobanura ko buri mwaka Minisiteri ifite imari mu nshingano zayo izajya itangira 3 000 Frw buri muntu utishoboye uri mu cyiciro cya mbere cy’Ubudehe. Ku mafaranga yishyurwa ku iyandikwa ry’imiti n’ibikoresho byo mu buvuzi, yishyurwa na Minisiteri ifite ubuzima mu nshingano zayo, 50% azajya nayo agenerwa kunganira Mutuelle de Santé mu gihe amafaranga yose (100%) yishyurwa n’abakora ubushakashatsi mu rwego rw’ubuzima nayo azajya agenerwa kuyunganira. Iri teka rigaragaza kandi ko 10% by’amafaranga acibwa kuri serivisi zihabwa amasosiyete y’ubucuruzi akora ibikorwa by’imikino y’amahirwe izwi nka Betting, yishyurwa Minisiteri ifite ubucuruzi mu nshingano nayo azajya agenerwa kunganira ubu bwishingizi. Iri teka risobanura ko 50% by’amafaranga yose atangwa mu kugenzura imiterere y’ibinyabiziga ‘Contrôle Technique’ ndetse na 10% acibwa abakoze amakosa mu muhanda, asanzwe yishyurwa Polisi y’igihugu nayo agiye kujya agenerwa kunganira Mutuelle de Santé. Hari kandi amafaranga asanzwe acibwa abacuruza ibintu bitujuje ubuziranenge, yishyurwa ikigo cya Leta gifite ubuziranenge mu nshingano zacyo iri teka risobanura ko yose(100%) agiye kujya yunganira ubu bwishingizi ndetse n’amafaranga 100Frw ava ku mahoro yakwa kuri parikingi z’ibinyabiziga kuri buri saha imwe bihagaze, yishyurwa n’Umujyi wa Kigali. Iri teka rigaragaza ko 10% by’amafaranga ava mu bukerarugendo agenewe uturere bireba, yishyurwa n’Urwego rushinzwe Iterambere mu Rwanda (RDB) agiye kugenerwa ubu bwishingizi. Hari kandi ibihumbi 20Frw asanzwe ava mu ihererekanywa ry’imodoka yaguzwe n’ibihumbi 10 Frw kuri moto asanzwe yishyurwa ikigo cy’imisoro n’amahoro nayo agiye kuzajya yunganira ubu bwishingizi. Rivuga ko 4.000 Frw kuri hegitari imwe y’ubutaka bw’igishanga na 5.000 Frw kuri hegitari imwe y’ubutaka bw’imusozi na 2.000 Frw kuri hegitari imwe y’amaterasi y’indinganire, yishyurwa n’Akarere bireba azajya agenerwa kunganira ubu bwishingizi. Iri teka rivuga ko uretse inkunga ya Leta igenewe abatishoboye itangwa bitarenze tariki ya 30 Nzeri buri mwaka, inkunga ya Leta ivugwa muri iyi ngingo itangwa buri gihembwe. label: politics
title: Isi yashyizwe mu bihe bidasanzwe kubera Coronavirus
content:
Tedros Ghebreyesus, utegeka OMS yagize ati: "Impamvu nyamukuru yo gutangaza ibi si ibiri kubera mu Bushinwa ahubwo n’ibiri kuba no mu bindi bihugu".
Impungenge ziriho ni uko iyi ndwara ishobora kugera mu bihugu bifite ubuvuzi budateye imbere.
 Ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku buzima, OMS/WHO,ryatangaje ko ubu isi iri mu bihe bidasanzwe kubera virus ya Coronavirus ikomeje gukwirakwira no hanze y’Ubushinwa Umuryango w’ibihugu bigize Africa y’iburasirazuba, EAC, wasabye ibihugu biwugize kuba maso bikitegura guhangana n’iyi virus. Leta y’u Rwanda yatangaje ko yatangiye gusuzuma abantu banyura ku kibuga cy’indege mpuzamahanga cya Kigali. Yatanze kandi itangazo riburira abanyarwanda kwirinda kujya mu ntara ya Hubei irimo umujyi wa Wuhan ufatwa nk’izingiro ry’iyi ndwara. Ibikorwa nk’ibi byo kwitegura no kwirinda birakorwa n’ibindi bihugu byo mu karere.
Mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru i Geneve, Bwana Tedros yavuze ko iyi virus "ari icyorezo kidasanzwe" ariko "kiri kurwanywa mu buryo budasanzwe". Yashimye umuhate n’ingamba za leta y’Ubushinwa mu kurwanya iyi virus, avuga ko abona nta mpamvu yo kugabanya cyangwa kubuza abantu kujya mu Bushinwa.
Gusa ibihugu nka Leta zunze ubumwe za Amerika zabujije abaturage bazo kujya mu Bushinwa. Muri Amerika kandi ejo kuwa kane abashinzwe ubuzima bemeje ko babonye umuntu wa mbere wanduye iyi ndwara atarageze mu Bushinwa ayivaye ku wahavuye.
Naho Uburusiya bwamaze gufunga umupaka wabwo wose n’Ubushinwa. Mu Bushinwa iyi ndwara imaze guhitana abantu 213, abantu hafi 10,000 bamaze kuyandura. OMS ivuga ko hari abantu 98 mu bihugu 18 ku isi bamaze kuyandura, gusa ntawe irahitana hanze y’Ubushinwa. Ibihugu na kompanyi zinyuranye biri guhagarika no kugabanya ingendo n’ibikorwa mu Bushinwa. Kompanyi nka Google, Ikea, Starbucks na Tesla zafunze ibikorwa byazo mu Bushinwa.
Ni ryari bundi OMS yatangaje icyemezo nk’iki? Gutangaza ko isi yinjiye mu bihe bidasanzwe biba bigamije kongera umuhate mu gukumira no kurwanya icyorezo kidasanzwe; Inshuro eshanu mu bihe bishinzwe nibwo OMS yatangaje ko isi yinjiye mu bihe bidasanzwe by’ubuzima; Ibicurane by’ingurube, 2009 -Icyo gihe Virus ya H1N1 yakwiriye ahayuranye ku isi yica abantu 200,000. Imbasa, 2014 - Nubwo yari hafi gucika ku isi mu 2012, imibare yayo yarazamutse cyane mu 2013 maze OMS itangazo iyi ngingo. Zika, 2016 - OMS yatangaje ko Zika yashyize isi mu kaga mu gihe yariho ikwirakwira cyane muri Amerika y’epfo. Ebola, 2014 na 2019 - Bwa mbere ni mu 2014 ubwo abantu 30,000 bayanduraga muri Afurika y’Iburengerazuba 11,000 ikabica. Ubuheruka ni umwaka ushize igihe yacaga ibintu muri DR Congo

title: Nyanza: Hibutswe intyoza muri ruhago Gasana
content:
Nyuma y’umwaka umwe,  Gasana wari umenyerewe mu gukunda no gukundisha abandi ruhago ndetse no guharanira icyaewuteza imbere, apfuye yibutswe nabakunzi ba ruhago. Mu muhango wo kumwibuka habanje igitambo cya misa cyabereye kuri Paruwasi ya Christ Umwami i Nyanza nyuma y’aho hakurikira gushyira indabo kumva ye no kumwibuka. Nyuma y’iyi mihango abari bayitabiriye baturutse imihanda yose berekeje kuri Stade ya Nyanza ahabereye umupira wahuje ikipe Gasana yakinagamo yitwa Nyanza City Veterans hamwe n’ikipe y’abakinannye na Gasana kera akiri umusore mu cyitwaga Murama. ubu hari mu karere ka Nyanza umurenge wa Mukingo kagari ka Nkomero. Umukino ukaba wararangiye amakipe yombi anganya ibitego bibiri kuri bibiri.
nyuma yuyu mukino hakaba harabayehop ubusabane bwo gusangira indyo gakondo ikunda kugaragara muri kano karere nk’uko biri mu muco wa cyami ukiharangwa.  Amafoto y’uko uyu munsi wagenze. 









 Aba bose bakaba bariyemeje ko buri mwaka bazajya bagira igikorwa nk’iki mu rwego rwo kwibuka Gasana no kwegera umuryango yasize.

title: Rayon Sports yegukanye igikombe cya Shampiyona cya 2016-2017
content:
Bidasubirwaho, Rayon Sports yegukanye igikombe cya shampiyona ya 2016-2017 nyuma yo gutsinda Mukura VS ibitego 2-1 bya Moussa Camara mu mukino w’ikirarane wabereye kuri Stade ya Kigali i Nyamirambo kuri uyu wa Gatatu. 
Muri uyu mukino wari ishiraniro, warangiye ikipe ya Rayon Sports yakiniraga kuri Stade Regionale I Nyamirambo ibashije kuhikura ku bitego bibiri byatsinzwe na rutahizamu w’umunya-Mali, Moussa Camara.
 
Igitego cya Mukura VS cyatsinzwe na Yussuf Habimana ku munota wa 58 w’umukino.
 Rayon Sports itwaye igikombe ku manota 67 mu gihe APR iyikurikiye ifite amanota 54 habura imikino ine ngo shampiyona irangire.

title: Ku myaka 40, Francesco Totti yasezeye ku mupira w’amaguru
content:
Totti , umukinnyi w’ikipe ya As Roma yo mu Butaliyani kuva mu mwaka wa 1993 akaba n’umukinnyi w’ikipe y’igihugu, yavutse tariki ya 27 Nzeli 1976. Mu buzima bwe yakiniye ikipe ya AS Roma gusa anabereye kapiteni igihe kinini. Amaze gukinira ikipe ya AS ROMA imikino 616 ayitsindira ibitego 250 akaba ari umukinnyi wa gatatu mu bamaze gukina imikino myishi muri Serie A akaba uwa Kabiri mu bamaze gutsinda ibitego byinshi muri iyi shampiyona nyuma ya Silvio Piola ufite ibitego 274.

 Rutahizamu Francesco Totti yavuze ko uyu mwaka w’imikino nurangira azahagarika kongera gukina ruhago.
 Aganira na AFP, Ibiro Ntaramakuru by’Abafaransa, Spaniard Monchi umuyobozi wa siporo mu ikipe ya As Roma yagize ati “nasoza umupira agomba kumba hafi, azi byinshi kuri As Roma , Toti ni As Roma agomba gutuma numva icyo As Roma ari cyo”. Francesco Totti yatwaye igikombe cy’isi mu 2006 ari kumwe n’ikipe y’igihugu y’Ubutaliyani. Yatwaye igikombe cya shampiyona kimwe, Coppa Italia ebyiri hamwe na Supercoppa Italia ebyiri hose ari kumwe n’ikipe ya As Roma. Toti yahawe ibihembo byinshi birimo icya kapiteni muto mu mateka ya Serie A, yatwaye igihembo cy’umukinnyi mwiza w’umwaka w’umwenegihugu inshuro eshanu, atwara kandi icy’umukinnyi mwiza muri shampiyona inshuro ebyiri. Biteganyijwe ko asezera ku mugaragaro ku wa 28 Gicurasi 2017 ubwo As Roma izaba ikina na Genoa umukino wa nyuma wa shampiyona muri uyu mwaka w’imikino .

label: sport
title: Rayon Sports igiye gutangira imyitozo
content: Rayon Sports igiye gutangira imyitozo yitegura imikino ya shampiyona y’igihugu y’umupira w’amaguru y’icyiciro cya mbere ya 2016-2017. Umunyamabanga Mukuru wa Rayon Sports, Gakwaya Olivier atangaza ko  bazatangira imyitozo mbere y’itariki ya 15 Kanama 2016 bitegura imikino ya shampiyona. Gakwaya yagize ati ” abakinnyi bacu bari mu biruhuko turatekereza ko twazasubira mu myitozo hagati y’amatariki ya 10 na 15 Kanama 2016 mu rwego rwo kwitegura”. Umunyamabanga wa Rayon Sports avuga ko bataramenya aho bazajya bakorera imyitozo, ariko igihe nikigera bazabitangaza. Ntabwo ari shampiyona gusa iyo kipe igomba kwitegura, kuko igomba no kwitegura imikino Nyafurika y’amakipe yegukanye ibikombe iwayo (CAF Confederation Cup). title: Umukinnyi w’ikipe y’u Rwanda yahunze
content:
Mvuyekure Jean Pierre umukinnyi w’ikipe y’igihugu y’imikino ngororamubiri (athletisme) nyuma yo guhagarikwa imyaka ibiri kutongera gukinira u Rwanda kuva muri 2015, kuko yanze kujya gukorera imyitozo mu kigo (centre) cya Eridoreti muri Kenya, abantu ntibongere kumenya amakuru ye, ubu byamenyekanye ko yahungiye mu Bufaransa.
 Mvuyekure Jean Pierre mu bihe bitandukanye (Ifoto/Internet)  Amakuru ikinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe gikesha iyi nkuru ku nkuru ikura kurubuga rwa internet rwa www.courrier-picard.fr avuga ko uyu mukinnyi w’Umunyarwanda ari mu Bufaransa aho afite ibyangombwa by’uko ari impunzi. Inkuru igaragara ku rubuga rwa www.courrier-picard.fr ifite umutwe w’amagambo ugira uti “ATHLETISME – Il faut aider le Rwandais Jean Pierre Mvuyekure” bishatse kuvuga ngo Imikino Ngororamubiri-  Umunyarwanda Mvuyekuru Jean Pierre akeneye ubufasha”. Iki kinyamakuru kivuga ko Mvuyekure mu Gushyingo 2015 yageze mu Bufaransa avuye mu Butaliyani ajya kureba umutoza wo mu ikipe ya “Amiens Université Club” witwa Christophe Guibon. Umutoza Christophe Guibon yemeza ko Mvuyekure Jean Pierre yamusanze mu Bufaransa mu kigo cya AUC afite icyangombwa kigaragaza ko ari impunzi. Nubwo ngo uyu mukinnyi yabaye impunzi nyuma yo gufatirwa ibihano n’Ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri mu Rwanda (FRA), ariko mu Bufaransa yatangiye kwitabira amarushanwa ahabera.  Src:Izuba

title: José Mourinho ashobora gusubira muri Real Madrid
content:
Uwahoze atoza ikipe ya Real Madrid, José Mourinho ubu utamerewe neza muri Chelsea kuko uyu mwaka itarimo kwitwara neza, biravugwa ko ashobora gusubira muri iyi kipe nyuma y’aho umutoza Benitez ashobora kwirukanwa kubera kutitwara neza. José Mário dos Santos Mourinho Félix yabaye muri iyi kipe 2010 kugeza 2013 aho yasimbuwe na Carlo Ancelotti nawe wahise asimbura na Rafael Benitez ushobora kwirukanwa vuba aha.
 Jose Mourinho ushobora gusubira muri Real Madrid nk’umutoza  José Mourinho amakuru dukesha “TopMercato” ni uko iyi shampiyona nirangira azahita ava muri iyi kipe ya Chelsea. Ubwo yatozaga Real Madrid yigeze kugirana ikibazo n’abakinnyi, benshi bakaba bibaza niba kumusubiza muri iyi kipe bitaba ari ukuzambya ibintu kuko hari abandi batoza banyuza muri iyi kipe bakagira ibigwi nka Carlo Ancelotti nawe udafite ikipe ubu.

title: Umuyobozi wa FERWAHAND azajya mu Burusiya
content:
Utabarutse Théogène azitabira inteko rusange izabera ahitwa Soshi mu Burusiya kuva kuwa 5 kugeza 11 Ugushyingo 2015. Utarabarutse, Umuyobozi w’Ishyirahamwe ry’Umukino wa Handball mu Rwanda (FERWAHAND) yabwiye ikinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe dukesha iyi nkuru ko muri iyo Nteko Rusange isanzwe, izahuza abayobozi bose bo hirya no hino ku isi bayobora amashyirahamwe  y’umukino wa Handball aho bazareberahamwe amarushanwa mpuzamahanga azaba mu myaka ibiri iri imbere. Ikindi Umuyobozi wa FERWAHAND yavuze ni uko akenshi hari amarushanwa u Rwanda rutajya rwitabira bitewe n’uko mu Rwanda ingengo y’imari itangirana na Nyakanga mu gihe mu bategura imikino mpuzamahanga ya Handball ingengo y’abo y’imari ijyana na Mutarama buri mwaka. Utabarutse avuga ko biri mu byo bagiye kureba kugira ngo hatazajya hagira amarushanwa u Rwanda rutitabira bitewe no kudahuza ku ngengabihe y’itangira ry’ingengo y’imari ya buri mwaka.

 Utabarutse   
Ikinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe cyabajije Utabarutse niba muri iyo nama ashobora no kuboneraho umwanya wo gushaka abafatanyabikorwa asubiza ati“mu nteko rusange si ho ni aho kuvugira ibyifuzo byawe ahubwo higwa ku cyateza imbere Handball nko guhugura abasifuzi, abatoza n’ibindi”. Ubu hakaba hari na gahunda yo guteza imbere Handball muri aka Karere k’Ibiyaga Bigali (CPEGL) bikaba ari bimwe mu bizagerwaho nyuma y’iyo nteko rusange y’abayobozi b’amashyirahamwe y’umukino wa Handball izabera mu Burusiya mu Gushyingo 2015.  Kubaho Aime / Indatwa.net

title: Ikipe y’u Rwanda y’abagore izaserukira Afurika muri Brazil
content:
Ikipe y’u Rwanda y’abagore yabonye itike yo kuzitabira imikino Paralempike izabera muri Brazil muri 2016 nyuma yo kwegukana umwanya wa mbere mu mikino y’Afurika ya Sitting Volleyball. 
Ikipe y’u Rwanda y’abagore yatsinze Misiri ku maseti 3-2 ku mukino wa nyuma mu marushanwa yiswe "2015 Para Volleyball Africa Sitting Volleyball Championships” yasojwe kuri uyu wa kabiri tariki ya 28 Nyakanga 2015. Ikipe ya Misiri yatsinze iseti ya mbere ku manota 26-24,u Rwanda rutsinda iseti ya kabiri ku manota 25-17,Misiri itsinda iseti ya gatatu ku manota 25-23,u Rwanda rutsinda iseti ya kane ku manota 26-24 n’iya gatanu ari nayo ya nyuma ku manota 15-13. Umutoza w’ikipe y’igihugu Gakwaya Eric avuga ko mu mateka ibyo bari barifuje babigezeho nubwo bitari byoroshye kuko iri rushanwa ryari rikomeye cyane. Yagize ati " ikipe ya Misiri yari inshuro ya kabiri duhura muri iri rushanwa ariko umukino ubanza twabatsinze bitworoheye, ariko uyu munsi wo yari ikomeye cyane kuko yazanye imbaraga zidasanzwe”. Mukobwankabo Liliane kapiteni w’ikipe y’igihugu ya Sitting Volleyball mu bagore avuga ko kuba babonye intsinzi ku mukino wa nyuma ari intambwe ishimishije bateye kandi bagiye no gukomeza kwitegura kugira ngo bazabashe kwitabira imikino Paraleympike izabera i Rio muri Brazil umwaka utaha. Mu bagabo Ikipe ya Misiri niyo yabonye itike nyuma yo gutsinda ikipe y’u Rwanda ku maseti 3-0. Kalisa Eduard Umunyamabanga Uhoraho wa Minisiteri ya Siporo n’Umuco yabwiye abanyamakuru ko kuba amakipe y’u Rwanda akomeye muri Sitting Volleyball bigaragaza ko na shampiyona ikomeye. Ku bijyanye n’ishimwe ry’abakinnyi Kalisa yavuze ko bazicara bakabyigaho. Nzeyimana Célestin Umuyobozi wa Komite y’Igihugu y’Imikino y’abafite ubumuga (NPC Rwanda) yabwiye ikinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe ko kwakira iyi mikino y’Afurika ya Sitting Volleyball bisigiye igihugu kumenya gutegura, abatekinisiye bariyongereye kuko babaye amahugurwa y’abasifuzi ku buryo abitwaye neza bazajya basifura imikino mpuzamahanga. Nzeyimana avuga ko ikindi gikomeye ari ukubona itike yo kuzitabira imikino Paralempike izabera i Rio muri Brazil umwaka utaha. Ibihugu bitandatu nibyo byitabiriye aya marushanwa y’Afurika yabereye mu Rwanda, harimo: Misiri, Kenya, u Burundi, Congo Kinshasa, Algeria n’u Rwanda rwakiriye amarushanwa.  Indatwa.net

label: sport
title: Agaciro Cup:Rayon isezerewe na Sunrise kuri Penaliti
content:
23 Kamena 2015- Kuri Stade Amahora ikipe ya Sunrise FC yo mu Buganza  yasezere ikipe ya Rayon sport FC y’i Nyanza nyuma yo kuyitsinda Penaliti 2-0 ihita inakatisha itike yo kuzakina umukino wa nyuma n’ikipe ya Police FC mu irushanwa ry’Agaciro Development Found. 
 Ikipe ya Rayon sport FC yabanje mu Kibuga  Ni umukino muri rusange ikipe ya Sunrise nubwo itahabwaga amahirwe mbere yawo ariko  ibifashijwemo na Segawa Mike ukina hagati asatira ,yatangiye irusha bikomeye ikipe ya Rayon sport FC ari nako yotsa igitutu abinyuma b’iyi ikipe yambara ubururu n’umweru.Ariko mu minota igana kuyanyuma y’umukino nibwo Rayon sport FC yabaye  nk’iyinjira mu mukino nayo itangira guhungabanya abanyima b’ikipe ya Sunrise ariko biranga biba ibyubusa. Iminota 90 isanzwe  y’umukino yaje kurangira  amakipe yombi anganya ubusa ku busa, hitabazwa penaliti, Sunrise  FC iza kubasha ku injiza  ebyiri muri enye yateye mu gihe ikipe ya Rayon sport FC yateye enye ariko  ntibashe kugira nimwe yerekeza mu nshundura. 
 Ikipe ya Sunrise FC yabanje mu kibuga  Mutuyimana Moussa bita Kasereka Fabrice, wahoze mu  ikipe ya Police FC  nkumwe mubari bitezwe bikomeye n’abakunzi b’ikipe ya Rayon sport FC,bashije kubanza  mu kibuga kuri uyu mukino we wa mbere muri Rayon Sports FC  nyuma yo kuyerekezamo mu cyumweru gishize. Sunrise FC  izahura ku mukino wa nyuma na Police FC yaraye isezereye Musanze FC iyitsinze ibitego 2-1. Biteganijwe ko umukino wa nyuma   uzakinwa ku cyumweru tariki 30/08/2015.  Kubaho Aimee / Indatwa.net

label: sport
title: Nyuma yo kwegura kwa Ntampaka Rayon Sports iyobowe na Gacinya Denis
content:
Nyuma yo kwegura kwa Ntampaka Theogene, Ikipe ya Rayon Sports kuri iki cyumweru mu nama rusange yashyizeho ubuyobozi bushya bukuriwe na Perezida mushya Gacinya Denis. Olivier Gakwaya wari warasezeye yongeye kugaruka aba umunyamabanga w’iyi kipe y’i Nyanza. 
 Komite nshya yatowe iyobowe na Denis Gacinya wa kabiri imbere uvuye ibumoso
  Azaba yungirijwe na Visi Perezida wa mbere Martin Rutagambwa, Visi Perezida wa kabiri Fredy Muhirwa naho Umunyamabanga Mukuru w’ikipe ni Olivier Gakwaya. Umubitsi w’ikipe ni Rukundo Patrick, mu gihe Komisiyo ya Tekiniki ikuriwe na Shafi Mudaheranwa naho Komisiyo yo kumenyekanisha ibikorwa (Marketing) iyobowe na Ndayisenga Davis. Komisiyo y’Ubuyobozi n’Imari (Administration & Finance) iyobowe na Francois Harerimana, Komisiyo y’itangazamakuru ikuriwe na Valentin Mugabo na Jean Lambert Gatare. Ibi byabereye Mu nama y’inteko rusange ya Rayon Sports ibera muri Alpha Palace Hotel, uwari umuyobozi wa Rayon Sports Ntampaka Theogene yatangaje kwegura kwe ku buyobozi bw’ikipe nyuma yaho byari bimaze iminsi bisabwa n’abakunzi benshi b’iyi kipe. Nyuma yo gutorwa Denis Gacinya Perezida mushya wa Rayon yavuze ko Rayon Sports ayizi cyane kuko ayimazemo igihe kinini, yavuze ko azi neza ko ibamo guhangana n’ibibazo bikomeye ariko ko nibemera gufatanya nawe aribwo nawe azagera ku  murasaruro. Mu ntego yihaye harimo kwegukana igikombe cya shampionat  Indatwa.net

Nyuma yo gutorwa Denis Gacinya Perezida mushya wa Rayon yavuze ko Rayon Sports ayizi cyane kuko ayimazemo igihe kinini, yavuze ko azi neza ko ibamo guhangana n’ibibazo bikomeye ariko ko nibemera gufatanya nawe aribwo nawe azagera ku  murasaruro. Mu ntego yihaye harimo kwegukana igikombe cya shampionat  Indatwa.net

label: sport
title: Mackenzi wakiniye Rayon Sports yatowe nk’umukinnyi mwiza muri Kenya
content:
Uwahoze ari myugariro wa Rayon Sports, Nizigiyimana Kharim “Mackenzi” ukinira Gor Mahia yatowe nk’umukinnyi mwiza wa Kamena muri shampiyona ya Kenya mbere yo kwerekeza muri CECAFA Kagame cup muri Tanzania. Mackenzi wavuye mu Rwanda akinira Rayon Sports muri Mutarama 2015 yari ku rutonde rwakozwe n’abanyamakuru b’imikino bahatanira iki gihembo ariko atorwa n’akanama k’abantu barindwi. 

Uyu Murundi wakinnye muri APR FC na Kiyovu Sports yashimwe kubera uruhare rwe mu kugarira nk’intwaro ya Gor Mahia iyoboye shampiyona itaratsindwa mu mikino 18. Nizigiyimana Kharim yatowe n’abanyamakuru b’imikino muri Kenya nk’umukinnyi mwiza muri Kamena 

Mackenzi yavuuye muri Rayon Sports muri Mutarama 2015, Abahembye bongeyeho n’umubare w’imipira Nizigiyimana yahaye bagenzi be ikavamo ibitego. Yahembwe ibihumbi bisaga 350 FRW na televiziyo (42 inch Smart TV). Muri Gor Mahia, Mackenzi akinana na Sibomana Abuba na Kagere Meddie babanye no muri Rayon Sports. Abandi bari bafite ibi bihembo ni Ali Hassan Abondo wa Gor Mahia, John Makwatta wa Ulinzi na Gabriel Andika wa West Stima. 

Kuri uyu wa Kane nibwo Gor Mahia yahagurutse muri Kenya yerekeza muri Tanzania aho kuwa Gatandatu bazakina na Yanga Africans mu mukino w’itsinda A rya CECAFA Kagame cup. Mu 2014, Gor Mahia yasezerewe mu matsinda mu mikino yabereye mu Rwanda, baheruka gutwara iki gikombe gihuza amakipe yo muri Afurika yo hagati n’Iburasirazuba mu 1985.

label: sport
title: “Rayon ntiyatsinzwe yaribwe” Umutoza Baptiste KAYIRANGA
content:
Umutoza w’ikipe ya Rayon Sports FC nyuma yo gutakaza igikombe cy’Amahoro cya 2015 itsinzwe n’ikipe ya Police FC, aratangaza ko ashimira abakinnyi be uko bakinnye, ariko avuga ko adatinya kuvuga ko abasifuzi bamubijije intsinzi Imana yari yamushyize mu biganza, 

Umutoza Kayiranga Baptiste wakomeje kugaragaza uburakari mu mukino hagati no kutishimira ibyemezo by’umusifuzi Kagabo Issa n’abamufashaga bo ku mpande, yavuze amagambo aremereye aca amarenga ko igikombe Police FC igitwaye mu buryo budafututse. Kayiranga yagize ati “ ndashimira Imana uko twakinnye n’uko abakinnyi banjye babashije gukina, ndashimira Imana ko nayimenye ariko tuzanashimira Imana n’abatuyobora mu kibuga (abasifuzi) nibamenya Imana, bakareka ugomba gutsinda agatsinda. Kayiranga avuga ko adatinya kuvuga ko yibwe kandi ko n’abanyamakuru bazareba za televiziyo bakareba basanga yarabeshye akazabisabira Imana n’abananyarwanda imbabazi. Kayiranga usibye kuvuga amahirwe yabujijwe n’umusifuzi Kagabo Isaa anavuga ko n’igitego cyagiye mu izamu rya Police FC mu gice cya mbere kikangwa nacyo cyari cyo kuri we. Mu gusoza uyu mutoza yashimiye abakinnyi be uko bitwaye, ndetse asaba abakunzi ba Rayon Sports n’ubuyobozi kwihanganira ibyabaye bakaba babuze igikombe ku munota wa nyuma. Usibye umutoza Kayiranga wagaragazaga kutishimira ibyemezo by’umusifuzi Kagabo Issa kuva umukino ugitangira, abafana b’iyi kipe banakomeje kugaragaza mu majwi ko basakuza kutemeranya n’ibyemezo by’abasifuzi.

label: sport
title: Kigali Peace Marathon 2015: Hamaze kwiyandikisha abasaga 600
content:
Isiganwa ngarukamwaka risanzwe ribera mu Rwanda ryo gusiganwa ku magaru ryitiriwe Marato y’Amahoro  “Kigali Peace Marathon” rigiye kuba ku nshuro ya 11, Perezida w’agateganyo w’ ishyirahamwe ry’imikino ngororamubiri “FRA”, Kajuga Thomas  akaba atangaza ko imyiteguro irimo kugenda neza kandi biteguye ko n’irushanwa rizagenda neza. 

 Umunyakenya Biwot Kipkorir ubwo yegukanaga Marato y’Amahoro umwaka ushize wa 2014  Kajuga akaba avuga ko  bakomeje kwakira abantu biyandikisha  kuzitabira iyi Marato iteganyijwe kuba tariki 24 Gicurasi 2015. Umunyamabanga mukuru wa FRA, Rukundo Johnson   atangaza ko bamaze kwandika abantu bagera kuri 600  ariko avuga ko babimenyereye ko abantu baza ku munota wa nyuma. Muri aba 600 akaba atavuze abiyandikishije ku mufatanyabikorwa wabo MTN kuko babaha imibare mu mpera z’icyumweru.

Ibyiciro by’isiganwa Iyi Marato mpuzamahanga y’Amahoro irimo ibyiciro bitatu. Rukundo Johnson  yatangarije Imvaho Nshya ko hari Marato yuzuye (km 42) n’igice cya Marato (21) n’abiruka bishimisha. Abasiganwa Marato bazava Sitade Amahoro-KIE-Nyarutarama-Hotel Umubano-Sitade bazenguruke indi inshuro mu gihe abaziruka igice cya Marato bagenda iyo ntera inshuro imwe. Abiruka byo kwishimisha bazava Sitade Amahoro – KIE bakate bagaruke (km 5). Ibihembo biteye bite ? Nk’uko bisanzwe bigenda, muri Mataro hahembwa 3 ba mbere mu bahungu n’abakobwa ndetse no mu gice cya Marato “Half Marathon”. Uyu mwaka uwa mbere mu bahungu n’abakobwa muri Marato azahembwa Miliyoni  imwe n’ibihumbi 600 naho mu gice cya Marato aba mbere bazahembwa Miliyoni imwe. Abanyarwanda bazabasha kuza mu 10 ba mbere bazagenerwa ibihembo. Ibi bihembo byose bikaba bizatwara hafi Miliyoni 21. Umunyamabanga mukuru wa FRA, Rukundo Johnson   atangaza ko bateguye ingengo y’imari  ya miliyoni 120, ubu bakaba bamaze kubona milinoni 60. Gusa avuga ko hari abafatanyabikorwa babakorera bimwe bagakwiye gukora ariko bikabarirwa amafaranga kuko ayo bahabwa mu ntoki ari make. Bamwe muri abafatanyabikorwa bazagaragara muri Marato yitriwe Amahoro  ni MINISPOC, MTN, World Vision, RDB, Milles Collines Hotel, IAAF. Skol, Right to play, Drop Water,Hello Foods, Akagera Aviation n’ibitaro byaGisirika i Kanombe. Twabibutsa ko ubushize, mu bahungu Marato yegukanwe na Biwot Kipkorir wo muri  na Sally Jemutai Kimaiyo mu bakobwa bose bo muri Kenya. Igice cya Marato  mu bahungu cyegukanwe na Limo Kipkemboi  wo muri Kenya  na Natalie Elisante mu bakobwa  wo muri Tanzania.

label: sport
title: Rayon Sports VC yongeye kwegukana igikombe cyo kwibuka
content:
Rayon Sports Volleyball Club ku nshuro ya yakabiri yegukanye igikombe cyo kwibuka nyuma yo gutsinda APR VC amaseti 3-2 ku mukino wa nyuma. Muri 2014, Rayon Sports Volleyball Club yari yegukanye iri rushanwa ryo kwibuka abakinnyi n’abakunzi b’uyu mukino bishwe muri Jenoside yakorewe Abatutsi itsinze APR VC amaseti 3-0. Uko amaseti yakurikiranye. APR VC yatsinze iseti ya mbere ku manota 25-18, Rayon Sports itsinda iya kabiri ku manota 25-18, APR itsinda iya gatatu ku manota 25-16, Rayon Sports itsinda iya kane ku manota 25-16, niya gatanu ari nayo ya nyuma ku munota 15-12. Umutoza wa Rayon Sports VC Nyirimana Fidèle avuga ko bishimiye iyi ntsinzi kuko iyi ari imwe mu ntego bari barahize kugeraho muri uyu mwaka. Yagize ati "uyu mwaka tuwutangira hari gahunda nyinshi twateguye ndetse tuniha intego zo kuba twagira ibikombe twegukana ni kimwe muri ibi rero tubashije kugeraho, ariko haracyari urugendo rukomeye cyane kuko intumbero yacu ahanini ni ku gikombe cya shampiyona”. Avuga ko kuba begukanye iri rushanwa bizabafasha kuguma ku muvuduko nkuwo bariho bakina iri rushanwa bikazabafasha muri shampiyona y’icyiciro cya mbere. Sammy Mulinge umutoza wa APR VC avuga ko bagerageje gukina uko bashoboye ariko baza kubura amahirwe kuko bari babanje gutsinda iseti ya mbere umukino ugitangira ndetse baza no kubona iya kabiri Rayon Sports igifite imwe. Avuga ko kuba bahombye iri rushanwa bitavuze ko icyizere cyose cyatakara kuko hari na shampiyona kandi bari mu makipe agifite amahirwe yo ku cyegukana. Mu bagore, Rwanda Revenue Authority ni yo yegukanye irushanwa ryo kwibuka nyuma yo gutsinda ikipe yo muri Kenya yitwa Nairobi water amaseti 3-0. 

 Ikipe ya Rayon Sports VC yishimira insinzi (ifoto/Sikubwabo D) 


 Nkurunziza Gustave umuyobozi wa FRVB na Robert Bayigamba umuyobozi wa Komite Olempike bashyikiriza Kapiteni wa Rayon Sports igikombe (Ifoto/Sikubwabo D)

title: Mukura igiye kugaruka ku kibuga cyayo
content:
ikibugak’ikipe ya Mukura V.S kigiye kuzura Nkuko bigaragara iyo usuye kiriya kibuga usanga kiri kubakwa ariko kiri mu nzira yo kurangira kuko itapi yamaze kugezwamo ndetse n’imirongo y’amabara y’umweru ikaba nayo irimo gushyirwamo kuburyo kibura igihe gito ngo cyuzure. Mbere gato ariko umuyobozi wa karere ka Huye akaba yari yatangaje ko nyuma y’amezi 3 kizaba cyuzuye. Ubwo Minisitiri wa Siporo n’Umuco Protais Mitari, yatangizaga ku mugaraharo imirimo yo kuvugurura iyi sitade , akaba yaratangaje ko iyi sitade izaba yujuje ibyangombwa byose bisabwa n’amategeko mpuzamahanga hanyuma ngo iyi sitade izaba ingana n’izindi sitade ziherutse kuvugururwa harimo sitade ya Nyamirambo n’iya Rubavu.Izaba kandi ifite ubushobozi bwo kwakira umubare w’abantu uri hagati y’ibihumbi icumi na cumi na bitanu. Mukura imaze amezi arenga atandatu idakinira kuri sitade ya Huye izwi nk’Imbehe Ya Mukura, ubu ikaba iri ku mwanya wa kabiri wa shampiyona bya gateganyo Sitio NDOLI

title: Leta yifuje ko abanyamigabane basanzwe aribo bagira uruhare mu kongera imari shingiro ya Banki ya Kigali
content:
Leta yanyuzwe n’iterambere rya Banki ya Kigali isaba ko kongera imari shingiro y’iyi banki ya mbere mu Rwanda, bigirwamo uruhare n’abandi banyamigabane bayo.

 Banki ya Kigali ni yo ikomeye ku isoko ry’imari mu Rwanda  Inteko rusange y’abanyamigabane ba BK Group PLC muri Gicurasi yemeje ko iki kigo kijya ku isoko ry’imari n’imigabane rya Nairobi, hagamijwe kongera imari shingiro hagati ya miliyoni 60 na 70 z’amadorali ya Amerika. Ni amafaranga iki kigo kivuga ko igice kinini kizakoreshwa mu ishoramari mu ikoranabuhanga.

 Umuyobozi Mukuru wa BK Group Plc, Dr Diane Karusisi yavuze ko iki kigo cyiteze kubona abashoramari benshi ku isoko ry’imari n’imigabane muri Kenya  Umuyobozi Mukuru wa BK Group Plc, kuri uyu wa Gatatu yatangaje ko mbere yo kugurisha imigabane, basabye abasanzwe bayifitemo kongera amafaranga, ariko leta igaragaza ko abashoramari basanzwe aribo bahabwa ayo mahirwe. Ati “Iyo bareba ibikorwa byihutirwa nka Guverinoma basanga BK itakiri ikibazo, urwego rw’amabanki ntabwo rukiri ikibazo, bashobora gushyira amafaranga mu bindi. Leta y’u Rwanda yaratubwiye ngo ‘twebwe ntabwo tuzazamo kuko tubona ko mumaze kugera ahantu hashimishije, amafaranga mwayakura ahandi twe tugakora ishoramari mu zindi nzego.”
 
 Abakozi ba BK n’abayobozi bakuru bayo mu muhango werekaniwemo abayobozi bashya   “Niyo mpamvu iyo migabane tuzayijyana i Nairobi kugira ngo abandi bashoramari bashobore gushyiramo amafaranga.” Kutitabira iki gikorwa bishobora gutuma imigabane leta yari ifite muri BK igabanyuka. Mu 2011 nibwo Banki ya Kigali yagiye ku isoko ry’imari n’imigabane ry’u Rwanda, ishaka kongera imari shingiro kuri miliyoni 60$. Dr Karusisi yavuze ko ayo mafaranga yakoreshejwe neza banki ikunguka ndetse igatanga inyungu ku banyamigabane, binatuma BK imenyekana mu gihugu hose ndetse igaba amashami hirya no hino. title: Abacuruza imyenda ikorerwa mu Rwanda barishimira ko imisoro ya caguwa yongerewe
content:
Bamwe mu bacuruzi n’abakora imyenda ikorerwa mu Rwanda baravuga ko kuzamura imisoro ku myenda n’inkweto byambawe bizwi nka caguwa, byatumye umubare w’abakiriya wiyongera. 

Imyambaro ikorerwa mu Rwanda irakomeye kandi ni myiza kurusha imwe itumizwa hanze Mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari wa 2016/2017 ni bwo leta y’u Rwanda yazamuye imisoro ku nkweto n’imyenda byambawe byinjiza mu Rwanda bizwi nka caguwa aho yikubye inshuro 25, ni nako bizaguma mu mwaka wa 2017/2018. Ibi byakozwe mu rwego rwo kugabanya imyenda ya caguwa ikundwa na benshi, hagatezwa imbere inganda zikora imyenda zo mu gihugu. Ibi kandi u Rwanda rubihuriyeho n’ibindi bihugu bigize Umuryango w’Afurika y’Uburasirazuba aho muri 2019 nta mwenda wambawe uzaba wemerewe kwinjira muri ibi bihugu. Bamwe mu bakora imyenda n’inkweto, bakanabicuruza batangaza ko aho imisoro yongerewe ku myenda n’inkweto bya caguwa, ngo byatumye abakiliya babagana biyongera. Uwitwa Eric Rugira akora inkweto zizwi nka Masayi avuga ko kuba imisoro yarongerewe ku nkweto za caguwa byatumye abakiriya be biyongera. Yagize ati “icyo navuga kuri Made in Rwanda, icyambere baragikoze, kiriya gikorwa bakoze cyo kugabanya caguwa, byatumye noneho ubu umuntu akora ikintu akabona abakiriya. Nk’ubu urabona abakiriya bari kugura ariko iyo haba hakiriho za caguwa niho aba bigiriye. Uwineza Ange nawe akora imyenda y’ubwoko bitandukanye yifashishije ibitenge, avuga ko gahunda yo guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda, hongerwa imisoro ku myenda ya caguwa, byatumye abanyarwanda batinyuka kwambara imyenda ikoze mu bitenge mu gihe bumvaga ko ihenze yambarwa n’abanyamahanga gusa. Yagize ati “ icyo twishimira ni uko ubona abanyarwanda nabo bamaze gusobanuka, ntibagitinya kwambara ishati ikoze mu gitenge, kuko mbere wasangaga bavuga ko imyenda nk’iyi igurwa n’abazungu gusa.” Minisitiri w’Ubucuruzi, Inganda n’Ibikorwa by’Umuryango w’Afurika y’Uburasirazuba mu gihe ubukangurambaga bwo guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda bumaze, abakora imyenda n’inkweto bateye intambwe ishimishije gusa ngo hari inzira ndende kugira ngo u Rwanda rugere aho rwifuza. Yagize ati “intambwe imaze guterwa irashimishije, urebye inganda nto n’iziciriritse zikora imyenda n’inkweto zimaze gushingwa . ibintu byose bikiri bishya ntago abantu babyumva kimwe, politiki leta yashyizeho ugasanga ntabwo zibageraho neza kuko batazi uburyo bashobora kwishyira hamwe kugira ngo bashobore kubona ibyiza bizituruka ho. Aha niho hakiri imbogamizi kugira ngo ibintu bijye ku murongo neza.” Ishami rishinzwe Ubucuruzi rya Leta Zunze Ubumwe z’Amerika riherutse gutangaza ko rishobora gufatira ibihano mu by’ubucuruzi Leta y’u Rwanda hamwe n’ibindi bihugu by’Afurika y’Uburasirazuba kuko byazamuye imisoro ku myenda yacuguwa, bikagira ingaruka ku bacuruzi bo muri Amerika,ariko u Rwanda rwo ruvuga ko rudateze kwisubiraho n’ubwo bihano bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bukungu bw’u Rwanda. Gahunda yo guteza imbere ibikorerwa mu Rwanda yitezweho gufasha u Rwanda kugabanya umubare w’abashomeri, kongera umusaruro w’u Rwanda biturutse mu maboko y’abanyarwanda, ari nako u Rwanda rufata ibindi bihugu byari byararusize mu iterambere. Kugeza ubu mu Rwanda hari inganda nini zikora imyenda nka Utexurwa, C&H Garments n’izindi nganda nto zikorera mu bice nitandukanye by’igihugu. Hari kandi n’uruganda rwa Kigali Leather Ltd rutunganya impu rukaba rwaranatangiye gukora inkweto z’ubwoko butandukanye. MUVUNYI ARSENE / Imvaho

label: economy
title: Muhanga: Agakiriro ka Miliyoni 250 Frw ngo uyu mwaka urarangira gakorerwamo
content:
Mu gikorwa cyo gusura ibikorwa remezo biri mu mugi wa Muhanga, ku gicamunsi cyo kuri uyu wa Kabiri, umuyobozi w’aka karere, Uwamariya Béatrice yavuze ko  imirimo yo kubaka ahakorerwa ibikorwa by’ubukorikori hazwi nk’Agakiriro izarangira mu mpera z’uyu mwaka wa 2016 ku buryo uyu mwaka uzarangira hatangiye gukorerwa. Aka gakiriro ngo kazuzura gatwaye Miliyoni 250 Frw. Ni igikorwa cyateguwe na komite nyobozi y’Akarere ka Muhanga, kigamije kureba aho ibikorwa remezo birimo Agakiriro, umuhanda werekeza kuri sitade ya Muhanga, n’isoko rya kijyambere bigeze byubakwa. Agakiriro gategerejweho umusaruro muri ibi bikorwa biri kubakwa, byari byatangajwe ko imirimo yako yagombaga kurangira mu ntangiro z’uyu mwaka ubura ukwezi kumwe ngo urangire. Umuyobozi w’Akarere ka Muhanga, Uwamariya Béatrice wari uyoboye iri tsinda ryasuye ibi bikorwa, avuga ko imirimo yo kubaka aka gakiriro yadindijwe n’umuyoboro w’amazi n’intsinga z’umuriro w’amashanyarazi byatinze kwegerezwa ahari kubakwa iki gikorwa kuko hitaruye umugi.. Umuyoboz w’Akarere, Uwamariya yizeza abategerezanyije amatsiko aka gakiriro ko bashonje bahishiwe kuko mu mpera z’Ukuboza k’uyu mwaka imirimo yose izaba yararangiye. Ati « Nta bikorwa bikomeye bisigaye, harabura gusa amazi kandi ndizera ko mu mpera z’uyu mwaka azaba yahageze.» Avuga ko imirimo yo kubaka aka gakiriro nirangira, abakorera ubukorikori mu mugi wa Muhanga bazahimurirwa kuko uko basanzwe bakora biteza akajagari kandi muri aka gakiriro ari ahantu hisanzuye. Umuyobozi   w’akarere ka Muhanga, avuga ko mu rwego rwo koroshya urujya n’uruza kuri aka gakiriro, mu ngengo y’imari y’Akarere ya 2016-2017, hateganyijwemo amafaranga yo kubaka umuhanda wa kaburimbo uherekeza. Aka gakiriro kitezweho guhindura ubuzima bw’abakora ubukorikori mu mugi wa Muhanga, kazuzura gatwaye Miliyoni 250 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda.
Isoko rya Kijyambere na ryo riri kubakwa, rizuzura ritwaye Miliyari Eshanu, bikaba biteganyijwe ko rizubakwa mu gihe cy’imyaka ibiri.  MUKANKUSI Liberata / PRMCO

title: Umuyobozi wa Cogebanque yirukanywe mu Rwanda
content:
Kuwa gatanu w’icyumweru gishize nibwo uyu muyobozi Mostafa Ouezekhti yahawe kutarenza kuwa mbere(uyu munsi) atarava mu Rwanda nk’uko ibiro bishinzwe abinjira n’abasohoka byabyemereye ikinyamakuru NewTimes. 
 Mostafa Ouezekhti w’imyaka 56 ni umunyamabanki wigeze kuba depite muri Maroc Icyo yirukaniwe shishi itabona kugeza ubu ntabwo cyatangajwe neza, gusa amakuru aravuga ko uyu munya Maroc avugwaho gukoresha nabi ububasha bwe, ihererekanya ry’amafaranga rikemangwa n’ibindi. Kuwa gatanu ngo nibwo yahawe urwandiko rumubwira ko atagomba kurenza tariki 14 Nzeri 2015 atarava mu Rwanda nk’uko byemezwa na Ange Sebutege umuvugizi w’urwego rw’abinjira n’abasohoka. Ati “Byagaragaye ko uwo mugabo yanyuranyije n’ibyo yemererwa gukora n’uruhusa rumwemerera gukorera mu Rwanda, niyo mpamvu yahawe kutarenza kuwa mbere akiri mu gihugu.” Hari amakuru yemeza ko uyu mugabo kuri uyu wa mbere ari bujye kuganira n’ibiro by’abinjira n’abasohoka kuri iki cyemezo yafatiwe, ndetse we ngo yemeza ko ari bumenye neza ko yirukanywe amaze kubibwirwa imbonankubone kuri uyu wa mbere. Mostafa Ouezekhti yatangiye kuyobora Cogebanque mu 2014, uruhusa rwe rwo gutura no gukorera mu Rwanda rwari kurangira mu 2016. Maurice Toroitich ukuriye urugaga rw’abanyamabanki mu Rwanda yabwiye NewTimes ko uru rwego rurebana gusa n’ibikora ku mabanki muri rusange rutareba iby’imyitwarire y’umuntu ku giti cye. Toroitich avuga ko hari amabwiriza ngenderwaho ya Banki nkuru y’igihugu areba buri muyobozi mu rwego rw’amabanki, yaba umunyagihugu cyangwa umunyamahanga. Ati “buri wese ategetswe kuyubahiriza ndetse n’andi mabwiriza n’amategeko y’uru rwego n’igihugu muri rusange.” Cogebanque niyo banki yonyine mu gihugu ifitwe 100% n’abanyamigabane b’abanyarwanda gusa.  SRC:Umuseke

label: economy
title: Dr. Kaberuka yibiye Abayapani ibanga  ry’ubukungu bavana muri Afurika
content:
Perezida ucyuye igihe wa Banki Nyafurika Itsura Amajyambere, AfDB, Donald Kaberuka yasabye abashoramari bo mu Buyapani gutangira kugana umugabane wa Afurika, abumvisha ko bazahavana ubukungu kandi n’Abanyafurika bakabyungukiramo. Mu ijambo yavuze asoza urugendo rw’iminsi ibiri rwo gusezera k’u Buyapani, Kaberuka yakanguriye abayobozi b’u Buyapani n’abakuru b’ibihugu bya Afurika korohereza abashoramari gutangira ubucuruzi cyane cyane mu rwego rw’ingufu nk’uko Africa Renewal ibitangaza. Yishimiye ko hagiye kubaho Inama mpuzamahanga ya Tokyo ku Iterambere rya Afurika (TIGAD) muri 2016, ndetse asaba ko gushyira mu bikorwa imyanzuro yavuye mu nama iherutse y’u Buyapani n’ibihugu bya Afurika yabereye I Yokohama muri 2013 birushaho kwihutishwa. Ibihugu byo muri Aziya, nk’u Bushinwa, u Buhinde, Koreya y’Epfo bikomeje guhangana n’u Buyapani ku isoko ry’umugabane wa Afurika. 
 Dr. Kaberuka ahura na Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Buyapani Shinzo Abe 
Binyuze mu Ishami ryabwo ry’Ubufatanye Mpuzamahanga, JICA, u Buyapani bwagiye butera inkunga ibihugu bya Afurika birimo n’u Rwanda. Kaberuka yahuye na Minisitiri w’Intebe w’u Buyapani, Shinzo Abe, umwungirije akaba na Minisitiri w’Imari, Taro Aso, guverineri wa Banki Nkuru y’icyo gihugu, Haruhiko Kuroda n’abandi bayobozi bakomeye ba guverinoma n’ibigo by’imari. U Buyapani ni cyo gihugu cya kabiri gishyira amafaranga mu Kigega cy’Iterambere rya Afurika, ADF, nyuma ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Iki gihugu ni nacyo cya gatatu gifite imigabane myinshi muri AfDB nyuma ya Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika na Nigeria. AfDB yari imaze imyaka icumi iyobowe na Donald Kaberuka wasimbuwe na Akinwumi Adesina. Iyi banki yafunguye ishami ryayo mu murwa mukuru w’u Buyapani, Tokyo mu Ukwakira 2012.  SRC:Imvaho

label: economy
title: Inguzanyo zitangwa n’ibigo by’imari zazamutseho 10.6%
content:
Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda ubwo yashyiraga ahagaraga imiterere ya politiki no gucunga agaciro k’ifaranga ry’u Rwanda, hatangajwe ko inguzanyo zitangwa n’ibigo by’imari mu Rwanda zazamutseho 10.6%. Guverineri wa Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda John Rwangombwa, yatangaje ko inguzanyo nshya zemewe gutangwa n’ibigo by’imari ugereranyije n’ibyifuzo byakiriwe zazamutse ku gipimo cya 10.6%. Ibi bikaba ngo byaratumye hiyongera inguzanyo zihabwa abikorera ku gipimo cya 25.3% kugeza mu kwezi kwa Gicurasi hagereranyijwe n’izamuka rya 15.8% mu gihe nk’iki mu mwaka ushize wa 2014. 

 Rwangobwa John umuyobozi wa banke yu rwanda   Dr Thomas Kigabo ushinzwe ubukungu muri Banki Nkuru y’u Rwanda, yavuzeko ibi byatumye habaho izamuka ry’ibiciro cyane cyane mu kwezi gushize kwa gatanu nubwo biri munsi y’umurongo BNR yihaye. Byatumye kandi ishoramari ryiyongera binongera ibyifuzo by’abaguzi ari byo byatumye ibiciro byiyongera. Icyegeranyo cy’Ikigo cy’Igihugu cy’Ibarurishamibare kigaragaza ihindagurika ry’ibiciro giherutse gushyirwa ahagaragara, cyerekana ko ibiciro bikomatanyirijwe hamwe (mu mijyi no mu byaro) muri Gicurasi 2015, ibiciro mu Rwanda byiyongereyeho 1,6% ugereranyije na Gicurasi 2014. Naho hagereranyijwe Gicurasi na Mata 2015, ibiciro byazamutseho 0,1%.

label: economy
title: RwandAir yaguze indege ya munani
content:
Sosiyete itwara abantu n’ibintu mu kirere ‘RwandAir’ yabonye indege yayo ya munani biyiha ubushobozi bwo gutwara abagenzi barenga 800 icya rimwe. Indege nshya yo mu bwoko bwa Bombardier Q400 Next Gen yageze mu Rwanda kuri uyu wa Kane ahagana saa 17:15 ivuye muri Canada, ni iya Kabiri yo muri ubu bwoko iyi sosiyete ifite nyuma y’indi imwe yari isanganwe. 

Bombardier Q400 Next Gen yaguzwe na Leta y’u Rwanda muri gahunda zo gufasha RwandAir kwagura ingendo yari isanzwe ikora hirya no hino muri Afurika. Iyi ndege y’imyanya 67 ifite ubushobozi bwo gukora ingendo ngufi z’ahantu h’amasaha agera kuri atatu ashobora no kurenga ariko akenshi ikora neza iyo ari urugendo rutayisaba kurenza amasaha ane. Umuyobozi mukuru wa RwandAir, John Mirenge, avuga ko iyi ndege igiye gufasha iyi kompanyi gukora ingendo mu bindi bice itari isanzwe igeramo. Yagize ati “ Biraduha izindi mbaraga zo kongera kujya mu yindi mijyi tutashoboraga kujyamo kuko iyo ufite indege biguha imbaraga zo kuba wagera n’ahandi utageraga.” Iyo sosiyete irateganya kwagura ingendo zayo igatangira kujya i Luanda muri Angola, i Harare muri Zimbabwe, Bamako muri Mali, Khartoum muri Sudani n’ahandi. Umunyamabanga wa Leta ushinzwe ubwikorezi muri Minisiteri y’ibikorwa Remezo, Dr Alexis Nzahabwanimana, avuga ko Leta izakomeza gufasha RwandAir mu bikorwa byo kwagura ingendo yakoraga. Yagize ati “ RwandAir ni ikigo gikora neza gikorera ibintu ku gihe, gishimwa n’abagenzi n’Imiryango Mpuzamahanga mu by’indege niyo mpamvu muri Leta dukomeza gukora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo itere imbere tuyifasha kugura izindi ndege kugira ngo yagure aho ikorera, yagure ingendo kuko nibwo izashobora gukora neza no kurushaho kwishakamo ubushobozi.” Air Bus ishobora gutwara abarenga 200 yitezwe umwaka utaha Iyi sosiyete yiteze kuzabona izindi ndege ebyiri nini kurusha izo yari isanganwe zo mu bwoko bwa Air Bus 330 zizagera mu Rwanda kuva muri Nzeli 2016 bityo ibashe gukora ingendo ku yindi migabane yo ku Isi. Izo Air Bus zitezwe mu mwaka utaha imwe izaba ifite ubushobozi bwo gutwara abagenzi 244, indi itwara 274. Kugeza ubu, indege nini RwandAir ifite ishobora gutwara abagenzi 154. 
Bombardier Q400 Next Gen yiyongereye ku zindi zirindwi RwandAir yari ifite biha iyi sosiyete ubushobozi bwo gutwara abagenzi 832 icya rimwe.

label: economy
title: Azam TV yatangije ibikorwa byayo mu Rwanda
content:
Ikigo cya Azam TV gitanga serivisi zijyanye n’ibijyanye no kugeza ku bafatabuguzi amashene ya televiziyo yaba ayo mu gihugu, mu karere ndetse no ku isi yose cyatangijwe ku mugaragaro mu Rwanda. 

Iki kigo gitanga serivisi za televiziyo ikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya satellite ni kimwe mu bigo bifite ifatabuguzi rihendutse, rifasha abantu kubona amashene ya televiziyo menshi haba ayo mu gihugu, mu karere ndetse no ku isi yose. Ikigo cya Azam TV gikorera mu Rwanda ku izina rya Azam Media (R) Limited, kikaba gifite ikicaro I Remera ku Gisimenti ubu kikaba gitanga dekoderi zifasha kubona amashene ya televiziyo yose akenewe ku isoko, ndetse ku mafaranga make angana n’ibihumbi 30 y’u Rwanda akaba aguhesha kubona dekoderi, ikarita y’ifatabuguzi, ndetse n’igisahani (antenne parabolique) kigufasha kubona amashene menshi n’amashusho meza. Ifatabuguzi rya Azam TV kandi rikugezaho amashene asaga 140 arimo ay’igifaransa n’icyongereza, ndetse hakaba hariho bouquet idasanzwe y’igihinde ku mafaranga 15,000 y’u Rwanda gusa ku kwezi. 

 Azam TV yatangijwe ku mugaragaro mu Rwanda  Mu rwego rwo korohereza abafatabuguzi bayo, ushobora kugura bouquet zo mu rurimi rw’igifaransa no mu cyongereza mu buryo butandukanye ku mafaranga 6500 ku z’ururimi rw’icyongereza buri kwezi ndetse n’9000 ku z’igifaransa ukabasha kubona amashene arenga 80 kuri bouquets z’icyongereza ndetse n’amashene asaga 60 kuri bouquets z’igifaransa. Nk’uko bisobanurwa n’ubuyobozi bwa Bakhresa Group ari nayo ifite Azam TV mu biganza byayo, bazanye izi serivisi mu Rwanda mu rwego rwo guteza imbere isakazamakuru rya televiziyo muri iki gihugu. Bakhresa Mounir, umuyobozi wa Azam TV mu Rwanda yagize ati: “Turifuza u Rwanda aho buri muntu wese azajya abasha kureba ibiganiro byiza, amakuru yifuza ndetse no kwidagadura mu buryo bumworoheye ku mashene yifuza yaba ayo mu Rwanda, mu karere ndetse no hirya no hino ku isi ku giciro gito gishoboka, binyuze ku ikoranabuhanga ryacu ryifashisha satellite mu kugeza amashene ku bantu aho bari hose.” Nk’uko imibare ibigaragaza, kugeza ubu Azam TV imaze kugurisha dekoderi zigera kuri 200 mu Rwanda, ikaba ifite abafatabuguzi bagera ku 270,000 mu karere ka Afurika y’uburasirazuba bose bavuga imyato serivisi zayo. 

 Azam TV yahageze!  Nk’uko Faradjallah Ndagano ushinzwe ibikorwa muri Azam TV Rwanda abivuga, iki kigo cyahuguye abakozi bacyo ku bijyanye n’imikoreshereze y’ifatabuguzi ryacyo ku buryo uguze ifatabuguzi rya Azam TV ahabwa umuntu wo kumufasha kuritangiza (installation), ndetse no ku bundi bufasha umukiliya akenera bwose, ku buryo umukiliya asabwa kwishyura amafaranga 40,000 yonyine y’u Rwanda agatangira kureba isi yose imbere ye mu gihe kitarenze umusi 1 gusa. Kuri ubu Azam TV yamaze gusinya amasezerano n’urugaga nyarwanda rw’umupira w’amaguru (FERWAFA) ku buryo imipira yose izajya inyuzwa kuri shene y’iyi televiziyo ya Azam 1 uhereye ku gikombe cy’amahoro uhereye mu

Nk’uko Faradjallah Ndagano ushinzwe ibikorwa muri Azam TV Rwanda abivuga, iki kigo cyahuguye abakozi bacyo ku bijyanye n’imikoreshereze y’ifatabuguzi ryacyo ku buryo uguze ifatabuguzi rya Azam TV ahabwa umuntu wo kumufasha kuritangiza (installation), ndetse no ku bundi bufasha umukiliya akenera bwose, ku buryo umukiliya asabwa kwishyura amafaranga 40,000 yonyine y’u Rwanda agatangira kureba isi yose imbere ye mu gihe kitarenze umusi 1 gusa. Kuri ubu Azam TV yamaze gusinya amasezerano n’urugaga nyarwanda rw’umupira w’amaguru (FERWAFA) ku buryo imipira yose izajya inyuzwa kuri shene y’iyi televiziyo ya Azam 1 uhereye ku gikombe cy’amahoro uhereye mu

label: economy
title: Hagiye gushyirwaho amakusanyirizo agena igiciro kimwe ku birayi
content: Ministeri y’ubucuruzi n’inganda iravuga ko hagomba gushyirwaho  amakusanyirizo y’ibirayi  hirya no hino  ku buryo igiciro cy’ibirayi kizajya kiba kimwe mu gihugu hose. Uyu ni umwanzuru watangejwe nyuma y’biganiro byagarutse kungorane abahinzi bahura nazo mu mwuga wabo birimo kugura imbuto bahenzwe bagatanga umusaruro kugiciro cyo hasi, gukomwa mu nkokora n’ibihe by’imvura umusaruro ukabora n’ibindi. Ni ibiganiro byahuje ,Minisiteri y’ubucuruzi n’inganda n’abahinzi, abacuruzi ndetse n’abikorera ku giti cyabo, hagamijwe gukemura ibyo bibazo ndetse n’akavuyo kaboneka mu bucuruzi bw’ibirayi bigatera ibihombo Hashize igihe abahinzi b’ibirayi binubira ko abacuruzi ba bagurira ku giciro cyo hasi kandi baraguze imbuto ibahenze,  bigatuma ubu bucuruzi bukorwa mu buryo bw’akajagari bikabatera igihombo. Muhawenimana Philippe ni umuhinzi wo mu karere ka Burera avuga ko hari abacuruzi bajya kurangura ibirayi mu bice  by’ibyaro,  maze bakishyura ku giciro cyohasi,  kuko abahinzi baba bashaka kwikuraho umusaruro ngo utababorana bakabyemera. Ati “abacuruzi  b’ibirayi baraza bakaduhenda kubera nta giciro gihamye ku kiro cy’ibirayi, bigatuma duhomba kandi natwe ntabwo twagumana umusaruro kuko wabora” Yanongeyeho ko hari iminzani abo bacuruzi bakoresha itujuje ubuziranenge ituma bibwa  ibiro bagakorera mu gihombo. Murebwayire Christine, umuyobozi uhagarariye abahinzi n’aborozi mu Rwanda mu rwego rw’abikorera yemeza ko uretse amakusanyirizo y’ibirayi ,  gukorera mu mashyirahamwe,bigiye gukemura ibi bazo bajyaga bahura nabyo bibahombya. Nyamara Leta yo ishimangira ko ku kibazo cy’iminzani, yazanye iyujuje ubuziranenge ku buryo mu bice byose ariyo ikoreshwa. Minisiteri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda François Kanimba yamaze impungenge aba bacuruzi, abahinzi ndetse n’abagura ibirayi bose kugirango birinde kugwa mu gihombo Ati” leta igiye gushyiraho amakusanyirizo y’ibirayi mu gihugu ndetse no ku rwego rw’igihugu ku buryo igiciro kizajya cyiba kimwe ku mwero w’ibirayi.” Yongeraho ko izi ngamba zo gushyiraho aya makusanyirizo bizafasha abacuruzi n’abahinzi b’ibirayi guhangana n’ikibazo cyabazamura ibiciro uko biboneye. Ikindi kandi ,  ibi bizatuma umusaruro w’iyongera habeho kwihaza mu biribwa no gusagurira amasoko. Ku biciro , abitabiriye ibi biganiro  bumvikanye ko umuhinzi yajya agurirwa nibura ku mafaranga 140 ku kilo mu makusanyirizo yo mu turere naho ikusanyirizo ry’i Kigali rikabagurira ku 150 ku kilo ariko ibi bikaba ari iby’agateganyo. Ibi biganiro byanzuye ko umugabane nshingiro wo kujya mu ihuriro rikusanya ibirayi ari ibihumbi 300, ukaguramo imigabane 10 bingana na miliyoni eshatu ariko ugatanga kimwe cya cumi (1/10)andi ukaba wayishyura mu myaka ibiri.

label: economy
title: Uturere ducunga umutungo nabi twakuriwe inzira ku murima
content:
Minisitiri w’Imari n’Igenamigambi, Amb. Gatete Claver, yasabye abahagarariye uturere guharanira imicungire myiza y’umutungo wa Leta, kuko nta karere kazongera guhabwa amafaranga katagaragaje ko kacunze neza imari n’umutungo bya Leta gafite. 

 Minisitiri Gatete atangiza iyo nama  Ibyo bikubiye mu butumwa Minisitiri Gatete Claver yagejeje ku bayobozi bahagarariye uturere 30, mu nama barimo i Kigali, mu gihe cy’iminsi itanu barimo. Muri iyo nama bari  guhabwa amasomo yihariye  ku bufatanye bwa Banki y’Isi,  n’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’Abibumbye ryita ku miturire, (UN HABITAT) ku birebana n’uburyo bushya bwo kubona amafaranga azajya yifashishwa mu mishinga igamije guteza imbere uturere n’imijyi byabo, batagombye gutegereza ingengo y’imari  Leta ibagenera iturutse muri guverinoma. Minisitiri Gatete yagize ati  “Ubusanzwe muzi ko uturere twabonaga amafaranga avuye mu misoro itangwa n’abaturage,  tukayakura mu ngengo y’imari twahabwaga na Leta.” “Ubumenyi barimo kunguka muri aya mahugurwa buzafasha abahagarariye uturere kubona amafaranga aturutse no mu zindi nzego, dusanga ari ubumenyi buzafasha uturere kwihutisha iterambere ryatwo kuko tuzaba dufite ubumenyi bwo kwaka no gukoresha neza inguzanyo kandi bakibeshaho ubwabo badategereje Leta, cyangwa abandi baterankunga.” Umuyobozi wungirije w’Ishami ry’Umuryango w’abibumbye ryita ku miturire, Dr. Aisa Kirabo Kakira, yavuze ko ubumenyi abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze barimo guhabwa buzabafasha kwihutisha iterambere ry’igihugu cyane ko u Rwanda ari igihugu kirimo kwiyubaka kizi aho kivuye naho kigeze. Visi Meya w’akarere ka Kirehe wungirije ushinzwe Iterambere ry’Ubukungu, Tihabyona Jean de Dieu, asanga ubumenyi  azunguka buzamufasha mu kunoza imishinga y’iterambere. Ati “Tugiye gufatanya n’abikorera tunoza imishinga myiza tuyifashishe kwaka inguzanyo. Kuko dore nk’ubu twe hari Sosiyete  twatangije yitwa Kirehe Investment Group ifite imishinga imwe n’imwe nk’Isoko rya Kijyambere n’ibindi, ubu buryo buje kutwunganira kunoza ibyatuberaga inziti kugeraho’’.  SRC:Imvaho

label: economy
title: Kubera ibihe bibi irimo SONARWA  ntigishaka gutanga amakuru
content:
Mu gihe hashize iminsi muri sosiyete y’ubwishingizi SONARWA havugwa uruntu runtu mu mikorere yayo no mubakozi bayo bwite,Ikinyamakuru indatwa cyashatse kubamenyera byimbitse ibyaya makuru gikomwa mu nkokora nabamwe mu bakozi yabo yashinzwe gutanga amakuru.
 
 Uruntu runtu rukaba ruturuka ku mikorere bivugwa ko idahitwe iyi sosiyete igeza kubayigana, aho usanga itagitanga serivise zinoze ndetse no kwita kubazo bazo baherereye hirya no hino mu gihugu. Amakuru twahawe na bamwe mu bakozi babarizwa muri iki kigo cy’ubwishingizi cya SONARWA bavuga ko kw’ibwigihombo ikigo cyabo kiri kujyamo biturutse kumicungire mibi y’abamwe mu bayobozi bakuru, kuri ubu abakozi bari kujyenda bagabanwa buhoro buhoro. Aba bakozi bakomeza bavuga ko, kuri ubu bashyiriweho ibizamini, bibemerera gukomeza gukora akazi kabo muri SONARWA, ibi abakozi bakabibonamo nkuburyo bwo kubananiza ngo babashe kwirukanwa. Bavuga ko kuva ikigo cyakwegurirwa abikorera, cyajyiye kibahugura kuburyo buhagije, kikabaha na zimwe mu nyigisho zijyendanye n’igihe, ibi bikaba byaratumye n’ikigo gitera imbere mu buryo bugaragara, nyuma abakozi bavuga ko hajemo kwirara no gusesagura umutungo w’ikigo aribyo byakiviriyemo kubaho uko kiriho ubu.
Abakozi bavuga ko kubazahereweho bakoreshwa ibizamini, ari abakozi bakora muri serivise zitanga ubwishingizi. Ikinyamakuru Indatwa cyakurikiranye aya makuru, gishaka kuvugana n’abashimnzwe gutanga amakuru muri iki kigo ntibabasha kuduha amakuru, kuko uko Ikinyamakuru cyakaga umwanya ngo gihabwe amakuru cyitabiraga isaha cyabaga cyahawe, abagitumijeho ngo bagihe amakuru ntibabe bahari, cyabasaba kuyaka mu buryo bw’inyandiko nabwo nibyabyemere, kugeza ubwo dutangaje iyi nkuru uretse ko nubu tugitegereje icyo bazatubwiraho n’ubwo hashize igihe cy’ukwezi n’igice tukibaka umwanya wo kubonana nabo ngo baduhe amakuru kuri ibi bivugwa muri SONARWA. Ku bindi bivugwa muri iki kigo, bivugwa ko aribyo byagiteye igihombo harimo aho SONARWA yategetswe guha miliyoni 69 Special Guarantee Fund, aho Urukiko rw’Ikirenga kuwa 8 Werurwe 2013  rwategetse ko sosiyete y’ubwishingizi SONARWA  guha miliyoni 69 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda ikigega cy’ingoboka “Special Guarantee Fund”. Ibi byavuye mu rubanza SONARWA na COGEAR zaburanaga n’iki kigega ku kuba hari imisanzu y’ubwishingizi ku binyabiziga izi sosiyete zitatanze. SONARWA yo yari yaregewe miliyoni 121 mu Rukiko Rukuru, maze Special Guarantee Fund itsindira miliyoni 145 ariko na yo itanga ikirego ku mafaranga yagombaga kwishyurwa igihe yayoboraga kiriya kigega ari yo yakira imisoro y’ubwishingizi angana na miliyoni 52. Kuri iki kibazo urukiko rwemeje ko SONARWA iha Special Guarantee Fund miliyoni 145, iki kigaga na cyo kigaha SONARWA miliyoni 52. Icyo gihe bose barajuriye bituma ku wa gatanu tariki ya 8 werurwe 2013, urukiko ruvuga ko Special Guarantee Fund batsindiye miliyoni 121 baregeye bakanishyura SONARWA miliyoni 52, bivuze ko SONARWA izaha Special Guarantee Fund miliyoni 69 nyuma y’ uko batsindaguranye. SONARWA kandi yategetse kwishyura miliyoni 380 ibi  bikaba byarategetswe n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge rwatangije urubanza imiryango 18 Iregamo Sosiyete y’Ubwishingizi ya SONARWA iyisaba miliyoni 380 z’amafaranga y’u Rwanda, bakaba basaba   Banki ya Kigali kubaha ayo mafaranga kuko ariyo ifite amakonti ya SONARWA. Muri uko kubaka uwo muhanda byabaye ngombwa ko hasenywa amazu 44 ndetse abantu 184 bo mu miryango 18 barimurwa, ariko ntibahabwa ibyo bagenerwa n’amategeko niko kugana ubutabera. Ku yandi makuu tukibakuririrana aravuga ko kubera ibi bihe SONARWA irimo inengwa n’abaturage ku kutishyura abafashe ubwishingizi bw’ubuhinzi.

label: economy
title: Ibiciro by’ibicuruzwa bikomeje guhananuka hirya no hino ku masoko
content:
Mu gihe gishize ibicuruzwa byari byarazamutse ku masoko y’u Rwanda aho ibirayi kuri ubu ibicuruzwa biri ku giciro gito cyane nkuko byemezwa n’abaguzi batandukanye baganiriye n’ikinyamakuru The new times.  Kuri ubu ikiro cy’ibirayi igiciro kiri hagati y’amafarangs 130 n’150 mu gihe mu minsi ishize cyari ku mafaranga 200 mu mujyi wa Kigali. Hari naho amwe mu masoko atandukanye, harimo ayo mu Gakenke, Base, Kinigi, Musanze, Byangabo ndetse na Rubavu ikiro kigura hagati y’amafaranga 50 na80. Ikiro cy’amashaza kigeze hagati y’amafaranga 500 na800, ku masoko ya Nyarugenge, Kimironko, Kicukiro ndetse na kabuga. title: Nyabihu : Ubujura mu mirima y’ibirayi butuma bamwe bahasiga ubuzima
content: Abibumbiye mu matsinda ashinzwe kurinda imirima y’ibirayi mu Karere ka Nyabihu, biravugwa ko iyo bafashe umujura bakubitwa bikomeye bikamuvira urupfu. Bamwe mu baturage bo mu Karere ka Nyabihu, mu Murenge wa Bigobwe, Akagari ka Kora, Umudugudu wa Rwankuba bavuga ko batewe impungenge n’uburyo abo barinzi bihanira bikomeye. Umwe mu baturage yagize ati “Muri uku kwezi k’Ukwakira gusa hamaze gupfa abajura bane, uwa nyuma bamuhabye ejo[kuwa Gatatu]. Hari umusore witwa Toto ukomoka mu Kagari ka Kora, mu Mudugudu wa Rwankuba baherutse gutesha mu mirima itatu bamufatira mu murima wa kane, baramukubita kugeza ashizemo umwuka twamuhabye ku cyumweru gishize.” Abashinzwe kurinda imirima y’ibirayi bashyizweho n’abaturage babisabwe n’Akarere. Uwo muturage mu baganiriye na IGIHE yagize ati”Ubuyobozi bw’Akarere bwasabye abaturage ko bakora urutonde rw’ibisambo kabuhariwe, urutonde rwarakozwe, barwohereza ku karere. Bahise badusaba gukora urundi rutonde rw’abantu tubona ko bazajya barinda imirima kugira ngo bahashye abajura biba ibirayi, urwo rutonde rugizwe n’abantu15 bibumbiye muri buri mudugudu.” Iyo abashizwe kurinda ibirayi bafashe umujura ngo ntibirwa bamujyana ku buyobozi cyangwa kuri Polisi baramukubita udahise apfa, nyuma y’igihe gito arapfa. Niyibizi Louis, Umunyamabanga Nshingwabikorwa w’Umurenge wa Bigongwe yatangarije IGIHE ko hamaze gupfa umuntu umwe, ariko uwo umwe atandukanye n’uwo abaturage batubwiye uzwi ku izina rya « Toto » Yagize ati’’Hamaze gupfa umuntu umwe yishwe n’abarinzi b’imirima y’ibirayi. » Umuvugizi wa Polisi mu ntara y’Uburengerazuba, Supt Amza Vita yatangarije IGIHE ko amakuru bafite ari ayu muntu umwe umaze kwicwa. Yagize ati”Tariki ya kabiri Ugushyingo nibwo twamenye amakuru y’uwitwa Ayurukundo Jean d’Amour ari mu kigero cy’imyaka 28 wishwe, amakuru dufite kugeza ubu avuga ko uwo muntu yari mu birayi, agakubitwa na ba nyir’imirima arapfa. Iperereza rirakomeje. » Vita akomeza agira ati « Icyo twabwira abaturage ni uko icyaha kidakemurwa no gukora ikindi cyaha, hari inzira binyuramo kandi hari inzego zishinzwe guhana abanyabyaha hakurikijwe amategeko.” Polisi kandi yiyama abaturage bashaka kurya ibyo batavunikiye, aho guhaguruka ngo bakore. Inkuru ya Igihe

label: economy
title: Ibiciro bya Mützig, Guiness na Amstel byazamutse
content:
Guhera kuwa 01 Kamena 2013, uruganda rutunganya ibinyobwa bisembuye n’ibinyamitobe BRALIRWA (Brasseries et Limonaderies du Rwanda), rwazamuye ibiciro bya bimwe mu binyobwa byarwo bisembuye. Ibyo binyobwa ni  Mützig ya santilitiro 33 na 65cl, Amstel cl 33 ndetse na Guinness cl 33.


 Mützig (33cl) yaguraga amafaranga y’u Rwanda 450 izajya igura amafaranga 500, mu gihe inini ya 65cl izajya igura amafaranga 1000 ivuye ku mafaranga 900; inzoga ya Guinness 33cl izajya igura 750 frw ivuye ku mafaranga 650, naho Amstel ya 33cl igure amafaranga 600.  Umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi no gushaka amasoko muri Bralirwa, Jan Van Velzen, aravuga ko ibyo binyobwa byazamutse kubera imihindagurikire y’ibiciro ku isoko, amafaranga y’urugendo yiyongereye ndetse n’ikiguzi cy’ingufu zikoreshwa mu kwenga izo nzoga cyazamutse. Mu kiganiro n’ikinyamakuru Izuba Rirashe, umwe mu bakiriya ba Bralirwa witwa Ngendahimana Pierre yavuze ko akunda kunywa Mützig kandi ko kuba igiciro cyayo cyazamutse bitazatuma ayireka, ngo ntacyo  bizamubangamiraho.  Izindi nzoga zicuruzwa na Bralirwa zitazamuriwe ibiciro harimo Primus, Heineken ndetse na Turbo King.  Uruganda rwa Bralirwa rwashinzwe muri 1957, rutangira gutunganya ibinyobwa bisembuye mu mwaka wa 1959, ndetse n’ibidasembuye muri 1974.  Kuva muri 1971, ikigo cy’ubucuruzi Heineken Group, gifitemo imigabane ingana na 75%, mu gihe 25% iri mu isoko ry’imari n’imigabane. Sitio NDOLI gihamya.com

title: Umugabo mwiza aba ameze ate?
content:
Nyuma yo kubona ibimenyetso bigaragaza umugore mwiza, dore noneho ibimenyetso bigaragaza umugabo mwiza.
 1.	UMUGABO WUBAHA UMUGORE AKAMUHA AGACIRO Umugabo mwiza ni uwubaha umugore, akamugira umujyanama we muri byose, kandi ntagire umwanzuro n’umwe afata atamugishije inama; mbese akumva ko umugore we ari umuntu w’igiciro cyinshi imbere ye. Kandi iteka ryose iyo ugisha inama uba witeguye no kuba wahindura imigambi bitewe n’ibyo ukura mu nama baguha.  2.	UMUGABO UFATA INSHINGANO Z’URUGO NK’IZE Umugabo agomba kumenya ko inshingano zo gutunga urugo ari ize, akamenya ko kurya no kwambara by’umugore n’abana byose bimureba, ndetse akamenya ko iterambere ry’urugo ryose riri kumutwe we, naho umugore akaza ari umufasha. Mwibuke ko mu miruho Imana yaraze Eva, kurya yiyushye icyuya ntibirimo; ahubwo uwo muruho Imana yawuraze Adamu; byumvikane rero ko abagabo bagomba kuvunikira abagore n’abana babashakira ibibatunga, naho umugore akaba umufasha w’umugabo (akunganira umugabo).  3.	UMUGABO WITA KUNSHINGANO ZO MU BURIRI Umugabo agomba kumenya ko umugore atazanwe no kurya, kunywa, kwambara cyangwa kuba mu mazu meza (n’ubwo nabyo biba bikenewe), kuko hari igihe aba yaravuye iwabo asize ibiruta ibyo yaje asanga, akemera kuza kubana nawe. Ugomba rero kumwitaho, ukamumara inzara n’inyota kubyo yaje ashaka, kuburyo atazaba mu buzima bwo kwifuza umugabo kandi amufite.  Src: notrefamille.com

label: entertainment
title: Umujinya ukomeye kuri Chameleone wahawe akato muri Uganda
content:
Umuririmbyi Joseph Mayanja [Jose Chameleone] yongeye kugarukwaho mu itangazamakuru avugwa mu bibazo n’ubushyamirane biturutse ku nshyi yakubise umwe mu ba Dj bakomeye muri Uganda bimushyira mu bibazo bikomeye cyane. Indirimbo za Chameleone zahagaritswe mu tubyiniro, utubari n’inzu z’imyidagaduro muri Uganda nyuma y’uko mu minsi yashize yagiye mu kabyiniro ahondagura umwe mu basore bavanga imiziki amuziza ko ‘ngo yanze gucuranga indirimbo ze’. 
 Utubyiniro Cahmeleone ajyamo twose aba yifuza ko bacuranga indirimbo ze gusa Dj yabyanga bakarwana. Iyi foto igaragaza Chameleone ubwo aheruka kuza i Kigali, hano yari mu kabyiniro kitwa Plus 250  Chimp Reports itangaza ko Chameleone yahise afatirwa ibihano bikarishye birimo guhagarika ibihangano bye no kutazongera kubicuranga mu nzu z’imyidagaduro kugeza igihe azasabira imbabazi ishyirahamwe ry’abavanga imiziki muri Uganda. Mu byumweru bibiri bishize Chameleone yagiye mu kabyiniro kitwa Club Play akubita Dj Bryan nyuma y’intonganya zavutse hagati y’aba bombi. Uyu muhanzi ngo yabwiye Dj Bryan ko akwiye ‘kuzirikana gucuranga indirimbo ze’ undi na we amubwira ko acuranga iby’abanywi bifuza; umujinya wasagutse Chameleone ahita amufata mu ijosi amutera imigeri n’inshyi. Ubu bushyamirane bwakurikiwe n’uko ishyirahamwe ry’abavanga imiziki muri Uganda ryahise ryanzura ko ibihangano bya Chameleone bigomba guhabwa akato, iki cyemezo cyaje gisanga icyari giherutse gufatwa n’akabyiniro kitwa Club Guvnor ko uyu muhanzi atemerewe kuzongera kuhakandagiza ikirenge kuko iteka iyo ahaje arwana n’abakiriya. Televiziyo nshya ya Trace Mziki [ishami rya Trace Urban rikorera muri Afurika y’Uburasirazuba] na yo yafashe umwanzuro ko ibihangano bya Chameleone bitazongera gutambutswa kuko yakubise umu Dj. Chameleone wakunzwe mu ndirimbo “Wale Wale” akibona iryo tangazo kuri Instagram ya Trace Mziki yahise yikoma iki gitangazamakuru n’ubuyobozi bwacyo avuga ko ‘kibiba amacakubiri mu bahanzi ba Afurika kandi cyagakwiye guhuza uyu mugabane biciye mu buhanzi’. Yanditse kuri Facebook amagambo yuzuyemo umujinya avuga ko imyaka irenga 16 amaze aririmba agikunzwe ndetse ko ibyo yagezeho byose atabikesha impuhwe z’abameze nka Trace Mziki ahubwo ko bituruka mu baturage biyumva mu byo aririmba. Umwiryane na Televiziyo ya Trace Mziki Yagize ati “Igisebo kuri Trace Mziki, murakwirakwiza urwangano aho gutanga urugero muhuza Afurika biciye mu muziki. Ubunyamwuga ntabwo ari gutya bugaragara, maze imyaka 16 ndiho atari ku bw’impuhwe cyangwa ikindi. Ni abafana banjye n’Imana yampaye igikundiro.”

“Umuntu uri gukora iyamamaza bikorwa hano ntabwo ari kubahesha agaciro nka Trace, twebwe abakora umuziki twatekerezaga ko mugiye kutuzamura none mutangiye kutuzanamo amacakubiri n’ibindi bitandukanye. Twishimiye kuza kwanyu ariko niba iyi ari yo nzira, ngiye gusubira ku ishuri nige neza hanyuma nze nshake akazi.” Yongeyeho ko Televiziyo ya Trace Mziki idateze kuzatera imbere no kumenyekana mu gihe idashaka gukorana n’abahanzi bashije ikibanza cy’umuziki Afurika ifite muri iki gihe. Ati “Ntaho mwagera niba mudashaka gukorana n’abakinnyi b’imena, twakoreye uru ruganda[rw’umuziki] turanaruzamura duhereye ku busa. Iyo tudakora nka Afurika y’Uburasirazuba yihuje ntabwo mwari gutekereza gushaka isoko muri iki gice.” Chameleone yanavuze ko Trace Mziki nititonda izasenyuka bidatinze ndetse yikomeye ubuyobozi bwayo ko atazigera na rimwe apfukama imbere yabo asaba ko bacuranga ibihangano bye.

title: Juliana Kanyomozi agiye kwihoza amarira yatewe n’imfura ye iherutse kwitaba Imana
content: Umuhanzikazi wo mu gihugu cya Uganda Juliana Kanyomozi aritegura kubyara undi mwana nyuma y’aho imfura ye yitabye Imana. Mu kwezi kwa Nyakanga 2015 ni bwo umuhanzikazi wo muri Uganda Juliana Kanyomozi yabuze umwana we w’imfura wari ufite imyaka 11 Keron Raphael aho yitabye Imana azize indwara ya Asima.

title: Umukobwa wa Senderi yinjiye muri muzika ashyira hanze indirimbo ye ku mazina y’ubuhanzi “Kevin Hit”
content:
Umukobwa wa Senderi International Hit w’imyaka 12 y’amavuko, yinjiye muri muzika nyarwanda anashyira hanze indirimbo ye ya mbere, ahita afata izina ry’ubuhanzi rya Kevine Hit, anatangaza ingamba afite muri muzika nyarwanda ateganya gufatanya n’amasomo ntibimubuze kuba uwa mbere. 

Umwaka wa 2016, ni umwaka umuryango wa Senderi International Hit wungutsemo umuhanzi mushya, uyu akaba ari umukobwa wa Senderi International Hit witwa Keza Kevin wamaze gushyira hanze indirimbo ye ya mbere akanatangaza ko izina rya ry’ubuhanzi ari Kevine Hit. Mu kiganiro Kevine Hit yagiranye n’umunyamakuru wa Inyarwanda.com ubwo yashyiraga ku mugaragaro indirimbo ye ya mbere yise “Icyizere”, yavuze ko ubu yinjiye muri muzika kandi ashaka kuzakomeza akazaba umuhanzikazi w’icyamamare, ariko agashyira imbere amasomo ye ntibimubuze gukomeza kuba umuhanga mu ishuri nk’uko bisanzwe. Kevin Hit ugiye kwimukira mu mwaka wa Gatandatu w’amashuri abanza mu kigo giherereye i Kayonza, avuga ko kuva yatangira amashuri abanza umwanya wa kure yabaye mu ishuri ari uwa kabiri, ubusanzwe akaba yibera uwa mbere kandi ibi akemeza ko bizanakomeza gutyo kuko atazemera ko umuziki wamurangaza ngo umubuze kwiga, ahubwo akaba azajya aha umwanya muzika mu gihe cy’ibiruhoko bikamufasha no kuruhuka mu mutwe. Kevin Hit avuga ko indirimbo za se akunda ari iyitwa Tekana ndetse n’iyitwa Icyomoro, mu bahanzikazi nyarwanda akaba akunda cyane Butera Knowless ariko umuhanzi ashaka kuzakurikiza akaba ari Tom Close kuko nawe yifuza kuzaminuza akaba umuganga ariko akabifatanya na muzika nk’uko Tom Close yabigezeho.

label: entertainment
title: Lil G yateye utwatsi umukobwa babyaranye
content:
Ku myaka 21 y’amavuko Karangwa Lionel wamenyekanye cyane nka Lil G muri muzika nyarwanda, yashimangiye ko kuba yarabyaranye n’umukobwa nta tegeko rimutegeka kuba bashyingiranwa. 
 Lil G n’umwana we wimfura yabyaranye n’umukobwa avuga ko batazabana  Ni nyuma y’aho uyu muhanzi ashyiriye hanze indirimbo yise ‘Ese ujya unkumbura’ avuga ko yayihimbiye umukobwa bigeze gukundanaho bakaza kuburana. Mu kiganiro na Isango Star, Lil G yatangaje ko mu gihe cyose amaze ku isi atari yabona umukobwa n’umwe usa n’uwo bakundanyeho bakaza gutandukana bitewe n’umuryango we. Yagize ati “Nakoze iyi ndirimbo kubera ko nabuze ahantu nakura amakuru yerekeranye n’uwo mukobwa twakundanye. Kubera ko sinzi niba nzongera kubona umukobwa nkunda muri njye. Nibuka ko uwo mukobwa twahuye bwa mbere muri 2009 ubwo Meddy yashyiraga hanze album yise AMAYOBERA. Nyuma yaho turakomeza turakundana. Mu rugo i wabo byaje kubageraho kubera guhora batubona mu itangazamakuru bituma bamumpisha tuburana gutyo. Gusa ndibaza ko iyi ndirimbo aramutse ayumvishe aho yaba ari hose yakumva ko mukumbuye kandi nkimukunda. Ibyo kuba narabyaye rero, ntabwo twabyaranye ngo tuzabane akaramata. Oyaaaaaa!!!Ni ibintu byatugwiririye kandi bisanzwe bibaho mu buzima”. Lil G yamenyekanye cyane mu ndirimbo yitwa ‘Nimba umugabo’ yakoranye na Meddy. Nyuma aza gukomeza gukora izindi zatumye arushaho kumenyaka nk’umuhanzi ukuri umwana.  Indatwa.net
